en.description: Activations are scattered across frequency, fragments within several proper names or terms, the code operator ==, and the biomedical word aggregation. Apart from frequency, which recurs across multiple technical passages, the others are mostly singletons; no unified semantic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: frequency substring within a word
patterns.context: When the English word frequency appears, it is strongly marked. It may occur in technical descriptions or papers, with surrounding context that does not constrain it to a single topic.

patterns.name: aye at the end of a person's name
patterns.context: In the name Alec MacKaye, strong activation falls on the surname-final aye; the name appears repeatedly.

patterns.name: Code comparison operator
patterns.context: Matches or branches on the comparison operator == in code. The same passage also contains operators such as <<, >>>, and ^, but the activation peak is on ==.

patterns.name: salicylanilides within a proper term

patterns.name: Greenies within a product name
patterns.context: In the phrase Feline Greenies Ocean Fish Cat Treats, the peak falls on the final fragment ies in Greenies.

patterns.name: Aggregation-related word
patterns.context: The word aggregation activates most strongly in discussions of protein aggregation, viral inclusion bodies, or cytotoxicity.

patterns.name: 瑞典语介词短语片段
patterns.context: med tanke på（考虑到）中的 med；处于瑞典语议会发言、气候议题上下文。

patterns.name: Medals 中的 Med
patterns.context: Med 是英语复数名词 medals 的词首，谈及勋章与军事荣誉。

en.description: Primarily responds to the contiguous English characters pen, whether at the beginning or within a word or across word-meaning fragments; there are also a few scattered weak activations on punctuation, line breaks, IRC markers, and other tokens, with no unified condition.

patterns.name: English substring pen
patterns.context: Activation centers on the contiguous character substring pen. It occurs in different words or word fragments, including WebSockets project name «pen»alosa, drug term inter«pen»etrating, string «pen»etration_testing, «pen» tags, ri«pen», «pen»-based, and diter«pen»oids. There is no unified meaning or word-boundary requirement.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English text: technology, medicine, Q&A, blogs, gardening, encyclopedias

patterns.name: Punctuation and formatting tokens
patterns.context: In a few passages, activation falls on formatting/punctuation tokens such as colons, line breaks, or tildes; these positions have no shared local semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Code snippets, chat logs, webpage text formatting

patterns.name: IRC chat tokens
patterns.context: Usernames, angle-bracket speaker markers, and nearby tokens in chat logs activate; [6] and [9] are both Ubuntu IRC, but the specific marked strings differ.

patterns.name: Scattered short words and code tokens
patterns.context: These tokens are scattered across passages, with relatively weak local activation and no stable co-occurrence or clear shared semantic or syntactic condition; they should not be merged into the main pen substring pattern.
patterns.domain: Technical text, biomedical abstracts, code, chat, and general English

1_16.description: 主要响应英文中的连续字符 pen，不论它位于词首、词中或跨词义词片段；另有少量标点、换行、IRC 标记及分散的弱 token 激活，缺少统一条件。

patterns.name: 英文子串 pen
patterns.context: 激活集中在 pen 这一连续字符子串；它出现在 WebSockets 项目名 «pen»alosa、药物 inter«pen»etrating、字符串 «pen»etration_testing、«pen» 标签、ri«pen»、«pen»-based、diter«pen»oids 等不同词或词片段中。没有统一的词义或词边界要求。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文文本：技术、医学、问答、博客、园艺、百科

patterns.name: 标点及格式 token
patterns.context: 少数段落中，激活落在冒号、换行或波浪线等格式/标点 token 上；这些位置没有共同的局部语义条件。
patterns.domain: 代码片段、聊天记录、网页文本格式

patterns.name: IRC 聊天 token
patterns.context: 聊天记录中的用户名、尖括号说话人标记及邻近 token 有激活；[6] 与 [9] 均为 Ubuntu IRC，但具体被标记的字符串不一致。

patterns.name: 零散短词与代码 token
patterns.context: 这些 token 分散在各段，局部激活较弱，彼此缺乏稳定共现或明确共享的语义、句法条件；不宜并入主要的 pen 子串模式。
patterns.domain: 技术文本、医学摘要、代码、聊天及一般英文

en.concept: Sentence-initial proper name or title term
en.description: The strongest and recurring trigger is the sentence-initial fragment “Steve,” regardless of whether it is followed by email body text, a name entry, or a list. There are also two cases of activation on terms before a colon in medical titles, marijuana and virus; both occur at the end of a title phrase.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial occurrence of the name Steve
patterns.context: Steve appears at the start of the passage, followed by a colon, comma, space, or line break; this is the primary pattern.
patterns.domain: Enron email, Wikipedia entry titles, and PubMed titles

patterns.name: marijuana followed by a colon in a title
patterns.context: At the end of the phrase “Medical marijuana:” in a medical title; activation centers on marijuana.

patterns.name: virus followed by a colon in a title
patterns.context: At the end of “Border disease virus:” in a disease-name title; activation centers on virus.

1_16.description: 最强且反复出现的触发是片段开头的人名“Steve”，不依赖其后是邮件正文、姓名条目或列表。另有两例医学标题中冒号前的术语 marijuana、virus 激活，二者均位于标题短语末尾。

patterns.name: 人名 Steve 的句首出现
patterns.context: Steve 位于片段开头，后面可接冒号、逗号、空格或换行；这是主要模式。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、Wikipedia 条目标题及 PubMed 标题

patterns.name: 标题中的 marijuana 后接冒号
patterns.context: 医学标题中短语“Medical marijuana:”的末尾；激活集中在 marijuana。

patterns.name: 标题中的 virus 后接冒号
patterns.context: 疾病名称标题中“Border disease virus:”的末尾；激活集中在 virus。

en.description: Strongly responds to the names Steve or Gary, especially the Steve sender label at the beginning of email lines and name beginnings in Wikipedia biographical titles or disambiguation entries; colons, surnames, and line breaks are common adjacent elements.

patterns.name: Beginning of the name Steve
patterns.context: The name Steve appears at the beginning of a line or as an email sender label; in email it is often followed by a colon introducing the body, but may also be followed by a comma or directly by a name or space.

patterns.name: Steve article title
patterns.context: Steve is the first name in a biographical article title, followed by a surname and parenthetical identity information, and ending with a line break.

patterns.name: Beginning of the name Gary
patterns.context: Gary is the first name in a biographical article title or subsequent entry name, commonly joined to a surname and followed by a line break; the surname may be split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia biographical entries and disambiguation pages

1_16.description: 强烈响应人名 Steve 或 Gary，尤其是邮件行首的 Steve 发件人标签，以及 Wikipedia 人物标题或消歧条目中的名字开头；冒号、姓氏和换行是常见邻接形式。

patterns.name: Steve 名字开头
patterns.context: 人名 Steve 作为行首或邮件发件人标签出现；邮件中常以冒号引出正文，也有逗号或直接接名字、空格。

patterns.name: Steve 条目标题
patterns.context: Steve 是人物条目标题的首名，后接姓氏及括号内身份说明，并以换行结束。

patterns.name: Gary 名字开头
patterns.context: Gary 作为人物条目标题或后续条目名的首名，常与姓氏相连并出现换行；姓氏可能拆分为多个 token。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物条目及消歧页面

en.description: The most consistent pattern is sentence-initial “Currently,” spanning patent, medical, and webpage passages. Other activations are scattered across technical terms, status descriptions, conversational email, legal citations, and programming titles, with no shared lexical or topical trigger condition.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Currently
patterns.context: A paragraph or sentence begins with “Currently,” followed by a statement about a current state, known technology, or present situation; the trigger does not depend on a specific topic.
patterns.domain: Patent background, medicine, webpages, and general explanatory prose

patterns.name: Technical/professional noun phrases
patterns.context: Professional descriptions of devices, systems, or treatments follow “Currently”; these words activate more weakly and may be triggered primarily by the sentence-initial word.

patterns.name: Webpage status notice
patterns.context: Webpage or community content describes a service as unavailable or introduces a product/software feature by stating its current status.
patterns.domain: Web content, communities, and product descriptions

patterns.name: Conversational quotations and complaints
patterns.context: Informal speech expresses a customer-service complaint or surprise; activation is scattered across several words in the quotation.

patterns.name: Names and reported speech in email
patterns.context: Conversational email mentions what someone else said, or opens with “Ok guys” to report having started work on something.

patterns.name: Legal citation numbering
patterns.context: Case citations in legal text; activation falls mainly on the citation's initial number, with insufficient context to determine a more specific condition.

patterns.name: Cross-script configuration in programming questions
patterns.context: A Q&A title asks how to share project configuration variables across multiple Python scripts.

1_16.description: 最一致的模式是句首“Currently”，覆盖专利、医学和网页片段。其余激活分散于技术名词、状态说明、口语邮件、法律引文及编程标题，未显示共同的词汇或主题触发条件。

patterns.name: 句首 Currently
patterns.context: 段落或句子以“Currently”开头，后接说明某种当前状态、已知技术或现状；触发不依赖特定主题。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学、网页及一般说明文

patterns.name: 技术/专业名词短语
patterns.context: “Currently”之后出现设备、系统或治疗相关的专业描述；这些词的激活较弱，可能主要由句首词触发。

patterns.name: 网页状态提示
patterns.context: 网页或社区内容中描述服务不可用，或以当前状态引出产品/软件功能。
patterns.domain: 网页内容、社区及产品说明

patterns.name: 口语引述与抱怨
patterns.context: 非正式话语中表达客服抱怨或惊讶；激活分散在引述中的若干词上。

patterns.name: 邮件中的名字与转述
patterns.context: 邮件式口语中提及他人说法，或以“Ok guys”开场汇报已着手处理某事。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件，内部工作交流

patterns.name: 法律引文编号
patterns.context: 法律文本中的判例引文；主要激活落在引文首部的编号上，缺少足够上下文判断更具体条件。

patterns.name: 编程问题中的跨脚本配置
patterns.context: 问答标题提出在多个 Python 脚本之间共享项目配置变量的问题。

en.description: Responses are distributed across four types of formatting features: sentence-initial Currently in patent backgrounds, F.2d case citation volume numbers, conversational names and says in emails, and the Related literature subsection heading and sec1 anchor in papers; there is no single obvious semantic theme.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Currently
patterns.context: A paragraph begins with Currently, followed by a statement describing existing devices, technologies, or systems; activation falls on Currently and some of the following words

patterns.name: Federal case citation number
patterns.context: A number occupies the volume-number position in a U.S. federal case citation, followed by F.2d, a page number, and court or case information after a line break

patterns.name: Brief conversational email fragment
patterns.context: A conversational paraphrase in an email begins with a name and includes contractions, numbers, and power-unit notation; activation is concentrated on Mike and says

patterns.name: Related literature heading and section anchor
patterns.context: “Related literature” appears as a subsection heading in a PubMed Central document, followed by the sec1 section anchor, then a line break and a separator line of equals signs

1_16.description: 响应分散于四类格式特征：专利背景中的句首 Currently、F.2d 判例引文卷号、邮件口语人名与 says，以及论文 Related literature 小节标题和 sec1 锚点；没有单一明显语义主题。

patterns.name: 句首 Currently
patterns.context: 段首以 Currently 开始，后接描述现有设备、技术或系统的陈述；激活落在 Currently 及其后部分词语上

patterns.name: 联邦判例引文编号
patterns.context: 数字位于美国联邦判例引文的卷号位置，后接 F.2d、页码及换行后的法院或案件信息

patterns.name: 短促邮件口语片段
patterns.context: 邮件中以人名开头的口语转述，包含缩写、数字及功率单位写法；激活集中于 Mike 和 says

patterns.name: Related literature 标题及章节锚点
patterns.trigger: «Related» « literature» {#«sec1»}；部分样本在标题后有空格或不换行空格
patterns.context: PubMed Central 文档中作为小节标题的“Related literature”，后跟 sec1 章节锚点，再换行并出现等号分隔线
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文的结构化文本/标记文本

en.description: Activation centers on sentence-initial “Currently,” and also responds to the email colloquial opening “Ok guys I've” and entry titles beginning with “2019”; these passages differ in style and show no shared specific semantic topic.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Currently
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a sentence, followed by a statement about the current situation, known information, standards, availability, or a product feature; no particular following word is required

patterns.name: Colloquial email expression
patterns.context: Introduces a statement in an email, colloquially, that work on something has been started

patterns.name: 2019 entry titles
patterns.context: The year appears at the beginning of an entry or title, followed by a country, election, sporting event, product, or other proper name or noun phrase

1_16.description: 激活集中于句首“Currently”，另对邮件口语开头“Ok guys I've”及以“2019”起始的条目标题有反应；这些片段文体各异，未见共同的具体语义主题。

patterns.name: 句首 Currently
patterns.context: 出现在句首，后接对现状、已知情况、标准、可用性或某产品功能的陈述；不要求特定后续词
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学、网页文本

patterns.name: 邮件口语表达
patterns.context: 邮件中以口语化方式引出已着手处理某事的说明

patterns.name: 2019 年条目标题
patterns.context: 年份位于条目或标题开头，后接国家、选举、赛事、产品等专名或名词短语

en.concept: Common discourse openings and formulaic phrases
en.description: Activation is concentrated on sentence-initial Currently (including lowercase currently), and also covers VR technology descriptions, CBC news-broadcast format, and email expressions of work progress and thanks; these patterns are mainly distinguished by common sentence structures or genre cues.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Currently
patterns.context: A sentence or webpage text begins with the adverb Currently, followed by a status, known information, or current practice.
patterns.domain: Patent background, medical text, webpage content

patterns.name: VR-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Technical descriptions of VR environments providing applications or features to users.

patterns.name: News outlet and broadcast format
patterns.context: A news source name is followed by a colon and broadcast information such as location or time.

patterns.name: Work-progress expression
patterns.context: A first-person statement explains that the speaker is currently working on a task or document.

patterns.name: Expression of thanks
patterns.context: Thanks the recipient, followed by renewed thanks or a salutation.

1_16.description: 激活集中于句首 Currently（含小写 currently），也覆盖 VR 技术描述、CBC 新闻播报格式及邮件中的工作进展和感谢表达；这些模式主要由常见句式或体裁线索区分。

patterns.name: 句首 Currently
patterns.context: 句子或网页文本以副词 Currently 开头，后接状态、已知信息或当前做法。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医疗文本、网页内容

patterns.name: VR 相关词汇
patterns.context: VR 环境向用户提供应用或功能的技术描述。

patterns.name: 新闻台与播报格式
patterns.context: 新闻来源名称后接冒号和地点、时间等播报信息。

patterns.name: 工作进展表达
patterns.context: 第一人称说明目前正在处理某项工作或文档。

patterns.name: 感谢表达
patterns.context: 对收件人表示感谢，后接再次致谢或称呼。

en.description: The most consistent trigger is sentence-initial Currently (1–5), but the following content and style vary widely. Other high activations are scattered across academic titles, conversational email, place names, and iOS user statements, with no unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Currently
patterns.context: A statement beginning with Currently; followed by a verb or comma, often used to describe the current state, existing technology, or standards.
patterns.domain: Patent background, medical abstracts, and also general web and control-system text

patterns.name: English progressive Working
patterns.context: Begins a title or phrase and is followed by the capitalized term “Memory Task,” forming part of a research title.

patterns.name: Conversational report opening
patterns.context: In email, a person’s name followed by says reports speech, or Ok guys directly addresses recipients and introduces work progress.

patterns.name: Days in a place name
patterns.context: The opening part of the proper name Daysville; the place name is repeated later and introduced in an encyclopedia-style description.

patterns.name: iOS users
patterns.context: After a sentence-initial line break, platform users are the subject of a discussion of app purchases and spending behavior.

1_16.description: 最一致的触发是句首 Currently（1–5），但其后内容和文体差异很大。其余高激活分散在学术标题、邮件口语、地名和 iOS 用户表述中，未见统一的语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 句首 Currently
patterns.context: 句首以 Currently 开始的陈述；后接动词或逗号，常用于说明现状、已有技术或标准。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学摘要，也见一般网页及控制系统文字

patterns.name: 英文进行时 Working
patterns.context: 标题或短语开头，后接大写术语“Memory Task”，构成研究标题的一部分。

patterns.name: 口语报告开头
patterns.context: 邮件中以人名加 says 转述，或以 Ok guys 直接称呼收件人并引出工作进展。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、非正式工作沟通

patterns.name: 地点名称中的 Days
patterns.context: 专名 Daysville 的开头部分，后文重复该地名并作百科式介绍。

patterns.name: iOS 用户
patterns.context: 句首换行后以平台用户为主语，讨论购买应用及消费行为。

en.description: Most strong activations fall on year numbers, especially “2019” at the beginning of a paragraph; other cases include the sentence-initial time adverbs “Currently” and “Previously” and the conversational email phrase “just brought around.” They share a role as time or narrative-start markers at the beginning of sentences or passages, but their contexts differ considerably.

patterns.name: Year number 2019
patterns.context: A year serves as a sentence-initial or passage-initial time marker, followed by varied content such as an event, person, election, device, or date.

patterns.name: Year number 2016
patterns.context: A year at the beginning of a passage is followed by the name of a sporting event.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial “Currently used”
patterns.context: Introduces a description of the current use of a type of device or technology.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial “Previously”
patterns.context: A sentence-initial time adverb followed by a description of researchers and their prior use of a method.

patterns.name: “just brought around” in email
patterns.context: A conversational email describes someone having just brought over a stack of confirmation materials; the name is tokenized as «Reg»«gie».

1_16.description: 多数强激活落在年份数字，尤其段首的“2019”，另有段首时间副词“Currently”“Previously”及邮件口语短语“just brought around”；共同表现为句段开头的时间或叙述起始标记，但上下文差异明显。

patterns.name: 数字年份 2019
patterns.context: 年份作为段首或开头的时间标记，后接赛事、人物、选举、设备或日期等不同内容。

patterns.name: 数字年份 2016
patterns.context: 年份位于段首，后接体育赛事名称。

patterns.name: 句首“Currently used”
patterns.context: 以当前使用状况引出某类设备或技术的描述。

patterns.name: 句首“Previously”
patterns.context: 句首时间副词，后接研究者及其先前使用某方法的描述。

patterns.name: 邮件中“just brought around”
patterns.context: 口语化邮件中描述某人刚带来一叠确认材料；人名切分为«Reg»«gie»。

en.concept: Numbers and proper names in titles or fragments
en.description: The strongest shared feature is a four-digit year, especially 2019, often at the start of an encyclopedia title introducing a date, place name, competition, or entry category; other examples include year ranges, line breaks, and isolated patent, fireworks, and email fragments, which cannot be fully explained by a single title pattern.

patterns.name: Year 2019
patterns.context: A four-digit year at the beginning of a title or entry; in segments 5 and 9, it is followed by a year-range symbol.

patterns.name: Hyphen or range symbol after a year
patterns.context: A range symbol follows a year, or a hyphen appears between a number and the inch unit.

patterns.name: Numeric date in a title
patterns.context: A date or measurement appears in an entry title or product description; in segment 2, the date uses Portuguese formatting.

patterns.name: Title-style proper names and entry category terms
patterns.context: A place name, team name, competition name, or event name follows the year, often ending with a category term such as election, season, league, or Grand Prix.

patterns.name: Repeated year and title separator
patterns.context: A title is followed by a line break, or the year appears again in the text after a line break; in segment 8, a line break joins a holiday phrase.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia pages and web text formatting

patterns.name: Description of laser technology in a medium-duty pickup
patterns.context: Begins with Currently used and describes a medium-duty pickup using a semiconductor laser; not evidently part of the year-title pattern.

patterns.name: Fireworks and standalone holiday phrase
patterns.context: A blank line follows a fireworks term, then a phrase about Independence Day in the United States; unrelated to year titles.

patterns.name: Name and email body
patterns.context: An email-style salutation or name is followed by conversational text; activation concentrates on the name, with weaker activation on «I».

1_16.concept: 标题或片段中的数字与专名
1_16.description: 最强的共同特征是四位数年份，尤其2019，常出现在百科标题开头并引出日期、地名、赛事或条目类别；另有年份范围、换行和若干孤立的专利、烟花及邮件片段，不能由单一标题模式充分解释。

patterns.name: 年份 2019
patterns.context: 四位数年份作为标题或条目开头；段 5、9 中年份后接年份范围符号。
patterns.domain: 百科条目标题、网页文本

patterns.name: 年份后的连字符或范围符号
patterns.context: 年份后接范围符号，或数字与英寸单位之间的连字符。

patterns.name: 标题中的数字日期
patterns.context: 日期或尺寸数字出现在条目标题或产品描述中；段 2 的日期使用葡萄牙语格式。

patterns.name: 标题式专名与条目分类词
patterns.trigger: « Bel»«arus»ian parliamentary election；« Ta»«ça»；« North»« Carolina» « FC» « season»；« FI»U« Panthers»；« Val»«enc»«ian» Community motorcycle Grand Prix；« Senegal» Premier League
patterns.context: 年份后出现地名、队名、赛事名或事件名称，常以选举、赛季、联赛、大奖赛等类别词收尾。

patterns.name: 年份重复与标题分隔符
patterns.context: 条目标题后有换行，或换行后正文再次出现年份；段 8 的换行连接节日短语。
patterns.domain: 百科页面及网页文本排版

patterns.name: 半高皮卡的激光技术描述
patterns.trigger: «Currently» « used» « half»«-»height« pick»«ups» « employ» « semiconductor» « laser»
patterns.context: 以 Currently used 开头，描述半高皮卡采用半导体激光器；不明显属于年份标题模式。

patterns.name: 烟花与独立节日短语
patterns.context: 烟花词后出现空行，继而是美国独立日短语；与年份标题无关。

patterns.name: 人名及邮件正文
patterns.context: 邮件式称呼或人名后接对话正文；激活集中在人名，且 «I» 有较弱激活。

en.description: Most activations occur on years, especially “2019” at the beginning of titles; there is also one year range, one tokenized name, and two webpage fragments beginning with “Over.” The latter two types have no clear connection to the year pattern.

patterns.name: Year 2019
patterns.context: The year token appears at the beginning of an entry title or title-like phrase, followed by an event name, proper noun, year range, or product description.

patterns.name: Year and hyphen
patterns.context: A year is followed by a dash and a number to form a season or event title; similar to the “Year 2019” pattern, but with a different year.

patterns.name: Tokenized name
patterns.context: Activation falls on the parts of a tokenized name, followed by a line break and a repeated name beginning.

patterns.name: Beginning with Over
patterns.context: A sentence or fragment begins with Over; one example is followed by a forum-style attribution/quotation, and another by an amount.

1_16.description: 多数激活出现在年份，尤其标题开头的“2019”；另有一例年份范围、一例人名分词，以及两例以“Over”开头的网页片段，后两类与年份模式关联不明。

patterns.name: 年份 2019
patterns.context: 年份 token 出现在条目标题或标题式短语开头；后接事件名称、专名、年份范围或产品描述。

patterns.name: 数字年份与短横线
patterns.context: 年份后接连接号和数字，组成赛季或赛事标题；和模式“年份 2019”相近，但年份不同。

patterns.name: 人名分词
patterns.context: 激活落在分词的人名各部分上，且姓名后有换行及重复姓名开头。

patterns.name: Over 开头
patterns.context: 句子或片段以 Over 开头；一例接论坛式署名／引文，另一例接金额。

en.concept: Words at the beginning of text fragments
en.description: Strong activations concentrate on «2019» at the beginning of fragments, and also occur on «Eric» and sentence-initial «Previously» and «Wow»; the subsequent contexts vary considerably.

patterns.name: Year 2019
patterns.context: The year appears at the beginning of a text fragment; it may be followed by an event, work, or competition name.

patterns.name: Name Eric
patterns.context: Eric Carter appears as a name or email salutation; one example is followed by a biography, another by a colon and email body.

patterns.name: Previously as sentence opener
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a sentence, followed by a comma and a researcher designation.

patterns.name: Exclamatory opening
patterns.context: An interjection at the beginning, followed by an exclamation mark and an expression like “Where to start”.

1_16.description: 强激活集中于片段开头的«2019»，也见于«Eric»及句首«Previously»、«Wow»；各词后续语境差异较大。

patterns.name: 年份 2019
patterns.context: 年份出现在文本片段开头；后面可接事件、作品或赛事名称。

patterns.name: Eric 姓名
patterns.context: Eric Carter 作为人名或邮件称呼出现；一例后续有简介，一例接冒号和邮件正文。

patterns.name: Previously 起句
patterns.context: 位于句首，后接逗号和研究者称谓。

patterns.name: 感叹开场
patterns.context: 句首感叹词，随后是感叹号和“Where to start”一类表达。

en.concept: Proper names or time markers at the beginning of text
en.description: Activation mainly falls on the year “2019” and the name “Eric” at the beginning of entries or texts; there are also sporadic patterns involving a mathematical word-form fragment and the beginning of research narratives, with no unified semantic feature.

patterns.name: Year number “2019”
patterns.context: A year serves as an entry-title or sentence-initial year, followed by names of elections, sporting events, products, etc.; in [9], “2019” also appears again.

patterns.name: Beginning of the name Eric
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a name or email salutation, followed by a surname or colon.

patterns.name: Word form containing -icked and its context
patterns.context: In mathematical text, the word-form fragment is followed by “without replacement” and includes set notation.

patterns.name: Research narrative introduced by Previously
patterns.context: The sentence begins with “Previously,” introducing a method previously used by researchers.

patterns.name: Unexplained word fragment
patterns.context: The fragment appears in a year range and league name, but does not fully match the other high-activation patterns.

1_16.concept: 文本开头的专名或时间标记
1_16.description: 激活主要落在条目或文本开头的年份“2019”及人名“Eric”上；另有数学词形片段和研究叙述开头等零散模式，未见统一语义特征。

patterns.name: 数字年份“2019”
patterns.context: 年份作为条目标题或句首年份，后面可接选举、赛事、产品等名称；在[9]中还再次出现“2019”。

patterns.name: 人名 Eric 的开头
patterns.context: 出现在人名或邮件称呼开头，后接姓氏或冒号。

patterns.name: 带 -icked 的词形及其语境
patterns.context: 数学文本中，词形片段后出现“without replacement”，并含集合记号。

patterns.name: Previously 引出的研究叙述
patterns.context: 句首用“Previously”引出研究者先前采用的方法。

patterns.name: 未解释的词片段
patterns.context: 该片段呈现年份范围及联赛名称，但与其他高激活模式不完全吻合。

en.concept: Prominent markers at the beginning of text
en.description: Strong activations often fall on years at the start of entries or text (2016, 2017, 2019), which may be followed by sports titles, elections, competitions, or product content; there are also year-range dashes and one exclamatory opening. The triggering conditions are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Year numbers
patterns.context: A year appears at the beginning of a title or entry; the strongest activation is on the year digits, while subsequent content varies.

patterns.name: Separator in a year range
patterns.context: A year is followed by a dash and an abbreviated part of another year, such as «2019–20», «2017–18», «2016–17».

patterns.name: Sports entry names
patterns.context: A team, season, league, competition, or sport name follows a year; activation falls on different words, without a consistent sports-word trigger.

patterns.name: Non-sports proper names or product titles
patterns.context: An election title, competition proper name, or product-related text directly follows a year; these occur only sporadically.

patterns.name: Exclamatory opening
patterns.context: Begins with an interjection and question-like expression, followed by a mention of Neil; differs from the year-title format.

1_16.description: 强激活常落在条目或文本开头的年份（2016、2017、2019），其后可接体育标题、选举、赛事、产品内容；另有年份范围短横线及一例感叹式开场。触发条件并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 年份数字
patterns.context: 年份出现在标题或条目开头；最强激活落在年份数字上，后续内容不固定。
patterns.domain: 百科条目标题、网页内容

patterns.name: 体育条目名称
patterns.trigger: «North»（[4]）、「« FI»U« Panthers» men’s basketball」（[5]）、「«motorcycle Grand Prix»」（[6]）、「« Premier League»」（[8]）、「«Men’s Volleyball»」（[9]）、「«Super 8» (Handball League)」（[10]）
patterns.context: 年份后出现球队、赛季、联赛、赛事或体育项目名称；激活在不同词上，未形成一致的体育词触发特征。

patterns.name: 非体育专名或产品标题
patterns.trigger: « Bel»arusian parliamentary election」（[1]）、「« Ta»ça 12 de Novembro」（[2]）、「«13»-inch MacBook Pro users」（[3]）
patterns.context: 年份后紧接选举标题、赛事专名或产品相关文本；仅零星出现。

patterns.name: 感叹式开场
patterns.context: 以感叹词及问句式表达起头，随后提到 Neil；与年份标题格式不同。

en.concept: Sentence-initial Over, proper names, and year formats
en.description: Mainly responds to sentence-initial Over (introducing an amount, proportion, or time span), and also to the name/speaker label Eric and the year range “2017–18”; the relationship between Over and the subsequent content in passage 3 is unclear.

patterns.name: Name Eric and colon
patterns.context: Eric appears in a name (e.g., Eric Carter) or as a speaker label followed by a colon; it may then be followed by a line break or body text.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Over
patterns.context: Over occurs at the beginning of a passage, followed by an amount, quantity, time span, or statistic; forms include «Over $2.5 billion», «Over half», «Over the last decade», «Over the past five years», «Over the last couple of days».
patterns.domain: Webpage text, medical research, patent background, email

patterns.name: Year in a year range
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the starting year and dash in the abbreviated year range “2017–18”.

1_16.concept: 句首 Over及专名、年份格式
1_16.description: 主要响应句首 Over（引出金额、比例或时间跨度），另响应 Eric 姓名/发言者标签，以及年份区间“2017–18”；第3段后续内容与 Over 的具体关系不明。

patterns.name: Eric 姓名及冒号
patterns.context: Eric 出现在姓名中（如 Eric Carter），或作为发言者标签后接冒号；其后可能换行或接正文。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物条目、邮件对话

patterns.name: 句首 Over
patterns.context: Over 位于片段开头，后接金额、数量、时间跨度或统计描述；形式包括 «Over $2.5 billion»、«Over half»、«Over the last decade»、«Over the past five years»、«Over the last couple of days»。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、医学研究、专利背景、邮件

patterns.name: 年份区间中的年份
patterns.context: 年份缩写区间“2017–18”中，激活集中在起始年份及连接号。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on sentence-initial “Over,” which may be followed by an amount, percentage, or time span; there are also responses to the interjection “Wow,” the name “Eric,” and sentence-initial “Previously,” as well as one anomalous concatenation, “OverThe”.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial “Over”
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence, introducing a quantity, percentage, time span, or other phrase beginning with “Over”; subsequent meanings vary
patterns.domain: Expository and narrative text across multiple domains

patterns.name: Sentence-initial interjection
patterns.context: Conversational exclamation or dialogue opening

patterns.name: Name “Eric”
patterns.context: Appears as a person’s name at the beginning of an entry or after an email salutation

patterns.name: Sentence-initial “Previously”
patterns.context: Placed at the beginning of a sentence to introduce prior research or previous actions

patterns.name: Anomalous concatenation “OverThe” at the beginning
patterns.context: Nonstandard concatenation, followed by “TheGeicoE writes: TSA”

1_16.description: 激活主要集中于句首的“Over”，其后可接金额、比例或时间跨度；另对感叹词“Wow”、人名“Eric”和句首“Previously”有反应，并覆盖一处“OverThe”异常连写。

patterns.name: 句首“Over”
patterns.context: 位于句首，开启数量、比例、时间跨度或其他以“Over”引出的短语；后续语义不一
patterns.domain: 多领域说明性、叙述性文本

patterns.name: 句首感叹词
patterns.context: 口语式感叹或对话开头

patterns.name: 姓名“Eric”
patterns.context: 作为人名出现在条目开头或邮件称呼后

patterns.name: 句首“Previously”
patterns.context: 置于句首，引出先前研究或既往行动

patterns.name: 句首“OverThe”异常连写
patterns.context: 非标准连写，后接“TheGeicoE writes: TSA”

en.description: Includes two prominent cases: a question opening after the conversational exclamation “Wow!”; and years in encyclopedia sports titles, especially year ranges. Year titles often end with a newline, and subwords from a few event names also activate.

patterns.name: Exclamatory opening and question
patterns.context: Begins with “Wow!”, followed by “Where to start with …” to express surprise or difficulty summarizing; activation is concentrated on the exclamation and question opening.

patterns.name: Year–year range title
patterns.context: A year and hyphen form a year range, commonly in titles or season names; the years and connecting hyphen activate strongly.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entry titles, especially competitions, leagues, and seasons

patterns.name: Year-initial entry title
patterns.context: A year appears at the start of a title, followed by a competition, event, or category name; strong activation occurs even without a year range.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia competition and sports entry titles

patterns.name: Newline separator after title
patterns.context: One or more newlines immediately follow the title, often marking the formatting boundary between an encyclopedia page title and its body; the newline itself activates weakly.

patterns.name: Word boundary in compound sports event names
patterns.context: Sports event names or compound words are split into subword tokens; these fragments may relate to event names in titles, but there is insufficient evidence for an independent pattern.
patterns.domain: Sports entries such as shooting and handball

1_16.description: 包含两类显著情形：口语感叹“Wow!”后的提问开头；以及百科体育标题中的年份，尤其是年份范围。年份标题常以换行收尾，少数项目名称子词也激活。

patterns.name: 感叹式开场与提问
patterns.context: 以“Wow!”开头，接着用“Where to start with …”表达惊讶或难以归纳；激活集中在感叹词和提问开头。

patterns.name: 年份—年份范围式标题
patterns.context: 年份及短横线构成年份范围，常见于标题或赛季名称；年份和连接号激活较强。
patterns.domain: 百科条目标题，尤见赛事、联赛及赛季

patterns.name: 年份开头的条目标题
patterns.context: 年份出现在标题起始处，后接赛事、项目或类别名称；即使没有年份范围也有强激活。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 赛事与体育条目标题

patterns.name: 标题后的换行分隔
patterns.context: 标题后紧接一个或多个换行，常是百科页面标题与正文之间的格式边界；换行本身激活较弱。

patterns.name: 复合体育赛事名称中的词界
patterns.context: 体育项目名称或复合词被拆成子词 token；这些片段可能与标题中的项目名称相关，但样本不足以证明独立模式。

en.concept: Title fragments beginning with a year
en.description: Most activations concentrate on entry titles beginning with a year, especially when the year is followed by dates, numbers, proper names, and sports competition or season names; there is also one conversational, exclamatory opening.

patterns.name: Title or entry beginning with a year
patterns.context: A year appears at the beginning of a fragment, followed by a competition, team, product, or entry name; common in Wikipedia entry titles or text following a title
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia titles, sports competition and season entries, also product news

patterns.name: Number or range after a year
patterns.context: A number, date, or year range directly follows the year, then a name or description
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia titles, competition dates or product models

patterns.name: Place name or proper name after a year
patterns.context: A proper name follows the year, with terms for a competition, team, region, or event type completing the title
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries on competitions, sports, and events

patterns.name: Sports season or event name after a year
patterns.context: A team, sport, or title component such as season follows a year or year range, often accompanied by a line break and the start of entry text

patterns.name: Numbered competition title not beginning with a year
patterns.context: A year introduces a tiered competition or competition proper name, followed by a line break in the title

patterns.name: Exclamatory and conversational opening
patterns.context: A conversational opening expression follows an initial exclamation, with a person mentioned later

1_16.description: 多数激活集中在年份开头的条目标题，尤其年份后接日期、数字、专名及体育赛事或赛季名称；另有一段口语感叹式开场。

patterns.name: 年份开头的标题或条目
patterns.context: 年份位于片段开头，后接赛事、球队、产品或条目名称；常见于 Wikipedia 条目标题或标题后的正文
patterns.domain: 百科标题、体育赛事与赛季条目，也包括产品新闻

patterns.name: 年份后的数字或区间
patterns.context: 年份后紧接数字、日期或年份区间，再接名称或描述
patterns.domain: 百科标题、赛事日期或产品型号

patterns.name: 年份后的地名或专名
patterns.context: 年份后接专名，随后由赛事、球队、地区或活动类型等词补全标题
patterns.domain: 百科赛事、体育与活动条目

patterns.name: 年份后的体育赛季或项目名称
patterns.trigger: «2019»« North Carolina FC season»、«2019»«–20 FIU Panthers men's basketball»、«2011»«–12 Philadelphia Flyers season»
patterns.context: 年份或年份区间后接球队、运动项目或 season 等标题成分，常伴随换行和条目正文起始

patterns.name: 非年份开头的编号赛事标题
patterns.context: 以年份引出分级赛事或赛事专名，标题后出现换行

patterns.name: 感叹与口语开场
patterns.context: 句首感叹后接口语化的起始表达，后文提及人物
patterns.domain: 网络文章或评论式文字

en.description: The most stable pattern is a year at the start of a fragment (2010, 2011, 2018), commonly in encyclopedia titles and competition, season, or event entries; range markers after years and titles also often activate. A separate conversational question begins with “Wow!”.

patterns.name: Year digits at the start
patterns.context: A year appears at the start of a fragment, usually as an entry title or its first field; different years trigger activation, with the year token activating most strongly.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia titles, list titles, and web text

patterns.name: Competition or entry title after year
patterns.context: A year is followed by a year range or a proper-name title for a competition, season, accident, product, etc.; a newline often follows the title.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entry titles, including sports, competitions, accidents, and products

patterns.name: Event/competition description after year
patterns.context: A year is immediately followed by an event, competition, or proper name; internal fragments of split words also activate.

patterns.name: Conversational exclamation and question opening
patterns.context: Begins with an exclamation and exclamation mark, followed by the interrogative “Where to start…”.

1_16.concept: 条目标题中的年份开头
1_16.description: 最稳定的模式是片段开头的年份（2010、2011、2018），常见于百科标题及赛事、赛季或事件条目；年份后的范围符号和标题也常激活。另有一段以“Wow!”开头的口语问句。

patterns.name: 年份数字开头
patterns.context: 年份出现在片段开头，通常作为条目标题或标题的首个字段；不同年份都能触发，且年份 token 激活最强。
patterns.domain: 百科标题、列表标题及网页文本

patterns.name: 年份后接赛事或条目标题
patterns.trigger: «2011»–«12»；«2010» Bar… Challenge；«2018» Leicester helicopter crash、«2018»–«19» Welsh Premier League (women)
patterns.context: 年份后紧跟跨年年份范围，或赛事、赛季、事故、产品等专名标题；标题后常有换行。
patterns.domain: 百科条目标题，涵盖体育、赛事、事故与产品

patterns.name: 年份后接事件/赛事描述
patterns.context: 年份紧接事件、赛事或专名；分词形式的词内部片段也有激活。

patterns.name: 口语感叹与问句开头
patterns.context: 以感叹词和感叹号开场，随后是疑问式的“Where to start…”。
patterns.domain: 非正式对话或网络文本

en.concept: Year titles at the start of a passage
en.description: Strongly responds to years at the start of passages, especially 2018, 2010, and 2011; common in Wikipedia event, competition, and season entry titles, and also responds to year-range markers, title newlines, and following proper names. The second passage is a year-initial example in a different style.

patterns.name: Year-initial title
patterns.context: A year occurs at the beginning of a paragraph or entry, often followed by a competition, season, or event name; a year-range format may follow.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entry titles, sports competitions, and event entries

patterns.name: Hyphen in a year range
patterns.context: Appears after a year, connecting years or a year range; followed by digits.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia titles, common in competition and season entries

patterns.name: Newline after title
patterns.context: One or more newlines appear after a year or entry title, often separating the title from the body.

patterns.name: Continuation with a specific competition or proper name
patterns.context: A competition, sports team, location, or event name follows the year; some words are split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia sports competition, season, and event entries

patterns.name: Year plus media/book-like phrase
patterns.context: A name containing split words follows the year, then “is” appears; this does not match most sports-entry formats.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC text, possibly a statement related to media or a book title

1_16.description: 强烈响应段首年份，尤其是2018、2010、2011；常见于Wikipedia事件、赛事及赛季条目标题，也响应年份范围符号、标题换行和其后的专名。第2段是不同文体的年份开头例子。

patterns.name: 年份标题开头
patterns.context: 年份位于段落或条目开头，常接赛事、赛季、事件名称；后续可能有年份范围格式
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目标题、体育赛事与事件条目

patterns.name: 年份范围中的连接符
patterns.context: 出现在年份之后，连接年份或年份区间；后接数字
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 标题，常见于赛事、赛季条目

patterns.name: 标题后的换行
patterns.context: 年份或条目标题后出现一个或多个换行，常用于标题与正文之间的分隔

patterns.name: 特定赛事或专名续写
patterns.context: 年份之后接赛事、体育队伍、地点或活动名称；部分词被拆分成多个 token
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 体育赛事、赛季及事件条目

patterns.name: 年份加媒体/书名式短语
patterns.context: 年份后接带有拆分词的名称，之后出现“is”；不符合多数体育条目格式
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 文本，疑似媒体或书名相关语句

en.description: Activations concentrate on years at the beginning of lines, especially when followed by sports competitions, championships, or team titles; there are also email names, conversational exclamatory openings, and a Latvian year phrase, showing multiple types of text openings.

patterns.name: Entry title beginning with a year
patterns.context: A year appears at the beginning of a line or title, followed by a competition, team, or event name; often seen in encyclopedia entry titles.

patterns.name: Competition or event name after a year
patterns.context: A proper competition or championship name directly follows a year, sometimes with a line break at the end of the title.

patterns.name: Team name after a year
patterns.context: A team name and sport name follow a year or season marker.

patterns.name: Name and subsequent text in email
patterns.context: A name appears at the beginning of an email body or within a sentence, followed by a description of routine work progress or tasks.

patterns.name: Conversational exclamatory opening
patterns.context: Informal text begins with an interjection, followed by a question or narrative.

patterns.name: Non-English month expression after a year
patterns.context: A Latvian phrase meaning “summer” appears after the year, within a sentence rather than a typical English title.

1_16.description: 激活集中于行首年份，尤其年份后接体育赛事、锦标赛或球队标题；另见邮件人名、口语感叹开场及拉脱维亚语年份短语，呈现多种文本开头模式。

patterns.name: 年份开头的条目标题
patterns.context: 年份作为行首或标题开头，后接赛事、队伍或活动名称；多见于百科条目标题。

patterns.name: 年份后接赛事或活动名称
patterns.trigger: «2010» «Bar»clays New York« Challenge»；«2015» «Under» 21« Women»'s ... «Championships»；«2015» «F»uzhou« Open»；«2009» «Ab»ierto« Mex»icano；«2009» «IS»U« World» «Team» Trophy
patterns.context: 年份后紧接专名赛事或锦标赛名称，有时标题末尾带换行。

patterns.name: 年份后接队伍名称
patterns.context: 年份或赛季标记后接球队名与项目名称。

patterns.name: 邮件中的人名及后续正文
patterns.context: 人名位于邮件正文开头或句中，后续是日常工作进展或事务描述。

patterns.name: 对话式感叹开场
patterns.context: 非正式文字以感叹词开头，接续提问或展开叙述。
patterns.domain: 网络随笔或口语化文本

patterns.name: 年份后接非英语月份表述
patterns.context: 年份后出现拉脱维亚语表示“夏季”的短语，处于句子中而非典型英文标题。

en.concept: Salient markers at the start of text fragments
en.description: Most fragments begin with a four-digit year, with 2009 and 2011 particularly strong triggers, commonly in sports competition titles and sometimes followed by a year range; “Wow” at the start of a sentence and the email name “Jason” also activate strongly, and are difficult to unify with the year pattern.

patterns.name: Year-initial title
patterns.context: A year appears at the start of a fragment, usually immediately followed by a title or entry name; the year itself is the main high-activation trigger.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia titles and sports competition entries; also seen in EuroParl fragments

patterns.name: Hyphen and number after year
patterns.context: A hyphen connects a year to a number, resembling a date or season year range; the year activates most strongly, and the hyphen also activates strongly.

patterns.name: Non-year initial word or name
patterns.context: The first word or a person’s name at the start of a fragment activates strongly, but the following words and styles vary, with no clear shared condition.

1_16.concept: 文本片段开头的显著标记
1_16.description: 多数片段以四位年份开头，尤以2009、2011为强触发，常见于体育赛事标题，也可接年份范围；另有句首“Wow”和邮件人名“Jason”强激活，难与年份模式统一。

patterns.name: 年份标题开头
patterns.context: 年份出现在片段开头，通常紧接标题或条目名称；年份本身是主要高激活触发词。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 标题、体育赛事条目；另见 EuroParl 片段

patterns.name: 年份后的连接号与数字
patterns.context: 年份后以短横线连接数字，像日期或赛季年份范围；年份激活最高，连接号也有较强激活。

patterns.name: 非年份的句首词或姓名
patterns.context: 片段起始处的首词或人名激活很强，但后续词语和文体各异，未见明确共同条件。

en.concept: Year-initial titles and conversational exclamatory openings
en.description: Strongly responds to four-digit years “2011” and “2009” at the start of titles or text, which may be followed by year ranges and names of competitions or sports teams; it also responds strongly to the conversational opening “Wow! Where to start...”.

patterns.name: Four-digit year 2011
patterns.context: The year begins an entry title or heading, followed by a competition, team, or season name; sometimes followed by year-range punctuation and a number.

patterns.name: Four-digit year 2009
patterns.context: The year begins an entry title or heading, followed by a competition, sport, place name, or other text; sometimes followed by year-range punctuation and a number.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entry titles; also European Parliament text

patterns.name: Exclamatory opening
patterns.context: An exclamation is followed by a conversational question of the form “Where to start with ...”.

1_16.concept: 年份开头及口语感叹开场
1_16.description: 强烈响应标题或文本开头的四位年份“2011”“2009”，其后可接年份范围及赛事、运动队等名称；另对“Wow! Where to start...”口语开场有较强响应。

patterns.name: 四位年份 2011
patterns.context: 年份作为条目标题或标题开头，后接赛事、队伍或赛季名称；有时接年份范围标点与数字。

patterns.name: 四位年份 2009
patterns.context: 年份作为条目标题或标题开头，后接赛事、运动项目、地名或其他正文；有时接年份范围标点与数字。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目标题；另有欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 感叹式开场
patterns.context: 感叹后接“Where to start with ...”式的口语化提问。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on event, person, or topic titles beginning with a year; it also covers list titles, conversational exclamatory openings, an academic concessive sentence, and a Latvian year-containing passage, with no single lexical pattern that explains all fragments.

patterns.name: Year-initial title
patterns.context: A year appears at the beginning of an entry or title, followed by a proper name, competition, or topic; in [8], a range hyphen follows the year.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia-style titles, competition names, or entry fragments

patterns.name: List/ranking title
patterns.context: The title uses list-style wording to present rankings or a summary.

patterns.name: Exclamatory opening and person’s name
patterns.context: Begins with an exclamation and punctuation, followed by a conversational question opening and a person’s name.

patterns.name: Concessive sentence in research background
patterns.context: An initial concessive construction introduces long-term research, followed by a scientific question or mechanism.

patterns.name: Latvian year fragment
patterns.context: A year is followed by a period and Latvian word forms; the fragment appears to be body text rather than an English title.

1_16.description: 激活主要集中在以年份开头的赛事、人物或主题标题；另覆盖榜单标题、口语感叹开场、学术让步句，以及一段拉脱维亚语年份正文，未见能统一解释全部片段的单一词汇模式。

patterns.name: 年份开头的标题
patterns.context: 年份出现在条目或标题的开头，后接专名、赛事或主题；在 [8] 中年份后有范围连接号。
patterns.domain: 维基百科式标题、赛事名称或条目片段

patterns.name: 列表/榜单标题
patterns.context: 标题使用榜单措辞，列出排名或汇总内容。

patterns.name: 感叹式开场与人名
patterns.context: 以感叹词和标点开场，随后出现对话式提问开头及人名。

patterns.name: 研究背景中的让步句
patterns.context: 句首让步结构引出长期研究，后接科学问题或机制。

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语年份片段
patterns.context: 年份后接句点及拉脱维亚语词形，片段像正文而非英语标题。

en.description: Primarily responds to years at the beginning of text, especially Wikipedia sports entry titles, often accompanied by title-style proper names and line breaks; it also responds to cross-year season formats. There is also one conversational exclamatory opening and a proper-name token fragment.

patterns.name: Entry title beginning with a year
patterns.context: A year appears at the beginning of text or an entry, followed by a competition, season, organization, or league name; typically a Wikipedia-like title or lead format

patterns.name: Year plus season range
patterns.context: A hyphen connects the year to two digits, indicating a cross-year season, followed by a team or competition name

patterns.name: Interjection-style dialogue opening
patterns.context: A sentence begins with an interjection and exclamation mark, followed by a conversational question or comment

patterns.name: Token fragment of a place name or proper name
patterns.context: A proper name is split into multiple tokens; these appear in a place-name entry title and a competition name

1_16.description: 主要响应文本开头的年份，尤其是 Wikipedia 体育条目标题，常伴随标题式专名及换行；也响应跨年度赛季格式。另有一次口语感叹开头及专名分词片段。

patterns.name: 年份开头的条目标题
patterns.context: 年份位于文本或条目开头，后接赛事、赛季、组织或联赛名称；多为类似 Wikipedia 条目的标题/导语格式

patterns.name: 年份加赛季范围
patterns.context: 年份后以短横线连接两位数，表示跨年度赛季，再接队伍或赛事名称

patterns.name: 感叹词式对话开头
patterns.context: 句子以感叹词和感叹号开头，随后是口语化提问/评论

patterns.name: 地名或专名的分词片段
patterns.context: 专名被拆成多个 token；分别出现在地名条目标题和赛事名称中

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to entry titles for competitions, teams, and championships that begin with a year; it also covers a Latvian date fragment, the place name Ashfield, and dialogue beginning with “Wow!”, so it cannot be reduced to sports titles.

patterns.name: Year-initial title
patterns.context: A year appears at the beginning of an entry or title, followed by a competition, team, or other proper name.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entry titles and competition names; also a EuroParl corpus fragment

patterns.name: Specific year-and-competition title
patterns.context: A year and the name of a competition, sports team, or championship form a proper-name title; some are followed by a newline and a repeated title opening.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entry titles for sports competitions and teams

patterns.name: Latvian date fragment
patterns.context: A year is followed by a period, a number, and a Latvian month/date expression; the fragment ends with the incomplete «notiku».

patterns.name: Place name and repeated entry opening
patterns.context: The place name Ashfield cum Thorpe appears, followed by a newline and a repeated opening with Ashfield.

patterns.name: Conversational exclamatory opening
patterns.context: Begins with an exclamation and question-like expression, followed by the name Neil; no entry-title or year structure is apparent.

1_16.description: 主要对年份开头的赛事、队伍及锦标赛条目标题高响应；另覆盖拉脱维亚语日期片段、Ashfield 地名及以“Wow!”开头的对话，不能统一归为体育标题。

patterns.name: 年份数字标题
patterns.context: 年份出现在条目或标题开头；年份后接赛事、队伍或其他专名。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目标题、赛事名称；另有 EuroParl 语料片段

patterns.name: 具体年份赛事标题
patterns.trigger: «2009» 后接 «Ab»ierto Mexicano、«ISU World Team Trophy»、«Florida Gators women's basketball»、«New Zealand Grand Prix»；以及 «2010» 后接 «Barclays New York Challenge»、«2015» 后接 «Under 21 Women's Australian Championships» 或 «Fuzhou Open»
patterns.context: 年份与赛事名、体育队伍或锦标赛名组成专名标题；部分后接换行及重复标题开头。
patterns.domain: 体育赛事与队伍的百科条目标题

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语日期片段
patterns.context: 年份后跟句点、数字及拉脱维亚语月份/日期表达，片段以未完成的 «notiku» 结束。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 中的拉脱维亚语文本

patterns.name: 地名与重复式条目开头
patterns.context: 地名 Ashfield cum Thorpe 出现后换行，并再次以 Ashfield 开头。

patterns.name: 对话式感叹开头
patterns.context: 以感叹词和问句式表达开头，后接人名 Neil；不见条目标题或年份结构。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 对话或非正式文本

en.concept: Years at the start of titles
en.description: The strongest and most recurrent pattern is a year at the beginning of encyclopedia sports competition, season, or annual entry titles; some titles use a hyphen to indicate a cross-year range, while a few are Latvian dates, specific competition names, or title-to-body formatting. There is also a conversational exclamatory opening.

patterns.name: Year digits at title start
patterns.context: A year appears at the start of the context as a date for a following event, season, or entry title; activation is concentrated mainly on the year token itself.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia annual competition, sports, and list titles

patterns.name: Year range format
patterns.context: A year is followed by a hyphen and two digits, indicating a cross-year season or competition date; the year remains the strongest trigger.

patterns.name: Annual competition-name entry
patterns.context: A year begins the title, followed by the name of a competition, sport, or league; the name itself activates weakly.

patterns.name: Newline and repeated year after annual entry
patterns.context: A blank line follows the title, then the body begins by repeating the year.

patterns.name: Latvian date fragment
patterns.context: A year is followed by a period and a Latvian date expression; the year remains the strongest activation site.
patterns.domain: Latvian text in the European Parliament corpus

patterns.name: Year and proper name in a competition title
patterns.context: A year directly introduces a competition name and sponsor name, with no cross-year range format.

patterns.name: Exclamation and conversational opening
patterns.context: A conversational exclamation is followed by an opening sentence expressing uncertainty about where to begin; it does not contain a year-title structure.

1_16.description: 最强且反复出现的模式是年份出现在百科体育赛事、赛季或年度条目标题开头；部分标题用短横线表示跨年，少数为拉脱维亚语日期、具体赛事专名或标题后正文排版。另有一段口语感叹开场。

patterns.name: 年份数字标题起始
patterns.context: 年份位于上下文开头，作为后续事件、赛季或条目标题的日期；激活主要集中在年份 token 本身。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 年度赛事、体育条目及列表标题

patterns.name: 年份范围写法
patterns.context: 年份后接短横线和两位数，表示跨年度赛季或赛事日期；年份仍是最强触发。

patterns.name: 年度赛事名称条目
patterns.trigger: 年份后接赛事或项目名称，如 «2009»« IS»«U»« World»« Team»« Trophy»、«2016»« Men»'s « Vol»ley«ball»
patterns.context: 年份充当标题开头，后续列出赛事、项目或联赛名称；名称本身的激活较弱。

patterns.name: 年度条目后接换行与重复年份
patterns.context: 标题后出现空行及正文开头，正文再次重复年份。

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语日期片段
patterns.context: 年份后是点号及拉脱维亚语日期表达；年份仍为最强激活位置。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会语料中的拉脱维亚语文本

patterns.name: 赛事名称中的年份与专名
patterns.context: 年份直接引出赛事名称及赞助商名，未见跨年度范围格式。

patterns.name: 感叹语及对话开场
patterns.context: 口语化感叹后接表示不知从何说起的开场句；不含年份标题结构。

en.concept: Year or proper name at the start of a fragment
en.description: Strongly responds to the years 2009 or 2016 at the start of a fragment, and also to the sentence-initial proper name “Ashfield” and the email salutation “Jason,”. The year pattern spans different domains and titles, with a positional and formatting feature.

patterns.name: Year 2009
patterns.context: The year begins an entry, competition, or event name and is followed by different proper names, dates, or titles; in passage [6], “2009” appears again after a newline.

patterns.name: Year 2016
patterns.context: The year appears at the beginning of a sports competition or match name, followed by a sport, team, date, or competition proper name.

patterns.name: Ashfield string
patterns.context: Begins with “Ashfield”, followed by “ cum Thorpe”; the word is repeated at the end of the fragment.

patterns.name: Jason salutation
patterns.context: The email body begins with a name and comma, followed by a newline and the start of “Here are…”.

1_16.concept: 片段开头的年份或专名
1_16.description: 强烈响应片段开头的年份2009或2016，也响应句首专名“Ashfield”和邮件称呼“Jason,”。年份模式跨不同领域和标题，呈现位置与格式特征。

patterns.name: 年份 2009
patterns.context: 年份作为词条、赛事或事件名称开头，后接不同专名、日期或标题；段[6]中还在换行后再次出现“2009”。

patterns.name: 年份 2016
patterns.context: 年份出现在体育赛事或比赛名称开头，后接项目、队伍、日期或赛事专名。

patterns.name: Ashfield 字符串
patterns.context: 句首为“Ashfield”，后接“ cum Thorpe”；片段末尾重复该词。

patterns.name: Jason 称呼
patterns.context: 邮件正文以姓名加逗号开头，随后换行并开始“Here are…”。

en.concept: Title/entry text beginning with a year
en.description: Primarily responds strongly to text beginning with a four-digit year, especially sports competition titles on Wikipedia; it also covers year ranges, competitions, and sport names. There is also a date sentence and an “Ashfield” title fragment that do not fully fit the sports-title pattern.

patterns.name: Year at the beginning of a title
patterns.context: A year appears at the beginning of an entry or title, followed by a competition name, year range, or other title content; [1] also activates at the beginning of “Ashfield” in a title
patterns.domain: Wikipedia titles and similar entry text; also date-bearing EuroParl text

patterns.name: Range connector after a year
patterns.context: A connector and another year number directly follow the year, forming a season or year range

patterns.name: Competition or league name
patterns.context: A competition, league, or cup name follows a date

patterns.name: Sport and team categories
patterns.context: A sport, gender category, team, or league category appears after year or season information

patterns.name: Year and regional text in a date
patterns.context: A year begins a date, followed by a period and non-English (Latvian) text

patterns.name: Ashfield title text
patterns.context: Text following “Ashfield” appears to include a place name or entry title and a line break; the specific meaning is unclear
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entry fragment, specific meaning unclear

1_16.concept: 年份开头的标题/条目文本
1_16.description: 主要对以四位年份开头的文本强烈响应，尤见维基百科体育赛事标题；也覆盖年份范围、赛事与项目名称。另有日期句和“Ashfield”标题片段，无法完全归入体育标题模式。

patterns.name: 年份作为标题开头
patterns.context: 年份出现在条目或标题开头，后接赛事名称、年份范围或其他标题内容；[1]也在标题中的“Ashfield”开头激活
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 标题及类似条目文本；另见 EuroParl 中带日期的文本

patterns.name: 年份后的范围连接号
patterns.context: 年份后紧接连接号和另一年份数字，形成赛季或年份范围

patterns.name: 赛事或联赛名称
patterns.trigger: « IS»«U» World Team Trophy»、«Ab»ierto Mexicano»、«Premier League»、«Champions' Cup»、«Super 8»
patterns.context: 日期之后跟随赛事、联赛或杯赛名称

patterns.name: 体育项目及队伍类别
patterns.context: 年份或赛季信息后出现项目、性别组别、球队或联赛类别

patterns.name: 日期中的年份与地域文本
patterns.context: 年份作为日期开头，后接句点及非英语（拉脱维亚语）文本

patterns.name: Ashfield 标题文本
patterns.context: “Ashfield”后出现疑似地名或条目标题的后续文本与换行
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目片段，具体语义不明

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to year digits at the beginning of an entry or text, especially years and cross-year ranges in sports competition and season titles; it also responds to the proper name Ashfield, title newlines, and Latvian year-date fragments.

patterns.name: Year digits
patterns.context: A year appears at the beginning of an entry title or title-like phrase; different years occur.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entry titles and sports competition/season entries; also seen in passage 1

patterns.name: Year range
patterns.context: A year is followed by a hyphen and two digits, forming a cross-year season or competition year range.
patterns.domain: Sports competition or season entry titles

patterns.name: Proper name Ashfield
patterns.context: A place name appears at the beginning, followed by “cum Thorpe”; then a newline and “Ashfield” appears again.

patterns.name: Newline after title
patterns.context: Consecutive newlines appear after a title-like competition name; some newline tokens also activate weakly.
patterns.domain: Formatting boundary between a Wikipedia entry title and body

patterns.name: Latvian date fragment
patterns.context: A year is followed by a period, then a Latvian date expression (like “summer 2009”).

1_16.description: 主要对条目或文本开头的年份数字强烈响应，尤其是体育赛事、赛季标题中的年份及跨年范围；另对 Ashfield 专名、标题换行和拉脱维亚语年份日期片段有响应。

patterns.name: 年份数字
patterns.context: 年份位于条目标题或标题式短语开头；不同年份均出现
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目标题及体育赛事/赛季条目；另见第1段

patterns.name: 年份范围
patterns.context: 年份后以短横线连接两位数字，形成跨年赛季或赛事年份范围
patterns.domain: 体育赛事或赛季条目标题

patterns.name: 专名 Ashfield
patterns.context: 地名专名开头处；后接“cum Thorpe”，随后换行并再次出现“Ashfield”

patterns.name: 标题后换行
patterns.context: 标题式赛事名称后出现连续换行，部分换行 token 也有较弱激活
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目标题与正文的排版边界

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语日期片段
patterns.context: 年份后接句点，随后为拉脱维亚语日期表达（“2009年夏季”一类）

en.concept: Identifiers at the beginning of titles or records
en.description: The strongest shared signal is a year at the beginning of a title or text, especially 2009, 2011, and 2017, often followed by a sports competition, team, or season name; other examples include an Ashfield title, the email salutation Jason, and a Latvian date-style expression.

patterns.name: Year string 2009
patterns.context: A year appears at the beginning of an entry title or title-style text, followed by competition, team, event, or date-related content
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entry titles; also a EuroParl sentence

patterns.name: Year-range title
patterns.context: A hyphen and abbreviated year directly follow the year, then a league or team season name

patterns.name: Word at the beginning of a proper-name title
patterns.context: The place name Ashfield appears at the beginning of an entry title, followed by an administrative-area name and a repeated title

patterns.name: Name in an email salutation
patterns.context: An email body or fragment begins with a name and comma, followed by a line break and the body text

patterns.name: Sports competition title beginning with a year
patterns.context: A year directly introduces a competition name in an encyclopedia-style title layout

patterns.name: Latvian date-style body text
patterns.context: After 2009, a period and Latvian month- and date-related forms appear; the year is not clearly a title prefix

1_16.concept: 标题或记录开头的标识符
1_16.description: 最强共同信号是标题或文本开头的年份，尤其 2009、2011、2017，常接体育赛事、球队或赛季名称；另有 Ashfield 标题、邮件称呼 Jason，以及拉脱维亚语日期式表达。

patterns.name: 年份数字串 2009
patterns.context: 年份位于条目标题或标题式文本开头，后接赛事、球队、活动或日期相关内容
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目标题；另有 EuroParl 句子

patterns.name: 年份区间标题
patterns.context: 年份后紧接连接号和缩写式年份，再接联赛或球队赛季名称

patterns.name: 专名标题中的词首
patterns.context: 地名 Ashfield 出现在条目标题开头，后接行政区名称及重复标题

patterns.name: 邮件称呼姓名
patterns.context: 邮件正文或邮件片段以姓名加逗号开头，随后换行并进入正文

patterns.name: 年份开头的体育赛事标题
patterns.context: 年份直接引出赛事名称，标题呈百科条目式排列

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语日期式正文
patterns.context: 2009 后出现句点及拉脱维亚语月份、日期相关词形；年份并非明显的标题前缀

en.description: Activations concentrate on the uppercase sequence AS and also occur on GSH. AS appears across medical abbreviations, legal boilerplate, and code identifiers; GSH occurs in biochemical contexts. The commonality appears to be sensitivity to specific uppercase character sequences rather than shared semantics.

patterns.name: AS/GWAS abbreviations
patterns.context: The consecutive letters AS in uppercase abbreviations; appears in the medical research abbreviation GWAS, AS (ankylosing spondylitis), LASIK, and the software license phrase AS IS.

patterns.name: GSH biochemical abbreviation
patterns.context: The uppercase biochemical abbreviation GSH, appearing in contexts of oxidative stress or liver injury.

patterns.name: Code identifiers containing AS
patterns.context: An uppercase letter sequence in code or a macro definition, with AS inside the identifier.

1_25.concept: 大写字母序列 AS/GSH
1_25.description: 激活集中在大写字母序列 AS，也出现在 GSH；AS 跨医学缩写、法律套语及代码标识符，GSH 出现在生化语境。共同点更像对特定大写字符序列敏感，而非统一语义。

patterns.name: AS/GWAS 缩写
patterns.context: 大写缩写中的连续字母 AS；出现在医学研究缩写 GWAS、AS（强直性脊柱炎）、LASIK，及软件许可中的 AS IS。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、法律与软件许可

patterns.name: GSH 生化缩写
patterns.context: 大写生化缩写 GSH，出现在氧化应激或肝损伤语境中。

patterns.name: 含 AS 的代码标识符
patterns.context: 代码或宏定义中的大写字母序列，AS 位于标识符内部。

en.description: Every segment highlights uppercase AS, but it appears in GWAS, medical abbreviations, AS IS, quoted fragments, term-adjacent positions, and code identifiers; some activations do not correspond precisely to a visible AS string.

patterns.name: Uppercase AS string
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the contiguous uppercase letters AS; in medical text it is a disease abbreviation, in a license it is part of a fixed phrase, and in code it is an identifier fragment.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, code, and legal text

patterns.name: AS in GWAS
patterns.context: Appears at the end of the genomics association study abbreviation GWAS.

patterns.name: AS in APAP
patterns.context: The context discusses APAP-induced cytotoxicity, oxidative stress, and depletion of the GSH pool; the activation marker actually falls on an abbreviation after APAP and may not be AS within a word.

patterns.name: Abbreviation for ankylosing spondylitis
patterns.context: AS abbreviates ankylosing spondylitis and is associated with myocardial infarction risk.

patterns.name: AS IS in a license disclaimer
patterns.context: The fixed legal expression “AS IS” in the Apache License disclaimer, meaning provided as is.

patterns.name: Split AS in a legal citation
patterns.context: Appears in a typographic fragment of a case citation; AS may be the suffix of a truncated or line-broken preceding word, and its lexical function cannot be determined from the fragment alone.

patterns.name: AS near GSH-Px
patterns.context: A liver-injury research abstract; the marker falls near GSH-Px (glutathione peroxidase), where no explicit AS string appears locally.

patterns.name: AS in LASIK
patterns.context: AS appears in LASIK-related text; it may be a character fragment of the procedure name or may be affected by subsequent repeated LASIK text.

patterns.name: AS in a code identifier
patterns.context: Uppercase AS is embedded in the C-style macro name FAS_RLO, with no visible natural-language meaning.

1_25.concept: 大写字母串 AS
1_25.description: 所有段都标出大写 AS，但它分属 GWAS、医学缩写、AS IS、引文片段、术语邻近位置及代码标识符；部分激活并不与可见 AS 字符串精确对应。

patterns.name: 大写 AS 字母串
patterns.context: 激活集中在大写连续字母 AS；在医学文本中它是疾病缩写，在许可证中是固定短语的一部分，在代码中则是标识符片段。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本、代码与法律文本

patterns.name: GWAS 中的 AS
patterns.context: 出现在基因组关联研究缩写 GWAS 的末尾。

patterns.name: APAP 中的 AS
patterns.context: 上下文讨论 APAP 诱导的细胞毒性、氧化应激及 GSH 池耗竭；激活标记实际落在 APAP 后文的缩写位置，可能并非词内 AS。

patterns.name: 强直性脊柱炎缩写
patterns.context: AS 是 ankylosing spondylitis（强直性脊柱炎）的缩写，涉及心肌梗死风险。

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明中的 AS IS
patterns.context: Apache 许可证免责声明中的固定法律表达“AS IS”，表示按现状提供。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的断词 AS
patterns.context: 出现在判例引文的排版片段中；AS 可能是被截断或跨行的前词后缀，无法仅凭片段确定其词汇功能。

patterns.name: AS 位于 GSH-Px 相邻区域
patterns.context: 肝损伤研究摘要，标记落在 GSH-Px（谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶）附近；该局部没有明确的 AS 字母串。

patterns.name: LASIK 中的 AS
patterns.context: AS 出现在 LASIK 相关文本中，既可能是该术式名称的字符片段，也可能受后续重复的 LASIK 文字影响。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 AS
patterns.context: 大写 AS 嵌在 C 风格宏名 FAS_RLO 中，没有可见的自然语言语义。

en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on the contiguous characters “AS,” but their meanings differ across GWAS, ankylosing spondylitis, license phrases, and legal and code strings; there are also activations in GSH- and APAP-related biochemical contexts. Overall, this appears more sensitive to the character sequence than to a single semantic concept.

patterns.name: Abbreviation AS
patterns.context: Activation falls on the letter sequence AS, but the abbreviation’s meaning varies by context: it denotes a study type in GWAS, a disease abbreviation in medical abstracts, and the fixed phrase “AS IS” in license text.

patterns.name: GSH
patterns.context: Appears in statements about oxidative stress, glutathione depletion, or enzyme activity; GSH-Px in segment 8 is a marker in a liver-injury study. Segment 3 also contains APAP (acetaminophen), a biochemical abbreviation.

patterns.name: Intra-word/boundary matching of AS
patterns.context: AS is embedded in legal citations or code identifiers, rather than referring to a disease or the phrase “AS IS”; activation still concentrates on the character sequence AS.

1_25.concept: 字符序列 AS
1_25.description: 强激活主要落在连续字符“AS”，但它在GWAS、强直性脊柱炎、许可证短语及法律和代码字符串中含义各异；另有GSH及APAP相关生化语境的激活。整体更像对字符序列的敏感，而非单一语义概念。

patterns.name: 缩写 AS
patterns.trigger: «AS»10；包括«Gen»ome«-»«wide»« association»« studies» (GW«AS»)，«ank»ylosing« sp»ondylitis («AS»)，以及«"AS» IS
patterns.context: 激活落在大小写字母序列 AS 上，但该缩写的含义因上下文而异：GWAS 中是研究类型，医学摘要中是疾病缩写，许可证文本中是固定短语“AS IS”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、软件许可证

patterns.name: GSH
patterns.context: 出现在氧化应激、谷胱甘肽耗竭或酶活性相关语句中；第8段的GSH-Px是肝损伤研究中的指标。第3段同时出现APAP（对乙酰氨基酚）这一生化缩写。

patterns.name: AS 的词内/词边界匹配
patterns.context: AS嵌在法律引文或代码标识符中，不是疾病或“AS IS”短语；激活仍集中于字符序列AS。
patterns.domain: 法律引文、硬件/嵌入式代码

en.description: All snippets show strong activation at the string AS; its meaning depends on context, including GWAS, ankylosing spondylitis, license phrases, ASF, code identifiers, and fragments of legal names.

patterns.name: Uppercase AS abbreviation
patterns.context: AS appears as an all-uppercase abbreviation, possibly flanked by parentheses, punctuation, or other words; its referent varies with context, including a disease, license text, software identifiers, and fragments of legal names.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, software licenses, code, and legal texts

patterns.name: AS string in GWAS
patterns.context: AS is adjacent to GW, forming the genetics abbreviation GWAS; activation falls on the final AS.

patterns.name: Gene symbol APAS
patterns.context: Appears in sentences about macrophages, cytotoxicity, and apoptosis; AS is a letter string in text related to APAP and GSH, but the activation marker actually falls on GSH.

patterns.name: AS IS license phrase
patterns.context: The fixed phrase AS IS in a license disclaimer, preceded by text about distributing software under applicable law or a written agreement.

patterns.name: AS in a legal name
patterns.context: Appears in case citations and fragments of litigants’ names, with AS between PREAS and a comma.

patterns.name: AS in a code identifier
patterns.context: AS is part of an underscore-separated macro or identifier, surrounded by preprocessor code and hardware identifiers.

patterns.name: Apache Foundation abbreviation ASF
patterns.context: ASF appears in parentheses in an Apache Software Foundation copyright notice; the activation marker falls on AS.

patterns.name: AS disease abbreviation
patterns.context: AS appears in parentheses as an abbreviation for ankylosing spondylitis, in medical contexts concerning disease risk or association.

1_25.concept: 大写 AS 字母串
1_25.description: 所有片段都在 AS 字母串处标出强激活；AS 的含义由上下文决定，包括 GWAS、强直性脊柱炎、许可证短语、ASF、代码标识符及法律姓名片段。

patterns.name: 大写 AS 缩写
patterns.context: AS 作为全大写缩写出现，左右可有括号、标点或其他词；所指含义随上下文变化，包括疾病、许可文本、软件标识和法律姓名片段。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、软件许可证、代码及法律文本

patterns.name: GWAS 中的 AS 字母串
patterns.context: AS 与 GW 相邻，组成遗传学缩写 GWAS；激活落在末尾 AS 上。

patterns.name: 基因符号 APAS
patterns.context: 出现于研究巨噬细胞、细胞毒性及凋亡的句子中；AS 是 APAP 与 GSH 相关文本中的字母串，激活标记实际落在 GSH。

patterns.name: AS IS 许可证短语
patterns.context: 许可证免责声明中的固定短语 AS IS，前文涉及按适用法律或书面协议分发软件。

patterns.name: 法律姓名中的 AS
patterns.context: 出现在案件引注和诉讼双方姓名片段中，AS 位于 PREAS 与逗号之间。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 AS
patterns.context: AS 是下划线分隔的宏或标识符的一部分，周围有预处理器代码及硬件标识符。

patterns.name: Apache 基金会缩写 ASF
patterns.context: 括号中出现 ASF，位于 Apache Software Foundation 的版权声明里；激活标记落在 AS。

patterns.name: 疾病缩写 AS
patterns.context: AS 在括号中作为 ankylosing spondylitis（强直性脊柱炎）的缩写，出现在疾病风险或关联的医学语境中。

en.concept: Uppercase string AS (plus a GSH singleton)
en.description: The strongest signal concentrates on the uppercase substring AS: it is both a medical abbreviation and embedded in strings such as LASIK and FAS, as well as in license phrases, spanning diverse meanings; a GSH singleton also has strong activation.

patterns.name: AS abbreviation string
patterns.context: The uppercase letter sequence AS appears in a disease abbreviation, an in-sentence term, a code identifier, or license text; the fragment alone cannot determine whether a particular meaning is involved.

patterns.name: AS within a longer identifier
patterns.context: AS is a contiguous substring of a longer word or identifier; LASIK also appears twice in segment 3.

patterns.name: Co-occurrence with oxidative-stress vocabulary
patterns.context: In biomedical accounts involving APAP, cytotoxicity, apoptosis, ROS, and oxidative stress, the strong activation is marked on GSH.

1_25.concept: 大写字符串 AS（另有 GSH 单例）
1_25.description: 最强信号集中在大写子串 AS：它既是医学缩写，也嵌在 LASIK、FAS 等字符串及许可证短语中，语义跨度大；另有 GSH 单例强激活。

patterns.name: AS 缩写字符串
patterns.context: 大写字母序列 AS 出现在疾病缩写、句中术语、代码标识符或许可证文本中；单凭片段无法判断是否依赖某个特定语义
patterns.domain: 生物医学、法律文本及代码

patterns.name: AS 位于更长标识符中
patterns.context: AS 是更长单词或标识符的连续子串；第3段中的 LASIK 还出现两次
patterns.domain: 医学缩写及代码标识符

patterns.name: 与氧化应激词汇共现
patterns.context: 围绕 APAP、细胞毒性、凋亡、ROS 与氧化应激的生物医学叙述中，强激活标在 GSH

en.description: Strong activations concentrate on the string AS, especially as an abbreviation fragment in different terms or proper names: GWAS, ankylosing spondylitis, PAS, ASF, AAS, and PCAS. Contexts are mostly biomedical, with some software licensing.

patterns.name: AS in the term GWAS
patterns.context: AS is part of the abbreviation for genome-wide association studies, appearing in overviews of genetic research

patterns.name: AS abbreviation for ankylosing spondylitis
patterns.context: AS refers to ankylosing spondylitis; it often co-occurs with research contexts such as myocardial infarction risk, HLA-B27, or biomarkers

patterns.name: PAS staining abbreviation
patterns.context: AS appears in the abbreviation PAS (periodic acid–Schiff), concerning tissue staining or microscopic observation

patterns.name: PAS for previous abdominal surgery
patterns.context: PAS is defined as previous abdominal surgery and treated as a preexisting factor in laparoscopic resection for colorectal cancer

patterns.name: Apache Software Foundation abbreviation
patterns.context: AS is part of the organization name abbreviation ASF, appearing in a license comment

patterns.name: AAS drug abbreviation
patterns.context: AAS appears as an abbreviation for a drug or steroid name, in discussion of its effects on rats’ spatial memory and hippocampus

patterns.name: PCAS culture medium abbreviation
patterns.context: AS occurs in the abbreviation PCAS, referring to Con A-induced porcine leukocyte culture supernatant

1_25.concept: AS字母串及其缩写
1_25.description: 强激活集中在字符串 AS，尤其作为不同术语或专名的缩写片段：GWAS、强直性脊柱炎、PAS、ASF、AAS、PCAS；上下文领域多为生物医学，另有软件许可证。

patterns.name: GWAS术语中的AS
patterns.context: AS是 genome-wide association studies 的缩写组成部分，出现在遗传学研究概述中
patterns.domain: 复杂疾病遗传学 / 学术论文

patterns.name: 强直性脊柱炎的AS缩写
patterns.context: AS指 ankylosing spondylitis；常与心肌梗死风险、HLA-B27或生物标志物等研究语境共现
patterns.domain: 医学摘要 / 风湿病学

patterns.name: PAS染色缩写
patterns.context: AS出现在 PAS（periodic acid–Schiff）缩写中，涉及组织染色或显微观察
patterns.domain: 病理学 / 生物医学方法

patterns.name: PAS指既往腹部手术
patterns.context: PAS被定义为 previous abdominal surgery，并作为腹腔镜结直肠癌切除术的既往因素

patterns.name: Apache Software Foundation缩写
patterns.context: AS是 ASF 组织名称缩写的一部分，出现在许可证注释中
patterns.domain: 软件许可证 / 源代码注释

patterns.name: AAS药物缩写
patterns.context: AAS作为药物或类固醇名称的缩写出现，讨论其对大鼠空间记忆及海马的影响
patterns.domain: 神经科学 / 药理学论文

patterns.name: PCAS培养液缩写
patterns.context: AS处于 PCAS 缩写中，指 Con A 诱导的猪白细胞培养上清液

en.description: Activation consistently falls on the uppercase string AS across biomedical abbreviations, the Apache Foundation abbreviation, and a physics experiment name; prefixes, suffixes, and contextual domains vary widely.

patterns.name: Uppercase AS string
patterns.context: The consecutive letters AS within an uppercase abbreviation; surrounding abbreviation content varies, while AS itself is marked in every case.

patterns.name: AS in the GWAS abbreviation
patterns.context: Appears after “Genome-wide association studies” as the ending of the genetics abbreviation GWAS.

patterns.name: AS in the Apache Software Foundation abbreviation
patterns.context: The parenthetical abbreviation ASF for Apache Software Foundation in license text; AS is followed by F.

patterns.name: AS in the ankylosing spondylitis abbreviation
patterns.context: The parenthetical abbreviation following the full disease name ankylosing spondylitis; some passages also mention the disease’s relation to other medical concepts.

patterns.name: AS in the previous abdominal surgery abbreviation
patterns.context: The abbreviation PAS following “previous abdominal surgery”; AS are its final letters.

patterns.name: AS in the CLAS experiment name
patterns.context: The final letter sequence of the experiment name CLAS in a reaction cross-section study.

1_25.concept: 大写字母串 AS
1_25.description: 激活稳定落在大写字母串 AS 上，跨生物医学缩写、Apache 基金会缩写及物理实验名；前缀后缀和上下文领域变化很大。

patterns.name: AS 大写字母串
patterns.context: 大写缩写内部的连续字母 AS；缩写前后内容不同，AS 本身均被标记。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：生物医学、软件许可证、物理

patterns.name: GWAS 缩写中的 AS
patterns.context: 出现在“Genome-wide association studies”之后，作为遗传学缩写 GWAS 的末尾。

patterns.name: Apache 软件基金会缩写中的 AS
patterns.context: 许可证文本中 Apache Software Foundation 的括号缩写 ASF；AS 后接 F。
patterns.domain: 软件许可证与代码注释

patterns.name: 强直性脊柱炎缩写中的 AS
patterns.context: 疾病全称 ankylosing spondylitis 后的括号缩写；部分段落还提及疾病与其他医学概念的关系。

patterns.name: 既往腹部手术缩写中的 AS
patterns.context: “previous abdominal surgery”后的括号缩写 PAS，AS 是其末尾字母。

patterns.name: CLAS 实验名称中的 AS
patterns.context: 反应截面研究中实验名称 CLAS 的字母序列末尾。

en.concept: Mixed word-form feature, primarily in GSH-related text
en.description: Most passages activate on GSH/glutathione and redox or detection contexts in biomedicine; there are also sporadic activations on abbreviations such as AS, GWAS, and ASF, and on the suffix in “intractable,” which are difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: GSH (glutathione)-related biochemical text
patterns.context: GSH appears as a content, level, activity, or detection target, or in contexts of oxidative stress, antioxidants, cell damage, or experimental assays
patterns.domain: Biomedical, pharmacological, and biochemical experimental papers

patterns.name: AS abbreviation for ankylosing spondylitis
patterns.context: AS appears after HLA-B27 in a disease association context; here it is not an abbreviation for glutathione

patterns.name: GWAS abbreviation
patterns.context: The abbreviation for genome-wide association studies appears in an introduction to complex disease genetics

patterns.name: ASF abbreviation
patterns.context: An organization-name abbreviation appears in a license comment; it is unrelated to GSH or disease-related AS in biomedicine

patterns.name: Statistical methods terminology
patterns.context: Describes variables in complex models whose integration is analytically or computationally intractable; the visible activation falls on a word suffix

1_25.concept: 以GSH相关文本为主的混合词形特征
1_25.description: 多数段落激活于生物医学中的GSH/谷胱甘肽及氧化还原、检测语境；另有AS、GWAS、ASF等缩写和“intractable”后缀的零星激活，难归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: GSH（谷胱甘肽）相关生化文本
patterns.context: GSH作为含量、水平、活性或检测对象出现，或置于氧化应激、抗氧化、细胞损伤、实验测定的语境中
patterns.domain: 生物医学、药理学与生化实验论文

patterns.name: AS（强直性脊柱炎）疾病缩写
patterns.context: AS紧随HLA-B27与疾病关联语境出现；此处不是谷胱甘肽缩写

patterns.name: GWAS缩写
patterns.context: 基因组关联研究缩写出现在复杂疾病遗传学介绍中

patterns.name: ASF缩写
patterns.context: 许可证注释中出现组织名称缩写；与生物医学中的GSH或疾病AS无关

patterns.name: 统计方法术语
patterns.context: 描述复杂模型中的变量积分在解析或计算上不可处理；可见激活落在单词后缀部分
patterns.domain: 机器学习或统计学论文

en.description: Primarily responds to GSH/glutathione and GTPase signaling terminology; also covers citation markers, G6PD deficiency, NAC, mercury fluorescence detection, liver injury indicators, APAP toxicity, and PI3K/receptor pathways in biomedical contexts.

patterns.name: GSH glutathione
patterns.context: Directly mentions GSH content, detection, depletion, activity, or fluorescence detection, often adjacent to metabolism, oxidative stress, cell damage, or biochemical assays.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, molecular biology, and biochemical experimental literature

patterns.name: GTPase signaling
patterns.context: Mentions GTPases or their signaling pathways, effectors, activity, and relations to cell transformation or proliferation; includes RhoB, Ras, Ral, and Rac.
patterns.domain: Cell signaling, tumor biology papers, and grant abstracts

patterns.name: Citation markers
patterns.context: Special markers and numbers in references or in-text citations; appear only at paragraph starts or in parenthetical citations.

patterns.name: G6PD deficiency context
patterns.context: Discusses G6PD-deficient newborns or red blood cells and the pro-oxidant effects of traditional Chinese medicine; the same passage also mentions changes in GSH levels.

patterns.name: NAC treatment
patterns.context: Describes changes in radiation damage, non-protein-bound thiols, and GSH content after NAC treatment of cells.

patterns.name: Hg and dithiol fluorescence
patterns.context: Discusses how the reaction between mercury ions and dithiols disrupts compact structures and reduces fluorescence, using fluorescence changes to detect GSH.
patterns.domain: Chemical sensing and analytical chemistry abstracts

patterns.name: Liver injury indicators
patterns.context: Compares body-weight ratios, oxidative stress indicators, and GSH-Px activity between chronic liver injury models and control groups.
patterns.domain: Liver disease and animal experiment abstracts

patterns.name: Drug metabolism and cytotoxicity
patterns.context: Discusses APAP-induced cytotoxicity and its relation to GSH depletion, metabolic activation, and detoxification.

patterns.name: PI3K downstream pathways
patterns.context: Lists downstream enzymes and signaling pathways alongside GTPases; focuses on pathway activation rather than GSH.
patterns.domain: Cell signaling reviews or research papers

patterns.name: Thyroid hormone receptor and Rac
patterns.context: Describes thyroid hormone receptor effects at the plasma membrane mediated by PI3K and Rac GTPase.
