patterns.domain: Endocrine and cell signaling grant abstracts

1_25.concept: 生物医学分子术语
1_25.description: 主要响应 GSH/谷胱甘肽及 GTPase 信号相关术语；还覆盖引文标记、G6PD 缺乏、NAC、汞荧光检测、肝损伤指标、APAP 毒性及 PI3K/受体通路等生物医学语境。

patterns.name: GSH 谷胱甘肽
patterns.context: 直接提及 GSH 含量、检测、耗竭、活性或荧光检测，常与代谢、氧化应激、细胞损伤或生化测定相邻。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、分子生物学与生化实验文献

patterns.name: GTPase 信号
patterns.context: 提到 GTPase 或其信号通路、效应物、活性及与细胞转化或增殖的关系；包括 RhoB、Ras、Ral、Rac。
patterns.domain: 细胞信号转导、肿瘤生物学论文及资助摘要

patterns.name: 引文标记
patterns.context: 参考文献或文内引文的特殊标记与编号；仅在段落开头或括号引文中出现。

patterns.name: G6PD 缺乏语境
patterns.context: 讨论 G6PD 缺乏新生儿或红细胞及中药的促氧化作用；同段还提到 GSH 水平变化。

patterns.name: NAC 处理
patterns.context: 描述 NAC 处理细胞后辐射损伤及非蛋白结合硫醇、GSH 含量的变化。
patterns.domain: 细胞生物学与放射生物学论文

patterns.name: Hg 与联硫醇荧光
patterns.context: 讨论汞离子与联硫醇反应破坏紧凑结构、降低荧光，并以荧光变化检测 GSH。
patterns.domain: 化学传感与分析化学摘要

patterns.name: 肝损伤指标
patterns.context: 比较慢性肝损伤模型与对照组的体重比值、氧化应激指标及 GSH-Px 活性。

patterns.name: 药物代谢与细胞毒性
patterns.context: 讨论 APAP 诱导细胞毒性及其与 GSH 耗竭、代谢活化和解毒的关系。

patterns.name: PI3K 下游通路
patterns.context: 列举下游酶及信号通路，并与 GTPase 并列；侧重通路激活而非 GSH。
patterns.domain: 细胞信号转导综述或研究论文

patterns.name: 甲状腺激素受体与 Rac
patterns.context: 描述甲状腺激素受体在质膜处经 PI3K 和 Rac GTPase 介导作用。
patterns.domain: 内分泌与细胞信号研究资助摘要

en.description: Primarily responds to sentence-initial “We have” and the present-perfect structures that follow to report findings, methods, or research progress; also responds to research introductions of the form “We are interested in understanding.” Topics are mostly biomedical research, with a business email and a code snippet as well.

patterns.name: We have in academic prose
patterns.context: Sentence-initial first-person plural “we” introduces researchers’ actions, findings, methods, or completed work; paragraph 1 begins “We are interested in…”, while most others use “We have + past participle”
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts or research descriptions, plus one business email

patterns.name: Present-perfect reports with We have
patterns.context: Sentence-initial subject “We” is followed by the frequent “have,” then a past participle or “been + -ing,” reporting research progress, results, methods, or received documents
patterns.domain: Primarily NIH grant-related biomedical research texts; paragraph 6 is a business email

patterns.name: Introducing research interests and questions
patterns.context: Sentence-initial “We are interested in” introduces a mechanism or question to be understood, followed by a how-clause
patterns.domain: Biomedical research proposals or paper prose

patterns.name: Research subjects and technical terms
patterns.context: Appears when researchers report their work, including biomedical subjects, treatments, research methods, or analytical tools; specific topics vary by passage

patterns.name: Code dependency or build-file snippet
patterns.context: A line in command-line comment style contains an include path or filename, with underscores and the “.inc” extension
patterns.domain: Github code or build configuration text

patterns.name: Confidentiality agreement email phrasing
patterns.context: Sentence-initial “We have received” reports receipt of a formally signed confidentiality agreement

1_25.concept: 研究者的进展报告句式
1_25.description: 主要响应句首“We have”及其后报告发现、方法、研究进展的完成时结构，也响应“We are interested in understanding”式研究引入。主题多为生物医学科研；另有商务邮件和代码片段。

patterns.name: 学术表述中的 We have
patterns.trigger: “We”及“We have”，其中“We have”在多个片段中反复出现；另有“We are interested in understanding”
patterns.context: 句首以第一人称复数“we”介绍研究者的行为、发现、方法或已完成事项；第1段为“We are interested in…”，其余多为“We have + 过去分词”
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要或研究描述，另有一段商务邮件

patterns.name: We have 的完成时报告
patterns.trigger: “We have found”“We have described”“We have shown”“We have received”“We have been studying”“We have instituted”“We have recently developed”“We have developed”
patterns.context: 句首主语“We”后接高频的“have”，再接过去分词或“been + -ing”，陈述研究进展、结果、方法或收到的文件
patterns.domain: 主要为NIH资助相关的生物医学研究文本；第6段为商务邮件

patterns.name: 研究兴趣与研究问题引入
patterns.context: 句首“We are interested in”引出欲理解的机制或问题，后接how从句
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究计划或论文表述

patterns.name: 研究对象与专业术语
patterns.trigger: “transcription of protein-coding genes”“receptor FPRL”“dsRNA viruses”“targeted therapy”“type 1”“local injections”“dynamic Intensity Modulated Rad…”“stable isotope tracer method”“databases and software”“comparative analysis”
patterns.context: 出现在研究者报告研究工作的语境中，包含生物医学对象、治疗手段、研究方法或分析工具；各段具体主题不同

patterns.name: 代码依赖或构建文件片段
patterns.context: 命令行注释样式的行中出现include路径或文件名，包含下划线和“.inc”扩展名

patterns.name: 保密协议邮件表述
patterns.trigger: “We have received the fully executed Confidentiality Agreement”
patterns.context: 句首“We have received”报告已收到正式签署的保密协议

en.description: The activation pattern is mixed: several passages contain the substring ve, while others include discard/exit code in code, tokenized fragments of titles and names, and multiple word fragments in abstracts; it is difficult to attribute them to a shared semantic or stable contextual pattern.

patterns.name: Token fragments containing ve
patterns.context: Activation falls on the substring ve inside English words, or on independent/near-independent ve in mathematical content; contexts include medical titles, mathematical expressions, and proper names/abbreviations.

patterns.name: disc…ard and code boundary
patterns.context: String fragment in a code block, adjacent to a newline and exit-code output; disc and ard combine to form discard.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of proper names or titles
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across tokenized English titles, Italian word sequences, or personal names, with no evident shared semantics or local character pattern.
patterns.domain: Webpage titles, parliamentary texts, encyclopedia names

patterns.name: Multiple word fragments in abstracts
patterns.context: Several adjacent or scattered tokens are activated in a continuous stretch of English at the beginning of an abstract, including word and identifier fragments.

1_25.concept: none
1_25.description: 激活模式混杂：若干段含 ve 子串，但另有代码中的 discard/exit code、标题与人名的分词片段，以及摘要中多处词片段；难以归结为统一语义或稳定上下文。

patterns.name: 含字母 ve 的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文单词内部的 ve 子串，或数学内容中独立/近似独立的 ve；上下文分别是医学标题、数学表达式和专名/缩写。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、数学文本、百科

patterns.name: disc…ard 与代码边界
patterns.context: 代码块中的字符串片段，紧邻换行与退出码输出；disc 与 ard 拼成 discard。

patterns.name: 分词后的专名或标题片段
patterns.context: 激活散布于被切分的英文标题、意大利语词串或人名中，未见共同的语义或局部字符模式。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、议会文本、百科人名

patterns.name: 摘要中的多处词片段
patterns.context: 摘要开头的一段连续英文中，多个相邻或分散 token 均有激活，包含词语及标识符片段。

en.description: Activations often fall on local fragments within words or at word beginnings, including forms in different languages, technical terms, and several Co-initial words; contexts and meanings vary widely and cannot be explained by a single theme.

patterns.name: Italian word-final fragments
patterns.context: The Italian phrase “Esecuzione effettiva delle decisioni”; activations are distributed across multiple subword fragments within words.
patterns.domain: European Parliament text / Italian political and legal style

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in Surveillance
patterns.context: Within the opening word of the English medical phrase “Surveillance of the gastrointestinal mucosa by sensory neurons.”

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in Refreshing
patterns.context: In the title “Most Refreshing Summer Sandwich,” activation falls within the adjective; a line break and the beginning of the body text follow.

patterns.name: Fragment in a fuzzy-clustering term
patterns.context: Technical sentence describing image segmentation algorithms and fuzzy clustering methods such as FCM, IFCM, and PFCM.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in Aggresomes
patterns.context: A cell-biology term listed alongside “pericentriolar sites.”

patterns.name: Co-initial words
patterns.context: One is cooperative binding systems, while the other is the standalone title Co-insurance; the same word-initial fragment occurs in different lexical and semantic contexts.

patterns.name: Co-compounds and their suffixes
patterns.context: Activation covers the Co-initial part of hyphenated compounds and also the non-hyphenated word Coastal; subsequent contexts concern parasites, uranyl transport, and coastal planning, respectively.

1_25.concept: 词内片段与词首 Co
1_25.description: 激活多落在词内或词首的局部片段：包括不同语言词形、技术术语及若干 Co- 开头词；上下文和语义跨度很大，无法由单一主题解释。

patterns.name: 意大利语词尾片段
patterns.context: 意大利语短语“Esecuzione effettiva delle decisioni”，激活分布在词内多个子词片段
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本／意大利语政治法律文体

patterns.name: Surveillance 的词内片段
patterns.context: 英语医学短语“Surveillance of the gastrointestinal mucosa by sensory neurons”开头的单词内部

patterns.name: Refreshing 的词内片段
patterns.context: 标题中“Most Refreshing Summer Sandwich”，激活落在形容词内部；后续为换行和正文开头

patterns.name: 模糊聚类术语中的片段
patterns.context: 描述图像分割算法及 FCM、IFCM、PFCM 等模糊聚类方法的技术句子

patterns.name: Aggresomes 的词内片段
patterns.context: 与“pericentriolar sites”并列的细胞生物学术语

patterns.name: Co- 前缀词
patterns.context: 一个是 cooperative binding systems，另一个是独立标题 Co-insurance；同一词首片段处于不同词汇和语义环境
patterns.domain: 科研计划文本、百科条目

patterns.name: Co-复合词及其后缀
patterns.context: 激活覆盖连字符复合词的 Co- 开头，也包括非连字符单词 Coastal；后续上下文分别涉及寄生虫、铀酰运输及沿海规划
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、科研摘要、邮件

en.description: Activations span different corpora and topics, including main.bib in ArXiv metadata, fragments within Italian words, academic terminology, and several sentence-initial English word fragments. The triggering forms are inconsistent across passages, making it difficult to identify a single semantic or syntactic feature.

patterns.name: Bib filename in ArXiv paper metadata
patterns.context: A filename for the main cited work in the bibliography: field; often accompanied by title:

patterns.name: Specific subword fragments in Italian words
patterns.context: Appears in Italian sentences, embedded respectively in the forms “esecuzione” and “effettiva”

patterns.name: Token fragments within English words
patterns.context: Hyphenated compound words in English technical prose

patterns.name: Token fragment at the beginning of retroviral
patterns.context: A continuous sequence of English word fragments is activated at the start of the sentence, ending within retroviral; it is not triggered only by a fragment within one word

patterns.name: Sentence-initial word fragment in cooperative binding systems
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on sentence-initial Co, followed by a biochemical research topic

patterns.name: Rare terminology and its subword fragments
patterns.context: Discussion of convergence, semigroups, and Vlasov evolution in a mathematics paper

patterns.name: Split fragment of Surveillance
patterns.context: Sentence-initial statement concerning gastrointestinal mucosa and sensory neurons; only the initial word fragment shows prominent activation

1_25.concept: none
1_25.description: 激活分布于不同语料和主题：包括 ArXiv 元数据中的 main.bib、意大利语词内片段、学术术语及若干句首英文词片段。各段触发形式不统一，难以归为单一语义或句法特征。

patterns.name: ArXiv 论文元数据中的 bib 文件名
patterns.context: 在 bibliography: 字段中作为引用主文献的文件名；多处伴有 title:

patterns.name: 意大利语词语中的特定子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在意大利语句子中，分别嵌入“esecuzione”和“effettiva”等词形

patterns.name: 英文词内的切分片段
patterns.context: 英文专业论述中的连字符复合词

patterns.name: retroviral 一词开头的切分片段
patterns.trigger: «A»« model»« system»« has»« been»« developed» 后接 “retro«viral”
patterns.context: 句首为连续英文词片段激活，末尾落在 retroviral 中；并非只由某个词内片段触发

patterns.name: 合作结合系统的句首词片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在句首 Co，后续为生物化学研究主题

patterns.name: 生僻术语及其子词片段
patterns.context: 数学论文中关于收敛、半群与 Vlasov 演化的论述

patterns.name: Surveillance 的拆分片段
patterns.context: 句首出现 gastrointestinal mucosa 与 sensory neurons 相关陈述；只有词首片段显著激活

en.concept: Derivative-related text and several formatting/string features
en.description: Most segments contain derivative and its compound uses in academic contexts; there are also isolated activations on main.bib in paper metadata, the sym substring in electroweak-symmetry, and the title year 2007.

patterns.name: Derivative terminology and mathematical usage
patterns.context: Directly contains derivative or a modifier form, often in mathematical or physical statements describing functions, curves, estimators, or forces; no fixed syntactic position is required.
patterns.domain: Academic papers in mathematics, statistics, physics, etc.

patterns.name: Bibliography filename formatting
patterns.context: A bibliography field and the filename main.bib appear in paper metadata or a document list; segment 9 has a similar bibliography/main.bib format, but no activation on main is marked.

patterns.name: Letter combination in a specific string
patterns.context: The word electroweak-symmetry is split by tokenization; strong activation falls on the sym substring, which is not semantically related to derivatives.

patterns.name: Year number
patterns.context: A year appears as the year/season identifier at the start of a title, followed by the name of the Division 1 league.

1_25.concept: 导数相关文本及若干格式/字符串特征
1_25.description: 多数段在学术语境中出现 derivative 及其复合用法；另对论文元数据中的 main.bib、electroweak-symmetry 的 sym 子串和标题年份 2007 有孤立激活。

patterns.name: 导数术语及其数学用法
patterns.context: 直接出现 derivative 或其修饰形式，常处在描述函数、曲线、估计量或力的数学/物理语句中；无需固定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 数学、统计、物理等学术论文

patterns.name: 参考文献文件名格式
patterns.context: 论文元数据或文档列表中出现 bibliography 字段及 main.bib 文件名；第9段也有相似 bibliography/main.bib 格式，但未标记 main 的激活。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文档或元数据片段

patterns.name: 特定字符串中的字母组合
patterns.context: 单词 electroweak-symmetry 被分词切开；强激活落在 sym 子串，语义上并非导数。

patterns.name: 年份数字
patterns.context: 年份作为标题开头的年份／赛季标识出现，后接 Division 1 联赛名称。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科体育条目

en.concept: Derivative word forms in technical text
en.description: Primarily activates on derivative and its mathematical and physical modifiers in technical text; there are also local activations on word forms or terms such as octet, cross, properties, and majorizing, as well as sporadic activations in proper names, formulas, and titles.

patterns.name: Derivative in mathematics/physics
patterns.context: Appears in technical prose to refer to a differential, derivative, or derivative-related object; may have modifiers such as cross derivative, directional derivative, second derivative, derivative nonlinear equation.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, statistics, and engineering papers

patterns.name: Final subword in a hyphenated compound
patterns.context: Activation falls on the repeated subword octet in a hyphenated compound, with weaker activation on the first octet as well; it may be unrelated to the semantics of derivative.

patterns.name: Technical use of cross
patterns.context: Cross modifies derivative, and nearby content discusses additional forces and dependence on time and nuclear motion; the same word is repeatedly activated in the same passage.

patterns.name: Properties in a gas properties heading
patterns.context: Appears in the paper-structure heading “Section [gas_properties]”, describing gas properties; it is unclear whether derivative explains it.

patterns.name: Majorizing function word fragment
patterns.context: Adjacent to “majorizing function” and derivative error estimates; activation concentrates on the stem major rather than a consistent derivative token.

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: Sporadic activations in an abstract passage at the beginning, without a clear shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: If not treated as a hyphenated subword pattern, this is an isolated trigger on the term octet, with no clear connection to other passages.

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: Appears within Floquet; activation may be related to tokenization, but this is a single instance and the semantic trigger is unclear.

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: Located at the end of a formula/variable expression; insufficient context to determine the cause of activation.

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: Located in “dust IR emission”; the cause of activation is unclear.

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: Appears in the name Ablo(w)itz-Kaup-Newell-Segur, possibly due to tokenization of a proper name.

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: Appears in the theorem label “main theorem”; a singleton activation.

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: Appears within autocad, possibly due to tokenization; cannot be robustly associated with derivative in technical papers.

1_25.concept: 技术文本中的 derivative 词形
1_25.description: 主要对技术文本中的 derivative 及其数学、物理修饰形式激活；另有 octet、cross、properties、majorizing 等局部词形或术语激活，以及若干专名、公式和标题中的零散激活。

patterns.name: 数学/物理中的 derivative
patterns.context: 出现在技术叙述中，指微分、导数或导数相关对象；前后可有修饰语，如 cross derivative、directional derivative、second derivative、derivative nonlinear equation。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理、统计及工程论文

patterns.name: 连字符复合词中的末尾子词
patterns.context: 激活落在连字符连接的重复子词 octet 中，首个 octet 也有较弱激活；未必与 derivative 的语义有关。

patterns.name: cross 的术语性出现
patterns.context: cross 修饰 derivative，且相邻内容讨论额外的力及时间与核运动依赖；同一词在同一片段重复激活。
patterns.domain: 量子化学/分子动力学论文

patterns.name: gas properties 标题中的 properties
patterns.context: 处于论文结构标题“Section [gas_properties]”中，描述气体性质；是否由 derivative 模式解释不清。

patterns.name: 主要化函数词片段
patterns.context: 与“majorizing function”及其导数误差估计相邻；激活集中在 major 词干而非统一的导数 token。

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: 片段开头抽象表述中的零散激活，未形成清晰的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: 若不把它视为连字符子词模式，则这是单独的 octet 术语触发，和其他片段缺少明确联系。

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: 出现在 Floquet 一词内部；激活可能与分词有关，但仅此一例，语义触发不明。

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: 位于公式/变量表达式末尾，缺少足够上下文判定触发原因。

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: 位于“dust IR emission”中，激活原因不明。

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: 出现在人名 Ablo(w)itz-Kaup-Newell-Segur 中，可能是专名分词效应。

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: 出现在定理标签“main theorem”中，单例激活。

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: 出现在 autocad 的词内，可能是分词效应，无法与技术论文中的 derivative 稳健关联。

en.description: Activations are scattered across derivative/differential terminology, octet baryons, a Feature field, galactic halos, a Boselli subword in a citation, and iron spectral lines; no unified semantics or stable contextual condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Derivative and differential-analysis terminology
patterns.context: Derivatives are used for curve feature extraction, estimator properties, error analysis, or descriptions of astrophysical relationships; they appear both alone and in nested derivative expressions.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, signal processing, statistical estimation, astrophysics; paper abstracts or body text

patterns.name: Octet baryon terminology
patterns.context: Names the research subject near the beginning of a particle-physics abstract; activation mainly falls on octet-related word fragments.

patterns.name: Feature field label
patterns.context: A field heading beginning with Feature in code or configuration text, followed by “BoxPacker.”

patterns.name: Galactic halo terminology
patterns.context: Discusses galaxies, satellite galaxies, cold gas accretion, and feedback, or dark matter halos and elliptical-galaxy profiles; activation covers tokenized fragments of halo.

patterns.name: Author-name fragment in a citation
patterns.context: An author’s surname in an astrophysics reference list; activation concentrates on a subword fragment of the name, surrounded by author-year citations.
patterns.domain: Literature citations in ArXiv body text

patterns.name: Iron spectral-line marker
patterns.context: Mentions iron spectral lines in stellar observations or spectral analysis and describes model grids and sample validation.

1_25.concept: none
1_25.description: 激活分散于导数/微分术语、octet 重子、Feature 字段、星系晕、引用中的 Boselli 子词及铁谱线等不同局部片段；未见统一语义或稳定上下文条件。

patterns.name: 导数与微分分析术语
patterns.trigger: “third-order polynomial fitting”“second derivative”“derivative”“directional derivative”“twice derivative”“derivative of MLR”
patterns.context: 导数用于曲线特征提取、估计器性质、误差分析或天体物理关系描述；既包括单独出现，也包括嵌套导数表达。
patterns.domain: 数学、信号处理、统计估计、天体物理；论文摘要或正文

patterns.name: octet 重子术语
patterns.context: 粒子物理摘要开头对研究对象的命名；激活主要落在 octet 相关词片段。
patterns.domain: 高能理论物理，ArXiv 摘要

patterns.name: 特征字段标签
patterns.context: 代码或配置文本中以 Feature 开头的字段标题，后接 “BoxPacker”。

patterns.name: 星系晕术语
patterns.context: 讨论星系、卫星星系、冷气体吸积及反馈，或暗物质晕与椭圆星系剖面；激活覆盖 halo 的分词片段。
patterns.domain: 天体物理与星系演化论文

patterns.name: 文献引用中的作者名片段
patterns.context: 天体物理参考文献列表中的作者姓氏；激活集中在名字的子词片段，周围是作者—年份引用。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 正文中的文献引用

patterns.name: 铁谱线标记
patterns.context: 恒星观测或光谱分析中提及铁谱线，并描述模型网格及样本验证。

en.description: Primarily responds to derivative and its scientific-paper contexts, covering derivatives of estimators, optimization, stellar mass, nonlinear equations, and slow variables; also strongly responds to sporadic fragments such as feature extraction, extraction/distillation, octet-octet, and covariances.

patterns.name: derivative root
patterns.context: Direct trigger: derivative; appears in scientific discussion, with no requirement for a specific mathematical object or syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, statistics, and scientific papers

patterns.name: Polynomial fitting and derivative features
patterns.context: Describes fitting a trend curve with a third-degree polynomial and using the extrema of its second derivative as features.

patterns.name: Octet baryon name fragment
patterns.context: In particle-physics abstracts, the term octet-octet baryon is split into tokens.

patterns.name: Extraction- and distillation-related words
patterns.context: Root fragments trigger in information-extraction or knowledge-distillation contexts; these do not share the same semantics as the derivative pattern.
patterns.domain: Quantum information and natural language processing papers

patterns.name: Fragment within covariances
patterns.context: In high-dimensional statistics, covariances is split into fragments, with activation concentrated on the initial fragment.

1_25.concept: 科学术语片段检测
1_25.description: 主要响应 derivative 及其科学论文语境，涵盖估计量、优化、恒星质量、非线性方程和慢变量的导数；另对特征提取、抽取/蒸馏、octet-octet及covariances等零散片段强响应。

patterns.name: derivative 词根
patterns.context: 直接触发词 derivative；出现在科学论述中，不要求特定数学对象或句法位置。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理、统计及科学论文

patterns.name: 多项式拟合与导数特征
patterns.context: 描述用三阶多项式拟合趋势曲线，并取其二阶导数的极值作为特征。
patterns.domain: 医学信号处理／特征提取摘要

patterns.name: 八重态粒子名称片段
patterns.context: 粒子物理摘要中，octet-octet baryon 一词被拆分标记。

patterns.name: 抽取及蒸馏相关词
patterns.context: 信息抽取或知识蒸馏语境中，触发词根片段；与 derivative 模式并非同一语义。
patterns.domain: 量子信息、自然语言处理论文

patterns.name: 协方差词内片段
patterns.context: 高维统计中，covariances 被分段标记，激活集中在词首片段。

en.concept: Separate word forms and scattered paper fragments
en.description: Activations often fall on Sep/separ forms, in contexts involving separability, class separation, or independent analysis; other high activations occur on paper terminology, metadata, and Italian fragments, which cannot yet be explained by the same rule.

patterns.name: Separation/splitting-related word forms
patterns.context: The forms vary but all appear in contexts expressing separation, class margins, or independent analysis; some are split into subwords.
patterns.domain: Papers, medical abstracts, and statistical analyses

patterns.name: Lexical or subword incidental trigger
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on word fragments containing Sep/separ, but their contexts vary: word splitting, class separation, and independent analysis. It is unclear whether they share a semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Other paper terminology and structural fragments
patterns.context: Several high activations fall on abstracts, technical terms, titles, or bibliography-format fragments, with no stable co-occurrence with separation-related forms.

patterns.name: Italian word fragment
patterns.context: Appears in parliamentary text, possibly an Italian expression meaning “effective execution”; no clear shared trigger with the other segments.

1_25.concept: 分离词形及零散论文片段
1_25.description: 激活常落在 Sep/separ 词形上，涉及可分、类别分离或独立分析；但另有论文术语、元数据、意大利语片段等高激活，尚不能用同一规则解释。

patterns.name: 分离／拆分相关词形
patterns.context: 词形虽有不同，但都出现在表示分离、分类间隔或独立分析的语境中；有的被切分为子词。
patterns.domain: 论文、医学摘要及统计分析

patterns.name: 词汇或子词偶然触发
patterns.trigger: « Sep»10arable Optical« Pot»1«entials»1；« Sep»10«aration»4；«sep»相关片段
patterns.context: 激活集中于包含 Sep/separ 的词片段，但上下文含义各异：词语拆分、类别分离、独立分析；无法确认是否共享语义触发。

patterns.name: 其他论文术语与结构片段
patterns.context: 若干高激活落在摘要、技术术语、标题或文献格式片段，未见它们与分离词形稳定共现。

patterns.name: 意大利语词片段
patterns.context: 出现在议会文本中，疑似意大利语“有效执行”一类表达；与其他段落无明显共享触发。

en.concept: Methods and processes in academic technical text
en.description: Activation is distributed across ArXiv abstract markers and technical text from multiple fields: methods, mappings, networks, statistical inference, information extraction/distillation, reference-image learning, geometric representations, and astrophysical modeling; there is no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: abstract marker at the start of an abstract
patterns.context: Begins with abstract: ' at the start of a paragraph, followed by the abstract text; other tokens in the text also activate.

patterns.name: Statistical methods and variable selection
patterns.context: The abstract introduces an adaptive clustered Lasso method for variable selection.

patterns.name: Bilingual word embeddings and learned mapping
patterns.context: The abstract describes an unsupervised bilingual word-embedding method that learns a cross-lingual mapping matrix.

patterns.name: Narrowband wireless networks and wide-sensing range
patterns.context: The abstract discusses wide-sense stationarity in narrowband wireless body-area networks.

patterns.name: Wide- and narrow-band measurement or survey descriptions
patterns.context: The abstract introduces deep and wide narrow-band surveys conducted using UKIRT.

patterns.name: High-dimensional statistical inference for covariance matrices
patterns.context: The abstract discusses the asymptotic distribution of the maximum deviation of a sample covariance matrix and high-dimensional covariance inference.

patterns.name: Extraction and distillation
patterns.context: In descriptions of quantum information processing, extractable information is extracted and singlets are distilled.

patterns.name: Reference images and data-driven learning
patterns.context: Compares category reference images and proposes learning background-category reference images from data rather than relying on heuristic rules.

patterns.name: Distilling information to aid extraction
patterns.context: Opinion information from the entire input is distilled for aspect-term extraction.
patterns.domain: Natural language processing paper body text

patterns.name: Geometric representations and property distortion
patterns.context: Discusses how different representations of hyperbolic space preserve some geometric properties while distorting others.
patterns.domain: Papers on geometry and representation learning

patterns.name: Radiative-transfer modeling and tracing
patterns.context: Astrophysical modeling uses the large-velocity-gradient approximation to construct a radiative-transfer module and CO transitions to trace shocks.

1_25.concept: 学术技术文本中的方法与过程表述
1_25.description: 激活分布于ArXiv论文摘要标记及多领域技术文本：方法、映射、网络、统计推断、信息提取/蒸馏、参考图像学习、几何表示和天体物理建模；没有单一稳定的语义触发词。

patterns.name: 摘要开头的 abstract 标记
patterns.context: 段首以 abstract: ' 开始，随后进入论文摘要正文；正文中的 token 另有激活。

patterns.name: 统计方法与变量选择
patterns.context: 摘要介绍一种用于 variable selection 的自适应聚类 Lasso 方法。
patterns.domain: 统计学、机器学习论文摘要

patterns.name: 双语词嵌入及学习映射
patterns.context: 摘要描述无监督双语词嵌入方法学习跨语言映射矩阵。
patterns.domain: 自然语言处理论文摘要

patterns.name: 窄带无线网络与宽感知范围
patterns.context: 摘要讨论窄带无线体域网络中的宽感知平稳性。

patterns.name: 宽窄带测量或调查描述
patterns.context: 摘要介绍使用 UKIRT 进行的 deep and wide narrow-band surveys。

patterns.name: 协方差矩阵的高维统计推断
patterns.context: 摘要讨论样本协方差矩阵最大偏差的渐近分布及高维协方差推断。

patterns.name: 提取与蒸馏
patterns.context: 在量子信息处理描述中提取可提取信息并蒸馏单重态。

patterns.name: 参考图像及数据驱动学习
patterns.context: 以类别参考图像进行比较，并提出从数据中学习背景类别参考图像，而非依赖启发式规则。

patterns.name: 蒸馏信息辅助抽取
patterns.context: 为方面词抽取而蒸馏整段输入中的意见信息。
patterns.domain: 自然语言处理论文正文

patterns.name: 几何表示及性质失真
patterns.context: 讨论双曲空间的不同表示保留某些几何性质、同时扭曲另一些性质。
patterns.domain: 几何与表示学习相关论文正文

patterns.name: 辐射转移建模与示踪
patterns.context: 天体物理建模中以大速度梯度近似建立辐射转移模块，并用 CO 跃迁示踪激波。

en.concept: Subword boundaries and template markers in academic text
en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on the word-initial subword dist in distill; there are also weaker or localized patterns involving abstract templates, internal splits in technical terms, and equation markers. The corpora are all academic papers, but the trigger forms are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Word-initial split in distill
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-initial subword fragment dist in the English word distill; the full word varies with context.
patterns.domain: Machine learning, quantum information, and geometry paper body text

patterns.name: Abstract marker and its introductory template
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of an ArXiv abstract, often followed by the research subject, problem, or method.

patterns.name: Internal subword splits in names or terminology
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within compound terms or technical words, rather than at full-word boundaries; referents differ across instances.
patterns.domain: Statistical learning, classification, and particle physics abstracts

patterns.name: Methods and research-action words
patterns.context: Appears in statements describing research goals, methods, or experimental design; several action words receive only weak activation.
patterns.domain: Academic paper abstracts and body text

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and label structure
patterns.context: Near LaTeX mathematical formulas, alignment environments, or equation numbers.

patterns.name: Trace class phrase
patterns.context: Appears in a technical phrase describing determinantal point processes and projection kernels.

patterns.name: Numerical marker
patterns.context: Appears at an upper bound in a formula sum or at a quantity symbol; activation is weak.

1_25.concept: 学术文本中的子词边界与模板标记
1_25.description: 强激活主要落在 distill 的词首子词 dist；另有摘要模板、技术词内部切分及公式标记等较弱或局部模式。语料均为学术论文，但触发形式并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 词首 distill 的切分
patterns.context: 激活落在英文单词 distill 的词首子词片段 dist 上；完整词随上下文变化。
patterns.domain: 机器学习、量子信息及几何学论文正文

patterns.name: abstract 摘要标记及其引言模板
patterns.context: 出现在 ArXiv 摘要开头；常接研究对象、问题或方法。

patterns.name: 专名或术语的内部子词切分
patterns.context: 激活落在复合术语或技术词的子词片段中，而非完整词边界；各处所指不同。
patterns.domain: 统计学习、分类及粒子物理摘要

patterns.name: 方法与研究动作词
patterns.context: 出现在论文描述研究目标、方法或实验方案的陈述中；多个动作词仅有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 数学公式及标签结构
patterns.context: 位于 LaTeX 数学公式、对齐环境或公式编号附近。

patterns.name: trace class 短语
patterns.context: 出现在描述行列式点过程及投影核的技术短语中。
patterns.domain: 概率论与数学论文摘要

patterns.name: 数值标记
patterns.context: 出现在公式求和上界或数量符号处；激活较弱。

en.concept: Proper names and markers in machine-learning text
en.description: Activation is distributed across abstract markers, paper terminology and formulas, code paths, and machine-learning contexts; recurring local cues include learn/learnability, scikit-learn, and split proper names. Isolated triggers such as closing parentheses after list numbers also occur.

patterns.name: abstract marker
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a paper abstract, followed by a quotation mark or the abstract text.

patterns.name: Spectrograph token split
patterns.context: The instrument name Spectrograph is split into multiple tokens, with especially strong activation on the final part.

patterns.name: Mathematical subscript l and state-vector notation
patterns.context: Mathematical formulas contain bra-ket notation, state vectors with subscripts, or script symbols; the trigger may be concentrated on l or related formula tokens.

patterns.name: learn in a dataset path
patterns.context: learn appears in a path string adjacent to a dataset or code-directory name.

patterns.name: Convolution blocks and dataset names
patterns.context: Discusses model-performance evaluation involving CNNs, convolution kernels, or convolution blocks, and lists dataset or model names.

patterns.name: Lasso method name
patterns.context: The method name Adaptive Cluster Lasso is split into multiple tokens, with activation especially on Lasso.

patterns.name: learnability and causal functions
patterns.context: A mathematical argument uses learnability as a section label and discusses causal functions, shift intensity, and limits.

patterns.name: scikit-learn name
patterns.context: Mentions the Python machine-learning library scikit-learn, possibly in connection with labels, classification, or metric-related questions.

patterns.name: learn variable name
patterns.context: In code, the variable learn refers to a ConvLearner object and fit is called; occurs near library names or training procedures.

patterns.name: Closing parenthesis in numbered items
patterns.context: In numbered list items, a closing parenthesis follows the number; activation also occurs near the item text.

1_25.concept: 机器学习文本中的专名与标记
1_25.description: 激活分布于摘要标记、论文术语与公式、代码路径及机器学习语境；反复出现的局部线索包括 learn/learnability、scikit-learn，以及被拆分的专名。另有编号右括号等孤立触发。

patterns.name: abstract 摘要标记
patterns.context: 出现在论文摘要开头，后接引号或摘要正文。

patterns.name: Spectrograph 断词
patterns.context: 仪器名 Spectrograph 被拆成多个 token，末尾部分激活尤其强。

patterns.name: 数学下标 l 与态矢量记号
patterns.context: 数学公式中出现 bra-ket、带下标的态矢量或脚本符号；具体触发可能集中于 l 或相关公式 token。

patterns.name: 数据集路径中的 learn
patterns.context: 路径字符串中出现 learn，且邻接数据集或代码目录名。

patterns.name: 卷积块与数据集名
patterns.context: 讨论 CNN、卷积核或卷积块的模型性能评估，并列出数据集或模型名。

patterns.name: Lasso 方法名
patterns.context: 方法名称 Adaptive Cluster Lasso 被拆分为多个 token，尤其 Lasso 部分激活。
patterns.domain: 统计/机器学习论文摘要

patterns.name: learnability 与因果函数
patterns.context: 数学论证中以 learnability 作为章节标签，讨论因果函数、移位强度与极限。

patterns.name: scikit-learn 名称
patterns.context: 提及 Python 机器学习库 scikit-learn，可能用于标签、分类或指标相关问题。

patterns.name: learn 变量名
patterns.context: 代码中变量 learn 指向 ConvLearner 对象，并调用 fit；与库名或训练流程相邻。

patterns.name: 编号条目右括号
patterns.context: 编号列表条目中，数字后跟右括号；激活也出现在条目内容附近。

en.concept: Academic paper abstracts and method terminology
en.description: Activations mainly concentrate at the beginnings of ArXiv abstracts and in “propose” proposal sentences; topics vary, with localized responses also to clustering terminology, convolution, quantum gates, mathematical subscripts, and several specific expressions.

patterns.name: Opening format of paper abstracts
patterns.context: Located at the beginning of an ArXiv abstract or proposal sentence; the neuron responds to local tokens in abstract formatting and proposal wording, but the marked content does not always belong to the same semantic category.

patterns.name: Clustering and data-partition terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in discussions of clustering, classification, data partitioning, or clustering methods; activation falls on clustering terms, nearby phrases, and method names.

patterns.name: 3D convolution terminology
patterns.context: Describes the computational or memory cost of 3D convolutions; activation mainly falls on a tokenized fragment of “convolutions.”

patterns.name: Model proposal and learning descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces a new model or method and its learning objective in an abstract; unlike the clustering topic, these terms occur in the context of sparse recommendation-system modeling.

patterns.name: Quantum information terminology
patterns.context: Introduces quantum gates or quantum circuits; activation covers gate operations and gate-set terminology.

patterns.name: Consistency-condition statement
patterns.context: Proposes a set of consistency conditions; the fragment is truncated near “therm…”, so the full topic cannot be determined.

patterns.name: Suggested research location
patterns.context: An abstract proposes finding the best location for an object; the fragment is truncated at “S”, leaving the specific research object unclear.
patterns.domain: Uncertain, possibly applied or empirical research

patterns.name: Subscript notation in formulas
patterns.context: A post-formula explanation in a mathematical derivation of a sum or index range; activation highlights the word “subscript” rather than a clustering topic.

1_25.concept: 学术论文摘要与方法术语
1_25.description: 激活主要集中于 ArXiv 摘要的开头与“propose”提案句；内容主题多样，另对聚类术语、卷积、量子门、数学下标及若干特定表达有局部响应。

patterns.name: 论文摘要起始格式
patterns.context: 位于 ArXiv 摘要开头或提案句开头；神经元对摘要格式和提案表达的局部 token 有响应，但被标记的内容并不总是同一语义类别。

patterns.name: 聚类与数据划分术语
patterns.context: 讨论聚类、分类、数据分区或聚类方法时；激活落在聚类术语、邻近短语及方法名上。

patterns.name: 3D 卷积术语
patterns.context: 描述 3D 卷积的计算或内存代价；激活主要落在“convolutions”的分词片段。

patterns.name: 模型提出与学习表述
patterns.context: 摘要中介绍新模型或方法及其学习目标；不同于聚类主题，这些词出现在稀疏推荐系统建模语境。

patterns.name: 量子信息术语
patterns.context: 介绍量子门或量子电路；激活覆盖门操作、门集合相关术语。

patterns.name: 一致性条件表述
patterns.context: 提出一组一致性条件；片段截断在“therm…”附近，无法确定完整主题。
patterns.domain: 理论或数学类论文摘要

patterns.name: 研究地点建议
patterns.context: 摘要提出寻找某对象的最佳地点；片段在“S”处截断，具体研究对象不明。
patterns.domain: 不确定，可能为应用或实证研究

patterns.name: 公式中的下标符号
patterns.context: 数学推导中的公式后解释求和或指标范围；激活突出“subscript”一词而非聚类主题。

en.description: Activation commonly occurs in ArXiv papers, especially abstracts, method proposals, and statistical/machine-learning terminology; it also appears sporadically in physics, experimental sample preparation, deep learning, paper navigation, and quantum computing text. Some activations fall on subword fragments of technical terms, with no unified semantics apparent.

patterns.name: Machine-learning paper abstracts and method proposals
patterns.context: An abstract or paper introduction states a problem or proposes a method or model; often accompanied by terms such as machine learning, clustering, classification, and feature selection.

patterns.name: Machine-learning and statistical modeling terminology
patterns.context: Discusses learning, classification, sparse modeling, Bayesian inference, or regression methods; need not occur in an abstract.

patterns.name: Opening format of an abstract
patterns.context: At the start of an ArXiv abstract, often using standard phrasing to introduce the paper or propose a method.

patterns.name: Token fragments in domain-specific names and terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments of technical vocabulary or proper names; surrounding semantics and sentence structures vary, with no common condition observed.

patterns.name: Physics and astrophysics discussion
patterns.context: Discusses particle phenomenology, perturbation theory, or the X-ray evolution and gas of galaxy clusters.

patterns.name: Experimental materials and sample-preparation descriptions
patterns.context: Describes powder sample loading, thickness, and encapsulation materials.

patterns.name: Computer-vision / deep-learning model descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces the computational cost and memory requirements of traditional three-dimensional convolutions.

patterns.name: Paper structure, sections, and cross-references
patterns.context: Section organization, figure and table references, or anchored section headings in the main text.

patterns.name: Statistical-inference conditions and distribution tails
patterns.context: Discusses misspecified-noise conditions, distribution tails, and sampler derivations.

patterns.name: Quantum-gate terminology
patterns.context: Lists controlled quantum logic gates in an abstract.

1_25.concept: 学术论文及专业术语
1_25.description: 激活常见于ArXiv论文，尤其摘要、方法提出及统计/机器学习术语；也散见于物理、实验制样、深度学习、论文导航和量子计算文本。若干激活落在专业词的子词片段，未显示统一语义。

patterns.name: 机器学习论文摘要与方法提出
patterns.context: 摘要或论文介绍中陈述问题、提出方法或模型；常伴随机器学习、聚类、分类、特征选择等词

patterns.name: 机器学习与统计建模术语
patterns.context: 讨论学习、分类、稀疏建模、贝叶斯推断或回归方法；不一定出现在摘要

patterns.name: 摘要开头格式
patterns.context: ArXiv 摘要起始处，常用论文自述或提出方法的固定表述

patterns.name: 领域专名与术语中的 token 片段
patterns.trigger: «apt»（«kapton» 中）、«unit»（«unitarity» 中）、«pl»（«pltdif» 中）、«sam»、«pl»（«samplers» 中）、«conv»（«convolutions» 中）
patterns.context: 激活落在专业词汇或专名的子词片段上；周围语义和句式各异，未见共同条件

patterns.name: 物理与天体物理论述
patterns.context: 讨论粒子现象学、微扰理论或星系团的 X 射线演化与气体

patterns.name: 实验材料与制样描述
patterns.context: 说明粉末样品的装填、厚度与封装材料
patterns.domain: 实验物理/材料实验方法

patterns.name: 计算机视觉/深度学习模型描述
patterns.context: 介绍传统三维卷积的计算成本和内存需求

patterns.name: 论文结构、章节与交叉引用
patterns.context: 正文中的章节安排、图表引用或带锚点的章节标题

patterns.name: 统计推断条件与分布尾部
patterns.context: 讨论错设噪声条件、分布尾部和采样器推导

patterns.name: 量子门术语
patterns.context: 摘要中列举受控量子逻辑门

en.description: Mainly responds to abstract-style method introductions and specialist terminology in ArXiv scientific papers; there are also localized responses to word-initial oct-, LaTeX formulas, section and figure markers, and astronomy and algebra terminology.

patterns.name: Models and methods in machine-learning abstracts
patterns.context: When an abstract or paper introduction presents a model, method, prediction task, or data problem; especially method proposals and descriptions of neural networks, classifiers, recommender systems, etc.

patterns.name: Specialist terms beginning with oct-
patterns.context: A technical term beginning with oct- appears in physics- or geometry-related technical text; both instances are near abstracts, and the trigger concentrates on the word-initial substring “oct”.
patterns.domain: Particle physics, geometry, and spatial structures

patterns.name: Mathematical notation in formulas
patterns.context: Near LaTeX formulas, ket notation, and equation numbers in the paper body.

patterns.name: Paper section headings and cross-references
patterns.context: Section headings, figure/table references, or heading lines with markup syntax in the body text.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper body text and markup

patterns.name: Classification terminology in disciplinary abstracts
patterns.context: Introduces mathematical classification results or algebraic structures at the beginning of an abstract; the word is only lexically identical to classification in machine learning, and the contexts differ.

patterns.name: Astronomical parameters and model subsection
patterns.context: Discusses spectral wavelengths, figures, and stellar-atmosphere or abundance-analysis methods.

1_25.concept: 科技论文中的技术表述
1_25.description: 主要响应 ArXiv 科技论文中的摘要式方法介绍与专业术语；另对 oct- 词首、LaTeX 公式、章节图表标记及天文和代数术语有局部响应。

patterns.name: 机器学习摘要中的模型与方法
patterns.context: 摘要或论文引言中介绍模型、方法、预测任务或数据问题时；尤其是提出方法及描述神经网络、分类器、推荐系统等
patterns.domain: ArXiv 机器学习与计算方法论文

patterns.name: oct-开头的专业术语
patterns.context: 物理或几何相关技术文本中出现以 oct- 开头的专业词；两处都在摘要附近，触发集中在词首子串“oct”
patterns.domain: 粒子物理、几何与空间结构

patterns.name: 公式中的数学排版符号
patterns.context: 论文正文的 LaTeX 公式、态矢记号及公式编号附近

patterns.name: 论文结构标题与交叉引用
patterns.context: 正文中的章节标题、图表引用或带有标记语法的标题行
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文正文及排版标记

patterns.name: 专业学科摘要中的分类术语
patterns.context: 摘要开头介绍数学分类结果或代数结构时；与机器学习中的分类一词仅字面相同，语境不同

patterns.name: 天文学参数与模型小节
patterns.context: 讨论光谱波长、图表及恒星大气或丰度分析方法时

en.description: Activation occurs in multidisciplinary paper abstracts, formulas, and code documentation, often alongside technical terminology and method descriptions; several passages involve density, distributions, or statistics, but no clear shared semantics cover all passages.

patterns.name: Machine-learning paper abstracts
patterns.context: ArXiv abstracts introduce a method, problem, or model involving machine-learning topics such as classification, convolution, recommendation, and word vectors.

patterns.name: Density and statistical distributions in physics
patterns.context: Physics papers discuss charge-density waves, particle distributions, or statistical-mechanics quantities.

patterns.name: Mathematical-physics formulas and symbols
patterns.context: Text explaining subscript ranges follows a typeset formula.

patterns.name: Convolution code documentation
patterns.context: Code comments or documentation explain that a module consists of different branches and operations.

patterns.name: Hadron-physics terminology
patterns.context: The abstract begins by stating that it studies a baryonic system.

patterns.name: Target localization and measurement
patterns.context: Describes a measurement problem in which an unknown target is localized by probing a set of positions.

1_25.concept: none
1_25.description: 激活出现在多学科论文摘要、公式和代码文档中，常伴随技术术语与方法说明；若干段涉及密度、分布或统计量，但没有覆盖全部段落的明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 机器学习论文摘要
patterns.trigger: “high probability density clusters”“classification”“semi-supervised classification”；“3D convolutions”；“data sparsity problem of recommender systems”“shared feature space”；“Unsupervised bilingual word embedding”“transformation matrix”
patterns.context: ArXiv 摘要中介绍方法、问题或模型，涉及分类、卷积、推荐、词向量等机器学习内容
patterns.domain: 机器学习与计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 物理中的密度与统计分布
patterns.trigger: “charge density wave”“particle distribution”“partition function”“mutual exclusion statistics”
patterns.context: 物理学论文讨论电荷密度波、粒子分布或统计力学量
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理与统计物理

patterns.name: 数学物理公式与符号
patterns.context: 公式排版后接关于下标范围的文字说明

patterns.name: 卷积代码文档
patterns.context: 代码注释或文档说明模块由不同分支及操作组成

patterns.name: 强子物理术语
patterns.context: 摘要开头陈述对重子体系的研究

patterns.name: 目标定位与测量
patterns.trigger: “unknown target location”“sequence of measurements”“sum of an indicator”
patterns.context: 描述通过对一组位置进行探测来定位未知目标的测量问题
patterns.domain: 数学建模或信号处理论文

en.concept: Function and rule phrases in scientific terminology
en.description: Strong responses are distributed across scientific paper terminology: density function (in several combinations) is most prominent, with additional responses to Spectrograph, partition function, Bayesian procedure, and sum rule phrases; GZK- and inflaton-related fragments lack discernible trigger points.

patterns.name: density function and its combinations
patterns.context: density function appears as a noun phrase preceded by different modifiers; surrounding text may discuss integration, empirical probability, or the atomic pair distribution.
patterns.domain: Machine learning, statistical physics, condensed matter physics

patterns.name: Spectrograph names in astronomical observations
patterns.context: A subword fragment forms Spectrograph in the name of an astronomical observation instrument or survey.

patterns.name: partition function
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of statistical mechanics in the context of maximizing particle distributions.

patterns.name: Bayesian procedure
patterns.context: Used to quantify truncation errors in EFT predictions and fits.

patterns.name: cluster sum rule
patterns.context: Appears as the name of a rule for inferring or analyzing nuclear structure and nucleon correlations.

patterns.name: sum rules
patterns.context: Refers to sum rules applied to models; these are not the same domain object as “cluster sum rule.”

1_25.concept: 科学术语中的 function 与规则词组
1_25.description: 强响应分散在科学论文术语中：density function（含多种组合）最突出，另对 Spectrograph、partition function、Bayesian procedure 和 sum rule 类词组有反应；GZK 与暴胀子相关片段缺乏可辨触发点。

patterns.name: density function及其组合
patterns.trigger: « density»2« function»10；« probability»6« density»1« function»10；« pair»4« distribution»7« function»10
patterns.context: density function 作为名词短语出现，前接不同限定词；周边可谈积分、经验概率或原子对分布。
patterns.domain: 机器学习、统计物理、凝聚态物理

patterns.name: 天体观测中的光谱仪名称
patterns.context: 词片段组成 Spectrograph，出现在天文观测设备或观测项目名称中。

patterns.name: partition function
patterns.context: 在统计力学讨论中，出现在最大化粒子分布的语境。

patterns.name: Bayesian procedure
patterns.context: 用于量化 EFT 预测和拟合的截断误差。

patterns.name: cluster sum rule
patterns.context: 作为推断或分析核结构、核子相关性的规则名称出现。

patterns.name: sum rules
patterns.context: 指应用于模型的求和规则；与“cluster sum rule”不是同一领域对象。

en.description: Activation spans various ArXiv technical contexts: distributions and their statistics, convolution/filtering operations, machine-learning models and classification, as well as specialized theoretical terms and word-embedding mappings. Some vocabulary recurs across fields, but there is no single clear triggering concept common to all passages.

patterns.name: distribution-related terminology
patterns.context: A physical or statistical object’s distribution, distribution function, or distance between distributions appears; often paired with words such as density, function, particle, and level.

patterns.name: Convolution and filtering operations
patterns.context: Discusses convolution operations, filters, or kernel sizes in convolutional networks or instrument-response convolution.

patterns.name: Machine-learning models and classification
patterns.context: Directly introduces a learning method, classification task, or model application; not merely a mention of a neural-network architecture.

patterns.name: Discipline-specific statistical objects and methods
patterns.context: A physics or statistics paper contains domain-specific theoretical objects, models, or computational methods; each term appears only once.
patterns.domain: Condensed-matter physics, field theory, statistical physics, and machine-learning theory

patterns.name: Embedding-space mapping
patterns.context: Describes learning a mapping matrix between two monolingual spaces of bilingual word embeddings.

1_25.concept: none
1_25.description: 激活覆盖多种 ArXiv 专业语境：分布及其统计量、卷积/滤波操作、机器学习模型与分类，以及若干专门理论术语和词嵌入映射。部分词汇跨领域复现，但没有贯穿全部片段的单一明确触发概念。

patterns.name: distribution相关术语
patterns.trigger: « distribution»，包括 «distribution»« function»、«particle»« distribution»、«nearest»« level»« spac»ings
patterns.context: 出现物理或统计对象的分布、分布函数或分布间距；常与 density、function、particle、level 等词搭配

patterns.name: 卷积与滤波操作
patterns.context: 讨论卷积网络或仪器响应卷积时，出现卷积操作、滤波器或核尺寸
patterns.domain: 机器学习论文、天体物理论文

patterns.name: 机器学习模型与分类
patterns.context: 直接介绍学习方法、分类任务或模型用途；不只是提及神经网络架构

patterns.name: 学科专门的统计对象与方法
patterns.trigger: «comm»«ens»«urate»« charge»« density»« wave»；«Wilson»«ian»« renormal»isation« group»« flows»；«Boltzmann»« Machine»；«exclusion»« statistics»
patterns.context: 物理或统计论文中出现领域特定的理论对象、模型或计算方法；这些术语各自只出现一次
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理、场论、统计物理及机器学习理论

patterns.name: 嵌入空间映射
patterns.context: 描述双语词嵌入从两个单语空间学习映射矩阵

en.concept: Mathematical function terminology in scientific texts
en.description: Activation favors function and mathematical terms such as density, distribution, and probability in scientific texts, and also covers classification and trees, neural network structures, partition functions, and Green functions; there are also code export markers and sporadic activation on Hamiltonians.

patterns.name: density / probability density terminology
patterns.context: Density, probability density, and distribution functions in statistical or physical contexts; often paired with function, distribution, or wave.

patterns.name: Mathematical function names and expressions
patterns.context: Function names or mathematical objects, often near formula explanations or computational procedures.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, statistical physics, and scientific papers

patterns.name: Machine learning terminology for classification, trees, and complexity
patterns.context: Discusses classification methods, training/test complexity, or tree construction algorithms.

patterns.name: Neural network architectures and activation functions
patterns.context: Describes model layers, number of filters, hidden dimensions, or activation functions.

patterns.name: Partition functions and state counting in statistical physics
patterns.context: Describes physical systems using partition functions, density of states, or free energy.

patterns.name: Functions in domain-specific terminology
patterns.context: Optimal estimation of Green functions in a half-space problem.

patterns.name: Export markers and proper names
patterns.context: Occur respectively in automatically generated code comments and discussions of nuclear physics Hamiltonians; weakly connected to the other patterns.

1_25.concept: 科学文本中的数学函数术语
1_25.description: 激活偏向科学文本中的 function 及密度、分布、概率等数学术语，也覆盖分类与树、神经网络结构、配分函数和 Green 函数等；另有代码导出标记及哈密顿量的零散激活。

patterns.name: density / probability density terminology
patterns.context: 统计或物理语境中的密度、概率密度、分布函数；常与 function、distribution 或 wave 连用。

patterns.name: 数学函数名与函数表达式
patterns.context: 函数名或数学对象的名称，常处于公式说明或计算过程附近。
patterns.domain: 数学、统计物理及科学论文

patterns.name: 分类、树与复杂度的机器学习术语
patterns.context: 讨论分类方法、训练/测试复杂度或树构造算法。

patterns.name: 神经网络架构与激活函数
patterns.context: 描述模型层、滤波器数量、隐藏维度或激活函数。

patterns.name: 统计物理中的配分函数与状态计数
patterns.context: 通过配分函数、态密度或自由能描述物理系统。

patterns.name: 特定领域术语中的函数
patterns.context: 半空间问题中求 Green 函数的最优估计。

patterns.name: 导出标记与专名
patterns.context: 分别出现在自动转换生成的代码注释，以及核物理哈密顿量讨论中；与其他模式联系较弱。

en.concept: Functions and mathematical objects in academic contexts
en.description: Activation most often occurs on function and its collocations in academic texts, especially partition, probability density, distribution, activation, and generating function; it also covers tree classification, embeddings, and physical models. Examples across multiple fields are insufficient to establish a narrower unified semantics.

patterns.name: partition function / thermodynamic statistics
patterns.context: In physics, statistical physics, or probability texts, the trigger is often “partition function”; “function” also appears adjacent to mathematical definitions or descriptions. The first passage also mentions exclusion statistics.

patterns.name: Probability density and classification objectives
patterns.context: When discussing probability density functions and their integrals, classifiers, or optimization objectives; the third passage is triggered by “probability density function,” while the fourth concerns an objective function on tree nodes.

patterns.name: Specific mathematical function terminology
patterns.context: A function or distribution appears as a specialized mathematical object, not as ordinary language; examples include particle distributions, atomic pair distribution functions, and moment-generating functions.

patterns.name: MLP/CNN activation functions
patterns.context: In a description of neural network architecture, ReLU is explicitly identified as the activation function for filter outputs.

patterns.name: General academic use of the word function
patterns.context: “Function” appears in papers from various disciplines, but the specific collocations preceding the trigger vary; these passages alone do not establish a shared condition more specific than the word “function.”

patterns.name: Subword fragments within English words
patterns.context: Annotations sometimes fall on subword fragments created by tokenization, forming “generalised,” “incommensurate,” and “minimises”; these fragments show no stable shared semantics.

patterns.name: Bilingual word embeddings
patterns.context: Describes unsupervised bilingual word embedding methods and the process of mapping two monolingual vector spaces.

patterns.name: Convolutional network architecture parameters
patterns.context: Describes the number of filters, hidden layer size, kernel size, and ReLU outputs.

patterns.name: Tree structure and complexity
patterns.context: Discusses training and test complexity for a classification task and constructs a logarithmic-depth tree.

patterns.name: Interactions between neighboring Ising spins
patterns.context: Describes interactions between itinerant electrons and nearest-neighbor Ising spins.

patterns.name: Potts model and density-of-states calculation
patterns.context: Describes estimating the density of states and calculating free energy in a two-dimensional Potts model using the Wang–Landau algorithm.

patterns.name: Moment-generating functions of probability distributions
patterns.context: A normal random variable example gives the mean and variance and writes the moment-generating function.

patterns.name: Charge density waves and local structure
patterns.context: Discusses an incommensurate charge density wave state and analyzes local structure using the atomic pair distribution function.

patterns.name: Order parameter for quark matter
patterns.context: Uses the isospin-singlet scalar field sigma to describe baryon fluctuations and writes the partition function as a path integral.

1_25.concept: 学术语境中的函数及其数学对象
1_25.description: 激活最常落在学术文本中的 function 及其搭配，尤其是 partition、probability density、distribution、activation、generating function；还涵盖树分类、嵌入、物理模型等。多领域例子不足以确认更窄的统一语义。

patterns.name: partition function / thermodynamic statistics
patterns.context: 在物理、统计物理或概率文本中，触发点常为“partition function”，也有“function”紧邻数学定义或描述；第1段还出现 exclusion statistics。

patterns.name: 概率密度与分类目标
patterns.context: 谈论概率密度函数及其积分、分类器或优化目标时；第3段由“probability density function”触发，第4段则是树节点上的 objective function。

patterns.name: 特定数学函数术语
patterns.context: 函数或分布作为专业数学对象出现，而非一般日常用语；包括粒子分布、原子对分布函数和矩生成函数。

patterns.name: MLP/CNN激活函数
patterns.context: 神经网络结构说明中，明确将 ReLU 作为滤波器输出的激活函数。

patterns.name: 函数一词的泛化学术用法
patterns.context: 多种学科论文中出现“function”，但触发前的具体搭配各异；仅凭这些段落无法确认它们是否共享比“function”字样更具体的条件。

patterns.name: 英文词内部片段
patterns.context: 标注有时落在被分词拆开的词片段上，分别构成“generalised”“incommensurate”“minimises”；这些片段未显示稳定的共同语义。

patterns.name: 双语词嵌入
patterns.context: 描述无监督双语词嵌入方法及其映射两个单语向量空间的过程。

patterns.name: 卷积网络架构参数
patterns.context: 说明滤波器数量、隐藏层大小、核尺寸及 ReLU 输出。

patterns.name: 树结构与复杂度
patterns.context: 讨论分类任务的训练与测试复杂度，并构建对数深度树。

patterns.name: 相邻 Ising 自旋相互作用
patterns.context: 描述巡游电子与最近邻 Ising 自旋之间的相互作用。

patterns.name: Potts模型与态密度计算
patterns.context: 说明二维 Potts 模型中用 Wang–Landau 算法估计态密度并计算自由能。

patterns.name: 概率分布矩生成函数
patterns.context: 正态随机变量例题中给出均值、方差并写出矩生成函数。

patterns.name: 电荷密度波与局域结构
patterns.context: 讨论非公度电荷密度波态，并用原子对分布函数分析局域结构。

patterns.name: 夸克物质序参量
patterns.context: 以同位旋单态标量场 sigma 描述重子涨落，并把配分函数写作路径积分。

en.concept: Distribution and model terminology in scientific papers
en.description: Activation is scattered across scientific-paper contexts, often involving statistical terms such as distribution, density, and probability function, as well as machine-learning model structures and physics concepts; it also favors abstracts and academic-style statements. The third passage only discusses RBM parameters in general and has no obvious shared trigger word.

patterns.name: Distribution / probability density function
patterns.context: Discusses a statistical distribution or probability density of some quantity, or its calculation and properties; commonly occurs around distribution/function.
patterns.domain: Physics, statistics, scientific abstracts, or paper body text

patterns.name: Machine-learning models and network components
patterns.context: Describes the architecture, training, or parameters of a machine-learning model; triggers are mostly model terms and network components.

patterns.name: Density and many-body / condensed-matter terminology in physics
patterns.context: In physics research, density is paired with a specific physical object or mathematical construction; some cases overlap with the statistical-distribution pattern.
patterns.domain: Condensed-matter, quantum many-body, and statistical-physics papers

patterns.name: Scientific abstracts and structured academic writing
patterns.context: Academic statements or section guides in abstracts or paper body text; no specific disciplinary terminology required.

patterns.name: Specialized phrasing about generalized exclusion statistics
patterns.context: Discussion of a specific statistical-physics concept and its calculation.

patterns.name: Astronomical instruments and surveys
patterns.context: Introduces an observational survey and the telescope instruments used.

patterns.name: Mathematical mappings and linear transformations
patterns.context: Explains the mapping between bilingual word-vector spaces.

patterns.name: Event offspring counts and power laws
patterns.context: Analyzes how the power-law distribution of the number of event offspring affects a probability function.

1_25.concept: 科学论文中的分布与模型术语
1_25.description: 激活分散在科学论文语境，常涉及 distribution、density、probability function 等统计术语，也涉及机器学习模型结构与物理概念；还偏好摘要和论文式陈述。第3段仅泛谈 RBM 参数，未见明显共享触发词。

patterns.name: 分布/概率密度函数
patterns.context: 讨论某种量的统计分布、概率密度或其计算与性质；常见于 distribution/function 前后
patterns.domain: 物理、统计、科学论文摘要或正文

patterns.name: 机器学习模型与网络组件
patterns.context: 描述机器学习模型的架构、训练或参数；触发词多为模型术语及网络组件

patterns.name: 物理中的密度与多体/凝聚态术语
patterns.trigger: “charge density wave”, “two-body reduced density matrix”, “hyperplane”, “minimum density hyperplane”
patterns.context: 物理研究中，density 与具体物理对象或数学构造搭配；部分与统计分布模式交叠
patterns.domain: 凝聚态、量子多体及统计物理论文

patterns.name: 科学论文摘要与结构化行文
patterns.context: 摘要或论文正文中的学术陈述、章节导读；不要求具体学科术语

patterns.name: 泛化排斥统计的专门表述
patterns.context: 特定统计物理概念及其计算讨论

patterns.name: 天文观测仪器与巡天
patterns.context: 介绍观测巡天及所用望远镜仪器

patterns.name: 数学映射与线性变换
patterns.trigger: “linear transformation matrix that maps two monolingual embedding spaces”
patterns.context: 说明双语词向量空间之间的映射关系
patterns.domain: 自然语言处理/机器学习论文

patterns.name: 事件触发数与幂律
patterns.trigger: “power law distribution of fertilities”, “number of triggered events”
patterns.context: 分析事件后代数量及其幂律分布对概率函数的影响
patterns.domain: PubMed 科学摘要，领域未明确

en.concept: Technical terms and object names in academic texts
en.description: Activation is distributed across technical nouns, compound terms, and their tokenized fragments in ArXiv texts, especially object names such as function, distribution, correlation, rule, and method; it also occurs in model components, computational steps, quantity structures, and a few descriptions of data representations.

patterns.name: Abstract nouns or technical terms at sentence ends/boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on technical nouns themselves or their tokenized fragments, especially at the ends of noun phrases; topics and specific meanings vary.
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic papers across multiple fields

patterns.name: Compound terms consisting of two parts
patterns.context: Numerals modify technical objects or structures, such as “two monolingual embedding spaces,” “one-dimensional form,” and “three-point correlation function”; activation does not always fall on the numeral.
patterns.domain: Machine learning, data analysis, physics, and mathematics papers

patterns.name: Specific lexical fragments and cross-word internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation sometimes covers within-word fragments created by tokenization; no specific topic is required, and the fragments may be associated with technical terms or morphologically complex words.

patterns.name: Model, network, and learning terminology
patterns.context: Activation occurs on machine learning methods, network components, or training-related terms, often in sentences defining or describing a model.
patterns.domain: Computer science and machine learning papers

patterns.name: Statistics, correlations, and rules in physics
patterns.context: When discussing particle distributions, correlation functions, or physical rules, activation focuses on these object names and nearby descriptive terms.
patterns.domain: Condensed matter, nuclear physics, and cosmology papers

patterns.name: Descriptions of methods, objectives, and computational procedures
patterns.context: Appears when describing training, computation, inference, or optimization steps; these terms occur across different topics and cannot by themselves explain all activation.
patterns.domain: Methods and results in academic papers

patterns.name: Specialized chart or data-processing objects
patterns.context: Activation occurs when describing time-varying data and its compact representation; this is a rare pattern whose topic differs from the other examples.

patterns.name: Expressions of relationships between abstract objects and attributes
patterns.context: Explains how parameters, contributions, or multiple quantities relate or combine; some examples overlap only sporadically, with no stable syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Machine learning and theoretical/computational physics papers

1_25.concept: 学术技术术语与对象名
1_25.description: 激活广泛分布于ArXiv文本的技术名词、复合术语及其分词片段，尤其是function、distribution、correlation、rule、method等对象名；也见于模型组件、计算步骤、数量结构和少数数据表示描述。

patterns.name: 抽象名词或技术术语的句末/边界处
patterns.context: 激活落在专业名词本身或其分词片段上，尤其是名词短语末尾；主题和具体含义各异。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文，跨多个领域

patterns.name: 由两个部分构成的复合术语
patterns.context: 数词修饰技术对象或结构，例如“两种单语嵌入空间”“一维形式”“三点相关函数”；激活并不总落在数词上。
patterns.domain: 机器学习、数据分析、物理与数学论文

patterns.name: 特定词汇片段及跨词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活有时覆盖被分词拆开的词内片段；不要求特定主题，可能与技术词或形态复杂的词有关。

patterns.name: 模型、网络与学习术语
patterns.context: 机器学习方法、网络组件或训练相关术语处激活，常出现在定义或描述模型的语句中。
patterns.domain: 计算机科学与机器学习论文

patterns.name: 物理中的统计量、相关性及规则
patterns.trigger: «exclusion statistics»、«particle distribution»、«cluster sum rule»、«two-point correlation»、«three-point correlation function»
patterns.context: 讨论粒子分布、相关函数或物理规则时，激活集中于这些对象名称及邻近的描述性术语。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态、核物理与宇宙学论文

patterns.name: 方法、目标与计算过程的描述
patterns.context: 描述训练、计算、推断或优化步骤时出现；这些词分布在不同主题中，不能单独解释全部激活。
patterns.domain: 学术论文方法与结果表述

patterns.name: 带有较强术语性的图表或数据处理对象
patterns.context: 描述随时间变化的数据及其紧凑表示时激活，属于少数且与其余例子主题不同的模式。

patterns.name: 抽象对象与属性之间的关系表述
patterns.context: 说明参数、贡献或多个量如何关联或合并；部分例子仅有零散重合，未见稳定句法条件。
patterns.domain: 机器学习与理论/计算物理论文

en.description: Activation is distributed across scientific papers and commonly occurs around probability density/distribution, function, and partition function in statistical physics; it also appears with time steps, nearest neighbors, neuroscience, and neural network implementation details. The intensity or location may correspond to a subword fragment, and there is no single stable theme.

patterns.name: Probability density functions
patterns.context: When discussing probability distributions, density functions, and their statistical or computational properties; the trigger word is not always marked and often co-occurs with distribution/function.
patterns.domain: Statistical physics, mathematics, and scientific papers

patterns.name: partition function
patterns.context: Discussions of the partition function in statistical mechanics, including its maximization, calculation, or use in deriving free energy.

patterns.name: Time step
patterns.context: When reporting discrete time-step sizes in algorithms or simulations, strong activation focuses on “step.”

patterns.name: Nearest-neighbor time steps
patterns.context: Describes evolving data, nearest-neighbor intervals, or lattice neighbors; the two words occur in different passages and need not form the same phrase.
patterns.domain: Data visualization, energy-level statistics, and lattice model papers

patterns.name: Neurons and neuroplasticity
patterns.context: Describes activity-dependent neuroplasticity and research on memory function.

patterns.name: Convolutional network layer structure
patterns.context: Describes implementation details of neural network filters, hidden layer sizes, and activation functions.

patterns.name: Hyperplane classifier
patterns.context: Introduces a classifier and its objective function for clustering and semi-supervised classification.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment activation
patterns.context: Activation may fall on word fragments split across tokens; the marking alone does not establish that the complete word meaning is the trigger.

patterns.name: Dense scientific terminology and formula contexts
patterns.context: Overall, the passages are mostly from ArXiv papers, but individual strong trigger points span different topics and show no unified, specific theme.

1_25.concept: 科学术语与函数/分布语境
1_25.description: 激活分布在科学论文中，常见于概率密度/分布、函数和配分函数等统计物理语境，也见时间步、最近邻、神经科学与神经网络实现细节；强度或落点可能对应词内片段，缺乏单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: 概率密度函数
patterns.context: 讨论概率分布、密度函数及其统计或计算性质时；触发词并非总是带标记，常与 distribution/function 连用
patterns.domain: 统计物理、数学与科学论文

patterns.name: partition function
patterns.context: 统计力学中讨论配分函数及其最大化、计算或由其得到自由能时
patterns.domain: 理论物理、统计力学论文

patterns.name: 时间步
patterns.context: 报告算法或模拟的离散时间步长时，强触发集中于“step”

patterns.name: 最近邻时间步
patterns.context: 描述随时间演化的数据、最近邻间隔或格点邻居时；两个词出现在不同段落，未必构成同一短语
patterns.domain: 数据可视化、能级统计与格点模型论文

patterns.name: 神经元与神经可塑性
patterns.context: 描述活动依赖的神经可塑性及记忆功能研究

patterns.name: 卷积网络层结构
patterns.context: 说明神经网络滤波器、隐藏层尺寸与激活函数的实现细节

patterns.name: 超平面分类器
patterns.context: 介绍用于聚类和半监督分类的分类器及其目标函数

patterns.name: 词内片段激活
patterns.context: 激活可能落在跨 token 切分的词片段上，不能仅据标记断定由完整词义触发

patterns.name: 密集的科学论文术语与公式语境
patterns.context: 整体多为 ArXiv 论文片段，但单个强触发点跨越不同主题，未显示统一的具体主题

en.concept: Mathematical and statistical terminology in scientific papers
en.description: Activation is distributed across academic texts in multiple fields; recurring mathematical and scientific terms include integrals, correlation functions, density/distribution, and time steps, alongside sporadic paper vocabulary. Word forms and contexts are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Statements involving integrals
patterns.context: The word integral appears directly in general academic sentences; [1] concerns understanding memory function, while [2] concerns integrating a probability density over a hyperplane.

patterns.name: Point / correlation function terminology
patterns.context: Expressions combining point or pair with correlation/distribution and other statistical or physical terms.
patterns.domain: Theoretical physics, condensed matter physics, nuclear physics

patterns.name: Probability or particle distribution terminology
patterns.context: Discusses probability density, particle distributions, or specific distributions; the trigger word can occur in different positions, with no unified fixed collocation.
patterns.domain: Statistics, physics, and scientific computing papers

patterns.name: Expressions for unit time steps
patterns.context: Describes time-step sizes or each time point in numerical simulation or time-series contexts; the trigger is step, not a term specific to one discipline.

patterns.name: Other sporadic scientific paper terminology
patterns.context: Terms or ordinary words appearing in their respective paper contexts, with insufficient evidence for a consistent local trigger pattern.
patterns.domain: Machine learning, physics, and computational science

1_25.concept: 科学论文中的数学统计术语
1_25.description: 激活分布在多领域学术文本中；反复出现积分、相关函数、密度／分布及时间步等数学与科学术语，也有零散论文词汇。词形和语境并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 积分相关表述
patterns.context: 在一般学术句子中，直接出现单词 integral；[1] 指向理解记忆功能，[2] 指概率密度沿超平面的积分。
patterns.domain: 神经科学、机器学习论文

patterns.name: 点／相关函数术语
patterns.context: 出现 point 或 pair 与 correlation/distribution 等统计或物理术语结合的表达。
patterns.domain: 理论物理、凝聚态物理、核物理

patterns.name: 概率或粒子分布术语
patterns.trigger: «density»；«probability»« density»；«particle»« distribution»；«semi»-«Po»«isson»« distribution»；«distribution» of nearest level« spac»ings
patterns.context: 讨论概率密度、粒子分布或特定分布；其中触发词可出现在不同位置，未见统一固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 统计、物理及科学计算论文

patterns.name: 单位时间步表达
patterns.context: 以数值模拟或时间序列语境描述时间步长或每个时间点；触发的是 step，而非某一特定学科术语。

patterns.name: 其余零散的科学论文术语
patterns.context: 在各自论文语境中出现的术语或普通词，没有足够证据构成一致的局部触发模式。
patterns.domain: 机器学习、物理与计算科学

en.description: Primarily sensitive to function and common function-related terminology in academic text, including probability density/distribution functions, correlation functions, activation functions, and Green function; also responds to the statistical term Quantile-quantile.

patterns.name: Probability density function terminology
patterns.context: Technical text contains the full term for a probability distribution or density function; local context often includes preceding modifiers (such as empirical, probability, or distribution).
patterns.domain: Mathematics, statistics, and physics paper abstracts

patterns.name: Correlation-function terminology
patterns.context: “function(s)” occurs in academic terminology describing correlation, fields, or evolution.
patterns.domain: Theoretical physics, cosmology, and mathematical physics

patterns.name: Other technical terms ending in function
patterns.context: A technical noun phrase has function as its head, or function follows a proper name; does not have to involve probability or correlation.

patterns.name: Statistical plot terminology
patterns.context: Describes a plot used to inspect P-values in statistical analysis; activation falls on the “Quantile” subword.

1_25.concept: 学术函数术语
1_25.description: 主要对学术文本中的 function 及常见函数术语敏感，涵盖概率密度/分布函数、相关函数、激活函数和 Green function；也响应统计术语 Quantile-quantile。

patterns.name: 概率密度函数术语
patterns.trigger: “probability density function” / “probability distribution function”，尤以 “function” 为激活位置
patterns.context: 技术文本中出现概率分布或密度函数的完整术语；局部常有其前置修饰词（如 empirical、probability、distribution）
patterns.domain: 数学、统计与物理学论文摘要

patterns.name: 相关函数术语
patterns.context: “function(s)”位于描述相关性、场或演化的学术术语中
patterns.domain: 理论物理、宇宙学及数学物理

patterns.name: 其他以 function 结尾的技术术语
patterns.context: 技术名词短语以 function 为核心词，或 function 紧随专名；不要求涉及概率或相关性

patterns.name: 统计图表术语
patterns.context: 统计分析中描述用于检视 P-values 的图表；激活落在 “Quantile” 子词上
patterns.domain: 遗传学与生物医学统计

en.concept: Distribution functions and scientific mathematical terminology
en.description: Primarily activates on “distribution function” and adjacent statistical terms such as probability/density in scientific texts, and also responds to mathematical words such as integral and function; additional scattered paper-method phrasing and domain-specific terms from multiple fields do not form a single stable pattern.

patterns.name: distribution function terminology
patterns.context: The noun phrase “distribution function” appears in academic texts; it may be preceded by modifiers such as empirical probability density.
patterns.domain: Machine learning, statistical physics, and other scientific papers

patterns.name: Statements involving functions or integrals
patterns.context: Discusses integrals, functions, or the calculation and properties of a function in scientific writing; the complete phrase “distribution function” is not required.
patterns.domain: Academic texts in mathematics, physics, biomedicine, and neuroscience

patterns.name: Methods and analysis phrasing in scientific papers
patterns.context: Introduces analysis methods, computation, research objectives, or paper structure in abstracts or main text; these words occur sporadically and show no stable shared local trigger.

patterns.name: Statistical analysis and testing terminology
patterns.context: Expresses gene-level association tests, result summaries, and distribution comparisons.

patterns.name: Astrophysics and star formation
patterns.context: Describes starbursts in galaxies and their effects on energy output.

patterns.name: Neuroplasticity and memory
patterns.context: Describes a principle as necessary for understanding normal or impaired memory function and introduces research objectives.

patterns.name: Time-series data summaries
patterns.context: Discusses compact representations of time-varying data to help identify periods of interest.

patterns.name: Ordinary word forms or incidental triggers in scientific texts
patterns.context: The passages vary in field and syntactic function; these markers alone do not establish a shared, specific semantic trigger.

1_25.concept: 分布函数与科学数学术语
1_25.description: 主要在科学文本中对“distribution function”及 probability/density 等相邻统计术语激活，也响应 integral、function 等数学词；另有分散的论文方法措辞和多个领域特有词，未能归为单一稳定模式。

patterns.name: distribution function 术语
patterns.context: 学术文本中出现“distribution function”这一名词短语；前面可能有 empirical probability density 等修饰语。
patterns.domain: 机器学习、统计物理及其他科学论文

patterns.name: 函数或积分相关表述
patterns.context: 在科学论述中谈及积分、函数或某种函数的计算与性质；不要求出现完整的“distribution function”短语。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理、生物医学及神经科学学术文本

patterns.name: 科学论文中的方法与分析措辞
patterns.context: 论文摘要或正文介绍分析方法、计算、研究目标或文章结构；这些词分散出现，未显示稳定的共同局部触发。

patterns.name: 统计分析及检验术语
patterns.context: 表达基因层面的关联检验及结果汇总、分布比较。

patterns.name: 天体物理与恒星形成
patterns.context: 叙述星系中恒星形成爆发及其对能量输出的影响。

patterns.name: 神经可塑性与记忆
patterns.context: 把某原则描述为理解正常或受损记忆功能所必需，并介绍研究目标。

patterns.name: 时间序列数据摘要
patterns.context: 讨论用紧凑形式呈现随时间变化的数据，以辅助识别感兴趣的时间段。

patterns.name: 科学文本中的普通词形或偶然触发
patterns.context: 各段领域和句法用途不一；单凭这些标记无法确认一个共享的特定语义触发。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on function(s) and internal subword fragments of several scientific terms: nov in supernovae, ile in quantile, comm in incommensurate, os in homosynaptic, and ov in Vlasov; there is also weak activation on integral and other terms. The commonality is unclear.

patterns.name: function / functions word forms
patterns.context: Appears as a noun in mathematical or scientific papers, within technical phrases such as probability density and correlation functions; activation primarily falls on function(s) itself.

patterns.name: Supernova spelling fragment
patterns.context: The word Supernovae is split into subwords in astrophysics text; high activation focuses on the nov subword, not ae.

patterns.name: Repeated word stem in quantile
patterns.context: The phrase quantile-quantile plots in genetic association analysis results; activation falls on the repeated final subword ile, more strongly on the second occurrence.

patterns.name: Integral with different meanings
patterns.context: Appears respectively in “the integral of the empirical probability density function” and “integral to understanding”; the meaning and syntax differ, as does activation strength.
patterns.domain: Machine learning papers; neuroscience research proposals

patterns.name: incommensurate subword
patterns.context: In the solid-state physics phrase incommensurate charge density wave, activation falls only on the split subword comm.

patterns.name: can subword in MetaXcan
patterns.context: Appears in the method name MetaXcan for gene expression association analysis; activation is weak.

patterns.name: os subword in homosynaptic
patterns.context: The technical term homosynaptic appears in a research proposal on neuroplasticity and long-term depression; high activation is on the internal os subword.

patterns.name: Internal subword in Vlasov
patterns.context: In the term Vlasov-type scaling, the word is split into multiple subwords, with the ov subword markedly stronger.

patterns.name: Probability terms at word ends in an incomplete sentence
patterns.context: Discusses the effect of the event reproduction rate on PDF f(τ); besides function, probability and distribution also show weaker activation.
patterns.domain: Complex systems or probability modeling papers

1_25.concept: none
1_25.description: 激活集中于 function(s) 及若干科学术语的内部子词：超新星中的 nov、quantile 中的 ile、incommensurate 中的 comm、homosynaptic 中的 os、Vlasov 中的 ov；另有 integral 等弱触发。共同点不明确。

patterns.name: function / functions 词形
patterns.context: 在数学或科学论文中，作为名词出现在概率密度、相关函数等技术短语里；主要激活落在 function(s) 本身。

patterns.context: Occurs in a C++ function parameter type identifier, with no context matching names or pronouns

1_86.description: 强激活多落在 Debbie 与 she；但也见于名称、网址、 bedsheets、常见词和代码标识符的分词片段。模式不统一，可能受子词边界或偶然拼写重合影响。

patterns.name: 特殊专名中的 Debbie
patterns.trigger: «Debbie»10；另有 «bbie»10、«bb»1 等被分词显示的名字片段
patterns.context: 人名 Debbie 出现在邮件收件人、法律文书证人或署名等位置；个别文本中也出现其他含相近字母序列的名字
patterns.domain: 邮件、法律文书、百科及一般网页文本

patterns.name: she 的代词与词内片段
patterns.context: 完整代词 she 出现在叙述或口语语境中；另有一次 she 跨入专名/网址式字符串，一次嵌在 bedsheets 的拼写中
patterns.domain: 邮件、法律叙事、网页、专利文本

patterns.name: 分词边界处的弱重合
patterns.context: 激活片段位于人名或邮箱地址内部，未必是完整词；与 Debbie/Chapman 等名字有关，但并非同一种稳定触发
patterns.domain: 邮件、姓名及电子邮件地址

patterns.name: 常见词的偶然子串
patterns.context: 完整词或词内字母偶然与上面的名字/子串相似；缺少稳定共同语义条件

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的弱片段
patterns.context: 出现在 C++ 函数参数类型标识符中，未见与姓名或代词一致的上下文

en.description: All snippets contain the letter sequence she: mainly the pronoun she, but also within the name Debbie and the words sheets and spreadsheets; spans multiple genres, with no stable topic or domain condition.

patterns.name: she (personal pronoun)
patterns.context: The trigger is the word she, including at the beginning or middle of a sentence, and in possessive or contracted forms she’d, she’s, she-says, which contain she; context may refer to a female person or character.
patterns.domain: Email, legal testimony, news links, fiction/character introductions, etc.

patterns.name: she in surname or name fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on a subword fragment of the name Debbie or the initial fragment of the common word sheets, rather than the pronoun she.
patterns.domain: Email contacts, parties to legal cases, patent text

patterns.name: spreadsheet subword fragment
