patterns.context: she occurs within spreadsheets, with the prefix spread and suffix ets forming the complete word.

1_86.description: 所有片段都含有 she 这一字母串：主要是代词 she，也出现在姓名 Debbie、单词 sheets 和 spreadsheets 的词内；覆盖多种文体，未见稳定的主题或领域条件。

patterns.name: she（人称代词）
patterns.context: 触发位置是单词 she，包含句首或句中，也包括所有格形式 she’d、she’s、she-says 中的 she；上下文可指女性人物或角色。
patterns.domain: 邮件、法律证词、新闻链接、小说/角色介绍等

patterns.name: 姓氏或姓名片段中的 she
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名 Debbie 的子词片段或普通词 sheets 的词首片段，并非代词 she。
patterns.domain: 邮件联系人、法律案件当事人、专利文本

patterns.name: spreadsheet 的子词片段
patterns.context: she 位于 spreadsheets 的词内，前缀 spread 与后缀 ets 共同组成完整单词。
patterns.domain: 个人简介/技术与教学描述

en.description: All fragments highlight the consecutive characters she: sometimes the feminine pronoun, sometimes embedded in a name, URL, citation marker, or word; capitalization and surrounding contexts vary considerably.

patterns.name: she and feminine pronoun
patterns.context: The standalone pronoun she/She appears, or the sequence occurs as part of a name/string; the context may involve the pronoun or merely the letter sequence.
patterns.domain: Across corpora, including email, legal testimony, fiction, patents, web, and academic text

patterns.name: she inside words or marked strings
patterns.context: The highlighted position is embedded in a username, URL, citation marker, name, or other continuous string, rather than functioning syntactically as a feminine pronoun.
patterns.domain: Web/forums, URLs, paper citations, email names

patterns.name: she referring to a woman in narratives or testimony
patterns.context: she is the subject of a sentence and refers to a previously mentioned or contextual woman; it is sometimes followed by an auxiliary verb, predicate, or additional description.

patterns.name: she at a patent term boundary
patterns.context: The characters she occur across an ordinary spelling fragment in the word sheets and do not form a pronoun.

1_86.description: 全部片段都标亮连续字符 she：有时是女性代词，有时嵌在姓名、网址、引文标记或单词中；大小写及周边语境变化较大。

patterns.name: she 及女性代词
patterns.context: 出现独立代词 she/She，或作为姓名/字符串的一部分；语境可在代词前后，也可能只是字母序列。
patterns.domain: 跨语料，包括邮件、法律证词、小说、专利、网页及学术文本

patterns.name: she 的词内或标记串内出现
patterns.context: 高亮位置嵌在用户名、URL、引文标记、姓名或其他连续字符串中，并非句法上的女性代词。
patterns.domain: 网页/论坛、网址、论文引文、邮件姓名

patterns.name: she 在叙事或证词中指代女性
patterns.context: she 是句子中的主语，指代已提及或上下文中的女性；有时后接助动词、谓语或补充描述。
patterns.domain: 邮件、法律证词、小说叙事

patterns.name: she 出现在专利术语边界
patterns.context: 字符 she 跨越普通拼写片段而出现在 sheets 一词中，不构成代词。

en.concept: she-containing subword fragments and several heterogeneous markers
en.description: Strong activations repeatedly fall on she/she’d and name fragments containing she; they also occur on role, the code identifier Patch, dates, and time numerals. The contexts and parts of speech vary, making it difficult to assign a single semantic category.

patterns.name: she / she’d forms
patterns.context: she as a standalone personal pronoun or the stem of the contraction she’d; both capitalization forms occur.
patterns.domain: News blogs, literary reporting, business email, legal testimony

patterns.name: she in role names or compounds
patterns.context: she is part of a name spelling, appearing in a person’s name and an email address, rather than as a pronoun.

patterns.name: Abstract academic noun role
patterns.context: role appears in noun phrases describing a system’s role or function.

patterns.name: Patch identifier in code
patterns.context: Patch/Patch[] is used as a type or variable name in code, surrounded by function declarations, parameters, or comments.

patterns.name: Numeric time markers
patterns.context: Numbers and colons in a time range; this segment also contains the primary activation on she’d.

patterns.name: Date numerals in web paths
patterns.context: Numeric fragments representing year, month, and day in URL paths.

1_86.concept: 含 she 的词片段及若干异质标记
1_86.description: 强激活反复落在 she/she’d 及含 she 的姓名片段；另在 role、代码标识符 Patch、日期和时间数字上激活。不同语境和词类并存，难归为单一语义。

patterns.name: she / she’d 词形
patterns.context: she 作为独立人称代词，或缩写 she’d 的词干；大小写均见。
patterns.domain: 新闻博客、文学报道、商务邮件、法律证词

patterns.name: 角色名称或复合词中的 she
patterns.context: she 是姓名拼写的一部分，分别出现在人名和邮件地址中，并非代词。

patterns.name: 抽象学术名词 role
patterns.context: role 出现在描述系统作用、功能的名词短语中。

patterns.name: 代码中的 Patch 标识符
patterns.context: Patch/Patch[] 作为代码中的类型或变量名，周围有函数声明、参数或注释。

patterns.name: 数字时间标记
patterns.context: 时间范围中的数字和冒号；该段还含有主要激活的 she’d。

patterns.name: 网页路径中的日期数字
patterns.context: URL 路径里表示年月日的数字片段。

en.description: Activations fall on a variety of in-word fragments, names, and identifiers, with examples in code configuration, email lists, tables, and legal or encyclopedia text. There is no stable unifying semantics; local patterns are mainly determined by each segment’s format and morpheme boundaries.

patterns.name: Specific morphemes inside compounds
patterns.context: These morphemes occur within longer words or proper names, with activation at morpheme boundaries; no single fixed meaning or part of speech explains them.

patterns.name: English word-final or internal fragments
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across complete English words, names, and affix-like fragments, often combining with adjacent letters to form a word; no stable semantic or positional rule is apparent.
patterns.domain: Patents, email, legal texts, encyclopedia entries, and code

patterns.name: Code configuration and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Occurs within keys, string values, or code identifiers in JSON/configuration objects; common in newline-indented lists and configuration snippets.

patterns.name: Email addresses and contact lists
patterns.context: Embedded in addresses, names, or semicolon-separated contact lists in Enron email headers; activations concentrate on local fragments of names and addresses.

patterns.name: Country names in tables
patterns.context: Located in newline-separated tables arranged by code, number, or abbreviation, where country names are table entries; activation occurs especially on “Emirates”.

patterns.name: Judge titles and court documents
patterns.context: Appears near judges’ names, titles, and court document headers; the body then moves on to the case facts.

patterns.name: People’s names and entry lists
patterns.context: Appears as a name fragment in encyclopedia biographies and “See also” related-people lists.

patterns.name: Patch objects and code comments
patterns.context: Occurs in PHP test functions, variable names, and type comments, surrounded by webhook requests and patch-handling logic.

1_86.description: 激活落在多种词内片段、姓名和标识符上；在代码配置、邮件名单、表格及法律或百科文本中均有实例。没有稳定统一的语义，局部规律主要由各段格式和词素边界决定。

patterns.name: 复合词中间的特定词素
patterns.context: 这些词素出现在较长词或专名内部，激活落在词素边界处；无法由一种固定词义或词类解释。

patterns.name: 英文词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活散布在完整英文词、姓名及词缀式片段中，常与相邻字母共同组成词；看不出稳定的语义或位置规则。
patterns.domain: 专利、邮件、法律文本、百科及代码

patterns.name: 代码配置与标识符片段
patterns.context: 出现在 JSON/配置对象中的键名、字符串值或代码标识符内；常见于换行缩进的列表和配置片段。

patterns.name: 邮件地址和联系人名单
patterns.context: 嵌在 Enron 邮件头的地址、姓名或分号分隔联系人列表中，激活集中在姓名及地址的局部片段。

patterns.name: 表格中的国家名
patterns.context: 位于按代码、数字或缩写分列的换行表格中，国家名是表格条目；激活尤其出现在“Emirates”。

patterns.name: 法官称谓与法院文书
patterns.context: 出现在法官姓名、职衔及法院文书抬头附近，正文随后转入案件事实。

patterns.name: 人物姓名及条目列表
patterns.context: 在百科人物条目及“See also”相关人物列表中作为姓名片段出现。

patterns.name: 补丁对象与代码注释
patterns.context: 出现在 PHP 测试函数、变量名和类型注释中，周围是 webhook 请求及补丁处理逻辑。

en.description: Primarily responds to “paragraph” and its numbering in documents, especially when citing, locating, or revising a paragraph; also appears in legal clauses and standards citations. There is a weaker response to court document headers.

patterns.name: “paragraph” and paragraph numbers
patterns.context: A paragraph is cited, discussed, or labeled in legal text, email, or press releases; the number may follow directly or be spelled out.

patterns.name: Revising and explaining paragraph content
patterns.context: Discusses rewriting, checking, or updating a paragraph and identifies its location in the document or the reason for the change.
patterns.domain: Business email, news editing, online comments

patterns.name: Other legal document structure markers
patterns.context: Formatted metadata such as headings and docket information in legal opinions or court documents; no obvious paragraph trigger word is present.

patterns.name: Clause references in the C language standard
patterns.context: A technical Q&A cites a specific paragraph of the C standard; it also discusses pointer types and type conversions.

1_86.description: 主要响应文档中的“paragraph”及其编号，尤其在引用、定位或修改段落时；也出现在法律条款和标准引用中。另对法院文书标头有较弱反应。

patterns.name: “paragraph”及段落编号
patterns.trigger: «paragraph»，以及邻近的编号或序数，如 «paragraph»10、«paragraph»9、«paragraph» seven
patterns.context: 在法律文本、邮件或新闻稿中引用、讨论或标注某个段落；编号可紧随其后，也可用文字表示。
patterns.domain: 法律、商务邮件、新闻/编辑文本

patterns.name: 段落内容的修订与说明
patterns.context: 讨论重写、检查或更新某一段落，并指出它在文档中的位置或修改原因。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、新闻编辑、在线评论

patterns.name: 其他法律文书结构标记
patterns.trigger: «United» «States» «District» «Court»，及案名、法院、日期等标头字段
patterns.context: 法律判决或法院文书的标题、案卷信息等格式化元数据；未见明显段落触发词。

patterns.name: C 语言标准中的条款引用
patterns.context: 技术问答中引用 C 标准的具体段落；同时包含指针类型与类型转换讨论。

en.description: The strongest activation in each segment is on “War” in different capitalization forms: sometimes at the beginning of Warwick, sometimes at the beginning of war/War-related words, including warfarin, War Picture, World War, and Warnecke; domains and contexts vary.

patterns.name: Warwick internal fragment
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the initial portion of Warwick, not the whole word; it occurs in institutional addresses, university locations, or descriptions of places
patterns.domain: Academic addresses, institutional descriptions, email signatures, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: war internal fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on the initial portion of war, followed by “farin” (warfarin), “Picture” (War Picture), “ of Independence” (War of Independence), “necke” (Warnecke), or forming part of a compound word

1_86.description: 各段最强激活都在大小写形式的“War”上：有时是 Warwick 的词首，有时是 war/War 相关词的词首，包括 warfarin、War Picture、World War、Warnecke 等；领域与上下文多样。

patterns.name: Warwick 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中落在 Warwick 的首段，而非整个词；出现在机构地址、大学所在地或地点介绍中
patterns.domain: 学术地址、机构介绍、邮件签名、百科条目

patterns.name: war 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 war 的首段；后接 “farin”（warfarin）、“Picture”（War Picture）、“ of Independence”（War of Independence）、“necke”（Warnecke），或作为复合词的一部分

en.description: Activations concentrate on specific strings in structured text: U.S. Code citations, February in dates, legal opinion metadata, birth/death date separators, as well as the surname Williams and figure markers.

patterns.name: U.S.C. § in U.S. Code citations
patterns.context: The trigger occurs in the U.S. Code abbreviation or its section number; sometimes the number follows §, and sometimes a title number also precedes it
patterns.domain: Legal, patent documents, and code snippets

patterns.name: February in dates
patterns.context: Occurs in people’s birth/death dates, case dates, or opinion filing dates; often surrounded by a day, year, and separator

patterns.name: Legal opinion headings and metadata
patterns.context: Occurs near docket information, titles, or filing dates in court opinions
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and legal documents

patterns.name: Separator in birth/death dates
patterns.context: Between birth and death dates, which are often written in day-month-year or month-day-year format

patterns.name: Williams in names
patterns.context: Repeatedly appears as part of a person’s full name, followed by a birth date and biography

patterns.name: Figure citation markers
patterns.context: Occurs in markers or body text containing figure citations and supplementary material links

1_86.description: 激活集中于结构化文本中的特定字符串：美国法典引文、日期中的 February、法律意见书元数据、生卒日期连接号，另有 Williams 姓名和图表标记。

patterns.name: 美国法典引文中的 U.S.C. §
patterns.context: 触发点出现在美国法典缩写或其条款编号中；有时编号紧随 §，有时前面还带标题编号
patterns.domain: 法律、专利文书及代码片段

patterns.name: 日期中的 February
patterns.context: 出现在人物生卒日期、案件日期或意见书提交日期中；周围常有日、年份及连接号
patterns.domain: 百科人物传记与法律文书

patterns.name: 法律意见书标题与元数据
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见书的案头信息、标题或提交日期附近
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与法律文书

patterns.name: 生卒日期中的连接号
patterns.context: 夹在出生与死亡日期之间，日期常以日月年或月日年形式书写

patterns.name: 姓名中的 Williams
patterns.context: 作为人物全名的一部分重复出现，随后附出生日期及简介

patterns.name: 图表引用标记
patterns.context: 出现在带有图表引用及补充材料链接的标记或正文中
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文 XML/标记文本

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to month names in dates, especially December, October, and September; March and other months also elicit weaker responses. Also responds strongly to the section sign § in statutory citations, which does not fully fit the date pattern.

patterns.name: December date month
patterns.context: The month name December appears in dates, usually followed by a year or a date in a range; this is the most consistent and strongest pattern.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including medical abstracts, Wikipedia biographies, and legal texts

patterns.name: October date month
patterns.context: The month name October appears in dates or study time periods.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, public health surveys, and biographies

patterns.name: September date month
patterns.context: The month name September appears in study periods or time comparisons.

patterns.name: March date month
patterns.context: The month name March appears in time periods or biographical dates, with weaker activation.

patterns.name: Month-date format
patterns.context: A month name is used in a date expression, but activation is weaker than for December and October; may reflect a broader response to month words in dates.

patterns.name: Legal section symbol
patterns.context: The section sign in a code title is followed by a provision number; this passage contains none of the high-activation months above.

1_86.description: 主要对日期中的月份名作强响应，尤其是 December、October、September；March及其他月份也有较弱响应。另对法典引用中的节号符号§强响应，不能完全归入日期模式。

patterns.name: 日期月份 December
patterns.context: 月份名称 December 出现在日期中，通常后接年份或日期范围中的日期；这是最一致、激活最强的模式。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、Wikipedia 人物传记及法律文本等多种文体

patterns.name: 日期月份 October
patterns.context: 月份名称 October 出现在日期或研究时间范围中。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、公共卫生调查及传记

patterns.name: 日期月份 September
patterns.context: 月份名称 September 出现在研究时段或时间比较中。

patterns.name: 日期月份 March
patterns.context: 月份名称 March 出现在时间范围或传记日期中，激活较弱。
patterns.domain: 医学数据库描述、人物传记

patterns.name: 月份日期格式
patterns.context: 月份名用于日期表达，但相较 December、October 激活较弱；可能反映对日期月份词的较广泛响应。

patterns.name: 法律条文符号
patterns.context: 法典标题中节号符号后接条款编号；该段未出现上述高激活月份。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the month name December in dates across many genres; it also responds to September in dates and to year and hyphen in age-group labels.

patterns.name: December in dates
patterns.context: Occurs in dates, followed by a day number; it is also typically part of a year, date range, or parenthetical date information.
patterns.domain: Date expressions across domains, including medical papers, astronomical archives, encyclopedia entries, legal documents, and project budgets; present in nearly all segments.

patterns.name: September as a month name
patterns.context: Appears as the month in a date, followed by “in”, within abstract text comparing different age groups.

patterns.name: Year in date/time units
patterns.context: Embedded in the age-group labels “5-14-year-olds” and “15-24-year-olds”; the hyphens in age ranges and compound adjectives are also marked.

1_86.description: 主要对日期中月份名 December 强烈响应，跨多种文体出现；另对 September 日期月份及年龄组标签中的 year 和连字符有响应。

patterns.name: 日期中的 December
patterns.context: 在日期中，后接日号；通常也处于年份、日期范围或括号中的日期信息内。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的日期表达，包括医学论文、天文档案、百科条目、法律文件和项目预算；覆盖几乎所有片段。

patterns.name: 月份名 September
patterns.context: 作为日期中的月份出现，后接“in”，并处于对不同年龄组进行比较的摘要文字中。

patterns.name: 日期／时间单位中的年
patterns.context: 嵌在年龄组标签“5-14-year-olds”“15-24-year-olds”中；年龄范围和复合形容词中的连字符也被标记。

en.description: All passages include high-activation “October,” usually in “October + day + year” dates, across abstracts, legal documents, biographical entries, emails, and references; nearby months, years, numbers, and punctuation also often activate.

patterns.name: October date string
patterns.context: “October” is followed by a date number or date field and often appears before a year; this is the most stable trigger across domains.

patterns.name: Years and punctuation in dates
patterns.context: Appears after or near an October date as a year; date commas, hyphens, and adjacent numbers are also observed.

patterns.name: Months or day numbers near dates
patterns.context: Appears alongside an October date or in the same date metadata/birth-date expression; may reflect months, ordinal days, and adjacent numbers in date formats.

patterns.name: Numbers and separators in date contexts
patterns.context: Numbers and punctuation near dates receive activation; some numbers may be dates, years, page numbers, or identifiers, with insufficient evidence to treat them as independent semantic triggers.

1_86.description: 各段均出现高激活的“October”，多为“October + 日 + 年”的日期，涵盖摘要、法律文书、人物条目、邮件与参考文献；邻近月份、年份、数字和标点也常激活。

patterns.name: October 日期字符串
patterns.context: “October”后接日期数字或日期字段，且常出现在年份之前；这是最稳定、贯穿各领域的触发形式。
patterns.domain: 日期、时间戳与文献记录

patterns.name: 日期中的年份与标点
patterns.context: 出现在 October 日期之后或附近，作为年份；也可见日期逗号、连字符及相邻数字。

patterns.name: 日期附近的月份或日期数字
patterns.context: 与 October 日期并列，或处在同一日期元数据/出生日期表达中；可能反映日期格式中的月份、日序号和数字邻接。

patterns.name: 日期语境中的数字与分隔符
patterns.context: 日期附近的数字和标点获得激活；部分数字可能是日期、年份、页码或编号，证据不足以将其视为独立语义触发。

en.description: The most stable trigger is “October” in dates, appearing across birth/death records, event dates, email subjects, paper metadata, and medical and legal texts. Other months, nearby years, or day numbers occasionally elicit weaker responses; a few local terms cannot be confirmed as independent patterns.

patterns.name: October in dates
patterns.context: Appears in dates, date expressions, or time ranges; it is the main trigger shared by all segments, often adjacent to a year or day number.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia biographies, email, paper metadata, medical abstracts, legal documents, and astronomy papers

patterns.name: Adjacent day numbers in dates
patterns.context: Adjacent to a month or complete date; marking and activation on the numbers themselves are inconsistent and may be accompanying features of the month-date pattern.

patterns.name: Other months in dates and time ranges
patterns.context: Appears when describing events, birth/death dates, or paper receipt dates; significant activation remains concentrated on October, while responses to other months are weaker and less stable.

patterns.name: Meeting/event wording in email subjects
patterns.context: Appears in an email subject line, which also contains «October»10 and a year; whether it is independent of the date trigger is uncertain.

patterns.name: Local non-date terms
patterns.context: These words or word fragments each occur in a single segment and fit the local semantics, but cannot be confirmed as stable trigger patterns from other segments.
patterns.domain: Astronomy papers, legal documents, medical abstracts

1_86.description: 最稳定的触发是日期中的“October”，跨人物生卒、事件日期、邮件主题、论文元数据及医学和法律文本出现。其他月份、相邻年份或日号偶有较弱反应；少量局部词项无法确认是否独立模式。

patterns.name: 日期中的 October
patterns.context: 在日期、年月日或时间范围表达中出现；是所有片段共有的主要触发形式，常与年份、日号相邻。
patterns.domain: 百科人物传记、邮件、论文元数据、医学摘要、法律文书及天文学论文

patterns.name: 日期中相邻的日号
patterns.context: 与月份或完整日期相邻；数字自身的标记和激活并不一致，可能是月份日期模式的伴随特征。

patterns.name: 日期及时间范围中的其他月份
patterns.context: 在叙述事件、人物生卒日期或论文接收日期时出现；显著激活主要仍集中在 October，其他月份的反应较弱且不稳定。
patterns.domain: 论文、人物传记及日期元数据

patterns.name: 邮件主题中的会议活动措辞
patterns.context: 出现在邮件主题行，且同一主题含 «October»10 和年份；是否独立于日期触发不确定。

patterns.name: 局部非日期词项
patterns.context: 这些词或词片段各出现在单个片段，且与局部语义相符，但无法从其他片段确认是稳定触发模式。
patterns.domain: 天文学论文、法律文书、医学摘要

en.description: All passages show strong activation on the month token «January»; it occurs in dates or time periods spanning observations, studies, publications, and biographical dates. Domains and date uses vary, with no reliable non-date trigger pattern.

patterns.name: January date token
patterns.context: Appears as a month name in a date, followed by a day or year; in multiple examples it is adjacent to date ranges, commas, or years. January itself is the strongest and most stable shared trigger, independent of any particular research topic.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain date text, including astronomy papers, journal information, medical research, statistical reports, and biographies

patterns.name: Time expressions in date ranges
patterns.context: January occurs in an observation period, study period, publication date, or biographical date; it is often surrounded by months, day numbers, years, and ranges formed with to, hyphens, or dashes.
patterns.domain: Scientific and medical papers, journal headers, encyclopedia biographies

patterns.name: Day numbers or numeric date fields after a month
patterns.context: A day number immediately follows the month word in a date; in some texts, tokenization places date numbers next to years, page numbers, or other numbers. The meaning of specific numbers varies by passage.
patterns.domain: Dates and bibliographic or paper metadata

1_86.description: 所有段落均出现强激活的月份词元 «January»；它处于日期或时间范围中，涵盖观测、研究、出版及生平日期。领域与日期用途多样，未见可靠的非日期触发模式。

patterns.name: January 日期词元
patterns.context: 在日期中作为月份名称出现，后接日号或年份；在多个例子中与日期范围、逗号或年份相邻。最强且最稳定的共同触发点是 January 本身，不要求特定研究主题。
patterns.domain: 跨领域日期文本，包括天文论文、期刊信息、医学研究、统计报告和传记

patterns.name: 日期范围中的时间表达
patterns.context: January 位于观测期、研究期、出版日期或生平日期中；周围常有月份、日号、年份及 to、连字符或破折号构成的范围。
patterns.domain: 科学与医学论文、期刊页眉、百科传记

patterns.name: 月份后的日号或数字日期字段
patterns.context: 日期中月份词后紧跟日号；部分文本的 token 切分使日期数字与年份、页码或其他数字相邻。具体数字含义因段落而异。
patterns.domain: 日期和书目、论文元数据

en.description: Primarily sensitive to date expressions and their components, especially day numbers after months, years, and start–end ranges; dates appear in study periods, legal documents, metadata, historical entries, and financial tables. There are also sporadic activations on Jan in author names and on judge titles; some passages are not fully explained by date patterns.

patterns.name: Date numbers after month names
patterns.context: A day number follows a month, commonly in full dates, date ranges, or statistical periods; activation concentrates on the month and the immediately adjacent number.
patterns.domain: Date and time expressions; spans papers, legal documents, emails, and encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Numbers in years and date ranges
patterns.context: Years appear in dates, start–end ranges, or historical birth and death information; they are usually adjacent to months, prepositions, or range connectors.
patterns.domain: Year expressions in papers, legal documents, emails, and encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Date ranges and their connectors
patterns.context: Expressions of time spans or validity periods; triggers include words indicating start and end, coverage, or duration, and their dates.
patterns.domain: Paper methods and data descriptions; email tables

patterns.name: Date field labels
patterns.context: Dates appear as table fields, metadata fields, or legal case information.

patterns.name: Jan in author names
patterns.context: Jan is part of an author's name, not a month or date.

patterns.name: Judge titles
patterns.context: Legal text uses Judge to identify a judge or judicial personnel; the passage also contains a date, but activation here stands out beyond the date pattern.

patterns.name: Author and acceptance information before dates
patterns.context: Paper YAML/reference-style metadata, with dates embedded in publication-process information such as received and accepted.

patterns.name: Names and historical birth and death dates
patterns.context: A biographical entry gives a person's name, followed by birth, death, or related historical dates in parentheses.

patterns.name: Statistical periods and experimental context
patterns.context: Month and day indicate the statistical period for a study or disease incidence.

patterns.name: Specialized time-series records
patterns.context: A table of futures contract expiration dates, with months, days, and years listed alongside instruments and validity-period notes.

1_86.description: 主要对日期表达及其构成敏感，尤其是月份后的日号、年份和起止区间；日期出现在研究周期、法律文书、元数据、历史条目和金融表格中。另有作者名中的 Jan、法官称谓等零散激活，部分段落无法由日期模式充分解释。

patterns.name: 月份名称后的日期数字
patterns.context: 月份后跟日号，常见于完整日期、日期范围或统计时间区间；激活集中在月份及紧邻数字
patterns.domain: 日期与时间表达；覆盖论文、法律文书、邮件和百科文本

patterns.name: 年份与日期范围中的数字
patterns.context: 年份出现在日期、起止区间或历史生卒信息中；通常邻接月份、介词或范围连接词
patterns.domain: 论文、法律文书、邮件、百科文本中的年份表达

patterns.name: 日期范围及其连接词
patterns.trigger: « from»1« 2000»2« to»1 2009、« covering»3 from…« to»1、« between»…« and»2、« extended until further« notice»2
patterns.context: 时间跨度或有效期表达；触发点包括表示起止、覆盖范围或延续期限的词及其日期
patterns.domain: 论文方法与数据描述、邮件表格

patterns.name: 日期字段标签
patterns.context: 日期作为表格字段、元数据字段或法律案件信息出现
patterns.domain: 邮件、论文元数据、法律文书

patterns.name: 作者名中的 Jan
patterns.context: Jan 是作者名字的一部分，而非月份日期
patterns.domain: 代码注释中的作者署名

patterns.name: 法官称谓
patterns.context: 法律文本中以 Judge 标记法官或司法人员信息；该段同时含日期，但此处激活突出于日期模式之外

patterns.name: 日期前的作者与接受信息
patterns.trigger: « Evidence»2 of；前文含 Received 8 April 2016; Accepted 24 February 2017
patterns.context: 论文 YAML/参考文献式元数据，日期嵌在接收、接受等出版流程信息中

patterns.name: 姓名及历史生卒日期
patterns.context: 人物条目先给出姓名，随后以括号列出生卒或相关历史日期

patterns.name: 统计周期与实验背景
patterns.trigger: « TB»2 from« January»10 to« June»7 2016；背景含信息提取与噪声检验
patterns.context: 月份日期标示研究或疾病发生率的统计区间

patterns.name: 专业时间序列记录
patterns.context: 期货合约到期日期表格，月份、日号和年份与品种及有效期说明并列

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to month names, especially January; trigger contexts are typically specific dates or time ranges across scientific, legal, email, and tabular text. February, March, August, December, and June also elicit responses, along with weaker date-field markers.

patterns.name: January in dates
patterns.context: January is followed by a date, year, or month in a date range; activation centers on the month name itself, especially for specific dates or time spans.
patterns.domain: Dates in papers, legal texts, emails, and project tables

patterns.name: February in dates
patterns.context: February occurs before a specific date in a date range or publication metadata.

patterns.name: March in dates
patterns.context: March forms a month range together with January.

patterns.name: August in dates
patterns.context: August is followed by a specific day and forms an observation period with February.

patterns.name: December in dates
patterns.context: December is followed by a specific day and serves as the endpoint of a time range.

patterns.name: June in dates
patterns.context: June is followed by a year, indicating the endpoint of case occurrence or statistical reporting.

patterns.name: Date markers in tables or literature
patterns.context: These words introduce date fields or date metadata; activation is weaker and does not fully align with month triggers.
patterns.domain: Project tables, court documents, paper metadata

1_86.description: 主要对月份名称作强反应，尤其 January；触发环境多为具体日期或时间范围，分布于科研、法律、邮件和表格文本。February、March、August、December、June 也有反应，另有较弱的日期字段标记。

patterns.name: 日期中的 January
patterns.context: January 后跟日期、年份，或日期范围中的月份；激活集中在月份名本身，尤其用于具体日期或起止时间。
patterns.domain: 论文、法律文本、邮件及项目表格中的日期

patterns.name: 日期中的 February
patterns.context: February 出现在日期范围或出版元数据中的具体日期前。
patterns.domain: 科研论文与出版元数据

patterns.name: 日期中的 March
patterns.context: March 与 January 一起构成月份范围。
patterns.domain: 科研论文中的时间区间

patterns.name: 日期中的 August
patterns.context: August 后接具体日，与 February 构成观测时间范围。

patterns.name: 日期中的 December
patterns.context: December 后接具体日，作为时间范围终点。

patterns.name: 日期中的 June
patterns.context: June 后接年份，表示病例发生或统计的时间终点。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要中的流行病学统计

patterns.name: 表格或文献中的日期标记
patterns.context: 这些词引出日期字段或日期元数据；激活较弱，且与月份触发不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 项目表格、法院文件、论文元数据

en.description: All passages contain month names, especially January, and many occur in dates or time ranges that include years or day numbers; triggers also cover astronomical observations, seasonal covariates, and project dates, not just medical research.

patterns.name: January in dates
patterns.context: In date ranges, study enrollment periods, or event times, often adjacent to a year and from/to, between/and, a hyphen, or a month and day; activation primarily falls on the January token fragments.
patterns.domain: Paper methods, research abstracts, and project budgets/schedules; also astronomical observation narratives

patterns.name: December in date ranges
patterns.context: Paired with January to form start and end dates for studies or projects, often with specific days and years.

patterns.name: Other months in date ranges
patterns.context: Appears as the endpoint of a date range or as an observation month; March also appears in a month range for seasonal covariates.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research, epidemiological modeling, astronomical observations

patterns.name: Date-range wording
patterns.context: Marks the start and end of a study or observation period around months such as January; these words do not activate universally, and local date context is more important.
patterns.domain: Methods sections, research abstracts, project schedules, and observation records

patterns.name: Non-date uses of January
patterns.context: Not limited to clinical study enrollment periods: also used for astronomical observation dates, preseason month ranges for model covariates, and a Dates column in a budget project.

1_86.description: 所有段都出现月份名称，尤其是 January，且多处处于带年份或日号的日期/时间范围中；触发也覆盖天文观测、季节性协变量和项目日期，并非只限医学研究。

patterns.name: 日期中的 January
patterns.context: 在日期范围、研究纳入时段或事件时间中，常与年份及 from/to、between/and、连字符或月份日号相邻；触发点主要是 January 的 token 分片。
patterns.domain: 论文方法、研究摘要及项目预算/时间表；另有天文观测叙述

patterns.name: 日期范围中的 December
patterns.context: 与 January 配对组成研究或项目的起止日期，常带具体日号和年份。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、项目描述

patterns.name: 日期范围中的其他月份
patterns.context: 作为日期区间终点或观测月份出现；March 也出现在季节性协变量的月份范围中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究、流行病学建模、天文观测

patterns.name: 日期范围措辞
patterns.context: 在 January 等月份前后标示研究或观测的起止时间；这些词并非普遍激活，局部日期语境更关键。
patterns.domain: 方法部分、研究摘要、项目时间表及观测记录

patterns.name: 非日期的 January 用法
patterns.trigger: «January» 与观测、季节性指标或项目日期并列
patterns.context: 不仅是临床研究纳入期：也用于天文观测日期、模型协变量的 preseason 月份范围，以及预算项目的 Dates 栏。
patterns.domain: 天文学、流行病学建模、项目/预算文档

en.description: Strongly responds to month names in dates, especially January; also responds to other months and to numbers, commas, and conjunctions in date ranges. Samples span medical, astronomy, and legal genres, with date expressions—not domain topics—as the trigger.

patterns.name: January in dates
patterns.context: January is followed by a day or year in a date or time interval; it often combines with months such as February, March, June, and December, and with years and punctuation, to express the start or end of a study or event.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, astronomy papers, legal decisions, and other formal genres; spans many domains

patterns.name: Date expressions with other months
patterns.context: Month names occur in date or time-range expressions; activation mainly falls on the month token rather than a unified research topic.
patterns.domain: Study time ranges, observation periods, decision dates, etc. in formal documents

patterns.name: Date punctuation and adjacent numbers
patterns.context: Commas, conjunctions, and numbers in date ranges or date lists also show weaker activation; compared with month tokens, the activation is lower and less stable.
patterns.domain: Date formatting in various formal genres

1_86.description: 强烈响应日期中的月份名称，尤其 January；也响应其他月份及其日期范围中的数字、逗号和连接词。样本横跨医学、天文学和法律等文体，触发点是日期表达而非领域主题。

patterns.name: 日期中的 January
patterns.context: 在日期或时间区间中，January 后接日或年份；常与 February、March、June、December 等月份及年份、标点组成研究或事件的起止时间。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、天文学论文、法律判决及其他正式文体；覆盖广泛领域

patterns.name: 其他月份的日期表达
patterns.context: 月份名称处在日期或时间范围表达中；激活主要落在月份 token，而非某个统一研究主题。
patterns.domain: 正式文献中的研究时间范围、观测时间、判决日期等

patterns.name: 日期标点与相邻数字
patterns.context: 日期区间或日期列表中的逗号、连接词和数字也有较弱激活；相较月份 token，强度较低且不稳定。
patterns.domain: 各类正式文体中的日期排写

en.description: All passages contain a marked January, often in a year, date range, or list of observation dates; December, June, and other months, as well as connectors, activate occasionally. Medical research-method terms are often accompanying features, and the astronomy passage also fits the date pattern.

patterns.name: Month name January
patterns.context: January in a date or study period, often appearing with a year, range connectors such as and/to, and other months. Activation primarily falls on January; numbers or months in a few contexts are also marked.
patterns.domain: Study methods, cohort and case descriptions in biomedical papers; also astronomical observation records

patterns.name: Other time words in date ranges
patterns.context: Other date ranges containing January or multiple observation dates listed chronologically. The specific months and connectors activated vary by passage and are usually weaker than January.
patterns.domain: Enrollment periods, follow-up periods, literature search periods, or observation dates in research papers

patterns.name: Case-study methods template (incidental)
patterns.context: The background involves study design, methods headings, or descriptions of case/patient enrollment; these terms are not common triggers across passages and may co-occur with date-range templates.
patterns.domain: Medical paper abstracts and main text

patterns.name: Astronomical date expressions
patterns.context: Lists the months in which telescope observations took place; this is not a medical research date range, but January appears in a similar date-listing structure.

1_86.description: 所有段都含被标记的 January，常位于年份、日期区间或观测日期列表中；December、June 等月份及连接词偶有激活。医学研究方法词多为伴随特征，天文段也符合日期模式。

patterns.name: 月份名称 January
patterns.context: 日期或研究时间范围中的 January；常与年份、范围连接词 and/to 及其他月份并列出现。激活主要落在 January，少数上下文中的数字或月份也被标记。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文的研究方法、队列与病例描述；另有天文学观测记录

patterns.name: 日期范围中的其他时间词
patterns.trigger: « December»、« June»、« February»、« March»、« April»、« May»；以及 « and»、« to»
patterns.context: 与 January 同处日期区间或按时间顺序列出的多个观测日期。各段激活的具体月份与连接词不一致，强度通常低于 January。
patterns.domain: 研究论文中的纳入时间、随访时间、文献检索期或观测日期

patterns.name: 病例研究方法模板（附带）
patterns.context: 以研究设计、方法标题或病例/患者纳入描述为背景；这些词并非各段共同触发条件，可能与日期区间模板共现。

patterns.name: 天文日期表述
patterns.context: 列举望远镜观测发生的月份；不属于医学研究日期范围，January 仍在相似日期列举结构中出现。

en.concept: Academic paper structure markers and paragraph openings
en.description: Most activation centers on the Background heading in PMC papers and the first word following it, though the topics of those opening words vary; also seen in a Participants/inclusion-date methods section and formatting markers and graph-submission terminology in an ArXiv graph paper.

patterns.name: Paper Background heading and opening
patterns.context: The first word of the body immediately follows a Markdown-style Background subsection heading in a medical or health-related paper; the specific topics vary.

patterns.name: Study Participants heading and methods description
patterns.context: A methods-section paragraph on participants or study settings describing registered patients, initial diagnosis, and inclusion time periods.

patterns.name: Graph theory terms and mathematical paper structure markers
patterns.context: Title/metadata and introduction of an ArXiv document introducing the intersection graph of geometric objects.

1_86.concept: 学术论文结构标记与段落起始
1_86.description: 多数激活集中在PMC论文的Background标题及其后首词，但首词主题不一；另见Participants/纳入日期的方法段，以及ArXiv图论文档的格式标记和交图术语。

patterns.name: 论文背景章节标题及其开头
patterns.context: 医学或健康相关论文中，Markdown 风格的 Background 小节标题后紧接正文首词；具体主题各异。

patterns.name: 研究参与者标题及方法描述
patterns.context: 方法部分的参与者或研究设置段落，描述登记患者、首次诊断及纳入时间范围。

patterns.name: 图论术语与数学论文结构标记
patterns.context: ArXiv 文档的标题/元数据和引言，介绍几何对象的交图定义。
patterns.domain: 数学或计算机科学论文

en.description: Primarily responds to day numbers after months in date expressions, especially dates after January; also responds more weakly to day numbers after December, June, March, and April. Common in study periods or observation dates; other passage features are insufficient to explain it.

patterns.name: Date numbers after January
patterns.context: Day numbers after January are marked in date ranges or specific observation dates; number formats vary, while adjacent commas and years are usually unmarked.
patterns.domain: Methods/results in medical papers, astronomy observation papers

patterns.name: Day numbers after other months in date ranges
patterns.context: Day numbers after other months may also trigger when listed alongside January date ranges, but marking is weaker and inconsistent.

patterns.name: Other date numbers in astronomy papers
patterns.context: Day numbers are marked in observation months listed alongside January; the month names themselves are unmarked.

1_86.description: 主要响应日期表达中的月份后日号，尤其 January 后的日期；也会较弱地响应 December、June、March、April 后的日号。常见于研究时间范围或观测日期，其他文段特征不足以解释。

patterns.name: 月份 January 后的日期数字
patterns.trigger: « January» 后紧接日期数字，如« January»10、« January»9
patterns.context: 日期范围或具体观测日期中，January 后的日号被标记；数字形式不固定，且相邻的逗号、年份通常未标记。
patterns.domain: 医学论文方法/结果、天文观测论文

patterns.name: 日期范围中的其他月份日号
patterns.context: 与 January 日期范围并列出现时，其他月份后的日号也可触发，但标记强度较弱且不稳定。
patterns.domain: 医学论文及研究时间范围

patterns.name: 天文论文中的其他日期数字
patterns.context: 与 January 同列的观测月份中，日号被标记；对应月份名称本身未标记。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on numeric punctuation and date formatting in papers, as well as section markers and cross-references; there is also one instance of “segments” in a graph theory title. The commonality is structured markers and numbering in scientific text, but the trigger forms are not entirely the same.

patterns.name: Punctuation in decimal number strings
patterns.context: Punctuation such as commas and periods near dates, years, or statistics, often within sequences of numbers; markers also cover some month names and numbers
patterns.domain: Dates, statistical results, and methods descriptions in scientific papers

patterns.name: Section references and section numbers
patterns.context: Papers use section numbers or bracketed references to point to sections, methods, appendices, and other content.
patterns.domain: Section structure and cross-references in ArXiv papers

patterns.name: segment in graph theory terminology
patterns.context: Appears in the graph theory paper title “Disjointness graphs of segments”, referring to geometric objects or components of a graph.

1_86.description: 激活主要落在论文中的数字标点与日期写法，以及章节标记和章节交叉引用；另有一次图论标题中的“segments”。共同点是科研文本里的结构化标记与编号，但触发形式并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 十进制数字串中的标点
patterns.trigger: 数字之间的 «,»、«.»，以及数字和月份之间的标点，如 «1 January»、«31 December»、«1, 2010»
patterns.context: 日期、年份或统计数字附近，常出现在数字序列中的逗号、句点等标点处；标记也覆盖部分月份名称和数字
patterns.domain: 科研论文中的日期、统计结果与方法描述

patterns.name: 章节引用与章节编号
patterns.context: 论文通过章节编号或方括号引用指向章节、方法、附录等内容
patterns.domain: ArXiv论文的章节结构与交叉引用

patterns.name: 图论术语中的 segment
patterns.context: 出现在图论论文标题“Disjointness graphs of segments”中，指几何对象或图的组成部分
patterns.domain: 数学／计算机科学论文标题

en.concept: Academic paper structure and formatting cues
en.description: Primarily responds to academic paper structure and layout cues, especially section references, section organization, and methods descriptions; also covers journal metadata, study date ranges, physics terms, observation notation, and graph theory content, with some patterns appearing only once.

patterns.name: Journal/paper layout metadata
patterns.context: Numbers, volume and issue information, placeholders, dates, and uppercase publication labels occur consecutively, resembling headers, citations, or manuscript metadata; passage [6].

patterns.name: Paper structure headings and section references
patterns.context: Introduces the organization, methods, or contents of sections in a research paper, often with section labels, numbers, or links; passages [3][4][7][9][10].

patterns.name: Date-range boundaries
patterns.context: A study enrollment or literature search period described by start and end dates; passages [1][2].

patterns.name: used to in research methods
patterns.context: Passive-voice description of a principle or database used for research purposes; passage [2].

patterns.name: Word fragments and compounds in scientific terminology
patterns.context: Technical terms, models, or variables appear in the main text of a theoretical physics paper; passages [3][4][7].

patterns.name: Digital technology and unit notation
patterns.context: Numbers, measurement units, angular scales, and dates appear together in astronomical observation descriptions; passage [8].

patterns.name: Graph theory terms and title fragments
patterns.context: Defines a graph using geometric objects and their intersection relations; graph-related terms appear in both the title and body; passage [5].

patterns.name: Properties and discourse connectors in academic writing
patterns.context: Organizes the discussion, points to subsequent sections, or summarizes analysis steps in a paper; passages [3][9].

1_86.concept: 学术论文结构与格式线索
1_86.description: 主要响应学术论文的结构与排版线索，尤其章节引用、章节安排及方法叙述；同时覆盖期刊元数据、研究日期范围、物理术语、观测记法和图论内容，部分模式仅个别出现。

patterns.name: 期刊/论文排版元数据
patterns.context: 数字、卷期、占位符、日期和大写出版标签连续出现，类似页眉、引文或稿件元数据；段[6]

patterns.name: 论文结构标题与章节引用
patterns.context: 研究论文中介绍章节安排、方法或章节内容，常出现章节标签、编号或链接；段[3][4][7][9][10]

patterns.name: 日期区间边界
patterns.trigger: “1 January 2010 and 31 December 2013”“1 January 2000 and 31 December 2017”
patterns.context: 研究纳入或文献检索的时间范围，以起止日期描述；段[1][2]

patterns.name: 研究方法中的 used to
patterns.trigger: “were used to provide”“was used to identify”
patterns.context: 被动语态描述某种原则或数据库被用于研究目的；段[2]

patterns.name: 科学术语中的分词/复合词片段
patterns.context: 理论物理论文正文出现技术术语、模型或变量；段[3][4][7]

patterns.name: 数字化技术与单位记法
patterns.trigger: “2 x 7.3 arcmin²”“10 m”“1996 January, March and April”
patterns.context: 天文观测描述中，数字、测量单位、角尺度和日期组合出现；段[8]

patterns.name: 图论术语与标题碎片
patterns.context: 以几何对象及其相交关系定义图，标题和正文均出现 graph 相关术语；段[5]

patterns.name: 学术表达中的性质与论述连接
patterns.trigger: “properties in Sec”“However, we will first provide”“followed in the numerical analyses”
patterns.context: 论文中组织论述、指引后文或概述分析步骤；段[3][9]

en.description: Primarily activates on checked and its verification contexts; sporadic activations also occur on month names in dates, limits approaching zero, medical unit prefixes, physics terms, affiliation subword fragments, HTML time markers, and section abbreviations.

patterns.name: checked and adjacent expressions
patterns.context: Describes an object, result, device, or conjecture being checked or verified; voice and discipline vary
patterns.domain: Research methods, medical research, scientific discussion

patterns.name: Month words in dates
patterns.context: A month appears in a date expression, especially “December 25”, “1 March 2005”, “31 December 2007”

patterns.name: Limits approaching zero in formulas
patterns.context: In a mathematical limit expression, 0 follows to

patterns.name: k in medical measurement units
patterns.context: The unit prefix k before Pa, in descriptions of blood gas threshold measurements

patterns.name: space/dimensions in quantum physics terms
patterns.context: Describes localized solutions in two- or three-dimensional space; the words occur in hyphenated compound expressions

patterns.name: Sporadic subwords in institution names
patterns.context: In English proper names for schools, departments, and place names; activation falls on common linking words or split subword fragments

patterns.name: HTML document markers and date fragments
patterns.context: Generation information in HTML comments, including month abbreviations and time punctuation/number fragments

patterns.name: Section abbreviations in algorithm papers
patterns.context: In section references such as “in Sec. [app]”, with a section marker following Sec.

1_86.description: 主要对 checked 及其验证语境激活；另对日期中的月份、极限趋零、医学单位前缀、物理术语、署名词片段、HTML时间标记和章节缩写出现零散激活。

patterns.name: checked及相邻表达
patterns.trigger: «checked»（[1][3][5][6][7]）；[1]中紧邻“double”，[3]前有“frequencies was”，[5]前有“has to be”，[6]后接“and then”，[7]前有“is”
patterns.context: 描述某对象、结果、设备或猜想被检查、验证；语态和学科不同
patterns.domain: 论文方法、医学研究、科学讨论

patterns.name: 日期中的月份词
patterns.context: 月份出现在日期表达中，特别是“December 25”“1 March 2005”“31 December 2007”
patterns.domain: 百科条目、公共卫生摘要

patterns.name: 公式中趋近零
patterns.context: 数学极限表达中，to 后接 0

patterns.name: 医学测量单位中的 k
patterns.context: Pa 前的单位前缀 k，位于血气阈值测量描述中

patterns.name: 量子物理术语中的 space/dimensions
patterns.context: 描述二或三维空间中的局域解，词语出现在连字符构成的复合表达中

patterns.name: 机构名称中的零散子词
patterns.context: 学校、院系及地名的英文专名中；激活落在常见连接词或被拆分的词片段上

patterns.name: HTML文档标记与日期片段
patterns.context: HTML注释中的生成信息，包含月份缩写及时间标点/数字片段

patterns.name: 算法论文中的章节缩写
patterns.context: “in Sec. [app]”一类章节引用中，Sec. 后跟章节标记

en.concept: Structure and technical markers in academic text
en.description: Activations are distributed across paper titles and section markers, date months, English function words, numerical units, and fragments of technical terms and abbreviations; most occur in technical academic text, but triggers are not uniform.

patterns.name: Paper structure headings and section references
patterns.context: Near titles, section names, cross-references, or subsection descriptions; often accompanied by section numbers, markers, or separators.
patterns.domain: Academic papers (astrophysics, graph theory, medicine, etc.)

patterns.name: Month names in dates
patterns.context: A month as part of a date, often adjacent to a day or year; also occurs in paper headers or tables.
patterns.domain: Academic paper dates, observation records, and tables

patterns.name: English function words and phrase boundaries
patterns.context: Prepositions or conjunctions in ordinary English sentences connect nouns, actions, or clauses; the context domain is not fixed.

patterns.name: Numbers, units, and technical quantities
patterns.context: A number followed by a time or physical unit, range symbol, or measurement-uncertainty notation.
patterns.domain: Experimental methods, physics and medical papers

patterns.name: Specific abbreviations or proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Internal fragments of proper names or abbreviations in table fields, network terminology, equipment names, or correction notices; contexts vary considerably.
patterns.domain: Research tables, computer networking, experimental equipment, publishing corrections

patterns.name: Fragments within technical terms and compounds
patterns.context: Trigger fragments are embedded in technical terms or word forms rather than being standalone general concepts.
patterns.domain: Nuclear physics, graph theory, and other technical texts

patterns.name: Experimental procedures and equipment descriptions
patterns.context: In sentences describing experimental steps, instruments, or operational results.
patterns.domain: Experimental methods and medical procedure descriptions

patterns.name: Date and numerical records in tables
patterns.context: Objects, dates, and measurement/count values are listed in rows and columns.

1_86.concept: 学术文本中的结构与技术标记
1_86.description: 激活分散于论文标题和章节标记、日期月份、英文功能词、数值单位，以及专业术语和缩写片段；多数出现在技术性学术文本，但触发点并不统一。

patterns.name: 论文结构标题与章节引用
patterns.context: 标题、章节名、章节交叉引用或小节说明附近；常伴随章节编号、标记或分隔线
patterns.domain: 学术论文（天体物理、图论、医学等）

patterns.name: 日期中的月份名称
patterns.context: 月份作为日期的一部分，常与日、年相邻；也见于论文页眉或表格
patterns.domain: 学术论文日期、观测记录及表格

patterns.name: 英文功能词与短语边界
patterns.context: 普通英文句子中介词或连词连接名词、动作或分句；上下文领域并不固定

patterns.name: 数字、单位及技术量值
patterns.context: 数字后接时间或物理单位、范围符号及测量误差记号
patterns.domain: 实验方法、物理与医学论文

patterns.name: 特定缩写或专名片段
patterns.context: 表格字段、网络术语、设备名称或更正声明中的专名/缩写内部片段；各例上下文差异较大
patterns.domain: 科研表格、计算机网络、实验设备、出版更正

patterns.name: 专业名词及复合词内部片段
patterns.context: 触发片段嵌在专业术语或词形中，而非独立的通用概念
patterns.domain: 核物理、图论及其他技术文本

patterns.name: 实验操作与器材表述
patterns.context: 描述实验步骤、器械或操作结果的句子中
patterns.domain: 实验方法及医学操作描述

patterns.name: 表格中的日期与数值记录
patterns.context: 以行列形式列出对象、日期及测量/计数数值

en.description: Primarily activates on months in date expressions and their neighboring numbers and punctuation, especially date ranges in papers; sporadic activations also occur on scientific tables, substrings within words, format markers, function words, and experimental terms, with no single stable pattern tying them together.

patterns.name: Months in dates
patterns.context: Month names appear in dates, usually immediately after the date number and forming a time expression with the year; sometimes the marker falls on the space before the month or a suffix after it.
patterns.domain: Dates in papers, reports, data tables, and web pages

patterns.name: Date-ending boundary markers
patterns.context: Months, date numbers, and punctuation occur adjacent to one another in date ranges or records; activation may fall on local tokens such as date numbers or commas.
patterns.domain: Academic papers and other dated text

patterns.name: Numbers and formatted tables
patterns.context: Sporadic activations occur near numbers, units, or mathematical/table markers; no stable shared semantic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics data tables and scientific notation

patterns.name: English plural or word-final substrings
patterns.context: Activation hits local substrings within words rather than complete words; the examples differ in meaning and context.

patterns.name: Function words in collocations
patterns.context: A small number of sentence function words or common verbs are marked; neighboring semantics are inconsistent, suggesting possible local incidental activation.

patterns.name: Format markers and delimiters
patterns.context: Activations occur near titles, section markers, or special formatting symbols.

patterns.name: Proper names or within-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on local parts of proper names, hyphens, or domain-specific terms, without showing a repeatable unified condition.
patterns.domain: Astronomical observation tables, author addresses, and physics papers

patterns.name: Word endings in optics experiments
patterns.context: In descriptions of microscopy/photoelectric detector experiments, activations are scattered across device word endings, punctuation, and ordinary words.

1_86.description: 主要对日期表达中的月份及其邻近数字、标点激活，尤其论文中的日期范围；另有科学表格、词内子串、格式符、功能词和实验术语等零散激活，无法归为同一稳定模式。

patterns.name: 日期中的月份
patterns.trigger: « January»、« February»、« March»、« May»、« September»、« November»
patterns.context: 月份名称出现在日期中，通常紧接日期数字并与年份组成时间表达；有时标记也落在月份前的空格或月份后缀上。
patterns.domain: 论文、报告、数据表及网页中的日期

patterns.name: 日期结束界标
patterns.context: 日期区间或记录中的月份、日期数字及标点相邻；激活可能落在日期数字、逗号等局部 token 上。
patterns.domain: 学术论文及其他带日期的文本

patterns.name: 数字与格式化表格
patterns.context: 数字、单位或数学/表格标记附近出现零散激活；未见稳定的共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 天文物理数据表与科学记号

patterns.name: 英语复数或词尾子串
patterns.context: 激活命中词内局部子串，而非完整词；这些例子词义和上下文不同。
patterns.domain: 医学、天文学、网络技术文本

patterns.name: 搭配中的功能词
patterns.context: 少量句中功能词或常见动词被标记，邻近语义不一致，可能是局部偶发激活。

patterns.name: 格式标记与边界符
patterns.context: 标题、章节标记或特殊格式符号附近激活。
patterns.domain: 带结构标记的论文语料

patterns.name: 专名或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、连字符或领域词语的局部，未显示可重复的统一条件。
patterns.domain: 天文观测表、作者地址及物理论文

patterns.name: 光学实验词尾
patterns.context: 显微/光电探测器实验描述中，多个激活分散在器件词尾、标点及普通词上。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on paper structure references (especially Sec/Appendix), checking expressions with checked, month names in dates, and the ending of intersection; sporadic triggers also include institution names, numbers, and citation fragments.

patterns.name: Section and appendix cross-references
patterns.context: The main text points to sections, appendices, or supplementary material, often with numbers or parenthetical references; the trigger is near the section name or one of its components.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper structure and technical writing

patterns.name: checked and its forms
patterns.context: Occurs in structures such as “double checked”, “has to be checked”, “remain to be checked”, and “was checked”, meaning checked, tested, or awaiting experimental verification.

patterns.name: Numeric date formats
patterns.context: A month name in a date is followed by a date number; this example is a publication or manuscript date.

patterns.name: Word-final intersection
patterns.context: The word is split into tokens; activation falls on the end of intersection, in the graph theory term “intersection graph(s)”.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on word endings and numeric tokens
patterns.context: Occur respectively in an institution name, a sampling interval number, and a personal-name citation; local context is insufficient to infer a shared semantic trigger pattern.
patterns.domain: Paper metadata, biostatistics methods, and citations

1_86.concept: 学术文本中的局部标记
1_86.description: 激活主要落在论文结构引用（尤其 Sec/Appendix）、checked 的核查表达、日期月份，以及 intersection 的词尾；另有机构名、数字和引文词片等零散触发。

patterns.name: 章节及附录交叉引用
patterns.context: 正文指向章节、附录或补充材料，常伴随编号或括号引用；触发位置靠近章节名或其组成部分。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文结构与技术写作

patterns.name: checked 及其形态
patterns.context: 出现在“double checked”“has to be checked”“remain to be checked”“was checked”等结构中，表示核查、检验或待实验验证。
patterns.domain: 学术论文及讨论性文字

patterns.name: 数字化日期格式
patterns.context: 日期中的月份名称后接日期数字；本例为出版或文稿日期。

patterns.name: 词尾 intersection
patterns.context: 词语被拆成 token；激活落在 intersection 词尾，并处于“intersection graph(s)”这一图论术语中。

patterns.name: 词尾与数值 token 的零散激活
patterns.context: 分别出现在机构名、采样间隔数字和人名引文中；局部上下文不足以归纳为同一语义触发模式。
patterns.domain: 论文元数据、生物统计方法及引文

en.description: Activations are scattered across several word fragments: paper subsection references are the most concentrated; Jared, compared, November, checked, and correction also appear in email, film, medical, paper-metadata, and journal-correction contexts, respectively.

patterns.name: Subsection/section references
patterns.context: Uses section cross-references to organize research content in the body of a paper, often accompanied by a summary of a section's content.

patterns.name: Name Jared
patterns.context: The name appears in email signatures or film-cast descriptions; activation is concentrated at the end of the name.

patterns.name: ared within a comparison word
patterns.context: Compares surviving and nonsurviving patients in a medical abstract; activation falls on a fragment within compared.

patterns.name: November in year-date expressions
patterns.context: A paper date or author information in parentheses, with the month adjacent to a year and author information.

patterns.name: Checking action
patterns.context: Describes an experimental method as double checked to avoid or confirm measurement error.

patterns.name: Opening of a correction notice
patterns.context: The title or opening of a journal correction notice, followed by publication details for the original paper.

1_86.concept: 词片段与标记格式触发
1_86.description: 激活分散在若干词片段上：论文小节引用最集中；另见 Jared、compared、November、checked 与 correction，分别来自邮件、影视、医学、论文元数据及期刊更正。

patterns.name: 小节/章节引用
patterns.trigger: «Sect»、«Sec» 后接章节编号或 LaTeX 引用，如 «Sect»10.\[«Discussion»2.«sec»4\]、«Sec»10. \[«sec»54\]
patterns.context: 论文正文中用章节交叉引用来组织研究内容，常伴随对某节内容的概述。

patterns.name: 姓名 Jared
patterns.context: 姓名出现在邮件署名或电影演员介绍语境中；触发位置集中在名字末尾。

patterns.name: 比较/对照词中含 ared
patterns.context: 医学摘要中比较存活与未存活患者；激活落在 compared 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 年份日期中的 November
patterns.context: 括号中的论文日期或署名信息，月份与年份、作者信息相邻。

patterns.name: 校验动作
patterns.context: 描述实验方法经过 double checked，以避免或确认测量误差。

patterns.name: 更正通知开头
patterns.context: 期刊更正说明的标题或开头，后接原论文的出版信息。

en.concept: Checking and verification in scientific contexts
en.description: The most stable pattern is passive checked in scientific or medical contexts, meaning checked, verified, or confirmed. Other activations are scattered across dates and numbers, metadata, technical abbreviations, within-word fragments, and general words; some passages cannot be explained by the main pattern.

patterns.name: Past participle checked
patterns.context: In passive constructions, indicates that something has been checked, verified, or confirmed; objects of checking include predictions, split frequencies, something, method, process estimates, and DLT position.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers and medical abstracts across fields

patterns.name: check with other auxiliaries or passive forms
patterns.context: Still involves checking or judgment, but some activations fall around checked, while other passages include a quotation about something “not being obvious”; it is unclear whether these tokens belong to the same local trigger.

patterns.name: Numbers, dates, and formatted counts
patterns.context: Dates, years, experimental sampling frequencies, or table numbers; activations fall on numbers and their adjacent units or months, not necessarily accompanied by checking semantics.
patterns.domain: Paper metadata, experimental methods, and astronomical observation tables

patterns.name: Proper names and punctuation in addresses
patterns.context: Institution names, commas, and postal-code hyphens in university addresses.

patterns.name: Technical abbreviations and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Local tokens in physics symbols, observation table fields, or networking terms; activation occurs alongside nearby numbers, dates, and abbreviation formats.

patterns.name: Specific word endings or within-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on complete words split across tokens or on parts of words; the words occur respectively in instrument descriptions, errata, astrophysics, and statistical analysis.

patterns.name: General function words and collocations
patterns.context: Adjacent to methods, processes, or noun phrases in technical prose, but do not by themselves constitute a consistent semantic trigger; activations are weak and scattered.
patterns.domain: Scientific text, networking documentation, and medical abstracts

1_86.concept: 科学语境中的检查与核验
1_86.description: 最稳定的模式是科学或医学语境中被动式 checked，表示检查、核验或确认。其余激活零散分布于日期和数字、元数据、技术缩写、词内片段及通用词，部分段落无法由主模式解释。

patterns.name: checked 的过去分词
patterns.context: 被动结构中表示某项事物经检查、核验或确认；检查对象包括 predictions、split frequencies、something、method、过程估算及 DLT position。
patterns.domain: 跨领域科学论文与医学摘要

patterns.name: check 与其他助动词或被动形式
patterns.trigger: «checked»10；«be»« checked»；«double»« checked»；«was»« checked»；«is»« by»« no»« means»（第 4 段）
patterns.context: 仍涉及检查或判断的语境，但有的激活落在 checked 周边，有的同段另有“并非显而易见”的引述，不能确定这些 token 是否属于同一局部触发。

patterns.name: 数字、日期与格式化计数
patterns.trigger: «1000»« generations»；«10»« November»；« November»10；« May»9；« May»9 2000；« 1000»2 等
patterns.context: 日期、年份、实验采样频率或表格数字；激活落在数字及其相邻单位或月份上，不一定伴随检查语义。
patterns.domain: 论文元数据、实验方法与天文观测表

patterns.name: 地址中的专名及标点
patterns.context: 大学地址中的机构名称、逗号及邮编连字符。

patterns.name: 技术缩写与专名片段
patterns.context: 物理符号、观测表字段或网络术语中的局部 token；激活与邻近数字、日期、缩写格式相伴。
patterns.domain: 高能物理、天文学、计算机网络

patterns.name: 特定词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在跨 token 切分的完整词或词的一部分；这些词分别出现在仪器描述、勘误、天体物理和统计分析中。

patterns.name: 通用功能词及搭配
patterns.context: 在技术叙述中与方法、过程或名词短语相邻，单独看不构成一致的语义触发；激活较弱且分散。
patterns.domain: 科学文本、网络说明及医学摘要

en.concept: Paper structure navigation and local subwords
en.description: Primarily activates in paper section-navigation expressions, especially Sec/Section, section numbers, and Appendix labels; sporadic activations also occur on month dates, the name Jared, within-word subwords, and several academic terms. The evidence is weaker and does not support a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Section or appendix navigation
patterns.context: When the main text outlines section contents or points to a specific section or appendix; activation often falls on Sec, a number, or a section label.

patterns.name: Month in date formats
patterns.context: A month appears in paper metadata or a publication date, especially in date formats where the month is adjacent to the year.

patterns.name: Jared name fragment
patterns.context: The name Jared appears in an email sign-off or an actor's name.

patterns.name: Token fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments inside ordinary English proper names; the two examples have no obvious semantic overlap.

patterns.name: See at the beginning of a sentence or in the main text
patterns.context: In an email, See introduces an attachment and asks the recipient to review a revised manuscript.

patterns.name: Specific academic term or word fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in a physics question about atomic nuclei.

patterns.name: Sporadic fragments within full word forms
patterns.context: Scattered across paper text, abstract-like section overviews, or journal correction text; apart from section navigation, no stable shared trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Local activations with no clear theme
patterns.context: The available context is insufficient to determine whether these belong to independent and stable trigger patterns.

1_86.concept: 论文结构导航及局部子词
1_86.description: 主要在论文的章节导航表达中激活，尤其是 Sec/Section、章节编号及 Appendix 标签；另有月份日期、人名 Jared、词内子词及若干学术词语的零散激活，证据较弱，无法归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 章节或附录导航
patterns.context: 论文正文在概述各章节内容、指向特定章节或附录时；激活常落在 Sec、编号或章节标签上。

patterns.name: 日期格式中的月份
patterns.context: 月份出现在论文元数据或出版日期中，尤其是月份与年份相邻的日期格式。
patterns.domain: 论文元数据、期刊更正说明

patterns.name: Jared 姓名片段
patterns.context: 人名 Jared 出现在邮件署名或演员姓名中。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、电影相关文字

patterns.name: 英文词内的 token 片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通英文专名内部的子词片段；两例上下文没有明显共同语义。
patterns.domain: 论文地址、电影相关文字

patterns.name: 句首或正文中的 See
patterns.context: 邮件中以 See 引出附件，要求收件人查看修订稿。

patterns.name: 特定学术术语或词语片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于原子核的物理学问题中。

patterns.name: 完整词形中的零散片段
patterns.context: 分散出现在论文正文、摘要式章节介绍或期刊更正文字中；除章节导航模式外，看不出稳定的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 无明确主题的局部激活
patterns.context: 仅凭现有上下文无法确定它们是否属于独立且稳定的触发模式。

en.description: Activations are scattered across academic text: section cross-references, checked verification expressions, several isolated lexical items, and Å, mm, ×, and K unit specifications in experimental tables. Trigger conditions and domains vary considerably.

patterns.name: Section or range references
patterns.context: Papers use section numbers or cross-references to locate discussion, results, or methods; sometimes LaTeX citation labels are included.

patterns.name: checked and adjacent structures
patterns.context: Occurs in expressions verifying a definition or experimental method; the trigger word is the same, but semantics and domains differ.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers and experimental methods papers

patterns.name: Specific English words or morphemes
patterns.context: Occur respectively in a nuclear physics question, a university name, and a description of geometric-object intersection; there is no shared local semantic condition.

patterns.name: Crystallographic units and specification symbols
patterns.context: Occur in experimental data or table rows containing radiation, temperature, and dimensions, accompanied by numbers, units, and Markdown data headers.

patterns.name: General academic narrative words
patterns.context: Occur respectively in statements of paper results, mathematical definitions, astrophysical properties, or methods discussion; these words show no unified trigger condition.

1_86.description: 激活分散于学术文本：章节交叉引用、checked验证表述、若干孤立词项，以及实验表格中的Å、mm、×和K单位规格。各触发条件与领域差异明显。

patterns.name: 章节或范围引用
patterns.trigger: « Sect»、« Sec»、« section»；以及« in»、« discussed»、« show»等邻近文字
patterns.context: 论文用章节编号或交叉引用定位讨论内容、结果或方法；有时含有 LaTeX 引用标签。

patterns.name: checked 及其相邻结构
patterns.trigger: « checked»（段2为“It is easily checked”，段10为“double checked”）
patterns.context: 出现在对定义或实验方法进行验证的表述中；触发词相同，但语义和领域不同。
patterns.domain: 数学论文与实验方法论文

patterns.name: 特定英语词项或词素
patterns.context: 分别出现在核物理问题、大学名称，以及几何对象交图的描述中；缺乏共同的局部语义条件。

patterns.name: 晶体学单位与规格符号
patterns.context: 出现在包含辐射、温度和尺寸的实验数据或表格行中，伴随数字、单位和 Markdown 数据标题。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 实验论文数据

patterns.name: 一般学术叙述词
patterns.context: 分别处于论文结果陈述、数学定义、天体物理性质或方法讨论中；这些词没有显示出统一触发条件。

en.concept: Academic text structure and scientific unit markers
en.description: Primarily responds to Section/section markers and section references in academic papers; also responds to Å, mm, and K in crystallographic parameter strings. A few isolated activations involve the text fragments quenching, Yonsei, and ASS/ell, which are difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: “Section” section references and heading markers
patterns.context: Appears in academic manuscripts to refer to a section, define a section anchor, or form part of a section heading; capitalization and combinations with numbers, punctuation, and anchor text vary.
patterns.domain: ArXiv or PubMed Central academic papers and their structured text

patterns.name: Å unit in crystallographic data
patterns.context: Appears in crystal structure/experimental data strings, adjacent to numbers, chemical formulas, or lattice parameters.
patterns.domain: Crystallographic data in PubMed Central scientific papers

patterns.name: mm unit
patterns.context: Appears near numbers and negative exponents as a measurement unit; the context is experimental crystallography parameters.
patterns.domain: Experimental data in PubMed Central scientific papers

patterns.name: K radiation symbol
patterns.context: Appears after a number to indicate experimental temperature; the same passage also contains a radiation source and crystallographic data.
patterns.domain: Crystallographic experimental parameters in PubMed Central scientific papers

patterns.name: Colon after section numbers
patterns.context: Follows a section marker and number, connecting to a section anchor name.
patterns.domain: Structured section markers in ArXiv papers

patterns.name: Other terms or formula fragments
patterns.context: Each appears in a separate context: a physics term, an institution-name fragment, and formatted text in a machine-learning title/keywords; there is insufficient evidence for a shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Nuclear physics, institutional affiliations, machine-learning papers

1_86.concept: 学术文本结构与科学单位标记
1_86.description: 主要响应学术论文中的 Section/section 章节标记及章节引用；另对晶体学参数串中的 Å、mm 和 K 有响应。少数孤立激活涉及 quenching、Yonsei 和 ASS/ell 等文本片段，难以与主模式统一。

patterns.name: “Section”章节引用与标题标记
patterns.context: 出现在学术文稿中，指向章节、定义章节锚点，或作为章节标题的一部分；大小写及与数字、标点、锚点文本的组合不一。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 或 PubMed Central 学术论文及其结构化文本

patterns.name: 晶体学数据中的单位符号 Å
patterns.context: 出现在晶体结构/实验数据串中，邻接数值、化学式或晶格参数。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 科学论文的晶体学数据

patterns.name: 量纲单位 mm
patterns.context: 出现在数字及负指数附近，作为测量单位；上下文是晶体学实验参数。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 科学论文的实验数据

patterns.name: 单位辐射符号 K
patterns.context: 出现在数字之后，表示实验温度；同段还包含辐射源和晶体学数据。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 科学论文的晶体学实验参数

patterns.name: 章节编号后的冒号
patterns.context: 紧跟章节标记和编号，并连接章节锚点名称。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文的结构化章节标记

patterns.name: 其他术语或公式碎片
patterns.context: 各自在单独语境中出现，分别是物理术语、机构名片段和机器学习标题/关键词中的格式化文本；没有足够证据形成共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 核物理、机构署名、机器学习论文

en.concept: Academic paper structure and method markers
en.description: Activations are scattered across academic paper structure and metadata: section references/titles, errata and author information, limits approaching zero in formulas, and reports of checking/convergence tests and statistical methods. Trigger forms span word classes, with no single stable semantics apparent.

patterns.name: Section numbers and structural navigation
patterns.context: In academic manuscripts, references sections, presents the section outline, or organizes the main text with section headings and anchors; activation falls on Section/section and nearby numbers

patterns.name: Correction title and citation identifiers
patterns.context: A journal erratum title with bibliographic information such as journal volume and page, DOI, and section anchors

patterns.name: Physics addresses and date metadata
patterns.context: Author addresses and dates in preprint metadata lines; the triggers are punctuation and date fields, not the body of the discussion

patterns.name: Limit expression following “to”
patterns.context: A limit in a mathematical formula describing a variable approaching zero

patterns.name: Checking, verification, or convergence testing
patterns.context: Describes checking a judgment, calculation result, or algorithm convergence; occurs respectively in personal discussion, MCMC methods, and explanations of mathematical definitions

patterns.name: Statistical software and significance reporting
patterns.context: Reports the software used for statistical analysis, its location, and the significance threshold
patterns.domain: PubMed Central empirical research methods sections

patterns.name: Name fragments in author names
patterns.context: A personal name in author metadata is marked as tokens; nearby are a title, abstract-like bibliographic information, and an introduction heading

1_86.concept: 学术论文结构与方法标记
1_86.description: 激活分散于学术论文结构与元数据：章节引用/标题、勘误和作者信息、公式中的趋零，以及检查/收敛检验和统计方法报告。触发形式跨词类，未见单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 章节编号与结构导航
patterns.trigger: « Section»、«section»，以及紧随其后的章节编号，如 « Section»7、«section»8、« Section»6 4
patterns.context: 学术文稿中引用章节、展示章节安排，或以章节标题和锚点组织正文；激活落在 Section/section 及附近编号上

patterns.name: Correction 标题及引文标识
patterns.context: 期刊勘误标题，带有期刊卷页、DOI 和章节锚点等书目信息

patterns.name: 物理地址与日期元数据
patterns.context: 作者地址和日期等预印本元数据行；触发内容是标点及日期字段，并非论述正文

patterns.name: “to”后接极限表达式
patterns.context: 数学公式中描述变量趋于零的极限
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学/理论物理文本

patterns.name: 检查、核验或收敛检验
patterns.context: 描述对某项判断、计算结果或算法收敛性进行检查；分别出现在个人论述、MCMC 方法和数学定义说明中

patterns.name: 统计软件与显著性报告
patterns.trigger: « software»、« Chicago»、« IL»；以及 « significance»、« was»、« set»
patterns.context: 报告统计分析所用软件、所在地和显著性阈值
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 实证研究方法部分

patterns.name: 作者姓名中的词片段
patterns.context: 作者元数据中的人名被分词标记；附近还有标题、摘要式书目信息及引言标题

en.concept: Academic paper structure and section navigation
en.description: Primarily responds to section navigation, section references, and titles with anchors and document boundaries; also covers descriptions of section organization. A few activations fall on corrections/DOIs, statistical significance, acknowledgment institutions, and sporadic scientific word fragments.

patterns.name: Section references and navigation
patterns.context: The main text points to other sections of a paper, often with section numbers, cross-reference markers, or an overview of section contents; it may also occur next to a section heading.

patterns.name: Section headings and anchor markers
patterns.context: Structured anchors consisting of braces, #, section, or similar fields occur near section headings; the heading text itself is not fixed.
patterns.domain: Titles and Markdown/document structure in ArXiv and PubMed Central papers

patterns.name: Section organization descriptions
patterns.context: Authors use first-person plural to explain what each section presents, what methods are used, or what results are reported, often with section references.

patterns.name: Document structure markers and title boundaries
patterns.context: Line breaks, title anchors, underline-style title separators, or the first words of the body immediately following a title occur together; some activations fall on these structural markers and adjacent words.
patterns.domain: ArXiv/PMC document extraction or Markdown-style text

patterns.name: Correction statements and bibliographic identifiers
patterns.context: A correction notice heading is followed by paper citations and publication metadata such as DOIs.

patterns.name: Statistical results reporting
patterns.context: A methods or results paragraph describes statistical software, analysis, and significance thresholds, followed by a Results section heading.

patterns.name: Acknowledgments and institution names
patterns.context: Institution names appear in author funding statements; paper titles and section anchors also occur nearby, but this is not main-text section navigation.

patterns.name: Local word-form fragments in disciplinary terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on ordinary words or word endings in scientific main text; domain vocabulary varies by passage, with no stable topic in specific terminology.
patterns.domain: Paper main text across mathematics, computing, physics, materials science, and other disciplines

1_86.concept: 学术论文结构与章节导航
1_86.description: 主要响应论文的章节导航、章节引用及带锚点的标题和文档边界；也覆盖章节安排说明。少数激活落在校正/DOI、统计显著性、致谢机构及零散科学词片段上。

patterns.name: 章节引用与章节导航
patterns.context: 正文中指向论文其他章节，常带章节编号、交叉引用标记或对章节内容的概述；也可能紧邻章节标题。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，主要是 ArXiv 论文

patterns.name: 章节标题及锚点标记
patterns.context: 章节标题附近出现由大括号、#、section 或类似字段组成的结构化锚点；标题文本本身不固定。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 与 PubMed Central 论文的标题、Markdown/文档结构

patterns.name: 章节安排说明
patterns.trigger: “we« show»”“we present”“Finally in Section 6”“we present our … results”
patterns.context: 作者用第一人称复数说明本文各节展示什么、采用何种方法或报告哪些结果，且常伴章节引用。

patterns.name: 文档结构化标记与标题边界
patterns.context: 换行、标题锚点、下划线式标题分隔符或紧接标题的正文首词同时出现；部分激活落在这些结构标记及相邻词上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv/PMC 文档抽取或 Markdown 风格文本

patterns.name: 校正声明及文献标识符
patterns.trigger: «Cor»«rection»、期刊名“Genet Sel Evol”、DOI 中的“/”“-”及数字
patterns.context: 校正说明标题中，论文引文和 DOI 等出版元数据紧随其后。

patterns.name: 统计结果报告
patterns.context: 方法或结果段落描述统计软件、分析及显著性阈值，之后出现 Results 章节标题。

patterns.name: 致谢与机构名称
patterns.trigger: “The second author was partially supported by the Max-Plan«ck» Institute”
patterns.context: 作者资助说明中出现机构名称；附近另有论文标题和章节锚点，但并非正文章节导航。
patterns.domain: 学术论文致谢及元数据

patterns.name: 学科术语中的局部词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在科学正文中的普通词或词尾，领域词汇随段落而异，没有稳定的特定术语主题。
patterns.domain: 跨数学、计算、物理及材料等学科的论文正文

en.concept: Section markers and miscellaneous local triggers
en.description: Most samples trigger on Section/section/Sec section markers and cross-references, including section numbers and title anchors; other sporadic triggers include a within-word hit on intersection, publication metadata, affiliation dates, VLAN, and results, which cannot all be explained by the same pattern.

patterns.name: Section in section headings
patterns.context: Section headings or references in the main text; often accompanied by section numbers, bracketed labels, or title anchors.

patterns.name: inter-section word family
patterns.context: As part of intersection, referring to the intersection of geometric objects and its graph; not a section reference.

patterns.name: Section references abbreviated as Sec
patterns.context: Uses a section abbreviation to refer to methods, results, or other parts of a paper.

patterns.name: Section as reference heading text
patterns.context: A section name appears in a title anchor, but the text is structural content of a paper following the acknowledgments.

patterns.name: Publication correction metadata
patterns.context: A correction notice and online publication date; no clear relation to section references.

patterns.name: Physics paper affiliation and date
patterns.context: Near addresses, author information, and manuscript dates.

patterns.name: VLAN string in network protocols
patterns.context: Describes the number of VLANs and a Layer 2 network; appears more like a local within-word trigger and differs from section markers.

patterns.name: General graph theory results wording
patterns.context: States research results in a paper abstract or main text; no shared condition sufficient to group it with other triggers is apparent.

1_86.concept: 章节标记与局部杂项触发
1_86.description: 多数样本触发于 Section/section/Sec 章节标记及交叉引用，含章节编号、标题锚点；另有 intersection 词内命中，以及出版元数据、署名日期、VLAN 和 results 等零散触发，无法完全由同一模式解释。

patterns.name: 章节标题中的 Section
patterns.context: 章节标题或正文中指向章节的引用；常伴随章节编号、方括号标签或标题锚点。

patterns.name: inter-section 词族
patterns.context: 作为 intersection 的组成部分，指几何对象交集及其图；不是章节引用。

patterns.name: Sec 缩写章节引用
patterns.context: 以章节缩写引用论文中的方法、结果等部分。

patterns.name: Section 作为参考文献标题文本
patterns.trigger: «-» 等周边没有稳定独立触发；本段实际触发仍为 «Section»
patterns.context: 标题锚点中出现章节名称，但所在文本是致谢之后的论文结构内容。
patterns.domain: 数学论文标题/结构标记

patterns.name: 出版更正元数据
patterns.context: 更正声明和在线发表日期；与章节引用无明显关系。

patterns.name: 物理学论文署名与日期
patterns.context: 地址、作者信息和稿件日期附近。

patterns.name: 网络协议中的 VLAN 字符串
patterns.context: 描述 VLAN 数量及二层网络；更像词内局部触发，和章节标记不同。

patterns.name: 一般图论结果用语
patterns.context: 论文摘要或正文中陈述研究结果；未见足以和其他触发归为一类的共同条件。

en.concept: Academic text formatting and terminology fragments
en.description: Activations are distributed across formatting and terminology common in academic literature: section references, crystallographic parameters (Å, Kα, mm⁻¹), corrections and DOI, as well as a few physics-paper metadata items and business email terms; there is no clear unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: “section” heading or cross-reference
patterns.context: Appears in paper body section references, section headings, or subsection anchors; sometimes adjacent to « graph».

patterns.name: Å unit in crystallographic tables
patterns.context: In crystallographic data records, Å is followed by a number or exponent notation; the same row often contains radiation, temperature, and unit-cell parameters.
patterns.domain: Data tables in PubMed Central crystallography papers

patterns.name: Kα radiation record
patterns.context: Appears in a crystallographic experimental data row, alongside parameters such as element, absorption coefficient μ, and temperature T.
patterns.domain: Data tables in PubMed Central crystallography papers

patterns.name: Negative-exponent length unit mm⁻¹
patterns.context: The unit of μ, appearing in crystallographic radiation parameter records.
patterns.domain: Data tables in PubMed Central crystallography papers

patterns.name: Correction statement and literature identifier
patterns.context: Begins a journal article correction notice, followed by a citation and DOI.

patterns.name: Quenching and author information in physics papers
patterns.context: A nuclear physics problem description is followed by a South Korean university address and date; activations are distributed across separate terms.
patterns.domain: ArXiv physics paper metadata or manuscript

patterns.name: See and signature terms in business emails
patterns.context: The email body refers to an attached revised draft and ends with Regards and the signature Jared.

1_86.concept: 学术文本格式与术语片段
1_86.description: 激活分布在学术文献中常见的格式与术语：section 引用、晶体学参数（Å、Kα、mm⁻¹）、校正与 DOI，以及少量物理论文元数据和商务邮件词项；没有明显统一的语义触发点。

patterns.name: “section”标题或交叉引用
patterns.context: 出现在论文正文的章节引用、章节标题或小节锚点中；有时与« graph»相邻。

patterns.name: 晶体学表格中的 Å 单位
patterns.context: 晶体学数据记录中，Å 后接数值或幂次记号；同一行常含辐射、温度和晶胞参数。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 晶体学论文的数据表

patterns.name: Kα 辐射记录
patterns.context: 出现在晶体学实验数据行，前后列有元素、吸收系数 μ、温度 T 等参数。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 晶体学论文的数据表

patterns.name: 负指数长度单位 mm⁻¹
patterns.context: 作为 μ 的单位，出现在晶体学辐射参数记录中。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 晶体学论文的数据表

patterns.name: 校正声明及文献标识符
patterns.context: 以期刊文章校正通知开头，随后出现引文和 DOI。

patterns.name: 物理论文中的 quenching 与作者信息
patterns.context: 核物理问题描述后接韩国大学地址和日期，激活分散在不同词项上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 物理论文元数据或文稿

patterns.name: 商务邮件中的 See 与署名名词
patterns.context: 邮件正文指向附件修订稿，结尾为 Regards 和 Jared 署名。

en.concept: Academic document structure markers and local fragments
en.description: Most passages activate near section markers, section numbers, cross-references, or title anchors; other activations include the compound word intersection, graph theory definitions, metadata punctuation and numbers, sporadic body words, and proper-name fragments, which cannot be fully explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Section references and numbering
patterns.context: Academic text contains section headings, tables of contents/anchors, section cross-references, or section numbers; capitalization, spacing, and numbering formats vary.

patterns.name: The word section itself
patterns.context: Occurs in a compound word or body-text term rather than a section heading; in passage 5 it refers to the intersection of geometric objects and an intersection graph.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in scientific metadata
