patterns.context: Hyphens, commas, numbers, or months occur together with neighboring fields in structured metadata such as bibliographic identifiers, addresses, or dates.

patterns.name: Other body-text terms and phrases
patterns.context: Ordinary academic words marked in the main text of different papers; their semantics and local syntax vary, with no unified specific lexical trigger condition apparent.
patterns.domain: Physics, patient studies, algorithm papers, and medical papers

patterns.name: Structural markers in titles
patterns.context: In passage 5, defining an intersection graph, activation falls on the graph theory term and its defining description; it may overlap with the section/intersection string in the same passage.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragment in acknowledgments
patterns.context: Occurs inside the proper name “Max-Planck”, not in a general section reference or body-text concept.

1_86.concept: 学术文档结构标记及局部片段
1_86.description: 多数段落在章节标记、章节编号、交叉引用或标题锚点附近激活；另有复合词intersection、图论定义、元数据标点与数字、零散正文词及专名片段，无法由单一语义模式完全解释。

patterns.name: 章节引用与编号
patterns.trigger: « Section»、«section»、«Sec»，以及邻近的数字或章节标记，如 «section»10«:»2prelims
patterns.context: 学术文本中出现章节标题、目录/锚点、章节交叉引用或章节编号；标记大小写、空格和编号格式不一。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 与 PubMed Central 论文

patterns.name: section 词语本身
patterns.context: 出现在复合词或正文术语中，而非章节标题；段5中指几何对象的交集及 intersection graph。

patterns.name: 科学元数据中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 文献标识符、地址、日期等结构化元数据中，连字符、逗号、数字或月份与邻近字段共同出现。
patterns.domain: 论文勘误、物理预印本元数据

patterns.name: 其他正文术语与短语
patterns.trigger: « quenching»、« study»、« experience»、« seek»、« objective»、« function»、« condition»
patterns.context: 不同论文正文中被标记的普通学术词语；这些词的语义和局部句法各异，未见统一的具体词汇触发条件。
patterns.domain: 物理、患者研究、算法论文及医学论文

patterns.name: 标题中的结构标记
patterns.context: 段5定义 intersection graph 时，激活落在图论术语及其定义性描述上；可能与同段的 section/intersection 字符串重叠。

patterns.name: 致谢中的专名片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名“Max-Planck”内部，而非一般章节引用或正文概念。

en.concept: Formatting and terminology fragments in scientific and technical text
en.description: Primarily responds to units, element/radiation symbols, and scientific-notation formats in crystallographic reports; also activates on local fragments in date months, paper section references, astrophysics narratives, table units, and network terminology.

patterns.name: Crystallographic parameters and unit symbols
patterns.context: Lattice parameters, radiation source, absorption coefficient, temperature, and scientific-notation numbers occur adjacent to one another in crystal structure data rows; activation often falls on symbols, units, and number-format fragments.
patterns.domain: Crystallographic paper data tables or structure reports in PubMed Central

patterns.name: Months in dates
patterns.context: A month appears in a date with a day, year, or author information; one is a paper date, the other a date in an observation log.
patterns.domain: Paper author information and astronomy observation tables

patterns.name: Letter fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activation fragments are embedded within institution names or technical abbreviations rather than being standalone words; examples include Yonsei and VLANs.
patterns.domain: Physics author affiliations; computer networking encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Paper structure section references
patterns.context: Refers to sections in a paper using Sect. or Sect. followed by a number, often near discussion, observations, or results.

patterns.name: Astrophysics terms and prose words
patterns.context: Appears in continuous academic prose describing galaxies, observations of nuclear regions, and paper results; not all triggers belong to the same narrow word class.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics paper abstracts or main text

patterns.name: Table value-column labels
patterns.context: Units or count-rate units appear in table column headings and near values in astronomy observation tables.

patterns.name: Network protocol path descriptions
patterns.context: Technical discussion of the spanning tree protocol, path forwarding, and VLANs; some trigger fragments are substrings within words.

patterns.name: Isolated table text and number formats
patterns.context: A crystallographic parameter row contains a color description or blank field, and number-format fragments activate; this partly overlaps with the other crystallographic parameter pattern.

1_86.concept: 科学技术文本中的格式与术语片段
1_86.description: 主要响应晶体学报告中的单位、元素/辐射符号及科学计数法格式；另对日期月份、论文章节引用、天体物理叙述、表格单位和网络术语中的局部片段激活。

patterns.name: 晶体学参数与单位符号
patterns.context: 晶体结构数据行中，晶格参数、辐射源、吸收系数、温度及科学计数法数值相邻出现；激活常落在符号、单位及数字格式片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的晶体学论文数据表或结构报告

patterns.name: 日期中的月份
patterns.context: 月份出现在带有日、年或作者信息的日期中；一个为论文日期，一个为观测记录表中的日期。
patterns.domain: 论文作者信息与天文观测表

patterns.name: 专名内部的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活片段嵌在机构名或技术缩写内部，而非独立词；分别见 Yonsei 与 VLANs。
patterns.domain: 物理作者地址；计算机网络百科文本

patterns.name: 论文结构标题引用
patterns.context: 以 Sect. 或 Sect.加编号引用论文中的章节，周围常有讨论、观察或结果等行文。

patterns.name: 天体物理术语与行文词
patterns.trigger: « properties»、« extinction»、« analyzed»、« detail»、« show»、« results»
patterns.context: 出现在描述星系、核区观测及论文结果的连续学术叙述中；不都由同一窄词类触发。
patterns.domain: 天体物理论文摘要或正文

patterns.name: 表格数值列标签
patterns.context: 单位或计数率单位出现在天文观测表的列标题、数值附近。

patterns.name: 网络协议路径描述
patterns.context: 讨论生成树协议、路径转发及 VLAN 的技术说明；触发片段部分是词内子串。

patterns.name: 孤立的表格文本与数值格式
patterns.context: 结构参数行中夹有颜色描述或空白字段，且数值格式片段激活；与其余晶体学参数模式部分重叠。

en.concept: beauty vocabulary and a few instances of involved
en.description: Strongly responds primarily to the English word beauty, covering different referents such as beauty products, nature, experiences, ethnic groups, mythology, and art; two other segments mark involved in different contexts. The triggering substring is the same, but the semantics and contexts differ.

patterns.name: The word beauty
patterns.context: The English noun beauty itself is marked; it often appears in of beauty or before a comma, and also directly in contexts involving industries and natural landscapes. Its specific referent may be beauty products, a social networking site, nature, an experience, an ethnic group, a mythological figure, or an artistic work.
patterns.domain: Various genres: business, biography, online discussion, product promotion, reviews, history, mythology, and art

patterns.name: involved in a machine-learning context
patterns.context: Appears in the expression “you're involved with machine learning”; activation falls on involved, while learning in the same sentence is unmarked.

patterns.name: involved in a startup Q&A context
patterns.context: Appears in “there is no salary involved,” describing an unpaid startup employment arrangement.

1_379.description: 主要对英文 beauty 一词强烈响应，涵盖美妆、自然、体验、民族、神话及艺术等不同所指；另两段在不同语境中标记 involved，触发子串相同但语义和上下文不同。

patterns.name: beauty 一词
patterns.context: 英文名词 beauty 本身被标记；多处位于 of beauty 或 beauty 后接逗号，也有直接接在行业、自然景观等语境中。具体所指可为美妆、社交网站、自然、体验、民族、神话人物或艺术创作。
patterns.domain: 多种文体：商业、人物传记、网络讨论、产品宣传、评论、历史、神话与艺术

patterns.name: 机器学习语境中的 involved
patterns.context: 出现在“you're involved with machine learning”这一表达中；激活落在 involved，而同句的 learning 未标记。

patterns.name: 创业问答语境中的 involved
patterns.context: 出现在“there is no salary involved”中，描述无薪酬的创业雇佣安排。

en.description: Strongly activates mainly on the word beauty, covering the beauty industry and descriptions of beauty in people, nature, culture, mythology, art, and experiences. It also strongly activates on involved (participating, pertaining) in two passages, with no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: beauty meaning aesthetic beauty
patterns.context: Used as a noun for the beauty of appearance, natural landscapes, art, or culture; may occur in constructions such as of beauty and beauty of..., or refer to the good qualities of an experience or thing.
patterns.domain: Beauty, social media, travel and lifestyle, history and culture, mythology, art, and other genres

patterns.name: Industry context related to beauty
patterns.context: “beauty” refers to the beauty industry or cosmetics; activation falls on beauty, not only on its abstract aesthetic sense.
patterns.domain: Introductions to the beauty industry or texts about personal-care products

patterns.name: involved in a machine-learning context
patterns.context: Occurs in “If you're involved with machine learning,” meaning participating in a field; beauty does not appear in the passage.

patterns.name: involved in a startup Q&A context
patterns.context: Occurs in “when there is no salary involved,” meaning pertaining to salary or compensation arrangements; beauty does not appear in the passage.

1_379.description: 主要对 beauty 一词强烈激活，涵盖美容产业及对人、自然、文化、神话、艺术和体验之美的描述；另在两段中对 involved（参与、涉及）强激活，缺少明显共同语义。

patterns.name: beauty 表示审美之美
patterns.context: 作为名词表示外貌、自然景观、艺术或文化的美；可出现在 of beauty、beauty of... 等结构，也可指体验、事物的美好之处。
patterns.domain: 美容、社交媒体、旅游与生活、历史文化、神话、艺术等多种文体

patterns.name: 与 beauty 相关的行业语境
patterns.context: “beauty”指美容产业或美妆领域；激活落在 beauty，而非仅限抽象审美含义。
patterns.domain: 美容行业介绍或个人护理产品相关文本

patterns.name: 机器学习语境中的 involved
patterns.context: 出现在“If you're involved with machine learning”中，指参与某领域；该段未出现 beauty。

patterns.name: 创业问答语境中的 involved
patterns.context: 出现在“when there is no salary involved”中，指涉及薪酬或薪酬安排；该段未出现 beauty。

en.concept: Surface features of beauty and involved
en.description: Most strong activations fall on beauty: it refers both to the beauty industry and to beauty in appearance, scenery, experiences, peoples, deities, or art. Two others fall on involved, referring respectively to participating in machine learning and to compensation arrangements.

patterns.name: beauty in beauty-related senses
patterns.context: The surface form beauty appears in beauty-industry, appearance, or aesthetic senses; it can be a noun and also appears in the fixed phrase “beauty of …”
patterns.domain: Beauty industry, biographies, social networks, travel experiences, history and culture, mythology, art criticism

patterns.name: involved in a machine-learning context
patterns.context: Describes participation in machine learning; activation is on involved, not on the subsequent TensorFlow or Windows in the same passage.

patterns.name: involved in a hiring/compensation context
patterns.context: Asks how much equity a first engineer should receive when there is no salary; involved means pertaining to or included in the arrangement.

1_379.concept: beauty 与 involved 的词面特征
1_379.description: 多数强激活落在 beauty：既指美容行业，也指外貌、景致、体验、民族、神祇或艺术之美。另有两处落在 involved，分别指参与机器学习及薪酬安排中的涉及。

patterns.name: beauty 相关词义中的 beauty
patterns.trigger: «beauty»10、«beauty»9；另有«beauty»10, health；«beauty»9, power and life changing experience
patterns.context: 词面 beauty 在美容、外貌或审美意义下出现；可作名词，也出现在固定搭配“beauty of …”中
patterns.domain: 美容行业、人物履历、社交网络、旅游体验、历史文化、神话、艺术评论

patterns.name: 机器学习语境中的 involved
patterns.context: 形容参与机器学习；激活位置是 involved，而不是同段后续的 TensorFlow 或 Windows

patterns.name: 招聘/薪酬语境中的 involved
patterns.context: 询问没有薪水时，首位工程师应获得多少股权；involved 表示涉及或参与

en.concept: Lexical triggers related to beauty and participation
en.description: The strongest and recurring pattern is the token beauty: it activates in texts from multiple domains discussing beauty, attractiveness, or the value of beauty. There are also two instances of activation on involved, concerning participation in machine learning and an unpaid arrangement, respectively; the contexts differ.

patterns.name: General use of beauty
patterns.context: The noun beauty appears in sentences describing beauty, aesthetics, or attractiveness; it may modify industries, communities, social networks, experiences, countries, artworks, or deities.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including beauty and health, community introductions, personal experiences, historical reviews, art, and mythology

patterns.name: involved in a machine-learning context
patterns.context: Appears in a conditional sentence asking whether the reader participates in a field, followed by “with machine learning”.

patterns.name: involved in an employment / compensation context
patterns.context: Modifies “salary” in a question about equity for a startup's first engineer, expressing an arrangement with no salary.

1_379.concept: 涉及美与参与的词汇触发
1_379.description: 最强且反复的模式是词元 beauty：多领域文本中谈及美感、美貌或美的价值时激活。另有两例在 involved 一词上激活，分别涉及参与机器学习和无薪酬安排，语境彼此不同。

patterns.name: beauty 的一般性使用
patterns.context: 名词 beauty 出现在描述美、美感或美貌的句子中；修饰对象可以是产业、社群、社交网络、体验、国家、艺术作品或神祇。
patterns.domain: 美容与健康、社群介绍、个人体验、历史评论、艺术和神话等多种文体

patterns.name: 机器学习语境中的 involved
patterns.context: 出现在询问读者是否参与某领域的条件句中，后接“with machine learning”。
patterns.domain: 技术教程／机器学习博客

patterns.name: 雇佣／薪酬语境中的 involved
patterns.context: 修饰“salary”，出现在创业公司首位工程师股权的问句中，表达没有薪水的安排。
patterns.domain: 创业公司／技术论坛讨论

en.description: Most passages strongly activate on beauty/Beauties, covering contexts involving beauty, cosmetics, nature, art, people, and abstract experiences, with a broad semantic range. The sixth passage contains only involved and machine learning, which cannot be explained as part of the main pattern.

patterns.name: The word beauty and its semantic associations
patterns.context: The word occurs in statements about beauty, attractiveness, or aesthetic value, and can refer to natural scenery, artworks, people, or abstract experiences. The second passage also uses it in a beauty-industry context.
patterns.domain: Beauty and health, social media, nature and travel, art, fashion, history, and biographies

patterns.name: involved in a machine-learning context
patterns.context: The opening of a technical tutorial introduces whether readers are involved in machine learning; beauty does not appear in this passage, and the trigger has no clear shared pattern with the others.

patterns.name: Unclear isolated trigger
patterns.context: The main feature shared across passages is the word beauty, but its referents and genres vary widely; beyond that, a unified semantic condition should not be inferred.

1_379.description: 多数段落在 beauty/Beauties 一词处强激活，涵盖美容、自然、艺术、人物与抽象体验等语境，语义跨度较大；第6段仅见 involved 与机器学习，无法与主模式解释为同一触发。

patterns.name: beauty 一词及其语义关联
patterns.context: 该词出现在有关美、吸引力或审美价值的陈述中，可指自然景观、艺术作品、人物或抽象体验；第2段还出现在美容行业语境中。
patterns.domain: 美容与健康、社交媒体、自然与旅游、艺术、时尚、历史与人物介绍

patterns.name: 机器学习语境中的 involved
patterns.context: 技术教程开头介绍读者是否涉足机器学习；此段未出现 beauty，触发词与其他段落的共同模式不明。

patterns.name: 无法确定的孤立触发
patterns.trigger: “beauty”在其他段落中的用法各异；无足够证据确定额外的独立触发模式。
patterns.context: 各段的共同点主要是 beauty 一词，但其指涉和文体跨度很大；除此之外不宜推断统一语义条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across the code identifier HM, the word involved, beauty, and a subword fragment within psychiatry; the first three categories each recur locally but have no unified semantics. No clear corresponding trigger appears in the PubMed samples.

patterns.name: HM code identifier
patterns.context: An uppercase identifier fragment in code, often surrounded by camel case or all-uppercase identifiers; both segments occur in Windows/display-related C code.

patterns.name: involved
patterns.context: The trigger is involved, appearing respectively in “no salary involved” and in “involved with/in” constructions; the latter refers to participation in machine learning or biosynthesis, or association with depression.
patterns.domain: Forum articles, machine-learning tutorials, PubMed/NIH academic abstracts

patterns.name: beauty
patterns.context: beauty appears in an introduction to the personal care industry and in a journalist's career history, where it is listed alongside health, nutrition, and fitness.
patterns.domain: Business introduction, biography / news career profile

patterns.name: beauty industry adjacent topic
patterns.context: A subword fragment in psychia-try occurs in a behavioral psychologist context after a title; it has no clear lexical or syntactic connection to the other triggers.

1_379.description: 激活分散于代码标识符 HM、词 involved、beauty，以及 psychiatry 的词内片段；前三类各有局部重复，但彼此无统一语义。PubMed 样本未见明确对应触发。

patterns.name: HM 代码标识符
patterns.context: 作为代码中的大写标识符片段，周围常有驼峰命名或全大写标识符；两段都处于 Windows/显示器相关 C 代码中。

patterns.name: involved
patterns.context: 触发词为 involved，分别出现在“no salary involved”和“involved with/in”结构中；后者表示参与机器学习、生物合成或与抑郁相关。
patterns.domain: 论坛文章、机器学习教程、PubMed/NIH 学术摘要

patterns.name: beauty
patterns.context: beauty 出现在个人护理行业介绍及记者职业经历中，后者与健康、营养、健身并列。
patterns.domain: 商业介绍、人物传记/新闻职业简介

patterns.name: beauty industry adjacent topic
patterns.context: psychia-try 的词内片段出现在标题后的行为心理学家语境；与其他触发词没有明显词义或句法联系。

en.description: Activation is scattered across the year 1956, the case-sensitive substring HM, the phrase Concert, and subword fragments in psychiatrist(s) and STRANGERS; each depends on different surface forms or local contexts, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Year 1956
patterns.context: The year appears in a television program title or a person's birth information.

patterns.name: Uppercase HM substring
patterns.context: The uppercase letter sequence HM appears in a flag field, identifier, code, or medical text; it may be joined to following characters.
patterns.domain: Code, medical abstracts, database gene names

patterns.name: Concert phrase
patterns.context: In and around the phrase “One Love Reggae Peace Concert History”.

patterns.name: psychiatrist(s)
patterns.context: The word psychiatrist(s) appears in texts about behavior, interviews, or interdisciplinary collaboration.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in STRANGERS
patterns.context: Activation falls on a contiguous fragment within STRANGERS in the all-uppercase title “CANDY WITH STRANGERS”.

1_379.description: 激活模式分散：年份1956、大小写敏感的HM子串、Concert短语、psychiatrist(s)及STRANGERS词内片段；各自依赖不同的词面或局部语境，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 年份 1956
patterns.context: 年份出现在电视节目标题或人物出生信息中

patterns.name: 大写 HM 子串
patterns.context: 大写字母串 HM 出现在标志字段、标识符、代码或医学文本中；可与后续字符连在一起
patterns.domain: 代码、医学摘要、数据库基因名

patterns.name: Concert 短语
patterns.context: 短语“One Love Reggae Peace Concert History”及其相关叙述中

patterns.name: psychiatrist(s)
patterns.context: psychiatrist(s) 一词出现在有关行为、访谈或跨学科合作的文本中
patterns.domain: 心理健康、学术项目介绍

patterns.name: STRANGERS 的词内片段
patterns.context: 全大写标题“CANDY WITH STRANGERS”中，激活落在 STRANGERS 的连续片段上

en.description: Activation falls mainly on letter strings such as Pres and HM and a few specific fragments (1956, Arch-top, Cindy); other activations occur on various fields, proper nouns, and technical-term fragments with no obvious shared semantics, spanning multiple domains.

patterns.name: Pres substring
patterns.context: The letter string Pres appears in identifiers, configuration fields, or ordinary English words; surrounding characters vary, and all show high activation.

patterns.name: HM abbreviation
patterns.context: HM appears in medical diseases or gene/biomedical abbreviations, with neighboring characters varying by context.

patterns.name: Number 1956
patterns.context: The year appears in a historical event description in a program title.

patterns.name: Field value 0
patterns.context: Field names and their values in structured configuration or serialized text; high activation concentrates on a substring of the field name, not the numeric value.

patterns.name: Standalone title field
patterns.context: The characters HM occur in the value of a Flags field in image/font-related metadata.

patterns.name: Guitar in an instrument title
patterns.context: In a work title related to an Arch-top guitar, the Arch/top subword fragments also activate.

patterns.name: Name fragment Cindy
patterns.context: The proper noun is tokenized as C and indy, occurring in a musician's biography.

patterns.name: Other sporadic subword fragments
patterns.context: Trigger locations differ across segments, relating respectively to Fiji word forms, drug terminology, metadata/encoding fields, and texture configuration; no shared local semantic condition is apparent.

1_379.description: 激活主要落在 Pres、HM 等字母子串及少数特定片段（1956、Arch-top、Cindy）；另有多种无明显共同语义的字段、专名和术语片段，跨领域分布。

patterns.name: Preserve 子串
patterns.context: 字母子串 Pres 出现在标识符、配置字段或普通英文词中；周围字符不同，均有高激活。
patterns.domain: GitHub 配置文本、专利文本

patterns.name: HM 缩写
patterns.context: HM 出现在医学疾病或基因/生物医学缩写中，邻接字符因语境而异。

patterns.name: 数字 1956
patterns.context: 年份出现在节目标题的历史事件描述中。

patterns.name: 字段值 0
patterns.context: 结构化配置或序列化文本中的字段名及其值；高激活集中于字段名子串，而非数值。

patterns.name: 独立标题字段
patterns.context: 字符 HM 位于图像/字体相关元数据的 Flags 字段值中。

patterns.name: 乐器标题中的 Guitar
patterns.context: Arch-top guitar 相关作品标题中，Arch/top 等分词片段也激活。

patterns.name: 人名片段 Cindy
patterns.context: 专名被分词为 C 与 indy，发生在音乐家传记中。

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 各段触发位置不同，分别涉及 Fiji 词形、药物术语、元数据/编码字段和纹理配置；未见共同的局部语义条件。

en.description: Activation often falls on the letter strings onic/sonic or Ish, including medical-term endings, physics and immunology terms, proper nouns, and titles; several other activations fall inside abbreviations or technical terms, with no consistent semantic condition.

patterns.name: myotonic / dystonic-related endings
patterns.context: In medical contexts, appears in the disease name “myotonic dystrophy” or “dystonic contraction”; [1] also contains «val»5«onic»10, related to the disease name mevalonic aciduria.

patterns.name: -onic string in other words
patterns.context: The letter substrings in “π-f interaction” and “opsonic antibodies” do not clearly have the same semantic function as medical disease-name endings.

patterns.name: Ish string in names
patterns.context: Activation falls inside names or proper nouns beginning with Ish; segments include Ishihara, Kenji Ishii, Ishin...omaki, Ishkur.
patterns.domain: Patent citations, paper authors, hospital names, encyclopedia text

patterns.name: SONIC string
patterns.context: The contiguous letters Sonic occur in a name; here, it is a music title or group name, not a medical term.

patterns.name: Other instances of the consonant string onic
patterns.context: These fragments have no identifiable shared meaning or contextual trigger; activation spans different substrings within terms, abbreviations, and proper nouns.
patterns.domain: Medicine, experimental techniques, ancient Near Eastern proper nouns

1_379.description: 激活点多落在 onic/sonic 或 Ish 字母串上：包括医学术语词尾、物理和免疫术语、专名及标题；另有若干落在其他缩写或术语内部，未见一致语义条件。

patterns.name: myotonic／dystonic 相关词尾
patterns.context: 在医学语境中，出现在疾病名称“myotonic dystrophy”或“dystonic contraction”中；[1]还出现 «val»5«onic»10，与疾病名 mevalonic aciduria 相关。

patterns.name: 其他词中的 -onic 字符串
patterns.context: 分别是“π-f interaction”和“opsonic antibodies”中的字母子串，不明显具有与医学疾病词尾相同的语义功能。

patterns.name: Ish 人名字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在 Ish 开头的人名或专名内部；片段中出现 Ishihara、Kenji Ishii、Ishin...omaki、Ishkur。
patterns.domain: 专利引文、论文作者、医院名称、百科文本

patterns.name: SONIC 字符串
patterns.context: 作为名称中的连续字母 Sonic 出现；此处是音乐标题或团体名称，而非医学术语。

patterns.name: 辅音字母串 onic 的其他实例
patterns.context: 这些片段没有可确认的共同词义或上下文触发条件；激活跨越术语、缩写及专名内部的不同子串。
patterns.domain: 医学、实验技术、古代近东专名

en.description: All segments mark fragments within words beginning with mult, covering different meanings such as multisystem, multigene, multijoint, multistep, multiferroic, multisensory, multivalent, multilayer, multitemporal, and multivalued; segment 1 also marks disease and genetic words, while segments 3 and 4 contain sporadic marks.

patterns.name: Beginning of mult- compounds
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on mult-; following affixes and meanings vary. It commonly occurs inside compounds containing multi-/multi, without requiring a specific semantic category.
patterns.domain: Medical, biological, physical, psychological, remote-sensing, mathematical, and related paper abstracts

patterns.name: Description of multisystem disease
patterns.context: Multi- terms occur in disease names and descriptions of genetic or systemic degenerative diseases; marks are scattered across different words.

patterns.name: multi- gene family in a title
patterns.context: The title discusses a gene family, with multi- forming multigene.

patterns.name: Motor control terms
patterns.context: Discusses hand control, with multi- forming multijoint; a mark also falls in the preceding word musculotendon.

patterns.name: Multistep process
patterns.context: An oncology title describes a process as multistep; tobacco and other words in the same title are also marked.

patterns.name: Multiferroic materials term
patterns.context: In a materials science abstract, multi- forms multiferroic, describing the phase structure of a strained film.

patterns.name: Multisensory term
patterns.context: Discusses sensory integration in bodily self-awareness and illusion, with multi- forming multisensory.

patterns.name: Multivalent counterions
patterns.context: Multivalent counterions occur in colloidal suspensions and polyelectrolyte solutions.

patterns.name: Multilayer bilayer membrane
patterns.context: Discusses the localization and organization of vitamin K1 in DPP C multilamellar bilayer vesicles.

patterns.name: Multitemporal data
patterns.context: A remote-sensing study uses Landsat data to compare multiple time periods; the term is multitemporal.

patterns.name: Multivalued mathematical term
patterns.context: In the context of numerical methods, nonmonotone source terms, and boundary conditions, multivalued appears twice and is marked both times.

1_379.description: 全部片段都标记了以 mult 开头的词项内部片段，涵盖多系统、多基因、多关节、多阶段、多铁性、多感觉、多价、多层、多时相及多值等不同含义；段1另有疾病和遗传词标记，段3、4也有零散标记。

patterns.name: mult-复合词开头
patterns.context: 激活集中于 mult-，后续词缀和词义多样；常见于带有 multi-/multi 的复合词内部，不要求特定语义类别。
patterns.domain: 医学、生物学、物理、心理学、遥感、数学及相关论文摘要

patterns.name: 多系统疾病表述
patterns.context: 疾病名称及遗传、系统性退行性疾病描述中出现 multi- 词项；各标记分散在不同词内。

patterns.name: 标题中的 multi- 基因家族
patterns.context: 标题谈及基因家族，且 multi- 构成 multigene。

patterns.name: 运动控制词项
patterns.context: 讨论手部控制，multi- 构成 multijoint；标记也落在前面的 musculotendon 词内。

patterns.name: 多阶段过程
patterns.context: 肿瘤标题将过程描述为 multistep；同一标题另有 tobacco 等词被标记。

patterns.name: 多铁性材料词项
patterns.context: 材料科学摘要中，multi- 构成 multiferroic，描述受应变薄膜相结构。

patterns.name: 多感觉词项
patterns.context: 讨论身体自我意识及错觉的感觉整合，multi- 构成 multisensory。

patterns.name: 多价反离子
patterns.context: 胶体悬浮液和聚电解质溶液中出现 multivalent counterions。

patterns.name: 多层双层膜
patterns.context: 讨论维生素K1在DPP C多层双层囊泡中的定位和组织。

patterns.name: 多时相数据
patterns.context: 遥感研究使用 Landsat 数据比较多个时间阶段；词项为 multitemporal。

patterns.name: 多值数学项
patterns.context: 数值方法、非单调源项和边界条件语境中，multivalued 出现两次并均被标记。
patterns.domain: 数学分析 ArXiv 摘要

en.description: All segments strongly activate the word-initial fragment “Ge”, but it occurs in geographic words, names, philosophical terms, technical terms, and biological taxonomic names; a few sporadic fragment activations are specific to individual segments, with no stable commonality.

patterns.name: “Ge” fragment within words
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the word-initial fragment “Ge” with uppercase G, while the following meaning and complete spelling vary; the same fragment appears in different words, including Geografia, Geórgia, Geremek, Geistes, Gecko, Geometridae, Geographical.
patterns.domain: Across Portuguese, Italian, Spanish, German, and English, as well as structured data; genres include place names, personal names, taxonomy, technical material, and bibliographic text

patterns.name: Geographic / place-name vocabulary
patterns.context: “Ge” is at the start of geography-related words such as Geografia, Geórgia, and Geographical; however, this meaning is not required for activation.
patterns.domain: Review text, European Parliament text, place-name data

patterns.name: Geometridae moth taxonomy name
patterns.context: “Ge” begins Geometridae; it appears in descriptions of moth family names, and the same set of entries also contains other moth names without that family name.

patterns.name: Other names or terms beginning with Ge
patterns.context: The activated “Ge” continues into Geremek, Geistes, and Gecko; these words differ considerably in meaning and context.
patterns.domain: European Parliament eulogy, philosophical bibliography, Ubuntu technical forum

patterns.name: Non-Ge subword fragments in moth entries
patterns.context: In addition to the “Ge” fragment, weaker positive activations occur in species or genus names in moth entries; the fragments vary, with no stable shared word form.

patterns.name: Portuguese word-final / internal fragments
patterns.context: Several sporadic positive activation fragments occur in Portuguese sentences, including word endings, internal fragments, and ordinary function words; they do not form a unified, clear trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Spanish internal fragments
patterns.context: Several internal fragments in Spanish philosophical discussion and bibliographic citations show weak activation; no clear semantic connection to the highly activated “Ge” is apparent.

patterns.name: Other sporadic function-word or internal-word activations
patterns.context: A few segments also show sporadic low-to-moderate activations in function words, ordinary words, or internal fragments, without a discernible pattern consistent across segments.
patterns.domain: European Parliament text, technical forums, and Github JSON

1_379.description: 全部段落都强烈激活词首片段“Ge”，但其后组成地理词、人名、哲学术语、技术术语及生物分类名；另有少量段落特有的零散词片段激活，未显出稳定共性。

patterns.name: 单词内的“Ge”片段
patterns.context: 激活集中落在大小写为 G 的词首片段“Ge”，且该片段后续词义和完整拼写各异；同一片段在不同词中出现，包括 Geografia、Geórgia、Geremek、Geistes、Gecko、Geometridae、Geographical。
patterns.domain: 跨葡萄牙语、意大利语、西班牙语、德语、英语及结构化数据；涉及地名、人名、分类学、技术和书目等文体

patterns.name: 地理/地名词汇
patterns.context: “Ge”处于 Geografia、Geórgia、Geographical 等地理相关词的词首；但该词义并非激活的必要条件。
patterns.domain: 评论文本、欧洲议会文本、地名数据

patterns.name: Geometridae 蛾类分类名
patterns.context: “Ge”开启 Geometridae；出现在蛾类条目的科名描述中，且同一批条目也有不含该科名的其他蛾类名称。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科生物分类条目

patterns.name: 其他以 Ge 开头的人名或术语
patterns.context: 激活的“Ge”继续组成 Geremek、Geistes、Gecko；这些词彼此语义和上下文差异明显。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会悼词、哲学书目、Ubuntu 技术论坛

patterns.name: 蛾类条目中的非 Ge 词片段
patterns.context: 除“Ge”片段外，蛾类条目的物种名或属名中也有较弱的正激活；片段各异，未见稳定共同词形。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科生物分类条目

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词尾/词内片段
patterns.context: 葡语句子中有多个零散正激活片段，包含词尾、词内片段及普通功能成分；它们不构成统一、明确的触发模式。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语评论或引文文本

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 西语哲学论述及书目引文中的若干词内片段有弱激活；和高激活的“Ge”未见明确语义联系。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语哲学文本及书目

patterns.name: 其他零散功能词或词内激活
patterns.context: 少数段落中还出现低至中等强度的零散激活，分布于功能词、普通词或词内片段，没有跨段一致的可辨模式。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、技术论坛及 Github JSON

en.description: The most consistent cue is reference and its various collocations; Importance at the beginning of abstracts also activates strongly. A few formatting symbols and sporadic words activate as well, but vary across genres and semantics, making them difficult to explain as a unified pattern.

patterns.name: The word reference and its collocations
patterns.context: reference appears in noun phrases meaning clinical terminology standards, reference values, a reference for something, a book's purpose, a discussion link, or a reference between code objects; its referents and collocations vary considerably.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, medical papers, general expository prose, Hacker News, StackExchange

patterns.name: Importance heading and word form
patterns.context: The Importance label at the start of an abstract or project record, or a heading-like opening such as Importance of a topic; activation falls on the latter part of Importance.
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter project records, PubMed abstracts

patterns.name: Numeric and heading-separator markers
patterns.context: Structural markers, separator lines, or line breaks after the INTRODUCTION heading in medical papers; activation is relatively weak.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on specific vocabulary
patterns.context: These words occur in local contexts across different passages, without an obvious shared meaning, syntactic position, or stable collocation; they should not be grouped into a unified trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Medicine, medical interpreting, health-related texts, online forums, and Q&A

1_379.description: 最稳定的线索是 reference 及其多种搭配；另对摘要开头的 Importance 有强激活。少数格式符号和零散词也激活，但跨文体、语义不一，难以解释为统一模式。

patterns.name: reference 一词及其搭配
patterns.context: reference 出现在名词短语中，表示临床术语标准、参考值、某事项的参考、书籍用途、讨论链接或代码对象间的引用；所指和搭配差异很大。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、医学论文、一般说明文、HackerNews、StackExchange

patterns.name: Importance 标题及词形
patterns.context: 摘要或项目记录开头的 Importance 标签，或 Importance of 某主题的标题式开头；激活落在 Importance 的后半部分。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 项目记录、PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: 数字与标题分隔标记
patterns.context: 医学论文中 INTRODUCTION 标题后的结构标记、分隔线或换行处；激活强度较低。

patterns.name: 特定词汇的零散激活
patterns.context: 这些词分别处于各段局部语境中，没有明显共同的词义、句法位置或稳定搭配；不宜归并成统一触发条件。
patterns.domain: 医学、医疗口译、健康类文本、网络论坛及问答

en.description: Primarily responds to coordinate, covering uses involving care coordination, coordinating organizations, database updates and communication, as well as structures and coordinate systems; it also responds to windows in different senses and activates in a set of greatest-common-divisor Q&A items.

patterns.name: Coordinate, organize, or relate objects
patterns.context: Involves coordinating care, organizations or database updates, communication, and structures or coordinate systems made up of multiple aspects; [1], [2], [3], [6], [9], [10]
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, language services, software and networking, text analysis, SVG programming

patterns.name: Window-related terms
patterns.context: Refers respectively to software display windows, Windows services, and the Windows operating system; the meanings differ, but all include windows.
patterns.domain: Bioinformatics software, StackExchange programming Q&A, Ubuntu IRC

patterns.name: Greatest common divisor Q&A format
patterns.context: Lists math problems consecutively with short answers; no coordinate or windows appears.

1_379.description: 主要响应 coordinate，覆盖协调照护、协调机构、数据库更新与通信，以及结构和坐标系统等用法；另响应不同语义下的 windows，且在一组最大公约数问答中激活。

patterns.name: 协调、组织或关联对象
patterns.context: 涉及协调照护、机构或数据库更新、通信，以及由多个方面组成的结构或坐标系统；[1]、[2]、[3]、[6]、[9]、[10]
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、语言服务、软件与网络、文本分析、SVG 编程

patterns.name: 窗口相关词
patterns.trigger: «windows»（[5] 的“display windows”，[7] 的“C# windows service”，[8] 的“windows 7”）
patterns.context: 分别指软件显示窗口、Windows 服务和 Windows 操作系统；含义不同，但都出现 windows
patterns.domain: 生物信息学软件、StackExchange 编程问答、Ubuntu IRC

patterns.name: 最大公约数问答格式
patterns.trigger: 重复出现的问句“greatest common divisor”及其数值例题
patterns.context: 连续列举数学题及简短答案；未见 coordinate 或 windows

en.concept: Word forms and specific lexical triggers
en.description: Primarily activates on coordinate and its word forms, as well as subword fragments of Importance; also activates on paper-heading format markers, vital, and windows in a software context.

patterns.name: Morphological variants of coordinate
patterns.context: Trigger words occur in contexts describing the coordination, organization, or arrangement of work, services, or information; common collocates include care, updates, partners, results, and information.
patterns.domain: Medical services research, language services, software/databases, research management

patterns.name: Subword fragments of importance
patterns.context: The word importance or its tokenized fragments, often appearing at the start of a title or section heading.
patterns.domain: Research grant abstracts, paper titles and section headings

patterns.name: Heading hierarchy and formatting markers
patterns.context: Structural paper headings and subsequent line breaks or equals-sign heading separators; the passage also contains «Importance» in a theoretical title.

patterns.name: Specific lexical trigger vital
patterns.context: Occurs in the dental paper title “Current concepts in vital pulpotomies in primary teeth”; isolated from the other activation patterns.

patterns.name: Words related to display windows
patterns.context: Refers to the sequence display window in molecular graphics software; nearby text describes graphics rendering, alignment editing, and tools.

1_379.description: 主要对 coordinate 及其词形、Importance 的词形片段激活；另对论文标题格式标记、vital 和软件语境中的 windows 激活。

patterns.name: coordinate 的形态变体
patterns.context: 触发词出现在描述协调、组织或安排工作/服务/信息的语境中；常与 care、updates、partners、results、information 等搭配。
patterns.domain: 医学服务研究、语言服务、软件/数据库、科研管理

patterns.name: importance 的词形片段
patterns.context: importance 一词或其被分词的片段，常出现在标题或小节标题开头。
patterns.domain: 科研资助摘要、论文标题与章节标题

patterns.name: 标题层级与格式标记
patterns.context: 论文结构标题及其后的换行、等号式标题分隔符；该段同时含有理论标题中的«Importance»。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文的 Markdown/纯文本格式

patterns.name: vital 的特定词汇触发
patterns.context: 出现在牙科论文标题“Current concepts in vital pulpotomies in primary teeth”中；孤立于其他激活模式。

patterns.name: 显示窗口相关词
patterns.context: 指分子图形软件中的序列显示窗口；附近描述图形渲染、比对编辑与工具。
patterns.domain: 生物信息学软件项目描述

en.description: Activations are scattered across papers, medical abstracts, project text, business discussions, philosophy, and code: these include expressions of research focus or current status such as focus/Current/Importance, as well as local terms such as vital, light, age, and kind reference, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Core terms in research titles
patterns.context: In title-like phrases, activation falls on the words “Importance” and “Guarantee”; section headings and Markdown heading formats surround them.

patterns.name: Ontology and importance / integrity
patterns.context: When discussing the creation, simplification, or application of ontologies, activation occurs on “focus” and expressions related to importance and integrity.

patterns.name: CSS font-weight word light
patterns.context: In a Tailwind CSS @apply style class, “light” after the hyphen is marked; other style tokens in the same segment do not show the same activation.

patterns.name: Medical term vital
patterns.context: In a dental medicine phrase, the adjective “vital” is marked, referring to pulpotomy of a primary tooth.

patterns.name: Focus in a research plan
patterns.context: In a project description sentence, “focus,” meaning the research emphasis, is activated.

patterns.name: light in a neural network model name
patterns.context: In a citation or model name related to a 3D CNN, “light” is marked as part of the model name.

patterns.name: age in a list of diversity dimensions
patterns.context: In a discussion of organizational diversity, “age” is marked when listing dimensions such as gender, age, and region.

patterns.name: Kind reference in philosophy
patterns.context: When discussing entities, existence, and related topics in philosophy of language, “reference” in the term “kind reference” activates.

patterns.name: Aging and age-related research
patterns.context: When describing normal aging and age-related neurodegenerative diseases, age-related words are marked.

patterns.name: Current and focus in a sleep disorder
patterns.context: In a sleep monitoring analysis abstract, “Current” and the expression “focus” for the research topic are marked.

1_379.description: 激活分散于论文、医学摘要、项目文本、商业论述、哲学及代码中：包括 focus/Current/Importance 等研究重点或现状表达，也包括 vital、light、age、kind reference 等局部术语，未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 研究标题中的核心术语
patterns.context: 标题式短语中，激活落在“Importance”及“Guarantee”等词；周围有章节标题和 Markdown 标题格式。

patterns.name: ontology 与重要性/完整性
patterns.trigger: “focus on very important aspect of ontology completeness”
patterns.context: 谈及本体的创建、简化或应用时，对“focus”及重要性、完整性相关表达激活。

patterns.name: CSS 字体粗细词 light
patterns.context: Tailwind CSS 的 @apply 样式类中，连字符后的“light”被标记；同段其他样式 token 未呈现相同激活。

patterns.name: 医学术语 vital
patterns.context: 牙科医学短语中，形容词“vital”被标记，指乳牙活髓切断术。

patterns.name: 研究计划中的 focus
patterns.context: 项目描述句中，表示研究重点的“focus”被激活。

patterns.name: 神经网络模型名中的 light
patterns.context: 3D CNN 相关论文的引文或模型名称中，“light”作为模型名组成部分被标记。

patterns.name: 多样性类型列举中的 age
patterns.context: 组织多样性论述中，在列举性别、年龄、地域等维度时，“age”被标记。

patterns.name: 哲学中的 kind reference
patterns.context: 语言哲学讨论实体、存在等议题时，术语“kind reference”中的“reference”激活。

patterns.name: 衰老及年龄相关研究
patterns.context: 描述正常衰老过程和年龄相关神经退行性疾病时，“age”相关词被标记。
patterns.domain: NIH 神经生物学项目摘要

patterns.name: 睡眠疾病中的 current 与 focus
patterns.context: 睡眠监测分析摘要中，“Current”和研究关注表达“focus”被标记。

en.concept: Suffix of importance and miscellaneous subwords
en.description: The most consistent cue is importance and its suffix ance, found in medical texts, papers, and test code. Other activations are scattered across document headings, Rust/CSS code, Italian policy text, design commentary, and academic vocabulary, with no single clear shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: Suffix/subword of importance
patterns.context: The word importance is split into multiple tokens; activation concentrates on the suffix ance. Common contexts include phrases such as Importance of, Variable Importance, and importance and specificity, as well as test names.

patterns.name: Heading hierarchy and section markers
patterns.context: Introduction/Background headings and their Markdown-like separator lines in papers or technical documents.

patterns.name: Rust serialization code
patterns.context: A Rust use declaration contains serde::{Serialize, Des...}; activation falls on a subword fragment of serde.

patterns.name: Frontend style class names
patterns.context: Typography and color class names appear next to each other in a CSS/Tailwind-style @apply rule.

patterns.name: Cross-border and payment-related terms
patterns.context: An Italian European Parliament text discusses cross-border credit, the free circulation of payment instructions, and obstacles to it; activation is scattered across subwords of several words.

patterns.name: Elegant and simple design
patterns.context: A comment argues for avoiding complexity and keeping things simple, and evaluates the elegance of the design and implementation.

patterns.name: Numeric and table test code
patterns.context: A test named Variable Importance table follows a list of test data; activation involves both numeric fragments and importance.

patterns.name: Sporadic subwords of English terms and general academic vocabulary
patterns.context: Local activations on subwords of technical or ordinary words in academic texts; apart from importance, they lack shared context.

1_379.description: 最稳定的线索是 importance 及其词尾 ance，见于医学、论文与测试代码；其余激活分散在文档标题、Rust/CSS 代码、意大利语政策文本、设计评论及学术词语中，未见单一明确的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: importance 的词尾/子词
patterns.context: 词语 importance 被拆成多个 token；激活集中在词尾 ance，常见于短语 Importance of、Variable Importance、importance and specificity 等，也出现在测试名称中

patterns.name: 标题层级与分节标记
patterns.context: 论文或技术文档中，Introduction/Background 标题及其 Markdown/类 Markdown 分隔线

patterns.name: Rust 序列化代码
patterns.context: Rust 的 use 声明中出现 serde::{Serialize, Des...}；激活落在 serde 的分词片段

patterns.name: 前端样式类名
patterns.context: CSS/Tailwind 风格的 @apply 规则中，排版与颜色类名相邻

patterns.name: 跨境与支付相关词语
patterns.context: 意大利语欧盟议会文本，讨论跨境信贷、支付指令自由流通及其障碍；激活分散在多种词的子词上

patterns.name: 优雅与简洁设计
patterns.context: 评论中主张避开复杂性、保持简单，并评价设计与实现的优雅

patterns.name: 数字与表格测试代码
patterns.context: 测试数据列表后出现 Variable Importance table 的测试名称；激活同时涉及数字片段和 importance

patterns.name: 英文术语与一般学术词汇的零散子词
patterns.context: 学术文本中术语或普通词被拆分后的局部激活；除 importance 外缺少共同上下文

en.description: Activation concentrates on specific endings of several technical terms, such as «ance» in Importance and «old» in threshold. Other activations occur on web-navigation terms, elegance in a simple-design context, and use in code import statements. Overall, technical-text word-form fragments predominate.

patterns.name: Importance ending
patterns.context: The word Importance or Variable Importance appears in a title, metric name, test name, or body text; activation concentrates on the ending fragment «ance».
patterns.domain: Academic papers, code, and popular-science texts

patterns.name: threshold ending
patterns.context: threshold appears in contexts such as measurement methods, genetic distance, or statistical modeling; activation falls on the ending fragment.
patterns.domain: Patents, life sciences, and machine-learning papers

patterns.name: Web navigation and search
patterns.context: Describes users browsing a site via web links or entering keywords to search within the site; several related words activate.

patterns.name: Elegance in simple design
patterns.context: The elegant result that comes from avoiding complexity and keeping design and implementation simple is discussed.

patterns.name: Serialized code fragment
patterns.context: Appears at the start of import statements resembling Rust’s use serde::...; strong activation falls mainly on use.

1_379.description: 激活集中于若干技术词的特定词尾，如 Importance 的 ance、threshold 的 old；另有网页导航词、简单设计语境中的 elegance，以及代码导入语句的 use。整体以技术文本中的词形片段为主。

patterns.name: Importance 词尾
patterns.context: 词语 Importance 或 Variable Importance 出现在标题、指标名称、测试名称或正文中；激活集中在词尾片段 «ance»。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、代码与科普文本

patterns.name: threshold 词尾
patterns.context: threshold 出现在测量方法、遗传距离或统计建模等语境中，激活在词尾片段。
patterns.domain: 专利、生命科学与机器学习论文

patterns.name: 网页导航与搜索
patterns.context: 描述用户通过网页链接浏览站点，或输入关键词进行站内搜索；多个相关词均有激活。

patterns.name: 简单设计中的优雅
patterns.context: 讨论避免复杂性、保持设计与实现简单后产生的优雅效果。
patterns.domain: 技术评论或 HackerNews 帖文

patterns.name: 序列化代码片段
patterns.context: 出现在类似 Rust 的 use serde::... 导入语句开头；强激活主要落在 use。

en.description: Activations do not reflect a single semantic feature: they occur on subword fragments of entered, Rust imports, Italian impedire, adaptive, elegance, the name Emms, and Portuguese continuar. These span different fields and vary in form and meaning.

patterns.name: Initial fragment in the English word “entered”
patterns.context: In English sentences, indicates that information, results, or keywords were entered; activation falls on entered.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A and patent technical descriptions

patterns.name: Rust serialization import syntax
patterns.context: A Rust use import statement followed by the serde path and identifiers such as Serialize.

patterns.name: Stem of the Italian verb impedire
patterns.context: An inflected form of the Italian verb impedire, meaning “to prevent”; activation concentrates on the stem imped.

patterns.name: adaptive in learning/adaptation contexts
patterns.context: adaptive modifies learning experiences or responses to situations; nearby words include context, experience, or coping.
patterns.domain: Educational encyclopedia and health research abstracts

patterns.name: The stem fragment eleg in the abstract noun elegance
patterns.context: An English comment discusses the simplicity and elegance of a design and implementation; activation falls on the stem fragment eleg in elegance.

patterns.name: Internal fragment Em in a proper name
patterns.context: A token fragment in the name John Emms, with the strongest activation in the middle of the surname.

patterns.name: Stem of the Portuguese verb continuar
patterns.context: A Portuguese verb meaning “to continue,” used in a statement about whether something will prevent people from continuing.

1_379.description: 激活并非单一语义特征：分别出现在 entered、Rust 导入、意大利语 impedire、adaptive、elegance、人名 Emms 和葡萄牙语 continuar 等词片段上；跨领域且词形、语义各异。

patterns.name: 英语词内的词首片段“entered”
patterns.context: 在英语句子中，表示信息、结果或关键词被输入；激活落在 entered 上。
patterns.domain: 编程问答与专利技术描述

patterns.name: Rust 序列化导入语法
patterns.context: Rust 代码中 use 导入语句，后接 serde 路径及 Serialize 等标识符。

patterns.name: 意大利语动词 impedire 的词干
patterns.context: 意大利语句中表示“阻止”的动词 impedire 的变位形式；激活集中在词干 imped。

patterns.name: adaptive 及其学习/应对语境
patterns.context: adaptive 修饰学习体验或情境应对，附近出现 context、experience 或 coping。
patterns.domain: 教育类百科与健康研究摘要

patterns.name: 抽象名词的词尾 elegance
patterns.context: 英语评论中谈设计与实现的简洁和优雅；激活落在 elegance 的词干片段 eleg。

patterns.name: 人名内部片段 Em
patterns.context: 人名 John Emms 的分词片段，最强激活在姓氏中间部分。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语 continuar 的词干
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句中表示“继续”的动词，出现在关于某种用法是否会阻止人们继续的表达中。

en.description: The strongest activations are scattered across varied terms and contexts: touch-related words are the only recurring surface pattern, but they occur with different meanings; other activations fall on entered, turning, adaptive, age, and the French fragment v, with no shared syntactic or thematic condition.

patterns.name: touch-related vocabulary
patterns.context: The literal word touch appears with instrumental intimacy, sensitive display, friendly UI, zooming, and ups; no single meaning or syntactic position is required.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, patents, technology discussions, HTML comments, software Q&A

patterns.name: entered followed by into
patterns.context: Describes usernames and passwords being entered into a form; activation falls on entered.

patterns.name: turning followed by an age
patterns.context: In an informal personal post, turning means about to reach a certain age.

patterns.name: adaptive followed by learning experience
patterns.context: An educational discussion describes an adaptive learning experience based on the current context.

patterns.name: age followed by enlightenment
patterns.context: The fixed expression an age of enlightenment refers to a research field potentially entering a new phase.

patterns.name: French word-internal fragment v
patterns.context: A token or subword fragment in a French parliamentary speech; the local context is insufficient to determine the word form or semantic trigger.

1_379.description: 最强激活分散在多种词项和语境：touch 相关词是唯一重复的表面模式，但出现于不同语义中；其余激活分别落在 entered、turning、adaptive、age 及法语片段 v，未见共同句法或主题条件。

patterns.name: touch 相关词汇
patterns.context: 字面出现 touch，分别搭配 instrumental intimacy、sensitive display、friendly UI、zooming、ups；并不要求同一含义或句法位置。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、专利、科技讨论、HTML 注释、软件问答

patterns.name: entered 后接 into
patterns.context: 描述用户名和密码被输入表单，激活落在 entered。

patterns.name: turning 后接年龄
patterns.context: 个人口语式发帖中，turning 表示即将年满某岁。

patterns.name: adaptive 后接 learning experience
patterns.context: 教育论述中描述基于当前情境的自适应学习体验。

patterns.name: age 后接 enlightenment
patterns.context: 固定表达 an age of enlightenment，指研究领域可能进入新阶段。
patterns.domain: 研究论文/机构声明相关文本

patterns.name: 法语词内片段 v
patterns.trigger: «v»10，位于 prop«res» m«ots» 之后、nous« dev» 之前
patterns.context: 法语议会发言的分词或子词片段；局部上下文不足以确定词形或语义触发条件。

en.concept: Expressions related to state transitions and goals
en.description: Activations occur in contexts involving entering a system or state, goals and specifications, functionality, and operation. They also often fall on common function words and internal subword fragments; the varied corpora and genres make it difficult to reduce them to a single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Entering/joining a target container
patterns.context: Indicates information, users, or content entering a container, system, or state; in login contexts, specifically means entering credentials.

patterns.name: Goals, visions, or direction
patterns.context: Used with for, in, and similar words to mark an intended goal, historical period, operating mode, or screen specification; the trigger contexts are not entirely consistent semantically.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, medicine, patents, and Q&A texts

patterns.name: Expressing, presenting, or functioning
patterns.context: Expressions concerning function, device operation, or addressing an audience; activation may fall on ordinary verbs or subwords within nouns.

patterns.name: Weak activation on function words and subwords in collocations
patterns.context: Highlights fall on common function words or fragments within words, without a stable and consistent local semantic condition.

1_379.concept: 状态转换与目标相关表达
1_379.description: 激活分布在进入系统或状态、目标与规格、功能和运行等语境，也常落在常见功能词及词内子片段；跨语料文体，难以归结为单一语义触发。

patterns.name: 进入/加入目标容器
patterns.context: 表示信息、用户或内容进入某个容器、系统或状态；在登录语境中尤指输入凭据。

patterns.name: 目标、愿景或方向
patterns.context: 与 for、in 等搭配，标示预期目标、时代阶段、操作方式或屏幕规格；触发处语义并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 百科、医学、专利及问答文本

patterns.name: 表达、呈现或发挥作用
patterns.trigger: « feature»；« operate»；« address»（法语分词片段 «ress»）
patterns.context: 围绕功能、设备工作或面向听众讲话的表述；激活可落在普通动词或名词内部子词上。

patterns.name: 搭配中的弱功能词与子词激活
patterns.trigger: « the»、« is»、« be»、« in»、« and» 等
patterns.context: 高亮落在常见功能词，或单词内部的片段；没有稳定且一致的局部语义条件。

en.description: Activations often fall on word fragments created by model tokenization, especially “ync” in English idiosyncrasies and “o” in Emoji; Portuguese and French fragments in European Parliament texts, as well as biographical names and birth information, also occur, with no consistent semantics across passages.

patterns.name: “emoji” word-internal segmentation
patterns.context: Emoji appears in an English title or CSS font name; activation falls on multiple subword fragments of the word, especially “o”.

patterns.name: “idiosyncrasies” word-internal segmentation
patterns.context: idiosyncrasies appears in English; activation concentrates on the “ync” fragment.

patterns.name: European Parliament multilingual token fragments
patterns.context: In European Parliament texts, activation falls on model-split word fragments; the forms and meanings vary, with no clear shared semantics.
patterns.domain: EuroParl Portuguese and French formal debates

patterns.name: Local fragments in names and dates
patterns.context: In biographical entries, activations occur on fragments in birth information and chess-player names; the strongest position is the final surname segment “ms”.

1_379.description: 激活多落在模型切分后的词片段，尤其是英文 idiosyncrasies 的“ync”和 Emoji 的“o”；另见欧洲议会葡法语词片段及传记姓名、出生信息，跨段语义不统一。

patterns.name: “emoji”词内切分
patterns.context: 英文标题或 CSS 字体名称中出现 Emoji，激活落在该词的多个子词片段上，尤以“o”为强。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 标题、Github/CSS 字体配置

patterns.name: “idiosyncrasies”词内切分
patterns.context: 英文中出现 idiosyncrasies，激活集中在“ync”片段。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 管理讨论、时间处理讨论

patterns.name: 欧洲议会多语种分词片段
patterns.context: 在欧洲议会文本中，激活落在被模型拆分的词片段上；涉及不同词形和词义，未见明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 名字与日期中的局部片段
patterns.context: 人物生平条目中，激活出现在出生信息及棋手姓名的词片段；最强位置是姓氏末段“ms”。

en.concept: Mixed responses to specific word fragments
en.description: The most prominent recurring cue is the string touch, appearing across French word forms and various English technical, patent, and research contexts. There are also sporadic activations on institutional vision headings, code-identifier fragments, a year, and an internal fragment of empathic.

patterns.name: touch within a word or at a word boundary
patterns.context: The string touch appears in French word forms, English compounds, or phrases; the words are tokenized in different ways.
patterns.domain: European Parliament text, French historical text, software Q&A, patent background, medical research

patterns.name: Vision heading and vision statement
patterns.context: Introductions to institutions or projects use Vision to mark a vision statement, often alongside words such as Mission, Our, or for.
patterns.domain: Research institution introductions, local government project texts

patterns.name: Proper-name fragment in code
patterns.context: In a C/C++ header filename, the fragment forms part of AutosaveJob.

patterns.name: Numeric fragment in a path or filename
patterns.context: A year appears after the date a title was awarded in an English biographical account.

patterns.name: Fragment within an emotional-relationship word
patterns.context: In a research abstract, empathic describes the nature of a caregiving relationship.

1_379.concept: 对特定词片段的混合响应
1_379.description: 激活最突出的复现线索是 touch 字符串，跨法语词形及多种英语技术、专利和研究语境；另对机构愿景标题、代码标识符片段、年份及 empathic 词内片段有零星激活。

patterns.name: 词内或词边界的 touch
patterns.trigger: « touch»9、« touch»10；另有 « touch»9«ant»2、« touch»9« ups»2
patterns.context: 在法语词形、英语复合词或短语中出现 touch 字符串；词本身的切分方式各异。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会文本、法语历史文本、软件问答、专利背景、医学研究

patterns.name: Vision 标题及愿景陈述
patterns.context: 机构或项目介绍中以 Vision 标记愿景，前后常有 Mission、Our、for 等词。
patterns.domain: 研究机构介绍、地方政府项目文本

patterns.name: 代码中的专名片段
patterns.context: C/C++ 头文件名中，片段组成 AutosaveJob。

patterns.name: 路径或文件名中的数字片段
patterns.context: 英文传记叙述中，年份出现在头衔获得时间之后。

patterns.name: 情感关系词内片段
patterns.context: 研究摘要中，empathic 描述照护关系的性质。
patterns.domain: 医学或社会科学研究摘要

en.concept: Empathy-related fragments and sporadic word forms
en.description: The main response is to fragments in the empath- word family related to empathy; sporadic activations also occur on copying, French ett, the surname ending ms, t within a drug name, and a touché fragment, without a unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: empathy word family
patterns.context: Contexts involving sympathy, empathy, or understanding others’ feelings; the trigger falls on an internal fragment of empath-.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, design discussions, philosophical writing, personal narratives

patterns.name: copying
patterns.context: Mentions not wanting to copy code when discussing reuse of software modules.

patterns.name: French character sequence ett
patterns.context: The sequence occurs inside French words with differing meanings.

patterns.name: Emms name fragment
patterns.context: The ending of a chess player’s name.

patterns.name: Fragment within a drug name
patterns.context: Within a drug name in a medical abstract.

patterns.name: touch word form
patterns.context: The French parliamentary text uses “touché” for a member of parliament receiving an allowance.

1_379.concept: 共情词片段及零散词形
1_379.description: 主要响应 empath- 词族中与共情相关的片段；另对 copying、法语 ett、姓名词尾 ms、药名内 t 及 touché 片段有零散激活，缺少统一语义条件。

patterns.name: empathy 词族
patterns.context: 与同情、共情或理解他人感受有关的语境；触发点落在 empath- 的词内片段
patterns.domain: 研究摘要、设计讨论、哲学论述、个人叙述

patterns.name: copying
patterns.context: 讨论复用软件模块时，提到不想复制代码

patterns.name: 法语 ett 字串
patterns.context: 法语词内部出现该字串，语义并不相同

patterns.name: Emms 姓名片段
patterns.context: 棋手姓名的词尾

patterns.name: 药名内部片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要中的药物名称内部

patterns.name: touch 词形
patterns.context: 法语议会文本中指领取津贴的议员“touché”

en.concept: Empathy stem and sporadic substring features
en.description: Primarily responds to the stem path within the empath word family, covering empathy and related word forms. Other activations are scattered across French word fragments, Em/Elm strings, a drug name, code identifiers, and a recipe phrase, with no unified semantic explanation yet.

patterns.name: empath stem and related word forms
patterns.context: Activation falls on the substring path in empath words; different suffixes form empathize, empathic, and empathizing. Contexts include design-thinking stages, nursing interventions, understanding others' trauma, and altruistic psychology.
patterns.domain: Design research, nursing and social psychology, personal narratives

patterns.name: Proper names or word fragments beginning with Em
patterns.context: Activation occurs inside case-sensitive Em/Elm strings that correspond to different word forms or identifiers; there is no clear shared semantics.
patterns.domain: Chess players' names, forum usernames, Android emoji discussions

patterns.name: French word fragments in EuroParl
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on internal fragments of several French words, including function words, affixes, and stems. The passages discuss budget deficits, economic restructuring, and related policy.
patterns.domain: European Parliament debates, French policy texts

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a drug name
patterns.context: Activation falls on a single-letter fragment in the middle of the drug name emtricitabine; the context is prophylactic medication after liver transplantation for hepatitis B.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a code identifier
patterns.context: Activation falls inside the identifier in the C/C++ include filename AutosaveJob.h.

patterns.name: Unclear trigger in a recipe context
patterns.context: The trigger fragment is the common word touch, but this passage is a recipe narrative; no stable connection is apparent to the empath word family or other fragments.

1_379.concept: 共情词干与零散子串特征
1_379.description: 主要响应 empath 词族中的词干 path，涵盖共情及其相关词形；其余激活分散在法语词片段、Em/Elm 字符串、药名、代码标识符和食谱短语中，尚无统一语义解释。

patterns.name: empath 词干及相关词形
patterns.context: 激活落在 empath 词中的 path 子串；后续词尾分别组成 empathize、empathic、empathizing。出现在讨论设计思维阶段、护理干预、理解他人创伤或利他心理的语境中。
patterns.domain: 设计研究、护理与社会心理学、个人叙述

patterns.name: Em 开头的专名或词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在大小写敏感的 Em/Elm 字符串内部，但对应不同词形或标识符；没有明显共同语义。
patterns.domain: 棋手姓名、论坛用户名、Android 表情符号讨论

patterns.name: EuroParl 法语词片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在多个法语词的内部片段，包括功能词、词缀和词干；段落讨论预算赤字、经济重组及相关政策。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会辩论，法语政策文本

patterns.name: 药名内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 emtricitabine 药名中间的单字母片段；上下文是乙肝肝移植后的预防用药。

patterns.name: 代码标识符内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 C/C++ include 文件名 AutosaveJob.h 的标识符内部。

patterns.name: 食谱语境中未明触发
patterns.context: 触发片段是常见词 touch，但本段是食谱叙述；与 empath 词族及其他片段看不出稳定联系。

en.concept: Emoji word form and sporadic subwords
en.description: The most stable signal is o in the word emoji, occurring across varied genres; other activations are scattered across proper nouns, code, French/Romanian word forms, drug names, and local subwords in Unicode terminology, and are difficult to explain with a single rule.

patterns.name: emoji string
patterns.context: The letter o in the stem emoji is marked; it can occur in varied contexts such as ordinary discussions, design questions, and technical documentation.
patterns.domain: Forums, Q&A, medical abstracts, encyclopedias, etc.

patterns.name: m within English words
patterns.context: Inside English proper nouns or code identifiers; there are few examples, so it is unclear whether this relates to the emoji pattern.

patterns.name: Aut word fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the code header filename “«Aut»osave” and at the start of Romanian text, “-«Aut»oritatea”; the specific trigger is unclear.

patterns.name: French word endings and internal fragments
patterns.context: Fragments of several words in French parliamentary texts are marked, including “«e». «Cec«i»”, “d«'»une”, “touch«ées»”; activations are scattered and may reflect subwords or local morphological features.

patterns.name: Romanian word fragments
patterns.context: Several internal fragments in formal Romanian speeches are marked, such as “Aut«or»itatea”, “dom«nil»or”, and “do«res»c”; there is no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: empathize word fragment
patterns.context: Appears in “em«path»«ize» phase” in a discussion of the empathy stage of design thinking; the adjacent “ize” and “phase” are also marked.

patterns.name: Medical drug-name fragments
patterns.context: Appears within the drug name emtricitabine as “em«t»ricit«it»abine”; nearby markings also include drug-abbreviation fragments.

patterns.name: Untouchables word fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the band name “«Un»«touch»ables”; it shares the surface substring touch with other passages, but the context differs.

patterns.name: Unicode variation sequence
patterns.context: Encyclopedia text describes Unicode variation selectors for emoji-style and text presentation; this aligns with the emoji theme, but markings are distributed across multiple fragments.

1_379.description: 最稳定线索是 emoji 一词中的 o，且出现于多种文体；其余激活分散在专名、代码、法语/罗马尼亚语词形、药名及 Unicode 术语的局部子词中，难以由单一规则解释。

patterns.name: emoji 字符串
patterns.context: 词干 emoji 中间的字母 o 被标记；可出现在普通讨论、设计问题、技术文档等不同上下文中。
patterns.domain: 论坛、问答、医学摘要、百科等

patterns.name: 英文词内的 m
patterns.context: 英文专名或代码标识符内部；片段很少，无法确定是否与 emoji 模式相关。

patterns.name: Aut 词片段
patterns.context: 出现在代码头文件名“«Aut»osave”及罗马尼亚语文本开头“-«Aut»oritatea”中，具体触发条件不明。

patterns.name: 法语词尾与词内片段
patterns.context: 法语议会文本中多个词的片段被标记，包括“«e». «Cec«i»”, “d«'»une”, “touch«ées»”；触发分散，可能是子词或局部形态特征。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语正式讲话中若干词内片段被标记，如“Aut«or»itatea”“dom«nil»or”“do«res»c”；没有明确共同语义。

patterns.name: empathize 词片段
patterns.context: 出现在“em«path»«ize» phase”中，讨论设计思维的同理心阶段；相邻的“ize”“phase”也被标记。

patterns.name: 医学药名片段
patterns.context: 出现在“em«t»ricit«it»abine”药名 emtricitabine 内；其余附近标记为药物缩写片段。

patterns.name: Untouchables 词片段
patterns.context: 出现在乐队名“«Un»«touch»ables”中；与其他段的 touch 子串表面相同，但上下文不同。

patterns.name: Unicode 变体序列
patterns.context: 百科文本描述 emoji-style 与文本呈现的 Unicode 变体选择符；与 emoji 主题一致，但标记分布在多个片段。

en.concept: touch forms and sporadic subword fragments
en.description: The most stable triggers are forms of touch and the French verb toucher, appearing in contexts involving food, touchscreens, interfaces, parliament, and band names. Sporadic subword activations also occur in French and Romanian words, C++ header fragments, and forum usernames.

patterns.name: touch root and inflected forms
patterns.context: Activations occur in the complete English word touch, its inflected or derived forms, or forms of the French verb toucher; meanings vary across contexts.
patterns.domain: Recipes, device interaction, forum discussions, biographies, French parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Subword fragments in split text
patterns.context: Activations occur in French sentences, often on subwords within words or at word boundaries. Many happen to form French word fragments, but it is unclear whether each has an independent semantic trigger.

patterns.name: C++ include path fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in the quoted header filename AutosaveJob.h after #include; the activation falls on a substring of a code identifier.

patterns.name: Romanian intra-word subword fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in the title “Autoritatea Palestiniană,” with the activation spanning an intra-word fragment; the subsequent speech has no obvious similar markers.
patterns.domain: European Parliament Romanian title and speech

patterns.name: Forum signature or username fragment
patterns.context: A single-letter marker appears in the middle of the username panpanna; the surrounding forum text has no obvious corresponding semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Username fragment
patterns.context: A single-letter marker appears in the middle of the username Elm3ntOfSurprise, not in an ordinary word in the subsequent sentence.

patterns.name: Short names and intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Occurs within proper names or words such as Alec MacKaye and Un touchables; this passage has no clear shared semantic condition.

1_379.concept: touch 词形及偶发子词片段
1_379.description: 最稳定的触发是 touch 及法语 toucher 的词形，出现于食物、触屏、界面、议会和乐队名等语境；另有法语、罗马尼亚语词内片段、C++ 头文件片段及论坛用户名中的零散子词激活。

patterns.name: touch 词根与词形片段
patterns.trigger: « touch»（包括 « touch»10、« touch»9、« touch»ées、« touch»é、«Un»3«touch»9ables）
patterns.context: 激活落在英语 touch 的完整词、变位/派生词中，或法语动词 toucher 的词形中；不同上下文意义不尽相同。
patterns.domain: 食谱、设备交互、论坛讨论、人物介绍、法语议会文本

patterns.name: 分词子词片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在法语句子中，常为词内子词或词边界片段；其中多处恰好构成法语词语片段，不能确定它们各自有独立语义触发作用。

patterns.name: C++ include 路径片段
patterns.context: 出现在 #include 后的带引号头文件名 AutosaveJob.h 中；激活落在代码标识符的子串上。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在标题“Autoritatea Palestiniană”中，激活覆盖词内片段；后续讲话正文没有明显同类标记。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会罗马尼亚语标题及讲话

patterns.name: 论坛署名或用户名片段
patterns.context: 单字母标记位于用户名 panpanna 的中间；周围论坛正文没有明显对应语义触发。

patterns.name: 用户名片段
patterns.context: 单字母标记位于用户名 Elm3ntOfSurprise 中间，而非后续句子的普通词语中。

patterns.name: 短名字母与词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Alec MacKaye、Un touchables 等专名或词的内部；本段没有清楚的共同语义条件。

en.description: The strongest recurring trigger is o in the spelling of emoji; empathy/empathize forms also trigger, as does t in emtricitabine. Other activations are scattered across course titles, names, band names, and Italian words, with no unified explanation.

patterns.name: Letter o in the spelling of emoji
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the letter o in the English string emoji; it is sometimes accompanied by a hyphen or explanatory text about emoji.
patterns.domain: Ordinary text in HackerNews, Wikipedia, and EuroParl

patterns.name: Internal fragment in the empathy root
patterns.context: Occurs in forms related to empathy/empathize, involving empathy relationships and the design-thinking stage.

patterns.name: Drug-name fragment in emtricitabine
patterns.context: Occurs within the spelling of emtricitabine, a drug related to HIV/HBV prophylaxis and treatment.

patterns.name: Word boundaries and Italian internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on boundaries between adjacent words or inside ordinary Italian words; no stable shared meaning or context is apparent.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in personal and band names
patterns.context: Occurs in musicians’ names and hardcore band names, with no clear connection to emoji or empathy forms.

patterns.name: Other sporadic English fragments
patterns.context: Scattered across comments, URLs, usernames, and ordinary words, without a confirmed recurring pattern.

1_379.description: 最强且重复的触发是 emoji 拼写中的 o；另在 empathy/empathize 词形中触发，也有 emtricitabine 内的 t。其余激活零散分布于课程标题、人名、乐队名和意大利语词语，无法统一解释。

patterns.name: emoji 拼写中的字母 o
patterns.context: 英文字符串 emoji 中，激活集中在字母 o；周围有时带连字符或有关 emoji 的说明文字。
patterns.domain: HackerNews、Wikipedia 及 EuroParl 中的普通文本

patterns.name: empathy 词根内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在 empathy/empathize 相关词形中，分别涉及共情关系和设计思维阶段。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目描述、StackExchange 问答

patterns.name: emtricitabine 药名片段
patterns.context: 出现在 HIV/HBV 预防治疗相关药物 emtricitabine 的拼写内部。

patterns.name: 多词边界及意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在相邻词的边界或普通意大利语词内部；未见稳定的共同词义或语境。
patterns.domain: 营销/阅读课程标题、意大利语法律论述

patterns.name: 人名和乐队名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 出现在音乐人姓名和 hardcore 乐队名称中，与 emoji 或共情词形无明显联系。

patterns.name: 其他零散英文片段
patterns.context: 散落在评论、URL、用户名及普通词语中，未形成可确认的重复模式。

en.concept: Intra-word substrings and technical word forms
en.description: The clearest triggers are the o in emoji/emotion-related words and ync in idiosyncrasies. Other activations occur in names, abbreviations, and numerous sporadic intra-word fragments, with no consistent condition apparent.

patterns.name: o in emoji-related words
patterns.context: Occurs in the spelling of words such as “emoji” or “emotion,” especially alongside discussion of emoji, emoticons, or their display or keyboards

patterns.name: ync in idiosyncrasies
patterns.context: Occurs within “idiosyncrasies” when discussing the particularities and differences of software, tools, or platforms

patterns.name: m in a name or identifier
patterns.context: Occurs inside mixed-case identifiers resembling usernames or handles

patterns.name: SSIS in a question
patterns.context: When asking how to upgrade a SQL Server Integration Services project file

patterns.name: Sporadic intra-word subword fragments
patterns.context: Markers are scattered across ordinary words, Romanian word forms, URLs, technical abbreviations, and numbers. Aside from the intra-word fragments in words such as emoji and idiosyncrasies, no consistent contextual trigger is apparent

1_379.description: 最鲜明的触发是 emoji/emotion 相关词中的 o，以及 idiosyncrasies 中的 ync；另有姓名、缩写和大量零散词内片段，无法归纳为一致条件。

patterns.name: emoji 相关词中的 o
patterns.context: “emoji”或“emotion”一类词的拼写中，尤其与 emoji、表情符号及其显示或键盘相关内容同现
patterns.domain: 科技讨论、维基百科、议会发言

patterns.name: idiosyncrasies 中的 ync
patterns.context: 谈论软件、工具或平台各自的特殊性与差异时，出现在 “idiosyncrasies” 一词内部

patterns.name: 姓名或标识符中的 m
patterns.context: 出现在类似用户名或网名的混合大小写标识符内部

patterns.name: 问句中的 SSIS
patterns.context: 询问如何升级 SQL Server Integration Services 项目文件时

patterns.name: 零散词内子词片段
patterns.context: 这些标记分散在普通词、罗马尼亚语词形、URL、技术缩写和数字中；除前述 emoji、idiosyncrasies 等词内片段外，看不出一致的上下文触发条件

en.description: The most prominent shared cue is the o in emoji. Italian intra-word fragments also recur across multiple passages, alongside Romanian word fragments, proper names, and an IRC word fragment; no single rule explains them all.

patterns.name: The word “emoji”
patterns.context: In sentences or compounds discussing emoji, especially when the complete word form appears; segment 3 also contains “em«o»10«ji»1-«style»1”.

patterns.name: Italian -tta word ending
patterns.context: Occurs in Italian words such as “tut«ta»9” and “met«t»9endo”; activation falls on a doubled consonant or related intra-word fragment and does not depend on the emoji context.
patterns.domain: Italian conversation, parliamentary texts, academic texts

patterns.name: Romanian intra-word fragment
patterns.context: An intra-word substring in Romanian text; the specific trigger is unclear.

patterns.name: Fragment in a proper name or entry
patterns.context: An intra-word fragment in a person’s name in a bibliography entry; no clear link to other high-activation patterns is apparent.

patterns.name: Fragment in Italian “si vede”
patterns.context: An Italian IRC sentence describing a gray desktop where only something is visible; this is an intra-word fragment, and any independent pattern is unclear.

1_379.concept: 词内 o／意大利语片段
1_379.description: 最突出的共同线索是 emoji 一词中的 o；此外意大利语词内片段在多段重复，另有罗马尼亚语词片段、专名和 IRC 词片段，未能由单一规则解释。

patterns.name: “emoji”一词
patterns.context: 在讨论 emoji 的句子或复合词中，尤其是出现完整词形时；第 3 段还出现 “em«o»10«ji»1-«style»1”。

patterns.name: 意大利语 -tta 词尾
patterns.context: 出现在意大利语词中，如 “tut«ta»9” 和 “met«t»9endo”；激活落在双辅音或相关词内片段，不依赖 emoji 语境。
patterns.domain: 意大利语对话、议会文本、学术文本

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语文本中的词内子串；具体触发条件不明。

patterns.name: 专名或词条中的片段
patterns.context: 参考文献条目中的人名内部片段；未见与其他高激活模式明确相连。

patterns.name: 意大利语“si vede”中的片段
patterns.context: IRC 消息中描述桌面呈灰色、只能看见某物的意大利语句子；属于词内片段，是否有独立规律不明。

en.concept: Cross-corpus word fragments and subword boundaries
en.description: Activations often fall on internal fragments of split words, including parliamentary texts in multiple languages, emoji, proper nouns such as Eloise, years and page numbers, usernames, and anomalous strings; no unified semantic trigger is apparent so far.

patterns.name: Split “emoji”
patterns.context: The word emoji appears in English sentences, with activation concentrated on the split o portion; it may be preceded by a hyphen or other modifiers.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia, HackerNews; explanatory text, forum discussions

patterns.name: Romanian internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Internal word fragments in continuous Romanian text, spanning word-initial and medial positions; Romanian diacritics also appear in the same passage.

patterns.name: French internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Fragments of ordinary words in French parliamentary speeches; high activation falls on «iter», followed by «a», in the context of profiter(a).

patterns.name: Italian internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across internal fragments in Italian parliamentary text; stronger activations concentrate on «i» and «uti» in compiuti.

patterns.name: Portuguese internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Internal fragments in Portuguese parliamentary speeches; the highest activation falls on «v» in desvio.

patterns.name: Years and numeric ranges
patterns.context: Bibliographic year entries and page ranges; «13» activates significantly more strongly than adjacent numbers.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: The personal name Eloise; the fragment appears in encyclopedia entries or descriptions of fictional characters.

patterns.name: Garbled numeric and alphabetic strings
patterns.context: Nonstandard strings, usernames, or truncated text in forum posts, with no clear semantic cues.

patterns.name: Fragments inside user identifiers
patterns.context: Strings resembling usernames, names, or identifiers in forum text; activation occurs on internal fragments.

1_379.concept: 跨语料词片段与子词边界
1_379.description: 激活常落在拆分后的词内片段：包括多种语言的议会文本、emoji、Eloise 等专名，以及年份页码、用户名和异常字符串；目前看不出统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 拆分的 “emoji”
patterns.context: 在英语句子中出现单词 emoji，激活集中于拆分后的 o 部分；周围可接连字符或其他修饰语。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语连续文本中的词内片段，跨越词首、词中等位置；同段还出现罗马尼亚语变音符号。

patterns.name: 法语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 法语议会发言中的普通词语片段；高激活落在 «iter»，其后接 «a»，并处于 profiter(a) 语境。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 意大利语议会文本中，激活分布于词内片段；较强处集中在 compiuti 的 «i» 及 «uti»。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会发言中的词内片段；最高激活落在 desvio 的 «v»。

patterns.name: 年份与数字范围
patterns.context: 书目式年份条目和页码范围；«13» 激活显著高于邻近数字。

patterns.name: 专名中的子词片段
patterns.context: 人物姓名 Eloise；片段出现在百科条目或虚构人物介绍中。

patterns.name: 乱码式数字与字母串
patterns.context: 论坛帖子中的非标准字符串、用户名或残缺文本，缺少清晰语义线索。

patterns.name: 用户标识符内部片段
patterns.context: 论坛文本中类似用户名、名称或标识符的字符串；激活出现在其内部片段。

en.concept: Fragments containing o and proper names
en.description: The most stable strong pattern is the o in emoji. There is also strong activation on fragments in proper names such as Eloise and Emo, and in idiosyncrasies; the latter cases occur in contexts different from the main pattern.

patterns.name: The letter o in emoji
patterns.context: The letter o occurs within the word emoji, often split by token boundaries; it is usually followed by ji. Appears in contexts discussing emoticons, emoji keyboards, or fonts.

patterns.name: The letter E in the name Eloise
patterns.context: Activation falls on the initial fragment of Eloise; the text concerns a person’s name or an index entry and need not relate to emoji.

patterns.name: The letter E in the name Emo
patterns.context: Activation falls on the initial fragment of the proper name Emo; the sentence introduces it as a person’s name.

patterns.name: A fragment in the name Eloise
patterns.context: Activation falls on a later fragment of the name Eloise; the name appears in a fictional-character description.

patterns.name: Non-emoji intra-word fragment
patterns.context: Activation occurs on an intra-word fragment in idiosyncrasies, in a context distinct from the emoji or proper-name cases above.

1_379.concept: 含 o 的片段与专名
1_379.description: 最稳定的强模式是 emoji 中的 o；另对 Eloise、Emo 等专名片段及 idiosyncrasies 的词内片段有较强激活，后几类与主模式语境不同。

patterns.name: emoji 中的字母 o
patterns.context: 字母 o 位于单词 emoji 的内部，常被分词边界拆开；后续通常接 ji。出现于讨论表情符号、表情键盘或字体的语境。

patterns.name: 人名 Eloise 中的字母 E
patterns.context: 激活落在 Eloise 的词首片段；后文涉及人物姓名或目录条目，不要求与 emoji 相关。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 百科条目、参考书目

patterns.name: 人名 Emo 中的字母 E
patterns.context: 激活落在专名 Emo 的词首片段；语句将其作为人物姓名介绍。

patterns.name: 人名 Eloise 中的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在人名 Eloise 的后续片段；该姓名在虚构人物介绍中出现。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 虚构作品人物条目

patterns.name: 非 emoji 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在 idiosyncrasies 的词内片段，与上述 emoji 或人名语境不同。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on intra-word substrings in multilingual text, often involving Italian, Portuguese, and English. They also occur in names, years, punctuation, and emoji/Unicode terminology, with no stable single semantic theme apparent.

patterns.name: Split fragments in Italian words
patterns.context: In Italian sentences, activations fall inside split words, often on word-final or intra-word fragments; a few also occur on punctuation and common function words.
patterns.domain: PhilPapers, legal or social science discussions

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Italian academic discussion
patterns.context: In formal discussion, words are split into multiple activated fragments, especially in sentences describing goals, methods, and arguments; «tutta» also appears.

patterns.name: Italian titles, pronouns, and other word fragments
patterns.context: In parliamentary speeches, activations are distributed within Italian words; «tutta» is also marked.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments and quantities in Italian and Portuguese
patterns.context: In multilingual parliamentary texts, activations span intra-word substrings, including years, numbers, and some short words; repeated word fragments may activate again within the same passage.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Portuguese parliamentary speeches and related policy discussions

patterns.name: Eloise fragments in a name
patterns.context: A person’s name in English text is split, with activation concentrated on an intra-word fragment of Eloise; it occurs twice.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments related to emoji
patterns.context: When discussing the appearance of emoji, older Android emoji, or standardized variants, activations occur on word fragments and Unicode code markers.

1_379.description: 激活主要落在多语种文本中的词内子串，常涉及意大利语、葡萄牙语和英语；也见于姓名、年份、标点及 emoji/Unicode 术语，未显出稳定的单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 意大利语词中切分片段
patterns.context: 意大利语句子中，激活落在被拆分的词内部，且多为词尾或词内片段；标点和常见功能词也有少量激活。

patterns.name: 意大利语学术论述中的词内片段
patterns.context: 正式论述中词被切分为多个激活片段，尤其出现在描述目标、方法和论证的句子里；另有 «tutta»。

patterns.name: 意大利语冠衔与代词等词片段
patterns.context: 议会发言中，激活分布在意大利语词内部；«tutta»也被标记。

patterns.name: 意大利语与葡萄牙语词内片段及数量
patterns.context: 多语种议会文本中，激活覆盖词内子串，也包括年份、数字和部分短词；重复出现的词片段可能在同一段中再次激活。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，葡萄牙语议会发言及相关政策讨论

patterns.name: 姓名中的 Eloise 片段
patterns.context: 英语文本中的人名被拆分，激活集中于 Eloise 的词内片段；两处出现。

patterns.name: 表情符号相关词内片段
