patterns.name: Litigation and judicial language
patterns.context: Discusses appeals, litigation, adjudication, or remedies, often in the context of county courts or county-level disputes.

patterns.name: County names in legal citations
patterns.context: County is part of a proper name in precedent citations or court and public-institution names; a state name, citation, or procedural outcome may appear nearby.

1_787.concept: 美国判例中的 County
1_787.description: 所有片段都含 County/county：主要是美国县名、县法院或县级机构；共同出现在判例文本中，并常伴随法院标题、法律引证、诉讼程序与裁判措辞。

patterns.name: 县名中的 County
patterns.trigger: « County»、«County»，以及所有格“«county»'s”，包括“McHenry« County»10”“Broward« County»9”“the« county»4's”
patterns.context: 出现在美国县名或 county 的所有格形式中；county 前后常有地名、法院、机构或诉讼相关措辞。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决及法律意见书

patterns.name: 法院与法律文书格式
patterns.trigger: « Court»、«¶»、«Judgment»、«Appeal»，以及章节标题“I.”和诉讼程序词语
patterns.context: 判决标题、案件程序说明、段落编号或法院层级等格式和语境；常与县名同现。
patterns.domain: 美国司法判决的标题及正文

patterns.name: 法律诉讼及裁判措辞
patterns.trigger: “we affirm”“we reverse”“filing an action”“challenging the validity”“trial court”“temporary injunction”等
patterns.context: 讨论上诉、诉讼、裁判或救济，且往往出现在县法院或县级争议语境中。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的县名
patterns.trigger: “v.”后或案件名称、法院名称中的县名，如“Jackson County”“Tarrant County”“Jefferson County”
patterns.context: 先例引证或法院、公共机构名称中，County 是专名的一部分；有时附近出现州名、引注或程序结果。

en.description: The clearest pattern involves county names, court jurisdictions, and adjudicative procedure terms in U.S. cases; there are also a few legal or publishing-format cues, including case citations, cadastral descriptions, book table-of-contents headings, and tax-law academic citations.

patterns.name: County names and judicial jurisdictions
patterns.context: In descriptions of courts, litigation, or judgments, a county name appears as the court’s jurisdiction, case location, or land location; institutional names also appear in citations.

patterns.name: Procedural and adjudicative language in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears when describing case facts, procedural progress, court determinations, or legal claims; it is adjacent to the county-name pattern but is not always triggered by a county name.

patterns.name: Legal citations and case-name format
patterns.context: Case citations contain the names of both parties, the court, or reporter information, often alongside abbreviations, punctuation, and citation formatting.

patterns.name: Place names and cadastral terms in legal land descriptions
patterns.context: Property or deed documents define a parcel’s location using information such as lot, block, county, and city.

patterns.name: Lists and publication format in table-of-contents headings
patterns.context: Headings in a book’s table of contents or index use uppercase letters, separators, and page numbers to list entries such as maps, plans, or military insignia.

patterns.name: Tax-paper titles and publishing institutions
patterns.context: Legal academic citations or paper titles include tax topics, university names, and annual symposium names.

1_787.concept: 法律文书与引文格式
1_787.description: 最明显的模式是美国判例中县名、法院辖区及裁判程序词；另有案件引注、地籍描述、书籍目录标题和税法学术引文等少量法律或出版格式线索。

patterns.name: 县名及司法辖区
patterns.trigger: « County»，常接具体县名，如 «McHenry County»、«Franklin County»、«Rock Island County»、«Kane County»
patterns.context: 法院、诉讼或判决的叙述中，县名作为法院辖区、案件地点或地块所在地出现；也有引文中的机构名称。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的程序与裁判用语
patterns.trigger: « reverse»、« Court»、« decided»、« unconstitutional»、« charged»、« filed»、« motion»
patterns.context: 描述案件事实、程序进展、法院判断或法律主张时出现；与县名模式相邻但并非每处都由县名触发。

patterns.name: 法律引文及案件名称格式
patterns.trigger: « v»、«.»、« writ»、« Texas Department»、« Stuart v.»
patterns.context: 判例引注中出现案件双方名称、法院或报告信息，常伴随缩写、标点和引文格式。

patterns.name: 法律地块描述中的地名与地籍词
patterns.context: 产权或契据文本以地块、区块、县、市等信息界定土地位置。

patterns.name: 目录标题中的列表与出版物格式
patterns.context: 书籍末尾的目录或索引标题，以大写字母、分隔符和页码列出地图、计划或军队徽记等条目。

patterns.name: 税务论文题名及出版机构
patterns.context: 学术法律引文或论文题名中，出现税务主题、大学名称及年度研讨会名称。

en.concept: Proper names and citations in U.S. legal texts
en.description: Primarily responds to proper names and structures in U.S. legal texts, especially County place names and case/institutional citations. It also covers immigration, property, land surveying, taxation, appeals, and injunctions, plus one 401(k) question-and-answer passage.

patterns.name: County in place names
patterns.context: County occurs in U.S. place names, court names, or legal citations, often adjacent to a state, town, or parcel description.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal texts, opinions, and deeds

patterns.name: Legal names with Board of Trustees
patterns.context: Part of an institution or case name, followed by the name of a local government, school, or union.

patterns.name: Citation format in legal references
patterns.context: Occurs in case names, statutory provisions, or opinion citations, often surrounded by abbreviations, numbers, and punctuation.

patterns.name: U.S. immigration agencies and status abbreviations
patterns.context: Background to an immigration application or litigant, often co-occurring with terms such as visa, petition, and Attorney General.

patterns.name: 401(k) retirement account
patterns.context: Asks about personal experience in a question title addressed to a community.

patterns.name: Parcel surveying and cadastral descriptions
patterns.context: Lists township, range, section, directions, and distances to define a land location.

patterns.name: Tax treatment and airport leases
patterns.context: Discusses airport-related legislation and whether an airport lease qualifies for favorable tax treatment.

patterns.name: Wills/joint ownership and farms
patterns.context: Mentions joint-tenancy survivorship and transfer of a family farm, alongside appellate language.

patterns.name: Leave to appeal and constitutional rights
patterns.context: Discusses whether to grant leave to appeal and cites federal statutes and constitutional-rights standards.

patterns.name: Standard for preliminary injunctions
patterns.context: Discusses whether a preliminary injunction may issue when factual disputes remain unresolved and cites case names.

1_787.concept: 美国法律文本中的专名与引文
1_787.description: 主要响应美国法律文本中的专名与结构，尤其 County 地名、判例/机构引文；也覆盖移民、产权、土地测绘、税务、上诉及禁令等法律语境，另有一条401(k)问答。

patterns.name: 地名中的 County
patterns.context: County 出现在美国地名、法院名称或法律引文中，常与州、镇、地块描述相邻。
patterns.domain: 美国法律文本、判决及地契

patterns.name: Board of Trustees 法律名称
patterns.context: 作为机构或案件名称的一部分，后接地方政府、学校或工会名称。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的引注格式
patterns.trigger: « v»、法院缩写及卷页/法条编号，如“v. Cook”“S.C. § 2253(c)(1)”
patterns.context: 判例名、法规条文或判决引文中出现，周围常有缩写、数字和标点。

patterns.name: 美国移民机构及身份缩写
patterns.context: 移民申请或诉讼当事人背景，常与签证、请愿、Attorney General 等词同现。

patterns.name: 401(k) 退休账户
patterns.context: 询问个人经验，置于面向社区的提问标题中。

patterns.name: 地块测量与地籍描述
patterns.context: 连续列出 township、range、section、方向及距离，以界定土地位置。

patterns.name: 税收待遇与机场租赁
patterns.context: 讨论机场相关立法及某机场租赁能否获得优惠税务待遇。

patterns.name: 遗嘱/共同产权与农场
patterns.context: 谈及共同产权存续者及家庭农场转让，伴随上诉裁判语句。

patterns.name: 上诉许可与宪法权利
patterns.context: 讨论是否签发上诉许可，并引用联邦法条及宪法权利标准。
patterns.domain: 联邦刑事/人身保护令判决

patterns.name: 临时禁令的裁判标准
patterns.context: 讨论事实争议未决时是否可颁发临时禁令，并引用案件名。

en.concept: Proper Names and Legal Document Vocabulary
en.description: Activations cluster around two types of lexical positions: “Institute” in the full name MIT; “affixed” (attached, stamped) in legal texts and “Department” in names of adjudicative institutions.

patterns.name: Institute in institutional names
patterns.context: Appears in the name “Massachusetts Institute of Technology”; may occur in copyright lines, addresses, or encyclopedia categories.
patterns.domain: Copyright notices, academic addresses, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: affixed in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal documents describe a file, seal, or mark as having been attached; common in court certification, signature, or evidence contexts.

patterns.name: Department in legal citations
patterns.context: Institutional names in legal case citations.

1_787.concept: 专名及法律文书词汇
1_787.description: 激活集中于两类词汇位置：MIT全称中的 Institute；法律文本中 affixed（附上、加盖）及判例机构名中的 Department。

patterns.name: 机构名称中的 Institute
patterns.context: 名称以“Massachusetts Institute of Technology”出现；可能位于版权行、地址或百科分类中。
patterns.domain: 版权声明、学术地址、百科条目

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 affixed
patterns.context: 法律文书描述文件、印章或标记被附上；多见于法院认证、签署或证据材料语境。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 Department
patterns.context: 法律判例引文中的机构名称。

en.description: Primarily responds to U.S. judicial opinions and their vocabulary, institutions, and citation formats, especially Texas Department, prisoner, judicial-procedure language, and names containing Citizens and County. There is also an isolated activation on ks in a question about 401ks.

patterns.name: Bank names in legal citations
patterns.context: Activation occurs on Citizens in bank names appearing in legal-opinion citations or party names; also includes cases where the name is split across multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions and case citations

patterns.name: The ks suffix in retirement-account abbreviations
patterns.context: The ks suffix immediately following 401 in “401ks,” in a question about self-directed retirement accounts.

patterns.name: County names in legal cases
patterns.context: County following a place name in U.S. legal texts, especially county names in case facts or institutional names.

patterns.name: Texas Department names
patterns.context: Names of government agencies beginning with Texas Department in legal opinions, including the Department of Human Services and the Department of Criminal Justice.

patterns.name: The ending of the legal term prisoner
patterns.context: The word prisoner, referring to a person in custody or serving a sentence in a legal context; activation falls on a split subword or the complete word.
patterns.domain: Legal-dictionary citations, criminal and civil opinions

patterns.name: Court-procedure terms in legal texts
patterns.context: Occurs when describing a court issuing a judgment, terminating parental rights, filing a pleading, or serving a sentence, and related procedural or legal statuses.

patterns.name: Sentencing and judicial-agency language
patterns.context: Describes days of imprisonment and a state prison department in sentencing language, common in plea-bargain and criminal-opinion narratives.

patterns.name: Legal argument and adjudication language
patterns.context: Appellate opinions state how evidence is evaluated, legal rules applied, disputes decided, or judicial relief granted.

patterns.name: Legal-document layout and citation markers
patterns.context: Occurs near page breaks, paragraph numbering, punctuation, or citation formatting in opinions; some activations may be triggered by formatting or split tokens.

1_787.concept: 美国法律文本与名称
1_787.description: 主要响应美国法律判决及其词汇、机构和引文格式，尤其是 Texas Department、prisoner、裁判程序语及含 Citizens、County 的名称；另对401ks提问中的ks有孤立激活。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的银行名称
patterns.trigger: «Cit»«izens» … «Bank»，包括“First-Citizens Bank & Trust Co.”、“Citizens Nat. T. & S. Bank”
patterns.context: 法律判决的引文或当事人名称中，银行名称出现 Citizens 时激活；也包括名称拆分成多个 token 的情形。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决、案例引文

patterns.name: 退休账户缩写 ks
patterns.context: “401ks”中紧接数字 401 的 ks 后缀，且处于关于 self-directed 退休账户的提问中。

patterns.name: 法律案件中的县名
patterns.context: 美国法律文本中地名后的 County，尤其是案例事实或机构名称中的县名。

patterns.name: Texas Department 名称
patterns.context: 法律判决中以 Texas Department 开头的政府机构名称，包括 Department of Human Services 和 Department of Criminal Justice。

patterns.name: 法律词语 prisoner 的词尾
patterns.context: 法律语境中指被羁押或服刑者的 prisoner 一词；激活落在拆分词片或完整词上。
patterns.domain: 法律词典引述、刑事及民事判决

patterns.name: 法律文本中的法院程序词语
patterns.context: 描述法院作出判决、终止亲子关系、提交诉状或服刑等程序与法律状态时出现。

patterns.name: 刑期与司法机构措辞
patterns.context: 量刑句中描述监禁天数及州监狱部门，常见于 plea bargain 和刑事判决叙述。

patterns.name: 法律论证与裁判用语
patterns.context: 上诉意见中陈述证据评价、法律规则适用、争议裁定或法院救济。

patterns.name: 法律文书版式与引文标记
patterns.trigger: «¶»、«-»、«.»、«» 引号及案例引文中的缩写片段
patterns.context: 判决文本的页码分隔、段落编号、标点或引文排版附近出现；个别激活可能由格式或拆分 token 触发。

en.concept: Criminal Justice Vocabulary in U.S. Cases
en.description: Activations are concentrated in U.S. cases, especially Texas criminal cases: names of government and judicial agencies, incarceration and guilty pleas or sentencing, case citations and caption formats; also procedural explanations and fragments of attorneys’ names, along with several general words.

patterns.name: Agency names in Texas criminal cases
patterns.context: Words such as Department, Bureau, and Investigation in full government agency names; often occur in accounts of criminal cases or legal opinions.
patterns.domain: U.S. cases, especially Texas criminal justice

patterns.name: Sentencing and custody vocabulary
patterns.context: Case accounts involving imprisonment, serving a sentence, prosecution, or criminal plea agreements; some trigger words are general and require a criminal context.

patterns.name: Courts, cases, and party names in legal citations
patterns.context: Cited decisions, bank or government party names, and legal causal statements in case citations or legal discussion.

patterns.name: Legal definitions and judicial terminology
patterns.context: Dictionary definitions of prisoner, or courts explaining procedural rules and whether an opinion is published.
patterns.domain: Quoted legal dictionaries, explanations of judicial procedure

patterns.name: Criminal case captions and court jurisdiction information
patterns.context: Parties, court, county, and case number listed on the first page of an appellate decision or in a case caption.

patterns.name: Surname fragments in attorneys’ names
patterns.context: Attorney names listed in New York counsel appearances; activation falls on fragments within the names.
patterns.domain: Attorney signature blocks at the end of decisions

patterns.name: Formatting or general connectives in legal text
patterns.context: Example abbreviations, case fact accounts, or date sentences in legal text; these words are general and show no stable shared semantic condition.

1_787.concept: 美国判例中的刑事司法语汇
1_787.description: 激活主要集中于美国判例，尤其德州刑事案件：政府司法机关名称、羁押服刑与认罪判刑、案件引文和标题格式；另有程序说明及律师姓名片段，若干一般词也被激活。

patterns.name: Texas刑事案件中的机构名
patterns.trigger: «Department»10 of «Human» Services；«Federal» Bureau of «Investigation»；Texas «Department» of Criminal Justice；Texas «Department» of Corrections
patterns.context: 政府机关全称中的 Department、Bureau、Investigation 等词；多处出现在刑事案件事实叙述或法律意见中
patterns.domain: 美国判例，尤其德州刑事司法

patterns.name: 刑罚与羁押词汇
patterns.context: 围绕监禁、服刑、起诉或刑事认罪协议的案件叙述；部分触发词本身较一般，需结合刑事语境

patterns.name: 法律引文中的法院、判例及当事人名称
patterns.trigger: «resulted» from the breach；«brought»；«First»-«Cit»izens Bank & Trust Co.；«v».« United» States；GO Comm. «v».« City»
patterns.context: 判例引文或法律论述中，出现引述判决、银行/政府当事方名称及法律因果表述

patterns.name: 法律定义与司法术语
patterns.trigger: «a» «person» held in custody, capt«ivity»；forcible «restraint»；«serving» a prison sentence；«Rule»；«not» be published
patterns.context: 词典对 prisoner 的定义，或法院说明程序规则与意见是否公开
patterns.domain: 法律词典引述、司法程序说明

patterns.name: 刑事案件标题与法院管辖信息
patterns.context: 上诉判决首页或案卷标题中列出当事方、法院、县及案号

patterns.name: 律师姓名中的姓氏片段
patterns.context: 纽约律师出庭信息中列明律师姓名；激活落在姓名内部片段

patterns.name: 法律文本中的格式或一般连接词
patterns.context: 法律文本中的举例缩写、案件事实叙述或日期句；这些词语本身较一般，未显示稳定的共同语义条件

en.concept: Judicial Entities and Citations in U.S. Legal Documents
en.description: All samples are U.S. legal documents; prominent cues include City and County in court names and judicial place names, as well as decision captions, procedural terms, and citation formats. There are also law enforcement agency names and sporadic body-text words and punctuation, without a consistent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: City in court names
patterns.context: Appears in a court or case name of the form “City of …”, followed by a place name or case citation.

patterns.name: County and judicial jurisdiction names
patterns.context: Appears in court locations, court names, or county names, often in the form “[place name] County”.
patterns.domain: U.S. case captions, court proceedings, and judicial opinions

patterns.name: Other judicial place names
patterns.context: Appears as part of a state or place name in court locations, party addresses, or case facts; not all instances follow the City/County format.
patterns.domain: Court and address information in U.S. legal documents

patterns.name: Formal judicial-opinion headings and procedural language
patterns.context: Appears in decision captions or procedural statements about judicial discretion, standards of review, or jurisdiction.

patterns.name: Abbreviations and formatting fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: Embedded in strings of statutes, cases, or court citations; activation falls on local tokens in abbreviations.

patterns.name: Federal law enforcement agency names
patterns.context: Constitutes “Federal Bureau of Investigation” in sequence, describing law enforcement personnel in a case.

patterns.name: Common words in legal arguments
patterns.context: Argument, procedure, or fact accounts in legal opinions; these words are sporadic and show no shared specific semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Legal prose, including discussion of procedure, contracts, and evidence

patterns.name: Bank or institution name fragments in case names
patterns.context: Appears in citations containing party or institution names, often alongside formatting such as et al.

patterns.name: Numbers, punctuation, and typographic structure
patterns.context: Appears near case numbers, statutory provisions, footnotes, or pagination; no stable independent semantic trigger is evident.

1_787.concept: 美国法律文书中的司法实体与引证
1_787.description: 激活样本全属美国法律文书；较显著的线索是法院名称中的 City、County 及司法地名，也包括判决标题、程序术语和引证格式。另有执法机构名及零散正文词、标点，未形成一致语义模式。

patterns.name: 法院名称中的 City
patterns.context: 出现在“City of …”这一法院或案件名称中，后接地名或案件引证。
patterns.domain: 美国判例与法律意见书

patterns.name: County及司法管辖区名称
patterns.context: 出现在法院所在地、法院名称或县名中，常见形式为“[地名] County”。
patterns.domain: 美国判例标题、法院程序与司法意见书

patterns.name: 其他司法机构地名
patterns.context: 作为州名或地名的一部分出现在法院所在地、当事方地址或案件事实中；不都属于 City/County 格式。
patterns.domain: 美国法律文书中的法院与地址信息

patterns.name: 司法意见书程式标题与程序用语
patterns.context: 出现在判决标题或说明法院裁量、审查标准、管辖权的程序性语句中。
patterns.domain: 判例与上诉法院意见书

patterns.name: 法律引证中的缩写与格式片段
patterns.context: 嵌在成串的法规、判例或法院引证中；激活落在缩写的局部 token 上。

patterns.name: 联邦执法机构名称
patterns.context: 连续组成“Federal Bureau of Investigation”，描述案件中的执法人员。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的普通词语
patterns.context: 法律意见书正文中的论证、程序或事实叙述；这些词分布零散，未见共同的具体语义条件。
patterns.domain: 法律 prose，包括程序、合同及证据讨论

patterns.name: 判例名中的银行或机构名称片段
patterns.context: 位于案件当事方或机构名称的引证中，常与 et al. 等格式并列。

patterns.name: 数字、标点及排版结构
patterns.context: 出现在案号、法规条文、脚注或分页排版附近，未显示稳定的独立语义触发条件。

en.concept: Formal names and specialized text formats
en.description: Activations are concentrated in formal names and legal texts, especially City in place names, institutional or company names, and the abbreviations and punctuation formats of statutes and case citations. There are also two isolated patterns: 401ks and nautical rigging and vessel-type vocabulary.

patterns.name: City in legal names, institutions, and place names
patterns.context: Occurs in formal names, often alongside place names such as New York, Iowa, Minot, and Bessemer; sometimes repeated in names or case citations within the same passage.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal documents, party addresses, and case citations

patterns.name: Legal citations and statutory formats
patterns.context: Markers occur in statute numbers, case citations, abbreviations, and section numbers; the pattern is not limited to a single word.

patterns.name: Proper names in institutions and legal terminology
patterns.context: Part of the name of a formal institution, program, company, or legal term.
patterns.domain: Legal documents and historical company names

patterns.name: Account abbreviations in financial Q&A
patterns.context: Follows 401 to form the retirement-account name 401ks.

patterns.name: Nautical rigging and vessel-type vocabulary
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of rigging use and lists of vessel types.

1_787.concept: 正式名称与专门文本格式
1_787.description: 激活主要集中在正式名称和法律文本，尤其是地名中的 City、机构或公司名称，以及法条、判例引文的缩写与标点格式。另有 401ks 和航海索具、船型词汇两个孤立模式。

patterns.name: 法律名称、机构和地名中的 City
patterns.context: 出现在正式名称中，常与 New York、Iowa、Minot、Bessemer 等地名相连；有时反复出现在同段的名称或判例引文中。
patterns.domain: 美国法律文书、当事人地址与判例引文

patterns.name: 法律引文与法条格式
patterns.context: 标记出现在法规编号、判例引文、缩写和条款编号中；不只限于某个单一词语。

patterns.name: 机构和法律术语中的专名
patterns.context: 正式机构、项目、公司或法律术语名称的一部分。
patterns.domain: 法律文书及历史公司名称

patterns.name: 金融问答中的账户缩写
patterns.context: 紧跟 401，构成退休账户名称 401ks。

patterns.name: 船舶索具与船型词汇
patterns.context: 出现在索具用途说明和船型列表中。

en.description: Primarily responds to review and decision language in legal texts and citation formats for statutes and cases; also sensitive to proper-name citations for courts, places, institutions, and authors. Other patterns concern parental rights, homestead exemptions, and a passage on nautical rigging.

patterns.name: Legal review and decision language
patterns.context: Appears in sentences where courts review legal questions, review lower-court rulings, or describe the basis for a decision; often co-occurs with articles such as “a” and “the” and phrases such as “of law” and “on appeal”.

patterns.name: Court or institutional names in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in court names, city names, or government department names, usually next to proper nouns or citation formats.

patterns.name: Statutory numbers and section formats in legal citations
patterns.context: Activations cluster around statutory section numbers, case citations, and years or numbers in parentheses; may span split tokens.

patterns.name: Personal names and legal literature author citations
patterns.context: Names appear in case citations, author lists, or legal bibliographies, including abbreviations, square brackets, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Family law and termination of parental rights terminology
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of whether evidence is sufficient to terminate parental rights and how courts review that conclusion.

patterns.name: Homestead exemptions and amounts
patterns.context: Appears alongside statutory exemption amounts and subsections.

patterns.name: Ship rigging terminology
patterns.context: Appears in chapter headings or descriptions of sailboat types and rigging.

1_787.concept: 法律文本与结构化引证
1_787.description: 主要响应法律文本中的审查、判决措辞及法规和案例引证格式，也对法院、地名、机构和作者姓名的专名引证敏感；另见亲权、宅地豁免等法律主题，以及一段航海索具文本。

patterns.name: 法律审查及判决措辞
patterns.trigger: “review”“plenary review”“review de novo”“question of law”“conclusion of law”“consistent”
patterns.context: 出现在法院审查法律问题、审查下级法院裁定或描述判决依据的句子中；常与“a”“the”等冠词以及“of law”“on appeal”等短语共现。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的法院或机构名称
patterns.context: 出现在法院名称、城市地名或政府部门名称中，通常紧邻专名或引证格式。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的法规编号与章节格式
patterns.context: 激活集中在法规条号、判例引注和括号内的年份或编号；会跨越被拆分的 token。

patterns.name: 人名及法律文献作者引证
patterns.context: 姓名出现在判例引证、作者名单或法律文献书目中，含缩写、方括号和标点。

patterns.name: 家庭与亲权终止术语
patterns.context: 在讨论证据是否足以终止父母权利及法院如何审查该结论时出现。

patterns.name: 宅地豁免及金额
patterns.context: 与法定豁免额度及法规分款并列出现。

patterns.name: 船舶索具术语
patterns.context: 在帆船类型与索具的章节标题或说明中出现。

en.concept: U.S. Legal Citations and Decision Text
en.description: Primarily responds to statutory citation formats and their numbers, parentheses, and punctuation in U.S. legal texts; also responds to the name of a vaccine act, criminal drug charges, case citations, and several legal analysis terms. All passages are legal in context, but the specific triggers are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Section symbols and numbers in U.S. Code citations
patterns.context: Appears in U.S. Code citations, especially titles, chapters, section numbers, and subsections; often adjacent to legal terms or statutory content.
patterns.domain: U.S. court decisions, statutes, and legal citations

patterns.name: Parentheses and punctuation in statutory citations
patterns.context: Appears as part of statutory numbers, offense provisions, or citation formats; not all ordinary punctuation activates.

patterns.name: Vaccine Act name and its statutory citations
patterns.context: Appears in Vaccine Act/vaccine compensation program cases, in contexts explaining or cross-referencing the act.

patterns.name: Criminal charges and distribution-related language
patterns.context: Describes violations of federal drug laws, possession with intent to distribute or distribution of cocaine, MDMA, and other drugs, often adjacent to statutory numbers.

patterns.name: “Federal” in legal citations and titles of procedural works
patterns.context: Appears as part of legal treatise titles or names of legal literature, rather than as a general description of the federal government.

patterns.name: Court review and statutory interpretation language
patterns.context: States that statutory interpretation is a question of law subject to appellate review; several marked words are common and may reflect local co-occurrence in legal phrasing.

patterns.name: Securities law and shareholder proposal voting
patterns.context: Discusses proxy rules requiring a statement of the votes needed to pass a plaintiff’s resolution, and cites federal securities law.

patterns.name: Proper names and citation formats in case citations
patterns.context: Appears in case names, institutional names, or state court citations; distinct from the statutory citation pattern.
patterns.domain: State court decisions and case citations

1_787.concept: 美国法律引证与判决文本
1_787.description: 主要响应美国法律文本中的法条引证格式及其编号、括号和标点，也响应疫苗法案名称、刑事毒品罪名、判例引证与若干法律分析词。各段均为法律语境，但具体触发词并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 美国法典引证中的分节符号与编号
patterns.context: 出现在美国法典引证中，尤其是标题、章节、条款编号及其子段；常与法律术语或法条内容相邻。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、法规与法律引证

patterns.name: 法条引证中的括号和标点
patterns.context: 作为法条编号、罪名条款或引证格式的一部分出现；并非所有普通标点都会激活。

patterns.name: 疫苗法案名称与其法规引证
patterns.context: 在 Vaccine Act/疫苗补偿计划相关案件中，名称出现在法案说明或交叉引用上下文。
patterns.domain: 疫苗伤害补偿法律判决

patterns.name: 刑事罪名与分配相关表述
patterns.context: 描述违反联邦毒品法规、持有并意图分销或分销可卡因、摇头丸等罪名，常紧邻法条编号。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的“Federal”及程序文献标题
patterns.context: 作为法律专著标题或法律文献名称的一部分，而非一般意义上的联邦政府描述。

patterns.name: 法院审查与法律解释表述
patterns.context: 陈述成文法解释属于法律问题，并接受上诉审查；其中多个被标记词较常见，可能只是法律句式中的局部共现。

patterns.name: 证券法与股东提案表决
patterns.context: 讨论代理规则要求说明通过原告决议所需票数，并援引联邦证券法。

patterns.name: 判例引证中的专名与引证格式
patterns.trigger: «Interest»、«A»、«v»、«Department»及“(Tex. App.—Fort Worth 1988, no writ)”一类引证成分
patterns.context: 出现在案件名称、机构名称或州法院判例引证中；与法条引证主题不同。
patterns.domain: 州法院判决与判例引证

en.concept: Legal Documents and Local Word-Form Fragments
en.description: Activations are concentrated in legal texts, especially punctuation and abbreviations in legal citations, procedural narratives, and criminal justice agency names; other isolated patterns include nautical rig/bark forms, attorney address blocks, and fragments within fruit and bark terms in popular science texts.

patterns.name: Abbreviations and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in case, statute, or legal bibliography citations, especially near volume and page numbers, court names, years, and citation formats.

patterns.name: rig forms and nautical equipment terminology
patterns.context: In nautical vessel categories or rigging descriptions, activation falls on local fragments of rig / bark forms.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in legal texts
patterns.context: Appears in legal accounts of conspiracy, ambush, and federal investigators; trigger positions are not at complete word boundaries.

patterns.name: Legal procedure and criminal justice agencies
patterns.context: Involves a petitioner or prisoner filing a pleading, a court ordering a response, and a criminal justice department handling a case.

patterns.name: Law firms and listed place names
patterns.context: Attorney names, representation roles, and city/state names form litigant signature or address information.
patterns.domain: Legal document headers or attorney signature blocks

patterns.name: Word fragments in descriptions of fruit and plant sources
patterns.context: Introduces a chemical substance obtainable from fruit, vegetables, or bark; activation falls within ordinary words.
patterns.domain: Popular science or nutrition explanatory text

1_787.concept: 法律文书与局部词形片段
1_787.description: 激活主要集中在法律文本，尤其法律引文的标点缩写、程序叙述及刑事司法机构名称；另有航海 rig/bark 词形、律师地址署名，以及科普文本中水果和树皮词内片段等孤立模式。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的缩写与标点
patterns.context: 出现在判例、法规或法律书目引文中，尤其是卷页、法院、年份和引文格式附近。

patterns.name: rig 词形及船具术语
patterns.context: 航海船舶类别或索具说明中，激活落在 rig / bark 相关词形的局部片段。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于共谋、伏击及联邦调查人员的法律叙述中；触发位置并非完整词边界。

patterns.name: 法律程序与刑事司法机构
patterns.context: 涉及申请人或囚犯提交诉状、法院命令回应，以及刑事司法部门处理案件。

patterns.name: 律师事务所与地名列示
patterns.context: 律师姓名、代理身份与城市／州名组成的诉讼参与方署名或地址信息。
patterns.domain: 法律文书抬头或律师署名

patterns.name: 水果与植物来源描述中的词片段
patterns.context: 介绍某种化学物质可从水果、蔬菜或树皮获得；激活落在普通词内部。
patterns.domain: 科普或营养类说明文字

en.concept: The ks substring and legal-text formatting
en.description: Activations are concentrated on the ks substring across multiple contexts and on case-citation formats in U.S. legal texts; there is also a response to capitalized jurisdictions and court names in legal documents. The shared feature of ks is more orthographic than semantic.

patterns.name: The ks / k’s substring at word endings
patterns.context: The substring occurs at the end of English words or in plural/possessive forms; contexts have no consistent semantics and refer respectively to ships, bark, surnames, and retirement accounts.
patterns.domain: Nautical books, popular science, biographies, personal-finance Q&A

patterns.name: Abbreviations and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Occurs in case names, reporter citations, courts, or years in legal references; activation falls on abbreviation letters and formatting elements such as periods and parentheses.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal literature

patterns.name: Title-case place and court names in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs in litigation captions or court and jurisdiction names, often in uppercase or title-case typography; it is adjacent to citation formatting but is not limited to abbreviations.

1_787.concept: ks 子串与法律文本格式
1_787.description: 激活最集中于多种语境中的 ks 子串，以及美国法律文本中的判例引注格式；另对法律文书中大写的辖区、法院名称有反应。ks 的共同点偏向字形而非语义。

patterns.name: 词尾 ks / k’s 的子串
patterns.context: 子串出现在英语单词末尾或复数/所有格形式中；上下文并无一致语义，分别指船只、树皮、姓氏和退休账户。
patterns.domain: 航海书籍、科普、传记、个人理财问答

patterns.name: 法律引证中的缩写与标点
patterns.trigger: 如 «U»«.»«S»«.»、«S»«.»«W»«d»、«Tex»«.»«App»、«(»年份«)»，以及引证中的字母缩写
patterns.context: 出现在判例名称、记者引证、法院或年份等法律引注中；激活落在缩写字母及句点、括号等格式成分上。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判例与法律文献

patterns.name: 法律文书中的标题式大写地名与法院名称
patterns.context: 出现在诉讼标题或法院、辖区名称中，常以大写或标题式排印；与引注格式相邻，但不只是缩写。

en.concept: Legal Citation and Proper-Name Formats, with Responses to Word-Form Fragments
en.description: Activations cluster around courts, case names, statutory abbreviations, citation punctuation, and procedural terms in U.S. legal texts; other patterns include nautical rigging, plant and food words, and in-word fragments in philosophical titles, which are not fully explained by a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Court or case names in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in decision citations, court names, or government agency names, often accompanied by abbreviations, case names, and citation formats.

patterns.name: Abbreviations and punctuation formats in legal citations
patterns.context: In statutory provisions, case citations, and procedural statements, abbreviations and punctuation appear next to case names, statutory numbers, or volume and page information.

patterns.name: Legal procedure and review terminology
patterns.context: Describes court review, dismissal of motions, statutory interpretation, custody, or imprisonment.

patterns.name: Statutes and legal document names
patterns.context: Appears in abbreviated statute names, statutory exemption names, or names of litigating parties.

patterns.name: Ship rigging terminology and compounds
patterns.context: In nautical or vessel-classification contexts, involving rigging, sails, and vessel names; some activations fall within words.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in plant or food names
patterns.context: Embedded in fruit names or bark-related words, surrounded by lists of fruit, vegetables, or plant sources.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in philosophical term titles
patterns.context: Appears in titles about Kant’s fifth meditation, cosmological arguments, and other philosophical discussions; activation lies within terms.

1_787.concept: 法律引文与专名格式，兼有词形片段响应
1_787.description: 激活集中于美国法律文本中的法院、案名、法条缩写、引文标点与程序术语；另有船舶索具、植物食物词和哲学标题中的词内片段，无法由单一语义主题完全解释。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的法院或判例名称
patterns.context: 出现在判决引文、法院名称或政府机构名称中，常伴随缩写、案名和引文格式。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决与法律文书

patterns.name: 法律引文中的缩写与标点格式
patterns.context: 法律条文、判例引文及程序性表述中，缩写和标点紧邻案名、法条号或卷页信息。

patterns.name: 法律程序与审查用语
patterns.context: 描述法院审查、驳回动议、解释法规、羁押或服刑等法律问题。

patterns.name: 法律法规与法律文件名称
patterns.context: 出现在法规简称、法定豁免名称或诉讼当事方名称中。

patterns.name: 船舶索具术语及复合词
patterns.context: 航海或船舶分类语境中，涉及索具、帆装及船型名称；部分激活落在词内部。

patterns.name: 植物或食物名称中的词内片段
patterns.context: 嵌在水果名称或树皮相关词中，周围列举水果、蔬菜或植物来源。

patterns.name: 哲学术语标题中的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在康德第五沉思、宇宙论论证等哲学讨论的标题中，激活位于术语内部。

en.concept: U.S. Legal Documents and Citation Formats
en.description: Primarily responds to courts, statutes, procedural terminology, proper names, and formatting fragments in U.S. legal documents and citations; also responds to a capitalized title fragment and a vessel-type word in a nautical catalog. Marked positions often fall on abbreviations, word fragments, and citation punctuation.

patterns.name: Legal case citations
patterns.context: Appears in citations of case names, courts and years, statutory numbers, volume and page numbers, and other legal references; marked items may be abbreviation fragments, numbers, or punctuation.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal decisions, statutes, and case citations

patterns.name: Court decision structure and procedural language
patterns.context: Appears in case facts, procedure, standards of review, or party captions in legal documents; often alongside court names, case numbers, and decision formats.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions, appellate decisions, and litigation documents

patterns.name: Proper names and statutory topic words in legal prose
patterns.context: Appears in institution names, legal terminology, or subjects of legal disputes; some marks cover fragments within proper names.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, quoted legal dictionary entries, and discussions of property exemptions

patterns.name: Nautical terminology and word breaks in catalog-style text
patterns.context: Appears in chapter headings and lists of vessel types, including split nautical words; no clear legal context is evident.
patterns.domain: Catalogs or explanatory text in nautical books

1_787.concept: 美国法律文书与引注格式
1_787.description: 主要响应美国法律文书及引注中的法院、法规、程序术语、专名和格式片段；也响应一处航海目录中的大写标题片段与船型词。标记常落在缩写、词内片段及引注标点上。

patterns.name: 法律判例引注
patterns.trigger: 如 «Tex» «App» «v» «S» «W» «U» «C» «§» 及引注中的 «.» «(» «)» «,»；例如 “758 S.W.2d 390 (Tex. App.—Fort Worth 1988, no writ)”
patterns.context: 出现在判例名称、法院与年份、法条编号、卷页号等法律引注中；被标记的可以是缩写片段、数字或标点。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决、法规及判例引注

patterns.name: 法院判决书结构与程序用语
patterns.context: 法律文书的案情、程序、审查标准或诉讼当事人标题中；常与法院名称、案件编号和判决格式并列。
patterns.domain: 美国法院意见、上诉判决及诉讼文书

patterns.name: 法律正文中的专名与法规主题词
patterns.context: 出现在机构名称、法律术语或法律争议对象中；有些标记覆盖专名内部的词片段。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、法律词典引述及财产豁免讨论

patterns.name: 目录式航海术语与断词
patterns.context: 出现在章节标题及船型名称列表中，包含被拆开的航海词；未见明显法律上下文。
patterns.domain: 航海类书籍的目录或说明文字

en.description: Primarily responds to distinctive citation formats in legal texts: Code abbreviations, subsection parentheses, and case citations; criminal drug decision language also appears. Other patterns include nautical rigging vocabulary and in-word capitalized fragments in philosophical titles.

patterns.name: Code abbreviations and citation punctuation in U.S. statutes
patterns.context: U.S. decisions or legal texts contain federal code section numbers, parenthetical subsections, and citation separators; activations often fall on split abbreviation characters and punctuation.

patterns.name: Case citation formats
patterns.context: Case names, reporter volumes and pages, courts, and years in court opinions or legal discussion.

patterns.name: Ship rigging and vessel-type vocabulary
patterns.context: Rigging, sails, and vessel types discussed in nautical manual catalogs or body text.

patterns.name: Criminal charges and drug distribution language
patterns.context: Criminal cases describing drug distribution, possession, conspiracy, and counts charged, often occurring with statutory citations.

patterns.name: In-word capitalized fragments in philosophical terms
patterns.context: Titles or body text present ontological arguments and related philosophical discussion in capitals; activation clusters on letter fragments within words.

1_787.concept: 法律引证与格式线索
1_787.description: 主要响应法律文本中特征鲜明的引证格式：法典缩写、条款括号与案件引证；也见毒品刑事判决措辞。另有航海索具词汇和哲学标题中的词内大写片段。

patterns.name: 美国法条中的法典缩写与引证标点
patterns.context: 美国判决或法律文本中出现联邦法典条款号、括号子款和引证分隔符；激活常落在被拆分标记的缩写字符及标点上

patterns.name: 判例引证格式
patterns.context: 法院意见或法律论述中的案件名、报告卷页、法院与年份等引证格式
patterns.domain: 法律判决及法律学术写作

patterns.name: 船舶索具与船型词汇
patterns.context: 航海手册目录或正文中讨论索具、帆装和船型

patterns.name: 法律罪名及分配毒品的措辞
patterns.context: 刑事案件中叙述毒品分配、持有、共谋及起诉罪数，常与法条引证同现

patterns.name: 哲学术语中的词内大写片段
patterns.context: 标题或正文以大写呈现本体论论证及相关哲学讨论；激活集中在词内字母片段

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in U.S. legal texts: jurisdictions and court names, statutes and case citations, litigation-procedure terms, and case captions. There are also sporadic activations on nautical rigging terms and bark in the botanical sense.

patterns.name: Jurisdiction names in legal documents
patterns.context: Proper names such as states, counties, and courts occur in legal facts, rulings, or case narratives; often adjacent to legal place-name markers such as Court, County, and State
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Legal citation and statutory-number formats
patterns.context: Combinations of abbreviations and punctuation in citations to codes, case reporters, docket numbers, and volumes/pages in legal documents

patterns.name: Litigation procedure and judicial language
patterns.context: Legal contexts describing appeals, rulings, applications, remedies, or procedural actions by parties

patterns.name: Proper names and title formats in legal documents
patterns.context: Case captions, party names, institutional names, or job titles, often formatted in uppercase, abbreviations, or title style
patterns.domain: U.S. case captions and case narratives

patterns.name: Maritime rigging vocabulary and headings
patterns.context: Discusses ropes, ship rigging, and sailing-ship categories; strings such as rig/rigged and bark(s) occur within words or at word endings

patterns.name: Bark in plant names
patterns.context: When describing plants or sources of bark, bark occurs as a plural noun

1_787.concept: 法律文书格式与专名
1_787.description: 激活主要集中于美国法律文本：司法辖区与法院名称、法条和判例引文、诉讼程序词及案件抬头；另对航海索具词及植物意义的bark有零星激活。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的司法管辖区名称
patterns.context: 州、县、法院名称等专名出现在法律事实、裁判或案情叙述中；常邻接 Court、County、State 等法律地名标记

patterns.name: 法律引文与法规编号格式
patterns.context: 法律文书中法典、判例汇编、案卷编号及卷页引文的缩写和标点组合

patterns.name: 诉讼程序与裁判用语
patterns.context: 描述上诉、裁判、申请、救济或当事人程序行为的法律语境

patterns.name: 法律文书中的专名与头衔格式
patterns.context: 案件标题、当事人姓名、机构名称或职务称谓，常以大写、缩写或标题排版出现
patterns.domain: 美国判例抬头及案件叙述

patterns.name: 海事索具词汇及标题
patterns.context: 讨论绳索、船舶索具与帆船类别，词中或词尾出现 rig/rigged、bark(s) 等字样

patterns.name: 植物名称中的 bark
patterns.context: 描述植物或树皮来源时，bark 作为树皮名词复数出现

en.concept: Legal Documents and Citation Formats, with Nautical Vocabulary
en.description: Primarily responds to case citations, statutes and criminal sentencing, and judicial review and procedural language in U.S. legal texts; also includes one instance of nautical rigging vocabulary and catalog formatting.

patterns.name: U.S. case citation formats
patterns.context: Cites court decisions in legal arguments, especially case names, reporter volume numbers, and page numbers; also includes standalone case captions and citations.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law, legal documents, and legal encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Criminal statutes and sentencing terminology
patterns.context: Describes charges, statutes, evidence, or penalties in criminal cases; case citations need not also be present.

patterns.name: Legal review and procedural language
patterns.context: Explains standards of evidence review, procedural safeguards, admission of evidence, or the effect of an identical issue in legal opinions.
patterns.domain: U.S. judicial opinions and litigation documents

patterns.name: Nautical rigging vocabulary and formatting
patterns.context: In nautical book catalogs or body text, discussing vessel categories and rigging, with capitalized headings, line breaks, or hyphenated words.

1_787.concept: 法律文书与引证格式，兼含航海词汇
1_787.description: 主要对美国法律文本中的判例引证、法条与刑事量刑，以及司法审查和程序措辞起反应；另有一次航海索具词汇及目录排版激活。

patterns.name: 美国判例引证格式
patterns.trigger: « v»、« U»«.»«S» 及其后数字、逗号和引证信息；如 « v»1.« United»1« States»7, 364« U»10«.»3«S»4«.»3 507
patterns.context: 法律论证中引用法院判例，尤其出现案名、法院报告卷号及页码；也包括独立列出的判例标题与引证
patterns.domain: 美国判例法、法律文书与法律百科条目

patterns.name: 刑事法条与量刑术语
patterns.trigger: « counts»、« distribution»、« violation»、« U»«.»«S»«.»«C»、« mandatory»« minimum»、« years»，以及« op»«ium»
patterns.context: 刑事案件中叙述罪名、法条、证据或刑罚；不要求同时出现判例引用

patterns.name: 法律审查与程序措辞
patterns.trigger: « factual»« findings»« supported»、« legal»« conclusions»、« reasonable»« basis»、« due»« process»、« admission»、« consent»
patterns.context: 法律意见书中说明证据审查标准、程序保障、证据采纳或同一争点的效力
patterns.domain: 美国司法意见与诉讼文书

patterns.name: 航海索具词汇与排版
patterns.context: 航海书籍目录或正文，谈船舶类别、索具，且有大写标题、换行或断词排版

en.concept: Legal citations and fragments of legal text
en.description: Primarily activates on statutory provisions, case citations, and litigation terminology in U.S. legal texts. A few nautical and nature-related examples are triggered by the forms “rig” or “bark(s)” and do not fit entirely into the legal pattern.

patterns.name: U.S. Code citation format
patterns.context: Forms code names, section numbers, and subsection citations in U.S. legal texts; activation is distributed across multiple characters or fragments in the citation.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions, pleadings, and statutory citations

patterns.name: Supreme Court case citations
patterns.context: Case names and United States Reports citations, especially United States and U.S. reporter volumes and pages.
patterns.domain: U.S. judicial opinions and case citations

patterns.name: Fixed terms in legal arguments
patterns.context: Discusses evidentiary standards of review, legal conclusions, exemptions, or statutory violations; these terms occur near citations or in judicial-argument sentences.

patterns.name: Procedural or claim language in legal texts
patterns.context: Describes filing an application, criminal charges, or litigation procedure; often adjacent to statutory numbers, offenses, or case facts.
patterns.domain: Legal pleadings and judicial fact statements

patterns.name: Nautical terms containing rig and section headings
patterns.context: Nautical equipment, vessel types, and section headings; “bar{ks}” refers to bark(s) here, not legal citations.

patterns.name: Natural-history words containing ks
patterns.context: In parallel descriptions of the bark of pine, yew, and other trees, activation falls within the word barks; this overlaps in form with bark(s) in nautical passages, but the context differs.

1_787.concept: 法律引文与法律文本片段
1_787.description: 主要对美国法律文本中的法典条款、判例引文及诉讼术语激活；另有少量由“rig”或“bark(s)”词形触发的航海和自然类例子，不能完全归入法律模式。

patterns.name: 美国法典引文格式
patterns.context: 在美国法律文本中组成法典名称、条款编号和子款引文；激活分布在引文的多个字符或片段上。
patterns.domain: 美国法律意见、诉状及法规引文

patterns.name: 最高法院判例引文
patterns.trigger: «v»、«United»、«States»、«U»、«S»及卷页格式，如“Reina v. United States, 364 U.S. 507”“340 U.S. 135”
patterns.context: 案件名称及《美国判例汇编》引文，尤其 United States 和 U.S. 报告卷页。
patterns.domain: 美国司法判决及判例引用

patterns.name: 法律论证中的固定术语
patterns.context: 讨论证据审查标准、法律结论、豁免或违反法规；这些词在引文附近或司法论证句中出现。

patterns.name: 法律程序或主张表述
patterns.context: 描述提交申请、刑事指控或诉讼程序；常与法规编号、罪名或案件事实相邻。
patterns.domain: 法律诉状与司法事实陈述

patterns.name: 含 rig 的航海词及章节标题
patterns.context: 航海器具、船型及章节标题；“bar{ks}”在此指 bark(s)，不是法律引文。

patterns.name: 含 ks 的自然词
patterns.context: 在松树、紫杉等树皮的并列描述中，激活落在 barks 一词内部；与航海段的 bark(s) 词形重合，但语境不同。
patterns.domain: 化学或自然类说明文字

en.concept: Academic research and medical quantitative expressions
en.description: One pattern activates on researchers in academic contexts; another strongly activates on the Quant- initial subword fragment in medical titles, followed by various quantitative forms covering blood flow, valves, biomarkers, metabolites, drugs, electrical activity, and comorbidities.

patterns.name: researchers
patterns.context: “researchers” appears in academic sentences, followed by their research, roles, or research subjects; examples include “Chemical Technology researchers develop…”、“In many experimental situations, researchers have…”及“Nurses play key roles … and researchers to eliminate…”
patterns.domain: Research funding/technology research and medical papers

patterns.name: Quant- initial subword fragment
patterns.context: Medical paper titles or title-like phrases begin with Quant, forming expressions for quantification, quantitative analysis, or quantifying diseases; subsequent words and research subjects vary

1_1165.concept: 学术研究与医学量化表述
1_1165.description: 一类激活于学术语境中的 researchers；另一类强烈激活于医学标题中 Quant 词首片段，后接多种量化词形，涉及血流、瓣膜、标志物、代谢物、药物、电活动及合并症。

patterns.name: researchers
patterns.context: 学术句子中出现“researchers”，后接其研究、角色或研究对象；分别为“Chemical Technology researchers develop…”、“In many experimental situations, researchers have…”及“Nurses play key roles … and researchers to eliminate…”
patterns.domain: 科研资助/技术研究与医学论文

patterns.name: Quant 词首片段
patterns.context: 医学论文标题或标题式短语以 Quant 开头，构成数量化、定量分析或量化疾病的表达；后续词语和研究对象不固定
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题或摘要

en.description: Activation concentrates on researchers in academic contexts and the Quant- prefix of quantitative terms in biomedical titles; the former occurs across research and medical texts, while the latter covers diverse quantitative research topics.

patterns.name: researchers term
patterns.context: Appears as the noun researchers in academic contexts; can refer to researchers in chemical technology or occur in descriptions of research design or professional roles.

patterns.name: Quant- quantitative terms
patterns.context: In medical or biomedical titles, Quant- is the prefix of terms related to quantification and quantitative analysis; strong activation falls on the prefix fragment rather than a fixed suffix.

1_1165.concept: 学术研究与量化术语
1_1165.description: 激活集中在学术语境的 researchers，以及生物医学标题中量化相关词的 Quant- 词首；前者跨科研与医学文本，后者覆盖多种定量研究主题。

patterns.name: researchers 词
patterns.context: 在学术语境中以 researchers 作为名词出现；既可指化学技术领域的研究人员，也可处于研究设计或职业角色描述中。

patterns.name: Quant- 开头的量化术语
patterns.context: 医学或生物医学标题中，Quant- 作为量化、定量分析相关词的词首；强激活落在词首片段，而非固定的后缀。
patterns.domain: PubMed 生物医学论文标题

en.description: Primarily activates on the plural word researchers (1–3) and the Quant- prefix of quantitative terms in biomedical texts (4–10); a few cases also respond to their suffixes or to fragments of coordinated terms and objects in quantitative analyses.

patterns.name: researchers term
patterns.context: The noun researchers appears in plural form, in descriptions of researchers and lists of professional roles.

patterns.name: Quant- prefix
patterns.context: The word begins with Quant, followed by Quantitation, Quantification, Quantitative, or Quantifying; activation concentrates on the prefix fragment.

patterns.name: Continuation fragments related to quantification
patterns.context: Appears after a Quant- term or in the objects of quantification and coordinated analysis content; not all similar fragments are marked.

1_1165.concept: 科研与量化术语词形
1_1165.description: 主要激活于 researchers 这一复数词（1–3），以及生物医学文本中 Quant- 量化词词首（4–10）；少数还响应其后缀或量化分析中的并列、对象词片段。

patterns.name: researchers 词
patterns.context: 名词 researchers 以复数形式出现；分别出现在研究者描述及职业角色列表中
patterns.domain: 科研、公共卫生/护理文献

patterns.name: Quant- 词首
patterns.context: 词首为 Quant，后续构成 Quantitation、Quantification、Quantitative 或 Quantifying；激活集中在词首片段
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题及摘要

patterns.name: 量化相关延续片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Quant- 词之后或量化对象、并列分析内容中；并非所有同类片段均有标记
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题及摘要

en.description: Activation occurs primarily on the Quant- initial subword fragment in medical literature titles, and also on researchers; the former covers various quantitative analysis topics, while the latter occurs in descriptions of researchers’ activities or roles.

patterns.name: Quant- initial subword fragment
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the Quant initial subword fragment, which appears at the beginning of titles or phrases; subsequent word formation and topics vary
patterns.domain: PubMed medical paper titles or abstract fragments

patterns.name: researchers
patterns.context: The word appears in sentences describing researchers’ work or roles; surrounding topics vary
patterns.domain: NIH project descriptions and PubMed medical abstracts

1_1165.concept: 科研与定量研究术语
1_1165.description: 激活主要落在医学文献标题中的 Quant- 词首，也落在 researchers 一词；前者涵盖多种定量分析主题，后者见于科研人员活动或角色描述。

patterns.name: Quant- 词首
patterns.context: 激活集中在 Quant 这一词首片段，出现在标题或短语开头；后续构词和主题各异
patterns.domain: PubMed 医学论文标题或摘要片段

patterns.name: researchers
patterns.context: 该词出现在描述研究人员开展工作或承担角色的句子中；前后主题不同
patterns.domain: NIH 项目描述及 PubMed 医学摘要

en.description: Activation concentrates on two types of textual cues: the word researchers and the Quant- prefix at the beginning of biomedical titles or abstracts. The former occurs in various research-related contexts, while the latter covers diverse quantitative measurement topics.

patterns.name: Researcher identity term
patterns.context: The word researchers itself is strongly activated; it appears in descriptions of authors conducting small-molecule screening research, researchers discussing experimental design, and lists of nursing roles.
patterns.domain: Chemical technology, research methods, nursing education

patterns.name: Quant prefix
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a sentence or title-like phrase, followed by quantitation, quantification, quantitative, or quantifying; activation concentrates on the prefix Quant rather than subsequent morphemes.

1_1165.concept: 科研与定量研究词汇
1_1165.description: 激活集中于两类文本线索：researchers 一词，以及生物医学标题或摘要开头的 Quant- 词首；前者见于多种研究相关语境，后者涵盖多类定量测量主题。

patterns.name: 研究者身份词
patterns.context: 词语 researchers 本身被强激活；分别出现在介绍小分子筛选研究的作者群体、实验设计讨论中的研究者，以及护理人员角色列举中。
patterns.domain: 化学技术、研究方法、护理教育

patterns.name: Quant 词首
patterns.context: 出现在句首或标题式短语开头，后接 quantitation、quantification、quantitative 或 quantifying；激活集中在词首 Quant，而非后续词素。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题与摘要

en.description: All segments contain researchers, which is the strongest activation point; research, scientific, investigate, and other research-related terms also activate weakly in some segments. Other marked words are sporadic and difficult to group under a single condition.

patterns.name: The word researchers
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the noun researchers; in some examples, it is followed by research goals, subjects, or actions.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, medical abstracts, and research project texts

patterns.name: Other research-related words
patterns.context: Words related to research activities or scientific fields show weaker activation; however, they are not common triggers across all segments, and strong activation remains on researchers.

patterns.name: Unclear activation on neighboring words
patterns.context: Sporadic words are marked as activated in individual segments, but there is insufficient evidence of recurrence across segments to confirm a stable pattern.
patterns.domain: Chemistry, statistics, public health, medicine, and other genres

1_1165.concept: 科研人员
1_1165.description: 所有段均含 researchers，且该词是最强激活点；若干段中 research、scientific、investigate 等科研词也弱激活。其余标记词分散，难归为统一条件。

patterns.name: researchers 一词
patterns.context: 激活集中在 researchers 这个名词上；部分例子位于 researchers 后接研究目标、研究对象或动作的语境中。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学摘要及科研项目文本

patterns.name: 其他科研相关词
patterns.context: 科研活动或科学领域的词汇出现时有较弱激活；但这些词并非各段共同触发因素，且强激活仍落在 researchers 上。

patterns.name: 未明的邻近词激活
patterns.trigger: « small»1、« approaches»2、« measured»3、« covariates»4、« essential»4 等
patterns.context: 零散词语在个别段落标记为激活，但缺少跨段重复证据，难以确认其是否属于稳定模式。
patterns.domain: 化学、统计、公共卫生及医学等不同文体

en.description: Every fragment activates on “researchers.” It occurs across disciplines, genres, and semantic contexts; surrounding text often describes researchers’ work, teams, or data, but segment 9 discusses online privacy, so the core trigger appears to be the word itself.

patterns.name: The word “researchers”
patterns.context: The word itself is the most stable trigger; it functions in the sentence as a noun for a group of researchers, without requiring a particular syntax or topic in the surrounding text.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, research project descriptions, and general online text

patterns.name: Researchers conducting or participating in research
patterns.context: Researchers appear as the agents, participants, or target groups of research activities; no single discipline or method is required.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, public health, psychopathology, chemical technology, neuroscience, and social sciences

patterns.name: Researchers and data or public issues
patterns.context: Researchers are described as parties obtaining data or information; this is not a typical account of a research team in an academic abstract.
patterns.domain: Online commentary and discussions of privacy and data disclosure

1_1165.concept: researchers（研究者）
1_1165.description: 所有片段都在“researchers”处激活。它跨学科、文体和语义场景出现；周围常描述研究者的工作、团队或数据，但第9段是网络隐私讨论，故触发核心更像该词本身。

patterns.name: “researchers”一词
patterns.context: 该词本身是最稳定的触发点；在句中作为研究者群体的名词，前后文不要求特定句法或主题。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、研究项目描述及一般网络文本

patterns.name: 研究者开展或参与研究
patterns.trigger: “researchers”及其周围关于研究、研究团队、科学或研究数据的表述，如 «researchers»10 develop、«researchers»10 observed、«researchers»10 studying
patterns.context: 研究者作为研究活动的主体、参与者或目标群体；不局限于单一学科，也不要求特定方法。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、公共卫生、心理病理学、化学技术、神经科学及社会科学

patterns.name: 研究者与数据或公共议题
patterns.trigger: «researchers»10 附近出现数据发布及其影响的叙述，如 “Giving the search history … to «researchers»10”
patterns.context: 研究者作为获取数据或信息的一方；此处不是典型学术摘要中的研究团队叙述。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、隐私与数据发布讨论

en.concept: The designation researchers in research contexts
en.description: Strong activation is concentrated on researchers, especially the plural designation in research abstracts or project texts; it also occurs in contexts involving collaborative teams, project participants, and target audiences. No other related words are marked as strongly activated.

patterns.name: Researcher designation researchers
patterns.context: Appears in the context of scientific papers or research projects, often as the subject of verbs such as “develop,” “have,” and “include,” or as participants, audiences, or team members; the token itself is marked as strongly activated.
patterns.domain: Scientific research abstracts, research plans, and project descriptions

patterns.name: Variants of the researcher designation researchers
patterns.context: Appears as forum participants, research project members, or team categories in research projects or collaborative research contexts; comparatively weaker activation.

patterns.name: Possible research/researcher semantic cues
patterns.context: Related to research/research team, but the strong activation markers actually fall on researchers or its variants, so it cannot be determined whether these words themselves are triggers.
patterns.domain: Scientific research abstracts and project descriptions

1_1165.concept: 科研语境中的研究者称谓
1_1165.description: 强激活集中于 researchers，尤以科研摘要或项目文本中的复数研究者称谓为显著；也见于协作团队、项目参与者和目标受众语境。其他相关词未标出强激活。

patterns.name: 研究者称谓 researchers
patterns.context: 出现在科研论文或研究项目语境中，常作“develop”“have”“include”等动词的主语，或作为参与者、受众、团队成员；该词 token 本身标出强激活。
patterns.domain: 科学研究摘要、研究计划与项目描述

patterns.name: 研究者称谓 researchers 的变体
patterns.context: 科研项目或协作研究语境中，作为论坛参与者、研究项目成员或团队类别出现；相对激活较弱。

patterns.name: 可能的研究/研究者语义线索
patterns.context: 与 research/research team 相关，但强激活标记实际落在 researchers 或其变体上，不能确定这些词本身是否触发。
patterns.domain: 科学研究摘要与项目描述

en.description: The neuron primarily responds to the English noun couple, covering uses such as partners, an approximate number, and paired objects; it also responds to a few instances of the verb couple meaning to link or combine. The shared form is couple, but the meanings and syntactic functions differ.

patterns.name: Noun couple
patterns.context: As a noun, refers to a pair of partners, two people, or a pair of objects; examples include “the couple”“a couple of”“observations par couple”“a couple of local hard disk drives” and other constructions.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including news, research, encyclopedic, and technical texts

patterns.name: Verb couple
patterns.context: Means to connect or couple a receptor to an intracellular second-messenger system; this is a verbal use, not a reference to a pair of people or things.

patterns.name: couple in a phrase and concatenation in a quotation
patterns.context: “couple” is a verb meaning to combine two research topics; the surrounding text introduces an institution and CRISP entries, then a topic in quantum dynamics.

1_1165.concept: couple 词形
1_1165.description: 神经元主要响应英文名词 couple，涵盖伴侣、约数及成对对象等用法；也响应少量表示耦联、结合的动词 couple。共同形式是 couple，但词义和句法功能不同。

patterns.name: 名词 couple
patterns.context: 作为名词指一对伴侣、两个人，或一对成对的对象；包括“the couple”“a couple of”“observations par couple”“a couple of local hard disk drives”等不同搭配。
patterns.domain: 新闻、科研、百科、技术文本等多种文体

patterns.name: 动词 couple
patterns.context: 表示将受体与细胞内第二信使系统连接或耦联；此处为动词用法，而非指一对人或物。

patterns.name: 短语 couple 与引文中的拼接
patterns.context: “couple”作动词，表示把两个研究主题结合；前后文介绍机构和 CRISP 条目，随后接量子动力学主题。
patterns.domain: 科研资助/研究介绍文本

en.concept: Specified entities and their applicability relations
en.description: The most salient pattern is those followed by a modifier, relative clause, or noun identifying a specific entity; activation also commonly occurs on for introducing a use or target and on and as a coordinator. Other local patterns include psychological relational judgments, religious salvation, people with accessibility needs, and HTML template markers.

patterns.name: those followed by a population or entity
patterns.context: Activation falls on those; a modifier or relative clause that follows specifies the referent, commonly in those with, those associated, and those causes.
patterns.domain: Medical, research, religious Q&A, and general expository texts

patterns.name: Use or applicable entity introduced by for
patterns.context: for introduces a therapeutic use, beneficiary group, or applicable entity; activation falls on the preposition for.
patterns.domain: Patent background, medical research, and general expository texts

patterns.name: and connecting coordinated items
patterns.context: Activation falls on the coordinating conjunction and, which connects entities, diseases, attributes, or clauses; it often occurs with lists or elaboration.
patterns.domain: Medical research and general expository texts

patterns.name: Relational, causal, and judgment vocabulary
patterns.context: Discusses beliefs, causal attribution, relationships, or judgments; activation is distributed across these related words rather than being limited to the those construction.

patterns.name: Faith and salvation context
patterns.context: Discusses whether those who once believed can attain eternal salvation; those refers to people who once believed.

patterns.name: Visual impairment and special needs
patterns.context: Uses those with to introduce a group with specific needs or visual conditions.

patterns.name: HTML comments and template markers
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on HTML comments, layout names, and template closing markers; this differs from the other semantic patterns.

1_1165.concept: 限定对象及其适用关系
1_1165.description: 最显著模式是 those 后接限定语、关系从句或名词，指明特定对象；也常激活于 for 引出的用途或对象及 and 并列连接。另有心理学关系判断词、宗教救赎、无障碍人群和 HTML 模板标记等局部模式。

patterns.name: those 后接人群或对象
patterns.trigger: those« … »，包括 “those associated”“those with asthma”“those causes”“those patients”
patterns.context: 激活落在 those 上；其后由限定语或关系从句说明所指对象，常见于 those with、those associated、those causes。
patterns.domain: 医学、科研、宗教问答及一般说明文

patterns.name: for 引出的用途或适用对象
patterns.context: for 引出治疗用途、受益人群或适用对象；激活落在介词 for 上。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学科研及一般说明文

patterns.name: and 连接并列项
patterns.context: 激活落在并列连词 and 上，连接对象、疾病、属性或分句；多与列举或补充说明同现。
patterns.domain: 医学科研与一般说明文

patterns.name: 关系、因果与判断词汇
patterns.context: 谈论信念、因果归因、关系或判断；激活分布在这些相关词上，而非仅限 those 结构。

patterns.name: 信仰与救赎语境
patterns.trigger: “salvation”“those who at one time truly believed”
patterns.context: 讨论曾经相信者是否能获得永恒救赎，those 指曾经相信的人。

patterns.name: 视觉障碍与特殊需求
patterns.trigger: “those with special needs”“those with impaired vision”
patterns.context: 以 those with 引出特定需求或视觉状况的人群。
patterns.domain: 社区宣传与无障碍主题文章

patterns.name: HTML 注释及模板标记
patterns.context: 激活集中在 HTML 注释、布局名和模板闭合标记；与其他语义模式不同。

en.concept: Word segments containing man and the title chairman
en.description: The strong pattern is the title chairman (4 segments); man also activates in the Spanish and Portuguese words manera, manutenção, and manos, and in the English phrase androgynous man. The remaining examples involve research on sexual behavior among young people, a medical enzyme name, mechanisms and copies in philosophy, and EU peacekeeping.

patterns.name: Political/institutional title “chairman”
patterns.context: chairman appears in descriptions of people in political organizations, parliaments, committees, or institutions, especially as a title or role
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, medical institution reports, political commentary

patterns.name: man forms and neighboring words
patterns.context: man appears as a complete word or as part of a subword fragment; the contexts respectively concern manner, maintenance, hands, and androgynous man

patterns.name: Sexual intercourse and unmarried youth
patterns.context: The study title and abstract discuss sexual behavior and related determinants among unmarried adolescents in Malaysia

patterns.name: phosphohexose isomerase terminology
patterns.context: A medical abstract title discusses the diagnostic and prognostic significance of serum phosphohexose isomerase

patterns.name: Abstract mechanisms and copies of impressions
patterns.context: Discusses temporality, mechanisms producing impressions, and when copies held by readers appear or disappear

patterns.name: EU and African peacekeeping
patterns.context: A European Parliament speech discusses cases in which the EU needs solutions or contributions from Africa, including peacekeeping

1_1165.concept: 含man的词段及chairman职务词
1_1165.description: 强模式是 chairman 职务称谓（4段）；另在西葡语的 manera、manutenção、manos 及英语 androgynous man 中激活 man 字符串。其余分别涉及青年性行为研究、医学酶名、哲学中的机制与副本、欧盟和平维护。

patterns.name: “chairman”政治/机构职务
patterns.context: 在政治组织、议会、委员会或机构人物介绍中出现 chairman，尤其是头衔或职务描述
patterns.domain: 百科人物传记、医疗机构报告、政治评论

patterns.name: man词形及其邻近词
patterns.context: man作为完整词或跨子词边界的一部分出现；上下文分别涉及方式、维护、手、以及androgynous man
patterns.domain: 西班牙语、葡萄牙语及英语片段

patterns.name: sexual intercourse与未婚青年
patterns.context: 研究标题及摘要讨论马来西亚未婚青少年的性行为及相关决定因素

patterns.name: phosphohexose isomerase术语
patterns.trigger: «Diagn»1«ostic»2« and»3« prognostic»8« significance»10« of»1 serum phospho«hex»1«ose»3 is«omerase»2
patterns.context: 医学摘要标题中，讨论血清磷酸己糖异构酶的诊断和预后意义

patterns.name: 抽象机制与印象副本
patterns.context: 讨论时间性、机制产生印象以及读者持有的副本何时出现或消失

patterns.name: 欧盟与非洲的和平维护
patterns.trigger: « à»3 Uni«ão»2 Europeia；« man»9uten«ção»2« da»1« pa»2z
patterns.context: 欧洲议会发言讨论欧盟需要非洲提供解决方案或贡献的案例，包括维护和平
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语欧洲议会辩论

en.description: Activation is scattered across word-initial and internal fragments and a few complete words in multilingual text: sentence-initial Nor, English content words, Spanish and Portuguese word forms, French words, as well as medical terms and proper names. No unified semantic or syntactic pattern is apparent beyond local contexts.

patterns.name: Word-initial Nor
patterns.context: Activation falls on sentence-initial English fragments or word-initial internal fragments; the context shows no stable semantic requirement.

patterns.name: Spanish word-final/internal fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Spanish text, activation is distributed across internal word fragments and common short words; it does not correspond to a single meaning.

patterns.name: English content-word fragments
patterns.context: In English titles or academic abstracts, activation falls on several content words, with no consistent part of speech or semantics.

patterns.name: French spatial-location fragment
patterns.context: In French imaging descriptions, occurs within the lesion-location phrase “central à gauche”.

patterns.name: Portuguese word-form fragment
patterns.context: In Portuguese parliamentary text, occurs within the phrase “nível ministerial”.

patterns.name: Biochemical term fragment
patterns.context: In discussions of TMAO and its precursor products, activation falls on the phrase “predecessor products”.

patterns.name: Proper-name/code fragment
patterns.context: In GitHub titles or identifiers, activation falls within common words and proper names; there is no clear semantic commonality.

patterns.name: English evaluative outcome term
patterns.context: In descriptions of health outcomes, occurs within the phrase “poorer long-term health outcomes”.

1_1165.concept: none
1_1165.description: 激活分散于多语种文本中的词首、词内片段和少数完整词：含句首 Nor、英语内容词、西葡法语词形，以及医学术语和专名。除局部语境外未见统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 词首Nor
patterns.context: 激活落在句首的英语片段或词内词首；上下文未显示稳定的语义要求。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词尾/词内片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语连续文本中，激活分布在词内片段及常见短词上；并非单一词义。

patterns.name: 英语内容词片段
patterns.context: 英语标题或学术摘要中，激活落在若干内容词上，未见一致的词类或语义。

patterns.name: 法语空间方位片段
patterns.context: 法语影像描述中，位于病灶位置描述“central à gauche”内。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 放射学/临床描述

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词形片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会文本中，出现在“nível ministerial”一词内。

patterns.name: 生化术语片段
patterns.context: TMAO 及其前体产物的讨论中，激活落在“predecessor products”一词上。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学文本

patterns.name: 专名/代码片段
patterns.context: GitHub 标题或标识符中，激活落在普通词及专名内部片段；无明确语义共性。

patterns.name: 英语评价性结果词
patterns.context: 健康结局表述中，出现在“poorer long-term health outcomes”短语内。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 临床研究摘要

en.description: Strong activation occurs primarily on the double hyphen «--» at the beginning of a line, as seen in code, comments, and email text; there is also activation on «Others» in a title contrasting the rich and the poor. Strong activation on «Nor» (Noradrenergic), «Among», and «predecessor» has no identifiable shared pattern.

patterns.name: Double hyphen
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of code, comments, or text lines; the following content varies
patterns.domain: GitHub code and repository text; Enron email signatures

patterns.name: Others in a contrasting title
patterns.context: The title “Why Some Countries Are Poor and Others Rich” contrasts poverty and wealth; other words in the same sentence also activate more weakly

1_1165.concept: none
1_1165.description: 主要对行首双连字符 «--» 强烈激活，见于代码、注释和邮件文本；另对贫富对比标题中的 «Others» 激活。«Nor»（Noradrenergic）、«Among» 和 «predecessor» 的强激活缺少可确认的共同模式。

patterns.name: 双连字符
patterns.context: 出现在代码、注释或文本行开头，后续内容各异
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码与仓库文本；Enron 邮件署名

patterns.name: 对比标题中的 Others
patterns.context: 标题以“Why Some Countries Are Poor and Others Rich”构成贫富对比；同句其他词也有较弱激活

en.concept: Word fragments and terminology in medical corpora
en.description: Activation is scattered across French word fragments, English conjunctions, and research-design, risk-factor, and biomedical terms in medical abstracts; some triggers are weak or are subword fragments, with no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: French suffix or function-word token fragments
patterns.context: In French text, activation falls on subword fragments within or near word boundaries, often in suffixes, conjunctions, or short words; the fragments are not fixed.
patterns.domain: French medical text, parliamentary speeches, and technical documents

patterns.name: English and
patterns.context: Coordination structures in English titles or abstracts; activation is very weak.

patterns.name: case-control in disease research
patterns.context: Describes epidemiological study design or explains the case-control method.

patterns.name: Risk and its research contribution
patterns.context: Evaluates disease-related risk factors and their effects, especially in statements of research aims.

patterns.name: Virus- or capsid-related terms
patterns.context: Discusses viruses, capsids, and their changes in virology titles or abstracts.

patterns.name: Disease names and clinical title fragments
patterns.context: Disease, pathology, or pharmacology terms in biomedical titles; activation occurs at the beginning or within terms.

patterns.name: dimorphism
patterns.context: The title contains dimorphism and discusses viral capsids or fungi-related phenomena.

1_1165.concept: 医学语料中的词片段与术语
1_1165.description: 激活分散于法语词片段、英语并列词及医学摘要中的研究设计、风险因素和生物医学术语；部分触发仅弱或为词内子词，未见单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 法语词尾或小词的分词片段
patterns.context: 法语文本中，激活落在词内或词界附近的子词片段，常见于词尾、连词或短词；片段并不固定
patterns.domain: 法语医学文字、议会发言及技术文档

patterns.name: 英语 and
patterns.context: 英语标题或摘要中的并列结构；只有极弱激活

patterns.name: 疾病研究中的 case-control
patterns.context: 描述流行病学研究设计或解释病例对照方法时

patterns.name: 风险及其研究贡献
patterns.context: 评估疾病相关风险因素及其影响，尤其是研究目的句

patterns.name: 病毒或衣壳相关词
patterns.context: 病毒学标题或摘要中讨论病毒、衣壳及其变化

patterns.name: 疾病名称及临床标题片段
patterns.context: 生物医学标题中的疾病、病理或药理术语，激活位于术语开头或内部

patterns.name: dimorphism
patterns.context: 标题中出现 dimorphism，讨论病毒衣壳或真菌相关现象

en.description: Primarily responds to word forms related to polymorphism/dimorphism and their medical and genetic contexts; there is also sporadic activation on group proportions, screening, pharmacological effects, smoking surveys, Spanish link text, and clinical demographic comparisons.

patterns.name: Morphological polymorphism/dimorphism terminology
patterns.context: In biological or medical contexts, describes morphological differences or polymorphism in species, viral capsids, or loci; related terms may appear in titles or body text

patterns.name: Nouns concerning proportions or populations
patterns.context: Describes the proportion of patient groups, or animal populations and their genetic characteristics

patterns.name: Noun habits followed by a population
patterns.context: Surveys smoking habits and attitudes among a specific occupational group

patterns.name: Screening-related expressions
patterns.context: Introduces cancer screening tests and their effectiveness

patterns.name: Pharmacological effect expressions
patterns.context: Lists noradrenergic and dopaminergic effects

patterns.name: Spanish link suggestions
patterns.context: Suggests that readers repair broken links on a website and link to a blog post

patterns.name: Comparison of white people and weight
patterns.context: Compares the demographic characteristics of postoperative patients or different graft groups

1_1165.concept: 多态性及医学研究术语
1_1165.description: 主要对多态/二态相关词形及其医学、遗传学语境反应；另对群体比例、筛查、药理效应、吸烟调查、西语链接文本和临床人口学比较有零散激活。

patterns.name: 形态多态/二态术语
patterns.context: 生物学或医学语境中描述物种、病毒衣壳或基因座的形态差异、多态性；相关词可出现在标题或正文

patterns.name: 关于比例或群体的名词
patterns.context: 描述患者群体比例，或动物种群及其遗传特征

patterns.name: 名词 habits 后接人群
patterns.context: 调查特定职业人群的吸烟习惯及态度

patterns.name: screening 相关表达
patterns.context: 介绍癌症筛查检测及其效果

patterns.name: 药理效应表达
patterns.context: 并列描述去甲肾上腺素能和多巴胺能效应

patterns.name: 西班牙语链接建议
patterns.context: 建议读者修复网站上的失效链接，并链接到博客文章

patterns.name: 白人及体重比较
patterns.context: 比较术后患者或不同移植物组的人口学特征

en.concept: Polymorphism-related word forms and medical text fragments
en.description: Activation most clearly concentrates on polymorphism-related forms such as -orphism/-ism; it is also scattered across medical population comparisons, genetic terminology, clinical outcomes, and several medical vocabulary fragments, with no unified trigger condition for the latter groups.

patterns.name: Polymorphism-related suffixes
patterns.context: The trigger fragment falls at the end of a term or word form; it sometimes crosses subword boundaries, especially -orphism/-ism.
patterns.domain: Biomedical genetics, virology, disease case descriptions

patterns.name: Population and between-group comparisons
patterns.context: Compares populations, patient groups, cohorts, or outcomes in medical research; this pattern does not align perfectly with specific trigger words.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, epidemiology, and clinical research

patterns.name: among introducing a population
patterns.context: Introduces a population or set of subjects in a sentence, followed by subjects such as cancer screening trials or physicians.
patterns.domain: Medical research and public health abstracts

patterns.name: Disease outcomes and clinical measures
patterns.context: Discusses disease severity, health outcomes, mortality, or clinical research measures; there is no single consistent trigger form.

patterns.name: Genetic and population-characteristic terminology
patterns.context: Describes genetic factors, genetic polymorphism, or population genetic statistics; polymorphism terms also match the first pattern.

patterns.name: Morpheme fragments within medical terms
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across complete medical words or subword fragments; apart from a few fragments, there is no stable common trigger condition.

1_1165.concept: 多态性词形及医学文本片段
1_1165.description: 激活最明确地集中于 -orphism/-ism 等多态性相关词形；另散见医学人群比较、遗传术语、临床结局及若干医学词汇片段，后几类缺乏统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 多态性相关后缀
patterns.context: 触发片段落在术语或词形的末尾；有时跨越子词切分，尤见 -orphism/-ism。
patterns.domain: 生物医学遗传学、病毒学、疾病病例描述

patterns.name: 人群与组间比较
patterns.trigger: « among»、« compared»、« vs»、« groups»，以及表格/统计比较语境
patterns.context: 医学研究中对人群、患者组、队列或结果进行比较；此模式与具体触发词不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、流行病学与临床研究

patterns.name: among 的人群引入
patterns.context: 句中引出某一人群或对象集合，后接癌症筛查试验或医生等对象。
patterns.domain: 医学研究与公共卫生摘要

patterns.name: 疾病结局与临床指标
patterns.trigger: « poorer»、« health»« outcomes»、« disease»« activity»、« mortality»
patterns.context: 谈论疾病严重程度、健康结局、死亡率或临床研究指标；没有统一的单一触发形式。

patterns.name: 遗传及群体特征术语
patterns.context: 描述遗传因素、基因多态性或人群遗传统计；其中多态性词也符合第一模式。
patterns.domain: 遗传学与医学队列研究

patterns.name: 医学术语内部的 morpheme 片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在医学词汇的完整词或子词片段中；除个别片段外，看不出稳定共同触发条件。

en.concept: Expressions of research subjects and population relationships
en.description: Activations occur mainly on prepositions and relational expressions in paper titles or abstracts: introducing populations, connecting research subjects, or presenting statistical comparisons between patients and numerical groups. Also observed in social impact topics and descriptive structures in patent titles.

patterns.name: Populations or comparison subjects introduced by among
patterns.context: Introduces a population at the beginning of a sentence or in a noun phrase, or appears between an action or attribute and a population; often co-occurs with words about populations, habits, and attitudes.

patterns.name: Relational terms in medical statistical comparisons
patterns.context: Used to report statistical relationships, differences, proportions, or comparisons among patient populations, treatments, or clinical outcomes; often appears in abstract text containing numbers, percentages, and abbreviations.

patterns.name: Numerical ranges and age-group comparisons
patterns.context: Age or other numerical values are divided into groups by thresholds, and statistical results across groups are compared; the source contains repeated menarche-related expressions.
patterns.domain: Medical research text, possibly involving cohort or stratified analysis

patterns.name: Social impact topics in titles
patterns.context: A title-style phrase describing social impacts on adolescent sports activities; appears as a topic label rather than a complete sentence.
patterns.domain: Social science or public health titles

patterns.name: Descriptive structure in titles
patterns.context: A title summarizes subject characteristics using the structure “Characteristics of X in Y and Z”.

1_1165.concept: 研究对象与群体关系表达
1_1165.description: 激活主要见于论文标题或摘要中的介词与关系表达：引出群体、连接研究对象，或呈现患者及数值分组间的统计比较；另见社会影响主题和专利标题的特征描述结构。

patterns.name: among 引出的群体或比较对象
patterns.context: 句首或名词短语中引出某群体，或置于行为、属性与群体之间；常与人群、习惯、态度等词共现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文题目或摘要

patterns.name: 医学统计比较中的关系词
patterns.trigger: « differences»；« related»；« versus»；« in»；« for»；« and»
patterns.context: 用于报告患者群体、治疗或临床结局间的统计关系、差异、比例或比较；多见于带数字、百分比、缩写的摘要正文。

patterns.name: 数值范围与年龄分组比较
patterns.context: 年龄或其他数值按阈值分组，并比较不同组的统计结果；原文片段存在重复的 menarche 相关表述。
patterns.domain: 医学研究正文，可能涉及队列或分层分析

patterns.name: 标题中的社会影响主题
patterns.trigger: «Social» « influences» « in» « sports» « activity» « among» « adolescents»
patterns.context: 标题式短语描述青少年体育活动中的社会影响；呈现为主题标签，而非完整句子。
patterns.domain: 社会科学或公共卫生题目

patterns.name: 标题中的特征描述结构
patterns.trigger: «Characteristics» « of» « Wiring» « in» « Homes» « and» « Build»«ings»
patterns.context: 标题以“Characteristics of X in Y and Z”结构概述对象特征。

en.concept: Population comparisons and statistical results in medical research
en.description: Primarily responds to quantitative comparisons of patient populations, disease subgroups, or intervention groups in medical abstracts, especially percentages, clinical outcomes, and statistical measures; there is also a single activation on a sentence introducing cancer screening.

patterns.name: Patient population comparisons in medical research
patterns.context: Describes different patient subgroups, intervention groups, or disease states in clinical research abstracts, and presents between-group comparisons.

patterns.name: Statistical results and numerical comparisons
patterns.context: Reports proportions, risk ratios, confidence intervals, significance, or clinical outcomes, often presenting values for two groups alongside statistical tests.

patterns.name: Sentence introducing cancer screening
patterns.context: Begins with Among and introduces cancer screening programs known to significantly reduce risk; no visible between-group comparison.
patterns.domain: NIH research data or medical background statements

1_1165.concept: 医学研究中的群体比较与统计结果
1_1165.description: 主要响应医学摘要中对患者群体、疾病亚组或干预组的量化比较，尤其是百分比、临床结局及统计指标；另对癌症筛查引入句有单例激活。

patterns.name: 医学研究中患者群体的比较
patterns.context: 在临床研究摘要中描述不同患者亚组、干预组或疾病状态，并列出组间对比。

patterns.name: 统计结果与数值比较
patterns.context: 报告比例、风险比、置信区间、显著性或临床结局，常以两组数值和统计检验并列。

patterns.name: 癌症筛查引入句
patterns.context: 以 Among 开头，介绍已知能显著降低风险的癌症筛查项目；没有可见的组间比较。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究数据或医学背景陈述

en.description: Primarily responds to statistical expressions reporting odds ratios (OR) in medical research, often alongside OR values, 95% CI, percentages, groups, or models; also includes a clinical observation title and a cancer-screening sentence-initial fragment.

patterns.name: Odds ratio abbreviation OR
patterns.context: In statistical results or risk-factor analyses, OR is adjacent to a value, model, confidence interval, or variable; it is sometimes written out as odds ratio.
patterns.domain: Medical research abstracts, epidemiology, and clinical studies

patterns.name: OR results-reporting format
patterns.context: Reports effect sizes in medical statistical text, often accompanied by 95% CI, percentage, group comparisons, or model descriptions; activations involve numbers and statistical terms around OR.
