patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and clinical trials or observational studies

patterns.name: Clinical observation title fragment
patterns.context: A case or clinical observation title in square brackets; the passage is cut off at the start of a treatment description, with no OR present.

patterns.name: Cancer-screening phrase
patterns.context: Sentence-initial Among introduces a cancer-screening program; the fragment is cut off mid-sentence while describing screening effectiveness, with no OR present.

1_1165.concept: 医学统计结果中的 OR
1_1165.description: 主要对医学研究中报告比值比 OR 的统计表达起反应，常连同 OR 数值、95% CI、百分比、分组或模型；另有临床观察标题和癌症筛查句首片段。

patterns.name: 比值比缩写 OR
patterns.context: 统计结果或风险因素分析中，OR 紧邻数值、模型、置信区间或变量；有时被拆成 odds ratio。
patterns.domain: 医学研究摘要、流行病学与临床研究

patterns.name: OR 的结果报告格式
patterns.context: 医学统计文本中报告效应量，常伴随 95% CI、百分比、分组比较或模型说明；激活涉及 OR 周围的数字和统计术语。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要及临床试验、观察性研究

patterns.name: 临床观察标题片段
patterns.context: 方括号内的病例或临床观察标题；本段截断在治疗描述开头，未见 OR。

patterns.name: 癌症筛查短语
patterns.context: 句首 Among 引出癌症筛查项目；片段在说明筛查效果的句子中途截断，未见 OR。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生或癌症筛查研究

en.concept: Titles and results statements in medical research text
en.description: Primarily responds to title-like “Characteristics” phrases; it also responds to population descriptions introduced by “among” and statistical-result contexts reporting ORs and confidence intervals.

patterns.name: Characteristics in titles
patterns.context: A title or title-like phrase begins with “Characteristics of...” or uses “Characteristics and...” to introduce study characteristics, outcomes, or cost impact.

patterns.name: Population comparisons introduced by Among
patterns.context: Introduces a study population or group in descriptions of cancer screening, participation rates, or symptom incidence, often with a comparison.
patterns.domain: Medical and public health research abstracts or results narratives

patterns.name: OR in statistical reports
patterns.context: Appears when reporting odds ratios and their confidence intervals, or comparing population risks/outcomes.

1_1165.concept: 医学研究文本中的标题与结果表述
1_1165.description: 主要响应标题式“Characteristics”短语；也响应医学研究中由“among”引出的群体描述，以及报告 OR、置信区间的统计结果语境。

patterns.name: 标题中的 Characteristics
patterns.context: 标题或标题式短语以“Characteristics of...”开头，或以“Characteristics and...”引出研究特征、结局或成本影响。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学/生物医学论文标题

patterns.name: Among 引出的群体比较
patterns.context: 在癌症筛查、参与率或症状发生率等描述中，引出某个研究人群或群体，常伴随比较。
patterns.domain: 医学与公共卫生研究摘要或结果叙述

patterns.name: 统计报告中的 OR
patterns.context: 在报告比值比及其置信区间、或比较群体风险/结局时出现。
patterns.domain: 流行病学与医学统计结果

en.concept: Expressions of research topics and population characteristics
en.description: Primarily responds to “Characteristics of/and” at the start of titles, especially medical research titles; also activates on the medical statistical abbreviation OR and Among introducing a population.

patterns.name: Title beginning with Characteristics
patterns.context: A title or title-style phrase beginning with “Characteristics of ...”; followed by the subject being described or the research topic.

patterns.name: Title beginning with Characteristics and
patterns.context: A title begins with “Characteristics and ...”, followed by coordinated research topics.

patterns.name: OR abbreviation
patterns.context: Uppercase OR appears in medical research text, possibly as the statistical abbreviation for odds ratio; nearby text may include numbers, N, or numerical results.
patterns.domain: Medical paper abstracts, health research text

patterns.name: Among at the beginning or within a sentence
patterns.context: Among introduces a population, group, or subject at the beginning or within a sentence; examples involve screening tests or smoker groups.

1_1165.concept: 研究主题与人群特征表述
1_1165.description: 主要响应标题开头的“Characteristics of/and”，尤其是医学研究标题；另对医学统计缩写 OR 及引出人群的 Among 有激活。

patterns.name: Characteristics 标题起始
patterns.context: 以 “Characteristics of ...” 开头的标题或标题式短语；后接被描述的对象或研究主题。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学论文标题

patterns.name: Characteristics and 标题起始
patterns.context: 标题以 “Characteristics and ...” 开头，后接并列的研究主题。

patterns.name: OR 缩写
patterns.context: 医学研究文本中出现大写 OR，可能是统计学 odds ratio 的缩写；相邻处可有数字、N 或数值结果。
patterns.domain: 医学论文摘要、健康研究文本

patterns.name: Among 句首或句中
patterns.context: 句首或句中使用 Among 引出人群、组别或对象；例中涉及筛查测试或吸烟者分组。
patterns.domain: 医学研究文本、资助项目描述

en.concept: Title characteristics and odds ratio OR
en.description: Strongly responds to the title-like phrase “Characteristics of …” and also to OR denoting odds ratio in medical statistical results; the two trigger positions and contexts differ.

patterns.name: Characteristics at the start of a title
patterns.context: The phrase begins with “Characteristics of …”, followed by a study subject or topic; in one case it is followed by “and”. Usually a title or title fragment.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstract titles, also patent background titles

patterns.name: OR in statistical comparisons
patterns.context: Reports odds ratios in medical statistical results; often adjacent to comparison groups, CI, risk, or treatment outcomes.

1_1165.concept: 标题特征词与优势比 OR
1_1165.description: 强烈响应标题式短语“Characteristics of …”，也响应医学统计结果中表示优势比的 OR；两类触发位置和语境不同。

patterns.name: Characteristics 标题起始
patterns.context: 短语以“Characteristics of …”开头，后接研究对象或主题；也有一次接“and”。通常是标题或标题片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要标题，另有专利背景标题

patterns.name: 统计比较中的 OR
patterns.context: 医学统计结果中报告 odds ratio；常与比较组、CI、风险或治疗结局相邻。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要中的统计结果

en.concept: Medical research results and statistical reporting
en.description: Primarily responds to statistical reporting in medical abstracts, including OR, confidence intervals, and proportions; also responds to population comparisons and terms for clinical characteristics, risks, and outcomes. Two intraword fragments related to France in Hacker News are also activated and cannot be explained by the medical topic.

patterns.name: Statistical intervals and effect-size format
patterns.context: Reports proportions, OR, confidence intervals, or risk comparisons in medical research abstracts; activations often fall on statistical terms and adjacent numbers or punctuation.

patterns.name: Population comparisons introduced by among
patterns.context: Reports results, frequencies, or screening information by population or category; need not include a statistical measure.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and health research text

patterns.name: Clinical characteristics and outcome terms in medical abstracts
patterns.context: Describes characteristics, risks, associations, and outcomes in studies of diseases, symptoms, or treatments; some examples co-occur with statistical formats such as OR.

patterns.name: Word fragments related to France
patterns.context: Words related to France appear in Hacker News titles or link text, with activations on intraword fragments; these are not in a medical statistical context.

1_1165.concept: 医学研究结果与统计报告
1_1165.description: 主要响应医学摘要中的 OR、置信区间和比例等统计报告，也响应人群比较及临床特征、风险和结局词；另有两段 HackerNews 中 France/法国相关词的词内片段激活，无法由医学主题解释。

patterns.name: 统计区间与效应量格式
patterns.trigger: “%” “confidence interval”及“OR”“odds ratio”，常伴随数字、括号、CI、比较组
patterns.context: 医学研究摘要中报告比例、OR、置信区间或风险比较；激活常落在统计术语及相邻数字、标点上

patterns.name: among 引出的群体比较
patterns.trigger: “among”及“Among”，附近有群体名称或比较对象，如“sexually active people”“non-smokers”“quitters”“cancer screening tests”
patterns.context: 句子按人群或类别陈述结果、频率或筛查信息；不一定有统计量
patterns.domain: 医学摘要及健康研究文本

patterns.name: 医学摘要中的临床特征与结果词
patterns.context: 疾病、症状或治疗研究中描述特征、风险、相关性和结局；部分与 OR 等统计格式并存

patterns.name: 法国相关英文词的分词片段
patterns.context: HackerNews 标题或链接文本中出现 France/法国相关词，激活落在词内片段；并非医学统计上下文

en.description: Primarily activates when medical texts report odds ratios and statistical comparisons; it also strongly responds to titles beginning with “Characteristics of”, on topics ranging from medicine and immunology to building wiring. It also responds to local statistical contexts involving sex, smoking, genotype, regression, and related topics.

patterns.name: Odds ratio (OR) statistical results
patterns.context: Reports odds ratios for between-group comparisons, risk factors, or treatment outcomes in medical research, often adjacent to values, confidence intervals, or comparison groups.

patterns.name: Characteristics at the start of a title
patterns.context: The title begins with “Characteristics of …”, followed by a study subject or topic.
patterns.domain: Medical paper titles; also patent background titles

patterns.name: Sex ratios and participation
patterns.context: Reports numbers or proportions by sex and discusses participation and related factors.

patterns.name: MDR pneumonia predictors
patterns.context: Reports the incidence of multidrug-resistant pneumonia among patients with pneumonia and its predictors, including treatment exposure and OR.

patterns.name: Quality of included RCT studies
patterns.context: A systematic review describes the number and quality of included randomized controlled trials and between-group outcome comparisons.

patterns.name: Smoking status and symptom comparisons
patterns.context: Compares symptom incidence among current smokers, former smokers, or nonsmokers, and reports odds ratios.

patterns.name: Between-genotype comparisons
patterns.context: Reports comparison results and odds ratios by genotype combination, often with confidence intervals nearby.

patterns.name: Conditional logistic regression and exposure associations
patterns.context: Describes associations between environmental exposures or spore counts and outcomes after controlling for confounding factors.

patterns.name: Building electrical wiring characteristics title
patterns.context: The title describes electrical wiring characteristics in residences and buildings.

patterns.name: Bacterial flora characteristics title
patterns.context: The title describes conjunctiva-associated bacterial flora.

patterns.name: Characteristics of referred children title
patterns.context: The title describes patients referred to a pediatric infectious disease-related institution or department.

patterns.name: Lymphocyte nuclear factor pathway title
patterns.context: The title concerns characteristics of lymphocyte NF-κB signaling.

1_1165.concept: 医学统计与特征标题
1_1165.description: 主要在医学文本报告优势比及统计比较时激活；也强烈响应以“Characteristics of”开头的标题，主题涵盖医学、免疫学及建筑布线。另对性别、吸烟、基因型、回归等局部统计语境有响应。

patterns.name: 优势比（OR）统计结果
patterns.context: 医学研究中报告组间比较、风险因素或治疗结局的优势比，常与数值、置信区间或比较组相邻。

patterns.name: Characteristics 标题起始
patterns.context: 标题以“Characteristics of …”开头，后接研究对象或主题。
patterns.domain: 医学论文标题；另有专利背景标题

patterns.name: 性别比例与参与度
patterns.context: 报告性别人数或比例，并讨论参与度及其相关因素。

patterns.name: MDR 肺炎预测因素
patterns.context: 报告肺炎患者中多重耐药肺炎的发生及其预测因素，含治疗暴露和 OR。

patterns.name: RCT 纳入研究质量
patterns.context: 系统综述描述纳入的随机对照试验数量、质量及组间结局比较。

patterns.name: 吸烟状态与症状比较
patterns.context: 按持续吸烟、戒烟或非吸烟者比较症状发生情况，并报告优势比。
patterns.domain: 医学研究摘要/论文片段

patterns.name: 基因型组间比较
patterns.context: 按基因型组合报告比较结果和优势比，附近常有置信区间。

patterns.name: 条件 Logistic 回归与暴露关联
patterns.context: 描述控制混杂因素后，环境暴露或孢子计数与结局的关联。

patterns.name: 建筑电线特征标题
patterns.trigger: «Characteristics» of« Wiring» in« Homes» and« Buildings»
patterns.context: 标题描述住宅及建筑中的电气布线特征。

patterns.name: 细菌菌群特征标题
patterns.context: 标题描述结膜相关的细菌菌群。

patterns.name: 转诊患儿特征标题
patterns.context: 标题描述转诊至儿科感染相关机构或科室的患者。

patterns.name: 淋巴细胞核因子通路标题
patterns.context: 标题涉及淋巴细胞 NF-κB 信号转导特征。
patterns.domain: 分子/免疫医学论文标题

en.concept: Reporting OR effect sizes in medical research
en.description: All passages are in medical research statistical contexts. The core pattern is OR and surrounding reports of risk, association, and between-group effects; also involves confidence intervals, study design, stratification factors, and various specific diseases and outcomes.

patterns.name: OR effect-size marker
patterns.context: Appears in statistical sentences describing risk, association, incidence, outcomes, or between-group differences, often followed by numbers or outcome abbreviations; in multiple passages, the word adjacent to OR is also marked.
patterns.domain: Statistical reporting in biomedical papers and abstracts

patterns.name: Between-group comparison marker
patterns.context: Compares treatment and control groups, patient subgroups, or other categories and reports group effects or outcomes; not every passage contains these exact trigger terms.

patterns.name: Risk and association expressions
patterns.context: Describes risk, association, or correlation between an exposure and a disease or outcome, often appearing with OR.

patterns.name: OR confidence intervals and numerical format
patterns.context: Reports effect size using OR, with confidence intervals, comparison groups, or values; activations may fall on punctuation and statistical-format tokens adjacent to OR.

patterns.name: Outcome and research comparison terms
patterns.context: Compares outcomes, repair rates, or other results across interventions or study groups; this pattern is adjacent to OR statistical reporting, but the specific outcomes vary.

patterns.name: Population stratification and demographic factors
patterns.context: Stratifies by age, obstetric history, patient status, or other demographic characteristics, and reports differences in risk or outcomes.

patterns.name: Risk factors and birth outcomes
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship between obstetric factors and preterm birth or birth outcomes, with OR quantifying risk; the main trigger terms here are not limited to OR.

patterns.name: Smoking groups and symptom comparisons
patterns.context: Groups participants as continuing smokers, former smokers, and others, compares symptoms or back-pain incidence, and reports OR.

patterns.name: Neuromusculoskeletal symptoms
patterns.context: Symptoms themselves and their differences across smoking-status subgroups; these terms differ from the specific topics of other passages.

patterns.name: Neonatal neck condition and gestational diabetes
patterns.context: Reports the proportion of a neonatal condition and identifies its adjusted association with gestational diabetes.

patterns.name: Gestational age and neonatal mortality
patterns.context: Stratifies by obstetric history, compares neonatal mortality at different gestational ages after term, and reports OR later in the passage.

patterns.name: Significance testing and clinical relevance
patterns.context: Notes that large-sample analyses can detect small between-group risk differences that may lack clinical relevance; OR is explained afterward.
patterns.domain: Medical paper discussion or interpretation of results

patterns.name: Parotid inflammation and malignancy risk
patterns.context: Describes the relationship between salivary-gland inflammation severity and disease incidence or risk; the outcome abbreviation is not expanded in the passage.

patterns.name: Temporal changes in feeding-tube-related risk
patterns.context: Reports that nasogastric tube-related risk changes over time, initially being higher, then declining while remaining above the comparison level.

1_1165.concept: 医学研究中的OR效应量报告
1_1165.description: 各段均处在医学研究统计语境，核心是OR及其周边的风险、关联和组间效应报告；同时涉及置信区间、研究设计、分层因素及多种具体疾病和结局。

patterns.name: OR效应量标记
patterns.context: 出现在描述风险、关联、发生率、结局或组间差异的统计句中，常跟数字或结局缩写；在多段中 OR 邻近词本身也被标记。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及摘要中的统计报告

patterns.name: 组间比较标记
patterns.context: 比较治疗组与对照组、患者亚组或其他类别，并报告组间效应或结局；并非每段都出现这些精确触发词。
patterns.domain: 临床研究、荟萃分析及流行病学

patterns.name: 风险与关联表述
patterns.context: 描述暴露因素与疾病或结局之间的风险、关联或相关性，常与 OR 一同出现。

patterns.name: OR置信区间及数值格式
patterns.context: 以 OR 报告效应大小，并附置信区间、比较组或数值；激活可落在 OR 邻近的标点和统计格式 token 上。

patterns.name: 结局与研究比较用语
patterns.context: 研究结果段落中比较干预或研究组的结局、修复率等；本模式与 OR 统计报告相邻，但具体结局各异。

patterns.name: 人群分层与人口学因素
patterns.context: 按年龄、孕产史、患者状态或其他人口学特征分层，并报告风险或结局差异。
patterns.domain: 医学与母婴健康流行病学

patterns.name: 风险因素与出生结局
patterns.context: 讨论孕产因素与早产或出生结局的关系，OR 用于量化风险；此处主要触发词不只限于 OR。
patterns.domain: 生殖与围产期流行病学

patterns.name: 吸烟分组与症状比较
patterns.context: 按持续吸烟者、戒烟者等分组，比较症状或背痛发生情况，并报告 OR。
patterns.domain: 吸烟研究或观察性健康研究

patterns.name: 神经肌肉骨骼症状
patterns.context: 症状本身及其在吸烟状态亚组中的差异；这些词与其他段落的具体主题不同。

patterns.name: 新生儿颈部状况与妊娠糖尿病
patterns.context: 报告新生儿状况的比例，并指出其与妊娠糖尿病的调整后关联。

patterns.name: 孕周与新生儿死亡率
patterns.context: 按孕产史分层，比较足月后不同孕周的新生儿死亡率，并在后文报告 OR。

patterns.name: 显著性检验与临床意义
patterns.context: 指出大样本分析可检出较小的组间风险差异，但差异可能缺乏临床相关性；随后解释 OR。
patterns.domain: 医学论文讨论或结果解释

patterns.name: 腮腺炎症与恶性肿瘤风险
patterns.context: 描述唾液腺炎症严重度与疾病发生率或风险的关系，结局缩写未在片段中展开。

patterns.name: 管饲相关风险的时间变化
patterns.context: 报告鼻胃管相关风险随时间变化，先在早期较高，之后下降但仍高于比较水平。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to the statistical term OR (odds ratio), especially in contexts involving effect sizes, risk comparisons, and confidence intervals; also strongly activates the ending «ication» of the medical word contraindication.

patterns.name: Odds ratio abbreviation OR
patterns.context: Appears in statistical results reporting effect sizes or risk associations, often adjacent to values, equals signs, confidence intervals, models, or comparison groups; segment 1 explains the meaning of OR.
patterns.domain: Statistical results and abstracts in biomedical research papers

patterns.name: Ending of contraindication
patterns.context: Appears in contexts involving contraindications to CT angiography or prior anthracycline treatment; strong activation falls on the word ending «ication».
patterns.domain: Descriptions of clinical indications and treatment eligibility in biomedical papers

1_1165.concept: 生物医学术语片段
1_1165.description: 主要对统计术语 OR（优势比）敏感，尤其在效应量、风险比较及置信区间语境中；另对医学词 contraindication 的词尾 «ication» 有强激活。

patterns.name: 优势比缩写 OR
patterns.context: 出现在报告效应量或风险关联的统计结果中，常邻接数值、等号、置信区间、模型或比较组；第1段为解释 OR 的含义。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究论文的统计结果与摘要

patterns.name: contraindication 的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在 CT 血管造影或既往蒽环类治疗的禁忌症语境中；强激活落在单词末尾 «ication»。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文中的临床适应证与治疗资格描述

en.description: Activations cover census household classifications, medical statistics and clinical reporting, geographic disease distribution, imaging technologies, and Spanish-language parliamentary resolution terminology; no single clear trigger string explains all passages.

patterns.name: Household structure in demographic tables
patterns.context: Describes a sequence of household or population-statistics proportions, often listing married-couple households, female-headed households, nonfamily households, and all households as percentages.
patterns.domain: English Wikipedia census or town population entries

patterns.name: Statistical analysis and risk comparison
patterns.context: Discusses sample size, between-group risk differences, effect sizes, and odds ratios in research results or methods; also includes confidence intervals and associated factors.

patterns.name: Geographic distribution in disease surveillance
patterns.context: The research objective is to summarize disease data for a location and describe incidence or diagnoses by geographic region, age, and other dimensions.

patterns.name: Neonatal clinical findings and associated factors
patterns.context: Reports the proportion of neonatal symptoms or signs and gives statistical associations with pregnancy-related factors.

patterns.name: Vascular interventional imaging technology
patterns.context: Discusses the uses, benefits, or limitations of intraoperative imaging technology for endovascular procedures.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, interventional radiology or vascular surgery

patterns.name: Spanish parliamentary procedure and resolutions
patterns.context: Announces a joint debate on the agenda and cites committee recommendations and Council resolution items.

1_1165.concept: 结构化分类与统计报告
1_1165.description: 激活覆盖人口普查家庭分类、医学统计与临床报告、疾病地理分布、影像技术，以及西班牙语议会决议用语；没有一个明确触发词串能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 人口统计表格中的家庭结构
patterns.trigger: «married»« couples»«living»«together»；«had» a female house«holder»«with» no «husband» present；«families»；«households»
patterns.context: 描述住户或人口统计比例的连续分类，常以百分比列出已婚同住夫妇、女性户主、非家庭及全部住户。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科人口普查或城镇人口条目

patterns.name: 统计分析与风险比较
patterns.context: 研究结果或方法文字中讨论样本量、组间风险差异、效应量及比值比；也包括置信区间和相关因素。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要或论文

patterns.name: 疾病监测的地理分布
patterns.context: 研究目标是汇总某地疾病数据，并按地理区域、年龄等维度描述发病或诊断情况。

patterns.name: 新生儿临床发现与关联因素
patterns.context: 报告新生儿症状或体征的比例，并给出与孕期因素相关的统计关联。

patterns.name: 血管介入影像技术
patterns.context: 讨论术中影像技术对血管内操作的用途、效益或使用限制。
patterns.domain: 医学论文，介入放射学或血管外科

patterns.name: 西班牙语议会程序与决议
patterns.context: 议程中宣布进行联合辩论，并引述委员会建议及理事会决议项目。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语欧洲议会记录

en.description: Most segments focus on epidemiological and clinical research: reporting prevalence, percentages, and population subgroups; analyzing disease risk and associated factors; and describing disease distribution or sample testing. There are also clinical observation titles and an Italian-language account of factors.

patterns.name: Prevalence or proportion statistics
patterns.context: Reports the proportion of a population with an infection, symptom, demographic characteristic, or exposure, often using percentages and subgroup data; activation may fall on “prevalences” or the percent sign

patterns.name: Risk factors and association analysis
patterns.context: Discusses factors associated with a disease or outcome, predictors, or risk, often accompanied by OR, confidence intervals, or adjusted statistics

patterns.name: Disease surveillance and distribution data
patterns.context: Summarizes reports, incidence, mortality, or hospitalization data for a disease by region, age, or other dimensions

patterns.name: Laboratory testing and sample collection
patterns.context: Describes the collection, testing, or storage of biological samples such as serum, urine, or oral swabs, often for infection or case-control studies

patterns.name: Diagnostic or clinical observation title
patterns.context: Appears in a case report or clinical observation title; the disease name that follows is dysautonomia

patterns.name: Factors expressed in Italian
patterns.context: Italian text describes a factor's contribution to a person or event; this does not clearly match the dominant pattern in the medical statistics corpus

1_1165.concept: 流行病学研究统计表述
1_1165.description: 多数段落聚焦流行病学与临床研究：报告患病率、百分比和人口分组，分析疾病风险及关联因素，并描述疾病分布或样本检测。另有临床观察标题与意大利语因素叙述。

patterns.name: 患病率或比例统计
patterns.context: 报告人群中某种感染、症状、人口特征或暴露的比例，常以百分比及分组数据呈现；激活可落在“prevalences”或百分号上
patterns.domain: 流行病学摘要、人口统计

patterns.name: 风险因素与关联分析
patterns.context: 讨论疾病或结局的相关因素、预测因子或风险，常伴随 OR、置信区间或调整后统计量

patterns.name: 疾病监测与分布数据
patterns.context: 按地区、年龄等维度汇总疾病的报告、发病率、死亡或住院等资料

patterns.name: 实验室检测与样本采集
patterns.context: 描述血清、尿液或口腔拭子等生物样本的采集、检测或储存，常用于感染或病例对照研究

patterns.name: 诊断或临床观察标题
patterns.context: 出现在病例报告或临床观察标题中；后续疾病名为 dysautonomia

patterns.name: 意大利语中的因素表述
patterns.context: 意大利语叙述某因素对某人或事件的贡献；与医学统计语料的主模式不明显相同
patterns.domain: 意大利语哲学或传记文本

en.concept: Mixed triggers involving word forms and statistical contexts
en.description: The main pattern is the ending of the prevalence-related word prevalences; other activations include Italian meno, the medical term dysmenorrhea, demographic and gender participation statistics, and sporadic Italian, poetic, and research word fragments. The segments do not share a unified trigger explanation.

patterns.name: Ending of prevalences
patterns.context: The segmented ending of this word appears in medical research contexts related to prevalence; it is the strongest and most recurring trigger form.

patterns.name: -orrhea in a reproductive health/disease term
patterns.context: Appears inside “primary dysmenorrhea,” referring to menstrual pain; markings cluster around the disease name's stem and ending.

patterns.name: Italian comparative word men(o)
patterns.context: Italian meno (“less”) in comparative expressions, appearing in structures such as “giustificate o meno,” “per lo meno,” and “assai meno.”
patterns.domain: European Parliament Italian, Italian academic texts

patterns.name: Prevalences in GBV-C/HGV prevalence research
patterns.context: As in segment 1, appears as a noun ending in a study of seroprevalence; also includes descriptions of children and family-member samples.

patterns.name: Percentages/age distribution in demographic descriptions
patterns.context: Appears in statistical paragraphs on the age proportions and gender composition of an urban population; activation falls on “makeup,” and the percentages are also marked.

patterns.name: Gender and participation-rate statistics
patterns.context: In statistical sentences about gender, study participation rates, and odds ratios, gender, factors, associations, and statistical terms are marked.

patterns.name: Poetic lines about the years of protected desire
patterns.context: Appears in poetry, where mortals and old or young form a poetic expression about stages of life; there is no clear medical or statistical context.

patterns.name: Italian discussion of occupational safety and employer responsibility
patterns.context: An Italian legal/policy discussion describes how occupational safety and health obligations bind employers; the word means “binding.”

patterns.name: Other intra-word Italian fragments
patterns.context: Italian sentences in parliamentary speeches about whether something is justified or whether a deadlock can be overcome; several common words or subword fragments are marked, with no stable link to the other trigger patterns.

patterns.name: Other intra-word Italian fragments
patterns.context: Italian academic discussion of someone who was once famous worldwide and their deeds; local activations involve fragments inside common words.

patterns.name: GBV-C/HGV and children and family members
patterns.context: Describes Japanese children with no transfusion history and their family members, studying serum GBV-C/HGV RNA; the main trigger still seems to be the later occurrence of “prevalences,” and it is unclear whether these words trigger independently.

patterns.name: Other unclassified medical research fragments
patterns.context: These fragments occur in sentences about etiology, exposure-rate comparisons, associated factors, and participation rates; their forms and topics vary, making a shared trigger condition difficult to establish.

1_1165.concept: 混合的词形与统计语境触发
1_1165.description: 主模式是流行率相关的 prevalences 词尾；此外有意大利语 meno、医学术语 dysmenorrhea、人口统计与性别参与统计，以及零散的意大利语、诗歌和研究词片段。各段并无统一触发解释。

patterns.name: prevalences 的词尾
patterns.context: 该词被拆分标记的词尾，在流行率/患病率相关医学研究语境中出现；是最强且反复出现的触发形式。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、公共卫生研究

patterns.name: 生殖健康/疾病术语中的 -orrhea
patterns.context: 出现在“primary dysmenorrhea”一词内部，指痛经；标记集中在疾病名称的词干与词尾。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、学生健康研究

patterns.name: 意大利语 men(o) 比较词
patterns.context: 意大利语比较表达中的 meno（“较少”），分别出现在“giustificate o meno”“per lo meno”“assai meno”等结构中。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语、意大利语学术文本

patterns.name: GBV-C/HGV 流行率研究中的 prevalences
patterns.context: 与 segment 1 相同，作为血清感染流行率研究中的名词词尾出现；兼有儿童及家庭成员样本的描述。

patterns.name: 人口统计表述中的百分数/年龄分布
patterns.context: 在城市人口年龄比例和性别构成的统计段落中出现，激活落在“makeup”上，百分数本身也有标记。

patterns.name: 性别与参与率统计
patterns.context: 在性别与研究参与率、优势比相关的统计句中，性别、因素、关联和统计术语被标记。

patterns.name: 受保护的愿望年岁诗句
patterns.context: 出现在诗歌中，mortals 与 old or young 构成关于人生阶段的诗意表达；没有明显医学或统计语境。

patterns.name: 职业安全与雇主责任的意大利语论述
patterns.context: 意大利语法律/政策论述中，描述职业安全与健康义务对雇主的约束力；词语表示“有约束力”。
patterns.domain: 意大利语法律与劳动政策

patterns.name: 其他意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 议会发言中关于是否正当、是否克服僵局的意大利语句子；多个常见词或其子词片段被标记，未显示与其他触发模式的稳定联系。

patterns.name: 其他意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 关于某人曾经闻名于世及其事迹的意大利语学术论述；局部激活涉及常见词内部片段。

patterns.name: GBV-C/HGV 与儿童家庭成员
patterns.context: 描述无输血史的日本儿童及其家庭成员，研究血清 GBV-C/HGV RNA；主要触发似乎仍是其后出现的“prevalences”，这些词是否独立触发并不确定。

patterns.name: 其余无法归入的医学研究片段
patterns.context: 这些片段分别处于病因、暴露率比较、相关因素及参与率句中，词形与主题不一，难以确认共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 临床研究与流行病学摘要

en.description: Primarily responds to statistical effect sizes, confidence intervals, risks, and epidemiological measures in medical research; also includes medical case titles and intraword men/o fragments in Italian, whose semantic relationship is unclear.

patterns.name: Reporting statistical associations and effect sizes
patterns.context: Describes variable associations, between-group differences, risk magnitude, and statistical significance in results or methods; often co-occurs with numbers, confidence intervals, and comparison-group names.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts and main text

patterns.name: Listing epidemiological study measures
patterns.context: Reports disease or infection occurrence, distribution, outcomes, or prevalence, often listing multiple study measures.

patterns.name: men(o) fragments in Italian
patterns.context: In continuous Italian text, activations fall within words containing men/o; the contexts involve causal factors, degree of constraint, and parliamentary discussion, with no consistent semantics.
patterns.domain: Italian philosophical/legal texts and European Parliament speeches

patterns.name: Medical case title fragment
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a medical case-report-style title, followed by a disease name and treatment description.

1_1165.concept: 医学研究报告
1_1165.description: 主要响应医学研究中的统计效应量、置信区间、风险及流行病学指标；另见医学病例标题，以及意大利语词中 men/o 字符片段，语义关联不明。

patterns.name: 统计关联与效应量报告
patterns.context: 在研究结果或方法中描述变量关联、组间差异、风险大小及统计显著性；常与数字、置信区间和比较组名同现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要与论文正文

patterns.name: 流行病学研究指标列举
patterns.context: 报告疾病或感染的发生、分布、结局或患病情况，常列出多个研究指标。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生与流行病学论文

patterns.name: 意大利语中的 men(o) 片段
patterns.context: 意大利语连续文本中，相关激活落在包含 men/o 的词内；上下文分别涉及因果因素、约束程度和议会讨论，语义并不一致。
patterns.domain: 意大利语哲学/法律文本及欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 医学病例标题片段
patterns.context: 出现在医学病例报告式标题开头，后接病名及治疗描述。

en.description: The strongest and repeated pattern is the segmentation of the Italian word meno, seen in three contexts; other activations are sporadic, occurring on the English words makeup, observation, predictors, and amongst, as well as Spanish y and Italian mano, with no shared semantic or grammatical pattern.

patterns.name: Italian segmented fragments «men», «o»
patterns.context: In Italian word forms, activation concentrates on the segmented ending/fragments «men», «o»; they occur in “non meno importanti” (not less important), “giustificate o meno” (whether justified), and “assai meno vincolante” (much less binding).
patterns.domain: Italian philosophical or political discussion, parliamentary debate, and labor law texts

patterns.name: English phrase makeup
patterns.context: Appears in a statistical sentence describing the gender composition of an urban population; the trigger is “gender makeup.”

patterns.name: English word observation
patterns.context: Appears in the medical title fragment “Clinical observation of dystonia ...”.

patterns.name: Spanish “y”
patterns.context: The conjunction “and” links coordinated elements; one instance appears in “todos y no he apagado,” and another in the name of the transport and tourism committee.

patterns.name: Italian request word «mano»
patterns.context: Appears in the colloquial request “posso chiedervi una mano?” (can I ask you for help?), with activation spanning the segmented word “mano.”

patterns.name: English word predictors
patterns.context: Appears in the section heading “Predictors of adequate dose coverage,” with activation on the ending “ors.”
patterns.domain: Medical paper text or section heading

patterns.name: English word amongst
patterns.context: Appears in “Amongst the more prominent works ...”, with activation on the ending fragment “st”.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedia entries on architectural history

1_1165.concept: 多语种词形片段
1_1165.description: 最强且重复的模式是意大利语 meno 的切分片段，见于三种语境；其余激活零散落在英语 makeup、observation、predictors、amongst，以及西班牙语 y、意大利语 mano，缺乏共同语义或语法模式。

patterns.name: 意大利语分词片段「men」「o」
patterns.context: 意大利语词形中，激活集中在被切分的词尾/片段「men」「o」；分别出现在“non meno importanti”（不太重要）、“giustificate o meno”（是否合理）和“assai meno vincolante”（约束力小得多）中。
patterns.domain: 意大利语哲学或政治论述、议会辩论及劳动法文本

patterns.name: 英语短语 makeup
patterns.context: 出现在描述城市人口性别构成的统计句中，触发词为“gender makeup”。

patterns.name: 英语词 observation
patterns.context: 出现在医学标题片段“Clinical observation of dystonia ...”中。

patterns.name: 西班牙语「y」
patterns.context: 作为连接词“和”连接并列成分；一处出现在“todos y no he apagado”，另一处出现在运输与旅游委员会名称中。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语议会发言或议程

patterns.name: 意大利语请求用语「mano」
patterns.context: 出现在口语请求“posso chiedervi una mano?”（能请你们帮个忙吗）中，激活覆盖切分词“mano”。
patterns.domain: Ubuntu IRC 意大利语聊天

patterns.name: 英语词 predictors
patterns.context: 出现在小节标题“Predictors of adequate dose coverage”中，激活落在词尾“ors”。
patterns.domain: 医学论文正文或小节标题

patterns.name: 英语词 amongst
patterns.context: 出现在“Amongst the more prominent works ...”中，激活落在词尾片段“st”。

en.description: Activations are scattered across word fragments in several languages: Italian meno and mano, the endings of English conceals and prevalences, Portuguese maneira, and the clinical-title word observation; there is no unified semantics or style.

patterns.name: Italian negative comparative «meno»
patterns.context: Expresses “less/not as much” in Italian sentences, as in “non ... meno” or “assai meno vincolante”; commonly occurs in comparisons or judgments of degree.
patterns.domain: European Parliament, philosophical, and legal discussion

patterns.name: Italian colloquial request for help
patterns.context: “Una mano” literally means “a hand”; in “chiedervi una mano” it means asking for help.

patterns.name: English ending conceals
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of the verb conceals; both instances relate to the meaning of hiding or not revealing something.

patterns.name: Prevalences in medical texts
patterns.context: Activation falls on the plural ending of prevalences; the context reports prevalence of disease or infection indicators.

patterns.name: Portuguese maneira
patterns.context: Activation covers the internal and suffix portions of maneira, in a discussion structure such as “é a maneira pelo qual...”.

patterns.name: Observation in a clinical title
patterns.context: Activation falls on the title phrase Clinical observation in square brackets at the start of the abstract.

1_1165.concept: 多语种词片段
1_1165.description: 激活分散于多种语言中的词片段：意大利语 meno、mano，英语 conceals 与 prevalences 的词尾，以及葡萄牙语 maneira 和临床标题 observation；整体没有统一语义或文体。

patterns.name: 意大利语否定比较词 «meno»
patterns.context: 意大利语句中表达“较少/不那么”，如“non ... meno”或“assai meno vincolante”；常见于比较或程度判断。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会、哲学及法律论述

patterns.name: 意大利语口语求助表达
patterns.context: “una mano”字面为“一只手”，在“chiedervi una mano”中表示请求帮助。

patterns.name: 英语词尾 conceals
patterns.context: 激活落在动词 conceals 的词尾部分；两处均与隐藏、不显露某物的语义相关。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的 prevalences
patterns.context: 激活落在 prevalences 的复数词尾；上下文报告疾病或感染指标的患病率。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语 maneira
patterns.context: 激活覆盖 maneira 的内部及后缀部分，处在“é a maneira pelo qual...”一类论述结构中。

patterns.name: 临床标题中的 observation
patterns.context: 激活落在摘要开头方括号内的 Clinical observation 标题短语中。

en.description: Activations mainly concentrate on Italian comparative expressions with meno, prevalences in medical research, and English conceals; there are also weaker, isolated patterns involving an Italian colloquial request for help and pertussis surveillance indicators.

patterns.name: Italian negative comparative structure
patterns.context: Embedded in Italian sentences, with “o” or degree-comparison expressions nearby; both instances occur in comparisons of the strength of a property or whether it holds.
patterns.domain: Italian parliamentary texts, philosophical or academic prose

patterns.name: Prevalence word
patterns.context: Appears in disease or infection research, usually adjacent to statistical descriptions of samples, test results, or exposure.

patterns.name: Form conceals
patterns.context: In English, means to hide or conceal; once it takes the object “the actuality,” and once it describes a biographical account that does not conceal anything.

patterns.name: Request for help
patterns.context: An Italian colloquial request asking “could you help me?”

patterns.name: Sporadic medical data terms
patterns.context: Lists indicators such as surveillance, incidence, mortality, and geographical distribution around the risk of pertussis resurgence; no strongly triggering word matching the other patterns is apparent.

1_1165.concept: 跨语种词汇与统计表达
1_1165.description: 激活主要集中在意大利语 meno 的比较表达、医学研究中的 prevalences，以及英语 conceals；另有意大利语口语求助和百日咳监测指标等较弱、孤立模式。

patterns.name: 意大利语否定比较结构
patterns.context: 嵌在意大利语句子中，前后有“o”或程度比较表达；两次都出现在对某性质强弱或是否成立的比较中。
patterns.domain: 意大利语议会文本、哲学或学术 prose

patterns.name: 流行率词
patterns.context: 出现在疾病或感染研究中，通常与样本、检测结果或暴露情况的统计描述相邻。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、公共卫生研究

patterns.name: conceals 词形
patterns.context: 英语中表示隐藏、掩盖；一次接宾语“the actuality”，一次说明传记叙述没有隐瞒内容。

patterns.name: 求助表达
patterns.trigger: « pos»2so ch«ied»2erv«i»1 una« man»2«o»9（posso chiedervi una mano?）
patterns.context: 意大利语口语中以“能否请你帮个忙”提出请求。

patterns.name: 零散医学数据术语
patterns.context: 围绕百日咳再现风险罗列监测、发病率、死亡率和地理分布等指标；未见与其他模式相同的强触发词。

en.description: Activations are scattered across languages and word positions: final o in Italian words, the ending of prevalences in biomedical English, y within Hungarian and Spanish words, and final st in English amongst; there is no unified semantics or domain.

patterns.name: Final o in Italian
patterns.context: The letter o appears at the end of Italian words; examples include meno and mano.
patterns.domain: Italian philosophy, parliamentary texts, and IRC conversations

patterns.name: Ending of English prevalence
patterns.context: The suffix portion of the word prevalences in biomedical English text.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts and NIH research text

patterns.name: y in Hungarian words
patterns.context: The letter y within a Hungarian personal name or word; this example is “menyasszonyok”.

patterns.name: y in Spanish words
patterns.context: The letter y within a Spanish word; this example is “proyecto”.

patterns.name: Final st in English
patterns.context: The final letter combination st in the English word amongst.

1_1165.concept: none
1_1165.description: 激活分散于多种语言和词形位置：意大利语词尾 o、生物医学英语 prevalences 的词尾、匈牙利语及西班牙语词中的 y，以及英语 amongst 词尾 st；没有统一语义或领域。

patterns.name: 意大利语词尾 o
patterns.context: 意大利语中，出现在词尾或单词末尾的字母 o；例中分别见于 meno、mano。
patterns.domain: 意大利语哲学、议会文本及 IRC 对话

patterns.name: 英语 prevalence 词尾
patterns.context: 英语生物医学文本中，单词 prevalences 的后缀部分。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要及 NIH 研究文本

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词中 y
patterns.context: 匈牙利语人名或词语内部的字母 y；此例为 “menyasszonyok”。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词中 y
patterns.context: 西班牙语单词内部的字母 y；此例为 “proyecto”。

patterns.name: 英语词尾 st
patterns.context: 英语单词 amongst 的词尾字母组合 st。

en.description: Activations show local word-form patterns in several forms: Italian meno, medical prevalences, French salariés, and English conceals and sympathies; their domains and meanings are not unified.

patterns.name: Italian ending meno
patterns.context: Occurs in Italian words «almeno» or «meno», often in comparative, degree, or concessive expressions; activation concentrates on the ending o.
patterns.domain: Italian philosophical, legal, and general discussion

patterns.name: Prevalence term prevalences
patterns.context: Medical or epidemiological texts discuss the prevalence of a disease, infection, or exposure; activation falls on the ending of prevalences.

patterns.name: French ending salariés
patterns.context: Salariés (“employees”) in French labor and social policy texts; activation falls on the middle and ending of the word.
patterns.domain: European Parliament, employment and social affairs

patterns.name: English ending conceals
patterns.context: Conceals appears in English prose, with activation on its ending; the contexts discuss religious-cultural judgment and a penitent's self-disclosure.

patterns.name: English ending sympathies
patterns.context: When discussing pagan rites and their appeal to modern people, activation falls on the final part of the stem of sympathies.

1_1165.concept: 多语种词形片段
1_1165.description: 激活呈多种词汇形式的局部词形模式：意大利语 meno、医学 prevalences、法语 salariés，以及英语 conceals、sympathies；领域和语义并不统一。

patterns.name: 意大利语词尾 meno
patterns.context: 出现在意大利语词中 «almeno» 或 «meno»，常处于比较、程度或让步表达中；激活集中在词尾 o。
patterns.domain: 意大利语哲学、法律及一般论述

patterns.name: 流行率术语 prevalences
patterns.context: 医学或流行病学文本中，讨论疾病、感染或暴露的患病率；激活落在 prevalences 的词尾。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、公共卫生研究

patterns.name: 法语 salariés 词尾
patterns.context: 法语劳工与社会政策文本中的 salariés（雇员），激活落在词中及词尾。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会、就业与社会事务

patterns.name: 英语 conceals 词尾
patterns.context: 英语散文中出现 conceals，激活其词尾；上下文分别讨论宗教文化判断与忏悔者的自我揭示。
patterns.domain: 哲学／宗教论述、文学评论

patterns.name: 英语 sympathies 词尾
patterns.context: 谈及异教仪式及其对现代人的吸引力时，激活 sympathies 的词干末段。

en.description: Activations fall on local fragments of words in several languages: Italian meno and mano, English prevalences, conceals, and predictors, and Spanish y; they belong to different contexts, with no stable shared theme.

patterns.name: Italian meno
patterns.context: Meno (“less/not as much”) appears in Italian contexts, often near degree or comparative expressions; no fixed collocation is required, as in “per lo meno” and “assai meno.”
patterns.domain: Italian philosophical and legal discussion, and parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: English prevalences
patterns.context: Prevalences appears in English medical research texts discussing the prevalence of study populations, diseases, or biomarkers; Exposure prevalences also shares the same root, but strong activation is marked on prevalences.

patterns.name: Spanish y
patterns.context: The Spanish conjunction y (“and”) linking coordinated elements is marked in a parliamentary speech; the surrounding content concerns parliamentary procedure and microphones.

patterns.name: English conceals
patterns.context: Conceals appears in English theoretical discussion, describing an idea that obscures or hides reality.

patterns.name: English predictors
patterns.context: The plural noun predictors appears in a medical paper section heading, followed by a topic related to dose coverage.
patterns.domain: Medical paper title or section heading

patterns.name: Italian man(o)
patterns.context: In the colloquial Italian request for help “una mano” (a helping hand), the ending of mano strongly activates.

1_1165.concept: none
1_1165.description: 激活落在多语种词的局部片段：意大利语 meno、mano，英语 prevalences、conceals、predictors，以及西班牙语 y；分属不同语境，未见稳定的共同主题。

patterns.name: 意大利语中的 meno
patterns.context: 意大利语语境中出现 meno（“较少／不太”），前后常有程度或比较表达；不要求固定搭配，如“per lo meno”“assai meno”。
patterns.domain: 意大利语哲学、法律论述及议会发言

patterns.name: 英语 prevalences
patterns.context: 英语医学研究文本中出现 prevalences，讨论研究对象、疾病或生物标志物的患病率；另有同一词根的 Exposure prevalences，但强激活标记落在 prevalences。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、公共卫生研究

patterns.name: 西班牙语 y
patterns.context: 西班牙语议会发言中，连接并列成分的 y（“和”）被标记；周边内容谈及议事规则与麦克风。

patterns.name: 英语 conceals
patterns.context: 英语理论论述中出现 conceals，描述某种观念遮蔽或隐藏现实。

patterns.name: 英语 predictors
patterns.context: 医学论文小节标题中的复数名词 predictors，后接剂量覆盖相关主题。
patterns.domain: 医学论文标题或小节标题

patterns.name: 意大利语 man(o)
patterns.context: 意大利语请求帮助的口语表达“una mano”（帮一把）中，mano 的词尾部分强激活。

en.description: Activations are distributed across three local ending patterns: the ending of prevalence(s) in medical literature, the end of the Italian comparative word meno, and the ending of English Amongst. Contexts and styles vary, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: “prevalences” suffix
patterns.context: Describes the prevalence of disease, infection, or exposure in medical abstracts; activation concentrates on the plural ending of the word prevalence.

patterns.name: Ending of Italian meno
patterns.context: The comparative structure non meno appears in Italian sentences, meaning “no less than/not less”; strong activation falls on the end of meno.

patterns.name: Ending of Amongst
patterns.context: Amongst introduces a set of examples or people in English expository or encyclopedic entries; activation falls on the ending st.

1_1165.concept: 特定词形的词尾
1_1165.description: 激活分布于三种词尾局部模式：医学文献 prevalence(s) 的词尾、意大利语比较词 meno 的末尾，以及英语 Amongst 的词尾。上下文与文体各异，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: “prevalences”后缀
patterns.context: 医学摘要中描述疾病、感染或暴露的流行率；激活集中在单词 prevalence 的复数词尾部分。

patterns.name: 意大利语 meno 的词尾
patterns.context: 意大利语句中出现比较结构 non meno，表示“不少于／并非更少”；强激活落在 meno 的末尾。
patterns.domain: 意大利语学术论述、议会发言

patterns.name: Amongst 的词尾
patterns.context: 英语说明文或百科式条目中，Amongst 引出一组例子或人物；激活落在词尾 st。

en.description: Strong activations are distributed across «ences» in the epidemiological term prevalences, «o» in the Italian word meno, «st» in amongst, and local substrings in the English words occupation/occupations and conceals; the cross-language and morphological variation makes them difficult to assign to a single semantic topic.

patterns.name: Prevalence terminology
patterns.context: Appears in medical research abstracts describing the prevalence of an infection, exposure, or measure; strong activations concentrate on the word-final substring «ences».

patterns.name: Italian meno
patterns.context: Meno appears in Italian sentences, often in comparative or limiting expressions such as «almeno» and «meno vincolante»; activation is especially strong on the final «o».

patterns.name: Word ending of amongst
patterns.context: Amongst appears in English, with activations on the final «st»; both instances occur in listing or exemplification contexts.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedic and public health texts

patterns.name: Occupation word family
patterns.context: In the English forms occupation/occupations, activations concentrate on the stem substrings «up» or «occup», rather than a stable complete-word meaning; the latter example is weaker.

patterns.name: Ending of conceals
patterns.context: In the English verb conceals, activation falls on the ending «als»; the current example lacks sufficient context to support a more specific semantic condition.

1_1165.concept: none
1_1165.description: 强激活分布于流行病学词 prevalences 的 «ences»、意大利语 meno 的 «o»、amongst 的 «st»，以及 occupation/occupations、conceals 等英语词的局部子串；跨语种与词形差异明显，难以归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 流行率术语
patterns.context: 出现在医学研究摘要中，描述某种感染、暴露或指标的 prevalence；强激活集中在词尾子串 «ences»。
patterns.domain: PubMed、NIH 医学/流行病学摘要

patterns.name: 意大利语 meno
patterns.context: 意大利语句子中出现 meno，常用于比较或限制表达，例如 «almeno»、«meno vincolante»；尤以词尾 «o» 激活明显。
patterns.domain: 意大利语议会文本及学术文本

patterns.name: amongst 的词尾
patterns.context: 英语中出现 amongst，激活落在词尾 «st»；两处均位于列举或引出实例的语境。
patterns.domain: 英语百科及公共卫生文本

patterns.name: occupation 词族
patterns.context: 英语 occupation/occupations 词形中，激活集中在词干子串 «up» 或 «occup»，而非稳定的完整词义；后一例激活较弱。

patterns.name: conceals 的词尾
patterns.context: 英语动词 conceals 中，激活落在词尾 «als»；当前例子没有足够上下文支持更具体的语义条件。

en.concept: Common word forms and distribution statistics
en.description: Activations concentrate on three types of word forms or phrases: prevalences in epidemiology, the Italian comparative meno with the ending men…o, and distribution paired with geographical/gender in papers; the first two have clear word-form cues, while the third reflects statistical phrasing about distribution.

patterns.name: Ending of prevalences
patterns.context: Describes the occurrence rate of a disease, infection, exposure, or characteristic in epidemiological or clinical research; often appears near statistical results or the study objective.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, clinical and public health research

patterns.name: men…o comparative structure
patterns.context: Forms “meno” (less/not as much) in Italian sentences; preceding text often includes comparisons or degree expressions such as “less important” or “less binding.”

patterns.name: Collocation geographical distribution
patterns.context: Pairs with words such as geographical or gender to describe geographic or gender distribution; appears in contexts concerning study considerations or the geographic spread of cases.

1_1165.concept: 常见词形与分布统计表达
1_1165.description: 激活集中于三类词形或短语：流行病学中的 prevalences、意大利语 meno 的词尾 men…o，以及论文中与 geographical/gender 搭配的 distribution；前两类分别有明确词形线索，第三类体现分布统计表述。

patterns.name: prevalences 词尾
patterns.context: 流行病学或临床研究中，描述某种疾病、感染、暴露或特征的发生比例；常出现在统计结果或研究目的附近。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、临床与公共卫生研究

patterns.name: men…o 比较结构
patterns.context: 意大利语句子中构成“meno”（较少／不那么）；前文常有“不那么重要、较不具约束力”等比较或程度表达。
patterns.domain: 意大利语议会文本与哲学文本

patterns.name: geographical distribution 搭配
patterns.context: 与 geographical 或 gender 等词搭配，描述地域或性别分布；出现在研究考虑因素或病例地理扩展的语境中。

en.concept: Mixed subword fragments and medical vocabulary
en.description: The strong repeated pattern is the ending of prevalences in medical epidemiological contexts; there are also various intraword fragments in Italian (especially meno and in), along with sporadic activations in English encyclopedic, chat, and medical statistical vocabulary. No unified trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Prevalence word ending
patterns.context: Appears in sentences about the frequency of disease, infection, or exposure in a population or specific group; the word is usually in a noun phrase.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, public health, and epidemiology

patterns.name: Italian word ending meno
patterns.context: Means “less” in Italian sentences, as in “assai meno vincolante” or “per lo meno”; nearby text contains Italian function words and inflected words.

patterns.name: Italian intraword syllable
patterns.context: The Italian preposition in is followed by a relative structure or noun phrase; activation falls on token/subword fragments and is not a standalone special semantic marker.

patterns.name: Italian word fragment
patterns.context: In an Italian narrative sentence, activation corresponds to a subword fragment within a word.

patterns.name: Italian separable word fragment
patterns.context: In an Italian sentence, activation corresponds to a fragment within an adjective; the sentence discusses whether a factor can be identified.

patterns.name: Other Italian intraword fragments
patterns.context: An Italian subjunctive verb contains this intraword fragment, surrounded by a sentence discussing preconditions.

patterns.name: Italian intraword verb fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the Italian passive construction “viene posto”; the sentence discusses responsibility for workplace safety.

patterns.name: English preposition/article In
patterns.context: Capitalized In at the beginning of a sentence, followed by “the British colonial age”; activation is weak in this sole example.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment st in English
patterns.context: The word-final spelling fragment in an English word meaning “among”.

patterns.name: English word-ending transition fragment
patterns.context: An Ubuntu IRC discussion mentions the Ubuntu version number “11.04”; the fragment boundary may cross annotated and unannotated text.

patterns.name: English research data terminology
patterns.context: A public health study describes available data and analysis objectives, with two words separately annotated.

patterns.name: English statistical association terminology
patterns.context: A transplant medicine study describes the association between risk factors and incidence.

1_1165.concept: 混合的词片段与医学词汇
1_1165.description: 强而重复的模式是医学流行病学语境中的 prevalences 词尾；另有意大利语多种词内片段（尤其 meno、in），以及英语百科、聊天和医学统计词汇的零散激活，未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 患病率词尾
patterns.context: 出现在关于人群或特定群体中疾病、感染或暴露频率的句子里；该词通常处于名词短语中
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、公共卫生与流行病学

patterns.name: 意大利语词尾 meno
patterns.context: 意大利语句中表示“较少／更少”，如“assai meno vincolante”或“per lo meno”；附近有意大利语功能词与屈折词
patterns.domain: 意大利语学术或政治文本

patterns.name: 意大利语词内部音节
patterns.trigger: « in»5，分别位于“in cui”和“in questa sede”
patterns.context: 意大利语介词 in 后接关系结构或名词短语；激活落在词元/子词片段上，并非独立的特殊语义标记
patterns.domain: 意大利语学术、政治文本

patterns.name: 意大利语词片段
patterns.context: 意大利语叙述句中，激活对应单词内部的子词片段

patterns.name: 意大利语可分词片段
patterns.context: 意大利语句中，激活对应形容词内部片段；句子谈及某个因素可被识别

patterns.name: 意大利语其他词内片段
patterns.context: 意大利语虚拟式动词中出现该词内片段，周围为讨论先决条件的句子

patterns.name: 意大利语动词词内片段
patterns.context: 意大利语被动结构“viene posto”中；句子讨论工作场所安全责任归属
patterns.domain: 意大利语法律／职业安全文本

patterns.name: 英语介词/冠词 In
patterns.context: 句首大写 In，后接“the British colonial age”；仅此例激活较弱

patterns.name: 英语词内片段 st
patterns.context: 英语句中表示“在……之中”的词尾拼写片段

patterns.name: 英语词尾衔接片段
patterns.context: Ubuntu IRC 中提及 Ubuntu 版本号“11.04”；片段边界可能跨越标注与未标注文本

patterns.name: 英语研究数据用语
patterns.context: 公共卫生研究中描述可用数据及分析目标，两个词分别有标注

patterns.name: 英语统计关联用语
patterns.context: 移植医学研究中描述危险因素与发病率之间的关联

en.description: Activations occur on several local strings: recommendations, Fin/Finish, photosoft domain-like lists, and names, newspaper titles, numbers, bots, and legal terms. These patterns span different genres and show no unified semantics.

patterns.name: recommendations terminology
patterns.context: Technical-title contexts such as “add recommendations to your Rails app” or “Hosting recommendations for startup.”

patterns.name: Finish/Finishing strings within words
patterns.context: Different capitalization and tokenization, but all contain the string fragment Fin/FIN followed by ish/ishing; they appear in company names and code comments, respectively.

patterns.name: Website paths/domain components
patterns.context: photosoft. repeatedly appears followed by multiple domain-like terms, forming a directory or URL list.
patterns.domain: Web text, possibly a domain list

patterns.name: Token segmentation in names/proper nouns
patterns.context: Proper nouns are split into multiple tokens; segment 3 contains a person's name and biography, while segment 5 contains a newspaper name.

patterns.name: Numeric count or monetary format
patterns.context: Numbers are adjacent and comma-separated, followed by troops; this occurs only in this segment.

patterns.name: bots highlighted in an abbreviation
patterns.context: “(bots)” appears as a parenthetical explanation of the term botnet.

patterns.name: rehearing in a legal opinion
patterns.context: A court opinion states that the defendant filed a rehearing motion; this occurs only in this segment.

1_1175.description: 激活落在多种局部字符串上：recommendations、Fin/Finish、photosoft 域名式列表，以及姓名、报纸名、数字、bots 和法律术语；这些模式跨越不同文体，未显出统一语义。

patterns.name: recommendations 术语
patterns.context: 出现“add recommendations to your Rails app”或“Hosting recommendations for startup”等技术标题语境。

patterns.name: 词内 Finish/Finishing 字符串
patterns.context: 大小写和分词方式不同，但都包含字符串片段 Fin/FIN，后接 ish/ishing；分别出现在公司名称和代码注释中。

patterns.name: 网站路径/域名组成
patterns.context: 重复出现 photosoft. 后接多个域名式词项，形成目录或网址列表。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、可能是域名列表

patterns.name: 人名/专名中的 token 分段
patterns.context: 专名被拆成多个 token；段3为人物姓名和传记，段5为报纸名称。

patterns.name: 数字计数或金额格式
patterns.context: 数字相邻并以逗号分隔，后接 troops；只有此段出现。

patterns.name: 缩写中突出 bots
patterns.context: “(bots)”作为 botnet 的术语解释括注出现。

patterns.name: 法律意见中的 rehearing
patterns.context: 法院意见叙述被告方提交 rehearing motion；仅此段出现。

en.description: Activations are scattered across Fin/finish spelling fragments, numbers, clothing in recommendations and domain lists, proper nouns, botnet, the legal term rehearing, and the code constant Find; most patterns occur only once or twice, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Fin/finish fragments within words
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments of words or names containing Fin/finish, including sentence-initial words, company names, and code comments; capitalization and word boundaries vary.

patterns.name: Numeric fragments in numbers, amounts, and dates
patterns.context: Occurs in quantities, birth dates, and legal document dates; some activations correspond to numeric tokens, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: recommendations and its context
patterns.context: Mentions adding recommendation functionality to a Rails application or offering recommendations for startups or hosting services; surrounding context involves headlines or technical discussion.

patterns.name: Category word in an image-domain directory
patterns.context: In repeated photosoft. domain lists, the category word clothing receives strong activation; other words in the same lists, such as coffee, family, and games, have weak or no activation.

patterns.name: Local fragments in proper nouns or compound words
patterns.context: Activations occur on subwords or fragments of school, hotel, newspaper, and company names, with no consistent meaning or fixed position.

patterns.name: Cybersecurity term botnet
patterns.context: In a definition of botnet, the parenthesized word bots receives activation; nearby text describes controlled infected hosts.

patterns.name: Legal procedural term rehearing
patterns.context: A court opinion describes the defendant's motion for rehearing.

patterns.name: Code constant Find
patterns.context: Defines a string constant corresponding to a find/search operation after a code comment.

1_1175.description: 激活分散在 Fin/finish 拼写片段、数字、recommendations、域名列表中的 clothing，以及专名、botnet、法律词 rehearing 和代码常量 Find 等处；多数模式仅见一两次，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 词内 Fin/finish 片段
patterns.context: 激活落在拼写含 Fin/finish 的词或名称片段中，包括句首词、公司名及代码注释；大小写和词边界不固定。
patterns.domain: 百科、网页、公司介绍、代码

patterns.name: 数字、金额与日期中的数字片段
patterns.context: 出现在数量、出生日期、法律文书日期等数字串中；部分激活对应数字 token，缺少统一的语义条件。

patterns.name: recommendations 及其上下文
patterns.context: 提到给 Rails 应用添加推荐功能，或为创业公司、托管服务提供推荐；周围有标题或技术讨论语境。

patterns.name: 图片类域名目录词
patterns.context: 重复的 photosoft. 域名列表中，类别词 clothing 获得强激活；同列表还有 coffee、family、games 等词，但激活很弱或为零。

patterns.name: 专名或复合词中的局部片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在学校、酒店、报纸及公司名称的若干子词或碎片上，没有一致的词义或固定位置。

patterns.name: 网络安全术语 botnet
patterns.context: 在 botnet 的释义中，括号里的 bots 获得激活；周围说明受控的受感染主机。

patterns.name: 法律文书程序词 rehearing
patterns.context: 法院意见中描述被告方提出 rehearing 动议。

patterns.name: 代码常量 Find
patterns.context: 在代码注释后定义查找/搜索操作对应的字符串常量。

en.description: Activations are scattered across proper nouns and their subword fragments, recommendations in technical titles, webpage domains and category words, and legal terminology, cited author surnames, and a botnet definition; there is no clear, unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments in personal or institutional names
patterns.context: Proper names are spelled across multiple tokens and often occur in news, biographies, institutional profiles, or headlines; activations fall on one or more name fragments.

patterns.name: Recommendation-feature title words
patterns.context: Occurs in a title describing how to add recommendation functionality to a Rails application, or in a startup hosting title.

patterns.name: Web domains and directory words
patterns.context: Occurs in repeated photosoft.* domain lists, where clothing is one of the directory/category names; there is no same clear semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Procedural wording in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs in a court opinion and points to the procedural context of a party filing a motion for rehearing.

patterns.name: Author surname fragment in an academic citation
patterns.context: Occurs as part of an author's surname in a parenthetical citation; surrounding text discusses spherically symmetric systems and fields.

patterns.name: Botnet terminology
patterns.context: In a parenthetical definition of botnet, refers to controlled host computers.

1_1175.description: 激活分散在专名及其子词片段、技术标题中的 recommendations、网页域名/类别词，以及法律术语、引用作者姓氏和 botnet 释义中；没有统一的明显语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 人名或机构名的专名片段
patterns.context: 专名由多个 token 拼写，常出现在新闻、人物传记、机构介绍或标题中；激活落在名称的一个或多个片段上。

patterns.name: 推荐功能标题词
patterns.context: 出现在介绍如何为 Rails 应用添加推荐功能的标题，或 startup hosting 的标题中。

patterns.name: 网页域名与目录词
patterns.context: 出现在重复的 photosoft.* 域名列表中，且 clothing 是其中一个目录/类别名；没有相同的明确语义模式。

patterns.name: 数字化法律文书措辞
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见中，指向当事人提出重审动议的程序性语境。

patterns.name: 学术引用中的作者姓氏片段
patterns.context: 出现在括号式文献引用中，作为作者姓氏的一部分；周围讨论球对称系统与场。

patterns.name: 机器人网络术语
patterns.context: 在 botnet 的括号释义中，指受控主机电脑。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、计算机安全

en.description: Activations are scattered across several local terms: recommendation features, specific names or word forms (Hatchet, Eamon, bots, clothing, etc.), troop counts, company names, physics citations, and legal-procedure terms. The segments have no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: Suggestions, recommendations, and their deployment
patterns.context: Activates around adding recommendation features to a Rails app or discussing hosting recommendations for startups; mainly appears in headlines and technical descriptions.

patterns.name: Specific word forms in entity names
patterns.context: Strongly activates when the newspaper name “Hatchet” appears in a news report; the same segment also contains proper names and event information such as “inaugural ball.”

patterns.name: clothing in a domain list
patterns.context: Activates on “clothing” in repeated listings of photosoft. followed by different category or site suffixes; other suffixes in the same list activate less strongly.

patterns.name: bots in a patent citation
patterns.context: Activates when explaining the term botnet and identifying bots in parentheses as the controlled computers that make up a botnet.

patterns.name: Eamon in a name
patterns.context: Activates when the name Eamon Boland is repeated in a biographical entry; activations fall on tokenized fragments of the name.

patterns.name: Numbers and troop-count expressions
patterns.context: In a news sentence reporting that Obama deployed or called up troops for an event and quantifying the force, troops activates most strongly.

patterns.name: Unusual spelling fragment in an organization name
patterns.context: Activates on segmented character fragments of the name in a webpage header or company profile reading About Finishing Associates, Inc.

patterns.name: Author-name fragment in a physics citation
patterns.context: Activates on a tokenized fragment of the surname Krechet in a citation in academic text about spinor fields; other technical content in the same segment shows no equally clear shared trigger.

patterns.name: rehearing in a legal opinion
patterns.context: Activates on the legal-procedure term when a court opinion states that the defendant-appellee/cross-appellant filed a rehearing motion.

1_1175.description: 激活分散于若干局部词项：推荐功能、特定名称或词形（Hatchet、Eamon、bots、clothing 等），以及军队数量、公司名、物理学引文和法律程序用语；各段的共同语义不明显。

patterns.name: 建议、推荐及其部署
patterns.context: 围绕将推荐功能加入 Rails 应用，或讨论面向初创公司的托管推荐方案时激活；主要落在标题和技术说明中。

patterns.name: 实体名称中的特定词形
patterns.context: 新闻报道中出现学校报纸名称 “Hatchet” 时强激活；同段还有 “inaugural ball”等专名及活动信息。

patterns.name: 域名列表中的 clothing
patterns.context: 重复列出 photosoft. 后接不同类别或站点后缀的域名时，在 “clothing” 上激活；同一列表中的其他后缀激活较弱。

patterns.name: 专利文献引文中的 bots
patterns.context: 解释 botnet 一词、并在括号中给出 bots 作为构成 botnet 的受控计算机称呼时激活。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术／技术定义

patterns.name: 姓名中的 Eamon
patterns.context: 人物传记条目中，姓名 Eamon Boland 重复出现时激活；激活分布在姓名的分词片段上。

patterns.name: 数字与军队数量表达
patterns.context: 新闻句中报道 Obama 为某事调派或征召军队，并以数字量化兵力时，troops 激活最强。

patterns.name: 组织名称的异常拼写片段
patterns.context: 网页页眉或公司简介中出现公司名称 About Finishing Associates, Inc. 时，名称被拆分的字符片段激活。

patterns.name: 物理学引文作者名片段
patterns.context: 旋量场相关学术文本的参考文献引用中，作者姓氏 Krechet 的分词片段激活；同段其他技术内容未显示同等明确的共同触发。

patterns.name: 法律意见中的 rehearing
patterns.context: 法院意见书叙述被告—被上诉人／交叉上诉人提交 rehearing motion 时，该法律程序用语激活。

en.description: Activations are scattered across proper nouns, within-word subword boundaries, title/line-break structure, numeric adjacency, academic citations, and isolated technical terms; no semantic or syntactic pattern explains all samples.

patterns.name: Specific word or subword boundaries
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on word components or tokenization boundaries, especially particular subwords in Hatchet, bots, Tillotson/Ootsuki, and clothing; no unified semantic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Different genres including news, cybersecurity, song entries, website categories, and author lists

patterns.name: Personal names and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Personal names, institutional names, or proper nouns in citations are split across multiple tokens, and some name fragments activate strongly; positions and name types vary.
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedias, company profiles, academic papers

patterns.name: Titles and structural markers
patterns.context: Activations occur near the beginning of text, titles, author fields, or line breaks; some fall on title words or fragments within them.
patterns.domain: Webpages, encyclopedias, paper metadata, and company pages

patterns.name: Numbers and adjacent content
patterns.context: Activations occur near numbers, dates, or quantity expressions, but numbers themselves are not a consistent trigger and often co-occur with names, places, or word fragments.

patterns.name: Academic terms and citation fragments
patterns.context: Author surnames, reference markers, and neighboring term fragments in academic text activate, with no stable trigger tied to a disciplinary concept.

patterns.name: Rails recommendation-feature term
patterns.context: Triggered in a title describing how to add recommendation functionality to a Rails application; this is currently a single example, making it difficult to determine whether it is a semantic pattern.

1_1175.description: 激活分散在专名、词内子词边界、标题/换行结构、数字邻接、学术引文及单例技术词上；没有一个语义或句法模式能解释全部样本。

patterns.name: 特定词或子词边界
patterns.context: 激活集中在词的组成部分或分词边界，尤以 Hatchet、bots、Tillotson/Ootsuki、clothing 中特定子词为明显；未见统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻、网络安全、歌曲条目、网站分类、作者列表等不同文体

patterns.name: 人名与专名片段
patterns.context: 人物姓名、机构名或引用中的专名被拆分成多个 token，部分姓名片段激活较强；具体位置和姓名类型不一致。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、企业介绍、学术论文

patterns.name: 标题与结构标记
patterns.context: 文本开头、标题、作者字段或换行附近出现激活；有些激活落在标题词或其内部片段上。
patterns.domain: 网页、百科、论文元数据及企业页面

patterns.name: 数字及其邻接内容
patterns.context: 数字、日期或数量表达附近有激活，但数字本身并非一致的触发点，常与人名、地名或词片段共现。

patterns.name: 学术术语及引文片段
patterns.context: 学术文本中的作者姓氏、参考文献标识及邻近术语片段激活，未显示稳定的学科概念触发条件。

patterns.name: Rails 推荐功能词
patterns.context: 在介绍如何为 Rails 应用添加推荐功能的标题中触发；目前仅此一例，难以判断是否为语义模式。

en.description: Activations are scattered across recommendations, quantity-related news, campus proper nouns, cybersecurity terminology, company names, paper citations and author names, domain categories, and legal terms; there is no stable shared semantic or syntactic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: recommendations vocabulary
patterns.context: “recommendations” is the central noun for a product feature or service topic; nearby words include app, hosting, and startup.

patterns.name: Numeric quantity expressions
patterns.context: In a news sentence, a promised quantity is adjacent to a military personnel noun; the number marker and quantity phrase may jointly trigger.

patterns.name: Specific proper noun or title word
patterns.context: The newspaper name Hatchet and event name inaugural ball appear in a report about a university event; activation falls on subwords of proper nouns/title words.

patterns.name: bots in a botnet definition
patterns.context: Parentheses first explain the components of the term botnet, then state that bots are the computers being controlled.

patterns.name: Finishing in a company name
patterns.context: The name contains Finishing in the title or opening of a company introduction page.

patterns.name: Author surnames in paper citations
patterns.context: In academic reference markers, author surnames are split into subwords; different cited surnames activate.

patterns.name: clothing in a domain directory
patterns.context: The category subdomain is clothing in a repeated photosoft.<category> format list; the same list also includes coffee, family, games, etc.

patterns.name: Ootsuki in an author's name
patterns.context: A Japanese romanized surname in a paper's author list, embedded in author names and numbering format.

patterns.name: rehearing in legal documents
patterns.context: A court opinion describes a party filing a motion for rehearing.

1_1175.description: 激活分散在推荐功能、数量新闻、校园专名、网络安全术语、公司名、论文引文与作者名、域名类别和法律术语等位置；没有稳定共享的语义或句法触发模式。

patterns.name: recommendations 词汇
patterns.context: “recommendations”作为产品功能或服务主题中的核心名词；周围出现 app、hosting、startup 等词。

patterns.name: 数字化数量表达
patterns.context: 新闻句中，承诺的数量与军事人员名词相邻；数字标记与数量短语可能共同触发。

patterns.name: 特定专名或标题词
patterns.context: 大学活动报道中，报纸名称 Hatchet 与活动名称 inaugural ball；激活落在专名/标题词的子词上。

patterns.name: botnet 释义中的 bots
patterns.context: 括号中先解释 botnet 的术语构成，再说明 bots 是被控制的计算机。
patterns.domain: 网络安全定义／专利背景

patterns.name: 公司名称中的 Finishing
patterns.context: 公司介绍页标题或简介开头，名称包含 Finishing。

patterns.name: 论文引文中的作者姓氏
patterns.context: 学术文本的参考文献标记中，作者姓氏被拆成子词；不同引文姓氏均有激活。

patterns.name: 域名目录中的 clothing
patterns.context: 重复的 photosoft.<类别> 格式列表中，类别子域名为 clothing；同列表还有 coffee、family、games 等。

patterns.name: 作者姓名中的 Ootsuki
patterns.context: 论文作者列表中的日文罗马字姓氏，嵌在作者姓名及编号格式中。

patterns.name: 法律文书 rehearing
patterns.context: 法院意见中描述当事人提出重审动议。

en.concept: Salient words and numbers in several types of structured problems
en.description: Covers a software recommendation-feature headline, a news report with proper nouns, and several types of synthetic math QA: integer-property judgments, differentiation, place value, sequence terms, and common denominators/least common multiples. Most math segments share a question-answer format, but the specific mathematical tasks differ.

patterns.name: Headline about a recommendation feature
patterns.context: Describes adding or hosting recommendation features for an app or startup in a headline; activation falls on “recommendations” and nearby headline words

patterns.name: News proper noun and report quotation
patterns.context: A newspaper name, Hatchet, appears in a news report, followed by a colon and quotation; high activation here may be concentrated within the proper noun

patterns.name: Large integers in arithmetic judgment questions
patterns.context: A question asks whether something is a factor, multiple, or prime, with True/False as the answer; large integers are represented by segmented tokens

patterns.name: Multi-digit numbers and factor/prime judgments
patterns.context: True/false judgments about whether an integer is prime, composite, or a factor, including long digit strings

patterns.name: Differentiating algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Requests a first or second derivative of a polynomial containing variables and powers; numbers and variables in the expression are split into multiple tokens

patterns.name: Place-value questions
patterns.context: Asks for the ones, tens, or higher-place digit of a given integer, usually with a brief numeric answer for each question

patterns.name: Finding a sequence term
patterns.context: Gives a sequence and asks for a specified nth term; polynomial-form sequence expressions may also appear nearby

patterns.name: Fractions and least common multiples
patterns.context: Asks for a common denominator of two fractions or the least common multiple of two integers, and gives a numeric answer

1_1175.concept: 多类结构化问题中的显著词与数字
1_1175.description: 覆盖一个软件推荐功能标题、新闻专名报道，以及多类合成数学问答：整数性质判断、求导、位值、数列项和公分母／最小公倍数。多数数学段落共享问答格式，但具体数学任务不同。

patterns.name: 推荐功能的标题
patterns.context: 在标题中描述向应用或初创公司添加、托管推荐功能；激活落在“recommendations”及附近的标题词上

patterns.name: 新闻专名与报道引语
patterns.context: 新闻报道中出现报纸名称 Hatchet，后接冒号和引语；此处高激活可能集中在专名内部

patterns.name: 算术判断题中的大整数
patterns.context: 以问句要求判断因数、倍数或质数，并以 True/False 作答；大整数以分段 token 呈现

patterns.name: 多位数与因数／质数判断
patterns.context: 围绕整数是否为质数、合数或因数进行真假判断，含较长数字串

patterns.name: 代数式求导
patterns.context: 要求对含变量及幂的多项式求一阶或二阶导数，式中数字和变量被切分为多个 token

patterns.name: 位值数字提问
patterns.context: 询问给定整数的个位、十位或更高位数字，通常逐题给出简短数字答案

patterns.name: 数列求项
patterns.context: 给出数列，询问指定的第 n 项；附近也可能出现多项式形式的数列表达

patterns.name: 分数与最小公倍数
patterns.context: 询问两个分数的公分母或两个整数的最小公倍数，并给出数值答案

en.description: Activations mostly occur on numbers, numeric answers, and algebraic expressions in math QA; there are also numbers in a rolling-matrix problem, as well as names, dates, and phrases in web text. It is difficult to explain them with one shared local trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric answers in arithmetic problems
patterns.context: Numbers, digit strings, or answer digits appear in arithmetic QA sequences, potentially involving factors/multiples, primes, place value, or sequence calculations. Some markers concentrate on the problem numbers and others on the answers.

patterns.name: Numbers and symbols in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Numbers combine with variables, multiplication signs, and exponent symbols to form algebraic expressions or like-term simplification problems.

patterns.name: Digit strings in a rolling-matrix problem
patterns.context: Numbers are embedded in a description of a question about a rolling input matrix; this occurs only once, so it is unclear whether the trigger is the numbers themselves or the context.

patterns.name: Proper nouns, numeric dates, and text fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur on names, organization names, and date numbers in news narratives, as well as in licensing statements and phrase fragments; no local structure matching math QA is apparent.

1_1175.description: 激活多见于数学问答中的数字、数值答案和代数式；另有滚动矩阵问题里的数字，以及网页文本中的人名、日期和短语，难以用同一局部触发模式解释。

patterns.name: 算术题数字与数值答案
patterns.trigger: 如“« 15»”“« 216»”“«False»”“«7»3”，以及题目中的数值答案
patterns.context: 数字、数字串或答案数字出现在算术问答序列中；可能涉及因数/倍数、质数、位值，或数列计算。部分标记集中在问题数字，部分集中在答案。

patterns.name: 代数式中的数字与符号
patterns.context: 数字与变量、乘号、指数符号共同构成代数表达式或合并同类项题目。

patterns.name: 滚动矩阵问题中的数字串
patterns.context: 数字嵌在关于 rolling input matrix 的问题描述中；仅有这一段，触发是否来自数字本身或上下文不确定。

patterns.name: 专名、数字日期与文本片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在新闻叙述中的人名、机构名及日期数字，也出现在许可说明和短语片段中；未见与数学问答相同的局部结构。

en.description: Primarily responds to words containing the letter sequence shr, especially variants of shrink/shrinking and enshrine; there are also sporadic responses to Markdown footnote markers, em-dash separators, and code indentation whitespace.

patterns.name: shr stem and its derivatives
patterns.context: Appears in words such as shrink/shrinking or enshrine/enshrine; words are sometimes split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain general text, medical abstracts, literature, legal and news text, code strings

patterns.name: Markdown footnote markers
patterns.context: Appears in Markdown text with footnote numbers or citations.

patterns.name: Em-dash separators
patterns.context: Located in lines of hyphens used as separators in email signatures or source-code comments.

patterns.name: Code-formatting whitespace
patterns.context: Near indentation, line breaks, and statement boundaries in code blocks; may also be a weak accompanying feature in code contexts.

1_1175.concept: shr 字母序列及分隔符
1_1175.description: 主要响应包含 shr 字母序列的词，尤其 shrink/shrinking 与 enshrine 的变体；另对 Markdown 脚注标记、长横线分隔符及代码缩进空白有零星响应。

patterns.name: shr 词干及其派生词
patterns.context: 出现在 shrink/shrinking（缩小）或 enshrine/enshrine（铭刻、确立）等词中；有时词被拆成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 跨领域普通文本、医学摘要、文学、法律与新闻、代码字符串

patterns.name: Markdown 脚注标记
patterns.context: 出现在带脚注编号或引用的 Markdown 文本中。

patterns.name: 长横线分隔符
patterns.context: 位于邮件签名或源代码注释中的横线分隔栏。

patterns.name: 代码排版空白
patterns.context: 代码块中缩进、换行及语句边界附近；也可能是代码环境中的弱伴随特征。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to Interrupt and interrupt-related word forms, including system calls, kernel interrupts, registers, efficiency, and book titles. There are also activations on the Epic spelling fragment, the Giants team name, and several sporadic words and comment symbols; the latter categories have unclear connections to the main pattern.

patterns.name: Interrupt word forms
patterns.context: Word forms relating to interrupts, interrupt operations, or interrupt events, with variations in capitalization and affixes; contexts include error descriptions, kernel scheduling, interrupt registers, work efficiency, and book titles
patterns.domain: Systems programming, technical discussions, general text, and book titles

patterns.name: Epic word-form fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on the spelling fragment Epic, with varied following word forms and semantics; no clear shared semantic condition
patterns.domain: Horse-racing entries, arts institution lists, biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: Giants word form
patterns.context: The New York Giants team name appears in a narrative about players, their colleagues, and media work

patterns.name: Document interrupt marker
patterns.context: C code comment terminator; appears alongside Interrupt word forms in the adjacent comment
patterns.domain: C code and hardware register definitions

patterns.name: Sporadic function words and affixes
patterns.context: Appears in only a few contexts, with no stable shared trigger condition; some activations may be due to adjacent main word forms or common contextual words

1_1175.description: 主要对 Interrupt 及其中断相关词形起强反应，涵盖系统调用、内核中断、寄存器、效率和书名。另有 Epic 拼写片段、Giants 队名及若干零散词和注释符号激活，后几类与主模式联系不明。

patterns.name: Interrupt 词形
patterns.context: 出现中断、中断操作或中断事件的词形，大小写及词缀变化均可；上下文包括错误说明、内核调度、中断寄存器、工作效率和书名
patterns.domain: 系统编程、技术讨论、一般文本及书名

patterns.name: Epic 词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 Epic 这一拼写片段上，后续词形和语义各不相同；没有明显共同语义条件
patterns.domain: 赛马条目、艺术机构名单、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: Giants 词形
patterns.context: 纽约 Giants 球队名称，出现在球员及其同事、媒体工作的叙述中

patterns.name: 文档中断标记
patterns.context: C 代码注释结束符；与邻近注释中的 Interrupt 词形同时出现
patterns.domain: C 代码及硬件寄存器定义

patterns.name: 零散功能词与词缀
patterns.context: 仅在少量上下文中出现，未显示稳定的共同触发条件；部分可能是相邻主词形或常见上下文词带来的激活

en.description: The most stable trigger is the standalone capitalized word “All,” appearing across multiple genres; “significant” and “parameters” also trigger in scientific papers, both concentrated in research-results or health-indicator contexts.

patterns.name: Capitalized word-initial All
patterns.context: Appears where All is a standalone capitalized word followed by a noun or another constituent; it may occur mid-sentence, at the beginning of a sentence, or in a copyright statement.
patterns.domain: Narrative, religious, medical, product copy, copyright statements, and other genres

patterns.name: Statistical significance term
patterns.context: Appears in statements of statistical results in medical or nutrition studies, such as “any significant effect.”

patterns.name: Research use of parameters
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of measurement indicators or performance parameters in studies, often near evaluations, effects, or results.

1_1175.description: 最稳定的触发是独立大写词“All”，跨多种文体出现；另有科学论文中的“significant”和“parameters”触发，二者集中于研究结果或健康指标语境。

patterns.name: All 大写词首
patterns.context: 出现在 All 为独立大写词的语境，后接名词或其他成分；可位于句中、句首或版权语句中。
patterns.domain: 叙述、宗教、医学、商品文案、版权声明等多种文体

patterns.name: 显著性统计术语
patterns.context: 医学或营养学研究中，出现在“any significant effect”等统计结果表述里。

patterns.name: parameters 研究用法
patterns.context: 出现在研究对测量指标或性能参数的讨论中，附近常有评价、影响或结果描述。

en.description: All passages activate at Both; the word introduces two coordinated objects or refers back to two previously mentioned items, followed by a shared statement. The corpus spans encyclopedias, law, literature, and publishing profiles.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial contrastive/coordinating Both
patterns.context: Both appears capitalized at the beginning of a sentence or mid-sentence, followed by coordinated objects, two categories of things, or two people; often summarizes preceding text and opens the following sentence.
patterns.domain: Multidomain narrative, encyclopedias, legal documents, and literature

patterns.name: Explicit contrast or coordination of two objects
patterns.context: The scope of Both clearly covers two coordinated entities, commonly in constructions such as Both X and Y, or Both men/women/accounts/parties; the objects are usually identifiable from context.
patterns.domain: History, biographies, law, and general expository writing

patterns.name: Both + noun, referring back to two prior items
patterns.context: The preceding text has mentioned two books, two parties, two accounts, or two men; Both introduces a statement that applies to the two objects collectively.
patterns.domain: Publishing profiles, legal documents, and company/case narratives

patterns.name: Coordination of two places or constituencies
patterns.context: The preceding text lists constituencies represented by or won by a politician; Both coordinates the two place names.

1_1175.description: 所有段均在 Both 处激活；该词引出两个并列对象，或回指前文已提及的两项，后接共同陈述。语料涵盖百科、法律、文学和出版介绍。
