patterns.name: 句首转折/并列引出 Both
patterns.context: 段落中出现大写句首或句中大写的 Both，后面接并列对象、两类事物或两个人；常用于总结前文并开启后续句子。
patterns.domain: 多领域叙述、百科、法律文书及文学

patterns.name: 明确的双对象对照或并列
patterns.trigger: «Both»10 后接如 “Clan Cameron and Clan C…”, “France and Italy”, “the Soviet Union and Armenia”, “LSS and WHO”
patterns.context: Both 的辖域明确覆盖两个并列实体，常见结构为 Both X and Y，或 Both men/women/accounts/parties；对象通常可从上下文识别。
patterns.domain: 历史、人物传记、法律及一般说明文

patterns.name: Both + 名词，回指前文两项
patterns.context: 前文已提到两本书、两方、两个账户或两名男性，Both 引出对这两个对象共同成立的陈述。
patterns.domain: 出版介绍、法律文书及公司/案件叙述

patterns.name: 两地或两选区并列
patterns.context: 前文列举政治人物曾代表或当选的选区，Both 将两个地名并列。

en.description: The strongest activations concentrate on sentence-initial “Both,” introducing coordinated items or shared attributes; sentence-initial “All” also introduces general statements, and one activation occurs on the “All” fragment inside the proper name McAllister.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial “Both” introducing a coordination
patterns.context: “Both” occurs at the beginning of a sentence, followed by two coordinated people, organizations, things, or attributes; common forms include “Both X and Y,” but it may also precede a predicate or noun phrase.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, encyclopedias, academic abstracts, and narrative prose

patterns.name: Sentence-initial “All” referring to a whole
patterns.context: “All” occurs at the beginning of a sentence, followed by general groups such as “the world” or “nations,” forming a statement about the whole.

patterns.name: Internal “All” word fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on the letter sequence “All” inside the proper name “McAllister,” not on a sentence-initial determiner.

1_1175.description: 最强激活集中在句首的“Both”，引出并列对象或共同属性；另有句首“All”引出整体性陈述，以及一次专名McAllister内部的“All”片段激活。

patterns.name: 句首“Both”并列引出
patterns.context: “Both”位于句首，后接两个并列的人、组织、事物或属性；常见于“Both X and Y”，也可接后续谓语或名词短语。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、百科、学术摘要及叙事散文

patterns.name: 句首“All”泛指整体
patterns.context: “All”位于句首，后接“the world”或“nations”等泛指群体，构成整体性陈述。

patterns.name: 内部词缀片段“All”
patterns.context: 激活落在专名“McAllister”内部的“All”字母序列，并非句首量词。
patterns.domain: 书籍介绍、旧式出版文本

en.description: Primarily responds to Both denoting two litigation-related entities in legal texts, often connected by and; also occurs with coordinated place names and as within-name fragments in old books.

patterns.name: Both introducing opposing parties in legal documents
patterns.context: Both introduces two litigants, institutions, or witnesses at the beginning or within a sentence, often followed by and; nearby text often mentions claims, testimony, motions, or judgments.
patterns.domain: U.S. court decisions and legal documents

patterns.name: Coordinated place names in biographies
patterns.context: Both coordinates two constituencies or places, indicating that they belong to the same political category.

patterns.name: Name fragments in printed works
patterns.context: Activations occur on fragments within book titles or names, near book prefaces, printing information, or alphabetized name indexes; the context does not match a Both coordination structure.

1_1175.description: 主要响应法律文本中表示两个诉讼相关实体的“Both”，常以 and 连接；另有并列地名用法，以及古籍中的姓名词内片段激活。

patterns.name: 法律文书中“Both”引出双方
patterns.trigger: «Both»（多处后接双方名称，如“Both Cyphers and Ferro”“Both parties”）
patterns.context: 句首或句中以 Both 引出两个当事人、机构或证人，常接 and；附近常出现诉讼主张、证词、动议或判决。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与法律文书

patterns.name: 人物传记中的并列地名
patterns.context: Both 并列两个选区或地点，说明它们同属某种政治类别。

patterns.name: 印刷品中的姓名片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在书名或姓名的词内片段，附近是书籍前言、印刷信息或按字母排列的人名索引；未见与 Both 并列结构相符的上下文。

en.concept: Capitalized word beginnings and document titles/legal phrasing
en.description: Activations often fall on capitalized word beginnings and title-style text, and also occur in legal proceedings, law-enforcement roles, and phrasing about parties; a few book indexes and narrative terms are difficult to unify with the legal contexts.

patterns.name: Capitalized word beginnings in titles, proper nouns, or legal text
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the beginnings of capitalized words or tokenized proper nouns/word forms; they often occur at sentence beginnings, in titles, or in legal-document formatting, but not all capitalized words trigger.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, book titles and main text

patterns.name: Legal proceedings and judicial phrasing
patterns.context: Appears in contexts involving party status, legal claims, liability, trials, or court statements; activation falls on relevant legal words, common function words, or capitalized word beginnings.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions and litigation documents

patterns.name: Agent and law-enforcement/investigative roles
patterns.context: The title Agent appears explicitly; the passage concerns government investigations, law-enforcement personnel, or their testimony.
patterns.domain: Investigative and law-enforcement narratives in legal rulings

patterns.name: Book publishing and chapter titles
patterns.context: Appears in book titles, publication information, chapter headings, or title-style capitalization at the start of the main text.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg historical books and publication pages

patterns.name: Opposing parties or collective entities in cases
patterns.context: Refers to opposing parties in litigation or a group of defendants, companies, or similar entities; Both activates repeatedly in two legal passages.

patterns.name: Other bibliographic, narrative, and tokenized word forms
patterns.context: Appears in index-like entries with page numbers or historical narratives; some triggering words are not clearly related to the legal pattern, and word forms may be split into tokens.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg book indexes, titles, or main text

1_1175.concept: 大写词首与文书标题/法律措辞
1_1175.description: 激活多落在大写词首及标题式文字，也见于法律诉讼、执法角色和双方主体措辞；少数书籍目录与叙事词项难与法律语境统一。

patterns.name: 标题、专名或法律文本中的大写词首
patterns.context: 激活集中于大写词的词首或被分词切开的专名/词形；常处在句首、标题或法律文书格式中，但并非所有大写词都触发。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、书籍标题及正文

patterns.name: 法律诉讼程序与司法措辞
patterns.context: 出现在当事人身份、诉讼主张、法律责任、审判或法院陈述等语境；激活落在相关法律词、常见功能词或大小写词首上。
patterns.domain: 美国法律意见与诉讼文书

patterns.name: Agent及执法/调查角色
patterns.context: 明确出现 Agent 这一职务称谓；段落涉及政府调查、执法人员或其证词。
patterns.domain: 法律判决中的调查与执法叙述

patterns.name: 书籍出版与章节标题
patterns.context: 出现在书名、出版信息、章节标题或正文开头的标题式大写文字中。

patterns.name: 案件中的双方或集合主体
patterns.context: 指称诉讼双方或一组被告、公司等主体；其中 Both 在两个法律段落中重复触发。

patterns.name: 其他书目、叙事与分词词形
patterns.context: 出现在带页码的目录/索引式条目或历史叙述中，个别触发词与法律模式不明显相关；词形可能被拆分标记。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 书籍的目录、标题或正文

en.concept: Proper-name terminology in formal documents and historical texts
en.description: Activations occur mainly in legal documents involving property, trusts, courts, constitutions, and litigation narratives, as well as names, titles, and citation formats; they also occur in Civil War armies, book publication information, and historical constituency texts, with no single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Legal terminology in legal and government texts
patterns.context: In legal opinions, decisions, or statutes, activations often fall on part of a legal concept or fixed term, including contexts involving property, trusts, courts, state constitutions, and government departments.

patterns.name: Names and title labels in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs in case captions, party or attorney names, identity descriptions, and abbreviations; activations may fall on name fragments or titles rather than sentence meaning.
patterns.domain: Legal case captions and litigation records

patterns.name: Case facts and procedure in litigation narratives
patterns.context: Describes court orders, claims, findings of fact, or party evidence; activated words are scattered across legal narratives and are not always exclusively legal terms.

patterns.name: Armies and generals in historical military narratives
patterns.context: In U.S. Civil War historical accounts, troop movements, ranks, organization, and generals' names occur nearby.

patterns.name: Book publication details and preface editions
patterns.context: Book title pages or prefaces contain printers, addresses, editions, and author names; strong activations fall on proper-name fragments.

patterns.name: Political constituencies and election narratives
patterns.context: Describes historical representatives who represented or chose different constituencies, including elections and constituency names.

patterns.name: Activations near punctuation and statutory citations
patterns.context: Activations also occur near commas, periods, or statute numbers, but often co-occur with case citations, names, or statutory text, so a stable punctuation pattern cannot be established independently.
patterns.domain: Primarily legal documents, also historical and publishing texts

1_1175.concept: 正式文书与历史文本中的专名术语
1_1175.description: 激活主要见于法律文书中的财产、信托、法院、宪法及诉讼叙述，也落在人名、职务和引用格式上；另见内战军队、书籍出版信息及历史选区文本，未呈现单一语义触发。

patterns.name: 法律与政府文本中的法律术语
patterns.context: 在法律意见、判决或法规中，激活常落在法律概念或固定术语的一部分上；包括财产、信托、法院、州宪法及政府部门等语境。

patterns.name: 法律文书的人名与职务标签
patterns.context: 出现在案件标题、当事人或律师姓名、身份说明与缩写中；激活可能落在姓名的片段或职务称谓，而非句义。
patterns.domain: 法律案件标题与诉讼记录

patterns.name: 法律诉讼叙述中的案件事实与程序
patterns.context: 描述法院命令、诉讼请求、事实认定或当事人举证；激活词分散在法律叙述中，并不总是专属法律术语。

patterns.name: 历史军事叙述中的军队与将领
patterns.context: 美国内战历史叙述中，部队调动、军衔、编制和将领姓名相邻出现。

patterns.name: 书籍出版信息与前言版次
patterns.context: 书籍扉页或前言中出现印刷所、地址、版次及作者姓名；强激活落在专名片段。

patterns.name: 政治选区与选举叙述
patterns.context: 描述历史议员曾代表或选择不同选区，包含选举及选区专名。

patterns.name: 标点及法条引用附近的激活
patterns.context: 逗号、句点或法条编号附近也有激活，但常与案件引文、姓名或法规文本共现，不能单独确认其为稳定标点模式。
patterns.domain: 以法律文书为主，亦见历史与出版文本

en.concept: Full forms and bilateral phrasing in English legal texts
en.description: Activations concentrate on two word groups: All (including within proper names such as Allister and Allbritton) and Both, which introduces two parties in legal documents; there is also one instance of of within a legal proper name.

patterns.name: High activation near “All”
patterns.context: The capitalized form All is followed by part of a proper name (e.g., Allister, Allbritton) or a common noun (four, nations); note that [2], [5], [7]–[9] actually highlight Both, not All.
patterns.domain: Book text, legal decisions, and legal documents

patterns.name: “Both” introducing two parties at the beginning or within a sentence
patterns.context: Both introduces two parties, two witnesses, or litigants, usually followed by their names, claims, testimony, or actions; it can appear at the beginning or within a paragraph.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal decisions and litigation materials

patterns.name: “of” in a legal citation
patterns.context: Occurs within legal proper names, such as court or institution names, e.g., “Supreme Court of Florida”; there is only one notable activation, with no stable shared pattern in the surrounding context.
patterns.domain: Legal decision titles or institution names

1_1175.concept: 英文法律文本中的全称与双方表述
1_1175.description: 激活集中在两组词：All（含嵌入专名 Allister、Allbritton）及法律文书中引出双方的 Both；另有一次法律专名中的 of。

patterns.name: “All”附近高激活
patterns.context: 大小写形式 All 后接专名的一部分（如 Allister、Allbritton），或接普通名词（four、nations）；需注意，[2]、[5]、[7]–[9]实际高亮的是 Both，而不是 All。
patterns.domain: 书籍正文、法律判决及法律文书

patterns.name: “Both”句首或句中引出双方
patterns.context: Both 用来引出两方、两名证人或当事人，后文通常列出双方名称、主张、证词或行动；可出现在段首或段中。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决、诉讼材料

patterns.name: 法律引文中的“of”
patterns.context: 出现在法院名称或机构名称等法律专名内部，如“Supreme Court of Florida”；只有一次显著激活，且相邻语境没有稳定共同模式。
patterns.domain: 法律判决标题或机构名称

en.concept: References to both parties in legal texts
en.description: Primarily responds to Both/both referring to both parties in legal documents, often before parties or coordinated subjects; also responds to court captions, procedural terms, legal citation formats, and some fragments within proper names.

patterns.name: Both in legal texts
patterns.context: Summarizes or coordinates both parties, entities, or positions in legal discussion; usually sentence-initial and followed by a subject or parties
patterns.domain: Decisions, litigation materials, and other legal documents

patterns.name: Legal document structure and citation format
patterns.context: Captions, court information, sections, or citation formats in formal legal documents; does not require Both

patterns.name: Adjudicative bodies and procedural vocabulary
patterns.context: Introduces courts, judges, trials, or procedural matters

patterns.name: Fragments within legal proper names and compounds
patterns.context: Activations fall within proper names or across word fragments, whose fragments alone do not reveal a stable semantic condition
patterns.domain: Book text, company or institutional names, and legal case facts

1_1175.concept: 法律文本中的双方表述
1_1175.description: 主要响应法律文书中表示双方的 Both/both，常见于 parties 或并列主体之前；也响应法院标题、程序术语、法律引证格式，并有若干专名内部片段激活。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 Both
patterns.trigger: “Both”或“both”，特别是紧随其后的“parties”；第 4 段为“Both VISA and MasterCard”
patterns.context: 法律论述中概括或并列双方当事人、实体或观点；通常位于句首，后接主体或 parties
patterns.domain: 判决、诉讼材料及其他法律文书

patterns.name: 法律文书结构与引文格式
patterns.context: 正式法律文书的标题、法院信息、章节或引证格式；不要求出现 Both

patterns.name: 裁判机构与程序词汇
patterns.trigger: “District Court”“jury trial”“Bankruptcy Judges”“Bankruptcy Judge”“contested case proceeding”
patterns.context: 介绍法院、法官、审判或程序事项

patterns.name: 法律专名及复合词内部片段
patterns.trigger: 拆分或带有异常大小写的片段，如“«All»ister”“«more»land”“«Opp»ortunities”“«All»ied”“«Trans»portation”
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或跨词片段内部，单凭这些片段看不出稳定的语义条件
patterns.domain: 书籍正文、公司或机构名称及法律案件事实

en.description: Primarily responds to Both in legal documents, covering two parties, two men, two accounts, or two institutions; a few instances of All also occur within personal or company names and may represent a word-form trigger distinct from the main pattern.

patterns.name: Both in legal texts
patterns.context: In legal opinions, decisions, or litigation narratives, the word following Both may be parties, men, accounts, or directly the Authority; the word itself is the most prominent shared trigger across the passages.

patterns.name: All in personal names
patterns.context: Embedded in proper names or surnames: Mc«All»ister, «All»«br»itt, «All»ied; this is not the ordinary syntactic Both pattern.
patterns.domain: Book publication information and personal or company names in legal documents

1_1175.description: 主要响应法律文书中的 Both，涵盖双方当事人、两名男子、两个账户或两个机构；另有少数 All 出现在人名、公司名内部，可能是与主模式不同的词形触发。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 Both
patterns.context: 在法律意见、判决或诉讼叙述中，紧接 Both 的词可为 parties、men、accounts，也可直接接 the Authority；该词本身是各段最突出的共同触发。

patterns.name: 人名中的 All
patterns.context: 嵌在专名或姓氏中：Mc«All»ister、«All»«br»itt、«All»ied；并非普通句法中的 Both 模式。
patterns.domain: 书籍出版信息与法律文书中的人名、公司名

en.concept: The string “All” and its word-initial prefix
en.description: The strongest shared cue is the capitalization form All: this includes both the complete word All at the beginning or within a sentence and the All prefix within names such as Allstate, Alligator, and Allbritton; contexts are mostly legal documents, with some historical texts.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial All
patterns.context: The complete word All appears at the beginning or within a sentence, followed by a determiner, quantifier, noun phrase, or of phrase; activation concentrates on All rather than subsequent words.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, pleadings, and historical texts

patterns.name: All prefix within proper names
patterns.context: The capitalization form All occurs at the beginning of a proper name or compound, with subsequent letters attached; also includes proper-name fragments beginning with «Al».
patterns.domain: Names such as Allstate in legal texts; proper names or words in Gutenberg texts

patterns.name: Inconsistent within-word All
patterns.context: Activation falls on the string All, which is followed by the tokenized fragment Britton to form the name Allbritton; it is not the complete word All.

1_1175.description: 最强共同线索是大小写形式 All：既包括句首或句中的完整词 All，也包括 Allstate、Alligator、Allbritton 等词名内部的 All 前缀；上下文多为法律文书，另有历史文本。

patterns.name: 句首 All
patterns.context: 单词 All 作为完整词出现在句首或句中，后接限定词、数量词、名词短语或 of 短语；激活集中在 All，而非后续词。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、诉状及历史文本

patterns.name: 专名内部 All 前缀
patterns.context: 大小写形式 All 出现在专名或复合词开头，后续字母与 All 连写；也包括«Al»开头的专名片段。
patterns.domain: 法律文本中的 Allstate 等名称；Gutenberg 文本中的专名或词语

patterns.name: 不一致的词内 All
patterns.context: 激活落在 All 字符串上，但其后连着 Britton 的分词片段，构成姓名 Allbritton；并非完整词 All。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to “court below” and formulaic phrases introducing the reasoning that follows in judicial opinions; also involves litigation procedure and adjudication terminology. Also observed are temporal progression words in a naval itinerary narrative and “net profits” in company profit and tax contexts.

patterns.name: “below” in legal documents
patterns.context: Refers to the lower court in judicial opinions, usually near the reasoning or conclusion

patterns.name: Introductions to legal reasoning
patterns.context: The court summarizes and then introduces the reasoning or decision that follows; trigger includes “below”

patterns.name: Legal terminology and litigation procedure terms
patterns.context: Words related to issues, trial materials, decisions, or remedies in legal texts; no single fixed collocation

patterns.name: Temporal progression words in historical narratives
patterns.context: Chronologically recounts ship itineraries, arrivals, and subsequent activities

patterns.name: Isolated occurrence of net profits
patterns.context: Describes company profits, their distribution, and tax filing

1_1175.description: 主要对司法意见中“court below”及引出下文理由的程式语敏感，也涉及诉讼程序和裁判术语。另见海军行程叙事的时间推进词，以及公司利润、税务语境中的“net profits”。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的“below”
patterns.context: 司法意见中指称下级法院，通常出现在裁判理由或结论附近

patterns.name: 法律裁判理由引出语
patterns.context: 法院在概述后引出下文理由或裁判结论；触发部分包括“below”

patterns.name: 法律术语与诉讼程序词
patterns.context: 法律文本中有关争点、审理材料、裁判或救济的词语；没有单一固定搭配

patterns.name: 历史叙事中的时间推进词
patterns.context: 按日期叙述船只行程、抵达和后续活动
patterns.domain: 百科全书式海军历史叙述

patterns.name: 单独出现的 net profits
patterns.context: 描述公司利润及其分配、税务申报

en.concept: Local word forms and formatting in legal texts
en.description: Activations are scattered across legal documents and corporate financial texts: sentence-initial Both/All, property/real estate, legal citations and pleading formats, as well as personnel fields, names, and local fragments related to liquidation and net assets; there is no single stable theme.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Both
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or new passage, Both introduces two coordinated subjects or claims; mostly seen in legal discussion

patterns.name: Sentence-initial All
patterns.context: Sentence-initial All summarizes multiple previously mentioned objects, letters, or lawsuits; followed by a plural noun or reference

patterns.name: property / real estate
patterns.context: Property or real estate in contexts involving bankruptcy, sale, ownership disputes, or litigation
patterns.domain: Real estate, bankruptcy, and legal documents

patterns.name: Response in a legal citation
patterns.context: In the fixed legal name Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act

patterns.name: Comp in a legal citation
patterns.context: The abbreviation Compl. appears in a pleading paragraph citation

patterns.name: Pl in legal captions
patterns.context: Platt in personal names or Pressed in company names; no clear shared semantic condition

patterns.name: Disposition of bankruptcy property
patterns.context: A trustee prevents foreclosure and disposes of bankruptcy property

patterns.name: Brick company, bondholders, and real estate
patterns.context: Historical ownership narrative involving bondholder interests, sheriff's certificates, and real estate transfers

patterns.name: Segmented characters in statutory citations
patterns.context: Abbreviations, symbols, and numbers marked as split in citations to the U.S. Code

patterns.name: Listing constitutional amendments
patterns.context: Lists amendments to the U.S. Constitution and explains that they provide protection

patterns.name: Personnel fields and court formatting in decisions
patterns.context: Formatted information in a decision, including attorney, state, brief, and panel judge fields

patterns.name: Liquidation and net assets
patterns.context: Describes liquidation dividends and net assets after liabilities in a company's voluntary liquidation

patterns.name: Pleadings and partnership agreements
patterns.context: Defendants' responses and claims under a partnership agreement regarding written consent and real estate sales

patterns.name: Litigant surname fragments
patterns.context: Within-name fragments in Kingsland and Allbritton; no clear semantic condition is apparent

1_1175.concept: 法律文本局部词形与格式
1_1175.description: 激活分散于法律文书与公司财务文本：句首 Both/All、property/real estate、法律引注与诉状格式，以及人员栏、人名和清算净资产等局部词片段；没有单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: 句首 Both
patterns.context: 句首或新句开头，以 Both 引出并列的两个主体或主张；多见于法律论述

patterns.name: 句首 All
patterns.context: 句首 All 概括前文提及的多个对象、信件或诉讼；后接复数名词或指代

patterns.name: property / real estate
patterns.context: 财产或不动产在破产、出售、产权争议或诉讼中的语境
patterns.domain: 房地产、破产及法律文书

patterns.name: 法律引用中的 Response
patterns.context: 固定法律名称 Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act 中

patterns.name: 法律引用中的 Comp
patterns.context: 缩写 Compl. 出现在诉状段落引注中

patterns.name: 法律标题中的 Pl
patterns.context: 姓名缩写或公司名称中的 Platt、Pressed；没有明显共同语义条件

patterns.name: 破产财产处分
patterns.context: 受托人阻止止赎并处置破产财产

patterns.name: 砖公司、债券持有人及不动产
patterns.context: 历史产权叙述，涉及债券持有人利益、治安官证书及不动产转让

patterns.name: 法条引用的分段字符
patterns.context: 美国法典引注中被切分标记的缩写、符号与序号

patterns.name: 宪法修正案列举
patterns.context: 列举美国宪法修正案并说明受其保护

patterns.name: 判决书人员栏与法院格式
patterns.context: 判决书的律师、州别、书状及合议法官栏等格式化信息

patterns.name: 清算与净资产
patterns.context: 说明公司自愿清算时的清算股息及负债后的净资产

patterns.name: 诉状与合伙协议
patterns.context: 被告答辩及合伙协议关于书面同意和不动产出售的主张

patterns.name: 诉讼当事人姓氏碎片
patterns.context: 人名 Kingsland、Allbritton 的词内片段，未见清楚语义条件

en.description: All passages show notable activation on «below», referring to the “lower court”; several passages also contain formulaic judicial language concerning reasoning, motion dispositions, appellate review, and other matters, including evidence suppression, marital property, judge signatures, and case-specific issues.

patterns.name: Reference to the lower court
patterns.context: Appears in expressions such as “court below,” “plaintiff in the court below,” “decree below,” and “court below suppressed the evidence,” referring to the lower court or its judgment or ruling; this is the notable trigger shared by all passages
patterns.domain: U.S. court decisions and appellate opinions

patterns.name: Formulaic statements of reasoning and outcomes
patterns.context: The court introduces its decision with “for the following reasons,” or states that it grants, denies, or affirms a judgment; triggers cluster in trial or appellate decision narratives

patterns.name: Appellate records and review of decisions
patterns.context: Discusses the parties on appeal, the record, and the lower-court decision, then reaches a conclusion on review; appears alongside “court below,” but not every passage contains full appellate terminology

patterns.name: Motions and claims for relief
patterns.context: Describes motions or requests by parties for summary judgment, suppression of evidence, amendment of pleadings, and so on, followed by the court’s disposition

patterns.name: Evidence suppression and search disputes
patterns.context: Concerns whether evidence obtained through an unlawful search should be suppressed, recounting a hearing, motion, and lower-court ruling

patterns.name: Marital property and tenancy by the entirety
patterns.context: Describes legal issues involving property acquired during marriage and property held by spouses as a tenancy by the entirety; appears in only one passage

patterns.name: Oral argument and legal reasoning
patterns.context: Evaluates whether written facts and legal arguments are adequate, and whether oral argument would assist the decision

patterns.name: Court personnel and judicial signatures
patterns.context: Lists panel members or the signing judge at the beginning of a decision; activation appears in formatted decision information
patterns.domain: Headings / signature sections of judicial decisions

patterns.name: Substantive issues in decisions
patterns.context: Mentions specific substantive or procedural issues under consideration rather than a unified legal topic; these occur in different cases

1_1175.description: 所有片段均显著激活于指称“下级法院”的«below»；多段还含裁判理由、动议处置、上诉审查等司法程式语，另有证据压制、婚姻财产、法官署名及个案争点。

patterns.name: 下级法院指称
patterns.context: 出现在“court below”“plaintiff in the court below”“decree below”“court below suppressed the evidence”等表述中，指称下级法院或其判决、裁定；这是所有段落共有的显著触发
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与上诉意见

patterns.name: 裁判理由与结果公式
patterns.context: 法院以“以下理由”引出裁判，或说明批准、驳回、维持判决；触发集中在审判或上诉意见的裁判叙述中
patterns.domain: 司法裁判文书的程式化措辞

patterns.name: 上诉审记录与判决审查
patterns.context: 讨论上诉双方、案卷和下级法院判决，并作出审查结论；与“court below”共同出现，但不是每段都有完整上诉审语汇

patterns.name: 动议与诉讼请求
patterns.context: 陈述当事人提出的简易判决、压制证据、修改诉状等动议或请求，随后交代法院处置

patterns.name: 证据压制与搜查争议
patterns.context: 围绕非法搜查所得证据是否应被压制，叙述听证、申请及下级法院裁定

patterns.name: 婚姻财产与夫妻共有
patterns.context: 描述婚姻期间财产及夫妻以 entirety 形式共有的法律问题；仅见于一段

patterns.name: 口头辩论与法律论证
patterns.context: 评价书面事实和法律论证是否充分，以及口头辩论是否有助于裁判

patterns.name: 法院人员及判决署名
patterns.context: 判决开头列出合议庭成员或署名法官；激活分布在判决格式性信息中
patterns.domain: 司法判决的标题／署名部分

patterns.name: 判决所涉实体问题
patterns.context: 提及具体待审实体或程序问题，而非统一的法律议题；这些内容分别出现在不同案件中

en.description: All passages show strongest activation on the word “below” in legal texts, including uses referring to reasons set out below, a lower court, or a decision document; other marked words are scattered and have no stable shared pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-final “below”
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of a sentence or legal phrase referring to text below/a lower court, especially “reasons set forth below”; the word itself is marked in every passage and is the strongest activation in each
patterns.domain: U.S. case law, court opinions, and legal documents

1_1175.description: 所有段均在法律文本中对词“below”产生最强激活，涵盖指向下文理由、下级法院或裁判文书的用法；其余标记词分散且无稳定共同模式。

patterns.name: 句末“below”
patterns.context: 出现在句子或法律论述中指向下文/下级法院的短语末尾，尤其是“reasons set forth below”；该词本身在所有段中都被标记，且均为最强激活
patterns.domain: 美国判例、法院意见及法律文书

en.description: Primarily responds to formulaic language in judicial opinions concerning lower courts, record review, and affirmance of judgments; also covers property and liquidation, marital property rules, judicial signatures, and decision endings, as well as isolated formatting or numbering markers.

patterns.name: Property, bankruptcy, and liquidation
patterns.context: Involves a debtor’s property, foreclosure, sale, liquidation, or asset distribution; in [5], the trigger spans the tokenization of “liquidations.”
patterns.domain: Bankruptcy law, company liquidation legal texts, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Lower-court ruling or record
patterns.context: Judicial opinions review a lower court’s ruling, record, judgment, or litigation proceedings; “below” often refers to the lower court.

patterns.name: Appellate review and affirmance
patterns.context: An appellate court reviews the record or arguments, finds no error, and affirms the judgment; [3] only contains a statement about an appellate conviction and sentence.

patterns.name: Formulaic language in legal opinions
patterns.context: Courts use conventional decision language to describe proceedings, review materials, reach a conclusion, or issue an order; no particular legal issue is required.

patterns.name: Court personnel and opinion signatures
patterns.context: Lists counsel, panel members, or the judge who authored the opinion at the beginning of a decision.

patterns.name: Spouses and marital property rules
patterns.context: Sets out legal rights and eligibility conditions concerning spouses, marriage, or a marital residence held jointly.
patterns.domain: Marriage law, estate provisions, or homestead exemption statutes

patterns.name: Panel concurrence at the end of a decision
patterns.context: States at the end of a decision that all justices agree; activation is concentrated on “All.”

patterns.name: Isolated children marker
patterns.context: Appears at the end of a paragraph after a footnote or page break, with no apparent semantic connection nearby.

patterns.name: Isolated numeric marker
patterns.context: Appears near a statutory subsection “(2)”; it is unclear whether activation comes from the number itself or neighboring text.

1_1175.description: 主要响应司法意见中下级法院、案卷审查及维持判决的套语，也覆盖财产与清算、配偶财产规则、法官署名和判决结尾；另有孤立的排版或编号标记。

patterns.name: 财产、破产与清算
patterns.context: 涉及债务人财产、止赎、出售、清算或资产分配；[5] 中触发跨越分词的“liquidations”。
patterns.domain: 破产法、公司清算法律文本及百科说明

patterns.name: 下级法院裁定或记录
patterns.trigger: « lower»1 court、« court»1« below»10、« record»2/3、« proceedings»2« below»9、« decree»1« below»9
patterns.context: 司法意见中回顾下级法院的裁定、案卷、判决或诉讼程序；“below”常指下级法院。

patterns.name: 上诉审查与维持原判
patterns.trigger: « appeals»2« from»1、« AFFIRMED»、« affirm»2、« Jud»3«gment»1 affirmed
patterns.context: 上诉法院审阅记录或论点后认定无错误并维持判决；[3]仅出现上诉定罪判刑的表述。

patterns.name: 法律意见的程式性用语
patterns.trigger: « opinion»1、« We»3、« find»1、« order»1、« heard»4、« arguments»1
patterns.context: 法院以固定判决套语陈述审理、审阅材料、作出结论或命令；不要求特定法律争点。

patterns.name: 法院人员与意见署名
patterns.trigger: « for»2 appellee、法官姓名中的分段标记、« Judge»2
patterns.context: 判决开头列明代理人、合议庭成员或撰写意见的法官。

patterns.name: 配偶及婚姻财产规则
patterns.trigger: « spouse»1/2、« residence»1/2、« marriage»1、« wife»1、« husband»2、« tenants»3 by the « entirety»5
patterns.context: 规定配偶、婚姻或夫妻共有住宅的法律权利和资格条件。
patterns.domain: 婚姻法、遗产或住宅豁免条文

patterns.name: 判决结尾的合议确认
patterns.context: 判决末尾说明全体大法官一致同意；激活集中在“All”。

patterns.name: 孤立的 children 标记
patterns.context: 出现在段末脚注或分页符之后，附近没有明显语义联系。

patterns.name: 孤立的数字标记
patterns.context: 出现在法条分项“(2)”附近，无法确定激活来自编号本身还是邻近文本。

en.description: Activations are concentrated primarily in U.S. legal texts, especially expressions involving “below,” lower courts, and litigation proceedings; they also cover terminology for property and liquidation, case captions, and name formats. Specific triggers are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: “below” in legal texts
patterns.context: Appears in fixed legal expressions such as “proceedings below,” “court below,” “defendant below,” or “set forth below”; the word sometimes carries the highest activation.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal opinions

patterns.name: Legal use of property
patterns.context: Concerns bankruptcy estates, homestead exemptions, property sales, or corporate assets; in two passages, the word appears in “the property.”

patterns.name: Court proceedings and litigation-stage terminology
patterns.context: Formal legal phrasing about judicial proceedings, lower-court rulings, appeals, or motions; “below” need not appear.

patterns.name: Court names and captions in legal reports
patterns.context: Captions of Tax Court cases, party names, and case-report formats; activation falls on subword fragments in captions.

patterns.name: Corporate liquidation and asset distribution
patterns.context: Distribution of net assets following a company’s voluntary liquidation and payment of liabilities.

patterns.name: Individual legal words or subword fragments
patterns.context: Appear in varying statements of legal facts, causes of action, arbitration, or jurisdiction; apart from belonging to legal corpora, they share no clear trigger word.

patterns.name: Names and formatted fragments in legal documents
patterns.context: Judges’ names, signature lines, and formatted text; activation corresponds to local tokens within names.

1_1175.concept: 法律文本及下级法院表述
1_1175.description: 激活主要集中于美国法律文本，尤其是“below”及下级法院、诉讼程序等表达；也涉及财产与清算用语、判决标题和姓名格式。具体触发并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的“below”
patterns.context: 出现在“proceedings below”“court below”“defendant below”或“set forth below”等司法文书固定表达中；该词有时直接带最高激活。
patterns.domain: 美国判例与法律意见书

patterns.name: property 的法律用法
patterns.context: 涉及破产财产、房屋豁免、财产出售或公司资产；在两段中该词出现于“the property”。

patterns.name: 法院程序及诉讼阶段用语
patterns.context: 司法程序、下级法院裁决、上诉或动议等正式法律表述；不要求出现“below”。

patterns.name: 法律报告中的法院名称与标题
patterns.trigger: “UNITED STATES TAX COURT”“COMMISSIONER OF INTERNAL REVENUE”
patterns.context: 税务法院判例的标题、当事人名称及案件报告格式；激活落在标题中的词片段。
patterns.domain: 美国税务法院判例标题

patterns.name: 公司清算与资产分配
patterns.context: 公司自愿清算、偿还负债后分配净资产。

patterns.name: 个别法律词语或词片段
patterns.context: 在不同法律事实、诉因、仲裁或管辖权表述中出现；除同属法律语料外，没有明显共同触发词。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的姓名及格式化片段
patterns.context: 法官姓名、签署行与格式化文本；激活对应姓名中的局部 token。

en.concept: Titles and markers of subsequent argument in legal texts
en.description: Activations mainly fall on the “er” ending of Commissioner in legal documents and on further, which modifies subsequent claims, conclusions, statements, or review in legal reasoning; one instance falls on a carriage-return control character.

patterns.name: Commissioner title
patterns.context: Commissioner is split into tokens and often appears alongside an institution or jurisdiction; activation falls on the suffix er.
patterns.domain: Party identities, official titles, or quotations in legal decisions

patterns.name: further followed by a legal discourse noun or predicate
patterns.context: further modifies subsequent legal claims, conclusions, assertions, or review; in some examples, further occurs at the beginning of a sentence or within legal reasoning.

patterns.name: Control character or whitespace in formatting
patterns.context: Appears near line breaks or whitespace formatting in the body of a decision; activation falls on the carriage-return control character rather than a semantic word.

1_1175.concept: 法律文本中的职衔及后续论证标记
1_1175.description: 激活主要落在法律文书中的 Commissioner 词尾“er”及法律论证里修饰后续主张、结论、陈述或审查的 further；另有一例落在回车控制符上。

patterns.name: Commissioner 职务称谓
patterns.context: Commissioner 被拆分标记，常与机构或管辖领域名称并列；激活落在后缀 er 上。
patterns.domain: 法律判决中的当事人身份、官员职衔或引述

patterns.name: further 后接法律论述名词或谓语
patterns.trigger: “« further»10 contention”“« further»10 concluded”“« further»10 assertion”“«Upon»1« further»10« review”
patterns.context: further 修饰后续法律主张、结论、主张行为或审查；部分例子中 further 位于句首或插入法律论证。

patterns.name: 排版中的控制符或空白
patterns.context: 出现在判决正文换行、空白排版附近，激活落在回车控制符，而非语义词。

en.concept: U.S. court opinion formats and terminology
en.description: The most consistent signal is Commissioner (including internal subword fragments) in U.S. opinions, often alongside formal citations, docket numbers, and party captions. Other activations are scattered across connective words in legal text, litigation and evidence terminology, and several subword fragments, with no single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Suffix of Commissioner
patterns.context: “Commissioner” or its possessive appears in court opinions, party titles, or tax-agency names; some examples highlight only a subword fragment.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions, especially tax, Social Security, and insurance cases

patterns.name: Court citations and opinion format
patterns.context: Formal opinion citations, docket numbers, court headers, or judicial terminology; activation falls on different formatting markers or subword fragments.

patterns.name: Litigant captions
patterns.context: Marks litigation roles and the relationship between parties in case captions or party listings.

patterns.name: Verbs or connectives in legal statements
patterns.context: Common connectives, pronouns, and litigation-action verbs in judicial narratives or reasoning; no clear, consistent local semantic condition.

patterns.name: Sporadic subword fragments in quotations or legal terminology
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within words in factual narratives, evidence assessments, names, or case names; no stable shared context is apparent.
patterns.domain: Ordinary words and proper nouns in legal documents

patterns.name: Evidence and judicial conclusion terminology
patterns.context: Discussion of jury verdicts, evidentiary sufficiency, pleading defects, or court rulings.

1_1175.concept: 美国法院判决格式与用语
1_1175.description: 最稳定的信号是美国判决中的 Commissioner（含词内片段），并常伴随正式引证、案号和当事人标题。其余激活散布于法律正文连接词、诉讼及证据用语，以及若干词内片段，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: Commissioner 词尾
patterns.context: “Commissioner”或其所有格出现在法院案件正文、当事人职衔或税务机关名称中；部分样例只标亮词内片段。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决，尤其税务、社会保障及保险案件

patterns.name: 法院引证与判决格式
patterns.trigger: Inc. v. Commissioner, 126 T.C. 191 (2006)；D.C. No. 01-CV-2393-DJW)；148 T.C. No. 10；PER CURIAM:
patterns.context: 正式判决的引证、案号、法院抬头或裁判用语；激活落在其中不同格式标记或词片段上。

patterns.name: 诉讼当事人标题
patterns.context: 案件标题或当事人列示中，标记诉讼身份及双方关系。

patterns.name: 法律陈述中的动词或连接语
patterns.context: 判决叙述或裁判理由中的常见连接词、指代词及诉讼动作词；没有明显统一的局部语义条件。

patterns.name: 引述或法律术语内的零散词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部片段，分别出现在事实叙述、证据评价、人名或案件名称中；未见稳定共同上下文。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的普通词语及专名

patterns.name: 证据与裁判结论用语
patterns.context: 围绕陪审团裁决、证据是否充分、诉状缺陷或法院裁定的讨论。

en.description: Primarily activates on the title Commissioner in U.S. case law and language concerning appeals and judicial proceedings; also covers case names and party labels, real property and bankruptcy estates, benefit payments, statutory applicability, and a few highlighted connectives and fragments of proper nouns or citations.

patterns.name: Legal title Commissioner
patterns.context: Appears in court opinions or case names, referring to tax, Social Security, or state insurance officials; sometimes near quotation marks, possessives, or agency names.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Judgment and appellate procedure terminology
patterns.context: Describes appeals, review of lower courts, or procedural progress, using common formal judicial narration.

patterns.name: Directional or prepositional connectives in legal documents
patterns.context: Connect sources of rulings, time, or reference in legal phrasing; these words are highlighted individually in the samples and need not share a semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Property and land-dispute vocabulary
