patterns.context: 描述信托案件中的不动产位置及其面临止赎的情况。

patterns.name: 上诉判决标题与法官名单
patterns.context: 出现在法院层级、上诉来源和合议庭法官的标题式信息中；激活分散在这些司法文书用语和姓名片段。
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院判决抬头

en.concept: Proper nouns and formulaic language in U.S. legal documents
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in U.S. legal documents, especially Commissioner/tax-agency titles and formal case headers; there are also sporadic responses to opinion formulae, property-payment defaults, title-boundary disputes, and discussions of jury instructions.

patterns.name: Commissioner suffix fragment
patterns.context: The suffix er in Commissioner in legal texts, or a tokenized fragment of COMMISSIONER in all-caps captions; commonly found in party names, titles, and tax case captions
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and Tax Court documents

patterns.name: Commissioner in legal citations
patterns.context: Commissioner appears as a defendant or cited agency name in case citations or party names, followed by punctuation, citations, or other text

patterns.name: Formal case captions and court layout
patterns.context: Formal legal-document layout, including case headers, party sections, and judge lists; activation also occurs when Commissioner is absent
patterns.domain: Court opinions and Tax Court rulings

patterns.name: Formulaic language for court dispositions
patterns.context: Brief formulaic language stating the disposition or the panel’s opinion at the end of a judgment

patterns.name: Plans, payments, and property defaults in legal narratives
patterns.context: A debtor makes payments under a plan and subsequently defaults on real-estate taxes, or facts concern property

patterns.name: Land boundaries and title disputes
patterns.context: A title lawsuit follows a survey and the dispute is resolved through exchange deeds or boundary adjustments
patterns.domain: Land law and title-litigation fact narratives

patterns.name: General statements in commentary on instructions
patterns.context: Discusses the selection of jury instructions and cites commentary on the instructions and related cases

1_1175.concept: 美国法律文书中的专名与套语
1_1175.description: 激活主要集中在美国法律文书，尤其是 Commissioner/税务机关称谓及正式案件抬头；另对判决套语、财产付款违约、产权边界争议和陪审团指示讨论有零散响应。

patterns.name: Commissioner 词尾片段
patterns.context: 法律文本中 Commissioner 一词的 er 词尾，或全大写标题中 COMMISSIONER 的分词片段；常见于当事人名称、职衔及税务案件标题
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、税务法院文书

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 Commissioner
patterns.context: 判例引文或诉讼当事人名称中，Commissioner 作为被告或被引机构名称，后接标点、案引或其他文本

patterns.name: 正式案件标题与法院版式
patterns.trigger: UNITED STATES TAX COURT；Petitioners v.；Respondent；Before DUBINA, BLACK and CARNES
patterns.context: 案件抬头、当事人栏、法官名单等正式法律文书版式；即使未出现 Commissioner，仍可见激活
patterns.domain: 法院判决、税务法院裁定

patterns.name: 法院裁判结果套语
patterns.context: 判决末尾的简短裁判结果或合议法官意见套语

patterns.name: 法律中的计划、付款与财产违约叙述
patterns.context: 债务人依计划付款，继而拖欠房地产税或涉及财产的事实叙述
patterns.domain: 破产或财产相关法律文书

patterns.name: 土地边界与产权争议
patterns.context: 测量完成后发生产权诉讼，并以交换契据或调整边界解决争议
patterns.domain: 土地法、产权诉讼事实叙述

patterns.name: 指令评论中的一般性表述
patterns.trigger: comment to instruction 130；special focus instructions；comprehensive general instruction
patterns.context: 讨论陪审团指示取舍，并引用指示评论及相关判例
patterns.domain: 法律意见中的判例讨论

en.concept: Vocabulary and formatting in U.S. legal documents
en.description: Primarily responds to U.S. legal documents, especially the title Commissioner and Tax Court headers; also covers case formats, appellate judge lists, tax, bankruptcy, and family-law terminology, as well as sporadic triggers in police-report vocabulary.

patterns.name: Commissioner title and suffix
patterns.context: Commissioner appears in legal texts, especially referring to heads of Social Security, state insurance, or tax agencies; activation often falls on the suffix er.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and legal documents

patterns.name: Tax Court case-party headers
patterns.context: In Tax Court captions, the IRS Commissioner appears as defendant or respondent; activation is concentrated on Commissioner and an internal fragment of Internal.

patterns.name: Coordinating conjunctions in legal documents
patterns.context: Coordination structures in party names, agency names, or legal statements; trigger locations vary across examples and may be weakly related formatting signals.

patterns.name: Tax case citations
patterns.context: The abbreviation T.C. for Tax Court in case citations and adjacent citation formats.

patterns.name: Appellate-court judge-list format
patterns.context: At the beginning of an opinion, Before introduces circuit-court judges’ names and titles.

patterns.name: Tax terminology in tax cases
patterns.context: Describes a tax deficiency determined by a tax agency in a Tax Court case.

patterns.name: Bankruptcy and real-estate debt terminology
patterns.context: Describes a debtor making payments under a plan, delinquent real-estate taxes, and related property; these triggers may each reflect legal-document vocabulary.
patterns.domain: Bankruptcy, debt, and real-estate legal documents

patterns.name: Police-witness report vocabulary
patterns.context: Reports public calls, police conduct, and traffic lights; the activated words do not clearly match the main legal-opinion pattern.

patterns.name: Marriage dissolution and property-division language
patterns.context: A statute provides for how courts distribute spouses’ property after dissolution of a marriage.

1_1175.concept: 美国法律文书词汇与格式
1_1175.description: 主要响应美国法律文书，尤其 Commissioner 称谓及税务法院抬头；也覆盖判例格式、上诉法官名单、税务、破产、家庭法措辞，并有警方报道词汇等零散触发。

patterns.name: Commissioner称谓及后缀
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现 Commissioner，尤其指社会保障、州保险或税务机构负责人；激活常落在词尾 er。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、法律文书

patterns.name: 税务法院案件当事人抬头
patterns.context: 税务法院标题中以 IRS Commissioner 为被告或答辩人，激活集中于 Commissioner、Internal 的词内片段。
patterns.domain: 美国税务法院判决标题

patterns.name: 法律文书中的并列连接词
patterns.context: 当事人姓名、机构名称或法律陈述中的并列结构；各例触发位置不同，可能是弱相关的格式信号。

patterns.name: 税法判例引证
patterns.context: 判例引用中 Tax Court 的缩写 T.C.，以及相邻引文格式。

patterns.name: 上诉法院法官名单格式
patterns.context: 判决开头以 Before 引出巡回法院法官姓名及职衔。

patterns.name: 税务案件中的税务术语
patterns.context: 税务法院案件中描述税务机关认定的税款不足。

patterns.name: 破产及不动产债务术语
patterns.trigger: “« interest»”“« plan»”“« default»”“« payment»”“« real»« estate»”“« property»”
patterns.context: 描述债务人依计划付款、拖欠房地产税及相关财产；这些触发词可能各自反映法律文书词汇。
patterns.domain: 破产、债务与不动产法律文书

patterns.name: 警方目击报道词汇
patterns.context: 报道公众来电、警员行为及交通信号灯；激活词与法律判决主模式不明显相同。

patterns.name: 婚姻解散及财产分割措辞
patterns.trigger: “« following»”“« marriage»”“« property»”“« apart»”“« each»”“« marital»”
patterns.context: 法律条文规定婚姻解除后，法院如何分配配偶财产。

en.concept: U.S. legal document formatting and titles
en.description: Primarily responds to the title Commissioner in U.S. legal documents, as well as case citations, court headings, and case-title formats; also shows sporadic activation on legal adjudication terms and a traffic-related word and place name in a news passage, which cannot be explained by the main pattern.

patterns.name: Commissioner legal title
patterns.context: Commissioner occurs as an official title or party designation, often followed by of Social Security, of Internal Revenue, or a possessive followed by content concerning a decision or veto
patterns.domain: U.S. case law, tax, and administrative law documents

patterns.name: Punctuation and abbreviations in case citations
patterns.context: Activation occurs near semicolons, commas, court or reporter abbreviations, and their numbers in legal citations; parts of words are also marked

patterns.name: Case titles and party formatting
patterns.context: In court headings and case titles, the court name, party names, or company names appear alongside formats such as Petitioner v. Respondent

patterns.name: Traffic-related terms
patterns.context: A news narrative mentions a red light and the place name Poplar; activation falls on traffic and the ending of the place name, with no apparent contextual consistency with the legal passages

patterns.name: Sporadic legal terms and formatting
patterns.context: Local terms in legal arguments, judge signatures, or accounts of adjudication; these passages alone do not establish a shared trigger condition

1_1175.concept: 美国法律文书格式与称谓
1_1175.description: 主要响应美国法律文书中的 Commissioner 称谓，以及判例引证、法院抬头和案件标题格式；另有法律裁决词项的零散激活，并出现一段交通新闻中的交通词与地名，无法与主模式统一解释。

patterns.name: Commissioner 法律称谓
patterns.context: Commissioner 作为官员职衔或诉讼当事人称谓出现，常接 of Social Security、of Internal Revenue，或所有格后接裁决/否决等内容
patterns.domain: 美国判例、税务及行政法文书

patterns.name: 判例引证中的标点与缩写
patterns.context: 法律引证中，分号、逗号、法院或报告集缩写及其数字附近出现激活；词内部分字母也被标记

patterns.name: 案件标题与当事人格式
patterns.context: 法院抬头及案件标题中，法院名称、当事人姓名或公司名与 Petitioner v. Respondent 等格式相邻

patterns.name: 交通相关词项
patterns.context: 新闻叙述中提及红灯及地名 Poplar；激活落在 traffic 和地名词尾，缺乏与法律段落明显一致的语境

patterns.name: 零散法律词项及格式
patterns.trigger: «arm»2、« new»2、« uniform»3、« Before»4、« appeals»1、« order»1、« affirming»3
patterns.context: 法律论述、法官署名或裁决叙述中的局部词项；无法仅凭这些片段确定共同触发条件
patterns.domain: 法律意见书及司法文书

en.concept: Commissioner titles in U.S. legal texts
en.description: The strongest and most repeated trigger is Commissioner in legal documents, especially Social Security, tax, and state insurance officials; tax-commissioner titles also appear in Tax Court captions. Other activations occur sporadically in legal citations, appellate language, debt payments, criminal-law rules, and jury-instruction language.

patterns.name: Commissioner (official title)
patterns.context: Appears in court opinions, often referring to the head of a Social Security, tax, or state insurance agency; sometimes the defendant or the official who issued an administrative decision.

patterns.name: Commissioner in Tax Court captions
patterns.context: Internal Revenue Commissioner appears as Respondent in U.S. Tax Court captions; activation falls on tokenized fragments of Commissioner.

patterns.name: Punctuation and letter fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across punctuation and alphanumeric fragments in case citations, court names, personal names, or case captions; no stable independent semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Debt, interest, and tax payments
patterns.context: Narrates a debtor paying interest under a plan, delinquent property taxes, and facts concerning real property.

patterns.name: Coordination and application of criminal-law rules
patterns.context: Discusses firearms regulations, uniform application of criminal-procedure rules, and cites Michigan cases; no clear connection to the Commissioner pattern in other segments.

patterns.name: Court instructions
patterns.context: Discusses whether a jury instruction applies to a case and repeats the instruction within the same passage.

patterns.name: Appeals and judicial-review language
patterns.context: Summarizes a party’s appeal from a lower-court order or an administrative denial; these activations are weaker and may reflect common language in legal opinions.

1_1175.concept: 美国法律文本中的专员称谓
1_1175.description: 最强且重复的触发是法律文书中的 Commissioner，尤指社会保障、税务及州保险官员；另在税务法院标题中出现税务专员称谓。其余激活零散落在法律引注、上诉措辞、债务支付、刑法规则及陪审团指示语中。

patterns.name: Commissioner（官员称谓）
patterns.context: 法律判决中出现 commissioner，常指社会保障、税务或州级保险监管机构的负责人；有时是被告或行政决定的作出者。

patterns.name: 税务法院案名中的 Commissioner
patterns.context: 美国税务法院案名中，作为 Respondent 出现的 Internal Revenue Commissioner；激活落在 Commissioner 的分词片段。
patterns.domain: 美国税务法院判决标题

patterns.name: 法律引注中的标点及字母片段
patterns.context: 判例引注、法院名称、姓名或案件标题中，激活分布于标点和字母/数字片段；未见稳定的独立语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 债务、利息与税款支付
patterns.context: 叙述债务人依计划支付利息、拖欠房产税及涉及不动产的事实。

patterns.name: 刑法规则协调与适用
patterns.context: 讨论枪支法规、刑事司法规则统一适用，并引用密歇根州判例；与其他段的 Commissioner 模式无明显联系。

patterns.name: 法院指示语
patterns.context: 讨论某项陪审团指示是否适用于案件，且在同段重复出现。

patterns.name: 上诉与司法审查措辞
patterns.context: 概述当事人对下级法院命令或行政拒绝决定提起上诉；这些激活较弱，可能是法律判决常见措辞。

en.concept: Titles and citations in U.S. legal documents
en.description: Primarily responds to Commissioner in legal documents, including split-token and all-caps variants, and to punctuation in legal citations; weaker activation also occurs on tax case-name tokens, judicial terminology, and a few subword fragments in criminal, bankruptcy, and property cases.

patterns.name: Commissioner title ending
patterns.context: Commissioner occurs in legal documents, especially as a title, an official position attached to a name, or a party designation; various capitalization and split-token forms are activated
patterns.domain: U.S. court decisions and tax and administrative law documents

patterns.name: Punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Commas, parentheses, and semicolons near citations, case names, court names, or decision references; often co-occurs with activation on the Commissioner ending

patterns.name: Internal capitalized subword fragments
patterns.context: When an all-caps institution name is split into subwords, activation falls on an internal fragment; observed in Tax Court case titles

patterns.name: Specific vocabulary in legal texts
patterns.context: Terms related to institutions, courts, and outcomes in administrative or judicial cases; activation is weaker and does not always co-occur with Commissioner
patterns.domain: Social security, tax, and appellate decisions

patterns.name: Rules and case-law terms in criminal law
patterns.context: Discusses harmonization of criminal legal rules and their judicial application, citing state cases and the North Western Reporter

patterns.name: Bankruptcy and debt payment terms
patterns.context: Describes a debtor making interest payments under a plan, delinquent real estate taxes, and related property

patterns.name: Property litigation vocabulary
patterns.context: Describes the exchange of deeds and adjustment of boundaries after a quiet title action ends; activation falls on an internal fragment of redraw and related property context

1_1175.concept: 美国法律文书中的职务与引注
1_1175.description: 主要响应法律文书中的 Commissioner（含分词和全大写变体）及法律引注标点；另对税务案名分词、司法术语，以及刑法、破产、产权案件中的少数词片段有较弱激活。

patterns.name: Commissioner 头衔词尾
patterns.context: 法律文书中出现 Commissioner，尤其是头衔、人名职务或诉讼当事人身份；不同大小写及分词形式均有激活
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、税务及行政法文书

patterns.name: 法律引文中的标点
patterns.context: 引文、案名、法院名称或判决引用附近的逗号、括号、分号；与 Commissioner 词尾激活常同现

patterns.name: 内部大写分词
patterns.context: 全大写机构名称被分成子词时，激活落在词内片段；见于税务法院案件标题

patterns.name: 法律文本中的特定词汇
patterns.context: 行政或司法案件中与机构、法院及裁判结果相关的词语；激活较弱，且不总与 Commissioner 同现
patterns.domain: 社会保障、税务及上诉判决

patterns.name: 刑法中的规则与判例术语
patterns.context: 讨论刑事法律规则协调、司法适用，并引用州判例及西北地区判例汇编

patterns.name: 破产与债务履行术语
patterns.context: 描述债务人依计划支付利息、拖欠房地产税及相关财产

patterns.name: 产权诉讼词汇
patterns.context: 描述 quiet title 诉讼结束后交换契据并调整地界；激活落在 redraw 的内部片段及相关产权语境

en.description: Strongly responds mainly to the consecutive characters DH in capitalized acronyms, covering the network protocol DHCP, the virus DHAV, the institution DHHR, the company DHIM, the colloquial form of address DH, and the protein domain DH/PH; it also responds to the SK fragment in names in legal documents, possibly an independent character pattern.

patterns.name: DHCP network acronym
patterns.context: DHCP appears in technical documentation or network-configuration contexts; segment 1 contains it as part of the software name Micro-DHCP, and segment 6 explicitly mentions DNS and DHCP.
patterns.domain: Computer networking, technical encyclopedias, and forums

patterns.name: DHAV virus acronym
patterns.context: Used as the prefix in the name of the duck hepatitis virus DHAV-1, followed by a serotype number.

patterns.name: DHHR institution acronym
patterns.context: Appears in legal proceedings concerning an abuse and neglect petition and refers to an institution’s acronym.

patterns.name: DHIM company acronym
patterns.context: Appears in a narrative about home purchases and mortgage financing, as the name of a company affiliated with DRHI.

patterns.name: DH pronoun/form-of-address abbreviation
patterns.context: Used as an interpersonal form-of-address abbreviation in an informal forum sentence, in “talk my DH into it”.

patterns.name: Protein domain abbreviation
patterns.context: Paired with PH domain, referring to the DH/PH domain in proteins.

patterns.name: SK in names
patterns.context: Appears at the end of a judge’s or lawyer’s name in legal documents, as a surname character fragment marked by token splitting; the trigger here is not DH.

1_1231.description: 主要对大写缩写中的连续字符 DH 强烈响应，覆盖网络 DHCP、病毒 DHAV、机构 DHHR、公司 DHIM、口语称谓 DH 和蛋白结构域 DH/PH；此外也在法律文书姓名中对 SK 片段响应，可能是独立的字符模式。

patterns.name: DHCP 网络缩写
patterns.context: DHCP 出现在技术说明或网络配置语境中；第 1 段是软件名 Micro-DHCP 的组成部分，第 6 段明确提到 DNS and DHCP。
patterns.domain: 计算机网络、技术百科与论坛

patterns.name: DHAV 病毒缩写
patterns.context: 作为鸭肝炎病毒名称 DHAV-1 的前缀，后接血清型编号。

patterns.name: DHHR 机构缩写
patterns.context: 出现在 abuse and neglect petition 的法律叙述中，指涉相关机构缩写。

patterns.name: DHIM 公司缩写
patterns.context: 出现在购房及抵押融资叙述中，作为 DRHI 关联公司的名称。

patterns.name: DH 代词/称谓缩写
patterns.context: 在非正式论坛句子中作为人际称谓缩写，出现在“talk my DH into it”。

patterns.name: 蛋白质结构域缩写
patterns.context: 与 PH domain 并列，指蛋白质中的 DH/PH domain。

patterns.name: 姓名中的 SK
patterns.context: 出现在法律文书法官或律师姓名的末尾，属于被拆分标记的姓氏字符片段；此处触发点并非 DH。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on two types of character fragments: uppercase H in DH strings and SK in judges’ surnames in legal documents. They share an uppercase letter-string feature but serve different contextual purposes.

patterns.name: Uppercase H in DH strings
patterns.context: The H substring immediately following D is marked; subsequent characters are therefore assigned to different tokens. It appears in various strings, including DHCP, DHIM, DHHR, DHAV, and DH domain.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; technical documents, legal documents, biomedical texts, and conversational text

patterns.name: SK in judges’ surnames
patterns.context: S is followed by K in uppercase surnames, usually in judges’ signatures in legal opinions or case documents.

1_1231.description: 激活集中在两类字符片段：DH 字符串中的大写 H，以及法律文书法官姓氏中的 SK；它们共享大写字母串片段特征，但上下文用途不同。

patterns.name: DH 字符串中的大写 H
patterns.context: 紧邻 D 的 H 子串被标记；后续字符因而分属不同 token。出现于 DHCP、DHIM、DHHR、DHAV、DH domain 等不同字符串中。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；技术文档、法律文书、生物医学文本及口语文本

patterns.name: 法官姓氏中的 SK
patterns.context: 大写姓氏中 S 后接 K，通常位于法律意见或案件文书的法官署名处。
patterns.domain: 美国法律文书、法官署名

en.concept: Local patterns in uppercase letter strings
en.description: Primarily responds to the uppercase substring DH, especially when embedded in abbreviations or names such as DHCP, DHIM, DHHR, DHAV-1, and DH/PH, appearing across domains; it also responds to SK at the end of names in two bankruptcy court signatures. Specific activation may depend on capitalization and tokenization.

patterns.name: DH substring in uppercase strings
patterns.context: DH is followed directly by an uppercase letter, digit, or hyphen, forming part of an abbreviation, name, or identifier; no word boundary is required.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including technical documents, legal documents, biomedicine, forums, and Q&A

patterns.name: SKY in legal-document signatures
patterns.context: Appears at the end of a fragmented uppercase name, followed by the letter Y; no clear connection to the DH pattern was observed.
patterns.domain: Judges’ signatures in bankruptcy court documents

1_1231.concept: 大写字母串的局部模式
1_1231.description: 主要响应大写子串 DH，尤其嵌在 DHCP、DHIM、DHHR、DHAV-1、DH/PH 等缩写或名称中，跨领域出现；另在两段破产法院署名的人名末尾响应 SK。具体激活可能受大小写及分词影响。

patterns.name: 大写字符串中的 DH 子串
patterns.context: DH 紧接大写字母、数字或连字符，构成缩写、名称或标识符的一部分；不要求词边界。
patterns.domain: 技术文档、法律文书、生物医学、论坛及问答等多种文体

patterns.name: 法律文书署名中的 SKY
patterns.context: 出现在破碎的大写人名末尾，后接字母 Y；未见与 DH 模式的明显联系。
patterns.domain: 破产法院法律文书的法官署名

en.description: The most consistent trigger is the capital-letter string “DH”, often embedded in an acronym or proper name; the following letters vary. DHCP is a recurring subset, while other examples occur in legal, biomedical, news, and colloquial contexts.

patterns.name: DHCP string
patterns.context: The letter string DHCP appears in protocol names, acronym definitions, or technical topics.
patterns.domain: Computer networking, embedded software, technical articles

patterns.name: DH as an internal word fragment
patterns.context: The consecutive capital letters DH appear in letter sequences with varying following letters; examples include company acronyms, institution abbreviations, and protein domains.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, biomedicine, news, email, and informal text

1_1231.description: 最稳定的触发是大写字母串“DH”，常嵌在缩写或专名中；后续字母不固定。DHCP 是其中反复出现的子类，其他例子分属法律、生物医学、新闻和口语等语境。

patterns.name: DHCP 字符串
patterns.context: 字母串 DHCP；出现在协议名、缩写释义或技术主题中。
patterns.domain: 计算机网络、嵌入式软件、技术文章

patterns.name: DH 作为词内片段
patterns.context: 大小写字母序列中出现连续大写 DH，但后续字母各异；包括公司缩写、机构简称、蛋白质结构域等。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、生物医学、新闻、电邮及非正式文本

en.description: Activation most consistently falls on the uppercase letter string “DH”; subsequent characters and semantics vary by context. It appears in DHCP as well as various proper names, biological domain abbreviations, and conversational abbreviations.

patterns.name: DHCP protocol abbreviation
patterns.context: Appears in contexts involving client programs, DNS, network configuration, routers, or servers; DHCP itself is split across tokens, with activation concentrated on DH.
patterns.domain: Technical documents, networking Q&A, and HackerNews discussions

patterns.name: DH string in proper names
patterns.context: DH is part of a name or abbreviation, not DHCP; the same DH letter fragment appears in different entities.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, veterinary papers, press releases

patterns.name: Biological domain abbreviation
patterns.context: DH appears alongside PH and refers to a domain in a protein; it is not a network protocol.

patterns.name: DH abbreviation in colloquial text
patterns.context: A narrator persuades someone to participate in an activity; DH is an abbreviation for a person, but its meaning is not expanded in context.

1_1231.description: 激活最稳定地落在大写字母串“DH”上，后续字符和语义随上下文变化：既见于 DHCP，也见于多种专名、生物学结构域缩写及口语缩写。

patterns.name: DHCP 协议缩写
patterns.context: 出现于客户端程序、DNS、网络配置、路由器或服务器等语境；DHCP 本身被拆分标记，激活集中在 DH。
patterns.domain: 技术文档、网络问答与 HackerNews 讨论

patterns.name: 专名中的 DH 字符串
patterns.context: DH 是名称或缩写的一部分，并非 DHCP；不同实体中都出现相同的 DH 字母片段。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、兽医学论文、新闻稿

patterns.name: 生物学结构域缩写
patterns.context: DH 与 PH 并列，指蛋白质中的结构域；不是网络协议。

patterns.name: 口语中的 DH 缩写
patterns.context: 叙述者说服某人参与活动，DH 是对某人的缩写；上下文未展开其含义。

en.description: All segments activate on the capital-letter string “DH”; its suffix varies by context. It forms DHCP and also appears in legal, medical, and news entity acronyms, as well as personal forms of address.

patterns.name: Capital-letter string “DH”
patterns.context: DH is followed by different letters or acronym components; the string itself strongly activates across diverse contexts.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; technical, legal, medical, news, email, and fiction text

patterns.name: DHCP network term
patterns.context: Appears in network configuration, service, or acronym-definition contexts, often co-occurring with DNS, routers, IP, and servers.

patterns.name: Institution acronyms in legal documents
patterns.context: Embedded in litigation or case narratives, as part of an institution’s or party’s name.

patterns.name: Medical pathogen acronym
patterns.context: Appears in the pathogen name DHAV-1, involving duck infection and hepatitis.

patterns.name: Letter string in news organization or entity names
patterns.context: Appears as part of an entity name in newswire text.

patterns.name: DH in a non-acronym context
patterns.context: DH is used as a form of address for a person or relationship partner in first-person narration, rather than as a network or technical term.

1_1231.description: 所有段都激活于大写字母串“DH”；其后缀随语境变化，既构成 DHCP，也出现在法律、医学、新闻实体缩写及个人称呼中。

patterns.name: “DH”大写字母串
patterns.context: DH 后接不同字母或缩写成分；该字母串本身在多种上下文中强烈激活。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；技术、法律、医学、新闻、邮件和小说文本

patterns.name: DHCP 网络术语
patterns.context: 出现在网络配置、服务或缩写说明中，常与 DNS、路由器、IP、服务器等词共现。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的机构缩写
patterns.context: 嵌在诉讼或案件叙述中，作为机构或当事方名称的一部分。

patterns.name: 医学病原体缩写
patterns.context: 出现在病原体名称 DHAV-1 中，涉及鸭的感染和肝炎。

patterns.name: 新闻机构或实体名称中的字母串
patterns.context: 作为新闻电讯文本中的实体名称组成部分。

patterns.name: 非缩写语境中的 DH
patterns.context: DH 用作人或关系对象的称呼，出现在第一人称叙事中，而非网络或专业术语。

en.description: Most activations fall on DH in capitalized acronyms or proper names, especially DHCP; DHAV, institution names, and the ordinary form of address DH also occur. Segment 6 activates on SK at the end of a name, which is difficult to unify with the other examples.

patterns.name: DH letter combination and internal acronym boundary
patterns.context: The letter combination DH appears in acronyms, proper names, or capitalized identifiers; following characters vary, and the sequence may be contiguous or separated by a hyphen or punctuation.
patterns.domain: Technical, legal, medical, news, and general text

patterns.name: DHCP network term
patterns.context: DHCP refers to the Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol and appears in contexts involving servers, network configuration, or DNS.
patterns.domain: System administration, home networking, and CLI technical Q&A

patterns.name: DHAV virus acronym
patterns.context: DHAV is an acronym associated with duck hepatitis A virus; nearby context includes pathogens, ducks, and hepatitis.

patterns.name: DH in institution or company names
patterns.context: DH combines with other capital letters as part of an institution, company, or department name; the fragment itself provides insufficient context to identify what these names refer to.

patterns.name: Letter combination in a name
patterns.context: The activation falls on the final letter combination in a capitalized name, not on DH; the text is a judge’s signature.

patterns.name: Ordinary possessive DH
patterns.context: DH independently serves as a form of address for a family member in a sentence about persuading that person to participate in BLS; it is not an evident technical or institutional acronym.

1_1231.concept: 大写字母串中的局部模式
1_1231.description: 多数激活落在大写缩写或专名里的 DH，尤其是 DHCP；另见 DHAV、机构名称及普通称呼 DH。第6段则激活于姓名末尾的 SK，难与其余实例统一。

patterns.name: DH 字母组合与 acronym 内部边界
patterns.trigger: «DH»10，常与后续大写字母或数字相连，如 «DH»10«CP»、«DH»10«IM»、«DH»10«AV»、«DH»10«HR»、«DH»10«AB»、«DH»10«I»
patterns.context: 字母组合 DH 出现在缩写、专名或大写标识符中；后续字符各异，既有连写，也有连字符或标点分隔。
patterns.domain: 技术、法律、医学、新闻及一般文本

patterns.name: DHCP 网络术语
patterns.context: DHCP 指动态主机配置协议，出现在服务器、网络配置或 DNS 等语境中。
patterns.domain: 系统管理、家庭网络与 CLI 技术问答

patterns.name: DHAV 病毒缩写
patterns.context: DHAV 是鸭甲型肝炎病毒相关缩写，周围出现病原体、鸭、肝炎等医学语境。

patterns.name: 机构或企业名称中的 DH
patterns.context: DH 与其他大写字母组合构成机构、公司或部门名称的一部分；片段本身未提供足以确定这些名称所指对象的上下文。

patterns.name: 姓名中的字母组合
patterns.context: 激活落在大写姓名拼写的末尾字母组合中，而非 DH；文本是法官姓名署名。

patterns.name: 普通所有格 DH
patterns.context: DH 独立作为对家庭成员的称呼，所在句谈到说服对方参与 BLS；不属于显见的技术或机构缩写。

en.description: The shared trigger is the capital-letter string “DH”, especially inside acronyms where it is followed by letters. It spans many domains, including DHCP, company and institution names, news, and virus names, as well as colloquial acronym use.

patterns.name: DHCP acronym fragment
patterns.context: Appears within the word DHCP, often in contexts involving network configuration, routers, servers, or clients; it also occurs in acronym definitions.

patterns.name: DHIM proper-name fragment
patterns.context: Part of the proper name DHIM, appearing in narratives about home purchases, mortgage financing, and affiliated companies.

patterns.name: DHAB acronym fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the institutional name or acronym string ABU DHABI in a press release, near dates, news agency references, and headline information.

patterns.name: Institutional acronym beginning with DH
patterns.context: Appears in DHHR worker; this segment concerns a petition and a child sexual abuse disclosure.
patterns.domain: Legal or social services case materials

patterns.name: Biological acronym beginning with DH
patterns.context: Appears in the virus name DHAV-1; nearby text discusses ducks, acute hepatitis in ducklings, morbidity, and mortality.

patterns.name: Letter string DH
patterns.context: Embedded in the colloquial initialism “DH” in a sentence about persuading someone to do something; unlike the other technical or proper-name uses.

1_1231.concept: 大写缩写中的 DH 字母串
1_1231.description: 共同触发点是大写字母串“DH”，尤其其后紧接字母的缩写内部；所处领域跨度很大，涵盖 DHCP、公司、机构、新闻及病毒名称，另有口语缩写用法。

patterns.name: DHCP缩写片段
patterns.context: 出现在 DHCP 一词内部；多见于网络配置、路由器、服务器、客户端等上下文，也出现于缩写释义。

patterns.name: DHIM专名片段
patterns.context: 作为专名 DHIM 的组成部分，出现在购房、抵押融资及其关联公司叙述中。

patterns.name: DHAB缩写片段
patterns.context: 出现在新闻稿的机构或缩写字符串 ABU DHABI 中，附近有日期、通讯社及新闻标题信息。

patterns.name: DH开头的机构缩写
patterns.context: 出现在 DHHR worker（工作人员）这一机构名称或缩写中；本段涉及请愿及儿童性侵披露。
patterns.domain: 法律或社会服务案件材料

patterns.name: DH开头的生物缩写
patterns.context: 出现在 DHAV-1 病毒名称中，附近讨论鸭及雏鸭的急性肝炎、发病率和死亡率。

patterns.name: 字母串DH
patterns.context: 嵌在口语化首字母缩写串 “DH” 中，句子谈到把某人说服去做某事；与其他技术或专名用法不同。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on the capitalized acronym DH: in personal online contexts it can mean “husband”, and it also commonly forms part of an acronym, code, or name followed by letters or numbers; other examples include downhill events and the aircraft model DH.10.

patterns.name: DH abbreviation with following tokens
patterns.context: DH forms part of an acronym or name, followed by characters that make up an institution, model, legal abbreviation, or code; activation centers on DH rather than a consistent suffix.
patterns.domain: Forums, legal documents, email, institutional reports, and other web text

patterns.name: DH as a spouse term
patterns.context: In personal narratives, DH is an online abbreviation for husband; nearby text often discusses opinions, being at home, or food.
patterns.domain: Online posts, forums, or blog-style personal narratives

patterns.name: DH as a skiing event abbreviation
patterns.context: DH means downhill and appears alongside wins, podiums, or competition events.

patterns.name: Aircraft model DH.10
patterns.context: Part of the Airco DH.10 day bomber model name.

1_1231.description: 激活主要落在大写缩写 DH：它可作个人网络语境中的“丈夫”，也常是后接字母或数字的缩写、代码或名称；另见滑降项目和 DH.10 飞机型号。

patterns.name: 缩写 DH 后缀分词
patterns.trigger: «DH»10 后接或嵌入大写字母/数字，如 «DH»10«CP»、«DH»10«HR»、«DH»10«IM»、«DH»10«HS»、«DH»10«AB»、«DH»10«I»
patterns.context: DH 作为缩写或名称的一部分，后续字符构成机构、型号、法律简称或代码；激活集中在 DH，而非稳定的后缀。
patterns.domain: 论坛、法律文书、邮件、机构报告及其他网页文本

patterns.name: 配偶称谓 DH
patterns.trigger: «my» 后的 «DH»，如 «my DH is»、«my DH was»、«My DH said»
patterns.context: 个人叙述中，DH 用作对丈夫的网络缩写；周围常谈意见、在家或食物。
patterns.domain: 网络帖子、论坛或博客式个人叙述

patterns.name: 滑雪项目缩写 DH
patterns.trigger: «DH» 出现在 «SG»、«GS» 等项目缩写及成绩、赛季统计中
patterns.context: DH 指 downhill（高山滑降），与胜场、领奖台或比赛项目并列。

patterns.name: 航空型号 DH.10
patterns.context: 作为 Airco DH.10 日间轰炸机型号的一部分。

en.concept: Local word forms and disclaimer wording
en.description: Primarily responds to capitalized “no warranty/fitness” wording in software disclaimers; it also activates on fragments beginning with Da in some names, place names, or proper nouns, and on related wording in wine-event promotion.

patterns.name: GNU/open-source license disclaimer
patterns.context: Appears in software distribution terms or copyright disclaimers; the capitalized warranty exclusion is particularly salient

patterns.name: Name or proper-name fragments beginning with Da
patterns.context: Appears in legal parties’ names, place names, personnel lists, or discussions; activation falls on strings beginning with Da that are split into tokens
patterns.domain: Legal documents, place descriptions, personnel lists, forum discussions

patterns.name: Greek wine event promotion
patterns.context: Introduces an upcoming wine event and tasting opportunities

1_1231.concept: 局部词形与免责声明措辞
1_1231.description: 主要响应软件免责声明中大写的“无保证／适用性”措辞；另对若干 Da 开头的人名、地名或专名片段激活，也见于葡萄酒活动宣传中的相关词句。

patterns.name: GNU/开源许可证免责声明
patterns.trigger: “WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY”“MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE”，以及“AS IS”
patterns.context: 出现在软件分发条款或版权免责声明中；大写强调的保证排除语句尤为显著

patterns.name: Da 开头的人名或专名片段
patterns.trigger: “Da”后接姓名或专名，如“Da uphin”“Da uphin Island”“Da unt”“Da iley”“Da Vinc i”
patterns.context: 出现在法律当事人、地名、人员名单或讨论中；激活落在被拆分的 Da 开头字符串上
patterns.domain: 法律文书、地名介绍、人员表、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 希腊葡萄酒活动宣传
patterns.context: 介绍即将举行的葡萄酒活动及品酒机会

en.description: Primarily responds to the capitalized structural heading BACKGROUND, especially in abstracts and legal documents; it also responds to RESEARCH in title fields and Another introducing an additional item.

patterns.name: Background heading in paper abstracts
patterns.context: “BACKGROUND” appears as a standalone section heading, often at the start of an abstract or structured abstract, sometimes followed by a colon; activation centers on GROUND.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, research abstracts, and related index records

patterns.name: Background heading in legal opinions
patterns.context: The standalone capitalized heading “BACKGROUND” appears in the body of a legal opinion, separated by line breaks, paragraph markers, or whitespace.

patterns.name: RESEARCH split across tokens in a title
patterns.context: The capitalized word RESEARCH is split into multiple tokens and appears at the start of a document title or metadata field.

patterns.name: List-item introducer Another
patterns.context: “Another” at the beginning of a sentence or paragraph introduces another example, option, or person; it may be followed by way, alternative, or a numeral.

1_1231.description: 主要响应大写结构标题 BACKGROUND，尤其摘要与法律文书中的标题；也响应标题字段里的 RESEARCH，以及引出另一项内容的 Another。

patterns.name: 论文摘要中的背景标题
patterns.context: “BACKGROUND”作为独立章节标题，常位于摘要或结构化摘要开头，也可带冒号；激活集中在GROUND部分。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、研究摘要及相关索引记录

patterns.name: 法律判决中的背景标题
patterns.context: 法律判决正文中以大写“BACKGROUND”作独立标题，前后由换行、段落标记或空白分隔。

patterns.name: 标题中分段拼写的 RESEARCH
patterns.context: 大写单词 RESEARCH 被切分为多个 token，出现在文档标题或元数据字段开头。
patterns.domain: 学术出版元数据、研究摘要

patterns.name: 列表项引入词 Another
patterns.context: 句首或段落开头用“Another”引出另一个例子、方案或人物；可后接 way、alternative 或数词。

en.concept: Introduction of new items and paragraph-heading markers
en.description: Responds strongly and primarily to the sentence-initial connective “Another,” which introduces another person, plan, event, or heading of the same kind; it also responds to the word-final “GROUND” in the medical-text heading “BACKGROUND,” and activates on the digit “2” in one sports-scoring context.

patterns.name: Another at the beginning of a sentence or paragraph
patterns.context: The first word of a new sentence or paragraph, introducing another item, person, plan, or event; the preceding text usually mentions a similar subject or discussion. Sometimes appears in a heading.
patterns.domain: News, forum comments, narratives, technical discussions, and headings

patterns.name: BACKGROUND paper-structure heading
patterns.context: Appears as a section heading in a document or abstract, often in all caps and possibly followed by a numbered marker or colon.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and NIH project abstracts

patterns.name: Local activation in numerical or counting contexts
patterns.context: Appears in a sports score or counting expression; activation falls on the digit rather than the connective.

1_1231.concept: 新项引入与段落标题标记
1_1231.description: 主要对句首承接词“Another”强烈响应，用它引入同类的另一人、方案、事件或标题；也对医学文本标题“BACKGROUND”中的词尾“GROUND”响应，并在一处体育计数语境中激活数字“2”。

patterns.name: 句首或段落起始的 Another
patterns.context: 作为新句或新段的首词，引出另一项、另一个人/方案/事件，前文通常已有同类对象或讨论；有时出现在标题中
patterns.domain: 新闻、论坛评论、叙事、技术讨论及标题

patterns.name: 论文结构标题 BACKGROUND
patterns.context: 位于文档或摘要的章节标题处，常全大写，并可能跟随编号标记或冒号
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及 NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 数字或计数语境中的局部激活
patterns.context: 位于体育比分或计数表达中；激活落在数字而非承接词上

en.description: Activations are concentrated on introduction and related expressions of introducing or adopting, especially the introduction of new therapies, drugs, vaccines, or regimens; they also cover chapter introductions, instructions, and the injection of substances in animal experiments.

patterns.name: “introduction” and related forms
patterns.context: Trigger words usually refer to the introduction of a new therapy, drug, vaccine, technology, or chapter; in multiple segments they occur in the structure “the introduction of”. The word also appears in titles or at the start of sentences.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, patent backgrounds, web articles, and general expository writing

patterns.name: Introduction of antiretroviral therapy
patterns.context: Describes how HIV management changed or became more complex following the introduction of highly active antiretroviral therapy.

patterns.name: Title or chapter introduction
patterns.context: The word refers to an introduction, introductory material, or a historical introduction; it does not necessarily refer to a medical intervention.
patterns.domain: Firearms/health websites, religious blogs, patent texts

patterns.name: Timing context for vaccine introduction
patterns.context: Places sample collection before the vaccine was introduced in the United States.

patterns.name: Introduction or adjustment of a treatment regimen
patterns.context: Starting, adding, or switching drugs/immunosuppressants during clinical treatment.

patterns.name: Instrument instructions
patterns.context: Laboratory testing is performed according to the instructions or materials provided by the manufacturer.

patterns.name: Drug injection and physiological effects
patterns.context: Refers to injecting a drug or substance into an animal and describing its physiological effects.

1_1231.description: 激活主要集中于 introduction 及引入、采用等相关表达，尤其是新疗法、药物、疫苗或方案的引入；也涵盖章节导言、说明书和动物实验中的物质注入等不同用法。

patterns.name: “introduction”及其近义形式
patterns.context: 触发词多指新疗法、药物、疫苗、技术或章节的引入；在多段中位于“the introduction of”结构中。该词也出现在标题或句首。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利背景、网页文章及一般说明文

patterns.name: 引入抗逆转录病毒治疗
patterns.context: 描述 HIV 管理因高效抗逆转录病毒治疗的引入而改变或变复杂。

patterns.name: 标题或章节引言
patterns.context: 词语表示导言、入门内容，或某项历史性引入；不一定指医疗干预。
patterns.domain: 枪械/健康网页、宗教博客、专利文本

patterns.name: 疫苗引入的时间背景
patterns.context: 将样本采集时间置于疫苗在美国推出之前。

patterns.name: 治疗方案的引入或调整
patterns.trigger: «introduction» of TMZ；“«introduction», «optimization», or switch” of immunosuppressives
patterns.context: 临床治疗中开始、加入或更换药物/免疫抑制剂。

patterns.name: 仪器说明书
patterns.context: 实验室检测按制造商提供的说明或资料进行。

patterns.name: 药物注入及生理效应
patterns.trigger: “«intravenous» «introduction» of … heparin”；“«On» «introduction» of serotonin and epinephrine”
patterns.context: 指向动物体内注入药物或物质，并描述其生理影响。

en.description: Activation is most prominent on described/introduction-type expressions in academic narratives, and also covers experimental procedures, medical conditions and outcomes, anatomical imaging, drug treatment, patent listings, and news accounts of people; sporadic evaluative words also appear and cannot be assigned a single semantic function.

patterns.name: “Describe”-type expressions in literature
patterns.context: Academic narrative introducing something as newly reported, previously described, or the introduction of a therapy; the strongest trigger is described, with introduction also appearing.

patterns.name: Introduction or first edition
patterns.context: In promotional text, premiere precedes edition, indicating a first edition or launch; it has some superficial association with introduction in academic corpora.

patterns.name: Narratives of people’s identities and relationships
patterns.context: A sequence introduces a group of people, their ages, and relationships; no obvious trigger phrase shared with other passages was observed.

patterns.name: Administration and experimental procedures
patterns.context: Describes procedures, dosages, or analysis workflows in animal or tissue experiments; activation falls near procedural verbs and methodological descriptions.

patterns.name: Descriptions related to disease names, causes, and outcomes
patterns.context: Medical abstracts focus on a disease or pathological outcome, stating causes, abnormalities, predictions, or clinical outcomes; trigger locations are sporadic.

patterns.name: Anatomical regions and imaging associations
patterns.context: Tumor abstracts describe thoracic regions and radiological features; activation mainly falls on fragments of medical compounds such as clinicopathologic and radiographic.

patterns.name: Listing oils
patterns.context: A patent background lists several vegetable oils and states that they have been described in the literature; activation is concentrated on oil and parts of variety names.

patterns.name: HIV therapy and drug toxicity
patterns.context: Discusses HIV treatment and hepatotoxicity associated with antiretroviral drugs; activation falls on fragments of disease names and therapy terms.

patterns.name: Platelet adhesion and drug effects
patterns.context: Describes experimental results on platelet adhesiveness after administering serotonin, adrenaline, or heparin to rabbits; some trigger words are adjacent to procedural patterns.

patterns.name: General degree or evaluative words
patterns.context: Ordinary modifiers separately evaluate physical and mental states and the complexity of treatment management; there is no stable shared context, so the co-occurrence may be incidental.

1_1231.concept: 描述或引入信息的文本
1_1231.description: 激活以学术叙述中的 described/引入类表达最突出，也覆盖实验操作、医学病症与结局、解剖影像、药物治疗、专利列举及新闻人物叙述；另有零散评价词，无法归为单一语义功能。

patterns.name: 文献中“描述”类表述
patterns.context: 学术叙述中介绍某事物首次被报道、既往已有描述，或某疗法的引入；最强触发集中在 described，也出现 introduction。

patterns.name: 引入或版本首发
patterns.context: 宣传文字中 edition 前有 premiere，表示首版或首发；与学术语料里的 introduction 有一定表面关联。
patterns.domain: 商业宣传、枪械书籍介绍

patterns.name: 人物身份与关系叙述
patterns.context: 连续介绍一组人物、年龄及其相互关系；未见明显与其他段共享的触发短语。

patterns.name: 给药及实验程序
patterns.context: 说明动物或组织实验中的操作、给药剂量或分析流程；激活词落在操作动词及方法描述附近。

patterns.name: 病症名称及病因/结局相关描述
patterns.trigger: “The uncombable hair syndrome”“The etiology”“predict poor clinical outcome”
patterns.context: 医学摘要以疾病或病理结果为主题，陈述病因、异常、预测或临床结局；触发位置分散。

patterns.name: 解剖部位与影像学关联
patterns.context: 肿瘤摘要中描述胸部/胸腔部位及放射学特征；主要激活落在 clinicopathologic、radiographic 一类医学复合词片段。

patterns.name: 油类并列列举
patterns.context: 专利背景连续列举多种植物油，并接述其已见于文献；激活集中在 oil 及品种名称局部。

patterns.name: HIV疗法及药物毒性
patterns.context: 讨论 HIV 治疗背景与抗逆转录病毒药物相关肝毒性；激活落在疾病名及疗法术语片段。

patterns.name: 血小板黏附与药物效应
patterns.context: 描述给兔用血清素、肾上腺素或肝素后血小板黏附性的实验结果；部分触发词与方法类模式相邻。

patterns.name: 通用程度或评价词
patterns.context: 普通修饰语分别评价身心状态和治疗管理复杂度；缺乏稳定共同语境，可能是偶然共现。

en.description: Activations occur in medical literature describing prior findings, recipe ingredient quantities and steps, patent lists of oils, copyright lines, and firearms training promotional language; there is no single trigger pattern spanning all the corpora.

patterns.name: Academic phrasing “first described”
patterns.context: A medical abstract or methods section states that a disease, association, or method was first or previously described; activation centers on described, often paired with first

patterns.name: Quantities and ingredient phrases in recipes
patterns.context: Measurement units, ingredients, and cooking actions appear in recipe instructions or ingredient lists; activations are distributed across multiple local phrases rather than corresponding to a single word

patterns.name: List of oil names
patterns.context: A patent background paragraph lists various vegetable oils and then mentions that they have been described in the literature

patterns.name: Copyright notice
patterns.context: A copyright line in web or code repository text, followed by a year and author name

patterns.name: Weapons training promotional copy
patterns.context: Promotional or introductory text associates shooting skills with physical and mental health, veterans, and instructor credentials

1_1231.description: 激活见于医学文献中描述既往发现的表述、食谱的食材计量与步骤、专利油类列表、版权行及枪械训练宣传语；没有贯穿所有语料的单一触发模式。

patterns.name: “first described”学术表述
patterns.trigger: “first described”及后接时间、作者或文献事实；另见 “previously described”
patterns.context: 医学摘要或方法部分陈述某疾病、关联或方法首次/先前被描述；触发集中在 described 一词，且常与 first 连用

patterns.name: 食谱中的量词与食材短语
patterns.context: 食谱步骤或配料清单中出现计量单位、食材与烹饪动作；激活 token 分布在多个局部短语，并非只对应单一词

patterns.name: 油类名称列表
patterns.trigger: “corn oil”“soybean oil”“safflower oil”“peanut oil”“cottonseed oil”“sunflower oil”“rapeseed oil”“palm oil”
patterns.context: 专利背景段落罗列多种植物油，随后提到它们已在文献中被描述

patterns.name: 版权声明
patterns.context: 网页或代码仓库文本中的版权行，后接年份及作者名

patterns.name: 武器训练宣传文案
patterns.context: 宣传或介绍文字将射击能力与身心健康、退伍军人及教官身份并列

en.concept: Local patterns in academic description and procedural text
en.description: The most consistent activation cue is “described” and its collocations in academic contexts; other instances occur in medical abstract headings, imperative recipe steps, paper citation markers, and patent listings of vegetable oils. These cues differ substantially in context.

patterns.name: “described” and its past-participle forms
patterns.context: Appears in passive or perfect-tense academic statements, with common collocations such as “has already been variously described in the literature”“was first described”“have been described”“as previously described”; activation may span multiple surrounding tokens.
patterns.domain: Patent background, medical paper abstracts, life-science paper methods

patterns.name: Medical abstract headings and topic phrases
patterns.context: The beginning of a heading or topic phrase in a medical abstract, naming a disease, symptom, or clinical feature; some passages later contain “described,” but the headings themselves also activate.

patterns.name: Consecutive procedural instructions in cooking steps
patterns.context: Cooking steps linked by imperative verbs in recipes; activation falls on action words and neighboring tokens rather than medical terms or “described”.

patterns.name: Literature citation markers consisting of terms and numbers
patterns.context: A numbered citation format in the body of a paper followed by a method description; activation is concentrated on the citation marker and local method sentence, insufficient to establish a shared origin with other patterns.

patterns.name: Listing edible oil varieties
patterns.context: A patent background lists vegetable oils and follows with “has already been variously described in the literature”.

1_1231.concept: 学术描述与操作文本中的局部模式
1_1231.description: 激活最一致的线索是学术语境中“described”及其搭配；另见医学摘要标题、食谱祈使步骤、论文引用标记，以及专利中的植物油列举。不同线索有明显语境差异。

patterns.name: “described”及其过去分词形式
patterns.context: 出现在被动或完成式学术表述中，常见搭配如“has already been variously described in the literature”“was first described”“have been described”“as previously described”；激活可覆盖该词周围的多个 token
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学论文摘要、生命科学论文方法

patterns.name: 医学摘要标题与主题短语
patterns.trigger: 段2的标题短语“synovial sarcoma of the chest: radiographic and clinicopathologic correlation”；段3的“The uncombable hair syndrome.”；段4的“Rett syndrome and mitochondrial enzyme deficiencies.”；段5的“The variable echocardiographic features in aortic valve endocarditis.”
patterns.context: 医学摘要中标题或主题短语开头，围绕疾病、症状或临床特征命名；部分段落随后出现“described”，但标题本身也有激活

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤中的连续操作指令
patterns.trigger: 段8“Add zucchini and salt and cook until tender”“stirring frequently”“Stir in garlic”；段9“stirring to scrape up browned bits”“Boil gently”“Whisk in butter”“Pour sauce over meat”
patterns.context: 食谱中以祈使动词串联的烹饪步骤；激活落在动作词及其邻近 token 上，而非医学术语或“described”

patterns.name: 术语与编号构成的文献引用标记
patterns.context: 论文正文中引用编号格式后接方法描述；激活集中在引用标记及方法句局部，不足以确定与其他模式同源

patterns.name: 食用油品类列举
patterns.trigger: 段1“corn oil”“soybean oil”“safflower oil”“peanut oil”“cottonseed oil”“sunflower oil”“rapeseed oil”“palm oil”“other oils”
patterns.context: 专利背景中连续列举植物油，并接“has already been variously described in the literature”

en.description: Activations concentrate on descriptions or reports: items described or first described in the literature, expressions and abundance of experimental subjects, and instructions to pour in recipes; trigger forms and domains vary.

patterns.name: Literature review in patents
patterns.context: Passively reviews that something has been described in the literature, often accompanied by a citation or patent literature number

patterns.name: Pouring instructions in cooking steps
patterns.context: Imperative recipe steps instructing the user to pour sauce or liquid over a dish, or pour a mixture into a cooking vessel

patterns.name: First description in medical literature
patterns.context: Historical statement in an introduction to a disease or medical phenomenon, noting that it was first described or reported

patterns.name: Outcome/degree terms in medical papers
patterns.context: Words summarizing multifaceted effects when describing a treatment effect or clinical role

patterns.name: Patient expression or detection in medical studies
patterns.context: Describes whether patients or samples express a molecule, cell marker, or level

patterns.name: Citation of prior description in Methods sections
patterns.context: States in experimental methods that a procedure has been described previously, followed by a literature citation

patterns.name: Abundance descriptions in medical results
patterns.context: Compares protein/molecule levels across cell types or samples, indicating abundance in a particular location

1_1231.description: 激活集中于描述或报告：文献中已描述/首次描述、实验对象的表达与丰度，以及食谱中的倒入指令；触发形式和领域并不一致。

patterns.name: 专利中的文献回顾
patterns.trigger: “has already been variously described in the literature”
patterns.context: 以被动语态回顾某物已在文献中被描述，常伴随引用或专利文献编号

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤中的倾倒指令
patterns.context: 食谱中祈使句式的操作步骤，指示把酱汁或液体倒到菜肴上，或把混合物倒入烹饪容器

patterns.name: 医学文献中的首次描述
patterns.context: 疾病或医学现象介绍中的历史性陈述，说明其首次被描述或报道

patterns.name: 医学论文中的结果/程度词
patterns.context: 总结治疗作用或临床角色时，用词概括其多方面影响

patterns.name: 医学研究中的患者表达或检出
patterns.context: 描述患者或样本是否表达某种分子、细胞标志或水平

patterns.name: 方法部分中的既往描述引用
patterns.context: 实验方法中说明流程此前已有描述，后接文献引用
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法部分

patterns.name: 医学结果中的丰度描述
patterns.context: 比较不同细胞类型或样本中蛋白质/分子含量，表示某处含量丰富

en.concept: Recipe cooking text and sporadic words
en.description: Primarily responds to recipe instructions for adding ingredients, heating, cooking, and stirring, as well as ingredient and quantity lists. Other activations are scattered across specific words or phrases in medical and biological abstracts and descriptions of fictional works, with no clear shared semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Cooking steps in recipes
patterns.context: Procedural recipe text describing adding ingredients to cookware, heating, stirring, or cooking; no particular ingredient or dish is required.

patterns.name: Ingredients and quantities in recipes
patterns.context: Recipe ingredient lists or passages specifying quantities, often containing units, numbers, and ingredient names.

patterns.name: Specific words in medical terminology
patterns.context: A medical abstract compares outcomes of uncemented hip replacement with conventional cemented replacement; activation falls on the ordinary word “matches,” not an obvious technical term.

patterns.name: A character’s disappearance
patterns.context: Narrates the disappearance of Katrielle’s father, after which the character sets out to find him.

patterns.name: “systems” in a compound term
patterns.context: A heading discusses the nervous systems of polychaetes and their basic patterns and variations.

patterns.name: The word anesthesia
patterns.context: A surgical narrative describes administering “general anesthesia” while the surgical area remains unchanged.

patterns.name: “described” in a disease name context
patterns.context: A medical abstract on a rare hair syndrome mentions that the syndrome was first described by someone.

patterns.name: JAM-A expression
patterns.context: Discusses JAM-A expression in leukocytes and epithelial cells and its role in intestinal inflammation.

1_1231.concept: 食谱烹饪文本及零散词语
1_1231.description: 主要响应食谱中表示加料、加热、烹煮和搅拌的指令，也响应配料与份量清单。其余激活分散在医学、生物学摘要和虚构作品介绍中的特定词语或短语，未见共同的明确语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 食谱中的烹饪步骤
patterns.trigger: “stirring”后接“to scrape”“frequently”；以及“Add chicken”“cook and stir”“until”“Add zucchini”“cook”
patterns.context: 操作性食谱文本中，描述把食材加入锅具、加热、搅拌或烹煮的步骤；不要求特定食材或菜式。

patterns.name: 食谱中的配料和份量
patterns.context: 食谱的配料清单或说明份量的片段，常见单位、数字及食材名称。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的特定词语
patterns.context: 医学摘要中比较未骨水泥髋关节置换与经典骨水泥置换的结果；激活落在普通词“matches”，而非显见的专业术语上。

patterns.name: 人物消失情节
patterns.context: 叙述角色 Katrielle 的父亲失踪，角色随后展开寻找。
patterns.domain: 百科／虚构作品情节介绍

patterns.name: 复合词中的“systems”
patterns.context: 标题中讨论多毛类动物的神经系统及其基本模式和变化。

patterns.name: 麻醉一词
patterns.context: 手术叙述中描述在手术区域未改变的情况下给予“general anesthesia”。

patterns.name: 疾病名称中的“described”
patterns.context: 罕见毛发综合征的医学摘要，提及该综合征最早由某人描述。

patterns.name: JAM-A的表达
patterns.context: 讨论JAM-A在白细胞和上皮细胞中的表达及其对肠道炎症的作用。

en.description: Activations are distributed across utensils, actions, and cooking steps in recipes, as well as words such as general, treatment, anesthesia, and surgery in medical texts; there is also a passage about antibody feedback in immunology. Specific trigger words are inconsistent across examples.

patterns.name: General-purpose word general
patterns.context: Appears in noun or adjective phrases, including combinations such as general anesthesia, overall management, and the patient's general condition

patterns.name: Cooking instructions and utensils
patterns.context: Recipe steps describe utensils, ingredient preparation, heating, or stirring; activation points are distributed across different steps and instruction words

patterns.name: Medical treatment and surgery
patterns.context: Medical narratives introduce vascular interventions, anesthesia, surgical management, antibiotic treatment, or hip replacement; differs from the recipe pattern

patterns.name: Immune feedback and antibodies
patterns.context: Discusses circulating antibody levels and feedback-system regulation of antibody synthesis

1_1231.description: 激活分布于食谱中的器具、操作和烹饪步骤，以及医学文本中的 general、治疗、麻醉、手术等词；另有一段免疫学抗体反馈叙述。各处具体触发词并不一致。

patterns.name: 通用词 general
patterns.context: 在名词或形容词短语中出现 general，涵盖一般麻醉、总体管理、患者总体状况等不同搭配

patterns.name: 烹饪指令与器具
patterns.context: 食谱步骤中描述器具、食材处理、加热或搅拌动作；激活点分布在不同步骤与指令词上

patterns.name: 医学治疗与手术
patterns.context: 医学叙述中介绍血管介入、麻醉、手术管理、抗生素治疗或髋关节置换；与食谱模式不同

patterns.name: 免疫反馈与抗体
patterns.context: 讨论循环抗体水平及反馈系统调节抗体合成

en.description: Activation appears in recipe cooking steps and descriptions of time and doneness, as well as in medical terms for microscopy, vascular patency, implant replacement, and collagen synthesis and assembly.

patterns.name: Cooking steps and descriptions of time and state
patterns.context: Recipe instructions describe heating, stirring, baking, or boiling, with time or ingredient state specifying completion; this pattern spans different recipe steps.

patterns.name: Microscopy and histological examination in medical texts
patterns.context: Medical studies or case reports describe microscopic examination, imaging, or histological analysis; the term may be adjacent to examination methods or injury descriptions.

patterns.name: Vascular or graft patency
patterns.context: Clinical cases or experimental studies report whether a stent, vessel, or graft remains open and whether blood flow is unobstructed.

patterns.name: Implants and joint replacement
patterns.context: A heading or abstract briefly describes hip implants, short stems, and replacement outcomes.

patterns.name: Collagen synthesis and assembly
patterns.context: Describes the effects of cellular or molecular defects on processes such as collagen synthesis and assembly.

1_1231.description: 激活出现在食谱中烹饪步骤、时间和熟度描述，也见于医学文本中的显微镜检查、血管通畅性、植入物置换及胶原合成组装等术语。

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤与时间、状态描述
patterns.context: 食谱指令中描述加热、搅拌、烘烤或煮沸，并以时间或食材状态说明完成条件；该模式跨越不同菜谱步骤。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的显微镜与组织学检查
patterns.context: 医学研究或病例报告中，描述显微镜层面的检查、成像或组织学分析；该词可能紧邻检查方法或损伤描述。

patterns.name: 血管或移植物通畅性
patterns.context: 临床病例或实验研究中报告支架、血管或移植物是否保持开放、血流是否通畅。

patterns.name: 植入物与关节置换
patterns.context: 标题或摘要简述髋关节植入物、短柄及置换效果。

patterns.name: 胶原合成与组装
patterns.context: 描述细胞或分子缺陷对胶原合成、组装等过程的影响。

en.description: Activations are distributed across stirring and baking operations in recipes, and words related to vacuum, immune synthesis, management, dispersion, and tissue recovery in medical, materials, and product texts; there is no clear shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Utensils and actions in cooking
patterns.context: Recipe steps describe baking, stirring, or mixing ingredients; activation may fall on utensil or action words.

patterns.name: Vacuum or low-gas environment
patterns.context: Describes removing air from packaging or placing material in a vacuum environment.
patterns.domain: Food packaging, materials preparation, and biomedical research

patterns.name: Antibody feedback and synthesis
patterns.context: Discusses antibody feedback regulation or immunoglobulin synthesis in an immunological context.

patterns.name: General management
patterns.context: In a clinical infection-treatment sentence, ceftazidime is listed alongside surgical and general management measures.

patterns.name: Thermal insulation
patterns.context: Introduces a double-walled vacuum-insulated container that keeps bottles and cans cold.

patterns.name: Liquid dispersion system

patterns.name: 烹饪中的器具与操作

patterns.context: 食谱步骤中描述烘烤、搅拌或混合食材；激活可落在器具词或操作词上。

patterns.name: 真空或低气体环境

patterns.name: 抗体反馈与合成

patterns.name: 一般管理

en.description: Activation is distributed across two types of procedural text: cookware, stirring, covering, heating, and time/texture expressions in recipes; replacement, experimental concentrations and doses, injury, and vascular pharmacological responses in biomedical literature. The phrases and contexts differ, with no single stable trigger feature evident.

patterns.name: Quantifiers and degree adverbs in cooking steps
patterns.context: In recipes or experimental methods, values, ranges, units, or degree words occur in descriptions of procedures and results; activation falls on several tokens related to values, time, or concentration.

patterns.name: Mixing and texture descriptions in food preparation
patterns.context: Describes successive operations of mixing, heating, melting, or baking ingredients to a specific texture or color.

patterns.name: replacement in medical headings
patterns.context: In a medical heading or abstract, replacement refers to organ or joint replacement; activation is concentrated on the word.

patterns.name: Expressions of experimental concentration and dose
patterns.context: Experimental methods or pharmacological results describe concentrations or doses of drugs, inhibitors, or reagents and their changes.

patterns.name: Surgical/experimental injury and tissue response
patterns.context: Animal or tissue experiments describe injury, reperfusion, and related biochemical or histological responses.

patterns.name: Containers and utensils in experimental/cooking steps
patterns.context: Instructions specify using a pot, bowl, or mixing utensil in procedural text organized into steps.

patterns.name: Placing over or covering
patterns.context: In recipes, over or cover indicates pouring one ingredient over another or covering the edges of a baked item.

patterns.name: Vascular responses and pharmacological inhibition
patterns.context: Discusses vascular contraction in response to drugs or ionic stimuli and its inhibition.

patterns.name: Unexplained proper names/numbers and truncated fragments
patterns.context: The fragments are headings or reagent names, with insufficient context to determine why they trigger; each may simply be medical/experimental vocabulary or a truncation boundary.

1_1231.concept: 程序性操作与参数表达
1_1231.description: 激活分布在两类程序性文本：食谱中的器具、搅拌、覆盖、加热与时间/质地表达；生物医学文献中的 replacement、实验浓度剂量、损伤和血管药理反应。多个词组与上下文均不相同，未显出单一稳定触发特征。

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤中的量词及程度副词
patterns.trigger: “3 to 5 minutes”“until liquid is reduced by half”“Bake 30 to 35 minutes”“at concentrations of”
patterns.context: 配方或实验方法中，数值、范围、单位或程度词出现在操作和结果描述里；激活落在若干数值、时间或浓度相关 token 上。
patterns.domain: 食谱说明与生物医学方法/结果

patterns.name: 食物制作中的搅拌与质地描述
patterns.context: 描述把食材混合、加热、融化或烘烤至特定质地/颜色的连续操作。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的 replacement
patterns.context: 医学标题或摘要中，replacement 指器官/关节置换；激活集中在该词。

patterns.name: 实验浓度与剂量的表达
patterns.context: 实验方法或药理结果中，描述药物、抑制剂或试剂的浓度、剂量及其变化。

patterns.name: 手术/实验损伤与组织反应
patterns.context: 动物或组织实验描述损伤、再灌注及相关生化/组织学反应。

patterns.name: 实验/烹饪步骤中的容器与器具
patterns.context: 指示使用锅、碗或搅拌器具，出现在按步骤编写的程序性文本中。

patterns.name: 置于……之上或覆盖的操作
patterns.trigger: “Pour sauce over meat”“Pour the hot cream over the chocolate chips”“Cover edge of crust”
patterns.context: 食谱中用 over 或 cover 表示将食材浇在另一食材上，或覆盖烘焙物边缘。

patterns.name: 血管反应与药理抑制
patterns.context: 讨论血管对药物或离子刺激的收缩反应及其抑制。

patterns.name: 未充分解释的专名/编号与截断片段
patterns.trigger: “Conservative femoral implants. Short stems”“Cryopreserved aortic homograft”“STO-1609”
patterns.context: 片段是标题或试剂名称，未见足够上下文判断为何触发；各自可能只是医学/实验词汇或截断边界。
patterns.domain: 医学文献与实验材料说明

en.description: Strongly responds mainly to whisk (including inflected forms) and other mixing operations such as stir in recipes; also covers cookware, ingredients, cooking steps, and ingredient-list formatting. It is also particularly sensitive to replacement in medical abstracts, with a weaker association with aortic valve terminology. Burn-treatment abstracts are isolated.

patterns.name: Whisk operation in recipes
patterns.context: Describes stirring, beating, or mixing ingredients in cooking steps; strong activations concentrate on the full word whisk or its cross-token forms, with related activations for stir as well.

patterns.name: Cookware and actions in a pan
patterns.context: Mentions cookware, containers, ovens, or cooking food in a pan in recipe contexts; activations on these words alone are usually weaker than on whisk/stir.

patterns.name: Cooking ingredients and preparation steps
patterns.context: Ingredients occur in consecutive ingredient lists or preparation steps involving cooking, stirring, heating, or pouring; no specific ingredient is the trigger.

patterns.name: Replacement in medical texts
patterns.context: replacement appears in medical expressions such as hip replacement or aortic valve replacement; activation is especially prominent on this word, while neighboring words such as hip, valve, and aortic have lower activation.

patterns.name: Aortic valve and related cardiac terms
patterns.context: Describes aortic valve replacement, valvular disease, endocarditis, or echocardiographic findings; the terms themselves activate weakly, with replacement standing out.

patterns.name: Treatment of severe burn infections
patterns.context: Introduces infection and ceftazidime treatment in patients with severe burns; differs from cooking and replacement texts, with no obvious shared high-activation words.

patterns.name: Fractions and ingredient-list formatting
patterns.context: Recipes list ingredients on separate lines and use fractions for quantities; activation includes line breaks and formatting tokens such as numbers and slashes.

patterns.name: Recipe title or dish-name fragments
patterns.context: Near recipe titles, section labels, or dish names; activation is weaker and occurs only locally in the excerpts.

1_1231.concept: 烹饪搅拌与医学置换词
1_1231.description: 主要对食谱中 whisk（含词形变化）及 stir 等混拌操作强烈响应，也覆盖锅具、食材、烹饪步骤和配料表格式；另对医学摘要中的 replacement 特别敏感，并弱关联主动脉瓣术语。烧伤治疗摘要较孤立。

patterns.name: 食谱中的 whisk 操作
patterns.trigger: « whisk»10« or»4« fork»2«；« whisk»10；«Wh«isk»4；« whisk»9ing；« stir»8
patterns.context: 在烹饪步骤中描述搅拌、打匀或混合食材；显著激活集中在 whisk 的完整词或跨 token 词形，相关的 stir 也有激活。

patterns.name: 烹饪用具及锅中操作
patterns.trigger: « skillet»；« pot»；« saucepan»；« bowl»；« oven»；« cook»
patterns.context: 食谱语境中提及锅具、容器、烤箱，或在锅中烹煮食物；单独这些词的激活通常弱于 whisk/stir。

patterns.name: 烹饪食材与制作步骤
patterns.trigger: « chocolate chips»、« cream»、« eggs»、« prunes»、« sugar»、« chicken»、« onions»、« egg noodles»
patterns.context: 食材出现在连续的配料或制作步骤中，涉及烹煮、搅拌、加热或浇淋；并非某一种具体食材触发。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的 replacement
patterns.context: replacement 出现在髋关节置换或主动脉瓣置换等医学表述中；激活对该词特别突出，邻近词如 hip、valve、aortic 的激活较低。

patterns.name: 主动脉瓣及相关心脏病术语
patterns.context: 描述主动脉瓣置换、瓣膜疾病、心内膜炎或超声心动图结果；词语本身激活较弱，主要突出 replacement。

patterns.name: 严重烧伤感染治疗
patterns.context: 介绍严重烧伤患者的感染及 ceftazidime 治疗，与烹饪及置换文本不同，未见明显共享的高激活词。

patterns.name: 分数与配料清单格式
patterns.context: 食谱以换行分隔配料，并以分数表示用量；激活包含换行和数字、斜杠等格式 token。

patterns.name: 食谱标题或菜名片段
patterns.context: 食谱标题、章节标签或菜名附近；激活较弱，且在片段中只是局部出现。

en.concept: Procedural phrasing in medical and recipe texts
en.description: Activation primarily occurs in two types of text: replacement and descriptions of treatment, management, or anesthesia in medical contexts; and action verbs in recipes. There is also an isolated experimental wavelength measurement in nm, with no single stable trigger feature overall.

patterns.name: Medical outcome descriptions near “replacement”
patterns.context: replacement appears in medical abstracts or headings, referring to hip replacement, aortic valve replacement, or hormone replacement therapy; replacement in [1][3] is adjacent to results, while [7] contains only hormone replacement therapy.

patterns.name: Action words in cooking steps
patterns.context: Recipes describe consecutive actions such as heating, stirring, pouring, or cooking; activation falls on step verbs and surrounding words.

patterns.name: General management and anesthesia procedures
patterns.context: Medical text describes comprehensive management of severe burn infections or general anesthesia during surgery; the marked words relate to treatment or surgical contexts.

patterns.name: Units and values in experimental measurements
patterns.context: Experimental methods describe filter wavelengths for measuring fluorescence intensity; only this measurement parameter is highlighted.

1_1231.concept: 医学与食谱文本中的程序性表述
1_1231.description: 激活主要出现在两类文本：医学语境中的 replacement 及治疗、管理或麻醉表述；食谱中的操作动词。另有实验测量波长 nm 的孤例，整体没有单一稳定触发特征。

patterns.name: “replacement”附近的医学结果表述
patterns.trigger: « replacement»；[1] 中还有« best»« results»，[3] 中有« immediate»« results»， [7] 中有« therapy»
patterns.context: 医学摘要或标题中出现 replacement，涉及髋关节置换、主动脉瓣置换或激素替代治疗；[1][3] 的 replacement 邻近 results，但[7]只有 hormone replacement therapy

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤中的操作词
patterns.trigger: « stirring»、« Stir»、« Pour»、« whisk»、« heat»、« cook»
patterns.context: 食谱中连续描述加热、搅拌、倒入或烹煮等操作；激活落在步骤动词及其周边词上

patterns.name: 一般管理与麻醉操作

patterns.domain: 临床医学摘要/病例描述

patterns.name: 实验测量的单位与数值

en.description: Activations concentrate on replacement in biomedical texts, especially valve replacement and also hip replacement; other activations include medical results and evidence, inflammation or coagulation research terms, and a few ordinary English uses related to publishing, delivery, and recipe instructions.

patterns.name: Aortic valve replacement
patterns.context: In contexts involving aortic valve disease or grafts, especially aortic valve replacement

patterns.name: Valve replacement or prolapse
patterns.context: Describes mitral valve prolapse, regurgitation, and prosthetic valve replacement

patterns.name: Hip replacement
patterns.context: Compares outcomes of uncemented and conventional cemented hip replacement

patterns.name: Inflammatory factors and signaling research
patterns.context: Research descriptions involving neuroinflammation, coagulation factors, or cytokine expression and function

patterns.name: Research findings or evidence statements
patterns.context: Medical abstracts report observations, examination evidence, or clinical events; may co-occur with valve topics or appear independently

patterns.name: Uses of deliver and release
patterns.context: Expresses publication or delivery; one instance refers to a brand press release, another to a substance released by cells

patterns.name: Cooking instructions in recipes
patterns.context: Describes heating and cooking ingredients step by step, including the required duration and state

1_1231.description: 激活集中于 biomedical 文本中的 replacement，尤其瓣膜置换，也包括髋关节置换；另见医学结果与证据、炎症或凝血研究术语，以及少量普通英文发布、递送和食谱烹饪指令。

patterns.name: 主动脉瓣置换

patterns.name: 瓣膜置换或脱垂

patterns.name: 髋关节置换

patterns.name: 炎症因子与信号研究
patterns.context: 涉及神经炎症、凝血因子或细胞因子表达及其功能的研究描述

patterns.name: 研究发现或证据表述
patterns.context: 医学摘要中陈述观察结果、检查证据或临床事件；可能与瓣膜主题共现，也可独立出现

patterns.name: deliver 与 release 用语
patterns.context: 表达发布或递送；一处指品牌新闻稿，一处指细胞释放物质

patterns.name: 食谱烹饪指令
patterns.context: 按步骤描述加热、烹煮食材及所需时间和状态

en.description: Activations are most prominent in medical contexts involving valve or hip replacement; the rest are distributed across infection treatment, coagulation mechanisms, case narratives, experimental staining, and recipe instructions, making them difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Surgical replacement
patterns.context: Describes replacement surgery for the aortic valve, mitral valve, or hip in a medical context, often linked to treatment, outcomes, or postoperative situations.
patterns.domain: Medical paper abstracts and clinical reports

patterns.name: Infection and critical care treatment
patterns.context: Describes severe infections, antibiotic treatment, and management in burn patients, or heart failure and clinical outcomes associated with endocarditis.

patterns.name: Coagulation factors and receptor mechanisms
patterns.context: Discusses PAR receptors, tissue factor, coagulation, and vascular mechanisms, including research questions or hypotheses.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research proposals or mechanistic studies

patterns.name: Cooking instructions
patterns.context: Sequentially describes actions such as heating cream, pouring it over chocolate, and stirring until smooth.

patterns.name: Experimental staining protocol
patterns.context: Describes experimental steps in which tissue sections are incubated, washed, stained, and the reaction is stopped.

patterns.name: Clinical case narrative
patterns.context: Introduces an individual patient case by stating age, sex, and medical history.

1_1231.concept: 多领域过程与医学术语
1_1231.description: 激活最突出地落在医学语境中的瓣膜或髋关节置换；其余分布于感染治疗、凝血机制、病例叙述、实验染色和食谱指令，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 外科置换
patterns.context: 医学语境中描述主动脉瓣、二尖瓣或髋关节的置换手术，常与治疗、结果或术后情形相连。
patterns.domain: 医学论文摘要及临床报告

patterns.name: 感染与重症治疗
patterns.context: 描述烧伤患者的严重感染、抗生素治疗与管理，或心内膜炎相关的心衰及临床结局。

patterns.name: 凝血因子与受体机制
patterns.context: 讨论PAR受体、组织因子、凝血及血管相关机制，包含研究问题或假设。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究计划或机制研究

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤指令
patterns.context: 按顺序描述加热奶油、倒入巧克力并搅拌至顺滑等操作。

patterns.name: 实验染色流程
patterns.context: 描述组织切片经孵育、清洗、染色及终止反应的实验步骤。

patterns.name: 病例就诊叙述
patterns.context: 以年龄、性别及病史开头介绍单个患者病例。

en.description: Activations concentrate on medical procedural terminology, especially procedural and its collocations, and also occur with valve/hip replacement; other responses include the recipe imperative Pour, the ingredient thyme, the mouse-event attribute over, and blood vessels.

patterns.name: Procedural- surgical terminology
patterns.context: In medical contexts, acts as a modifier related to procedures, treatment, or sedation, describing surgical strategies, complications, pain, sedation, or procedures.

patterns.name: Replacement treatment names
patterns.context: Occurs in names of organ or joint replacement treatments, especially “valve replacement” and “hip replacement”.

patterns.name: Recipe instructions
patterns.context: In recipe instructions, an imperative introduces a step to pour or drizzle ingredients or sauce; the two examples are “Pour sauce over meat” and “Pour chicken broth into a large stock pot”.

patterns.name: Procedural strategy collocation
patterns.context: Describes a special procedural strategy required for a complex clinical intervention.

patterns.name: Procedural complications collocation
patterns.context: Lists procedure-related complications among study endpoints.

patterns.name: Procedural pain collocation
patterns.context: Refers to procedure-related pain, listed alongside other types of patient pain.

patterns.name: Procedural sedation collocation
patterns.context: Names a type of sedation in a discussion of short-acting opioids.

patterns.name: VueJS event attribute
patterns.context: A programming Q&A asks how to pass VueJS data to the mouse-hover attribute of an HTML tag; strong activation falls on “over” in the attribute name.

patterns.name: Thyme ingredient name
patterns.context: Dried thyme is listed in a recipe ingredient list; nearby content consists of units and ingredients.

patterns.name: Blood-vessel-related expression
patterns.context: Discusses whether tissue-factor expression is necessary within or around blood vessels.

patterns.name: Replacement terminology at other medical sites
patterns.context: Appears in titles about vascular valve or joint replacement; related to the broader medical-procedure topic but does not contain procedural.

1_1231.description: 激活集中于医学操作语汇，尤其 procedural 及其搭配，也出现在 valve/hip replacement；另对食谱祈使词 Pour、食材 thyme、鼠标事件属性 over 和 blood vessels 有反应。

patterns.name: procedural- 手术用语
patterns.context: 作为医学语境中的操作、治疗或镇静相关修饰语，描述手术策略、并发症、疼痛、镇静或操作过程。

patterns.name: replacement 治疗名称
patterns.context: 出现在器官或关节置换治疗名称中，尤其是“valve replacement”“hip replacement”。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、骨科/心血管临床文献

patterns.name: recipe 操作步骤
patterns.context: 食谱指令中，以祈使句引出倒入或淋上食材、酱汁的步骤；两例分别为“Pour sauce over meat”和“Pour chicken broth into a large stock pot”。

patterns.name: procedural strategy 搭配
patterns.context: 描述复杂临床介入所需的特殊操作策略。

patterns.name: procedural complications 搭配
patterns.context: 研究终点列表中列举操作相关并发症。

patterns.name: procedural pain 搭配
patterns.context: 与患者疼痛类型并列，指操作相关疼痛。

patterns.name: procedural sedation 搭配
patterns.context: 作为镇静类型名称，讨论短效阿片类药物。

patterns.name: VueJS 事件属性
patterns.context: 编程问答中询问如何将 VueJS 数据传给 HTML 标签的鼠标悬停属性；强激活落在属性名中的“over”。

patterns.name: thyme 食材名

patterns.name: 血管相关表达

patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究计划

patterns.name: 医学其他部位的替换术语
patterns.context: 出现在血管瓣膜或关节置换标题中；与一般医学操作主题相近，但不含 procedural。

en.description: Activations are distributed across presented in medical cases, terminology from papers or experimental methods and pathology testing, as well as recipe instructions and religious-political commentary; the forms and contexts triggering each fragment differ markedly, with no unified lexical item or stable syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Clinical case presentation wording
patterns.context: Describes a patient or animal presenting for care with symptoms, injury, or medical history, often followed by with, to a hospital, etc.

patterns.name: Replacement in a medical case title
patterns.context: Appears in a paper title about cryopreserved aortic homografts for aortic valve replacement, near immediate results.

patterns.name: Disease deficiency and necessity questions
patterns.context: While discussing coagulation factors, PAR, and tissue factor, asks whether deficiency produces a similar phenotype and whether expression is necessary.

patterns.name: Cooking steps and timed quantities
patterns.context: Consecutive recipe instructions describing adding liquid, stirring, cooking until reduced, and pouring over meat.

patterns.name: Religious identity and persecution rhetoric
patterns.context: Discusses Judaism, Holocaust denial, Israel, and violent threats against converts or non-Muslims.

patterns.name: Mouseover event attribute
patterns.context: Appears in “onmouse«over»10,” referring to the HTML/VueJS mouseover event attribute.

patterns.name: Numbers and symbols in immune-cell markers
patterns.context: Activations fall on split numeric or plus-sign fragments in immunological markers or receptor names; nearby text often mentions T cells, lymphocytes, antibodies, or immunodeficiency.

patterns.name: deficiency in the phrase immune deficiency
patterns.context: Appears in “immune deficiency” or “immune deficiency virus”; the former means immunodeficiency, while the latter is part of the full name of HIV.

patterns.name: care in the phrase intensive care unit
patterns.context: Legal testimony recounts an injured person being hospitalized and admitted to an intensive care unit.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in secrete
patterns.context: Describes cells secreting nerve growth factor in laboratory culture; activation covers the latter part of the split verb secrete.

patterns.name: Anti-CD33 antibody-related marker
patterns.context: Patent background describes anti-CD33 monoclonal antibodies and related expression findings.

patterns.name: appeal in legal texts
patterns.context: The testimony in a criminal case is followed by the appellate proceedings; activation is mainly on appeal.

patterns.name: sticky in forum announcements
patterns.context: Refers to pinned announcement posts in a forum moderation context; activation falls on the final letter of sticky.

1_1231.description: 激活分布在多种局部词形与短语：烹饪指令中的 stir until、悬停事件 over、免疫学标记及 deficiency、重症监护 care、secrete、anti-CD33、法律 appeal 和论坛 sticky；缺少统一语义。

patterns.name: “and stir”烹饪步骤
patterns.context: 食谱中描述加入食材后持续搅拌，直到达到某状态；也出现相邻的“« cook»3« and»3”。

patterns.name: 鼠标悬停事件属性
patterns.context: 出现在“onmouse«over»10”中，指向 HTML/VueJS 的鼠标悬停事件属性。

patterns.name: 免疫细胞标记中的数字与符号
patterns.context: 激活落在免疫学标记或受体名称中被拆分的数字、加号等片段；附近常见 T 细胞、淋巴细胞、抗体或免疫缺陷相关表述。

patterns.name: immune deficiency 短语中的 deficiency
patterns.context: 出现在“immune deficiency”或“immune deficiency virus”中，前者指免疫缺陷，后者为 HIV 全称的一部分。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要/科研标题

patterns.name: intensive care unit 短语中的 care
patterns.context: 法律证词叙述受伤者住院及进入重症监护病房。

patterns.name: secrete 中的词内片段
patterns.context: 描述细胞在实验室培养中分泌神经生长因子；激活覆盖被拆开的动词 secrete 的后半部分。

patterns.name: anti-CD33 抗体相关标记
patterns.context: 在专利背景中描述抗 CD33 单克隆抗体及其表达相关发现。
patterns.domain: 专利/血液肿瘤生物医学

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 appeal
patterns.context: 刑事案件证词之后转入上诉审理过程；激活主要在 appeal。

patterns.name: 论坛公告中的 sticky
patterns.context: 论坛管理语境中指置顶公告帖，激活落在 sticky 的末尾字母。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on procedure and related word forms describing surgical, diagnostic, or treatment processes in medical and technical texts; there are also cooking actions, the ending of crucified, and isolated activation on Romanian cel. No clear corresponding pattern for passage 1.

patterns.name: procedure vocabulary and its ending
patterns.context: Describes processes such as surgery, diagnosis, treatment, and device operation; procedure often appears as procedure or in compound expressions
patterns.domain: Medical papers and patent technical writing

patterns.name: Action words in cooking steps
patterns.context: Recipe instructions give consecutive steps for handling and cooking ingredients, especially the “cook and stir until…” construction

patterns.name: Association between Friday and religious events
patterns.context: Discusses cultural reasons Friday is considered unlucky and mentions Jesus being crucified

patterns.name: Romanian disaster-emphasis context
patterns.context: In a Romanian sentence, “cel mai grav” means “most severe” and refers to the Chernobyl disaster

1_1231.description: 激活主要集中在医学与技术文本中描述手术、诊断或治疗流程的 procedure 及相关词形；另有食谱烹饪动作、crucified 的词尾和罗马尼亚语 cel 等孤立激活。第1段无清晰对应模式。

patterns.name: procedure 词汇及其结尾
patterns.context: 围绕手术、诊断、治疗、器械操作等流程描述；procedure 常出现在 procedure 或 procedure 的复合表达中
patterns.domain: 医学论文及专利技术文体

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤中的动作词
patterns.context: 食谱中连续给出食材处理和烹饪步骤，尤其是“cook and stir until…”结构

patterns.name: 周五与宗教事件的关联
patterns.context: 谈论星期五不吉利的文化原因，提及耶稣被钉十字架
patterns.domain: 文化、宗教相关网络文章

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语的灾难强调语境
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句子中以“cel mai grav”表达“最严重”，谈及切尔诺贝利事故

en.description: Activations are distributed across several different contexts: cooking actions in recipes, biomedical cell-culture terminology, the “General” title in legal documents and Wikipedia categories, and forum “sticky” announcements. No single trigger pattern explains all passages.

patterns.name: stir in cooking steps
patterns.context: Recipe instructions direct heating, adding ingredients, and cooking or stirring; several passages also mention ingredients such as onions and vegetables

patterns.name: Cell-culture terminology
patterns.context: Biomedical methods passages describe cell lines, media, and culture conditions

patterns.name: Attorney General title
