patterns.context: Legal documents list prosecutors and their assistants, offices, and case roles

patterns.name: Attorney General in a category title
patterns.context: Wikipedia category entry title containing “Connecticut Attorneys General”

patterns.name: sticky in forum announcements
patterns.context: Forum posting instructions refer to pinned announcement posts

1_1231.description: 激活分布在几类不同语境：食谱中的烹饪动作、生物医学细胞培养术语、法律文书及维基分类中的“General”职衔，以及论坛“sticky”公告。没有单一触发模式能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤中的 stir
patterns.context: 食谱中指示加热、加入食材并烹煮或搅拌；多个段落还出现 onions、vegetables 等食材

patterns.name: 细胞培养相关术语
patterns.context: 生物医学方法段落，描述细胞系、培养基和培养条件
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: Attorney General 职衔
patterns.context: 法律文书中列出检察官及其助理、职务和案件身份

patterns.name: 分类标题中的 Attorney General
patterns.context: 维基百科分类条目标题，出现“Connecticut Attorneys General”

patterns.name: 论坛公告中的 sticky
patterns.context: 论坛发帖说明中指向置顶公告帖

en.description: Activations occur in medical uses of intensive care, the culture-medium name DMEM, and a few experimental terms and recipe action words. The latter triggers appear across scattered contexts, with no unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “intensive care”
patterns.context: In medical texts, this phrase refers to an intensive care ward or unit; in the displayed excerpts, activation falls on care near “intensive care”.
patterns.domain: Clinical medicine, case reports, and research abstracts

patterns.name: DMEM culture-medium name
patterns.context: In cell-culture methods, medium follows the full name of the medium; activation falls on medium.

patterns.name: Stirring in cooking steps
patterns.context: A recipe describes cooking ingredients while stirring continuously until tender; activation falls on stir.

patterns.name: Pouring action in cooking
patterns.context: A recipe instructs the reader to pour hot cream over chocolate chips; activation falls on Pour at the beginning of the sentence.

patterns.name: Cryopreservation-related term
patterns.context: Experimental methods or abstracts describe sample cryopreservation; the trigger word is split, with activation concentrated on reserved.

patterns.name: Tumor volume measurement
patterns.context: An animal tumor experiment explains that tumor volume is determined by external measurements; activation falls on volume.

1_1231.description: 激活见于医学中的 intensive care、培养基名称 DMEM，以及少数实验术语和食谱动作词。后几类触发语境分散，未显出统一的语义或句法规律。

patterns.name: 固定短语“intensive care”
patterns.context: 医学文本中，该词组指重症监护病房或单元；在所示片段中激活落在“intensive care”附近的 care 上。
patterns.domain: 临床医学、病例与研究摘要

patterns.name: DMEM 培养基名称
patterns.context: 细胞培养方法中，完整培养基名称后出现 medium；激活落在 medium 上。

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤中的搅拌
patterns.context: 食谱中描述烹煮食材并持续搅拌至熟软；激活落在 stir 上。

patterns.name: 烹饪中的浇淋动作
patterns.context: 食谱指示将热奶油倒在巧克力片上；激活落在句首的 Pour 上。

patterns.name: 低温保存相关术语
patterns.context: 实验方法或摘要中描述样品冷冻保存；触发词被拆分，激活集中在 reserved 部分。
patterns.domain: 生物医学实验与生殖研究

patterns.name: 肿瘤体积测量
patterns.context: 动物肿瘤实验中说明通过外部测量确定肿瘤体积；激活落在 volume 上。

en.description: Activations are distributed across two types of text: cooking operations, heating, and heat-level descriptions in recipes; and CD immune-cell phenotypes, HIV/immunodeficiency, and the cell-culture medium DMEM in biomedical texts. More than one specific trigger is involved.

patterns.name: Stirring in cooking steps
patterns.context: Recipes describe heating and cooking ingredients while stirring; nearby trigger words often include specific ingredients and timing or doneness instructions.

patterns.name: Pouring hot cream over chocolate
patterns.context: Dessert preparation step: pour heated cream over chocolate pieces to make ganache.

patterns.name: Immune-cell phenotype markers
patterns.context: CD markers and cell subsets appear when describing, classifying, or studying lymphocytes and T cells.

patterns.name: Immunodeficiency and HIV
patterns.context: Discusses AIDS/HIV, immunodeficiency, or related diseases and pathological manifestations; may appear alongside immune-cell information.

patterns.name: DMEM medium name
patterns.context: Experimental methods specify cell-line culture conditions, often near cell-line names and culture descriptions.

patterns.name: medium at the end of a term
patterns.context: medium means the heat level of a burner, not culture medium; this occurs in a recipe step.

1_1231.concept: 生物医学与食谱局部术语
1_1231.description: 激活分布于两类文本：食谱中的烹调操作、加热与火力描述；以及生物医学文本中的 CD 免疫细胞表型、HIV/免疫缺陷和细胞培养基 DMEM。具体触发不止一种。

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤中的搅拌
patterns.context: 食谱中描述加热、烹煮食材并搅拌；触发词附近常有具体食材和时间或熟度说明。

patterns.name: 热奶油浇巧克力
patterns.context: 甜点制作步骤：将加热的奶油倒在巧克力片上制作 ganache。

patterns.name: 免疫细胞表型标记
patterns.context: 描述、分类或研究淋巴细胞及 T 细胞时，出现 CD 标记和细胞亚群。

patterns.name: 免疫缺陷与 HIV
patterns.context: 讨论 AIDS/HIV、免疫缺陷或相关疾病与病理表现；可与免疫细胞信息同段出现。

patterns.name: DMEM 培养基名称
patterns.trigger: «modified»« Eagle»«'s»« medium»«9»，即 Dulbecco's modified Eagle's medium (DMEM)
patterns.context: 实验方法中说明细胞系的培养条件，常邻近细胞系名称及培养描述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学/细胞培养方法

patterns.name: 术语末尾的 medium
patterns.trigger: «medium»，出现在 “Reduce heat to medium-low” 一类烹饪指令中
patterns.context: medium 表示炉火强度，并非培养基；此处处于食谱步骤。

en.concept: Common multiword collocations and domain-specific word fragments
en.description: Activations are distributed across culture-medium names and cultured in cell-culture contexts, the fixed phrase intensive care unit, recipe action words stir/Pour, immune deficiency, and a letter fragment inside a radiotherapy term.

patterns.name: Dulbecco’s Eagle medium
patterns.context: Mentions the name of a culture medium in cell-culture methods; excerpts 1 and 2 also contain the abbreviation DMEM.

patterns.name: intensive care unit
patterns.context: Mentions a patient being admitted to or transferred to an intensive care unit; excerpt 5 is a medical fact quoted in legal testimony.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, case descriptions, and legal texts

patterns.name: stir in cooking instructions
patterns.context: Instructs the reader to cook ingredients in a recipe, often adjacent to cook, until, and ingredient names.

patterns.name: Pour in cooking instructions
patterns.context: When making ganache, hot cream is poured over chocolate chips.

patterns.name: immune deficiency
patterns.context: Describes immunoglobulin and lymphocyte testing to rule out immune deficiency.

patterns.name: Letter fragment inside a radiotherapy term
patterns.context: Marks only a letter fragment inside the English word for radiotherapy; there is insufficient context to establish it as an independent semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Culture-related but not a clear culture-medium collocation
patterns.context: Describes cell culture in cell-culture methods; DMEM also appears in the same passage, but the activation marker falls on cultured.

1_1231.concept: 常见多词搭配与领域词片段
1_1231.description: 激活分布于细胞培养语境的培养基名称及 cultured、重症监护病房固定短语、食谱操作词 stir/Pour、免疫缺陷词 deficiency，另有放疗词内部字母片段。

patterns.name: Dulbecco’s Eagle 培养基
patterns.context: 细胞培养方法中提及培养基名称；段1、2还出现缩写 DMEM。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文的方法部分

patterns.name: intensive care unit
patterns.context: 提及患者住院或转入重症监护病房；段5为法律证词引用的医疗事实。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、病例描述及法律文本

patterns.name: 烹饪指令中的 stir
patterns.trigger: «stir»，尤其是反复出现的 “cook and stir”
patterns.context: 食谱中指导烹饪食材，常与 cook、until 及食材名称相邻。

patterns.name: 烹饪指令中的 Pour
patterns.context: 制作甘纳许时，将热奶油倒在巧克力片上。

patterns.name: immune deficiency
patterns.context: 描述免疫球蛋白及淋巴细胞检测，以排除免疫缺陷。

patterns.name: 放疗词中间的字母片段
patterns.context: 只标记放射治疗英文单词内部的字母片段，没有足够上下文表明它是独立语义触发词。

patterns.name: 培养相关但非明确培养基搭配
patterns.context: 细胞培养方法中描述细胞的培养；同段还出现 DMEM，但激活标记落在 cultured。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文的方法部分

en.description: Activations fall almost entirely on the spelling fragment notes: mainly the Footnotes section heading, but also notes in banknotes, notes in citation links, and the internal fragment in connotes. Footnotes sections often appear at the end of documents, adjacent to references, indexes, or categories.

patterns.name: Footnotes label “notes”
patterns.context: Triggers cluster on the word notes; the strongest instance is in banknotes, while several others occur in Footnotes. The former is a currency term; the latter is a footnotes section heading in a page or document.
patterns.domain: Finance, encyclopedia pages, book typesetting guides

patterns.name: Footnotes section and page navigation
patterns.context: A Footnotes section heading appears at the end of paragraphs or in descriptions of document structure, often adjacent to navigation sections such as references, indexes, and categories; paragraph 5 discusses footnote typesetting, and paragraph 7 describes footnote placement.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, book prefaces, or typesetting guidelines

patterns.name: Currency term banknotes
patterns.context: notes combines with bank to form banknotes, referring to banknotes backed by a government; it does not have the page-footnote meaning.

patterns.name: notes in hyperlinks or bibliographic citations
patterns.context: notes appears in the link text of a bibliographic citation marker, referring to a notes page or note entry; it is not a footnotes section heading in ordinary prose.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, cryptography, or probability theory

patterns.name: Internal fragment in the verb connotes
patterns.context: notes is only the sequence of letters at the end of the verb connotes; it does not mean footnotes or banknotes. The passage discusses the meaning of the word lobbying.
patterns.domain: Online forum discussion, explanations of word meaning

1_1290.description: 激活几乎都落在拼写片段 notes 上：主要是 Footnotes 栏标题，也包括 banknotes、引用链接中的 notes，以及 connotes 的词内片段。脚注栏目常出现在文档末尾并邻接参考文献、索引或分类。

patterns.name: 脚注标签“notes”
patterns.context: 触发集中在 notes 这个词；最强实例位于 banknotes，另外多处位于 Footnotes。前者是货币术语，后者是页面或文档中的脚注栏标题。
patterns.domain: 金融、百科页面、书籍排版说明

patterns.name: 脚注栏及页面导航
patterns.context: 段落末尾或文档结构说明中出现 Footnotes 栏标题，常与参考文献、索引、分类等导航栏目相邻；第5段讲脚注排版，第7段说明脚注位置。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、书籍前言或排版规范

patterns.name: banknotes 货币词
patterns.context: notes 与 bank 构成 banknotes，指由政府背书的银行纸币；不是页面脚注语义。

patterns.name: 超链接或文献引用中的 notes
patterns.context: notes 出现在文献引用标记的链接文本中，指 notes 页面或笔记条目；并非普通正文中的脚注栏目标题。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、密码学或概率论

patterns.name: 动词 connotes 的词内片段
patterns.context: notes 只是 connotes 这个动词末尾的字母片段，并不表示脚注或纸币；该处讨论 lobbying 一词的含义。
patterns.domain: 网络论坛讨论、词义说明

en.description: Primarily sensitive to the word form notes, especially notes in the Footnotes heading; also triggered by banknotes, notes in reference paths, and connotes. Often occurs in footnote sections at the end of documents, but does not depend on that meaning or position.

patterns.name: Footnote headings and variants
patterns.context: “Footnotes” appears as a standalone section or navigation heading, often at the end of a passage and alongside end-of-page elements such as References, Category, and Index; strong activation falls on notes.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, legal webpages, transcriptions of old books, and general web text

patterns.name: notes as an internal word fragment
patterns.context: notes occurs at the end of a word or in a compound, rather than as a standalone footnote heading: examples include “[@…-notes]” and “banknotes”; triggered by the notes substring, without requiring a footnote context.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in notes-related word forms
patterns.context: notes is part of the verb “connotes” in a sentence discussing the meaning of the word lobbying; this is not a footnote context.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, explanations of language usage

patterns.name: End-of-page navigation and categories
patterns.context: End-of-document navigation, references, or category markers near a footnote heading; the triggering token itself is unmarked but adjacent to strongly activated Footnotes.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia pages, book contents, or transcribed texts

1_1290.concept: notes 字符串及脚注标题
1_1290.description: 主要对字符串 notes 的词形敏感，尤其是 Footnotes 标题中的 notes；也触发 banknotes、参考文献路径中的 notes 和 connotes。多出现在文档尾部脚注区，但不依赖该语义或位置。

patterns.name: 脚注标题及其变体
patterns.context: “Footnotes”作为独立的章节或导航标题出现，常在段落末尾并伴随 References、Category、Index 等页面尾部元素；强激活落在 notes 上。
patterns.domain: 百科、法律网页、古籍转录及一般网页文本

patterns.name: notes 词内片段
patterns.context: notes 出现在词尾或复合词中，而非独立脚注标题：如“[@…-notes]”及“banknotes”；均为 notes 子串触发，语境不要求脚注。

patterns.name: notes 相关词形中的词内片段
patterns.context: notes 是动词“connotes”的词内部分，处于讨论 lobbying 一词含义的句子中；不是脚注语境。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、语言用法说明

patterns.name: 尾部页面导航与分类
patterns.context: 脚注标题附近的文档末尾导航、参考资料或分类标记；触发 token 本身未标记，但与强激活的 Footnotes 相邻。
patterns.domain: 百科页面、书籍目录或转录文本

en.concept: notes word forms and document footnotes
en.description: All passages contain notes or a related word form; the strongest activation falls on notes, commonly in a Footnotes section, and also includes banknotes, notes in citation keys, and connotes. Contexts span encyclopedia, legal, academic, book, and forum texts.

patterns.name: Word endings related to “notes”
patterns.context: Strongest response is concentrated on the word “notes,” especially in “footnotes” and “banknotes”; also includes connotes and the weaker or adjacent form financier in a financial context.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, academic texts, book typesetting notes, legal notes, and financial history

patterns.name: Footnote section labels
patterns.context: Footnotes are listed under a standalone section heading at the end of a document or chapter; in several passages this heading appears among sections such as references.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia, legal webpages, Gutenberg books, and other documents

patterns.name: Banknotes and bank-issued currency
patterns.context: “banknotes” refers to currency issued by banks and backed by the government; this is not a footnote label.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in “connotes”
patterns.context: In a sentence explaining that lobbying usually implies paid activity, activation falls on the ending notes in connotes.

patterns.name: Standalone “notes” bibliographic label
patterns.context: In citation keys or reference identifiers in a mathematics paper, notes appears as part of a resource name, not as a footnote section in the body text.

patterns.name: Footnote formatting and placement notes
patterns.context: The main text specifically explains how footnotes are marked or where they appear in a book or chapter.
patterns.domain: Editorial and typesetting notes in Gutenberg ebooks

patterns.name: Footnote entries in a table of contents
patterns.context: Front or back matter of a book lists footnotes and other components in a contents- or index-like list.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg book contents or chapter structure

1_1290.description: 所有段都含有 notes 或其相关词形；最强激活落在 notes，常见于 Footnotes 栏目，也涵盖 banknotes、引用键中的 notes 和 connotes。上下文横跨百科、法律、学术、书籍与论坛文本。

patterns.name: “notes”相关词尾
patterns.context: 最强响应集中在“notes”一词，尤其是 footnotes、banknotes；另有 connotes、金融语境中的 financier 这一较弱或邻近形式。
patterns.domain: 百科、学术文本、书籍排版说明、法律说明及金融史

patterns.name: 脚注栏目标签
patterns.context: 文档或章节末尾以独立栏目标题列出脚注；多段中该标题出现在参考文献等栏目之间。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia、法律网页、Gutenberg 书籍及其他文档

patterns.name: 纸币与银行票据
patterns.context: “banknotes”指由银行发行、由政府支持的货币；此处并非脚注标签。

patterns.name: “connotes”的词内片段
patterns.context: 在解释 lobbying 一词通常暗示有偿行为的句子中，激活落在 connotes 的词尾 notes 上。
patterns.domain: 网络论坛评论、日常论述

patterns.name: 单独的“notes”文献标签
patterns.context: 数学论文的引用键或参考资料标识中，notes 作为资源名称的一部分出现，并非正文脚注栏目。

patterns.name: 脚注的排版与位置说明
patterns.context: 正文专门说明脚注的标记方式或其在书中/章节中的位置。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 电子书的编辑与排版说明

patterns.name: 章节目录中的脚注项目
patterns.context: 书籍前后部分以目录或索引式列表列出脚注等组成部分。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 书籍目录或篇章结构

en.description: Strongly responds to text fragments containing notes, especially footnotes section headings; it also appears in banknotes, notes in citation markers, and the ending of connotes.

patterns.name: Footnotes and references sections
patterns.context: Appears at the end of a document or at section boundaries as a footnotes heading, often alongside sections such as References, Sources, and Category; it can also occur in body text referring to footnotes.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, ebook guides, legal information pages, and web text

patterns.name: notes in compound words
patterns.context: notes is part of a compound word or hyphenated label, rather than a standalone footnotes section heading.

patterns.name: notes substring in connotes
patterns.context: notes is only the ending of the verb connotes and is semantically unrelated to footnotes or notes.
patterns.domain: Forum dialogue, explanations of terminology about lobbying

1_1290.description: 强烈响应包含 notes 的文本片段，尤其是脚注栏目标题；也会在 banknotes、引文标识中的 notes，以及 connotes 词尾出现。

patterns.name: 脚注及参考资料栏目
patterns.context: 出现在文末或章节边界处，作为脚注栏目标题，常与 References、Sources、Category 等栏目并列；也可在正文中提及脚注。
patterns.domain: 百科、电子书说明、法律信息页面及网页文本

patterns.name: 复合词中的 notes
patterns.context: notes 是复合词或带连字符标识的一部分，而非独立的脚注栏目标题。
patterns.domain: 美国货币史、学术论文引文

patterns.name: connotes 中的 notes 子串
patterns.context: notes 只是动词 connotes 的词尾部分，语义上与脚注或笔记无关。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、关于 lobbying 用语的解释

en.description: Primarily activates on “Footnotes” and its word root notes: this includes footnote headings at the end of pages as well as body-text uses involving banknotes, bibliographic notes, and connotes; it also responds more weakly to references, categories, and typesetting structure markers.

patterns.name: Footnote heading
patterns.context: “Footnotes” appears as a section heading, often at the end of a page alongside references, external links, or categories; activation spans different tokenizations and strengths.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, ebook typesetting notes, webpage content

patterns.name: Body-text mentions of footnotes and notes
patterns.context: The token notes appears in a compound or body text rather than a footnote heading; meanings include banknotes, bibliographic notes, and “implies.”

patterns.name: Document structure and typesetting markers
patterns.context: Documents contain section labels, line breaks, or typesetting conventions; some occur in the same page-structure area as footnote headings.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, ebook texts, and typesetting notes

1_1290.description: 主要对“Footnotes”及其词元 notes 激活：既包括页面尾部的脚注标题，也包括纸币、文献附注和 connotes 等正文用法；另对参考文献、分类及排版结构标记有较弱反应。

patterns.name: 脚注标题
patterns.context: “Footnotes”作为章节标题，常出现在参考文献、外部链接或分类等页面尾部；激活覆盖不同词元切分和强度
patterns.domain: 百科条目、电子书排版说明、网页内容

patterns.name: 脚注与附注的正文提及
patterns.context: 词元 notes 出现在复合词或正文中，而非脚注标题；含义分别涉及纸币、文献笔记/附注，以及“意味着”
patterns.domain: 历史、学术论文、网络评论

patterns.name: 文档结构与排版标记
patterns.context: 文档中出现章节标签、换行或排版规范；部分与脚注标题同处页面结构区域
patterns.domain: 百科条目、电子书文本与排版说明

en.description: The strongest shared pattern is the tokenized Footnotes section heading, usually at the end of a document and alongside references and other navigation items. There is also strong activation on notes in banknotes and in academic citation entries.

patterns.name: Footnotes section heading
patterns.context: Appears at a standalone section heading at the end of a paragraph or entry, often alongside navigation headings such as References, Category, and Further reading; activation covers tokenized fragments of Footnotes.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, legal webpages, book text, and webpage lists

patterns.name: Ending of banknotes
patterns.context: Appears in the word “banknotes” in a passage about issuing currency or national banks; the marked segment is notes.

patterns.name: notes in a bibliographic entry
patterns.context: Appears at the end of a bibliographic reference or online notes entry in a bracketed citation, preceded by “@uppsala-”; unrelated to a footnotes section heading.

1_1290.description: 最强共同模式是分词后的“Footnotes”栏目标题，通常位于文末并与参考文献等导航项并列。另对 banknotes 中的 notes 及学术引用条目中的 notes 有强激活。

patterns.name: 脚注栏目标题
patterns.context: 出现在段落或条目末尾的独立栏目标题处，常与 References、Category、Further reading 等导航标题并列；激活覆盖的是 Footnotes 的分词片段。
patterns.domain: 百科、法律网页、书籍文本及网页列表

patterns.name: banknotes词尾
patterns.context: 出现在“banknotes”一词中，且该词处于发行货币、国家银行的叙述里；标记落在 notes 词段。

patterns.name: notes文献条目
patterns.context: 出现在方括号引用中的文献或在线笔记条目末尾，前接“@uppsala-”；与脚注栏目标题无关。

en.description: The strongest shared pattern is sensitivity to “Footnotes/footnotes” and related notes bibliographic markers, especially section headings in reference sections; there is also sporadic activation on special typesetting in academic sections and the financial compound banknotes.

patterns.name: Footnotes section heading
patterns.context: Appears after article or webpage body text as a heading for a reference section, often alongside sections such as «References», «Sources», «Further reading», or «Category:»; trigger strength varies slightly across passages.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, legal texts, webpage content, and other genres with notes or references

patterns.name: Footnote citation wording
patterns.context: The word occurs in a sentence referring to a bibliographic footnote or explanatory note, rather than a section heading; paragraph 5 also contains «actual» «foot»notes».

patterns.name: Citation labels ending in notes
patterns.context: Appears at the end of a bibliographic or online resource identifier in parentheses, such as «[@livitanyi; @uppsala-notes]»; similar to a footnotes heading, but not an explicit Footnotes section.

patterns.name: Special section typesetting
patterns.context: Section headings use tab delimiters and include section numbers; there are no clear footnote or notes terms.
patterns.domain: Table of contents and section headings in philosophical or academic texts

patterns.name: banknotes in a financial context
patterns.context: Describes banknotes issued and backed by government bonds; notes is part of a compound word, not a footnote or reference.

1_1290.description: 最强共同模式是对“Footnotes/footnotes”及相关 notes 文献标记敏感，尤其是参考资料区的栏目标题；另对学术章节的特殊排版和金融复合词 banknotes 有零星响应。

patterns.name: 脚注栏目标题
patterns.context: 出现在文章或网页正文之后，作为参考资料区的标题，常与 «References»、«Sources»、«Further reading» 或 «Category:» 等栏目并列；触发强度在不同段落中略有不同。
patterns.domain: 百科、法律文本、网页内容及其他带有附注或参考资料的文体

patterns.name: 脚注引用用语
patterns.context: 词语出现在句子中，指向文献的脚注或说明性附注，而非栏目标题；第5段还出现 «actual» «foot»notes»。
patterns.domain: 网页介绍、法律判决引文

patterns.name: 词尾 notes 的引用标签
patterns.context: 出现在括号中的文献或在线资料标识末尾，如 «[@livitanyi; @uppsala-notes]»；与脚注标题相似，但不是明确的 Footnotes 栏目。

patterns.name: 特殊章节排版
patterns.context: 章节标题采用制表符分隔，并带有章节编号；没有明显脚注或 notes 用语。
patterns.domain: 哲学或学术文本的目录、章节标题

patterns.name: 金融语境中的 banknotes
patterns.context: 描述发行由政府债券支持的纸币；notes 是复合词的一部分，并非脚注或参考资料。

en.description: Activates mainly on “oplasmic” in “endoplasmic reticulum,” and repeatedly on “Footnotes” and other word endings containing notes; there is also one activation on corrupted characters.

patterns.name: Endoplasmic reticulum phrase
patterns.context: Activation focuses on “oplasmic” in the tokenized phrase “endoplasmic reticulum,” found in organelle research and related biomedical discussion.

patterns.name: Footnotes heading
patterns.context: Appears in document-ending or page-navigation-style headings; “Footnotes” is split into multiple tokens, with activation on “notes.”
patterns.domain: Wikipedia, legal webpages, and web text

patterns.name: Ending of banknotes
patterns.context: Occurs in the historical account “print banknotes backed by...”; activation falls on “notes” in the compound “banknotes.”

patterns.name: Special character sequence
patterns.context: Corrupted or damaged-encoding text in IRC chat; activation corresponds to anomalous characters rather than an identifiable ordinary word.

patterns.name: Citation suffix notes
patterns.context: Appears at the end of names such as “uppsala-notes” in citations in mathematics papers.

1_1290.description: 主要激活于“endoplasmic reticulum”中的“oplasmic”，也反复出现在“Footnotes”及其他含 notes 的词尾；另有一次乱码字符激活。

patterns.name: 内质网短语
patterns.context: 激活集中在被分词切开的“endoplasmic reticulum”中的“oplasmic”，见于细胞器研究及相关生物医学论述。

patterns.name: 脚注标题
patterns.context: 出现在文档尾部或页面导航式标题中；“Footnotes”被分成多个 token，激活落在“notes”。

patterns.name: 银行纸币词尾
patterns.context: 处于“print banknotes backed by...”这一历史叙述中，激活在复合词“banknotes”的“notes”。

patterns.name: 特殊字符序列
patterns.context: IRC 聊天中的乱码或损坏编码文本；激活对应异常字符，而非可辨认的普通词。

patterns.name: 笔记引用后缀
patterns.context: 数学论文的参考文献引文中，出现在“uppsala-notes”一类名称的末尾。

en.description: The most stable trigger is the -oplasmic fragment, especially in endoplasmic reticulum, and also in cytoplasmic and sarcoplasmic. Related passages concern organelles, calcium signaling, stress, and muscle; there are also behavioral-problem passages and a few activations on adjacent words.

patterns.name: Endoplasmic reticulum terminology and internal word fragments
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs in words containing -plasmic, especially endoplasmic reticulum; it also includes cytoplasmic and sarcoplasmic. No specific syntactic position is required.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research, cell biology, and muscle science papers

patterns.name: Endoplasmic reticulum and Golgi morphology and dynamics
patterns.context: Discusses relationships between organelles, morphology maintenance, or dynamics, often mentioning both the endoplasmic reticulum and Golgi.

patterns.name: Endoplasmic reticulum stress and cell fate
patterns.context: Endoplasmic reticulum transport defects, stress, or compounds localized to the endoplasmic reticulum are linked to outcomes such as cell survival and apoptosis.
patterns.domain: Cell biology and cancer research abstracts

patterns.name: Neurobehavioral disorders and related descriptions
patterns.context: Associated behavioral or neurological problems in children with fragile X syndrome; the main activations in this passage are not on endoplasmic reticulum terms.
patterns.domain: Genetic disorders and neurodevelopment research abstracts

patterns.name: Muscle proteins and sarcoplasmic reticulum terminology
patterns.context: Muscle sample fractionation or energy balance in the sarcoplasmic reticulum; activation falls on the tokenized fragment of sarcoplasmic.

patterns.name: Cytoplasmic morphology description
patterns.context: Description of the appearance of cytoplasmic contents when observing infected cells under a microscope.

patterns.name: Calcium signaling and endoplasmic reticulum calcium stores
patterns.context: The endoplasmic reticulum serves as a source of calcium-ion storage or release and participates in ion transport, changes in calcium content, and signaling pathways.

1_1290.concept: 含 -plasmic 的生物医学词语片段
1_1290.description: 最稳定的触发是 -oplasmic 片段，尤见于 endoplasmic reticulum，也见 cytoplasmic、sarcoplasmic。相关段落涉及细胞器、钙信号、应激及肌肉；另有行为问题和少数邻近词激活。

patterns.name: 内质网相关术语及词内片段
patterns.trigger: «oplasmic»（常出现在 end«oplasmic» reticulum；也见 Cyt«oplasmic» contents、sar«oplasmic» proteins）
patterns.context: 触发片段位于含有 -plasmic 的词中，尤其是 endoplasmic reticulum；也包括 cytoplasmic、sarcoplasmic。无需特定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、细胞生物学及肌肉科学论文

patterns.name: 内质网与高尔基体形态和动态
patterns.context: 讨论细胞器相互关系、形态维持或动态，常同时出现 endoplasmic reticulum 与 Golgi。

patterns.name: 内质网应激与细胞命运
patterns.context: 内质网运输缺陷、应激或定位于内质网的化合物与细胞存活、凋亡等结果相联系。
patterns.domain: 细胞生物学与肿瘤研究摘要

patterns.name: 神经行为障碍及相关表述
patterns.context: 脆性X综合征儿童的伴随行为或神经系统问题；本段主要激活并非内质网词汇。
patterns.domain: 遗传病与神经发育研究摘要

patterns.name: 肌肉蛋白及肌浆网术语
patterns.context: 肌肉样品分级或肌浆网能量平衡问题；激活落在 sarcoplasmic 的分词片段上。
patterns.domain: 肉类科学及肌肉生理学

patterns.name: 细胞质形态描述
patterns.context: 显微镜观察感染细胞时，对细胞质内容物外观的描述。

patterns.name: 钙信号与内质网钙库
patterns.context: 内质网作为钙离子储存或释放来源，参与离子运输、钙含量变化及信号通路。
patterns.domain: 细胞生理学与生物物理学

en.description: The most stable pattern involves noisy and contexts of noise, noisiness, or interference, spanning research, patents, forums, and popular science; there are also isolated activations on electronic journal, clearer audio segments, and line breaks in an email.

patterns.name: noisy and its semantic field
patterns.context: The trigger word noisy appears around nouns denoting noise, noisiness, or interference; examples include noisy speech, noisy measurements, noisy areas, noisy observation, noisy channels, and noisy fish.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; research papers, technical patents, forums, popular science text

patterns.name: Electronic journal publishing language
patterns.context: electronic modifies journal in a sentence introducing a peer-reviewed electronic journal and its publisher.

patterns.name: Search context for a clear segment
patterns.context: The questioner describes trying to identify a song in a commercial video using Shazam and notes that trying on a clearer segment still yielded no result.

patterns.name: Line breaks and name fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on a blank-line break marker, followed by names such as Experts, Tom Lambert, and Dan Lamb; there are no clear semantic cues related to noise.

1_1290.concept: 噪声及清晰度相关语境
1_1290.description: 最稳定模式是 noisy 及其噪声、嘈杂或受干扰语境，横跨科研、专利、论坛和科普文本；另有 electronic journal、较清晰的音频片段及邮件换行处的孤立激活。

patterns.name: noisy 及其语义场
patterns.context: 直接触发词 noisy 出现在表示噪声、嘈杂或受干扰的名词前后；包括 noisy speech、noisy measurements、noisy areas、noisy observation、noisy channels、noisy fish 等。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；科研论文、技术专利、论坛、科普文本

patterns.name: 电子期刊出版措辞
patterns.context: electronic 修饰 journal，处于介绍同行评审电子期刊及其出版方的句子中。

patterns.name: 清晰片段的检索语境
patterns.context: 提问者描述尝试用 Shazam 识别商业广告视频中的歌曲，并指出在较清晰的片段上尝试仍无结果。

patterns.name: 换行与人名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在空白行换行标记上，后接 Experts、Tom Lambert 和 Dan Lamb 等人名；没有明显的噪声语义线索。

en.description: Primarily responds to interesting (including quoted, italicized, and uninteresting forms), and also to pairwise and intersect/disjoint in mathematical contexts; it additionally responds once to interesting in a corollary label.

patterns.name: “interesting” and evaluative usage
patterns.context: Describes things, knowledge, opportunities, quotations, or books; it can express positive evaluation and also appears in the negative form “uninteresting”.
patterns.domain: Various genres including blogs, forums, academic papers, and book reviews

patterns.name: Pairwise-relation terminology in mathematics
patterns.context: Mathematical text describing pairwise intersecting or disjoint relations among sets, elements, or systems.
patterns.domain: Combinatorics, set theory, and related arXiv papers

patterns.name: Theorem or result labels in papers
patterns.context: “interesting” appears in a bracketed corollary name or citation label, rather than in ordinary evaluative usage.

1_1290.concept: interesting 与数学成对关系术语
1_1290.description: 主要响应 interesting（含引号、斜体及 uninteresting），也响应数学语境中的 pairwise 和 intersect/disjoint；另在一处响应推论标签中的 interesting。

patterns.name: “interesting”及其评价用法
patterns.context: 形容事物、知识、机会、引文或书籍；可用于正面评价，也出现在否定形式“uninteresting”中。
patterns.domain: 博客、论坛、学术论文及书评等多种文体

patterns.name: 数学中的成对关系术语
patterns.context: 数学文本中描述集合、元素或系统之间成对相交或不相交的关系。
patterns.domain: 组合数学、集合论及相关 arXiv 论文

patterns.name: 论文中的定理或结果标记
patterns.context: “interesting”出现在方括号标出的推论名称或引用标签中，而非普通评价语境。

en.description: Activations are scattered across whitespace and formatting fragments, evaluations such as confusing/unclear, mathematical and philosophical terms, code, and technical forum text; no single semantic pattern explains all fragments.

patterns.name: Space and tab markers
patterns.context: Runs of spaces or tabs are marked independently, often appearing in sequences; in passage 1 they are also embedded between email body text and date fields.

patterns.name: “confusing” and expressions of confusion
patterns.context: Evaluates something or some text as confusing or unclear; may occur alongside criticism of expression quality.

patterns.name: Abstract spaces and spaces of concepts
patterns.context: Discusses abstract spaces, conceptual constructions, and how they differ from real space.

patterns.name: Mathematical logic and set relations
patterns.context: Formal statements of existence, order relations, or subset conditions, accompanied by LaTeX mathematical notation.

patterns.name: Abstract mathematical terminology
patterns.context: An abstract introduces group-theoretic constructions and their properties.

patterns.name: Proper names and date fields in Enron text
patterns.context: Email text contains company- or transaction-related names, space-separated fields, and email header fields.

patterns.name: Negative descriptions of cognition and thought
patterns.context: Describes excessive research interests, unfocused thinking, or confused cognitive states.

patterns.name: Technical names and criticism of terminology
patterns.context: Forum discussions concern technical concepts, difficulty understanding terminology, or misleading names.

patterns.name: Tabs and instruction fragments in code
patterns.context: Lines in code or build files contain indentation, include directives, and filename fragments.

patterns.name: Names and word fragments related to network protocols or loading
patterns.context: A comment signature or mention of another person, accompanied by “social network not graph” and the bootload fragment.

1_1290.description: 激活分散于空白与格式片段、confusing/unclear 等混乱评价、数学与哲学术语、代码和技术论坛文本；没有单一语义模式能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 空格及 tab 标记
patterns.context: 连续空格或制表符被单独标记，常成串出现；第1段还夹在邮件正文与日期字段中。

patterns.name: “confusing”及表达混乱
patterns.context: 评价某事物或文字令人困惑、不清楚；可与批评表达质量的语境相邻。
patterns.domain: 问答、学术评论、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 抽象空间与性质空间
patterns.context: 讨论抽象空间、概念构造及其与真实空间的区别。

patterns.name: 数学逻辑与集合关系
patterns.context: 形式化陈述存在性、序关系或子集条件，伴随 LaTeX 数学符号。

patterns.name: 抽象数学术语
patterns.context: 摘要中介绍群论构造及其性质。

patterns.name: Enron 文本中的专名与日期字段
patterns.context: 邮件文本含公司或交易相关名称、空格分隔和邮件头字段。

patterns.name: 认知与思维状态的负面描写
patterns.context: 描写研究兴趣过多、思维不聚焦或认知状态混乱。

patterns.name: 技术名称及术语批评
patterns.context: 论坛讨论技术概念、术语理解困难或名称具有误导性。

patterns.name: 代码中的制表符与指令片段
patterns.context: 代码或构建文件行，含缩进、include 指令及文件名片段。

patterns.name: 人名与网络协议/加载词片段
patterns.context: 留言署名或提及他人，并带有“social network not graph”及 bootload 片段。

en.concept: Mathematical symbols and technical word fragments
en.description: Activations are distributed across formula boundaries, group theory, and algebraic geometry/combinatorial algebra terminology in mathematics papers; they also occur in code identifiers and C code structures (especially maybe and new), as well as abstract spatial language in philosophical texts. No single clear semantic trigger covers all passages.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula boundaries
patterns.context: Around formulas, theorems, or mathematical expressions, often at the boundary between inline/display equations and prose.

patterns.name: Group and group theory terminology
patterns.context: When discussing properties, representations, growth, or related classifications of groups; often co-occurs with mathematical terminology and proof-oriented prose.

patterns.name: Complex abelian varieties and homomorphisms
patterns.context: Discusses nonzero homomorphisms between complex abelian varieties and theorem assumptions.

patterns.name: Program identifier maybe
patterns.context: maybe appears in code identifiers, in function-name fragments and string literals; surrounding text includes underscores, parentheses, or C code.

patterns.name: new allocation in C code
patterns.context: new is followed by a type or array size as a dynamic allocation expression; occurs in lexer array initialization code.

patterns.name: Lexer identifier
patterns.context: Code creates a lexicon array and uses MAX to specify the character-array size.

patterns.name: Cleanup and return code
patterns.context: A function body performs resource cleanup and returns a Boolean value, near GLib-style types and function declarations.

patterns.name: Algebraic and combinatorial topology terminology
patterns.context: Links cleanness with shellability of simplicial complexes.

patterns.name: Abstract spaces and conceptual construction
patterns.context: Philosophical distinction between real space and an abstract space of properties.

patterns.name: Strong local trigger on maybe
patterns.context: The word is marked as strongly activating in both code passages, but its functions are a function-name fragment and string content, respectively; it shows no stable association with the mathematics passages.

1_1290.concept: 数学符号与技术词片段
1_1290.description: 激活分布在数学论文中的公式边界、群论及代数几何/组合代数术语，也出现在代码标识符与 C 代码结构（尤其 maybe、new）以及哲学文本的抽象空间用语中；不存在能覆盖全部段落的单一明确语义触发。

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式边界
patterns.context: 公式、定理或数学表达式周边，常出现在行内/陈列公式与正文交界处。

patterns.name: 群与群论术语
patterns.context: 讨论群的性质、表示、增长或相关分类时；常与数学术语及证明性叙述同现。

patterns.name: 复阿贝尔簇与同态
patterns.context: 讨论复阿贝尔簇之间的非零同态及定理假设。

patterns.name: 程序标识符 maybe
patterns.context: maybe 出现在代码标识符中，分别位于函数名片段和字符串字面量；周围有下划线、括号或 C 代码。

patterns.name: C 代码中的 new 分配
patterns.context: new 后接类型或数组尺寸，作为动态分配表达式；出现在词法分析器数组初始化代码中。

patterns.name: 词法分析器标识符
patterns.context: 代码中创建 lexicon 数组并以 MAX 指定字符数组大小。

patterns.name: 清理与返回代码
patterns.context: 函数体内执行资源清理并返回布尔值，附近有 GLib 风格类型和函数声明。

patterns.name: 代数与组合拓扑术语
patterns.context: 将 cleanness 与 simplicial complexes 的 shellability 联系起来。
patterns.domain: 交换代数/组合拓扑论文

patterns.name: 抽象空间与概念构造
patterns.context: 对真实空间与抽象属性空间作哲学性区分。

patterns.name: 强烈的 maybe 局部触发
patterns.context: 该词在两段代码中均被标记为强激活，但其功能分别是函数名片段与字符串内容，未见与数学段落稳定关联。

en.concept: mathematical terms and special word forms
en.description: Activation is most prominent on “unique,” which expresses uniqueness in mathematics, and is scattered across various specialized mathematical terms; there is also a response to mathematical uses of special, medical table labels, and ordinary narrative uses. These fragments alone do not establish a single semantic mechanism.

patterns.name: Uniqueness of mathematical objects
patterns.context: A mathematical discussion states that a component, solution, or construction is unique; nearby phrasing often includes “is the unique …” or “which is unique.”
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers (graph theory, algebraic geometry, partial differential equations)

patterns.name: special in specialized terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in the mathematical term “special values” and the clinical table field “Subspecialty”; the word form may be split across token boundaries.

patterns.name: complex abelian varieties
patterns.context: “complex” modifies “abelian varieties” and forms an algebraic-geometric statement alongside “homomorphisms” in the same context.

patterns.name: Terms related to complex structures
patterns.context: “complex structures” appears alongside structural terms such as Lie algebra, symplectic, and nilpotent.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers (Lie algebras and geometric structures)

patterns.name: Table category labels
patterns.context: Occurs in table rows containing values and percentages; activation is concentrated on category labels and their split word forms, not on table values.

patterns.name: special way before a term
patterns.context: In ordinary narrative, modifies “way” to explain that two commemorative events were connected in a special way.

patterns.name: different notions in mathematical terminology
patterns.context: “different notions” compares concepts of distributivity on join-semilattices; nearby terms also include “notion” and “distributivity.”

patterns.name: Other mathematical term activations
patterns.context: Modular and quas(i)modular forms in a list of operator applications; no clear shared local phrasing with the strong trigger words in other passages.

patterns.name: Other mathematical term activations
patterns.context: An analogy between cleanliness and shellability, in the context of defining a simplicial complex.

patterns.name: Weak and scattered mathematical vocabulary
patterns.context: Occurs in the definition of a connected component of a graph; weaker than “unique” in the same passage.

patterns.name: Weak and scattered mathematical vocabulary
patterns.context: Occurs in a mathematical statement about complex abelian varieties and homomorphisms.

patterns.name: Weak and scattered mathematical vocabulary
patterns.context: A geometric discussion of a potentially singular curve replaced by its resolution.

patterns.name: Weak and scattered mathematical vocabulary
patterns.context: An initial-value problem gives a unique solution for each input; the strong trigger word is “unique.”

patterns.name: Weak and scattered mathematical vocabulary
patterns.context: A statement about Lie algebra structures and their compatibility conditions.

patterns.name: Weak and scattered mathematical vocabulary
patterns.context: Introduces and compares notions of distributivity on join-semilattices.

1_1290.description: 激活最显著地落在数学中表示唯一性的“unique”，并散布于多种数学专门术语；另对 special 的数学用法、医学表格标签及普通叙事用法有响应。仅凭这些片段难以确认单一语义机制。

patterns.name: 数学对象的唯一性
patterns.context: 在数学论述中说明某个分量、解或构造唯一，附近常有“is the unique …”或“which is unique”。
patterns.domain: 数学论文（图论、代数几何、偏微分方程）

patterns.name: 专门术语中的 special
patterns.context: 出现在数学术语“special values”以及临床表格字段“Subspecialty”中；词形可跨词边界拆分。

patterns.name: complex abelian varieties
patterns.context: “complex”修饰“abelian varieties”，并与同一上下文中的“homomorphisms”构成代数几何表述。

patterns.name: 复结构相关术语
patterns.context: “complex structures”与 Lie algebra、symplectic、nilpotent 等结构术语并列。
patterns.domain: 数学论文（李代数与几何结构）

patterns.name: 表格类别标签
patterns.context: 出现在带数值和百分比的表格行中，激活集中于类别标签及其拆分词形，而非表格数值。

patterns.name: 术语前的 special way
patterns.context: 普通叙事中修饰“way”，说明两场纪念活动以某种特殊方式关联。

patterns.name: 数学术语中的 different notions
patterns.context: “different notions”用于比较 join-semilattices 上的 distributivity 概念；附近也出现“notion”“distributivity”等术语。

patterns.name: 其他数学术语激活
patterns.context: 算子应用列表中的 modular 与 quas(i)modular forms；与其他段的强触发词无明显共同局部句式。

patterns.name: 其他数学术语激活
patterns.context: 清洁性与 shellability 的类比，以及单纯复形的定义语境。
patterns.domain: 数学论文（交换代数/组合拓扑）

patterns.name: 弱而分散的数学词汇
patterns.context: 图的连通分量定义中出现；强度低于同段的“unique”。

patterns.name: 弱而分散的数学词汇
patterns.context: 与复阿贝尔簇及同态相关的数学陈述中出现。

patterns.name: 弱而分散的数学词汇
patterns.context: 曲线可能奇异，因而用其 resolution 替代的几何论述。

patterns.name: 弱而分散的数学词汇
patterns.context: 初值问题中对每个输入给出唯一解；强触发词为“unique”。

patterns.name: 弱而分散的数学词汇
patterns.context: 李代数结构及其兼容条件的陈述。

patterns.name: 弱而分散的数学词汇
patterns.context: 介绍并比较 join-semilattice 上的分配性概念。

en.concept: DOM and sporadic tokens in mathematical text
en.description: Primarily responds strongly to uppercase DOM and its object, element, and document contexts; it also activates on the word complex and on various scattered mathematical terms and formula symbols, the latter lacking a unified local pattern.

patterns.name: DOM label and frontend DOM objects
patterns.context: The uppercase abbreviation DOM appears, especially in discussion of DOM objects, elements, or documents, or in DOM identifiers in code; paragraph 4 also includes the indentation spaces immediately preceding DOM.
patterns.domain: StackExchange Q&A, templates/frontend code, PHP documentation comments

patterns.name: Adjective complex
patterns.context: complex is used as an ordinary adjective modifying abelian varieties; on another occasion it describes the DOM.

patterns.name: Expressions containing the letter M in mathematics
patterns.context: M, matrices, or related algebraic objects appear in mathematical formulas or prose; trigger positions vary, with no stable local lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Other scattered mathematical terms or markers
patterns.context: Different mathematical terms, symbols, or ordinary words activate across passages; they have no clear shared trigger substring.
patterns.domain: Algebra, graph theory, complex analysis, and mathematical typesetting text

1_1290.concept: DOM 与数学文本中的零散词符
1_1290.description: 主要对大写 DOM 及其对象、元素、文档语境强烈响应；另在 complex 一词和多种彼此分散的数学术语、公式符号中激活，后者缺少统一局部模式。

patterns.name: DOM 字样与前端 DOM 对象
patterns.context: 出现 DOM 这一大写缩写，尤其在谈论 DOM 对象、元素、文档，或代码中的 DOM 标识符时；第 4 段还包括紧邻 DOM 前的缩进空格。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答、模板/前端代码、PHP 文档注释

patterns.name: 复数形容词 complex
patterns.context: complex 作普通形容词，修饰 abelian varieties；另一次用于描述 DOM。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、StackExchange 模板示例

patterns.name: 数学中带字母 M 的表达式
patterns.context: 数学公式或行文中出现 M、矩阵或相关代数对象；触发位置各异，未见稳定的局部词法模式。

patterns.name: 其他分散的数学术语或标记
patterns.context: 各段中不同的数学术语、符号或普通词被激活；彼此没有明显共同的触发子串。
patterns.domain: 代数、图论、复分析及数学排版文本

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to arbitrary in mathematical and formal contexts, especially the use of “an arbitrary …” to introduce an arbitrary object; also covers arbitrary NP statements, arbitrary-length strings, and related variants.

patterns.name: arbitrary token activation
patterns.context: In mathematical or formal contexts, modifies an arbitrary object, element, dimension, set, or pair; the word occurs repeatedly and has the highest activation.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, math Q&A, and formal cryptography texts

patterns.name: arbitrary following an article
patterns.context: arbitrary immediately follows the indefinite article an and is followed by a mathematical object noun or quantified phrase; activation is concentrated on arbitrary.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers and StackExchange math Q&A

patterns.name: arbitrary NP statements
patterns.context: arbitrary modifies NP statements in an introduction to zero-knowledge proofs, rather than in the usual enumeration of mathematical objects.

patterns.name: arbitrary followed by long strings
patterns.context: arbitrary modifies length, describing arbitrarily long strings that may appear in a digit expansion.

1_1290.description: 主要对数学及形式化语境中的 arbitrary 强烈响应，尤其是“an arbitrary …”引出任意对象的用法；也涵盖任意 NP 语句、任意长字符串等变体。

patterns.name: arbitrary 的 token 激活
patterns.context: 在数学或形式化语境中，修饰任意对象、元素、维度、集合或配对；该词多次出现且强度最高
patterns.domain: 数学论文、数学问答及形式化密码学文本

patterns.name: 带冠词的 arbitrary
patterns.context: arbitrary 紧接不定冠词 an，后续是数学对象名词或量词短语；激活集中在 arbitrary
patterns.domain: 数学论文与 StackExchange 数学问答

patterns.name: arbitrary NP statements
patterns.context: arbitrary 修饰 NP statements，出现在零知识证明的介绍中，而不是通常的数学对象枚举

patterns.name: arbitrary 后接 long strings
patterns.context: arbitrary 修饰长度，描述数字展开中可出现的任意长字符串

en.concept: Mathematical terminology and the qualifier arbitrary
en.description: Activation patterns are dispersed: the most salient recurring cue is arbitrary qualifying an object or length in mathematical contexts; the rest are mostly specialized local phrases concerning complexes, complex abelian varieties, connected components, two-sorted algebras, cryptography, Lie algebra geometry, and congruence subgroups.

patterns.name: arbitrary as a qualifier
patterns.context: Modifies mathematical objects, choices, or parameters, such as “arbitrary spanning tree,” “arbitrary ring,” and “arbitrary integers”; it is not an independent sentence-initial use.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, primarily algebra, graph theory, group theory, and number theory

patterns.name: Terminology for complexes and algebraic properties
patterns.context: Activates when discussing simplicial complexes, shellability, and their algebraic correspondences.

patterns.name: Complex algebraic geometry terminology
patterns.context: Complex modifies abelian varieties in mathematical statements about homomorphisms and theorems.

patterns.name: Descriptions of graph connected components
patterns.context: Describes the connected components of a graph Γ and whether they are distinct or coincide.

patterns.name: two-sorted terminology
patterns.context: two combines with a hyphen and sorted to form a specialized term modifying algebras.
patterns.domain: Papers on algebraic logic or mathematical foundations

patterns.name: Keys and proofs in cryptography
patterns.context: Concerns public and private keys, signatures, and zero-knowledge proofs.

patterns.name: Complex structures and geometry terminology
patterns.context: Describes geometric structures compatible with a Lie algebra; complex is part of a mathematical term.
patterns.domain: Differential geometry and Lie algebra papers

patterns.name: Principal congruence subgroup
patterns.context: A free group is generated by matrices, and its principal congruence subgroup of level 2 is named.
patterns.domain: Group theory or number theory papers

patterns.name: Strings of arbitrary length
patterns.context: Discusses the unrestricted length of consecutive strings of 0 characters in base representations.

patterns.name: Motivic invariants and varieties
patterns.context: An abstract introduces motivic invariants of varieties over arbitrary perfect fields.

1_1290.concept: 数学术语与 arbitrary 限定词
1_1290.description: 激活模式分散：最显著的重复线索是数学语境中限定对象或长度的 arbitrary；其余多为复形、复阿贝尔簇、连通分支、two-sorted 代数、密码学、李代数几何及合同子群等局部专业短语。

patterns.name: arbitrary 作为限定词
patterns.context: 修饰数学对象、选择或参数，如 “arbitrary spanning tree”“arbitrary ring”“arbitrary integers”；不是句首独立用法。
patterns.domain: 数学论文，主要为代数、图论、群论与数论

patterns.name: 复形与代数性质术语
patterns.context: 在讨论 simplicial complex、shellability 及其代数对应关系时激活。

patterns.name: 复代数几何术语
patterns.context: complex 修饰 abelian varieties，出现在同态与定理的数学陈述中。

patterns.name: 图连通分支描述
patterns.context: 描述图 Γ 的连通分支及其互异或重合关系。

patterns.name: two-sorted 术语
patterns.context: two 与连字符及 sorted 合成专门术语，修饰 algebras。
patterns.domain: 代数逻辑或数学基础论文

patterns.name: 密码学中的密钥与证明
patterns.context: 围绕公私钥、签名和零知识证明展开。

patterns.name: 复结构与几何术语
patterns.context: 描述李代数上兼容的几何结构；complex 是数学术语的一部分。
patterns.domain: 微分几何与李代数论文

patterns.name: 主合同子群
patterns.context: 由矩阵生成自由群，并命名其 2 级主合同子群。

patterns.name: 任意长字符串
patterns.context: 讨论底数表示中连续出现的 0 字符串长度不受限。

patterns.name: 动机不变量与簇
patterns.context: 摘要中介绍任意完美域上的簇的动机不变量。

en.concept: expressions of arbitrariness in mathematical texts
en.description: The most prominent lexical cue is arbitrary, which often modifies mathematical objects, choices, inputs, or lengths; the samples also concentrate on mathematical texts containing formulas, theorems, and technical terminology. Terms and local meanings vary substantially across domains, so they cannot be reduced to one mathematical topic.

patterns.name: Arbitrariness / unspecified choice
patterns.context: The word modifies mathematical objects, choices, or lengths; it occurs in different syntactic positions and has no fixed object type.

patterns.name: General objects or universal quantification
patterns.context: Mathematical statements discuss unspecified objects, arbitrary inputs, or universally valid conditions; arbitrary may also occur in the same passage.

patterns.name: Algebraic geometry and algebraic structure terminology
patterns.context: Passages contain specialized mathematical terms, symbols, and theorem-like statements, but their specific topics vary, and not every passage has such terms.

patterns.name: Graph theory algorithm descriptions
patterns.context: Algorithm steps are described by phases, involving modifying a graph into a regular graph and selecting a spanning tree.

patterns.name: Mathematical uses of strings / long strings
patterns.context: The word string refers to digit strings in positional notation in one case, and to string topology operations on Hochschild cohomology in another; the meanings differ.
patterns.domain: Number theory and algebraic topology papers

patterns.name: PFG abbreviation definition
patterns.context: First defines a group property, then uses probability and arbitrary $k$-tuple; it shares the word arbitrary with other passages but has a specialized topic.

patterns.name: Symbolic mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: Formulas, theorem environments, and LaTeX notation are interspersed with prose; most samples are mathematical texts, but this does not explain the specific activation word.

patterns.name: Unexplained local activations
patterns.context: These words stand out locally in their respective passages but differ in meaning, so they do not support a more specific shared trigger pattern.

1_1290.concept: 数学文本中的任意性表达
1_1290.description: 最显眼的词法线索是 arbitrary，常修饰数学对象、选择、输入或长度；同时样本集中于含公式、定理及专业术语的数学文本。跨领域术语和局部词义差异较大，不能归为单一数学主题。

patterns.name: 任意性／无指定选择
patterns.trigger: “arbitrary”：如 “arbitrary varieties”“arbitrary spanning tree”“arbitrary integers”“arbitrary long strings”“an arbitrary $k$-tuple”
patterns.context: 该词用于修饰数学对象、选择或长度；出现于不同句法位置，没有固定的对象类型。

patterns.name: 一般对象或普遍量化
patterns.context: 数学陈述讨论不特定对象、任意输入或普遍成立的条件；有时同段也出现 arbitrary。

patterns.name: 代数几何与代数结构术语
patterns.context: 成段出现专业数学术语、符号和定理式表述；但具体主题各异，且并非每段都有此类术语。

patterns.name: 图论算法描述
patterns.context: 按 phases 描述算法步骤，涉及将图修改为正则图并选取生成树。

patterns.name: 字符串／长串的数学用法
patterns.context: 字符串一词分别指进位表示中的数字串和 Hochschild 上同调上的 string topology 运算，语义并不相同。

patterns.name: PFG 缩写定义
patterns.context: 先定义群的性质，再用概率和任意 $k$-tuple 表述；与其他段共享 arbitrary 一词，但主题特殊。

patterns.name: 符号化数学排版
patterns.context: 公式、定理环境、LaTeX 记号与正文交错；多数样本属于数学文本，但这不足以解释具体激活词。

patterns.name: 未解释的局部激活
patterns.context: 这些词在各段局部突出，但彼此语义不同，无法据此归为更具体的共同触发模式。

en.description: Activations center on technical structural terms and object nouns in mathematical papers, especially algebraic structures, complex structures, varieties, complexes, spaces, and their homology or operations; specific branches vary widely, with no single narrow topic evident.

patterns.name: Complex fields and complex geometric objects
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical contexts such as complex fields, complex abelian varieties, or complex vector spaces; trigger points are often near complex or C.
patterns.domain: Algebraic geometry, complex geometry, mathematical papers

patterns.name: Varieties and fields in algebraic geometry
patterns.context: Discusses varieties and their base fields, especially invariants of arbitrary varieties or varieties over perfect fields.

patterns.name: Algebraic and combinatorial commutative concepts
patterns.context: Juxtaposes algebraic properties with combinatorial structures such as simplicial complexes and shellability.

patterns.name: Lie algebra structures and complex structures
patterns.context: Discusses symplectic structures, nilpotent structures, or compatible pairs on Lie algebras.

patterns.name: Ring and algebra terminology
patterns.context: Formally describes many-sorted algebras and their base rings or scalar rings.

patterns.name: Vector spaces and invariants over the complex numbers
patterns.context: Discusses finite-group invariants and vector spaces over the complex numbers; appears in titles or introductions.

patterns.name: Coverings and vector space bases
patterns.context: Discusses holomorphic branched coverings of spheres and constructs vector spaces from isomorphism classes of coverings.

patterns.name: Homology and operation structures
patterns.context: Describes string topology operations induced by algebraic structures and Hochschild cohomology or cochain complexes.

patterns.name: Regular graphs in graph algorithms
patterns.context: An algorithm transforms a graph into a regular graph and then selects a spanning tree.

patterns.name: Derivations and operads
patterns.context: Constructs an operad structure of the derivations of the identity functor based on spaces and discusses its homology.

1_1290.description: 激活集中于数学论文中的技术性结构与对象名词，尤其是代数、复结构、簇、复形、空间及其同调或运算；各段具体分支差异很大，未见单一窄主题。

patterns.name: 复数域与复几何对象
patterns.context: 出现复数域、复阿贝尔簇或复向量空间等数学语境；触发点常邻近 complex 或 C。
patterns.domain: 代数几何、复几何、数学论文

patterns.name: 代数几何中的簇与域
patterns.context: 讨论簇及其底域，尤其是任意簇或完美域上的不变量。

patterns.name: 代数与组合交换概念
patterns.context: 将代数性质与单纯复形、可壳性等组合结构并置。

patterns.name: 李代数结构与复结构
patterns.context: 讨论李代数上的辛结构、幂零结构或兼容对。

patterns.name: 环与代数语言
patterns.context: 形式化描述多排序代数及其底环、标量环。

patterns.name: 复数上的向量空间与不变量
patterns.context: 讨论有限群不变量及复数域上的向量空间，标题或引言中出现。
patterns.domain: 不变量理论、非交换代数

patterns.name: 覆盖与向量空间基
patterns.context: 讨论球面上的全纯分支覆盖，并以覆盖的同构类构造向量空间。

patterns.name: 同调与运算结构
patterns.context: 描述代数结构诱导的弦拓扑运算及 Hochschild 上同调或上链复形。

patterns.name: 图算法中的正则图
patterns.context: 算法将图变换为正则图，再选取生成树。

patterns.name: 导子与 operad
patterns.context: 构造基于空间的恒等函子导子的 operad 结构，并讨论其同调。

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly in mathematical texts, especially algebraic geometry, category theory, and graph theory; it also covers rings and model theory, orbifold cohomology, and modular invariants. Dense mathematical notation is a cross-passage feature, but there is no single specialized topic.

patterns.name: variety in algebraic geometry
patterns.context: variety and its field, functions, or related algebraic-geometric structures occur in mathematical discussions.

patterns.name: Category and functor terminology
patterns.context: Discusses categories, functors, morphisms, and their structures or derivatives.
patterns.domain: Category theory, topology, and math Q&A; [4][5]

patterns.name: Graphs and graph connectivity
patterns.context: A graph or complex is the object of study, with discussion of connected components, morphisms, or graph algorithms.

patterns.name: Rings and algebraic structures
patterns.context: Focuses on rings, algebras, or their languages and scalar structures.

patterns.name: Orbifold cohomology and Chow groups
patterns.context: Discusses orbifold cohomology or related Chow groups as nontrivial invariants.

patterns.name: Algebraic invariants and sheaf support
patterns.context: Discusses associated prime ideals and support of modules and their correspondence with combinatorial properties.

patterns.name: First-order languages and many-sorted algebras
patterns.context: Introduces many-sorted algebras with components such as rings, along with their formal language.

patterns.name: Unexplained formal-symbol activations
patterns.context: Occurs in dense mathematical formulas and notation; may reflect general mathematical notation rather than a single concept.

1_1290.description: 激活主要集中于数学文本，尤其代数几何、范畴论和图论；也覆盖环与模型论、orbifold 上同调、模不变量等。公式符号密集是跨段特征，但缺少统一的专属主题。

patterns.name: 代数几何中的 variety
patterns.context: variety 及其域、函数或相关代数几何结构出现在数学论述中。

patterns.name: 范畴与函子术语
patterns.context: 讨论范畴、函子、态射及其结构或导数。
patterns.domain: 范畴论、拓扑与数学问答；[4][5]

patterns.name: 图与图的连通结构
patterns.context: 图或复形作为研究对象，讨论连通分支、态射或图算法。

patterns.name: 环与代数结构
patterns.context: 以环、代数或其语言和标量结构为主题。

patterns.name: orbifold 上同调与 Chow 群
patterns.context: 将 orbifold 上同调或相关 Chow 群作为非平凡不变量讨论。

patterns.name: 代数不变量与层支撑
patterns.context: 讨论模的关联素理想、支撑及其与组合性质的对应。

patterns.name: 一阶语言与排序代数
patterns.context: 介绍带有环等组成部分的多排序代数及其形式语言。

patterns.name: 未充分解释的形式符号激活
patterns.context: 数学公式和符号密集文本中出现；可能是通用数学记号而非单一概念。

en.description: Activations mainly occur in ArXiv mathematical texts: LaTeX formulas, mathematical terminology, and theorem-style exposition; topics span algebraic geometry, topology, algebra, set theory, number theory, and graph algorithms, and also include abstract formatting and descriptions of algorithmic steps.

patterns.name: Mathematical theorems and formula notation
patterns.context: Activations occur across formulas, theorem statements, and adjacent text in mathematical papers, including LaTeX symbols, variables, and mathematical terminology; content varies widely across fields.
patterns.domain: Mathematics and theoretical computer science papers

patterns.name: Algebraic geometry and topology terminology
patterns.context: Technical mathematical terms occur in abstracts or paper bodies, often adjacent to formulas and structural statements.
patterns.domain: Algebraic geometry, algebra, topology, and homological algebra

patterns.name: Theorem statements and logical connectives
patterns.context: Mathematical paper sentences organized around assumptions, conclusions, equivalences, or proof results.

patterns.name: Descriptions of graph algorithm steps
patterns.context: Describes algorithmic procedures and includes terminology for combinatorial structures such as graphs and trees.

patterns.name: Opening format of paper abstracts
patterns.context: An abstract label or opening, followed by a summary of the paper's results; this format is not shared by all snippets.

patterns.name: Strong null sets and real spaces
patterns.context: Defines or discusses sets of real numbers and their measure properties.

patterns.name: Asymptotic expressions in number theory
patterns.context: Involves formulas or statements about ranges of moduli, primes, and asymptotic estimates.

patterns.name: Symbol fragments adjacent to variables and numbers
patterns.context: Formula-like numbers or variables occur between a hyphen and regular, within a graph transformation description; this may be an independent local formatting cue.

1_1290.concept: 数学论文中的形式化论述
1_1290.description: 激活主要落在 ArXiv 数学文本：LaTeX 公式、数学术语与定理式论述；覆盖代数几何、拓扑、代数、集合论、数论和图算法，也出现摘要格式与算法步骤描述。

patterns.name: 数学定理与公式符号
patterns.context: 激活分布在数学论文中的公式、定理陈述及其邻近文本，含 LaTeX 符号、变量和数学术语；不同领域内容差异很大。
patterns.domain: 数学与理论计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 代数几何与拓扑相关术语
patterns.context: 数学专业术语出现在摘要或论文正文中，常与公式和结构性陈述相邻。
patterns.domain: 代数几何、代数、拓扑及同调代数

patterns.name: 定理陈述与逻辑连接语
patterns.context: 以假设、结论、等价关系或证明结果组织的数学论文句子。

patterns.name: 图算法步骤描述
patterns.context: 描述算法操作流程，并出现图、树等组合结构术语。

patterns.name: 论文摘要开头格式
patterns.context: 摘要标记或摘要开篇，随后概述论文结果；此格式本身并非所有片段共有。

patterns.name: 强零测集与实数空间
patterns.context: 定义或讨论实数集及其测度性质。

patterns.name: 数论渐近表达
patterns.context: 涉及模数范围、素数及渐近估计的公式或陈述。

patterns.name: 变量与数字邻接的符号片段
patterns.context: 公式化的数字/变量夹在连字符与 regular 之间，位于图变换描述中；可能是独立的局部格式线索。

en.description: Activation is concentrated in mathematical texts, especially formal definitions and structural statements: rings and ideals, operator-algebra structures, sets and families of sets; it also covers removable singularities in complex analysis and abelian varieties and homology in algebraic geometry.

patterns.name: Ideals, rings, and commutative algebra
patterns.context: Discusses rings, ideals, algebras, and their operations or classification; includes specific contexts such as algebras over finite groups and intersections of finitely many principal ideals.
patterns.domain: Abstract algebra, commutative algebra papers, and math Q&A

patterns.name: Operators and algebraic structures
patterns.context: Constructs or describes algebraic/operator structures in the context of homology, chain complexes, or derivatives of spaces.
patterns.domain: Homotopy theory, algebraic topology, and mathematics papers

patterns.name: Sets and families of sets
patterns.context: Formally defines or studies sets, families of sets, and their relations; objects may be subsets of the real numbers or families of subsets of a finite set.
patterns.domain: Set theory, real analysis, combinatorics papers

patterns.name: Local analytic properties in complex analysis
patterns.context: Discusses bounded functions, removable singularities, and analytic continuation near a point.

patterns.name: Jacobians and homology in algebraic geometry
patterns.context: Treats curve-related objects as complex abelian varieties and studies their rational homology.

1_1290.concept: 形式化数学结构与定义
1_1290.description: 激活集中于数学文本，尤偏形式化定义与结构陈述：环和理想、运算子代数结构、集合及集合族；另覆盖复分析的可去奇点，以及代数几何中的阿贝尔簇与同调。

patterns.name: 理想、环与交换代数
patterns.context: 讨论环、理想、代数及其运算或分类；包含有限群上的代数和有限个主理想的交等具体语境。
patterns.domain: 抽象代数、交换代数数学论文及数学问答

patterns.name: 运算子与代数结构
patterns.context: 在同调、链复形或空间导数的背景下构造或描述代数/运算子结构。
patterns.domain: 同伦论、代数拓扑及数学论文

patterns.name: 集合与集合族
patterns.trigger: “measure zero set”“sets”“symmetric difference”“family of all subsets”“set system”
patterns.context: 形式化定义或研究集合、集合族及其关系；对象可以是实数集中的集合，也可以是有限集的子集族。
patterns.domain: 集合论、实分析、组合数学论文

patterns.name: 复分析中的局部解析性质
patterns.context: 围绕一点讨论函数有界、可去奇点及延拓解析性。

patterns.name: 代数几何中的雅可比簇与同调
patterns.context: 将曲线相关对象视为复阿贝尔簇，并考察其有理同调。

en.concept: Set and structural statements about mathematical objects
en.description: Activations center on mathematical texts, with a particular emphasis on union or disjoint-union statements describing objects as composed of several parts; they also cover homology groups, and algebraic terms such as groups and ideals, as well as various geometric and topological objects. Some relational words also activate weakly and sporadically.

patterns.name: Union and decomposition
patterns.context: Sets, spaces, or objects are described as unions of several parts, often in constructions such as “is a union of” or “disjoint union of pieces/copies”; no specific mathematical branch is required.

patterns.name: Homology groups and their objects
patterns.context: The phrase homology group(s) appears in discussions of the homology of topological or algebraic-geometric objects.

patterns.name: Groups and ideals in algebraic structures
patterns.context: Discusses groups, subgroups, or ideals in rings and their algebraic properties; trigger positions are dispersed across related terms rather than forming a fixed phrase.
patterns.domain: Abstract algebra, representation theory, and related mathematics

patterns.name: Partitioning or combining other mathematical objects
patterns.context: Activations occur on object names and combinatorial statements in descriptions of specialized mathematical objects or spaces, without the more specific phrase triggers above.

patterns.name: Relational vocabulary in mathematical exposition
patterns.context: Relational words concerning definitions, existence, constructions, or derivations activate sporadically in formal mathematical statements; these words also occur in many non-activating positions, so the pattern is unstable.

1_1290.concept: 数学对象的集合与结构陈述
1_1290.description: 激活集中于数学文本，较突出的是对象由若干部分构成的并集/不交并陈述；也覆盖同调群、群与理想等代数术语，以及多种几何拓扑对象。若干关系词也有弱而分散的激活。

patterns.name: 并集与分解
patterns.context: 集合、空间或对象被描述为若干部分的并，常见于“is a union of”“disjoint union of pieces/copies”等构造；并不要求特定数学分支。

patterns.name: 同调群及其对象
patterns.context: 出现 homology 与 group(s) 的搭配，讨论拓扑或代数几何对象的同调。

patterns.name: 代数结构中的群/理想
patterns.context: 讨论群、子群或环中的理想及其代数性质；触发位置分散于相关术语，而非统一固定词组。
patterns.domain: 抽象代数、表示论及相关数学

patterns.name: 其他数学对象的分块或组合
patterns.context: 专门数学对象或空间的描述中，激活落在对象名称及组合性陈述上，但未见上述更具体的词组触发。

patterns.name: 数学叙述中的关系性词汇
patterns.context: 形式化数学陈述中，围绕定义、存在性、构造或推导的关系词出现零散激活；这些词本身也出现在许多非激活位置，规律不稳定。

en.concept: unions and disjoint unions in mathematics
en.description: The most stable trigger is union in mathematical contexts, especially “union of” or “disjoint union,” used to decompose sets, spaces, orbit attractors, and other objects; there are also responses to operad terminology and scattered mathematical vocabulary.

patterns.name: union phrases
patterns.context: Describes sets, objects, or spaces in mathematical texts as consisting of subsets or parts; no specific field is required. Passages 2, 3, 5, 8, and 10 contain explicit union, and passage 4 also contains union but it is unmarked.

patterns.name: Operator algebras and derivatives
patterns.context: Discusses operad structures and their applications in topology, homology, or algebra; the token fragment «oper» in operad is strongly marked.

patterns.name: Subgroups and normal subgroups
patterns.context: Asks or states in group theory whether a subgroup can be expressed as a union of normal subgroups.

patterns.name: Quotients and decompositions in topological constructions
patterns.context: Constructs a classifying space or related topological object from a disjoint union of pieces; «union» also occurs.

patterns.name: Covers and partitions
patterns.context: A sequence of subsets covers a set X and satisfies a given condition on a sequence of positive numbers; union itself is unmarked.

patterns.name: Decomposition of lattice lines
patterns.context: Describes an infinite line in a lattice and its decomposition into several copies; union is strongly marked.

patterns.name: Algebraic closures in algebraic geometry
patterns.context: States the algebraic closure of a field, followed by discussion of abelian varieties and their homology; no clear connection to the main union pattern.

patterns.name: Orbit attractors composed of intervals
patterns.context: In dynamical systems, describes a point's orbit approaching an attractor composed of finitely many closed intervals.

patterns.name: Singular sets of orbifolds
patterns.context: Describes an orbifold whose underlying space is a four-dimensional torus, with its singular set composed of several parts.

patterns.name: Sporadic responses to advanced mathematical terms or entities
patterns.context: These markers occur in different mathematical topics and lack stable shared local semantics; they may reflect a weak response to mathematical text or terminology.

1_1290.description: 最稳定的触发是数学语境中的 union，尤其是“union of”或“disjoint union”，用于集合、空间、轨道吸引子等的分解；另有 operad 术语及若干分散数学词汇响应。

patterns.name: union 短语
patterns.context: 在数学文本中描述集合、对象或空间由若干子集/部分组成；不要求特定领域。段 2、3、5、8、10 中有明确的 union，段 4 中也出现 union，但未标记。

patterns.name: 运算子代数与导数
patterns.context: 谈论 operad 结构及其在拓扑、同调或代数中的应用；operad 的分词片段 «oper» 被强烈标记。
patterns.domain: 代数拓扑、同调代数论文

patterns.name: 子群与正规子群
patterns.context: 群论中询问或陈述子群能否表示为正规子群的并。

patterns.name: 拓扑构造中的商与分块
patterns.context: 以不交并的分块构造分类空间或相关拓扑对象；同时出现 «union»。

patterns.name: 覆盖与划分
patterns.context: 用一列子集覆盖集合 X，并满足给定正数序列条件；union 本身未标记。

patterns.name: 格点线的分解
patterns.trigger: “a disjoint union of copies of T”
patterns.context: 描述格点中的无限线及其分解为若干副本；union 被强烈标记。

patterns.name: 代数几何中的代数闭包
patterns.trigger: «closure»，并有 “algebraic closure of K in C”
patterns.context: 说明域的代数闭包，后续讨论阿贝尔簇及其同调；与 union 主模式无明显联系。

patterns.name: 轨道吸引子由区间组成
patterns.trigger: “a disjoint union of a finite number of closed intervals”
patterns.context: 动力系统中描述点的轨道趋向吸引子，吸引子由有限个闭区间组成。

patterns.name: 轨形空间的奇异集
patterns.context: 描述底空间为四维环面的轨形空间，其奇异集由若干部分构成。

patterns.name: 高阶数学术语或实体的零散响应
patterns.context: 这些标记分别出现在不同数学主题中，缺乏稳定的共同局部语义；可能是弱的数学文本或术语响应。

en.description: Activations center on mathematical texts: structural terminology for groups, sets, graphs, and algebraic, geometric, or categorical objects; they also respond to proof and result phrasing in paper abstracts and mathematical statements interspersed with LaTeX notation. The topics are not identical across snippets.

patterns.name: Mathematical structures and group-theoretic relations
patterns.context: Discusses groups, subgroups, the composition of sets, or their properties, often in definitions, proofs, or questions; occurs across topics such as group actions, group representations, and combinatorial structures.
patterns.domain: Abstract mathematics, group theory, and StackExchange mathematics Q&A

patterns.name: Mathematical exposition of algebraic and geometric objects
patterns.context: States relations or properties between objects and structures in mathematical papers or Q&A; trigger terms include algebra, topology, and category theory.
patterns.domain: Mathematical paper abstracts and mathematics Q&A

patterns.name: Graphs and graph-related relations
patterns.context: Directly discusses trees or graphs, or treats objects in a set as graph vertices; some passages also involve groups or category theory.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, especially graph theory and related structures

patterns.name: Proof and conclusion phrasing in mathematical paper abstracts
patterns.context: Introduces a paper in an abstract by proving, demonstrating, or presenting results; not all passages use this format.

patterns.name: Special symbols and formal mathematical notation
patterns.context: LaTeX mathematical notation appears in or around mathematical prose and formulas; the symbols themselves vary across snippets.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, formulas, and mathematics Q&A

1_1290.description: 激活集中于数学文本：群、集合、图及代数、几何、范畴等结构术语；也响应论文摘要中的证明与结果措辞，以及夹杂 LaTeX 记号的数学表述。各段主题并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 数学结构与群论关系
patterns.context: 讨论群、子群、集合的构成或性质，常见于定义、证明或提问中；出现于群作用、群表示和组合结构等不同主题。
patterns.domain: 抽象数学、群论及 StackExchange 数学问答

patterns.name: 代数与几何对象的数学表述
patterns.context: 在数学论文或问答中陈述对象、结构之间的关系或性质；触发词包括代数、拓扑、范畴论等术语。
patterns.domain: 数学论文摘要及数学问答

patterns.name: 图与图相关关系
patterns.context: 直接讨论树或图，或将集合中的对象作为图的顶点；有的段落也同时涉及群或范畴论。
patterns.domain: 数学，尤其图论及相关结构

patterns.name: 数学论文摘要的证明与结论措辞
patterns.context: 摘要中以证明、展示或给出结果的方式介绍论文；并非所有段落都有此格式。

patterns.name: 特殊符号与形式化数学记号
patterns.context: 数学正文或公式周围出现 LaTeX 数学记号，与自然语言术语交错；符号本身在不同段落中并不固定。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、公式及数学问答

en.concept: Words and union expressions in mathematical contexts
en.description: Occurs primarily in mathematical texts, especially near unions, algebraic objects, mathematical relations, or technical terms; it also activates on articles, symbols, and terms with no obvious connection to one another. The topics span a wide range and cannot be explained by a single semantic condition.

patterns.name: Set union
patterns.context: “union” and adjacent words are marked, commonly when mathematical objects are represented as unions of several subsets or parts; the specific objects differ across examples.

patterns.name: Algebraic structures and object definitions
patterns.context: Activations fall on terms for abstract algebraic objects, their structures, or properties; not all such terms activate, and activation strength varies.
patterns.domain: Abstract mathematics, especially algebra and related fields

patterns.name: Relational or assertive wording in mathematical papers
patterns.context: These words occur in sentences about mathematical definitions, theorems, proofs, or relations between objects; they are not stable triggers in isolation.
patterns.domain: Mathematical paper abstracts, main text, and StackExchange Q&A

patterns.name: Nominalized mathematical terms
patterns.context: Technical terms or words describing mathematical properties are sometimes marked, but the topics span a wide range and show no unified, specific semantic condition.

patterns.name: English indefinite article
patterns.context: Articles occasionally activate in mathematical English sentences, such as “a sequence,” “a proof,” and “a subgroup”; they occur broadly and are insufficient to explain the examples on their own.

patterns.name: Several ungrouped mathematical term activations
patterns.context: Activations hit terms or their subword fragments across different mathematical topics, with no shared domain-specific trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Mathematical paper main text or abstract

patterns.name: Local symbols and notation
patterns.context: Letters, operators, or notation in formulas are marked, but the symbols refer to different objects in different passages and may co-occur with the surrounding mathematical discussion.

1_1290.concept: 数学语境中的词与并集表达
1_1290.description: 主要出现在数学文本中，尤其并集及代数对象、数学关系或专业术语附近；也会命中冠词、符号和彼此无明显联系的术语。多种主题跨度大，不能用单一语义条件解释。

patterns.name: 集合的并集
patterns.context: “union”及其相邻词被标记，常见于数学对象被表示为若干子集或部分的并；各例具体对象不同。

patterns.name: 代数结构与对象定义
patterns.trigger: « ring»7、« algebra»7、« subgroup»7、« group»7、« ideals»5、« variety»10
patterns.context: 激活落在抽象代数对象、其结构或性质的术语上；并非所有此类术语都激活，且强度分布不一。
patterns.domain: 抽象数学，尤其代数及相关领域

patterns.name: 数学论文中的关系或断言用语
patterns.context: 这些词出现在数学定义、定理、证明或对象间关系的句子里；单独看并非稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: 数学论文摘要、正文和 StackExchange 问答

patterns.name: 数学名词化术语
patterns.trigger: « positive»、« characteristic»、« reduct»、« equivalence»、« derivatives»、« homology»
patterns.context: 专业术语或描述数学性质的词语有时被标记，但所涉主题跨度很大，未显示统一的具体语义条件。

patterns.name: 英文不定冠词
patterns.context: 冠词在数学英语句子中偶有激活，如“a sequence”“a proof”“a subgroup”；出现广泛，不足以单独解释各例。

patterns.name: 若干未归并的数学术语激活
patterns.context: 激活命中不同数学主题中的术语或其分词片段，缺少共同的领域内触发条件。

patterns.name: 局部符号与记号
patterns.context: 公式中的字母、算子或记号被标记，但各段符号所指对象不同，可能与所在的数学论述共同出现。

en.concept: Formal exposition in mathematical academic texts
en.description: The most stable shared context for activations is mathematical academic text: the boundary between formulas and prose, formal definition language, and mathematical paper style. Topics span algebra, graph theory, topology, geometry, representation theory, and set theory, with no single topic accounting for all snippets.

patterns.name: Dollar signs near mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Activations cluster at the boundary between mathematical formulas or symbolic expressions and prose; no specific formula content is required.

patterns.name: Formal mathematical introductory language
patterns.context: These words occur in formal definitions and arguments about mathematical objects, sets, groups, rings, ideals, or properties; individually they are common words, but the snippets as a whole contain dense mathematical notation.

patterns.name: Abstract algebra and ring theory terminology
patterns.context: Terminology appears in definitions or discussions of rings, ideals, groups, and algebraic structures.
patterns.domain: Abstract algebra, algebra, and group theory

patterns.name: Graph theory structures and properties
patterns.context: Concerns graphs, vertex sets, and their properties; two snippets separately address graph definitions and graph-theoretic properties.
patterns.domain: Graph theory papers and mathematics Q&A

patterns.name: Algebraic topology and Goodwillie derivatives
patterns.context: Discusses the derivatives of the identity functor on based spaces and structures on their homology.

patterns.name: Abelian varieties and homology in algebraic geometry
patterns.context: Moves from the algebraic closure of a field to the Jacobian of a curve and its rational homology.

patterns.name: Cohen–Macaulay property in combinatorial commutative algebra
patterns.context: Discusses Cohen–Macaulay properties of rings or modules related to simplicial complexes.

patterns.name: Weyl representations in representation theory
patterns.context: States properties of symplectic group representations associated with finite abelian groups of odd order and their multiplicities.

patterns.name: Fubini property in set theory and measure theory
patterns.context: Discusses ideals satisfying the Fubini property and gives the ideal of null sets as an example.

patterns.name: Mathematical paper abstracts or formal academic style
patterns.context: Abstracts or paper bodies formally summarize research objects, results, and extensions; this stylistic pattern spans multiple topics.

1_1290.concept: 数学学术文本中的形式化表述
1_1290.description: 激活集中最稳定的共同背景是数学学术文本：公式符号与正文交界、形式化定义用语及数学论文文体。其下分布于代数、图论、拓扑、几何、表示论和集合论等多个具体主题，未见单一主题能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 数学表达式附近的美元符号
patterns.context: 激活集中出现于数学公式或符号表达式与正文交界处；未必需要特定公式内容

patterns.name: 形式化数学引入语
patterns.trigger: “Let”、“be”、“is”、“and”等数学定义或陈述中的常见词
patterns.context: 这些词位于数学对象、集合、群、环、理想或性质的形式化定义与论证中；单独看是常见词，但片段整体有密集数学记号
patterns.domain: 数学论文、StackExchange 数学问答

patterns.name: 抽象代数与环论术语
patterns.context: 术语出现在环、理想、群及代数结构的定义或论述中

patterns.name: 图论结构与性质
patterns.context: 围绕图、顶点集及其性质展开；两个片段分别涉及图的定义和图论性质

patterns.name: 代数拓扑与 Goodwillie 导数
patterns.context: 讨论基点空间上恒等函子的导数及其同调上的结构

patterns.name: 代数几何中的阿贝尔簇与同调
patterns.trigger: “algebraic closure”、“complex abelian variety”、“first rational homology group”
patterns.context: 由域的代数闭包转入曲线雅可比及其有理同调

patterns.name: 组合交换代数中的 Cohen–Macaulay 性
patterns.context: 讨论单纯复形相关的环或模的 Cohen–Macaulay 性质

patterns.name: 表示论中的 Weyl 表示
patterns.context: 陈述有限奇阶阿贝尔群关联的辛群表示及其重数性质

patterns.name: 集合论与测度论中的 Fubini 性质
patterns.context: 讨论满足 Fubini 性质的理想，并以零测集理想为例

patterns.name: 数学论文摘要或正式学术文体
patterns.trigger: “abstract:”、“In this paper we show”、“We also extend”、“is shown”
patterns.context: 摘要或论文正文以正式方式概述研究对象、结果与扩展；该文体模式跨越多个主题

en.description: Responds to the introduction of objects and properties, condition checks, universal quantifiers, and technical terms in mathematical text; it also involves constructions, decompositions, and transitions to conclusions. It spans algebra, topology, logic, and graph theory, with no evident single branch.

patterns.name: Defining or specifying a mathematical object
patterns.context: In definition sentences introducing objects, assumptions, notation, or properties, especially at the beginning of a sentence or clause
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers and mathematical Q&A, including algebra, topology, logic, and graph theory

patterns.name: Statements of mathematical relations and criteria
patterns.context: When stating theorem conditions, property checks, equivalences, or general conclusions; often accompanied by formulas and mathematical symbols

patterns.name: Technical mathematical terms and compound terms
patterns.context: Specialized terms in mathematics, typically embedded in definitions or statements; not limited to a particular mathematical branch

patterns.name: Descriptions of structures, decompositions, and constructions
