patterns.context: When explaining how an object is constructed, decomposed, or related to another object

patterns.name: Quantifiers and set conditions
patterns.context: When using universal quantifiers, arbitrary objects, or set conditions to define properties or express propositions

patterns.name: Transitions and explanations in mathematical paragraphs
patterns.context: When following up on a previous conclusion, giving a special case, emphasizing a property, or explaining an analogy

1_1290.description: 响应数学文本中引入对象与性质、条件判定、全称量词和专业术语；也涉及构造分解及结论衔接。跨代数、拓扑、逻辑和图论，无明显单一分支。

patterns.name: 定义或设定数学对象
patterns.context: 在引入对象、假设、记号或性质的定义句中，尤其是句首或从句开头
patterns.domain: 数学论文与数学问答，涉及代数、拓扑、逻辑、图论等

patterns.name: 数学关系与判定表述
patterns.trigger: “is not true in general”, “if … then”, “iff”, “is … equivalent”, “if for every”
patterns.context: 陈述定理条件、性质判定、等价关系或一般性结论时；常伴随公式和数学符号

patterns.name: 专业数学术语及复合术语
patterns.context: 数学领域专门名词出现时，通常嵌在定义或陈述中；并非只限某个数学分支

patterns.name: 结构、分解与构造描述
patterns.context: 说明对象如何构造、分解或由一个对象联系到另一个对象时

patterns.name: 量词与集合条件
patterns.context: 用全称量词、任意对象或集合条件来定义性质或表达命题时

patterns.name: 数学段落中的衔接与说明
patterns.context: 承接前述结论，给出特例、强调性质或类比说明时

en.description: Activations occur primarily in mathematical scholarly text, especially when introducing or describing algebraic objects such as rings and groups; they also appear in definitions of graphs and vertices, and in formal conditional sentences and technical terms across multiple fields.

patterns.name: Definitions of objects in rings and algebraic structures
patterns.context: In mathematical papers or Q&A, algebraic objects are introduced in background statements or definitions, especially with ring and its modifiers; triggers often fall on ring or adjacent structural nouns.
patterns.domain: Abstract algebra, commutative algebra, and related mathematical texts

patterns.name: group in mathematical terminology
patterns.context: A group appears as a mathematical object or group structure in research statements; no particular surrounding word order is required, including contexts involving algebraic and topological groups.
patterns.domain: Group theory, representation theory, and algebraic geometry

patterns.name: Graphs and vertices in titles or definitions
patterns.context: A combinatorial structure is defined using a graph and its vertex set; activations in this passage cluster around graph, vertex, and adjacent context.

patterns.name: Formal definitions or existence statements of mathematical concepts
patterns.context: Uses common paper-style definition, assumption, or conditional sentences to introduce objects or state properties; these forms may trigger alongside algebraic object words, and it is uncertain whether they constitute an independent pattern.

patterns.name: Formulaic term fragments in mathematical scholarly text
patterns.context: Paper-style exposition interweaves dense technical terms and mathematical symbols; some fragments have no clearly shared object word or sentence form.
patterns.domain: Mathematical fields including homotopy theory, number theory, combinatorics, and logic

1_1290.description: 激活主要出现在数学学术文本，尤其是引入或描述环、群等代数对象时；另见图与顶点的定义，以及多领域论文中的正式条件句和专业术语。

patterns.name: 环与代数结构中的对象定义
patterns.trigger: “Let $G$ be a finite group and $R$ be a commutative ring”；“ideals of a commutative ring with identity”；以及 “division ring”“endomorphism ring”“Cohen-Macaulay ring”
patterns.context: 数学论文或问答中，在背景陈述或定义里引入代数对象，尤其出现 ring 及其限定词；触发常落在 ring 或相邻的结构名词上。
patterns.domain: 抽象代数、交换代数及相关数学文本

patterns.name: 数学术语中的 group
patterns.context: 群作为数学对象或群结构出现在研究陈述中；不要求特定的前后词序，也包括代数群与拓扑群语境。
patterns.domain: 群论、表示论及代数几何

patterns.name: 标题或定义中的图与顶点
patterns.context: 以图及其顶点集定义组合结构；本段激活集中在 graph、vertex 及其相邻上下文。

patterns.name: 数学概念的正式定义或存在性陈述
patterns.context: 采用论文常见的定义、假设或条件句式，介绍对象或给出性质；这些句式本身可能与代数对象词共同触发，是否独立规律不确定。

patterns.name: 数学学术文本中的公式化术语片段
patterns.context: 高密度专业术语与数学符号交织的论文叙述；部分片段没有明确共享的对象词或句式。
patterns.domain: 同伦论、数论、组合学及逻辑等数学领域

en.description: Activations center on mathematical texts, especially the introduction of objects or notation, rings and ideals, groups and their structures; they also cover graph-theoretic properties, higher homological structures, definitions of topological and Borel notation, and abstract-style conclusions. Formula boundary markers also commonly activate.

patterns.name: Algebraic statements about rings and ideals
patterns.context: Mathematical text uses definitions, assumptions, or formulas to describe rings, ideals, endomorphism rings, and other algebraic objects; triggers often fall on object names and nearby definitional language.
patterns.domain: Commutative algebra, algebraic geometry, and abstract algebra papers or Q&A

patterns.name: Group-theoretic objects and group actions
patterns.context: When discussing finite groups, group representations, group actions, or subgroup structure, activations occur near groups and related classification terms.
patterns.domain: Group theory and representation theory papers

patterns.name: Definitional introduction of mathematical objects
patterns.context: Introduces objects, specifies notation, or explains symbols using Let, By, or similar expressions; not restricted to a single mathematical field.
patterns.domain: Definitions and notation in mathematical papers and mathematics Q&A

patterns.name: Properties and quantifier conditions in graph theory
patterns.context: Defines graph conditions using indexed property symbols and quantifies over the vertex set.

patterns.name: Higher structures and homological objects
patterns.context: Describes algebraic structures on derived objects and their homology; terminology centers on structures, derivations, and homology groups.
patterns.domain: Algebraic topology and homotopy theory papers

patterns.name: Notation for topological spaces and their measurable structures
patterns.context: First specifies a space, then defines its topology or a family of sets such as its Borel σ-algebra.
patterns.domain: Descriptive set theory and topology papers

patterns.name: Correspondences between group theory and algebraic structures
patterns.context: Derives a near-field or other algebraic structure from the action or transitivity conditions of a specific group, and states its defining properties.
patterns.domain: Finite group and algebraic structure theory papers

patterns.name: Abstract-style statements of research results
patterns.context: In an abstract or paper statement, briefly reports the research object, result, or proof conclusion; activations may also fall on technical terms in the sentence.

patterns.name: Markers near symbols and formula boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur near variables, formulas, or LaTeX symbol boundaries in mathematical typesetting; some strong activations fall directly on dollar-sign markers and may relate to formula tokenization or marker position.

patterns.name: Finiteness and order conditions for finite groups
patterns.context: Discusses group finiteness, group order, or odd-prime conditions; overlaps with the group theory pattern, but conditions such as odd order are prominent in several passages.
patterns.domain: Finite group theory and representation theory

1_1290.description: 激活集中于数学文本，尤其是对象或记号的引入、环与理想、群及其结构；也覆盖图论性质、高阶同调结构、拓扑与Borel记号定义，以及摘要式结论。公式边界标记亦常激活。

patterns.name: 环与理想的代数陈述
patterns.context: 数学文本中以定义、假设或公式描述环、理想、端同态环等代数对象；触发常落在对象名称及其邻近定义语句上。
patterns.domain: 交换代数、代数几何与抽象代数论文或问答

patterns.name: 群论对象与群作用
patterns.context: 讨论有限群、群表示、群作用或群的子群结构时，群及其相关分类术语附近激活。

patterns.name: 数学对象的定义式引入
patterns.trigger: “Let $G$ be”“Let $I$ and $J$ be”“By … we denote”“stands for the identity”
patterns.context: 以 Let、By 或类似表达引入对象、给出符号约定或解释记号；不局限于单一数学领域。
patterns.domain: 数学论文与数学问答中的定义、记号说明

patterns.name: 图论中的性质与量词条件
patterns.context: 通过带下标的性质符号定义图的条件，并对顶点集量化。

patterns.name: 高阶结构与同调对象
patterns.context: 描述导出对象上的代数结构及其同调，术语集中于结构、导子和同调群。
patterns.domain: 代数拓扑与同伦论论文

patterns.name: 拓扑空间及其可测结构的记号定义
patterns.context: 先指定空间，再定义其拓扑或 Borel σ-代数等集合族记号。
patterns.domain: 描述集合论与拓扑论文

patterns.name: 群论与代数结构之间的对应
patterns.trigger: “tame, algebraic structure theory”“associate a near field”“division ring”
patterns.context: 从特定群的作用或传递性条件导出近域等代数结构，并说明其定义性质。
patterns.domain: 有限群与代数结构理论论文

patterns.name: 摘要式研究结论表述
patterns.trigger: “abstract:”“In this paper, we show”“is shown to”
patterns.context: 摘要或论文陈述中，以简短句式报告研究对象、结果或证明结论；激活也可能落在该句中的专业名词。

patterns.name: 符号与公式边界附近的标记
patterns.context: 数学排版中变量、公式或 LaTeX 符号边界附近出现激活；部分强激活直接落在标记的美元符号上，可能与公式分词或标记位置有关。

patterns.name: 有限群的有限性与阶条件
patterns.trigger: “finite group”“finite abelian group”“odd order”“odd prime number”
patterns.context: 讨论群有限性、群阶或奇素数条件；与群论模式重合，但奇数阶等条件在若干段中显著出现。

en.description: Activations cluster in formal algebraic structures and their properties in mathematical text, especially groups, rings, graphs, spaces, and homological objects; they often occur near term definitions, classification statements, or structural relations. The domain spans widely, with no single narrow topic evident.

patterns.name: Group algebra and representation theory
patterns.context: Near group names and group-theoretic conditions in mathematical papers on groups, group actions, or group classification; also includes the homological structure of Lie operads and their derivatives.
patterns.domain: Algebra, representation theory, and homotopy theory papers

patterns.name: Homology and algebraic varieties
patterns.context: Introduces the rational homology group of an algebraic curve or complex algebraic-geometric object.

patterns.name: Definitions of descriptive set theory terms
patterns.context: Formally defines topological spaces, σ-algebras, and Borel sets, commonly in preliminaries or notation sections of mathematical papers.

patterns.name: Ring theory and elementary equivalence
patterns.context: States elementary equivalence of rings and algebraic characterizations in an abstract.
patterns.domain: Model theory and ring theory paper abstracts

patterns.name: Graph properties and vertex sets
patterns.context: Defines a property satisfied by a graph and uses disjoint vertex sets as quantified objects.

patterns.name: Graph definitions in geometric graph theory
patterns.context: Constructs a graph from a set of line segments in Euclidean space and specifies its vertex set.

patterns.name: Ideal and commutative ring equations
patterns.context: Discusses whether equations involving ideals, their powers, and intersections hold in a commutative ring with identity.

1_1290.description: 激活集中于数学文本中的形式化代数结构及其性质：尤其群、环、图、空间和同调对象；常出现在术语定义、分类陈述或结构关系附近。领域跨度较大，未见单一窄主题。

patterns.name: 群的代数与表示论
patterns.trigger: “symplectic group”“finite abelian group”“odd order”“simple groups”“alternating group”“Abels-Margulis-Soifer groups”
patterns.context: 群、群作用或群分类的数学论文中，群名和群论条件附近；也包括 Lie operad 及其导数的同调结构。
patterns.domain: 代数、表示论、同伦论论文

patterns.name: 同调与代数簇
patterns.context: 由代数曲线或复代数几何对象引出其有理同调群。

patterns.name: 描述集合论术语定义
patterns.context: 形式化定义拓扑空间、σ-域及 Borel 集，常见于数学论文的预备知识或记号说明。

patterns.name: 环论与初等等价
patterns.trigger: “algebraic characterization”“elementary equivalence”“rings”“finitely generated additive group”“pure rings”
patterns.context: 摘要中陈述环的初等等价及代数刻画。

patterns.name: 图论性质与顶点集
patterns.context: 定义图所满足的性质，并以不相交顶点集作为量化对象。

patterns.name: 几何图论的图定义
patterns.context: 把欧氏空间中的线段集构造成图，并说明顶点集。

patterns.name: 理想与交换环等式
patterns.context: 在交换含幺环中讨论理想及其幂、交等式是否成立。

en.description: Activations cluster in mathematical corpora: sets and their properties, algebraic structures, and objects recur, often in definitions, propositions, or proofs and alongside LaTeX formula markers; they span multiple mathematical branches, with no single specialized topic evident.

patterns.name: Sets and graph-theoretic objects
patterns.context: Discusses definitions, properties, constructions, and examples of sets, subsets, vertex sets, ideals, or topological sets; formulas and natural language sometimes alternate.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers and mathematical Q&A, especially set theory, graph theory, topology, and functional analysis

patterns.name: Algebraic structures and objects
patterns.context: Introduces algebraic objects, structures, homomorphisms, or classifications in mathematical text, often alongside symbolic formulas and theorem statements.
patterns.domain: Abstract algebra, algebraic topology, and algebraic geometry papers, and algebra Q&A

patterns.name: Connectives introducing and linking mathematical propositions/tasks
patterns.context: Defines objects, poses questions, or connects proof steps; usually adjacent to formulas or mathematical terms, but not sufficient on its own to explain all activations.
patterns.domain: Mathematical paper abstracts, main text, and StackExchange Q&A

patterns.name: Activation concentrated on particular mathematical words and symbol boundaries
patterns.context: Object names such as set, group, and ring, along with nearby formula markers, stand out in passages dense with mathematical formulas or terms; the specific trigger is not always the same word.

1_1290.description: 激活集中于数学语料：集合及其性质、代数结构与对象反复出现，常处在定义、命题或证明语境，并伴随 LaTeX 公式标记；跨越多个数学分支，未见单一专门主题。

patterns.name: 集合与图论对象
patterns.trigger: “partition poset models”“disjoint vertex sets”“two sets”“sets”“ideal”“open/closed sets”“meager sets”
patterns.context: 讨论集合、子集、顶点集、理想或拓扑集合的定义、性质、构造与例子；有时公式与自然语言交替
patterns.domain: 数学论文与数学问答，尤其集合论、图论、拓扑与泛函分析

patterns.name: 代数结构与代数对象
patterns.trigger: “operad structure”“Lie operad structure”“commutative ring”“ideals”“simple groups”“algebraic closure”“abelian variety”
patterns.context: 数学文本中介绍代数对象、结构、同态或分类，常伴随符号公式和定理陈述
patterns.domain: 抽象代数、代数拓扑、代数几何论文及代数问答

patterns.name: 数学命题/任务的引入与论证连接词
patterns.trigger: “Let”“Then”“We also extend”“Show that there is”“We show that”“one may view”
patterns.context: 定义对象、提出问题或连接证明步骤；通常紧邻公式或数学术语，但单独并不足以解释全部激活
patterns.domain: 数学论文摘要、正文与 StackExchange 问答

patterns.name: 强度集中于特定数学词及符号边界
patterns.trigger: “groups”后续激活 10；“vertex sets”中的“sets”激活 9；“ring”激活 9；以及反复被标记的“$”“{”“}”“\”
patterns.context: 数学公式或术语密集段落中，集合、群、环等对象名及其周围的公式标记尤为突出；具体触发并非总是同一词

en.description: Primarily responds to formal structures and technical terms in mathematical corpora: operads, rings and ideals, groups and representations, automorphisms of varieties, and graph-theoretic properties; it also responds to abstract-style definitions and statements. The subpatterns belong to different fields and may share a mathematical writing style.

patterns.name: operad / operational structures in mathematical terminology
patterns.context: Discusses derived functors, derivatives, and algebraic structures on their homology; activations cluster near operad and structural descriptions.
patterns.domain: Algebraic topology and homotopy theory papers

patterns.name: Rings and ideals in commutative algebra
patterns.context: Rings, modules, ideals, and relations such as inclusion or intersection occur, especially commutative rings and monomial ideals.
patterns.domain: Commutative algebra papers and mathematical Q&A

patterns.name: Finite groups and representation-theoretic terms
patterns.context: Discusses classes or orders of groups, or their representations; activations occur near the mathematical noun group and related structural terms.
patterns.domain: Finite group theory and representation theory papers

patterns.name: Automorphisms and varieties in algebraic geometry
patterns.context: Discusses varieties over a field, rings of endomorphisms, or identity automorphisms.

patterns.name: Graph structures and combinatorial properties in graph theory
patterns.context: Describes graph embeddings, edge and vertex sets, connectivity after edge deletion, or graph properties.

patterns.name: Formal statements in mathematical paper abstracts
patterns.context: Introduces mathematical objects with Let, be, and similar wording in abstracts or theorem-style statements; activations are dispersed across object names and definitional sentences.

1_1290.description: 主要响应数学语料中的形式化结构与专业术语：operad、环和理想、群及表示、簇的自同态、图的组合性质；也对摘要式定义和陈述有反应。各子模式领域不同，可能共享数学文本风格。

patterns.name: 数学术语中的 operad / 运算结构

patterns.name: 医学标题中的三维分析短语
patterns.context: 标题以三维分析描述体内支架与冠状动脉相互作用。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要，医学研究标题

patterns.name: 音乐风格与乐器术语
patterns.context: 描述浪漫音乐作品及 flamenco 与其他音乐传统的融合。

patterns.name: 纪律处分法律用语
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见中，描述律师同意纪律处分及相关规则。

en.description: Activations are concentrated on symbols, questions, and digit strings in base-arithmetic QA, as well as malformed-word forms and vascular stent terminology in medical text; also observed in cancer risk, legal Rule 413, and set in music reviews.

patterns.name: Positive and negative number expressions in base-arithmetic problems
patterns.context: Integer addition and subtraction QA under base prefixes (e.g., “In base 10/8/11/7”); activations occur near symbols, digit strings, and question marks

patterns.name: malformations word form
patterns.context: Names or classifications of congenital/cerebellar/cardiovascular/brain malformations in medical contexts; activations fall on word fragments

patterns.name: stent and related terms
patterns.context: Coronary or intracranial vascular stents, their implantation, and interactions

patterns.name: Stent-related coronary artery compounds
patterns.context: In titles about interactions between “coronary artery” and stents, words are marked in fragments

patterns.name: Clustering of childhood cancer and birth defects
patterns.context: Discusses cancer risk in siblings of children with congenital malformations and the clustering of cancer and birth defects

patterns.name: Number 413 in proper names/text
patterns.context: Legal citation “Rule 413”; the same digit string as “413” in math passages, but without base-arithmetic context

patterns.name: set in romantic music descriptions
patterns.context: Describes a set of romantic musical works blending nuevo flamenco with Latin and Caribbean influences

1_1413.concept: 局部词形与符号片段检测
1_1413.description: 激活主要落在基数算术问答中的符号、问句与数字串，以及医学文本的畸形词和血管支架术语；另见癌症风险、法律规则号413和音乐评论中的set。

patterns.name: 基数算术题中的正负数表达
patterns.context: 基数前缀（如“In base 10/8/11/7”）下的整数加减问答；符号、数字串与问号附近出现激活

patterns.name: malformations 词形
patterns.context: 医学语境中 congenital/cerebellar/cardiovascular/脑部等畸形的名称或分类；激活落在词的片段上
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、医学项目描述

patterns.name: stent 及支架相关词
patterns.context: 冠状动脉或颅内血管支架及其植入、相互作用

patterns.name: stent 相关冠状动脉复合词
patterns.context: “coronary artery”与支架相互作用的标题中，单词被分片标记

patterns.name: 儿童癌症与出生缺陷聚集
patterns.context: 讨论患有先天畸形儿童的兄弟姐妹癌症风险及癌症与出生缺陷聚集

patterns.name: 专名/文本中的数字 413
patterns.context: 法律规则引用“Rule 413”；与数学段中“413”数字串相同，但没有基数算术上下文

patterns.name: 浪漫音乐描述中的 set
patterns.context: 描述一组浪漫、混合新弗拉门戈与拉丁及加勒比影响的音乐作品

en.concept: Multiple types of proper names and structural fragments
en.description: Activations divide among numbers and operators in math problems, stent and congenital malformations in medical text, and one-off music reviews and legal disciplinary documents; the latter two lack shared lexical triggers that align with the main categories.

patterns.name: Number and operator fragments in math problems
patterns.context: In number sequences, integer arithmetic, or base-conversion problems, activations fall on some numbers and operators; passages 1 and 2 also repeatedly use the structure “In base …, what is …”.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, arithmetic and sequence problems

patterns.name: stent in medical literature
patterns.context: Medical abstracts discuss stents and related treatments for coronary or intracranial stenosis; both activations fall on stent.

patterns.name: Malformations in medical literature
patterns.context: Discusses congenital, brain, or cardiovascular malformations and their classification, risk, or genetic causes; activations are especially concentrated on formations.

patterns.name: Musical styles and cross-genre fusion
patterns.context: Describes a set of works and the fusion of nuevo flamenco with other musical traditions; no clear trigger word matching the medical or math patterns is observed.

patterns.name: Legal disciplinary documents
patterns.context: A court opinion begins with “PER CURIAM” and recounts a disciplinary counsel and a party reaching an agreement on a stipulated disciplinary sanction under the rules.

1_1413.description: 激活分为数学题中的数字与运算符、医学文本中的 stent 和先天畸形，以及单例的音乐评论与纪律处分法律文书；后两者缺少可与主类对应的共同词面触发。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与运算符片段
patterns.context: 数字序列、整数算术或进制转换题中，激活落在部分数字及运算符上；第 1、2 段还反复出现“In base …, what is …”结构。

patterns.name: 医学文献中的 stent
patterns.context: 医学摘要中谈冠状动脉或颅内狭窄的支架及相关治疗；两处都激活在 stent 上。

patterns.name: 医学文献中的畸形
patterns.context: 谈先天性、脑部或心血管畸形及其分类、风险或遗传成因；激活尤其集中在 formations。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目说明

patterns.name: 音乐风格与跨流派融合
patterns.context: 描述一组作品及 nuevo flamenco 与其他音乐传统的融合；未见与医学或数学模式相同的明确触发词。

patterns.name: 纪律处分法律文书
patterns.context: 法院以“PER CURIAM”开篇，叙述纪律顾问与当事人依规则达成同意处分协议。
patterns.domain: 法律意见或纪律处分裁决

en.description: Activations occur on numbers and symbols in arithmetic problems, stent and malformations in medical texts, and rule numbers in legal texts and set in music descriptions. They span domains, with no single stable semantic or syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: Arithmetic symbols and digit fragments in number strings
patterns.context: At or near numbers and arithmetic expressions; segments 1 and 2 are addition and subtraction problems in different bases, while segment 10 is a sequence problem. Some activation falls on digit blocks, symbols, or preceding spaces.

patterns.name: stent in medical titles
patterns.context: Appears in paper titles about coronary stent interactions or stroke after stenting; in segment 3 it is split into «stent» and subsequent «--» etc., and in segment 6 it is followed by -ing.

patterns.name: Medical word malformations
patterns.context: In medical titles and abstracts about birth defects, brain malformations, or cardiovascular malformations; activation concentrates on the stem and suffix of malformations.

patterns.name: Legal rule numbers
patterns.context: Appears as the rule number Rule 413 in a legal disciplinary consent agreement; it has the same form as digit fragments in math segments but a different context.

patterns.name: set in descriptions of Romantic music styles
patterns.context: Describes a collection of nuevo flamenco musical works; nearby text discusses its Romantic style and musical fusion.

1_1413.description: 激活分布在算术题的数字与符号、医学文本中的 stent 和 malformations，以及法律规则编号和音乐描述中的 set；跨领域，未见单一稳定语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 数字串中的算术符号与数字片段
patterns.context: 数字或算术表达式内部或邻近位置；段1、2是不同进制的加减题，段10是数列题。部分激活落在数字块、符号或其前置空格上。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的 stent
patterns.context: 出现在冠状动脉支架相互作用或支架术后卒中的论文标题中；段3中拆分为«stent»和后续«--»等，段6中接着-ing。

patterns.name: 医学词语 malformations
patterns.context: 在先天缺陷、脑部畸形或心血管畸形的医学标题和摘要中；激活集中在 malformations 的词干及后缀。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、医学研究简介

patterns.name: 法律规则编号
patterns.context: 法律纪律同意协议中，作为 Rule 413 的规则编号出现；与数学段中的数字片段同形，但语境不同。

patterns.name: 浪漫音乐风格描述中的 set
patterns.context: 形容一组 nuevo flamenco 音乐作品，附近描述其浪漫风格及音乐融合。

en.description: Activations are scattered across operators and question wording in base-arithmetic problems, medical terminology, descriptions of musical styles, and epistemological and transhuman topics in philosophy; there is no clear unified semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: Operators in base-arithmetic questions
patterns.context: In base-arithmetic problems, the question asks for the sum of two numbers; activations are associated with the plus sign and question words.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in medical terminology
patterns.context: Medical text includes congenital malformations, coronary stents, or related terminology; activations fall on complete parts or intra-word fragments of technical terms.
patterns.domain: Medical papers and research grant abstracts

patterns.name: Style terms in descriptions of blended musical styles
patterns.context: Appears when describing music blending nuevo flamenco with Latin and Caribbean influences and its style.

patterns.name: Epistemological and religious-disagreement vocabulary
patterns.context: Philosophical discussion addresses religious believers, disagreement, and its epistemic benefits; activations involve common word fragments or internal subwords.

patterns.name: Vocabulary about transhuman topics
patterns.context: When discussing transhuman topics, impacts, or technological origins, activations appear in transhuman-related expressions.

1_1413.description: 激活分散于进位制加法题的运算符与问句、医学专业词、音乐风格描述及哲学中的认识论和跨人类议题；没有明显统一的语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: 进位制算术问句中的运算符
patterns.context: 进位制算术题中，问句询问两个数的加法结果；激活与加号及问句词有关。

patterns.name: 医学术语的词内片段
patterns.context: 医学文本中，先天畸形、冠状动脉支架或支架相关术语出现；激活落在专业词的完整部分或词内片段。
patterns.domain: 医学论文与研究资助摘要

patterns.name: 混合音乐风格描述中的风格词
patterns.context: 描述新弗拉门戈与拉丁、加勒比影响融合的音乐及其风格时出现。

patterns.name: 认识论与宗教分歧词汇
patterns.context: 哲学论述谈及宗教信仰者、分歧及其认识论益处；激活涉及常见词片段或其内部子词。

patterns.name: 跨人类议题词汇
patterns.context: 讨论跨人类议题、影响或技术来源时，激活出现在 transhuman 相关表达中。

en.concept: In-word fragment of medical malformation terminology
en.description: Strongly responds mainly to the in-word fragment formations in malformations in medical contexts, spanning congenital, cerebrovascular, and fetal malformations and related research, statistics, and prevention texts. It also activates on fragments in several medical compounds and a sporadic word fragment in a music blurb. Segment 5 has no clear malformation term.

patterns.name: Suffix in congenital malformations
patterns.context: The trigger is the English word malformations in medical contexts, especially near words such as congenital and fetal; activation concentrates on formations and its internal subword fragments.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, clinical and public health texts

patterns.name: Medical titles and collocations related to malformations
patterns.context: Appears in medical titles describing cerebrovascular malformations, coronary stents, or fetal anomalies; the trigger is not necessarily malformations itself and may be associated with specific medical terms.

patterns.name: Malformation statistics and prevention
patterns.context: Activates in comparisons of pregnancy complication prevalence and descriptions of prenatal risk, screening, and postnatal detection; suffix activation is weaker than in some title examples.
patterns.domain: Perinatal medicine, epidemiology, and public health

patterns.name: Subword fragments within medical words
patterns.context: Activation covers subword fragments within medical compounds or technical terms; the first concerns malformation-related words, while the latter two occur in contexts involving valve formation and cerebral arteriovenous malformations, respectively.

patterns.name: Sporadic triggers in Romantic and music copy
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of nuevo flamenco music, genre blending, and portraits of musicians; it has no clear connection to the medical malformation theme and may be an independent word-fragment trigger.

1_1413.concept: 医学畸形术语的词内片段
1_1413.description: 主要对医学语境中 malformations 的词内片段 formations 强烈响应，覆盖先天、脑血管、胎儿畸形及相关研究、统计和预防文本；另对若干医学复合术语片段及一段音乐文案中的零散词片段激活。第5段无明确畸形词。

patterns.name: 先天畸形词尾
patterns.context: 触发点是医学语境中的英文单词 malformations，尤其是 congenital、fetal 等词附近；激活集中在 formations 及其词内拆分片段。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、临床与公共卫生文本

patterns.name: 畸形相关医学标题与搭配
patterns.trigger: «mal»3«formations»9，及 «mal»3«formations»9 前后的 «vascular»、«stent»、«diagnosis» 等医学词
patterns.context: 在描述脑血管畸形、冠状动脉支架或胎儿异常的医学标题中出现；不一定是单词 malformations 本身触发，也可能与特定医学名词搭配。

patterns.name: 畸形统计及预防
patterns.context: 在妊娠并发症患病率比较，以及产前风险、筛查和出生后检测的描述中激活；词尾激活强度低于若干标题实例。
patterns.domain: 围产医学、流行病学与公共卫生

patterns.name: 医学单词内部的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活覆盖医学复合词或专业术语内部的子词片段；前者为畸形相关词，后两者分别出现在瓣膜形成和脑动静脉畸形语境。

patterns.name: 浪漫与音乐文案中的零散触发
patterns.context: 出现在关于新弗拉门戈音乐、混合流派及人物肖像的描述中；与医学畸形主题无明显联系，可能是独立的词片段触发。

en.description: Strongly responds mainly to the word-final formations, especially in the medical compound malformations, spanning congenital, brain, and vascular malformations. It also responds to the same-spelling formations substring in German Informationen and biotransformations.

patterns.name: Malformation-related compounds
patterns.context: The term appears in medical contexts, especially congenital, brain, cardiovascular, or vascular malformations; activation concentrates on formations and the compound ending.

patterns.name: formation substring in an information term
patterns.context: The substring occurs in the German word “Informationen”; it does not have a medical malformation meaning.

patterns.name: formation substring in a biotransformation term
patterns.context: The substring occurs in “biotransformations,” referring to chemical/biochemical transformations rather than malformations.

1_1413.description: 主要对单词末尾 formations 强烈响应，尤其是医学复合词 malformations，覆盖先天、脑部及血管畸形；也响应德语 Informationen 和 biotransformations 中同形的 formations 子串。

patterns.name: 畸形相关复合词
patterns.context: 词项出现在医学语境，尤其是先天、脑部、心血管或血管畸形；激活集中在 formations 及复合词末尾。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: 信息词中的 formation 子串
patterns.context: 子串出现在德语“Informationen”一词中；并非医学畸形含义。

patterns.name: 生物转化词中的 formation 子串
patterns.context: 子串出现在“biotransformations”中，指化学/生物化学转化，而非畸形。

en.description: Strong activation mainly falls on formations in words split across tokens: English malformations, the chemistry term biotransformations, and German Informationen. English medical passages often discuss congenital or vascular malformations, but the trigger form also occurs across domains.

patterns.name: Morphological boundary in malformations
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the final formations segment of the English word malformations when split across tokens; prefixes and meanings vary.

patterns.name: Word ending in biotransformations
patterns.context: The formations substring in the full word biotransformations activates strongly, with weaker activation on the preceding split portion as well.

patterns.name: Word ending in Informationen
patterns.context: The spelling substring formations occurs in the German compound Informationen; the surrounding text discusses public information and awareness.

1_1413.description: 强激活主要落在跨 token 单词中的 formations：英语 malformations、化学术语 biotransformations，以及德语 Informationen；英语医学段落多谈先天或血管畸形，但触发形式也跨领域出现。

patterns.name: malformations 的形态边界
patterns.context: 激活集中在跨 token 拆分的英语单词 malformations 的末段 formations；前缀和词义各异。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、科研项目介绍

patterns.name: biotransformations 的词尾
patterns.context: 完整单词 biotransformations 中的 formations 子串被强烈激活，前面的拆分部分也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: Informationen 的词尾
patterns.context: 德语复合词 Informationen 中出现拼写子串 formations；前后文讨论公共信息与意识。

en.description: Strong activation mainly falls on malformations (often split as mal/formations) and films in movie-related corpora; samples in Kannada and physics texts also occur. Each pattern depends on different terms and local contexts.

patterns.name: Medical term malformations
patterns.context: Malformation-related terminology occurs in medical contexts; it can refer to fetal, congenital, cerebellar, or cerebrovascular malformations.

patterns.name: Film category labels
patterns.context: The term appears in category labels at the end of Wikipedia entries, often alongside Indian films, decades, languages, or genres.

patterns.name: Kannada term
patterns.context: Appears in biographies introducing film producers and their works, as part of the language/film industry name Kannada.

patterns.name: samples in a physics context
patterns.context: Appears in sentences discussing experimental samples or materials that can be used to build devices.

1_1413.description: 强激活主要落在 malformations（常被拆分为 mal/formations）及电影语料中的 films；另有 Kannada 和物理文中的 samples。各模式依赖不同词项与局部语境。

patterns.name: 医学术语 malformations
patterns.context: 医学语境中出现畸形相关术语；可指胎儿、先天性、小脑、脑血管等畸形。

patterns.name: 电影类别标签
patterns.context: 词项位于 Wikipedia 条目末尾的分类标签中，常与印度电影、年代、语言或类型并列。

patterns.name: Kannada 词项
patterns.context: 出现在介绍电影制片人及其作品的传记中，构成语言/电影产业名称 Kannada。

patterns.name: 物理语境中的 samples
patterns.context: 出现在讨论可用于构建设备的实验样品或材料的句子中。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on specific fragments of analyse/analysed and academia; there are also sporadic fragments in medical word endings, code identifiers, names, and abbreviations/numbers, with no unified semantics across contexts.

patterns.name: analyse in academic English
patterns.context: The verb occurs in academic or explanatory text, often followed by a research subject, data, or task; activation concentrates on specific subword fragments, such as «analyse»10 and «analysed»6.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, web descriptions, ArXiv, Wikipedia

patterns.name: Academic term academia
patterns.context: academia is split into academ + ia, with activation on «academ»9; used to describe research or career destinations.

patterns.name: Word fragments in medical phrases
patterns.context: Appears respectively in Urinary tract stone disease and BAL cytology; the contexts are medical terms, but they share no clear complete-word meaning or syntactic function.

patterns.name: aly in code identifiers
patterns.context: A token fragment in code paths/build filenames triggers activation; this does not align with ordinary English semantics.

patterns.name: aly in a name
patterns.context: Appears in the name Dr. Skaly, with activation on part of the surname.

patterns.name: Other in-word fragments
patterns.context: Appears respectively in 96 well, CFAR, and O​​EH abbreviations or numeric expressions; activation is local, with no unified contextual condition.

1_1413.description: 激活主要落在 analyse/analysed 与 academia 的特定词片段；另有医学词尾、代码标识符、人名及缩写/数字中的零散片段，跨语境并无统一语义。

patterns.name: 学术英语中的 analyse
patterns.context: 动词出现在学术或说明性文本中，常接研究对象、数据或任务；激活集中在词内特定子词片段，如 «analyse»10、«analysed»6。

patterns.name: 学术词汇 academia
patterns.context: academia 被切分成 academ + ia，激活在 «academ»9；用于描述研究或职业去向。

patterns.name: 医学短语中的词片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在 Urinary tract stone disease 和 BAL cytology 中；上下文为医学术语，但没有明显共同的完整词义或句法功能。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 aly
patterns.context: 代码路径/构建文件名中的分词片段触发；与普通英语语义不一致。

patterns.name: 人名中的 aly
patterns.context: 出现在人名 Dr. Skaly 中，激活落在姓氏片段。

patterns.name: 其他词内片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在 96 well、CFAR、O​​EH 等缩写或数字表达中，局部激活，未见统一上下文条件。

en.description: The strongest activation repeatedly falls on English plural -ors endings, with additional repeated responses to odor-related words. Other weaker activations occur sporadically in course names, fragments within proper nouns, and words in title lists; domains and parts of speech are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Plural genitive endings
patterns.context: Often occurs in English nouns ending in -or/-ors; sometimes the ending is split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: academic abstracts, encyclopedias, code, web content

patterns.name: Odor-related words
patterns.context: Odor terms and their plural forms; both occurrences are in contexts about odors or body odor.

patterns.name: Discipline and course names
patterns.context: Appears in course lists; some discipline terms activate weakly, most notably «Art».

patterns.name: Occasional proper names and endings
patterns.context: Sporadic in-word fragments occur in nationality terms, abstract nouns, medical terms, and football league names; there is no shared context.

patterns.name: Title-like words in headings or lists
patterns.context: Appears in web-style text such as headings, links, or course lists, with inconsistent parts of speech and ending forms.

1_1413.concept: 英语复数 -ors 词尾偏好
1_1413.description: 最强激活反复落在英文复数 -ors 词尾，另对气味相关词有重复响应；其余较弱激活散见于课程名、专名词内片段及标题列表词，领域和词类不统一。

patterns.name: 复数属格词尾
patterns.trigger: 高激活的词尾或词内片段：«ors»10、«ors»9、«ors»10（如 od«ors»、construct«ors»、Scul«pt»«ors»、Err«ors»、tut«ors»、«Spons»«ors»）
patterns.context: 多出现在以 -or/-ors 结尾的英文名词中；有时词尾被分割成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：学术摘要、百科、代码、网页内容

patterns.name: 气味相关词语
patterns.context: 气味词及其复数形式；两处都处在关于气味或体味的语境中。
patterns.domain: 嗅觉研究与生物学摘要

patterns.name: 学科与课程名称
patterns.context: 出现在课程清单中，部分学科词获得弱激活，最明显的是«Art»。

patterns.name: 个别专名及词尾
patterns.context: 零散词内片段，分别出现在国籍词、抽象名词、医学术语和足球联赛名称中；无共同语境。

patterns.name: 标题或列表中的标题式词
patterns.context: 出现在标题、链接或课程列表等网页式文本中，且词类与词尾形态不一致。

en.concept: Intra-word fragments and academic publishing vocabulary
en.description: Activations often fall on intra-word fragments and are common in review, journal, and academic publishing contexts; however, the fragments also appear in names, place names, German words, and code identifiers, so no single semantic pattern explains them.

patterns.name: “-ite/-ites” fragments within terms
patterns.context: Activations fall on letter fragments within words rather than stable standalone words; their spelling positions vary across terms.
patterns.domain: Journal titles, German parliamentary text, medicine, people and place names

patterns.name: review and related publication contexts
patterns.context: Appears in contexts such as book reviews, papers, or journal peer review; the same token also appears in texts across different disciplines.

patterns.name: Journal or academic publication titles
patterns.context: Appears in journal titles, disciplines, or discussions of academic publishing; some are headings and others are body text.
patterns.domain: Academic publishing, humanities and social sciences, and medicine

patterns.name: Similar letter fragments within names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments within proper nouns, without consistent semantic or syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: People's names, place names, and general narrative

patterns.name: report/errors identifier fragments in code
patterns.context: Appears in JavaScript/TypeScript import statements and identifiers.

patterns.name: Unclustered sporadic intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations are scattered within words, with no stable semantic or contextual condition shared across other passages.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic lists, correspondence, and academic publishing discussions

1_1413.concept: 词内片段与学术出版词汇
1_1413.description: 激活多落在词内片段，常见于 review、期刊及学术出版语境；但片段也出现在人名、地名、德语词和代码标识符中，无法由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 词项中的“-ite/-ites”片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内的字母片段上，而不是稳定的独立词；不同词中的拼写位置并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 期刊刊名、德语议会文本、医学、人物与地名

patterns.name: review 及相关刊物语境
patterns.context: 出现在书评、论文或期刊审稿等语境；同一 token 也出现于不同学科文本。

patterns.name: 期刊或学术出版物名称
patterns.context: 出现于刊名、学科名称或学术出版讨论中；有些是标题，有些是正文。
patterns.domain: 学术出版、人文社科与医学

patterns.name: 名字与专名内部的相似字母片段
patterns.context: 激活位于专名内部的子词片段，缺少一致的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 人物名、地名及一般叙述

patterns.name: 代码中的 report/errors 标识符片段
patterns.context: 出现在 JavaScript/TypeScript 的导入语句与标识符中。

patterns.name: 未能归并的零散词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在词内部，未显示出与其他段稳定共享的语义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 百科列表、书信与学术出版讨论

en.description: The main pattern is the English word “review” in contexts such as book reviews, peer review, journal reviews, or regulatory review. There are also several characters in Chinese code comments and one fragment within a name, with no clear connection to the main pattern.

patterns.name: The word review itself
patterns.context: The complete word “review” appears in English text; it can function as a noun and cover book reviews, peer review, literature reviews, and formal review.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including encyclopedias, reviews, academic publishing, and policy texts

patterns.name: Non-English character sequence (uncertain)
patterns.context: Trigger positions occur respectively in Chinese comments/code text and within a name in an English academic passage; no shared clear meaning or contextual condition is evident.

1_1413.description: 主要模式是英语词“review”在书评、同行评审、期刊综述或法规审查等语境中出现。另有中文代码注释中的若干字符及一处姓名内部片段，难以与主模式建立联系。

patterns.name: review 一词本身
patterns.context: 英语文本中出现完整词“review”；在句中可作名词，涵盖书评、同行评审、综述及正式审查等不同用法。
patterns.domain: 百科、评论、学术出版、政策文本等多种文体

patterns.name: 非英语字符序列（不确定）
patterns.context: 触发位置分别位于中文注释/代码文本和英语学术段落中的姓名内部；未见共同的明确词义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: Github 代码注释；生态学论文

en.description: Primarily responds to genera, species, families, and taxonomic terminology in biological classification texts, especially lists, identification, description, assignment, and disputes over taxonomic units; also covers diversity statistics, plant catalogs, and one unrelated software field.

patterns.name: Taxonomic ranks and terminology
patterns.context: These terms appear in classification, identification, taxonomic-rank, or classification-dispute contexts, often alongside genera, species, and families, or in discussions of their assignment.
patterns.domain: Biological taxonomy papers, abstracts, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Genus names and taxonomic catalogs
patterns.context: Species are listed under a genus or reassigned to one, or text is presented as scientific names, genus names, and taxonomic entries; passage 5 is a plant catalog, and passage 2 concerns a dispute over genus assignment.
patterns.domain: Animal, plant, and microbial taxonomic records; encyclopedia catalogs

patterns.name: Identification, description, and recording of taxonomic units
patterns.context: Explains how taxonomic units are diagnosed, identified, or recorded, or introduces newly described species or taxonomic units.
patterns.domain: Taxonomic research and biological survey abstracts

patterns.name: Classification methods and disputes
patterns.context: Discusses how organisms are divided or classified, or points out disputes and difficulties arising from classification criteria or morphological differences.

patterns.name: Biodiversity and community composition statistics
patterns.context: Surveys or summarizes the diversity of a location, community, or biological group and reports the number of taxonomic units.

patterns.name: Overview of coral reef butterflyfish groups
patterns.context: Summarizes the phylogeny, taxonomy, and geographic distribution of butterflyfish, and gives the number of genera and species.

patterns.name: Plant taxonomic catalogs and page category labels
patterns.context: References or category fields in botanical catalogs or encyclopedia pages; not taxonomic discussion in the body text.

patterns.name: Software feature fields
patterns.context: Feature names or field headings in GitHub text, without a biological taxonomy context.
patterns.domain: Software development documentation or repository text

1_1413.description: 主要响应生物分类文本中的属、种、科及分类术语，尤其是分类单元的列举、鉴定、描述、归属和分类争议；也覆盖多样性统计、植物名录与一处无关的软件字段。

patterns.name: 生物分类等级与分类学术语
patterns.context: 这些词出现在分类、鉴定、分类等级或分类争议的语境中，常与属、种、科等分类单元并列，或讨论其归属。
patterns.domain: 生物分类学论文、摘要及百科条目

patterns.name: 属名与分类名录
patterns.context: 物种被列入、重新归属某属，或文本以学名、属名及分类条目形式呈现；第5段为植物名录，第2段为属归属争议。
patterns.domain: 动物、植物及微生物分类记录；百科名录

patterns.name: 分类单元的鉴定、描述与记录
patterns.context: 说明分类单元如何被诊断、鉴定或记录，或介绍新描述物种、分类单元。
patterns.domain: 分类学研究与生物调查摘要

patterns.name: 分类方法与分类争议
patterns.context: 讨论如何划分或归类生物，或指出分类标准、形态差异带来的争议和困难。
patterns.domain: 分类学论文与百科说明

patterns.name: 生物多样性与群落组成统计
patterns.context: 调查或概述某地点、群落或生物类群的多样性，并报告分类单元数量。
patterns.domain: 生态学、微生物学及生物多样性研究

patterns.name: 珊瑚礁蝴蝶鱼类群概述
patterns.context: 概述蝴蝶鱼科的系统发育、分类与地理分布，并介绍属种数。

patterns.name: 植物分类名录及页面分类标签
patterns.context: 植物学名录或百科页面的参考文献、分类类别字段；并非正文中的分类论述。
patterns.domain: 植物学名录、维基百科条目

patterns.name: 软件功能字段
patterns.context: GitHub 文本中的功能名称或字段标题，未见生物分类语境。
patterns.domain: 软件开发文档或仓库文本

en.description: Primarily responds to references to genera, subgenera, families, orders, and species in biological taxonomy, with genera and taxonomic nouns as prominent triggers. There are also occasional high activations on geographic and disciplinary term endings, proper nouns, and a few isolated words.

patterns.name: Genus-level classification in taxonomy
patterns.context: In biological classification or species-description contexts, discussing genera, subgenera, species, and their classification, identification, or phylogeny; sometimes adjacent to numbers or lists.

patterns.name: Laurales / Lauraceae taxonomy terms
patterns.context: Laurales or Lauraceae appears in plant classification lists, alongside genus names, botanical names, or references.

patterns.name: Genus-name ending in a taxonomy heading
patterns.context: In a list of people or an entry title, the discipline name Geography is marked as split; no clear biological taxonomy context is evident.

patterns.name: Sporadic trigger on genera in a proper name
patterns.context: Club appears in the name Peterborough Handball Club; unrelated to biological taxonomy.

patterns.name: -ography ending in a proper noun
patterns.context: The ending of Astrophotography is marked; unrelated to biological taxonomy.

patterns.name: Other sporadic activations at names or token boundaries
patterns.context: Appears respectively near code comments, biographical introductions, paper introductions, and references; there is insufficient evidence that these words share a stable semantic trigger.

1_1413.description: 主要响应生物分类语境中关于属、亚属、科、目及物种的表述，尤以 genera 及分类名词为显著触发；另有地名学科词尾、专名与少数孤立词的偶发高激活。

patterns.name: 分类学中的属级分类
patterns.context: 生物学分类或物种描述语境，谈及属、亚属、物种及其分类、鉴定或系统发育；有时紧邻数字或列表。
patterns.domain: 分类学、生态学及生物学论文

patterns.name: Laurales / Lauraceae 分类词
patterns.context: 植物分类列表中出现目名 Laurales 或科名 Lauraceae，伴随属名、植物学名称或参考文献。

patterns.name: 分类标题中的属名词尾
patterns.context: 人物列表或条目标题中，学科名称 Geography 被切分标记，未见明显生物分类上下文。

patterns.name: 专名中带有 genera 的偶发触发
patterns.context: Peterborough Handball Club 的名称中出现 Club；与生物分类语境无关。

patterns.name: 专名中的 -ography 词尾
patterns.context: Astrophotography 一词的词尾被标记；与分类学语境无关。

patterns.name: 其他名称或分词边界的偶发激活
patterns.context: 分别出现在代码注释、人物简介、论文引言和参考文献附近；没有足够证据表明这些词共享稳定语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 代码、百科全书、生物医学论文

en.description: Activations are scattered across paper section separators, review in several contexts, the technical compound band, survey statistics, and taxonomic genus names; no single stable semantic feature explains all passages.

patterns.name: End-of-paper section headings
patterns.context: In the body of an academic paper, an uppercase section heading and its underline-style separator appear after the preceding text ends.

patterns.name: Section heading separators
patterns.context: A continuous equals-sign separator after a paper's final section heading; activations are concentrated on the separator itself.

patterns.name: Markers and separators in review-style academic text
patterns.context: Near table-of-contents-style section references or Markdown-style heading dividers in a paper.

patterns.name: Review terminology
patterns.context: Phrases describing critical evaluation in literary or media reviews.

patterns.name: Military review terminology
patterns.context: A historical account mentions a military review; the high activation falls on “review”.

patterns.name: Book review terminology
patterns.context: Mentions a review of a book or a book review, with “review” in an unambiguous review context.

patterns.name: Numerical and unit-style notation
patterns.context: In the compound wideband, activation falls on band; the context concerns technical terminology.

patterns.name: Wideband propagation/attenuation terminology
patterns.context: In a title, wide/broadband is associated with physical processes such as propagation and attenuation.

patterns.name: Taxonomic genus names and exception notes
patterns.context: A molecular phylogenetics study lists taxonomic units and explains which genera are included and which are exceptions.

patterns.name: National surveys and percentage statistics
patterns.context: Reports national survey results and gives percentages or statistics.

1_1413.description: 激活点分散：论文章节分隔符、若干语境中的 review、技术复合词 band，以及调查统计和分类学属名；未见单一稳定语义特征能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 文末章节标题
patterns.context: 学术论文正文中，前文结束后出现大写章节标题及其下划线式分隔符。

patterns.name: 章节标题分隔符
patterns.context: 论文末尾章节标题后的连续等号分隔符；激活集中在分隔符本身。

patterns.name: 综述性学术正文中的标记与分隔符
patterns.context: 论文目录式章节引用或 Markdown 风格标题分隔线附近。

patterns.name: 评论用语
patterns.context: 文艺评论或媒体评论中，描述评论评价的短语。

patterns.name: 军事检阅相关词
patterns.context: 历史叙述中提及军事检阅；高激活落在“review”。

patterns.name: 书评相关用语
patterns.context: 提及某书的评论或书评，且“review”处于语义明确的评论语境。

patterns.name: 数值与单位式写法
patterns.context: 复合词 wideband 中，激活落在 band；上下文涉及技术术语。

patterns.name: 宽带传播/衰减术语
patterns.context: 标题中 wide/broadband 与传播、衰减等物理过程相连。

patterns.name: 分类学属名及例外说明
patterns.context: 分子系统发育研究列举分类单元，并说明纳入的属及例外。

patterns.name: 全国调查与比例统计
patterns.context: 报告全国性调查结果，并给出比例或统计数据。

en.concept: Specific word forms and equals-sign delimiters
en.description: The strongest triggers are equals-sign section dividers and the word anthropology; isolated examples also occur in Sahara and within a biological genus name. Several astronomy papers contain equals-sign dividers, but they do not explain the other marked tokens.

patterns.name: Divider-style section heading
patterns.context: A section heading is underlined with consecutive equals signs, appearing after an Introduction or Related work heading; may also occur alongside a marker on the paper’s first page

patterns.name: Anthropology and academic titles
patterns.context: The word anthropology appears in interdisciplinary research topics or academic titles; capitalization varies, but all contexts are academic text

patterns.name: Sahara proper-name fragment
patterns.context: The triggered fragment is a substring within Little Sahara, not the whole word; context is a place name and recreational area name

patterns.name: In-word fragment in a taxon name
patterns.context: A subword fragment appears in the butterflyfish genus name Parachaetodon; strong activation falls within the name rather than on a general semantic word

1_1413.concept: 特定词形与等号分隔符
1_1413.description: 最强触发集中在等号式小节分隔线，以及 anthropology 一词；另有 Sahara 和生物属名内部片段的孤例。多篇天文学论文虽含等号分隔线，但无法说明其余被标记 token。

patterns.name: 分隔线式小节标题
patterns.context: 以连续等号作为章节标题下划线，出现在 Introduction 或 Related work 标题之后；同时可伴随论文首页标记
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文的 Markdown/文本转换格式

patterns.name: 人类学及其学术职衔
patterns.context: 词语 anthropology 出现在跨学科研究主题或学者职衔中；大小写不同，语境均为学术文本

patterns.name: Sahara 专名片段
patterns.context: 触发片段是 Little Sahara 中的词内子串，而不是完整词；上下文为地名及休闲区域名称

patterns.name: 分类群名称中的词内片段
patterns.context: 在蝴蝶鱼属名 Parachaetodon 中出现分词片段；强激活落在名称内部而非一般语义词

en.description: Almost all activations occur at page or section boundaries in ArXiv astronomy papers, especially continuous equals-sign underlines after headings; also includes structural headings such as Introduction and Conclusions, separators, and related document markers. Astronomy topics provide shared context, but are weak triggers on their own.

patterns.name: Section heading underlines
patterns.context: An underline used after a paper or section heading in Markdown/text formatting; this is the strongest and most recurring local trigger

patterns.name: Abstract/introduction and other structural boundaries
patterns.context: Near paper metadata, page markers, or section transitions, often appearing with equals-sign underlines

patterns.name: Astronomy and galaxy terms
patterns.context: Keywords, abstracts, or introductions in astrophysics papers; terms themselves are usually weakly activated and typically occur near structural markers

patterns.name: Document markers and special formatting
patterns.context: Page, section anchor, or cross-reference formatting in ArXiv document dumps

patterns.name: Conclusion/summary wording
patterns.context: In closing sections or navigational text about paper structure; activations may arise from section-heading format rather than summary semantics itself

patterns.name: Hyphens and heading labels in terminology
patterns.context: In keyword lists, titles, or astronomy terminology; no stable evidence of a trigger independent of paper formatting

1_1413.description: 激活几乎都出现在 ArXiv 天文学论文的页面或章节边界，尤其是标题后的连续等号下划线；同时涵盖 Introduction、Conclusions 等结构标题、分隔符及相关文档标记。天文学主题词提供共同语境，但单独触发作用较弱。

patterns.name: 章节标题下划线
patterns.context: 论文标题或章节标题之后，作为 Markdown/文本格式中的标题下划线；这是最强且反复出现的局部触发

patterns.name: 摘要/引言等结构边界
patterns.trigger: “Conclusions”“Introduction”“Observations”“first page”及其周围的换行、分隔符“---”
patterns.context: 论文元数据、页面标记或章节切换附近，常与等号下划线共同出现

patterns.name: 天文学与星系主题词
patterns.context: 天体物理论文的关键词、摘要或引言；词项本身多为弱激活，通常处于结构标记附近

patterns.name: 文档标记与特殊格式
patterns.context: ArXiv 文档转储中的页面、章节锚点或交叉引用格式

patterns.name: 结论/总结措辞
patterns.context: 结尾章节或对论文结构的导航文字；激活可能来自章节标题格式，而非总结语义本身

patterns.name: 术语中的连字符及标题标签
patterns.trigger: “age-metallicity”“gamma-ray”“late-type”“high-redshift”等连字符复合词，以及“galaxies:”类标签
patterns.context: 关键词列表、题名或天文学术语中；未见稳定独立于论文格式的触发证据
patterns.domain: 天文学论文元数据与术语

en.description: Sensitive to paper-structure formatting (especially long equals-sign dividers, section headings, and anchors) and formal research prose. Several passages involve astronomy terminology; it also covers machine-learning paper structure and terminology, physics paper titles, and keyword metadata.

patterns.name: Equals-sign section dividers
patterns.context: Long dividers made of equals signs, often following a section heading or section anchor and appearing between line breaks.

patterns.name: Paper sections and structure markers
patterns.context: Section headings, section references, page markers, or formatting markers before or after headings in papers; sometimes appearing with equals-sign dividers.

patterns.name: Astronomy and astrophysics terminology
patterns.context: Discusses stars, galaxies, observations, spectra, or astrophysical properties; often appears near section-structure markers, but no fixed pairing is required.

patterns.name: Scientific abstracts and research-report prose
patterns.context: Formal paper prose reporting research observations, methods, results, or conclusions.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers (primarily astronomy, also machine learning)

patterns.name: Machine-learning methods and evaluation terminology
patterns.context: Discusses model architectures, datasets, evaluation metrics, or graph neural networks; no clear astronomy topic.

patterns.name: Paper metadata and introduction formatting
patterns.context: Title or introduction area at the beginning of a paper, containing title fields and separators above and below.
patterns.domain: Metadata/opening format of high-energy physics papers

patterns.name: Catalog-style subject terms and classification terms
patterns.context: Subject terms separated by colons, or lists of astronomical classes and research objects before the introduction.
patterns.domain: Keyword or classification metadata in astronomy papers

1_1413.description: 对论文结构格式（尤以长等号分隔线、章节标题和锚点为突出线索）及正式研究叙述敏感。多段涉及天文学术语；也覆盖机器学习论文结构和术语、物理论文题名及关键词元数据。

patterns.name: 等号分隔的章节标题
patterns.context: 等号组成的长分隔线，常紧随章节标题或章节锚点，并位于换行之间。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文的 Markdown/网页转储格式

patterns.name: 论文章节与结构标记
patterns.context: 论文中的章节标题、章节引用、页面标记或标题前后的格式标记；有时与等号分隔线一起出现。

patterns.name: 天文学与天体物理术语
patterns.context: 讨论恒星、星系、观测、光谱或天体物理性质；多出现在章节结构标记附近，但不要求固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 天文学与天体物理研究论文

patterns.name: 科学论文摘要与研究报告表达
patterns.context: 报告研究观测、方法、结果或结论的正式论文叙述。
patterns.domain: 科学论文（天文学为主，也包含机器学习）

patterns.name: 机器学习方法与评估术语
patterns.context: 讨论模型架构、数据集、评价指标或图神经网络；没有明显天文学主题。

patterns.name: 论文元数据与引言格式
patterns.context: 论文开头的题名或引言区域，包含标题字段及上下分隔符。
patterns.domain: 高能物理论文的元数据/开篇格式

patterns.name: 目录式主题词与分类词
patterns.trigger: 「galaxies: high-redshift, galaxies: luminosity function」「stars: abundances」「Population II」
patterns.context: 以冒号分隔学科主题词，或在引言前列出天体类别和研究对象。
patterns.domain: 天文学论文的关键词或分类元数据

en.concept: Paper observation and spectroscopy section contexts
en.description: Primarily responds to spectroscopy and astronomical observation terminology in papers, especially the “Observations and data reduction” section heading, conclusion passages, and equals-sign dividers; also covers the title-style “Spectroscopic study” in biomedical text, stellar and galaxy-related content, and paper structure markers.

patterns.name: Spectroscopy terminology
patterns.context: Spectroscopy terms appear in paper titles, body text, or descriptions of observation methods; some activations concentrate at the word onset or on tokenized substrings.
patterns.domain: Biochemistry, chemistry, and astronomy research text

patterns.name: Observation and data-processing section headings
patterns.context: Appears as a section heading in ArXiv papers, usually following the discussion or conclusions section; passages 1, 4, 7, and 9 show strong activations at the heading.

patterns.name: Conclusion section headings and review statements
patterns.context: Near paper summaries, conclusion sections, or section cross-references; includes both conclusion-related wording in the body and headings with their formatting dividers.

patterns.name: Stellar and galactic astronomy content
patterns.context: When discussing stars, galaxies, stellar populations, and their observations or properties; some examples also contain spectroscopy terms or observation section headings.

patterns.name: Research subjects and actions in titles
patterns.context: At the beginning of PubMed abstract-style titles, followed by subjects of degradation or molecular interaction studies; this pattern shares literal form with spectroscopy terms in astronomy papers, but the genres differ.

patterns.name: Section-format markers and separators
patterns.context: Structured markers, heading anchors, or visual divider lines for section headings in ArXiv text; the equals-sign divider itself also has strong activation.

patterns.name: Other astronomy paper structure statements
patterns.context: Section navigation and paper organization statements in conclusions, appendices, or discussion sections; they do not always mention spectroscopy or observations directly.

1_1413.concept: 论文观测与光谱章节语境
1_1413.description: 主要响应论文中的光谱及天文观测用语，尤其是“Observations and data reduction”章节标题、结论段落和等号分隔线；也覆盖生物医学标题式“Spectroscopic study”及恒星、星系相关内容和论文结构标记。

patterns.name: 光谱学术语
patterns.context: 光谱学术语出现在论文标题、正文或观测方法描述中；有些触发集中在词首或被分词的子串上。
patterns.domain: 生物化学、化学与天文学研究文本

patterns.name: 观测与数据处理章节标题
patterns.trigger: “Observations and data reduction”“Observations and Data Reduction”及其下方的等号分隔线
patterns.context: ArXiv 论文中作为章节标题出现，通常紧随讨论或结论部分；段1、4、7、9标题处有强激活。

patterns.name: 结论章节标题与回顾语句
patterns.context: 论文总结、结论章节或章节交叉引用附近；既包括正文中的结论相关用语，也包括标题及其格式分隔线。

patterns.name: 恒星与星系天文学内容
patterns.context: 讨论恒星、星系、恒星族群及其观测或性质时；部分例子同时含光谱术语或观测章节标题。

patterns.name: 标题中的研究对象与研究动作
patterns.context: PubMed 摘要式标题开头，后接降解或分子相互作用研究对象；该模式与天文学正文中的光谱词汇共享字面形式，但文体不同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与化学论文标题

patterns.name: 章节格式标记与分隔符
patterns.context: ArXiv 文本中章节标题的结构化标记、标题锚点或视觉分隔线；等号分隔线本身也有很强激活。

patterns.name: 其他天文学论文结构语句
patterns.trigger: “Appendix contains a description”“finish with a discussion”“present further evidence”
patterns.context: 结论、附录或讨论部分的章节导航和论文组织语句；并不总是直接提及光谱或观测。

en.description: The strongest and most recurring pattern is the spectroscopic/spectroscopy stem, appearing in both biomedical and astronomy literature; a few astronomy terms and section-divider equals signs also activate. The spectroscopy-stem activation is prominent in passage 5, but its context is truncated; passage 10 also has local activations that do not fit the main pattern.

patterns.name: Spectroscopic spelling and forms
patterns.context: Activation on the spectroscopy stem in forms such as Spectroscopic, spectroscopic, and spectroscopy; the stem may be split across tokens.
patterns.domain: Abstracts, academic paper text, and section headings; including biochemistry and astronomy

patterns.name: NIR spectroscopy-template terminology
patterns.context: Context of near-infrared observations, bands, and templates of galaxy stellar populations; besides the spectroscopy stem, band in HK-band is also marked.

patterns.name: Narrowband imaging terminology
patterns.context: band in narrowband imaging terminology is marked when discussing high-redshift star formation and observational techniques.

patterns.name: Starburst-related terminology
patterns.context: When discussing other starburst events, starbursts is split into tokens and activates.

patterns.name: Strongly activated format marker
patterns.context: Consecutive equals signs used as a section divider in a paper; appearing after an observational data section heading.

1_1413.concept: 谱学词干及论文格式标记
1_1413.description: 最强且反复的模式是 spectroscopic/spectroscopy 词干，在生物医学和天文学文献中均出现；另有少量天文术语及章节分隔等号激活。第5段谱学词干激活明显，但所在上下文截断；第10段另有无法归入主模式的局部激活。

patterns.name: spectroscopic 拼写与词形
patterns.context: 对大小写形式 Spectroscopic、spectroscopic 及 spectroscopy 等词形中的谱学词干激活；词干可能跨 token 拆分。
patterns.domain: 摘要、学术论文正文和章节标题；覆盖生物化学与天文学等领域

patterns.name: NIR 光谱模板术语
patterns.context: 近红外观测、波段及星系恒星族群模板的语境；除谱学词干外，HK-band 中的 band 也被标记。

patterns.name: 窄带成像术语
patterns.context: 讨论高红移恒星形成及观测技术时，窄带成像术语中的 band 被标记。

patterns.name: 星爆相关术语
patterns.context: 讨论其他星爆事件时，starbursts 一词被分词拆开并激活。

patterns.name: 强激活格式标记
patterns.context: 论文中作为章节标题分隔线的连续等号；出现在观测数据章节标题之后。

en.description: Activations primarily cover section headings in astronomy papers, especially “Observations and data reduction,” conclusion headings, and equals-sign divider formatting; there are also sporadic responses to astronomical terms such as starburst, observatory, stellar models, and metallicity, as well as survey reports, news, and book review labels.

patterns.name: Observation and data-processing section headings
patterns.context: Appears as a standalone section heading, often followed by an equals-sign heading underline; “Observations” in the heading is especially consistently activated

patterns.name: Starburst terms in astronomy
patterns.context: Discusses starbursts or starburst rings in an astronomy context; may co-occur with observations and galaxy descriptions, but need not be a heading

patterns.name: Conclusion section headings
patterns.context: A conclusion section heading or a cross-reference to one; often accompanied by section-link markers

patterns.name: Observatory terms
patterns.context: Abstracts about public observatories and astronomy observation projects; activation falls on observatory-related word forms

patterns.name: Survey-report wording
patterns.context: Introduces statistical statements with a national survey report

patterns.name: Equals-sign-separated section heading format
patterns.context: A long string of equals signs is used as a divider beneath a heading; this format recurs across multiple passages, with activations concentrated at the end of the equals signs

patterns.name: Stellar population model terminology
patterns.context: Introduces stellar isochrone models or their literature citations, followed by Results, Color measurement, and other section headings

patterns.name: Metallicity and stellar age discussion
patterns.context: Discusses the ages and metallicities of globular clusters or stellar groups, and evidence from variable stars

patterns.name: Astronomers in astronomy news
patterns.context: A news-style sentence reports astronomers announcing a discovery; activation is concentrated on the word form astronomers

patterns.name: Journal book review metadata
patterns.context: A genre label appearing after journal volume, issue, and publisher information

1_1413.concept: 天文学论文结构与术语
1_1413.description: 激活主要覆盖天文学论文的章节标题，尤其“Observations and data reduction”、结论标题及等号分隔格式；另对星暴、天文台、恒星模型与金属丰度等天文词项，以及调查报告、新闻和书评标签有零散反应。

patterns.name: 观测与数据处理章节标题
patterns.trigger: “Observations and data reduction”及其变体“Observations and data reduction {#obs...}”“Observations and data reduction {#sec:observation}”
patterns.context: 作为独立章节标题出现，常紧接由等号构成的标题下划线；标题中的“Observations”尤其稳定地激活

patterns.name: 天文学中的星暴词项
patterns.context: 天文学语境中讨论星暴或星暴环；可能与观测、星系描述同现，但未必是标题

patterns.name: 结论章节标题
patterns.context: 结论章节标题或指向结论章节的交叉引用；常伴随章节链接标记

patterns.name: 天文台词项
patterns.context: 关于公共天文台、天文观测项目的摘要；激活落在 observatory 相关词形上

patterns.name: 调查报告措辞
patterns.context: 以全国性调查报告引出统计陈述

patterns.name: 等号分隔的章节标题格式
patterns.context: 标题下方使用长串等号作分隔；该格式在多段中反复出现，激活集中于等号末尾

patterns.name: 星族模型术语
patterns.context: 介绍恒星等时线模型或其文献引用，随后出现 Results、Color measurement 等章节标题

patterns.name: 金属丰度与恒星年龄讨论
patterns.trigger: “gradient in metallicity”“age-metallicity relation”“RR Lyrae variables”“old stars”
patterns.context: 讨论球状星团或恒星群的年龄、金属丰度及变量星证据

patterns.name: 天文学新闻中的 astronomers
patterns.context: 新闻式句子报道天文学家宣布发现；激活集中在 astronomers 词形

patterns.name: 期刊书评元数据
patterns.context: 期刊卷期与出版机构信息之后出现的文类标签

en.description: Primarily responds to the word spectroscopic, especially in paper titles, abstracts, or observational contexts; there is also activation on the endings of sculptors, Architectures, and engineers, and within the word Geographic.

patterns.name: Spectroscopy terminology
patterns.context: spectroscopic paired with academic words such as studies, study, or interaction; mainly in paper titles or abstracts, also in body text discussing astronomical observations.

patterns.name: Sculptor word forms
patterns.context: sculptor(s) appears in biographies or artist profiles; activation falls on the ending ors.

patterns.name: Geographic information system terminology
patterns.context: Explains the geographic feature numbers indicated by parenthesized numerals in a lake inventory; activation is concentrated within Geographic.

patterns.name: Architectures of Control proper name
patterns.context: A HackerNews post mentions a blog called Architectures of Control; activation falls on the ending of architectures.

patterns.name: Engineer suffix
patterns.context: An institutional profile lists scientists, engineers, and clinicians; activation falls on the ending of engineers.

1_1413.description: 主要响应 spectroscopic（光谱学）一词，尤其在论文标题、摘要或观测语境中；另对 sculptors、Architectures、engineers 等词的词尾，以及 Geographic 一词内部有激活。

patterns.name: 光谱学术语
patterns.context: spectroscopic 与 studies、study 或 interaction 等学术词搭配；以论文标题或摘要为主，也见于讨论天文观测的正文。
patterns.domain: 天文学、化学、生物医学论文

patterns.name: 雕塑家词形
patterns.context: sculptor(s) 出现在人物生平或艺术家介绍中，激活落在词尾 ors。

patterns.name: 地名信息系统术语
patterns.context: 解释湖泊清单中括号内数字所指的地理要素编号；激活集中在 Geographic 的词内部分。

patterns.name: Architectures of Control 专名
patterns.context: HackerNews 帖子提及名为 Architectures of Control 的博客，激活落在 architectures 的词尾。

patterns.name: 工程师词尾
patterns.context: 机构介绍中并列列举科学家、工程师和临床医生；激活落在 engineers 的词尾。

en.concept: Local patterns in word fragments and proper names
en.description: The most stable pattern is the ers ending in engineers, recurring in Hacker News; other sporadic activations fall on proper names or fragments such as Columbia, Neurorestoration, Picasa, and Greek mathematician.

patterns.name: Word ending in engineers
patterns.context: The word engineers is split into engine + ers, with activation on ers; usually in sentences about engineers, development teams, or engineering talent.

patterns.name: Columbia in institution names
patterns.context: Consecutive token fragments mark the proper name Columbia University; the sentence describes the author's employment history and published works.

patterns.name: Neuro in research institution names
patterns.context: Adjacent word fragments form Neurorestoration and Neurotechnology, appearing in a center name.

patterns.name: Software name fragment
patterns.context: The proper name Picasa is split, with activation concentrated on the suffix asa; the sentence discusses whether the software is open source.

patterns.name: Word ending in mathematician titles
patterns.context: A word fragment in Greek mathematician Proclus is marked, with strong activation on the ending ian in mathematician.

1_1413.concept: 词片段与专名的局部模式
1_1413.description: 最稳定模式是 engineers 的 ers 词尾，在 Hacker News 中反复出现；其余零散激活落在 Columbia、Neurorestoration、Picasa、Greek mathematician 等专名或词片段上。

patterns.name: engineers 的词尾
patterns.context: 单词 engineers 被切分为 engine + ers，激活落在 ers 上；多为谈论工程师、开发团队或工程人才的句子。

patterns.name: 机构名称中的 Columbia
patterns.context: 专名 Columbia University 的分词片段被连续标记；所在句介绍作者任职经历及发表作品。

patterns.name: 科研机构名称中的 Neuro
patterns.context: 紧邻的词片段组成 Neurorestoration and Neurotechnology，出现在中心名称中。

patterns.name: 软件名称片段
patterns.context: 专名 Picasa 被切分，激活集中在后缀 asa；句子谈论软件开源与否。

patterns.name: 数学家称谓中的词尾
patterns.context: Greek mathematician Proclus 的词片段被标记，强激活在 mathematician 的词尾 ian。

en.concept: Word endings er/ers and local lexical features
en.description: The most stable pattern is the -er ending across tokens in engineer-related words, generalizing to endings in astronomers, Architectures, and other words; there are also a few independent responses to reviews, best, and the Picasa subword.

patterns.name: Nominal ending -er
patterns.context: Words appear in forms such as engineer/engineered; activation is concentrated on the ending er across token boundaries, with varying roots.

patterns.name: Nominal ending -ers
patterns.context: The -ers ending in plural occupational or identity nouns.

patterns.name: Ending -ures
patterns.context: The ending -ures occurs in plural nouns; engineering semantics are not required.

patterns.name: Book-review publication name
patterns.context: reviews/review appears in the name of a publication or book-review column, surrounded by lists of media and periodicals.

patterns.name: best in school rankings
patterns.context: In a business-school ranking sentence, best modifies business schools.

patterns.name: Noun stem Picasa
patterns.context: The proper noun Picasa is split into tokens; appears in a discussion about whether software is closed source.

1_1413.concept: 词尾 er/ers 及局部词汇特征
1_1413.description: 最稳定的模式是工程师及相关词语中跨 token 的 -er 词尾，也泛化到 astronomers、Architectures 等词尾；另有少数对 reviews、best、Picasa 子词的独立响应。

patterns.name: 名词性词尾 -er
patterns.context: 词语以 engineer/engineered 等形式出现；激活集中在跨 token 边界的词尾 er，词根可不同。

patterns.name: 名词性词尾 -ers
patterns.context: 复数职业或身份名词中的 -ers 词尾。

patterns.name: 词尾 -ures
patterns.context: 词尾 -ures 出现在复数名词中；不要求工程师语义。

patterns.name: 书评出版物名称
patterns.context: reviews/review 出现在出版物或书评栏目名称中，周围列举媒体、刊物。

patterns.name: 学校排名中的 best
patterns.context: 商业学校排名句中，best 修饰 business schools。

patterns.name: 名词词干 Picasa
patterns.context: 专有名词 Picasa 被拆分为 token；出现在软件是否闭源的讨论中。

en.description: Activation occurs mainly on final substrings of several words, most prominently -or(s) in sculptor(s); local word endings also appear in observatory, Picasa, Review(s), and the Italian word lavoro. The triggered meanings and contexts vary.

patterns.name: English plural ending -ors
patterns.context: Words related to sculptors appear in English, especially the plural sculptors; the ending ors is marked in several segments.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, art history, literary prose

patterns.name: Observation-related word ending
patterns.context: The ending -atory in the English word observatory is strongly marked; this passage discusses a public observatory project.

patterns.name: Proper noun or intraword substring Picasa
patterns.context: The substring asa in the product name Picasa is marked twice; the context is photo-editing software.

patterns.name: Proper noun ending review(s)
patterns.context: Review/Reviews appears as part of a publication name or section heading, with the ending marked.
patterns.domain: Education ranking entries, book review directories

patterns.name: Italian word ending in lavoro
patterns.context: The ending oro in the Italian word lavoro (work) is marked; the sentence discusses workplace safety and health.

1_1413.description: 激活主要落在若干词的末尾子串：尤以 sculptor(s) 的 -or(s) 为突出；另见 observatory、Picasa、Review(s) 和意大利语 lavoro 的局部词尾。触发词义和语境各异。

patterns.name: 英文复数词尾 -ors
patterns.context: 英语中出现与雕塑家有关的词，尤其是复数 sculptors；词尾 ors 在多段被标记。
patterns.domain: 百科人物介绍、艺术史、文学散文

patterns.name: 观测相关词尾
patterns.context: 英语词 observatory 中的词尾 -atory 被强烈标记；本段谈公共观测台项目。

patterns.name: 专名或词内子串 Picasa
patterns.context: 产品名 Picasa 中间的子串 asa 被标记，两次出现；上下文是照片编辑软件。

patterns.name: 专名词尾 review(s)
patterns.context: Review/Reviews 作为出版物名或栏目标题的一部分出现，词尾被标记。
patterns.domain: 教育排名条目、书评目录

patterns.name: 意大利语 lavoro 词尾
patterns.context: 意大利语 lavoro（工作）中词尾 oro 被标记，句子讨论工作场所的安全与健康。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the final s of English plural nouns, especially in sculptors, Architects, climbers, and shoreline; there are also weak responses to line breaks and fragments within proper names, plus a single response to a code-variable suffix. Two other passages have no clear match.

patterns.name: English plural ending s
patterns.context: Activation falls on the final s or an adjacent letter, especially in plural nouns; also occurs on s within proper names or compounds.

patterns.name: Line breaks and formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Weak activation at line breaks between paragraphs, list items, or headings; often occurs in the same passage as final-s activation.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entries and other formatted text

patterns.name: Uppercase suffix in code identifier
patterns.context: In an uppercase, underscore-separated build-variable identifier, AN activates strongly, while FILES activates more weakly.

patterns.name: Local spelling in proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on an in-word fragment of a name or proper noun; strength varies and may be adjacent to or overlap with the final-s pattern.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia texts about people, institutions, and places

1_1413.concept: 英文词尾 s（尤指复数）
1_1413.description: 主要对英文复数名词词尾 s 有强响应，尤其 sculptors、Architects、climbers、shoreline；另有弱换行、专名内片段响应，及单例代码变量后缀响应。另两段未见清楚对应。

patterns.name: 英文复数词尾 s
patterns.context: 激活落在词尾 s 或紧邻词尾的字母上，尤其是名词复数；也见于专名或复合词内部的 s。

patterns.name: 换行及格式边界
patterns.context: 段落、条目或标题之间的换行处有弱激活；常与词尾 s 激活同段出现。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目及其他带格式文本

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的大写后缀
patterns.context: 大写、下划线分隔的构建变量标识符中，AN 强激活，FILES 也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 专名中的局部拼写
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名或专名的词内片段；强度不一，可能与词尾 s 模式相邻或重叠。
patterns.domain: 百科人物、机构及地名文本

en.description: Activation often falls on letter strings such as er/ers/ors at word ends or within words, especially in sculptors, Degrees, warbler, observatory, guide, time, and the name Sim iers; the shared orthographic cue is weak, and semantics and context may also contribute.

patterns.name: Plural noun ending -ors
patterns.context: Nouns ending in -or(s), especially words for occupations or categories of people; activation falls on the final ors/s.

patterns.name: Words ending in -ers/-ers
