patterns.context: DIRECTORY 作为 PHP 常量或代码标识符的一部分，而非普通散文词语

patterns.name: 词尾 ORY 的其他词
patterns.context: ORY 出现在普通词或标题中；segment 9 的“Designer”则是另一个强词尾激活，未见明确共同上下文
patterns.domain: 宣传网页标题与产品营销邮件

patterns.name: 无明确关联的科学词尾
patterns.context: 遥感研究摘要中关于海岸线测绘技术的讨论；激活落在“shoreline”的词尾

en.description: Activation is concentrated on three word forms: subcontractors in contract and employment contexts, DIRECTORY in uppercase and mixed-case forms, and archipelago in geographic contexts; there is no obvious shared semantic theme.

patterns.name: Subcontractor-related terms
patterns.context: Occurs in discussions of organizational staffing, project management, employment and time management, construction liability, or contractual disclaimers; refers to subcontractors and their conduct.
patterns.domain: Institutional descriptions, NIH project materials, business/legal texts

patterns.name: DIRECTORY word-form fragment
patterns.context: The ending of uppercase DIRECTORY; once in a roster heading and once in the PHP constant DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR.

patterns.name: Archipelago ending
patterns.context: An internal or final fragment of archipelago, describing island groups, geographic locations, or island ecology.

1_1413.description: 激活集中在三个词形：合同和用工语境中的 subcontractors、大小写形式的 DIRECTORY，以及地理语境中的 archipelago；没有明显共享的语义主题。

patterns.name: 分包商相关术语
patterns.context: 出现在组织人员构成、项目管理、雇佣与工时管理、施工责任或合同免责条款中，指分包商及其行为
patterns.domain: 机构介绍、NIH 项目材料、商业/法律文本

patterns.name: DIRECTORY词形片段
patterns.context: 大写 DIRECTORY 的词尾；一次出现在人名录标题中，一次出现在 PHP 常量 DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR 中

patterns.name: archipelago词尾
patterns.context: archipelago 一词的内部或词尾片段，描述岛群、地理位置或群岛生态

en.description: The strongest shared pattern is the ors ending of subcontractors, appearing in five passages about institutions, projects, and legal contexts. Other highlights are scattered across the endings of Designer, archipelago, Eulerian, and Companion, as well as the mathematical symbol Gamma, with no unified semantic or contextual pattern.

patterns.name: Plural ending of subcontractors
patterns.context: The trigger is the final plural suffix ors in subcontractors; occurs in contexts involving organizational staffing, project management, employment, and liability provisions
patterns.domain: Institutional profiles, grant applications, labor regulations, legal contracts

patterns.name: Endings of other split words
patterns.context: Highlights fall on suffixes or final segments within words, not a unified semantic category; each occurs in a different word and context
patterns.domain: Advertising, geographic encyclopedia entries, environmental science, fiction

patterns.name: Gamma in mathematical notation
patterns.context: Refers to the Euler Gamma function in a formula; the same passage also contains the Psi symbol, which is not marked

1_1413.description: 最强共同模式是 subcontractors 的词尾 ors，见于五段机构、项目及法律语境。其余高亮分散在 Designer、archipelago、Eulerian、Companion 的词尾，以及数学符号 Gamma，未见统一语义或上下文模式。

patterns.name: subcontractors 复数词尾
patterns.context: 触发位置是单词 subcontractors 的末尾复数后缀 ors；出现在组织人员构成、项目管理、雇佣和责任条款等语境中
patterns.domain: 机构介绍、项目申请、劳动法规、法律合同

patterns.name: 其他被切分词的词尾
patterns.trigger: “«er»8”于 Designer、“«ago»8”于 archipelago、“«ian»8”于 Eulerian、“«ion»7”于 Companion
patterns.context: 高亮落在词内部的后缀或末段，并非统一的语义类别；各自处于不同词和上下文中
patterns.domain: 广告、地理百科、环境科学、小说

patterns.name: 数学符号中的 Gamma
patterns.context: 在公式中指欧拉 Gamma 函数；同段也有 Psi 符号，但未标记

en.description: Activation falls mainly on word-final fragments: plural -ors in contract contexts, especially subcontractors, and the code directory constant DIRECTORY; there are also line in shoreline, rees in Degrees, and a word-final fragment in the heading EVOLUTIONARY.

patterns.name: “ors” suffix
patterns.context: Triggers are concentrated on the ending “ors,” especially in subcontractors; it also occurs in directors. Most examples are plural nouns.
patterns.domain: Institutional governance, government projects, construction contracts, and legal documents; spans items 1–5

patterns.name: DIRECTORY constant or path
patterns.context: Part of the DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR constant or a directory-related identifier in PHP code; activation is distributed within the identifier.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment line
patterns.context: Occurs in “shoreline mapping techniques,” as line at the end of the compound word; there are no other similar natural-language examples.
patterns.domain: Remote sensing and shoreline mapping academic abstract; spans item 9

patterns.name: “degrees” ending
patterns.context: Occurs in the venue name “Six Degrees,” triggering on the ending “rees”; a single example.

patterns.name: Ending fragment in Evolutionary
patterns.context: The ending “ARY” in an all-caps heading; occurs once and has no clear connection to the other patterns.
patterns.domain: Advocacy-style promotional text heading; spans item 6

1_1413.concept: 词尾片段与标识符子串
1_1413.description: 激活主要落在词尾片段：合同语境中的复数 -ors（尤其 subcontractors），以及代码目录常量 DIRECTORY；另有 shoreline 的 line、Degrees 的 rees 和标题 EVOLUTIONARY 的词尾片段。

patterns.name: “ors”后缀
patterns.context: 触发集中在词尾“ors”，尤其是 subcontractors；也出现在 directors。大多处于复数名词中。
patterns.domain: 机构治理、政府项目、建筑合同及法律文书；覆盖编号1–5

patterns.name: DIRECTORY 常量或路径
patterns.context: PHP 代码中作为 DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR 常量的一部分，或目录相关标识符；激活分散在标识符内部。

patterns.name: line 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在“shoreline mapping techniques”一词中，作为复合词末尾的 line；没有其他同类自然语言例子。
patterns.domain: 遥感与海岸线测绘学术摘要；覆盖编号9

patterns.name: “degrees”后缀
patterns.context: 出现在活动地点名称“Six Degrees”中，触发词尾“rees”；仅此一例。
patterns.domain: 活动宣传文案；覆盖编号10

patterns.name: Evolutionary 的词尾片段
patterns.context: 全大写标题中的词尾“ARY”；单次出现，和其他模式的联系不明确。
patterns.domain: 倡议类宣传文本标题；覆盖编号6

en.description: The main pattern is the -ors ending of “subcontractors,” occurring in institutional, contract, employment, and legal texts; there are also local activations in the PHP directory identifier DIRECTORY, template-constant fragments, and scattered endings, punctuation, and marketing-word fragments, which are difficult to group into one semantic feature.

patterns.name: subcontractors word form
patterns.context: The -ors ending of “subcontractors” is highlighted; preceding text discusses institutional staff, contracts, work duties, or legal liability.
patterns.domain: Institutional governance, project management, construction employment, and legal texts

patterns.name: DIRECTORY identifier
patterns.context: The DIRECTORY identifier in code appears in expressions related to PHP constants, directory paths, or directory separators; activation falls on an in-word fragment.

patterns.name: General word form directory
patterns.context: “DIRECTORY” appears in a title-style directory name, not a code path.
patterns.domain: Website promotional copy or directory headings

patterns.name: -ary ending
patterns.context: Activation falls respectively on the word-final fragments -ARY and -ian; the two examples occur in different contexts, with no stable shared contextual condition.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in template constants
patterns.context: PHP code involving template-directory constants and directory separators; activation lies within substrings of identifiers.

patterns.name: Scattered punctuation and formatting markers
patterns.context: These markers occur sporadically across passages, with no consistent semantic or contextual trigger; they may be secondary activations or tokenization-boundary effects.
patterns.domain: Various prose, code, and formatted text

patterns.name: Phrase fragments in marketing copy
patterns.context: Appears in a product-promotion email, with activation distributed across fragments in the marketing subject line and product description.

1_1413.concept: 词内后缀与标识符片段
1_1413.description: 主模式是“subcontractors”词尾 -ors，见于机构、合同、用工及法律文本；另有 PHP 目录标识符 DIRECTORY、模板常量片段，以及零散词尾、标点和营销词片段，难以归为同一语义特征。

patterns.name: subcontractors 词形
patterns.context: “subcontractors”一词的词尾 -ors 被突出；前文谈及机构人员、合同、工作责任或法律责任。
patterns.domain: 机构治理、项目管理、建筑用工与法律文本

patterns.name: DIRECTORY 标识符
patterns.context: 代码中的 DIRECTORY 标识符，出现在 PHP 常量、目录路径或目录分隔符相关表达中；激活落在词内片段。

patterns.name: directory 一般词形
patterns.context: “DIRECTORY”出现在标题式目录名称中，而非代码路径中。
patterns.domain: 网站宣传文案或目录标题

patterns.name: -ary 词尾
patterns.context: 激活分别落在词尾片段 -ARY 和 -ian；两例语境不同，未见稳定的共同上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 活动宣传文案；科学论文

patterns.name: 模板常量词内片段
patterns.context: PHP 代码中模板目录常量及目录分隔符名称；激活位于标识符内部的子串。

patterns.name: 零散标点与格式标记
patterns.trigger: « at»、« a»、« staff»、« with»、« interactions»、« work»、« there»、« over»、« for»、« at»、« ,»、« time»、« Show»、«case»、« <?»、«_»、« .»、« '»、«↵»
patterns.context: 这些标记在各段零散出现，缺少一致的语义或上下文触发条件；可能是次要激活或分词边界现象。
patterns.domain: 多种散文、代码及排版文本

patterns.name: 营销宣传中的词组片段
patterns.context: 出现在产品宣传邮件中，激活分布于营销标题和产品描述中的词片段。

en.concept: English word forms and subword fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to rallied (rebound, catch up, or recover) and selective forms, with isolated activation on fragments in Julie and Minority Communities; the latter two have unclear relations to the main pattern.

patterns.name: rallied forms
patterns.context: The stem rall followed by -ied, appearing in contexts of stock rebounds, teams catching up from a deficit, or someone recovering their composure.

patterns.name: selective-related forms
patterns.context: Selective or selective in compounds; concerns selectivity, non-selectivity, or selective treatment of a specific target.
patterns.domain: School descriptions, materials science, pharmacology, molecular biology

patterns.name: The name Julie
patterns.context: Greeting the recipient Julie at the start of an email; activation is concentrated on the name’s final ie.

patterns.name: The phrase minority communities
patterns.context: Minority Communities in the name of an HIV prevention research project.

1_1608.description: 主要响应 rallied（反弹、追赶或振作）及 selective 词形，另对 Julie 和 Minority Communities 中的片段有孤立激活；后两者与主模式的关系不明。

patterns.name: rallied 词形
patterns.context: 词干 rall 后接 -ied，出现在股票反弹、球队从落后局面追赶、或某人重新振作等语境。
patterns.domain: 新闻、体育报道、邮件叙述

patterns.name: selective 相关词形
patterns.context: selective 或复合词中的 selective；涉及选择性、非选择性或特定对象的选择性处理。
patterns.domain: 学校介绍、材料科学、药理学、分子生物学

patterns.name: 姓名 Julie
patterns.context: 邮件开头对收件人 Julie 的称呼，激活集中在姓名末尾 ie。

patterns.name: minority communities 短语
patterns.context: HIV prevention research 项目名称中的 Minority Communities。

en.description: The clearest recurring pattern is a response to the “rall” fragment in rally and spellings related to selective; there are also sporadic responses to internal fragments of proper names and to several words, abbreviations, or hyphenated forms. The latter two groups lack stable shared conditions.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in rallied
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the stem fragment “rall” in rallied, followed by the unmarked “ied”; it does not depend on a specific syntax and occurs in different contexts.
patterns.domain: News, sports narratives, dialogue, and financial texts

patterns.name: Selective-related endings
patterns.context: Triggers on selective, non-selective, and selective in compound words; activation varies in position, including stem or suffix portions, and the hyphen is also activated in some examples.
patterns.domain: School profiles, biomedical papers, and research proposals

patterns.name: Internal fragments of proper names and personal names
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal substrings of proper or personal names; token boundaries do not necessarily correspond to meaning or morphemes. These examples lack a clear shared semantics.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, email salutations, and research project names

patterns.name: Sporadic structural and word activations
patterns.context: Word fragments or short words activated in a few passages occur among abbreviations, proper names, common words, and technical terms, with no confirmed unified trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Political news, dialogue, email, and biomedical texts

1_1608.concept: 词形片段与选择性拼写检测
1_1608.description: 最清晰的重复模式是对 rally 的「rall」片段及 selective 相关拼写的响应；此外零散响应专名内部片段和若干词语、缩写或连字符。后两类缺少稳定共同条件。

patterns.name: rallied 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在 rallied 的词干片段「rall」，后接未标记的「ied」；不依赖特定句法，出现在不同语境中。
patterns.domain: 新闻、体育叙述、对话与财经文本

patterns.name: 选择性相关词尾
patterns.context: 在 selective、non-selective 及复合词中的 selective 触发；激活位置各异，包括词干或后缀部分，连字符在部分例子中也有激活。
patterns.domain: 学校介绍、生物医学论文与研究计划

patterns.name: 专名与人名内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或人名的内部子串，分词边界不一定对应词义或词素；这些例子彼此缺少清楚的共同语义。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、邮件称呼、研究项目名称

patterns.name: 零散结构与词语激活
patterns.context: 少数段落中出现的激活词片段或短词，分布在缩写、专名、普通词和技术术语中，缺少可确认的统一触发条件。
patterns.domain: 政治新闻、对话、邮件及生物医学文本

en.description: Activation occurs mainly on the rall subword in rallied; there are also sporadic responses to the full word selective or its ending, as well as to proper names, abbreviations, and other multi-token fragments, showing clear sensitivity to subword/token segmentation.

patterns.name: Segmentation of rallied
patterns.context: The word rallied is split into the prefix rall and suffix ied, and refers to a market, team, or person rebounding, recovering, or rallying; activation is concentrated on the prefix rall
patterns.domain: News, sports reporting, and narrative text

patterns.name: Ending of selective
patterns.context: Selective occurs in compound terms or technical contexts describing school admissions, material growth, drug functions, or DNA markers

patterns.name: Subword segmentation within proper names
patterns.context: Proper names are split into multiple tokens, with activation on an internal substring; examples refer to school, player, or company names

patterns.name: Abbreviations or uppercase-letter tokens
patterns.context: Abbreviations, initial combinations, or technical acronyms in parentheses are split into separate tokens

patterns.name: Subword in the name Julie
patterns.context: When addressing Julie, activation falls on a subword at the end of the name; the context is an email salutation

patterns.name: Split word fragments in “minority communities”
patterns.context: “Minority Communities” in a formal project name is split into multiple subwords

1_1608.description: 主要激活于 rallied 的 rall 子词；另对 selective 的完整词或词尾，以及专名、缩写和其他多词拆分片段有零散响应，呈现明显的子词/token 切分敏感性。

patterns.name: rallied 分词切分
patterns.context: 单词 rallied 被拆成前缀 rall 与后缀 ied，且该词指市场、球队或人物反弹、重整；激活集中在前缀 rall
patterns.domain: 新闻、体育报道及叙述性文字

patterns.name: selective 的词尾
patterns.context: selective 出现在描述学校招生、材料生长、药物功能或 DNA 标记的复合术语或技术语境中
patterns.domain: 百科、材料科学、生物医学

patterns.name: 专名内部子词切分
patterns.context: 专名被拆成多个 token，激活落在词内子串；各例对应学校、球员或公司名称

patterns.name: 缩写或大写字母 token
patterns.context: 缩写、首字母组合或括号中的技术简称被分成独立 token

patterns.name: Julie 名字中的子词
patterns.context: 称呼 Julie 时，激活落在名字末尾的子词；上下文为邮件称呼

patterns.name: minority communities 的拆分词片
patterns.context: 正式项目名称中的 Minority Communities 被分成多个子词

en.description: The most stable triggers are intra-word rall (always in rallied) and words related to selective; there is also activation on fragments within several proper names, company names, personal names, and Latvian words. Sporadic vocabulary is difficult to explain as a unified pattern.

patterns.name: Morphological fragment of rally within a word
patterns.context: The intra-word substring rall followed by -ied; used to describe stock-market gains, teams overcoming a deficit, and people responding or bouncing back.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in words related to selectivity
patterns.context: Appears in selective or its compounds, including non-selective; concerns school admissions characteristics and growth or pharmacological selectivity.

patterns.name: Token-like fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within proper names or names, rather than on complete word boundaries.

patterns.name: Cisco string fragment
patterns.context: The company name Cisco is split into C and isco; the same passage also mentions its stock rising, but activation is not on rally.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in the name Julie
patterns.context: The personal name Julie has split, intra-word activation; the context is a brief email opening.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Latvian
patterns.context: Appears within word forms in Latvian text; activation is distributed across multiple intra-word fragments and is difficult to explain with a single word meaning.

patterns.name: Other sporadic vocabulary activations
patterns.context: Isolated occurrences in political, materials-science, and other texts, with no common trigger condition confirmed by the available samples.

1_1608.description: 最稳定的触发是词内 rall（均为 rallied）和 selective 相关词；另有若干专名、公司名、人名及拉脱维亚语词内片段激活，零散词汇难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 词内 rally 的形态片段
patterns.context: 词内子串 rall 后接 -ied；分别用于描述股市上涨、球队扳回劣势，以及人物回应或反弹。
patterns.domain: 新闻、体育叙事、对话/评论

patterns.name: 选择性相关词的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 selective 或其复合词中，包括 non-selective；涉及学校招生属性及生长/药理选择性。
patterns.domain: 百科、材料科学、生物医学

patterns.name: 专名内的分词式片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或名称的内部子词片段，而非完整词边界。
patterns.domain: 百科、体育、生物医学项目名称

patterns.name: Cisco 字符串片段
patterns.context: 公司名 Cisco 被拆成 C 与 isco 两段；同段还提及其股票上涨，但激活并未标在 rally 上。

patterns.name: Julie 名字内部片段
patterns.context: 人名 Julie 在词内拆分激活；上下文是简短邮件开头。

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在拉脱维亚语文本的词形内部；激活分布于多个词内片段，难以由单一词义说明。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本/拉脱维亚语

patterns.name: 其他零散词汇激活
patterns.context: 孤立分布于政治、材料科学等文本中，未形成可由现有样本确认的共同触发条件。

en.description: The most prominent activation is on the full word form rallied; there are also sporadic activations on selective and related forms, proper names, and several segmented fragments. The fragments cannot all be reduced to a stable, singular semantic or formal pattern.

patterns.name: Word form rallied
patterns.context: In English narratives, rallied often means that a stock price, team, or person rebounded, recovered, or responded after a setback; the stem and suffix are segmented.

patterns.name: Selective-related terminology
patterns.context: Selective modifies nouns as a technical term, covering selective school, selective growth, and pathway-selective compounds; activation falls on different segments of the word.

patterns.name: Segmentation within proper names
patterns.context: Proper names or foreign words are split into multiple subword fragments, involving place names, personal names, and Polish word forms; it is unclear whether segmentation itself triggers the pattern.

patterns.name: Spelling segmentation or local activation on short words
patterns.context: Activation falls on word fragments split by the tokenizer, but the words and contexts vary considerably, with no shared semantic condition apparent.

patterns.name: No clear corresponding pattern
patterns.context: Activation occurs on sporadic fragments in materials science terminology, as well as in email salutations or common phrases; there is no clear link to the other patterns.

1_1608.description: 最突出的是 rallied 的完整词形；另有 selective 及相关词形、专名和若干分词片段的零散激活。无法将全部片段归结为稳定的单一语义或形式规律。

patterns.name: rallied 词形
patterns.context: 英语叙述中出现 rallied，常表示股价、球队或人物在受挫后反弹、振作或回应；词干与后缀分段标记。

patterns.name: 选择性相关术语
patterns.context: selective 作为术语修饰名词，涵盖 selective school、选择性生长及 pathway-selective compounds；激活落在词的不同分段上。
patterns.domain: 百科、材料科学、生物医学

patterns.name: 专名内部切分
patterns.context: 专有名称或外语词被分成多个子词片段，涉及地名、姓名及波兰语词形；模式是否由切分本身触发不确定。

patterns.name: 拼写切分或短词局部激活
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词器拆开的词片段上，但所涉词汇和语境差异较大，未见共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 无明显对应模式
patterns.context: 激活出现在材料科学术语中的零散片段，以及邮件称呼或普通短语；与其他模式缺乏清楚联系。

en.concept: Detection of specific stems and subword fragments
en.description: Strongly responds primarily to the rall fragment in rallied and intra-word fragments in selective; there is also sporadic activation on split fragments in Param, Minority, Wolverhampton, vapour, and code identifiers.

patterns.name: Stem fragment in rallied
patterns.context: The English past-tense verb rallied is split into rall + ied, with activation concentrated on the stem fragment rall; occurs in contexts including stock prices, team comebacks, and people responding.

patterns.name: Stem fragment in selective
patterns.context: Forms such as selective, non-selective, area-selective, and pathway-selective; strong activation on an internal word fragment in selective.
patterns.domain: School descriptions, materials-science papers, pharmacological research

patterns.name: ParamServiceReference type name
patterns.context: The compound code identifier ParamServiceReference and a subsequent type conversion error; activation is concentrated on the Param fragment.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in Minority
patterns.context: In the proper-name phrase Minority Communities, the word is split into Min and ority; activation is concentrated on the latter fragment, ority.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Wolverhampton
patterns.context: The UK place and school name Wolverhampton is tokenized into multiple fragments, with activation on parts such as olver and ham.

patterns.name: Fragment in the compound term vapour-liquid-solid
patterns.context: In the materials-growth term vapour-liquid-solid, the initial fragment of vapour and the hyphen are activated.

patterns.name: ParametricPlot in plotting code
patterns.context: Activation on the Param fragment of the Mathematica-style function name ParametricPlot; the same passage also contains plotting parameters and label code.

patterns.name: Other rare intra-word fragments
patterns.context: A few proper names, brands, or all-caps error messages are split into multiple subword fragments; no clear shared semantics with the main stem pattern.

1_1608.concept: 特定词干与子词片段探测
1_1608.description: 主要对 rallied 中的 rall 片段及 selective 的词内片段强烈响应；另对 Param、Minority、Wolverhampton、vapour 等被拆分的词片段和代码标识符有零散激活。

patterns.name: rallied 的词干片段
patterns.context: 英文过去式动词 rallied 被切分成 rall + ied，激活集中在词干片段 rall；见于股价、球队逆转和人物回应等不同语境。

patterns.name: selective 的词干片段
patterns.context: 出现 selective、non-selective、area-selective 或 pathway-selective 等形式；对 selective 的内部词片段有明显激活。
patterns.domain: 学校介绍、材料科学论文、药理研究

patterns.name: ParamServiceReference 类型名
patterns.context: 代码中的复合标识符 ParamServiceReference 及其后续类型转换错误；激活集中于 Param 词片段。

patterns.name: Minority 的词内片段
patterns.context: 专名短语 Minority Communities 中，词被切分为 Min 与 ority；激活集中于后半片段 ority。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目名称、公共卫生

patterns.name: Wolverhampton 的词内片段
patterns.context: 英国地名及学校名称 Wolverhampton 被分词为多个片段，激活涉及 olver、ham 等部分。

patterns.name: vapour-liquid-solid 复合术语片段
patterns.context: 材料生长术语 vapour-liquid-solid 中，vapour 的起始片段及连字符有激活。

patterns.name: 绘图代码中的 ParametricPlot
patterns.context: Mathematica 风格代码中 ParametricPlot 函数名的 Param 片段激活；同段还有图形参数与标签代码。

patterns.name: 其他稀有词内切分片段
patterns.context: 少数专名、品牌或全大写错误提示被拆分为多个子词片段；与主要词干模式没有明确共同语义。

en.description: The strongest and most repeated trigger is tokenized rallied (4 segments); there is also strong activation on fragments in portfolio, code identifiers Param/Parametric, and the patent term foaming. The triggers span multiple domains and show no unified semantic or stylistic condition.

patterns.name: rallied form
patterns.context: In English, the stem of rallied is split into the two tokens rall and ied; it can occur in sentences describing a rebound, recovery, or resumption of action.
patterns.domain: News, sports reporting, and general narrative

patterns.name: Other forms containing rall
patterns.context: The same tokenized stem occurs in non-obvious semantic collocations, such as “rallied” in response to criticism; no other rall forms are observed.

patterns.name: portfolio substring
patterns.context: The complete word portfolio, referring either to a collection of work or an investment portfolio; contexts include a webpage-link question and a discussion of financial assets.

patterns.name: Param substring in code
patterns.context: Param/Parametric in code identifiers, including uses for parameter types, service references, or encoding parameters.

patterns.name: Spelling fragments in foaming
patterns.context: In patent technical text, foaming is split into fo and aming, describing a foam-filled space in a door-frame construction.

1_1608.description: 最强且重复的触发是分词后的 rallied（4段）；另对 portfolio、代码标识符 Param/Parametric 及专利词 foaming 的片段有强激活。触发词跨多个领域，未显示统一语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: rallied 词形
patterns.context: 英语中 rallied 的词干被分成 rall 与 ied 两个 token；可出现在句中描述反弹、恢复或重新行动。
patterns.domain: 新闻、体育报道及一般叙述

patterns.name: 含 rall 的其他词形
patterns.context: 同一分词形式的词干出现在非显然的语义搭配中，如“rallied”回应质疑；未见其他 rall 词形。

patterns.name: portfolio 子串
patterns.context: 完整单词 portfolio，分别指作品集或投资组合；上下文分别为网页链接问题和金融资产讨论。

patterns.name: 代码中的 Param 子串
patterns.context: 代码标识符中的 Param/Parametric，包含参数类型、服务引用或编码参数等用法。

patterns.name: foaming 拼写片段
patterns.context: 专利技术文本中，foaming 被拆成 fo 与 aming，描述门框构造中的发泡填充空间。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on “portfolio” (collection of work or investment portfolio), “rallied” (rebounded or recovered), and a few investment terms; there is also sporadic activation in a passage about ACA politics that is difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: The word portfolio
patterns.context: The word itself appears in contexts involving a collection of work or an investment portfolio; it triggers both in the compound “portfolio-style” and in financial contexts.
patterns.domain: Web Q&A, academic abstracts, financial and business texts

patterns.name: rallied and its forms
patterns.context: Describes a rise, rebound, or recovery; the subjects include global stock markets, teams, people, or stocks.
patterns.domain: Economic news, sports encyclopedia, personal narratives

patterns.name: Investment-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Mentions investment in financial or economic contexts; may occur near infrastructure, portfolios, or risk and return.
patterns.domain: Economic news, corporate email, personal finance Q&A

patterns.name: ACA political passage
patterns.context: A sentence about Rand Paul opposing the Affordable Care Act and “Obamacare Lite”; several common words in it appear only in this passage.

1_1608.description: 激活集中于“portfolio”（作品集或投资组合）、“rallied”（反弹或振作）及少量投资词；另有一段 ACA 政治语句中的零散激活，难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: portfolio 一词
patterns.context: 词本身出现在作品集、投资组合等语境；无论是复合词“portfolio-style”还是金融语境均触发。
patterns.domain: 网页问答、学术摘要、金融与商业文本

patterns.name: rallied 及其词形
patterns.context: 描述回升、反弹或重新振作；主语分别是全球股市、球队、人物或股票。
patterns.domain: 经济新闻、体育百科、个人叙述

patterns.name: 投资相关词汇
patterns.context: 金融或经济语境中提及投资；可与基础设施、投资组合或风险收益相邻。
patterns.domain: 经济新闻、企业邮件、个人理财问答

patterns.name: ACA 政治语段
patterns.context: 关于兰德·保罗反对《平价医疗法案》及“Obamacare Lite”的句子；其中多个常见词仅在此段出现。

en.description: Activation is most prominent on portfolio and the stem rall (often in rallied), but the latter spans financial, sports, and everyday contexts. There are also intra-word fragments in medical terms, academic abstract formatting, and sporadic words, which are difficult to explain with a single semantic account.

patterns.name: portfolio
patterns.context: Mentions investment portfolios, particularly portfolio diversification or bond portfolios; in passage 1 it also appears in a collection-of-work context in a webpage-link question.

patterns.name: rallied and its forms
patterns.context: The stem rall followed by an ending triggers in descriptions of stocks/markets rising, teams overcoming a deficit, or someone regaining composure; semantics and domains vary.
patterns.domain: Financial news, sports reporting, personal narratives

patterns.name: Fragments in medical vocabulary
patterns.context: Medical terms or their intra-word fragments are marked after splitting; a strong marker falls on an intra-word fragment in “masquerading,” while other examples activate more weakly.

patterns.name: Abstract formatting and mathematical terms
patterns.context: The opening format of an ArXiv abstract and technical statements in abstracts; strong activation is concentrated on portfolio, while format markers themselves are weaker.

patterns.name: Other sporadic words and local markers
patterns.context: Distributed across different syntactic positions and contexts, with no common semantics or stable context; some are common function words or split words.

1_1608.concept: 不一致的词汇与子词特征
1_1608.description: 激活以 portfolio 及词干 rall（常见于 rallied）最突出，但后者跨金融、体育和日常语境。另有医学词内片段、学术摘要格式及零散词语，难以由单一语义解释。

patterns.name: portfolio
patterns.context: 提到投资组合，特别是组合多元化或债券组合；第1段也出现在网页链接问题中的作品集语境。
patterns.domain: 金融、投资及网页/设计问答

patterns.name: rallied 及其词形
patterns.context: 词干 rall 后接词尾，在描述股票/市场上涨、球队扳回劣势或某人恢复镇定时触发；语义和领域并不一致。
patterns.domain: 金融新闻、体育报道、个人叙述

patterns.name: 医学词汇中的片段
patterns.context: 医学术语或其词内片段被拆分标记；较强标记落在“masquerading”的词内片段，其他例子激活较弱。

patterns.name: 摘要格式及数学术语
patterns.context: ArXiv 摘要开头格式，以及摘要中的技术表述；强激活集中在 portfolio 一词，格式标记本身较弱。
patterns.domain: 学术论文摘要（物理、金融）

patterns.name: 其他零散词语与局部标记
patterns.trigger: «Q»、« a»、« specific»、« benefits»、« upset»、« Obamacare»、« investments»、« important»、« profess»
patterns.context: 分布于不同句法位置和语境，未见共同语义或稳定上下文；其中部分是常见功能词或被拆分的词。

en.description: Activation falls mainly on administration (drug administration or application) and its collocations with dosage and experimental conditions in biomedical texts, as well as mild modifying injuries or diseases (mild or mild-to-moderate); it also responds to administration in the project/system management sense and more weakly to medical research terminology.

patterns.name: administration and its collocations
patterns.context: In research or experimental descriptions, refers to administering or applying drugs, ethanol, stimuli, etc., and often appears with dosage, timing, and experimental conditions.

patterns.name: Mild trauma and mild-to-moderate injuries
patterns.context: The severity modifier mild, often adjacent to traumatic, injury, TBI, disorder, or insult; sometimes extended to mild-to-moderate.
patterns.domain: Clinical medicine, biomedical abstracts and research plans

patterns.name: Administrative usage
patterns.context: Administration means management of a project, contract, or system, rather than drug administration; occurs in project planning or personal system-management contexts.

patterns.name: Other medical experimental descriptions
patterns.context: Neuroimaging research mentions brain-region activation, or tissue-engineering/muscle research discusses regenerative capacity; neither has the above administration or mild-injury collocation.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central neuroscience papers; PubMed biomedical abstracts

1_1608.description: 激活主要落在生物医学文本中的 administration（给药或施用）及其剂量、实验条件搭配，以及 mild（轻度/轻中度）修饰损伤或疾病；另能响应项目/系统管理义的 administration，并较弱涉及医学研究术语。

patterns.name: administration及其搭配
patterns.context: 在研究或实验描述中，指药物、乙醇、刺激物等的给药或施用，并常连着剂量、时间、实验条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、实验研究计划

patterns.name: 轻度创伤及轻中度损伤
patterns.trigger: «mild»10 traumatic brain injury；«mild»9-«moderate» cannabis use disorder；«mild»-«moderate» TBI；«mild» physical or chemical insult
patterns.context: 严重程度修饰语 mild，常与 traumatic、injury、TBI、disorder 或 insult 相邻；有时扩展为 mild-to-moderate。
patterns.domain: 临床医学、生物医学摘要与研究计划

patterns.name: 行政管理用法
patterns.context: administration 指项目、合同或系统管理，而非药物施用；出现在项目安排或个人系统管理的语境中。
patterns.domain: 项目管理说明、HackerNews 技术讨论

patterns.name: 其他医学实验描述词
patterns.context: 神经影像研究提及脑区激活，或组织工程/肌肉研究谈再生能力；未见上述 administration 或 mild 损伤搭配。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 神经科学论文；PubMed 生物医学摘要

en.concept: Methods and technical expressions in academic papers
en.description: Most notable activation is on the academic-text use of “resort to” and on “kinetics”; the rest is distributed across iterative computation, paper structure and scientific discussion, and split technical terms, with no stable shared semantic or syntactic condition across these patterns.

patterns.name: Methodological use of resort
patterns.context: Appears in the structure “need/having to resort to,” meaning having to adopt a different method or means; the trigger is mainly resort and does not require a fixed domain.
patterns.domain: Academic paper body text, including machine learning, theoretical physics, and mathematical proofs

patterns.name: Kinetics and chemical reaction terminology
patterns.context: Appears as a term in academic titles or body text for studying the kinetics of reactions or processes.

patterns.name: Terms related to iterative processes
patterns.context: Describes computational methods or processes performed repeatedly, often near approximation, solving, and acceleration.

patterns.name: Academic paper title or abstract opening
patterns.context: Paper-structure markers or opening phrasing in abstracts; activation words vary, with no single stable lexical item.

patterns.name: Scientific evaluation and research descriptions
patterns.context: Describes experimental evaluation, research work, or argumentative results, with no shared immediately adjacent grammatical structure.

patterns.name: Technical terms and complex-term fragments
patterns.context: Technical terms are tokenized or split and include scientific concepts, but the topics of the terms vary.
patterns.domain: Physics, mathematics, and computational science papers

1_1608.concept: 学术论文中的方法与技术表达
1_1608.description: 激活最明显的是学术文本中的“resort to”用法及“kinetics”；其余分布于迭代计算、论文结构与科学论述、拆分的技术术语，未见这些模式共享的稳定语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: resort 的方法论用法
patterns.context: 出现在“need/having to resort to”结构中，表示不得不改用某种方法或手段；触发点主要是 resort，本身不要求固定领域
patterns.domain: 学术论文正文，涉及机器学习、理论物理、数学证明等

patterns.name: 动力学与化学反应术语
patterns.context: 在学术标题或正文中，作为研究反应或过程动力学的术语出现
patterns.domain: 化学、物理及交叉学科论文

patterns.name: 迭代过程相关术语
patterns.context: 描述反复执行的计算方法或过程，常与近似、求解及加速相邻
patterns.domain: 计算科学与数值方法论文

patterns.name: 学术论文标题或摘要开头
patterns.context: 论文结构标记或摘要开场措辞；激活词并不统一，缺乏单一稳定词项

patterns.name: 科学评估与研究描述
patterns.context: 描述实验评估、研究工作或论证结果，未显示共同的紧邻语法结构

patterns.name: 技术名词及复杂术语片段
patterns.context: 技术术语被分词或拆分，包含科学概念，但术语间主题各异
patterns.domain: 物理、数学与计算科学论文

en.description: Activation is concentrated on the word principle, especially in fixed technical terms or “principle of” constructions; triggers span physics, mathematics, statistics, engineering, and patent texts.

patterns.name: Principle as a methodological or theoretical term
patterns.context: “Principle” appears in technical texts, whether referring to a basic principle, constraint, statistical method, mathematical optimization, or physical radiation condition; paragraph 8 contains the phrase “in principle”

patterns.name: Fixed term “uncertainty principle”
patterns.context: The term-final “principle” is activated in a passage on quantum theory of the vacuum and virtual particles

1_1608.description: 激活集中出现在 principle 一词上，尤其是技术语境中的固定术语或“principle of”结构；触发范围跨物理、数学、统计、工程及专利文本。

patterns.name: principle 作为方法或理论术语
patterns.trigger: “principle”及其紧邻上下文；常见形式为“principle of”（1、4、5、9）或“principle”后接专名（2、6、7、10）
patterns.context: 技术性文本中出现“principle”，无论它指基本原理、约束条件、统计方法，还是数学优化/物理辐射条件；第8段为短语“in principle”
patterns.domain: 跨领域学术与专利文本

patterns.name: uncertainty principle 固定术语
patterns.context: 讨论真空与虚粒子的量子理论段落中，术语末尾“principle”激活

en.concept: Expressions of methods, constructions, and principles
en.description: Responds strongly to expressions related to methods, constructions, and principles, such as construction and principle, across academic and patent texts; it also responds to proofs, definitions, theories, and section descriptions. Quantum popular science, mathematical notation, and engineering background are distinct contexts, with no single narrow topic evident.

patterns.name: Construction and its academic description
patterns.context: Describes proposing, using, or proving a construction, method, principle, or theoretical result in a paper abstract or body; often a noun has a modifier before it or is followed by its use or proof basis.
patterns.domain: Academic papers spanning quantum information, networks, mathematics, physics, and other fields

patterns.name: principle in proper names
patterns.context: The word appears in the name of a specific method or theory, rather than in the general sense of a principle: for example, “maximum entropy principle,” “Kepler’s principle,” “transfer principle,” and “principle layers.”
patterns.domain: Proper names, terminology, and technical definitions in academic papers

patterns.name: Quantum-theory terminology
patterns.context: Discusses quantum fields, quantum theory, or vacuum effects; activation here is concentrated on “theory” and “principle” in related terminology.

patterns.name: Section and definitional structures
patterns.context: The paper reviews definitions by section, fixes notation, and explains the mathematical constructions needed later.

patterns.name: Terminology for layers in a layered system
patterns.context: Describes a layered system that groups atoms into sufficiently thick layers; activation covers “principle” and adjacent technical expressions.

patterns.name: Engineering principles and equipment background
patterns.context: A patent background explains that an electronic balance weighing module is based on a particular operating principle.

patterns.name: General statements of results and arguments
patterns.context: Discusses whether a quantity or object is well-defined, whether a result holds, or the methods underlying a proof or derivation; not all are synonymous with “construction.”

patterns.name: Possible local activation on word forms/tokenization
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences describing improving a scheme, deriving one from a construction, or developing a theory; activation is scattered and relatively weak.

patterns.name: Unexplained local activation
patterns.context: Sporadic activation in symbolic mathematical text; its relationship to the dominant lexical pattern is difficult to determine from the fragment.
patterns.domain: Mathematical paper formulas and typesetting fragments

1_1608.description: 跨领域学术与专利文本中，对 construction、principle 等方法、构造和原理相关表述反应明显；也响应证明、定义、理论及章节说明。量子科普、数学符号和工程背景等是不同语境，未见单一狭义主题。

patterns.name: 构造及其学术描述
patterns.context: 在论文摘要或正文中描述提出、使用或证明某种构造、方法、原理或理论结果；常见于名词前有定语或后接用途、证明依据
patterns.domain: 学术论文，跨量子信息、网络、数学、物理等领域

patterns.name: 专名中的 principle
patterns.context: 该词出现在特定方法或理论名称中，而非一般意义的原理：如“maximum entropy principle”“Kepler’s principle”“transfer principle”“principle layers”
patterns.domain: 学术论文中的专名、术语及技术定义

patterns.name: 量子理论术语
patterns.context: 讨论量子场、量子理论或真空效应；此处激活集中于相关术语中的“theory”和“principle”

patterns.name: 章节及定义性结构
patterns.context: 论文按章节回顾定义、固定符号，并说明后文需要的数学构造

patterns.name: 分层系统中的术语层
patterns.context: 描述分层系统，将原子分组为足够厚的层；激活覆盖“principle”及相邻技术表述
patterns.domain: 计算物理/材料科学论文

patterns.name: 工程原理及设备背景
patterns.context: 专利背景中说明电子天平称重模块基于某种工作原理

patterns.name: 一般的结果陈述与论证
patterns.context: 论述量或对象定义良好、结果成立，或解释证明/推导所依据的方法；并非都与“construction”同义

patterns.name: 可能的词形/分词局部激活
patterns.context: 出现在描述方案改进、方案由构造导出或理论发展的句子中，激活分散且强度较低

patterns.name: 未充分解释的局部激活
patterns.trigger: «principle»10之外的数字、公式及邻近碎片，如«3»4、«34»、«orb»6
patterns.context: 符号化数学文本中出现的零散激活，难以从片段确认其与主导词汇模式的关系
patterns.domain: 数学论文公式及排版片段

en.description: Covers several contexts: trying new things, proposing remedies, and isolated paper or encyclopedia phrases (interference effects, vacuum, three-dimensionality, and multitask problems); no unified, clear trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Experimentation or trying
patterns.context: Refers to conducting experiments, trying something out, or attempting a new approach; followed by with to introduce the object or domain of the attempt.
patterns.domain: Personal projects, fitness advice, music styles

patterns.name: Remedying problems or difficulties
patterns.context: After describing a problem, defect, or difficulty, proposes a method intended to solve it.
patterns.domain: Machine learning, quantum information research papers

patterns.name: Interference effect
patterns.context: Effect is used with interference to describe a predicted or studied physical effect.

patterns.name: Prepositional phrase involving a vacuum
patterns.context: Describes the location where virtual particle pairs form, with intervening modifying vacuum.

patterns.name: Three-dimensional quantity phrase
patterns.context: Three is followed by dimensional to describe a three-dimensional octahedral constellation; activation falls on the number word.

patterns.name: Complex multitask problems
patterns.context: The application involves complex multitask problems, followed by examples such as disaster relief, logistics, and manufacturing.

1_1608.description: 覆盖多类语境：尝试新事物、提出补救方案，以及若干孤立的论文或百科短语（干扰效应、真空、三维、多任务问题）；未见统一的明确触发规律。

patterns.name: 实验或尝试
patterns.context: 指进行实验、试用或尝试新做法；后接 with 引出尝试对象或领域。
patterns.domain: 个人项目、健身建议、音乐风格

patterns.name: 补救问题或困难
patterns.context: 在描述某种问题、缺陷或困难后，提出旨在解决它的方法。
patterns.domain: 机器学习、量子信息研究论文

patterns.name: 干扰效应
patterns.context: effect 与 interference 连用，描述预测或研究的物理效应。

patterns.name: 真空中的介词短语
patterns.context: 描述虚粒子对形成的位置，intervening 修饰 vacuum。

patterns.name: 三维数量短语
patterns.context: three 后接 dimensional，描述三维八面体星座；激活落在数字词。
patterns.domain: 通信或信号处理论文摘要

patterns.name: 涉及复杂多任务问题
patterns.context: 应用场景涉及复杂的多任务问题，随后列举灾害救援、物流、制造等实例。

en.description: Primarily activates on the suffix -otomy, as in dichotomy and axotomy, which differ in meaning and domain; there is also sporadic activation in complex multi-task problem statements and an abstract on the Pontryagin maximum principle, neither clearly related to the main pattern.

patterns.name: Suffix -otomy
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the “otomy” substring at the end of words; prefixes and meanings vary, while the shared substring persists across word boundaries.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain texts, including academic papers, forum discussions, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: multi-task / compound problem expressions
patterns.context: Describes abstract texts involving complex, multi-task problems and their applications; has no clear connection to the suffix -otomy.

patterns.name: PMP terminology fragments
patterns.context: Terminology related to the geometric discrete-time Pontryagin maximum principle; activation is scattered across the terms and surrounding words.

1_1608.description: 主要对词尾 -otomy 激活，见 dichotomy 和 axotomy，语义及领域各异；另有复杂多任务问题表述和 Pontryagin 最大值原理摘要中的零散激活，二者与主模式无明显关联。

patterns.name: 词尾 -otomy
patterns.context: 激活集中在单词末尾的“otomy”子串；前缀和词义不同，跨越词边界时该子串仍是共同点。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括学术论文、论坛讨论和百科条目

patterns.name: multi-task / 复合问题表达
patterns.context: 描述涉及复杂、多任务问题及其应用的抽象文本；与词尾 -otomy 无明显联系。

patterns.name: PMP 术语片段
patterns.context: 几何离散时间 Pontryagin 最大值原理相关术语；激活分散在术语及其周边词上。

en.description: Activation is distributed across methods, constructions, physical principles, and technical terms in academic texts, and also appears on words such as spirit, dichotomy, and colloquial ban; no single stable trigger word or unified semantics is apparent.

patterns.name: Methods and research-contribution statements in academic abstracts
patterns.context: An abstract or paper introduction states the research method, presents a new construction, or introduces the article's content; activation falls on several words in research terminology or contribution statements.

patterns.name: Expressions related to “spirit”
patterns.context: The word spirit appears in contexts expressing an idea, style, or background; one example is “in spirit,” another refers to a conference atmosphere, and a third describes a person's character.

patterns.name: Nested hierarchy and grammar
patterns.context: Mentions parsing nested hierarchy and asks about grammar; the passage also contains «spirit».

patterns.name: Principles and group structure in mathematical physics
patterns.context: A paper abstract introduces a discrete-time maximum principle on matrix Lie groups; activation occurs on terms such as principle and Lie groups.

patterns.name: Physics terminology and theoretical structures
patterns.context: Different physics passages contain terms such as spin transport, Haldane exclusion statistics, or classical formalism and gravitational principles; activation is distributed across proper names and theoretical vocabulary.
patterns.domain: ArXiv physics paper abstracts and body text

patterns.name: Particle production and fragmentation models
patterns.context: Discusses particle production in hadron collisions, diquark fragmentation models, and a long-standing dichotomy.
patterns.domain: ArXiv high-energy physics paper body text

patterns.name: Whether a phenomenon persists after a smoking ban
patterns.context: Colloquially asks whether a phenomenon persists after a smoking ban and discusses indoor smoking and a rock-and-roll spirit; no terminological pattern consistent with the other passages is apparent.

patterns.name: Human nature and dichotomy in philosophy
patterns.context: Discusses whether humans are complex machines or an interaction of soul and body, and notes that this dichotomy does not exhaust the possibilities.

patterns.name: Tutorial on disk radiation in astrophysics
patterns.context: States the chapter's purpose: to introduce how observations of disk radiation can reveal its physical properties, and mentions the conference context.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper or book chapter body text

1_1608.concept: 学术与理论性词汇（宽泛）
1_1608.description: 激活分布在学术文本中的方法、构造、物理原理与专业术语，也出现在 spirit、二分法及口语 ban 等词上；未见单一稳定触发词或统一语义。

patterns.name: 学术摘要中的方法与研究贡献表述
patterns.context: 摘要或论文介绍中陈述研究方法、提出的新构造或介绍文章内容；激活落在研究术语或贡献陈述中的若干词上。

patterns.name: “spirit”相关表达
patterns.context: 词 spirit 出现在表达某种思想、风格或背景的上下文中；一例是“in spirit”，另一例指会议氛围，还有一例用来形容人物气质。

patterns.name: 嵌套层级与语法
patterns.context: 提及解析 nested hierarchy，并询问语法；这一段还出现了 «spirit»。

patterns.name: 数学物理中的原则与群结构
patterns.context: 论文摘要介绍矩阵 Lie 群上的离散时间最大值原理；principle 和 Lie groups 等术语处激活。

patterns.name: 物理学术语与理论结构
patterns.context: 不同物理学段落中出现自旋输运、Haldane 排斥统计，或经典形式体系与引力原理等术语；激活分布于专名和理论词汇。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 物理学论文摘要与正文

patterns.name: 粒子产生与碎裂模型
patterns.context: 讨论强子碰撞中的粒子产生、双夸克碎裂模型，以及长期存在的二分争论。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 高能物理论文正文

patterns.name: 禁烟后是否仍有某种现象
patterns.context: 口语中询问禁烟后某种现象是否还存在，并谈及室内吸烟与摇滚气质；未见与其他段落一致的术语模式。

patterns.name: 哲学中的人性与二分法
patterns.context: 讨论人是复杂机器还是灵魂与身体互动，并指出这一二分法并不穷尽可能性。

patterns.name: 天体盘辐射教程
patterns.context: 说明章节目的：介绍如何通过盘的辐射观测推知其物理特征，并提到会议背景。

en.description: Primarily responds to approach (proposing or describing a method) and experimentation (research, development, or commercial attempts); also responds to split-written dichotomy, the century suffix eenth, and spirit in technical questions, with weaker connections for the latter cases.

patterns.name: approach
patterns.context: The word itself is repeatedly highlighted in statements proposing, studying, or applying a method; it can be a noun or a verb in “We approach ...”.
patterns.domain: Academic paper abstracts and main text

patterns.name: experimentation
patterns.context: Refers to attempts and experiments in research, development, or pricing; [1] is adjacent to “extensive” and “comparing”, [8] is “quick”, and [10] is “some”.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, software development, startup discussions

patterns.name: dichotomy
patterns.context: The word is split across a line break or subword boundary and refers to a division or opposition; [7] discusses a long-running debate about particle production, and [9] discusses whether explanations of human nature are exhaustive.

patterns.name: century subword in time expressions
patterns.context: Appears in historical accounts of capitalism, income, and working hours; only part of a time expression is highlighted.

patterns.name: spirit in a question
patterns.context: Embedded in the technical question “Parsing a nested hierarchy in spirit qi”, surrounded by parsing and grammar; it is unclear whether the highlight reflects word meaning or an incidental local pattern.

1_1608.description: 主要响应 approach（提出或描述方法）及 experimentation（研究、开发或商业尝试）；也响应拆分书写的 dichotomy、年代词尾 eenth 和技术问句中的 spirit，后几类联系较弱。

patterns.name: approach
patterns.context: 词本身反复高亮，出现在提出、研究或应用某种方法的表述中；可作名词，也出现在“We approach ...”中作动词。

patterns.name: experimentation
patterns.context: 指研究、开发或定价中的尝试与实验；[1]紧邻“extensive”“comparing”，[8]为“quick”，[10]为“some”。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、软件开发、创业讨论

patterns.name: dichotomy
patterns.context: 词在换行或子词边界处拆开，指二分或对立；[7]讨论粒子产生的长期争论，[9]讨论人性解释是否穷尽。

patterns.name: 时间词中的 century 子词
patterns.context: 出现在关于资本主义、收入与工作时长的历史叙述中；只标亮年代词的一部分。

patterns.name: 问句中的 spirit
patterns.context: 嵌在“Parsing a nested hierarchy in spirit qi”这一技术问句中，周围涉及解析与语法；高亮是否反映词义或偶然局部模式不明。

en.concept: The English word spirit and academic collocations
en.description: Activation mainly falls on spirit, especially in “in the spirit of”; there are also two academic collocations, principles and structure, and spirit referring to a work ethic in a community description.

patterns.name: Collocations with spirit and long-range context
patterns.context: Mainly occurs in the phrase “in the spirit of …”, often followed by a method, theory, precedent, or rule; the collocation recurs in paragraph 7.

patterns.name: First before principles
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on principles in the academic method name “first principles method”.

patterns.name: Structure and adjacent words
patterns.context: Structure forms an academic description with a preceding noun or following phrase, including “the structure of …” and “cooperad structure on …”.

patterns.name: Spirit in a community description
patterns.context: Spirit refers to the work ethic cultivated within a group, not the collocation “in the spirit of”.
patterns.domain: Introductions to individual contributions or community development

1_1608.concept: 英语词 spirit 及学术搭配
1_1608.description: 激活主要落在 spirit，尤其是“in the spirit of”中的 spirit；另有 principles 与 structure 两处学术搭配，以及社区描述中指工作精神的 spirit。

patterns.name: spirit 搭配及其跨距
patterns.context: 主要出现在短语“in the spirit of …”中，常接某种方法、理论、先例或规则；第7段重复出现该搭配。

patterns.name: principles 前的 first
patterns.context: “first principles method”这一学术方法名称中，激活集中在 principles。

patterns.name: structure 及其邻接词
patterns.context: structure 与前置名词或后续短语构成学术描述；包括“the structure of …”和“cooperad structure on …”。

patterns.name: community 描述中的 spirit
patterns.context: spirit 指群体中培养出的工作精神，并非“in the spirit of”搭配。
patterns.domain: 人物贡献或社区发展介绍

en.concept: Principles, mechanisms, and methodological expressions in research
en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on research-expression terms such as principles, mechanism, analogues, and approach; principles occurs across disciplines, while mechanism is more common in abstracts. A few nearby activations fall on different technical terms and lack a unified explanation.

patterns.name: principles
patterns.context: Appears in collocations such as “first principles method”, “engineering principles”, “biological principles”, and “basic principles”; usually “principles” or “fundamentals” in a noun phrase.
patterns.domain: ArXiv abstracts, Wikipedia science articles, PubMed/NIH research abstracts, and textbook introductions

patterns.name: mechanism
patterns.context: Appears in collocations such as “study the mechanism”, “simple mechanism for constructing”, and “reaction mechanism”, referring to the mechanism of a research subject or an implementation method.

patterns.name: analogues/corresponding forms
patterns.context: Appears in “piecewise-linear and birational analogues of …”, referring to analogous forms or corresponding versions of an object.

patterns.name: research method or approach
patterns.context: Used in “approach the non-perturbative regime” and, with weaker activation, “a new approach to constructing …”; denotes a research approach or way of handling something.
patterns.domain: ArXiv theoretical physics and computational methods abstracts

patterns.name: Other unexplained activations
patterns.context: Highlights fall on several different words and cannot be adequately explained by the trigger patterns for principles, mechanism, analogues, or approach.

1_1608.concept: 科研中的原理、机制与方法表述
1_1608.description: 强激活主要落在 principles、mechanism、analogues、approach 等科研表述词上；其中 principles 跨学科出现，mechanism 多见于摘要。另有少量邻近标记落在不同技术词上，缺乏统一解释。

patterns.name: 原则
patterns.context: 出现在“first principles method”“engineering principles”“biological principles”“basic principles”等搭配中；多为名词短语中的“原则/原理”。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 摘要、Wikipedia 科普条目、PubMed/NIH 科研摘要与教材介绍

patterns.name: 机制
patterns.context: 与“study the mechanism”“simple mechanism for constructing”“reaction mechanism”等搭配，指研究对象的机制或实现方法。

patterns.name: 类比物/对应物
patterns.context: 出现在“piecewise-linear and birational analogues of …”中，表示某对象的类比形式或对应版本。

patterns.name: 研究方法或进路
patterns.context: 用于“approach the non-perturbative regime”，以及较弱激活的“a new approach to constructing …”；表示研究进路或处理方式。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 理论物理与计算方法摘要

patterns.name: 未解释的其他激活
patterns.trigger: 未见明显共同触发词；包括 «efficient»、«spin transfer tor…»、«pearling»、«Regge» 等邻近标记
patterns.context: 标记落在若干不同词上，无法由 principles、mechanism、analogues 或 approach 这几组触发模式充分解释。

en.description: All fragments contain mechanism in an academic context, discussing how phenomena, systems, or effects work, or the purpose and function of a mechanism; the fields vary, and the main commonality is the word itself.

patterns.name: The word mechanism
patterns.context: In academic abstracts or paper body text, the noun discusses the mechanism of a process, effect, model, or system; it often appears in constructions such as “the mechanism of,” “mechanism for,” and “mechanism to.”
patterns.domain: Interdisciplinary research texts, especially physics, astronomy, biomedicine, and statistics

patterns.name: Postmodification of mechanism
patterns.context: An of-phrase specifies the phenomenon, system, or effect involved in the mechanism; the word itself is the primary trigger, while the following subject matter varies.

patterns.name: Purpose or target of a mechanism
patterns.context: A following for-phrase, to-infinitive, or relative clause explains the mechanism's purpose, function, or hypothesized role; the shared semantics is “mechanism,” but syntactic forms differ.

1_1608.description: 所有片段都在学术语境中出现 mechanism，讨论现象、系统或效应的作用机制，或机制的用途与功能；领域各异，主要共同点是词项本身。

patterns.name: mechanism 一词
patterns.context: 学术摘要或论文正文中，作为名词讨论某种过程、效应、模型或系统的作用机制；常出现在“the mechanism of”“mechanism for”“mechanism to”等结构中。
patterns.domain: 跨学科科研文本，尤见物理学、天文学、生物医学和统计学

patterns.name: 机制的后置说明
patterns.trigger: «mechanism» 后接 «of»，如“mechanism of the ‘pearling’ instability”“mechanism of CRISPR/Cas9 system”
patterns.context: 用 of 短语说明机制所涉及的现象、系统或效应；该词本身是主要触发点，后接内容领域各异。

patterns.name: 机制的目的或构造对象
patterns.trigger: “mechanism for constructing”“mechanism to clarify”“mechanism which sets”
patterns.context: mechanism 后由 for、to 或关系从句交代其用途、功能或被假设的作用；共享“机制”语义，但句法形式不同。
patterns.domain: 统计学、宇宙学与理论物理

en.description: Activations center on concepts expressed in academic texts, including principles, mechanisms, and research hypotheses, with one instance of the mathematical term “analogues”. The trigger words do not share a consistent syntax or semantics.

patterns.name: “principles” and compounds
patterns.context: The noun principles appears, especially with a domain modifier before it (engineering, basic) or an of-phrase after it; no particular sentence structure is required.
patterns.domain: Academic research, engineering education, architecture, and scientific discussion

patterns.name: “mechanism” and related mechanism expressions
patterns.context: Describes the mechanism of a research subject or a mechanism provided by a method; may occur in an abstract or research proposal.

patterns.name: Research-hypothesis lead-in
patterns.context: A research statement introduces a hypothesis in the first-person plural, followed by a research subject or proposition.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts or project text

patterns.name: Analogous forms of mathematical objects
patterns.context: A mathematics abstract describes defining an analogous form of an object; activation falls on analogues rather than the more common principles, mechanism, or hypothesize expressions.

1_1608.description: 激活集中在学术文本中的原则、机制、研究假设等概念表达，另有一次数学术语“analogues”。触发词的句法和语义并不统一。

patterns.name: “principles”及其复合表达
patterns.trigger: «principles»10，常见于“engineering principles”“basic principles”“basic principles of quantum theory”
patterns.context: 出现名词 principles，尤其前接领域修饰语（engineering、basic）或后接 of 短语；不要求特定句式。
patterns.domain: 学术研究、工程教育、建筑与科学论述

patterns.name: “mechanism”及相关机制表述
patterns.context: 描述某个研究对象的作用机制，或某种方法所提供的机制；可出现在摘要或研究计划中。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理、生物医学研究

patterns.name: 研究假设引导语
patterns.context: 研究陈述以第一人称复数提出假设，后接研究对象或命题。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要或项目文本

patterns.name: 数学对象的类比形式
patterns.context: 数学摘要中说明定义某对象的类比形式；激活落在 analogues，而非常见的 principles、mechanism 或 hypothesize 表达。

en.description: Primarily responds to “theory” and related theoretical-framework statements in academic texts, spanning complexity, perturbation, geometry, statistical physics, and other fields; it also responds to research descriptions involving models, mechanisms, methods, and scientific questions.

patterns.name: “Theory” and terminology for theoretical fields
patterns.context: In academic discussion, it often appears at the end of a field noun phrase, such as “elasticity theory,” “complexity theory,” “perturbation theory,” and “geometric theory”; it can also occur in constructions such as “in the theory of”.
patterns.domain: Cross-disciplinary academic papers, especially mathematics, physics, and computer science

patterns.name: Building and using theoretical frameworks or models
patterns.context: Describes modeling, mechanisms, methods, or theoretical frameworks for the research subject; sometimes appears in the same passage as theory, but does not necessarily depend directly on that word.

patterns.name: Complexity theory and classification of computational problems
patterns.context: Discusses computational complexity, complexity classes, or computational problems; the passage also contains “theory”.

patterns.name: Perturbation theory and higher-order computations
patterns.context: Mentions perturbation theory or higher-order computations in elasticity or physics-computation contexts.

patterns.name: Effective interactions and statistical mechanics models
patterns.context: Discusses interactions between a system and external spins, and replaces the system with an effective interaction.

patterns.name: Stochastic differential equations and unbiased estimation
patterns.context: Presents a method to compute an expectation or construct a finite-variance unbiased estimator.
patterns.domain: Probability, numerical analysis, Monte Carlo methods

patterns.name: Mechanism of Pearling instability
patterns.context: An abstract-style statement studies the mechanism of an instability; theory does not appear explicitly.
patterns.domain: Physics or related scientific paper abstracts

patterns.name: Solitons and particle-like solutions
patterns.context: Discusses soliton or breather solutions in field-theory models and interprets them as particle-like structures.

patterns.name: Evolution from microscopic to macroscopic states
patterns.context: Discusses a theoretical concept concerning evolution from microscopic states to macroscopic dynamics in infinite-particle systems.

patterns.name: Geometric theory of Morse functions
patterns.context: Introduces Reeb spaces and their compact representation of manifolds or maps.

1_1608.description: 主要对学术文本中的“theory”及相关理论框架表述反应，跨复杂度、微扰、几何、统计物理等领域；也响应模型、机制、方法和科学问题的研究描述。

patterns.name: “theory”及理论领域术语
patterns.context: 在学术论述中，常处于领域名词短语末尾，如“elasticity theory”“complexity theory”“perturbation theory”“geometric theory”；也可接在“in the theory of”等结构中。
patterns.domain: 跨领域学术论文，尤其数学、物理、计算机科学

patterns.name: 理论框架或模型的建立与使用
patterns.context: 描述研究对象的建模、机制、方法或理论框架；有时与 theory 同段出现，但未必直接依赖该词。

patterns.name: 复杂度理论与计算问题分类
patterns.context: 讨论 computational complexity、复杂度类别或计算问题；段落也出现“theory”。
patterns.domain: 计算机科学、理论计算机科学

patterns.name: 微扰理论及高阶计算
patterns.context: 在弹性、物理计算等语境中提及微扰理论或高阶计算。

patterns.name: 有效相互作用与统计力学模型

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to mechanism and nearby collocations in scientific contexts, spanning stochastic estimation, instability, reactions, decoherence, defense, and encoder–decoder mechanisms; isolated cases also involve theoretical feasibility and equivalent alternatives, template literals, and mechanics theory.

patterns.name: mechanism and nearby terms

patterns.domain: Primarily scientific paper abstracts, also machine-learning explanatory text

patterns.name: Principled alternatives and possibility expressions
patterns.context: In discussion of theoretical systems, in principle introduces feasibility or equivalent alternatives; no mechanism trigger word appears.

patterns.name: Template literals
patterns.context: Discusses the use of template literals in JavaScript; activation falls on a split part of literals, with no evident semantic connection to scientific mechanisms.

patterns.name: Theory and model terminology
patterns.context: A materials mechanics abstract introduces vibration modes of beams and theoretical methods for calculations; mechanism does not appear.

1_1608.description: 主要对科学语境中的 mechanism 及其近邻搭配强烈响应，覆盖随机估计、失稳、反应、退相干、防御和编码器—解码器机制；另见理论可行性与等效替代、模板字面量及力学理论等孤例。

patterns.name: 机制一词及其近邻
patterns.context: 在科学摘要或说明性文字中，描述某过程、方法、相互作用或模型时出现 mechanism；常与 the、a、of、相关领域修饰语搭配。
patterns.domain: 主要为科学论文摘要，也包括机器学习说明文

patterns.name: 原理性替代与可能性表述

patterns.name: 模板字面量
patterns.context: 讨论 JavaScript 中模板字面量的用法；激活落在 literals 的拆分部分，语义与科学机制无明显关联。

patterns.name: 理论与模型术语
patterns.context: 材料力学摘要中介绍梁的振动模式及用于计算的理论方法；未出现 mechanism。

en.description: Primarily responds to theoretical inquiry, hypothetical reasoning, and the construction or explanation of mechanisms, commonly in scientific papers and technical discussions; there are also sporadic activations on the Chinese character “法” and an internal fragment of a Hungarian word.

patterns.name: Theoretical hypotheses or argumentation

patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, scientific discussion, and technical forums

patterns.name: Mechanisms and generation processes
patterns.context: Describes the mechanism or method involved in producing, constructing, or explaining a phenomenon, especially the noun mechanism

patterns.name: Hypothetical possibilities and conditional reasoning
patterns.context: Discusses possible outcomes under hypothetical conditions, or effects a mechanism could or might produce

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a Hungarian word

patterns.name: “法” in a Chinese comment
patterns.context: A component of the word “algorithm” in a Chinese code comment; the trigger may be the character itself or the algorithm context

1_1608.concept: 理论机制与可能性推演
1_1608.description: 主要响应理论探究、假设推演以及机制的构造或解释，常见于科学论文和技术讨论；另对中文“法”和匈牙利语词内片段有零散激活。

patterns.name: 理论性假设或论证

patterns.name: 假设性可能与条件推演
patterns.context: 讨论假设条件下可能出现的结果，或某机制能够、可能带来的效果

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内片段

patterns.name: 中文注释中的“法”

en.description: Activations are scattered across academic expressions concerning theoretical possibility, mechanisms/methods/structures, and optimized solutions or optimal objects; they also involve the suffix als, photon discussions, and a Chinese annotation for “algorithm”. Trigger locations vary, and the acoustically generated example is difficult to explain.

patterns.name: Mechanism, method, or structure
patterns.context: Academic accounts introduce a mechanism, method, structure, principle, or model, often in contexts such as “propose/construct/provide/follow”; no fixed collocation is required.

patterns.name: Theoretical possibility and argument
patterns.context: Discusses a possibility, inference, or property to be proved, often with a conditional, future tense, or theoretical analysis.

patterns.name: Optimal objects and existence of solutions
patterns.context: In mathematical optimization or variational problems, mentions minimizers, optimal couplings, or the existence of an object; occurs near formulas, theorems, or problem definitions.

patterns.name: English subword -als

patterns.name: Quantum and photons in physics

patterns.name: Algorithm in a Chinese technical annotation

1_1608.description: 激活散见于学术文本中关于理论可能性、机制/方法/结构，以及优化解或最优对象的表述；还涉及词尾als、光子讨论和中文“算法”注释。各例触发位置并不统一，光声生成例难以解释。

patterns.name: 机制、方法或结构

patterns.name: 理论可能性与论证

patterns.domain: 科学讨论、HackerNews 技术讨论及论文摘要

patterns.name: 最优对象与解的存在

patterns.name: 英语词片段 -als

patterns.name: 物理学中的量子与光子

patterns.name: 中文技术注释中的算法

en.description: Primarily responds to hardcode/hard code, especially directly hardcoding values or rules; also responds to mechanism and precedence across programming, academic, and commentary contexts.

patterns.name: hardcode / hard code

patterns.name: mechanism

patterns.name: precedence

1_1608.concept: 写死、机制与优先级词汇

patterns.name: hardcode / hard code

patterns.domain: Pile-CC 社会科学文字、HackerNews 评论

en.description: Activations are scattered across hardcoded technical settings, expressions of priority, paper terminology, and a few proper nouns and hypothetical phrasing; many strong activations fall on split word fragments, with no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: hardcode and compounds
patterns.context: In code or technical discussion, refers to directly hardcoding settings, character sets, values, or protocol fields, contrasted with implementing an algorithm or following a specification.

patterns.name: Priority and tradeoffs

patterns.name: Conditional speculative phrasing

patterns.name: Possessive pronouns and contractions

patterns.name: hardcode 及其复合词

patterns.name: 优先级与取舍

patterns.name: 技术术语中的固定片段

patterns.name: 论文摘要术语

en.description: Activations cluster on the ending subword tokens of several words: hardcode in programming contexts and decomposition in scientific texts; precedence also occurs. The shared feature appears to be sensitivity to specific word endings, rather than a unified semantic theme.

1_1608.description: 激活集中在若干词的末尾子词元：编程语境中的 hardcode，以及科学文本中的 decomposition；另有 precedence。共同点较像对特定词尾形式敏感，而非统一语义主题。

en.description: Activations cluster on two distinct lexical items: code in hardcode and precedence meaning priority; there is also one occurrence on the ending al in Panama Canal. Contexts span technical discussions, general writing, and links.

patterns.name: code in the compound hardcode

patterns.name: precedence meaning priority

patterns.name: al in a proper noun

1_1608.description: 激活集中在两个不同词项：hardcode 中的 code，以及表示优先级的 precedence；另有一次落在 Panama Canal 的词尾 al。上下文横跨技术讨论、一般论述与链接。

patterns.name: hardcode 复合词中的 code

patterns.name: precedence 表示优先级

en.description: The strongest pattern is code in hardcode in programming contexts; there are also activations for yet to see in the perfect tense, katakana word endings, precedence, and a fragment of an academic citation name, with no clear shared semantics among the latter cases.

patterns.name: code in hardcode

patterns.name: yet meaning not yet seen/experienced

patterns.name: Japanese katakana

patterns.name: Word ending in precedence

1_1608.description: 最强模式是编程语境中 hardcode 的 code；另对完成时 yet to see、katakana 词尾、precedence 及一处学术引文姓名片段激活，后几类彼此缺少明显共同语义。

en.description: Activations cluster on several whole or split tokens: hardcode in technical contexts, the final words theory/decomposition in academic compound terms, and katakana fragments and precedence; these trigger words do not share a consistent meaning or register.

patterns.context: Code discussions mention directly hardcoding values, shapes, character sets, or types; the context may recommend doing so or advise against it.

patterns.name: final tokens in academic terms
