en.description: Activations mainly fall on al after intervention in interventional, across medical research, education, professional titles, and surgery-related texts; in programming Q&A, there's 's and hardcode's code also activate, with no direct unifying link to the main pattern.

patterns.name: internal suffix in interventional
patterns.context: The suffix al follows the stem intervention to form interventional; occurs in research, medical education, or technical terminology.

patterns.name: other internal segmentation in interventional
patterns.context: al follows intervention, forming interventional procedural; activation is distributed across the ending and part of the following word.

patterns.name: internal suffix in interventional
patterns.context: al follows intervention to form interventional; used in research design or for medical professional titles.

patterns.name: internal fragments unrelated to medical vocabulary
patterns.context: Activation falls on 's at the end of the contraction there's and on code in hardcode; context is a programming Q&A about implementing a rotation algorithm.

1_1608.concept: interventional 词尾及局部词片段
1_1608.description: 主要激活 interventional 中 intervention 后的 al，覆盖医学研究、教育、专业名称及手术相关文本；另在编程问答中激活 there's 的 's 和 hardcode 的 code，无法与主模式直接统一。

patterns.name: interventional 的词内后缀
patterns.context: 词干 intervention 后紧接后缀 al，形成 interventional；出现于研究、医学教育或专业术语中。

patterns.name: interventional 的词内其他切分
patterns.context: intervention 后出现 al，后续构成 interventional procedural；激活分布在词尾及其后续词内部分。

patterns.name: interventional 的词内后缀
patterns.context: intervention 后紧接 al，形成 interventional；用于研究设计或医学专业人员称谓。

patterns.name: 与医学词汇无关的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在缩写词尾 there's 的 's，以及 hardcode 的 code；上下文是实现旋转算法的编程问答。

en.concept: Specific word-form fragments and academic expressions
en.description: Primarily responds to the ending al in interventional in medical texts, and also to We hypothesize at the start of research abstracts; other activations are scattered across ak/ana in katakana and als in the machine-learning citation author name Vinyals.

patterns.name: Ending of interventional
patterns.context: al follows intervention to form the adjective interventional; activation is concentrated on the ending, not the entire word or intervention in general.
patterns.domain: Medical research, clinical, and educational texts

patterns.name: Hypothesis statement
patterns.context: Follows We at the start of a sentence, forming the research-hypothesis expression “We hypothesize that ...”.

patterns.name: Fragment in Japanese writing-system name
patterns.context: Occurs in katakana in a discussion of writing names with English characters rather than Japanese katakana.

patterns.name: Word ending in machine-learning terminology
patterns.context: Appears in the cited author name Vinyals, concatenated with a year and paper title; activation falls on the final fragment of the author name.

1_1608.concept: 特定词形片段与学术表达
1_1608.description: 主要响应医学文本中 interventional 的词尾 al，也响应研究摘要句首的 We hypothesize；另有 katakana 内的 ak/ana 和机器学习引文作者名 Vinyals 的 als。

patterns.name: interventional 的词尾
patterns.context: intervention 后接 al 构成形容词 interventional；激活集中在词尾，而非整个词或一般的 intervention。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、临床与教育文本

patterns.name: 假设提出用语
patterns.context: 位于句首 We 后，构成“We hypothesize that ...”的研究假设表达。

patterns.name: 日语文字名称中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在 katakana 一词中，讨论以英语字符而非日语片假名书写姓名。

patterns.name: 机器学习术语中的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在引用作者名 Vinyals 与年份、论文题名连写的文献引用中；激活落在作者名的末尾片段。

en.description: Strongly responds primarily to the -al suffix in interventional in medical academic texts; there is also one activation on the ending of katakana and one on the -less ending of the adjective effortless, neither of which clearly fits the main pattern.

patterns.name: suffix in interventional
patterns.context: In medical, research, or academic contexts, the neuron mainly activates on suffix -al after intervention-; commonly occurs in the adjective interventional, followed by words such as cardiologist, radiology, studies, care, trial.
patterns.domain: Medicine, clinical research, academic papers, and research project texts

patterns.name: Japanese transliteration ending
patterns.context: When discussing writing names in English characters or katakana, activation falls on a final substring of katakana; this differs from the medical pattern.
patterns.domain: Q&A about Japanese and writing names

patterns.name: adjective ending less
patterns.context: When describing how smart homes make the holidays more enjoyable and relaxing, activation falls on the -less ending of an English adjective; this does not fit the interventional pattern.
patterns.domain: Lifestyle and smart home promotional copy

1_1608.description: 主要对医学学术文本中 interventional 的 -al 后缀强烈响应；另有一次片假名 katakana 词尾及一次形容词 effortless 的 -less 词尾激活，二者与主模式不明显一致。

patterns.name: interventional 的后缀
patterns.context: 在医疗、研究或学术语境中，神经元主要激活于 intervention- 后缀 -al；常见于形容词 interventional，后面可接 cardiologist、radiology、studies、care、trial 等词。
patterns.domain: 医学、临床研究、学术论文及科研项目文本

patterns.name: 日语转写词尾
patterns.context: 谈论用英语字符还是片假名写名字时，激活落在 katakana 的词尾子串；与医学主模式不同。
patterns.domain: 日语与姓名书写的问答

patterns.name: 形容词词尾 less
patterns.context: 描述智能家居让节日更愉快、轻松时，激活英语形容词的 -less 词尾；此处与 interventional 模式不吻合。
patterns.domain: 生活方式与智能家居宣传文案

en.concept: Medical term endings and phrase fragments
en.description: Activations mainly occur on al at the end of interventional in medical contexts and on place in the phrase taking place; there are also sporadic numbers, common words, and technical term fragments, without a clear, consistent pattern.

patterns.name: interventional/interventionally forms
patterns.context: Occurs in medical terminology or descriptions of research design, such as interventional cardiologist, interventional radiology, interventional studies; also occurs in compounds related to intervention studies
patterns.domain: Medicine, clinical research, and medical education

patterns.name: taking place expression
patterns.context: place occurs in the phrase taking place, describing an event, process, or phenomenon that is occurring
patterns.domain: Expository academic texts concerning role-playing, astrophysics, or galaxy research

patterns.name: other sporadic collocations
patterns.context: Sporadic activations in local contexts, including articles, numbers and hyphens, common words, or fragments of technical terms; these fragments show no stable shared syntactic or semantic condition
patterns.domain: Mixed cross-domain texts, including medical research, teaching materials, and physics papers

1_1608.concept: 医学术语词尾与短语片段
1_1608.description: 主要激活于医学语境中 interventional 的词尾 al，以及短语 taking place 中 place；另有分散的数字、常见词和专业词片段，未形成清晰一致模式。

patterns.name: interventional/interventionally 词形
patterns.context: 出现在医学术语或研究设计表述中，如 interventional cardiologist、interventional radiology、interventional studies；也出现于干预研究相关的复合词中
patterns.domain: 医学、临床研究与医学教育

patterns.name: taking place 表达
patterns.context: place 位于 taking place 短语中，描述事件、过程或现象正在发生
patterns.domain: 说明性学术文本，涉及角色扮演、天体物理或星系研究

patterns.name: 其他零散搭配
patterns.trigger: « a»；« 5»；«-»；«year»；« plan»；« structure»；« exercise»；« Utility»；«Based»；«Refer»；« implement»；« place»；« experimental»；« can»；« asthmatic»；« alternative»；« stabilization»；« stable»；« observed»；« experimentally»；«SO»；«H»；«1»
patterns.context: 仅在局部语境中出现的零散激活，包含冠词、数字及连字符，常见词或专业术语片段；这些片段未显示稳定的共同句法或语义条件
patterns.domain: 跨领域混杂文本，包括医学研究、教学说明和物理学论文

en.description: The most consistent phenomenon is the internal al fragment in interventional across several medical contexts, as well as the ending al in Joakal; there are also katakana, numbers/hyphens, path strings, and sporadic word-internal or word-boundary activations, with no unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: word-final al subword fragment
patterns.context: Activation clusters on the letter sequence “al” within a word; in intervention(al), it is a common adjective suffix, while in Joak(al) it falls at the end of a proper name. Not every occurrence of al is marked as an activation.
patterns.domain: Medical research texts, project descriptions, and HackerNews texts

patterns.name: fragments related to the Japanese writing-system term
patterns.context: Mentions writing names in katakana and contrasts this with using English characters; strong activation falls on an internal fragment of katakana.
patterns.domain: StackExchange discussions of Japanese writing and name transliteration

patterns.name: numbers and year expressions
patterns.context: Activation falls on numbers, hyphens, or fragments of years, compound terms, and mathematical notation adjacent to numbers; forms vary and show no consistent local syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: NIH project descriptions and ArXiv academic papers

patterns.name: comparison-related terminology
patterns.context: Discusses a proposed comparative detection method and comparison concepts in few-shot learning; only propose is marked, not the comparison terms themselves.

patterns.name: common inflectional or function-word fragments
patterns.context: Sporadic markers occur near contractions, common words, and morpheme boundaries, spanning many parts of speech and contexts; there is insufficient evidence to assign them to a single grammatical pattern.
patterns.domain: Online discussions, academic papers, and news commentary

patterns.name: articles and fragment endings
patterns.context: Markers fall on word-initial, word-final, or internal fragments, including determiners, plural/derived forms, and ordinary words; contextual conditions are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Marketing articles and medical education paper titles/abstracts

patterns.name: nonlexical paths and number strings
patterns.context: Activations occur in path-like or marker strings at the beginning of HackerNews text, followed by a separator and post content; they have no clear connection to the subsequent text.

1_1608.description: 最一致的现象是多种医学语境中的 interventional 内部 al 片段，以及 Joakal 末尾 al；另有日语 katakana、数字/连字符、路径串和分散的词内或词边界激活，缺少统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 词尾 al 子词片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在单词内部的「al」字母片段；在 intervention(al) 中是常见形容词后缀，在 Joak(al) 中则落在专名末尾。不是所有出现的 al 都标记为激活。
patterns.domain: 医学研究文本、项目描述及 HackerNews 文本

patterns.name: 日语文字名称相关片段
patterns.context: 提及用片假名书写名字，并与使用英语字符作对比；强激活落在 katakana 的内部片段。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 对话，讨论日语书写与名字转写

patterns.name: 数字与年份表达
patterns.context: 激活落在数字、连字符或紧邻数字的年份、复合术语和数学排版片段中；形式各异，未显示一致的局部句法条件。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目描述与 ArXiv 学术论文

patterns.name: 比较相关术语
patterns.context: 讨论提出一种比较检测方法，以及 few-shot 学习中的比较概念；标记只落在 propose 上，比较术语本身未标记。

patterns.name: 常见屈折或功能词片段
patterns.trigger: I«'d»2；That«'s»2；« think»3；« highly»2；characterized« by»1；« excited»1；« attempt»2；« place»1；« carry»3；« stable»1
patterns.context: 零散标记出现在缩写、常见词及词缀边界附近，跨越多种词类和上下文；没有足够证据归为单一语法模式。
patterns.domain: 网络对话、学术论文及新闻讨论

patterns.name: 文章与片段词尾
patterns.context: 标记落在词首、词尾或词内片段，包括限定词、复数/派生形式和普通词；上下文条件不统一。
patterns.domain: 营销文章与医学教育论文标题/摘要

patterns.name: 非词汇性路径与数字串
patterns.context: 激活出现在 HackerNews 文本开头的类路径或标记串中，随后是分隔线和帖子内容；与后续文字没有明确关联。

en.description: Most paragraphs activate on the suffix al in the medical term interventional (including a word-final fragment in procedural); the rest are scattered across less, the reference-name endings er/als, and the mathematical term theory, with no consistent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Suffix in interventional derivatives
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending al in interventional; the word modifies medical research, study design, radiology, cardiology, or healthcare.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, research proposals, and abstracts

patterns.name: English suffix -less
patterns.context: Activation falls on the adjective suffix less, describing smart homes making holiday life easier.

patterns.name: English suffix -er
patterns.context: Activation falls on the end of the reference author surname Bersuker; the context is a molecular physics paper and citation.

patterns.name: English suffix -als
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of the reference author name Vinyals, in a citation for an image classification paper.

patterns.name: Mathematical term theory
patterns.context: Activation falls on theory in Hardy space theory; the context discusses function-space results and their applicability.

1_1608.description: 多数段落激活在医学术语 interventional 的后缀 al（含 procedural 词尾片段）；其余分散落在 less、参考文献姓氏后缀 er/als 及数学术语 theory，缺少一致语义模式。

patterns.name: interventional 派生词后缀
patterns.context: 激活落在 interventional 的词尾 al；该词用于修饰医学研究、研究设计、放射学、心脏病学或医疗护理。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、研究计划及摘要

patterns.name: 英语词尾 -less
patterns.context: 激活落在形容词词尾 less，描述智能家居让节日生活更轻松。
patterns.domain: 生活方式或产品介绍类网络文章

patterns.name: 英语词尾 -er
patterns.context: 激活落在参考文献作者姓氏 Bersuker 的末尾；上下文为分子物理学论文及引用。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文与参考文献

patterns.name: 英语词尾 -als
patterns.context: 激活落在参考文献作者名 Vinyals 的词尾，处于图像分类论文引用中。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文与参考文献

patterns.name: 数学术语 theory
patterns.context: 激活落在 Hardy space theory 中的 theory；上下文讨论函数空间结果及其适用性。

en.concept: Specific lexical fragments: Lotus, спасибо, hardcode
en.description: The strongest responses cluster on the brand name Lotus (often referring to IBM software); there is also an internal fragment of the Russian word “спасибо” and code in hardcode in a programming context. No clear corresponding pattern appears in the two ArXiv passages.

patterns.name: Lotus software product name
patterns.context: “Lotus” is used as a brand name in IBM software names such as Notes and Sametime, or in lists mapping people to companies.
patterns.domain: Software product descriptions, patent backgrounds, corporate emails, people-and-company lists

patterns.name: word ending in Russian thanks
patterns.context: A subword fragment inside the Russian word “спасибо” (thank you), occurring in a StackExchange post's expression of thanks.

patterns.name: hardcoding expression in code
patterns.context: “hardcode” means directly hardcoding values or shapes, contrasted with implementing an algorithm or setting chart axes.

1_1608.description: 最强响应集中于 Lotus 品牌名（多指 IBM 软件）；另有俄语“спасибо”的词内片段，以及编程语境中 hardcode 的 code。ArXiv 两段未见清楚对应模式。

patterns.name: Lotus 软件产品名
patterns.context: “Lotus”作为品牌名，出现在 Notes、Sametime 等 IBM 软件名称中，或人物与公司对应的列表中。
patterns.domain: 软件产品介绍、专利背景、企业邮件、人物与公司列表

patterns.name: 俄语致谢中的词尾
patterns.context: 俄语“спасибо”（谢谢）内部的子词片段，位于 StackExchange 帖子的感谢语中。

patterns.name: 硬编码代码表达
patterns.context: “hardcode”指直接写死数值或形状，与算法实现、图表坐标轴设置相对照。

en.concept: Word-fragment recognition, with a primary bias toward Lotus/us
en.description: The most consistent triggers are us in Lotus (company, software, or place name) and -al in the medical term interventional. Other activations are scattered across fragments in less, Weeding, and several title words, without a unified context.

patterns.name: Subword within the proper noun Lotus
patterns.context: “Lotus” is part of the name of a company, software product, or bridge/place; activation falls on the subword us.
patterns.domain: Software, corporate email, geographic entries, and lists of people and companies

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in interventional
patterns.context: The ending -al in the medical term interventional is marked; it modifies cardiologist, radiology, and studies in different examples.
patterns.domain: Medical research and NIH grant applications

patterns.name: Local subwords in different words
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments in less and Weeding; the former occurs in smart-home copy and the latter in a robotics headline. They have no evident shared semantics or contextual conditions.

patterns.name: Other sporadic word fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur in machine-learning papers and educational research titles, distributed across the beginnings, middles, or endings of different words; no stable common trigger condition is evident.

1_1608.concept: 词片段识别，主偏向 Lotus/us
1_1608.description: 最一致的触发是 Lotus 中的 us（公司、软件或地名），以及医学术语 interventional 的 -al。另有分散在 less、Weeding 及若干标题词中的片段激活，缺乏统一上下文。

patterns.name: Lotus 专名内部子词
patterns.context: “Lotus”作为公司、软件产品或地名桥梁名称中的一部分；激活落在 us 子词上。
patterns.domain: 软件、企业邮件、地理条目、人物与公司列表

patterns.name: interventional 词尾片段
patterns.context: 医学术语 interventional 的词尾 -al 被标记；分别修饰 cardiologist、radiology 和 studies。
patterns.domain: 医学研究与 NIH 资助申请

patterns.name: 不同词中的局部子词
patterns.context: 激活落在 less 和 Weeding 等词片段上，前者处于 smart-home 文案，后者出现在机器人标题；没有共同的明显语义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 消费产品宣传；HackerNews 标题

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 在机器学习论文和教育研究标题中激活，分布于若干不同词的词首、词中或词尾；未见稳定的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 机器学习论文；医学教育标题

en.description: Primarily responds to the uppercase DESCRIPTION label and the word difference in contexts involving group differences, statistical significance, or practical effects; also occurs in DES encryption suites, encoded certificate strings, and the name DESeq.

patterns.name: DESCRIPTION label or field name
patterns.context: The uppercase word DESCRIPTION appears as a field heading, HTML table header, or CSS/document-style label; its prefix may be split or partially encoded.

patterns.name: difference and semantic neighbors
patterns.context: The word difference appears in statements about differences, effects, or changes; biomedical statistical text reports group differences, while email and forum text describes effects.

patterns.name: Differences in statistical expressions
patterns.context: Adjacent to comparison targets, ratios, or significance judgments, as in “difference between”, “difference was not statistically significant”, and “no significant difference”.

patterns.name: DES encryption algorithm name
patterns.context: DES occurs as part of a cipher suite name, followed by markers such as CBC; it is not the ordinary word description.

patterns.name: DES substring in base64/certificate content
patterns.context: The string DES occurs within a long, encoded-looking string surrounded by certificate or public-key data, rather than readable natural language.

patterns.name: DES substring in statistical method names
patterns.context: DES occurs within method or tool names, such as edgeR/DESeq; the activation may correspond to a substring in the name rather than a standalone word.

1_1884.description: 主要响应大写 DESCRIPTION 标签，以及单词 difference 在组间差异、统计显著性或实际影响语境中的出现；另在 DES 加密套件、编码证书串和 DESeq 名称中出现。

patterns.name: DESCRIPTION 标签或字段名
patterns.context: 大写 DESCRIPTION 一词，在文本中作为字段标题、HTML 表头或 CSS/文档式标签出现；前缀可能被拆分或部分编码。

patterns.name: difference 及其语义近邻
patterns.context: 单词 difference 出现在陈述差异、影响或改变的句子中；医学统计文本报告组间差异，邮件和论坛文本描述产生的影响。

patterns.name: 统计表达中的差异
patterns.context: 与比较对象、比例或显著性判断相邻，如“difference between”“difference was not statistically significant”“no significant difference”。

patterns.name: DES 加密算法名称
patterns.context: DES 作为密码套件名的一部分，后接 CBC 等算法标记；并非普通单词 description。

patterns.name: base64／证书内容中的 DES 子串
patterns.context: DES 字符串出现在类似编码的长串中，周围是证书或公钥数据，而非可读自然语言。

patterns.name: 统计方法名中的 DES 子串
patterns.context: DES 出现在方法或工具名称内部，例如 edgeR/DESeq；激活位置可能对应名称中的子串，而非独立词。

en.description: Activations cluster on the DES10 string, difference (in both statistical and everyday senses), and the DESCRIPTION suffix. They occur across multiple domains, with insufficient evidence that they share a single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: DES10 string marker
patterns.context: DES is immediately followed by 10 in configuration values, citation markers, HTML text, and encoded strings; this is the most stable shared literal trigger across all examples
patterns.domain: Mixed: configuration, cryptography, paper citations, HTML, Base64

patterns.name: The form and semantics of difference
patterns.context: The complete English word difference is marked. It can refer to statistical or between-group differences, or to everyday differences or effects
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, corporate email, everyday commentary

patterns.name: The English word fragment DESCRIPTION
patterns.context: The latter part of DESCRIPTION is marked; one instance is the configuration comment --DESCRIPTION--, and another is the HTML table heading DESCRIPTION

1_1884.description: 激活集中在 DES10 字符串、difference（含统计及日常语义）和 DESCRIPTION 后缀；它们分布于多领域，没有足够证据证明都由同一语义触发。

patterns.name: DES10 字符串标记
patterns.context: DES 后紧接 10，出现在配置值、引用标记、HTML 文本和编码串中；这是所有样例中最稳定的共同字面触发
patterns.domain: 混合：配置、密码学、论文引用、HTML、Base64

patterns.name: difference 的词形与语义
patterns.context: 完整英文单词 difference 被标记；既可指统计差异或组间差异，也可指日常意义上的不同或影响
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、企业邮件、日常评论

patterns.name: 英文单词片段 DESCRIPTION
patterns.context: DESCRIPTION 的后半段被标记；一处是配置注释 --DESCRIPTION--，另一处是 HTML 表格标题文本 DESCRIPTION

en.description: Strong triggers include the DES substring and difference-related terms such as difference/differential expression. Activations also occur in employee recognition, biomedical gene descriptions, and contexts where earplugs improve focus; these latter cases may involve neighboring words or weakly related triggers.

patterns.name: DES substring in strings
patterns.context: DES occurs in identifiers, algorithm names, or text; the marked feature is a substring, not necessarily a standalone word.

patterns.name: difference and differential expression
patterns.context: The form difference occurs in statistical, biomedical, or everyday contexts; [2] also contains differential expression.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, statistical analysis, forum posts

patterns.name: recognize in an award program context
patterns.context: An Enron employee award program recognizes employees who made contributions.

patterns.name: Peripheral trigger: gene and resistance descriptions
patterns.context: Describes hybrid offspring, dominant genes, and resistance phenotypes.

patterns.name: Peripheral trigger: earplugs improve focus
patterns.context: A personal account mentions noise-canceling earplugs and their effect on focus.

1_1884.description: 强触发包括字符串子串 DES，以及 difference/differential expression 等差异相关词；此外在员工表彰、生物医学基因描述和耳塞改善专注语境中也有激活，后几类可能是邻近词或弱相关触发。

patterns.name: 字符串中的 DES 子串
patterns.context: DES 出现在标识符、算法名称或文本内容中；标记的是子串而非必然独立单词。

patterns.name: difference 及差异表达
patterns.context: 词形 difference 出现在统计、生物医学或日常表达中；[2] 另有 differential expression。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、统计分析、论坛帖子

patterns.name: Award program 语境中的 recognize
patterns.context: Enron 员工奖励计划表彰作出贡献的员工。

patterns.name: 边缘触发：基因与抗性描述
patterns.context: 描述杂交后代、显性基因及抗性表型。

patterns.name: 边缘触发：耳塞改善专注
patterns.context: 个人经验中提及降噪耳塞及其对专注的影响。

en.concept: Spelling patterns of DES and difference
en.description: Activation concentrates on two spelling patterns: DES embedded in code, markup, or technical identifiers, and difference in natural language; the latter commonly appears in research-result comparisons and also in email and forum contexts.

patterns.name: DES and DESCRIPTION strings
patterns.context: The letter sequence DES is highlighted within words or configuration, markup-language, code, or encoded strings; some instances are followed by DESCRIPTION, while others are embedded in identifiers such as DES-CBC.
patterns.domain: Code, HTML/CSS, encryption configuration, encoded text, and bioinformatics papers

patterns.name: difference stem
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word difference; in papers it is used to compare groups, cases, or results, while in email and forum text it refers to a difference or effect.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, corporate email, forum posts

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: No independent activation pattern could be reliably attributed to DES strings or difference.

1_1884.concept: DES 与 difference 的拼写特征
1_1884.description: 激活集中在两种拼写模式：嵌入代码、标记或技术标识符的 DES，以及自然语言中的 difference；后者常见于研究结果比较，也见于邮件和论坛语境。

patterns.name: DES 与 DESCRIPTION 字符串
patterns.context: 在单词内部或配置、标记语言、代码/编码字符串中，字母序列 DES 被突出；有的实例后接 DESCRIPTION，有的嵌在 DES-CBC 等标识符中。
patterns.domain: 代码、HTML/CSS、加密配置、编码文本及生物信息学论文

patterns.name: difference 词干
patterns.context: 激活落在 difference 一词上；论文中用于比较组别、病例或结果，邮件和论坛文本中则指差异或影响。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、企业邮件、论坛帖子

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.trigger: 片段中没有明显对应于上述两类的触发子串
patterns.context: 未发现可稳妥归入 DES 字符串或 difference 的独立激活模式。

en.description: The most stable clue is the word difference; there are also triggers on the uppercase DES substring in DESCRIPTION, DES-CBC, DESeq, and encoded text. The two types of clues may not share a source.

patterns.name: difference and its variants
patterns.context: Activation is most prominent near the word difference. It occurs in contexts involving comparison, difference, or effect, and can also be part of a longer string. Paragraphs 1, 4, 6, and 10 have no clear ordinary-English use of difference and may involve tokenization or incidental co-occurrence
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: corporate email, medical papers, forum discussions, Github/StackExchange technical text

patterns.name: DES substring
patterns.context: The uppercase substring DES occurs in the HTML comment identifier DESCRIPTION, the cipher suite name DES-CBC, the statistical software DESeq, and suspected encoded text; some examples are unrelated to the ordinary word difference
patterns.domain: Code, technical configuration, paper methods, and encoded text

1_1884.description: 最稳定的线索是 difference（差异）一词；另有大写 DES 子串触发，出现在 DESCRIPTION、DES-CBC、DESeq 和编码文本中。两类线索未必同源。

patterns.name: difference 词及其变体
patterns.trigger: «difference»10；第 8 段的上下文含完整词 difference，第 2、3、5、7、9 段也是完整词；其他段出现分词或被编码切碎的形式
patterns.context: 词 difference 附近激活最显著；可在比较、差异、影响等语义上下文中，也可作为较长串的一部分。第 1、4、6、10 段没有明显的普通英语 difference 用法，可能涉及切分或偶然共现
patterns.domain: 跨领域：企业邮件、医学论文、论坛讨论、Github/StackExchange 技术文本

patterns.name: DES 子串
patterns.context: 大写子串 DES 出现在 HTML 注释标识 DESCRIPTION、密码套件名称 DES-CBC、统计软件 DESeq，以及疑似编码文本中；部分例子与普通词 difference 无关
patterns.domain: 代码、技术配置、论文方法及编码文本

en.description: The strongest and most recurrent trigger is difference, concerning differences, effects, or no significant difference; there is also one DES subword activation in the code-documentation heading DESCRIPTION. Other contexts vary widely.

patterns.name: Modifiers or complements after difference
patterns.context: The word is marked as strongly activating; it occurs in phrases expressing effects, differences, distinctions, or lack of effect, followed by a complement or near the end of a sentence.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: email, Q&A, news commentary, medical papers, IRC

patterns.name: DESCRIPTION in a description field
patterns.context: Appears in code documentation as an uppercase field name or delimited heading; activation falls on the initial subword DES in DESCRIPTION.

1_1884.description: 最强且反复出现的触发是 difference，涉及差异、效果或无显著差异；另有一次代码文档标题 DESCRIPTION 的 DES 子词激活。其余上下文差异很大。

patterns.name: difference 后的修饰或补语
patterns.context: 该词被标记为强激活；出现在表达影响、差异、区分或无影响的短语中，后接补语或位于句末附近。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：邮件、问答、新闻评论、医学论文、IRC

patterns.name: 描述字段中的 DESCRIPTION
patterns.context: 代码文档中以大写字段名或分隔标题形式出现；激活落在 DESCRIPTION 的开头子词 DES。

en.concept: The word form difference and the DES subword
en.description: The clearest pattern is strong activation on the complete word “difference” across email, commentary, forums, medical papers, and IRC, in contexts involving differences, effects, or comparisons. In technical documentation, “DES” also activates strongly as the initial subword of “DESCRIPTION”; this instance may be incidental to the main pattern, due to tokenization or spelling.

patterns.name: The word form difference
patterns.context: The complete word is marked in sentences expressing differences, effects, or comparisons; although the contexts vary, the target word is identical.
patterns.domain: Multiple domains: email, Q&A, forums, medical papers, chat

patterns.name: Split DESCRIPTION field
patterns.context: The uppercase field name “DESCRIPTION” in HTML/configuration documentation is split into subwords; strong activation falls on the initial subword “DES”.

1_1884.concept: difference 词形及 DES 子词
1_1884.description: 最明显的规律是对完整单词“difference”的强激活，跨邮件、评论、论坛、医学论文和 IRC，涵盖差异、影响或比较等语境。另在技术文档中，“DES”作为“DESCRIPTION”的开头子词也强激活；此例与主规律可能只是分词或词形巧合。

patterns.name: difference 词形
patterns.context: 被标记的完整单词，出现在表达差异、影响或比较的句子中；虽上下文不同，目标词完全相同。
patterns.domain: 多领域：邮件、问答、论坛、医学论文、聊天

patterns.name: DESCRIPTION 字段拆分
patterns.context: HTML/配置文档中的大写字段名“DESCRIPTION”被拆成子词；强激活落在开头子词“DES”。

en.description: Activation is scattered across DESCRIPTION text, emitted, Webb in Webbington, Java parameter args, DES encryption suites, and several identifier/metadata fragments; there is no clear unified semantics.

patterns.name: DESCRIPTION label
patterns.context: DESCRIPTION is split into DES and CRIPTION, or appears as complete HTML label text; it can occur in comments, file headers, or table cells.

patterns.name: emitted followed by an object
patterns.context: The past participle emitted is followed by a from phrase or the modal may; instances come from scientific descriptions and patent text.

patterns.name: Ending fragment in Webbington
patterns.context: In tabular biographical or organizational information, the name Webbington is tokenized, with activation falling on Webb.

patterns.name: Java parameter name args
patterns.context: The parameter name args in a Java main method declaration, following the type String[].

patterns.name: DES cipher-suite fragment
patterns.context: DES occurs repeatedly within algorithm names in TLS/cipher-suite strings.

patterns.name: Character fragments in IOCs headings
patterns.context: Sporadic character fragments within IOC filenames or hash-like identifiers; they appear in the same segment as a DESCRIPTION file header.

patterns.name: Subword in neutral
patterns.context: Culture=neutral in an assembly identifier; located among metadata fields such as version and public key token.

1_1884.description: 激活分散于 DESCRIPTION 文本、emitted、Webbington 的 Webb、Java 参数 args、DES 加密套件及若干标识符/元数据片段；没有明显统一语义。

patterns.name: DESCRIPTION 标签
patterns.context: DESCRIPTION 被拆分为 DES 与 CRIPTION，或作为完整 HTML 标签文本出现；可位于注释、文件头或表格单元格中。

patterns.name: emitted 后接宾语
patterns.context: 过去分词 emitted 后接 from 短语或情态动词 may；分属科学描述与专利文本。

patterns.name: Webbington 的尾部片段
patterns.context: 表格化人物或组织信息中，名字 Webbington 被分词切分，激活落在 Webb 上。

patterns.name: Java 参数名 args
patterns.context: Java main 方法声明中的参数名 args，位于类型 String[] 之后。

patterns.name: DES 加密套件片段
patterns.context: TLS/密码套件字符串中 DES 出现在算法名称内，多次重复。

patterns.name: IOCs 标题中的字符片段
patterns.context: IOC 文件名或哈希样式标识符内的零散字符片段；并与 DESCRIPTION 文件头同段出现。

patterns.name: neutral 的子词
patterns.context: 程序集标识中的 Culture=neutral；处于版本与公钥令牌等元数据字段之间。

en.concept: CVD abbreviation and a few word forms/markers
en.description: Activation is concentrated on the abbreviation CVD, especially in biomedical text discussing disease, risk, or research outcomes; there are also two contexts for neutral and a Writer token in an XML type name, which do not fit into one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: CVD abbreviation
patterns.context: Occurs as an abbreviation for cardiovascular disease or in related contexts involving risk, outcomes, or prevalence; may appear with diabetes, older populations, risk factors, or research descriptions.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, research abstracts, and project abstracts

patterns.name: The word form neutral
patterns.context: Used as an ordinary adjective in the medical term “neutral glycolipid antibodies” or in the energy-related phrase “carbon neutral synthetic fuel”; neither occurrence is the CVD abbreviation.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts; energy and shipping discussions

patterns.name: XML resource writer marker
patterns.context: Part of the .NET type name System.Resources.ResXResourceWriter in XML configuration content, capitalized with an initial uppercase letter.

1_1884.concept: CVD 缩写及少数词形/标记
1_1884.description: 激活主要集中在 CVD 缩写，尤其是生物医学文本中讨论疾病、风险或研究结局时；另有 neutral 的两种语境，以及 XML 类型名中的 Writer，无法归入同一词义模式。

patterns.name: CVD 缩写
patterns.context: 出现在心血管疾病（cardiovascular disease）的缩写或相关风险、结局、患病率语境中；可伴随糖尿病、老年人群、危险因素或研究描述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、研究摘要及项目摘要

patterns.name: neutral 词形
patterns.context: 作为普通形容词出现在医学术语“neutral glycolipid antibodies”中，或能源语境的“carbon neutral synthetic fuel”中；两处均不是 CVD 缩写。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要；能源与航运讨论

patterns.name: XML 资源写入器标记
patterns.context: 作为 XML 配置内容中 .NET 类型名 System.Resources.ResXResourceWriter 的组成部分，大小写为首字母大写。

en.description: Activation centers on paired/unpaired and fragments within these words: it includes both ordinary senses of pairing or being unimpaired and contexts involving statistical tests, siRNA, drug leads, and device pairing.

patterns.name: paired/unpaired statistical tests
patterns.context: Occurs in statistical analyses or experimental results, modifying t-tests, samples, or comparison methods; includes un«paired» across token boundaries.

patterns.name: General senses of paired
patterns.context: Refers to a strictly paired siRNA duplex, paired drug leads, or unimpaired property rights; not a statistical-test usage.

patterns.name: Paired peripheral devices
patterns.context: Occurs in expressions such as “previously-paired peripheral device”, referring to a device already paired with a system.

patterns.name: Unimpaired physiological function
patterns.context: paired occurs within unimpaired, describing normal, unimpaired autonomic reflex function.

1_1884.description: 激活集中于 paired/unpaired 及其词内片段：既包括配对或未受损的普通词义，也包括统计检验、siRNA、药物线索和设备配对等语境。

patterns.name: paired/unpaired 统计检验
patterns.context: 出现在统计分析或实验结果中，修饰 t 检验、样本或比较方式；包括分词边界跨 token 的 un«paired»。

patterns.name: paired 的一般词义
patterns.context: 表示严格配对的 siRNA duplex、配对的药物线索，或未受损的产权（unimpaired）；并非统计检验用法。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、神经科学、法律

patterns.name: 配对外设
patterns.context: 出现在“previously-paired peripheral device”等表达中，指已与系统完成配对的设备。

patterns.name: unimpaired 生理功能
patterns.context: paired 位于 unimpaired 一词中，描述自主反射功能正常、未受损。

en.description: All passages contain judged or judges (the first passage contains the initial fragment of judicial); usages include judging, evaluating, assessing, and inferring, across varied domains and syntactic environments.

patterns.name: judged and inflected forms
patterns.context: Trigger forms include judged and judges; they function as active or passive predicates and as complement verbs meaning “determine/consider”. They occur in different contexts, including independently and embedded within words.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including news, encyclopedias, commentary, entertainment reporting, patents, and medical abstracts

1_1884.description: 所有段落都包含 judged 或 judges（第1段为 judicial 的词首片段）；涵盖裁判、评审、评价、判断及推断等用法，领域和句法环境多样。

patterns.name: judged 及其屈折形式
patterns.context: 触发词形包括 judged、judges；既可作主动谓语或被动谓语，也可作“判定/认为”的补语动词。不同语境下均出现，包括独立出现及嵌在词内的分词。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、评论、娱乐报道、专利、医学摘要等多种文体

en.description: All passages activate the bound stem, including bounding identifiers, directional compounds for travel or north/south, heading toward a destination, spellbound, and module boundaries. The main commonality is morphological rather than a single meaning.

patterns.name: bound/bounding stem
patterns.context: The stem itself is marked in standalone words, compounds, and derived forms, covering meanings such as boundary, direction, binding, and constraint.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; code, encyclopedia entries, email, legal narratives, and forum discussions

patterns.name: bound in code identifiers
patterns.context: Occurs inside program identifiers referring to rectangular bounding boxes, calculating contour bounding rectangles, and variable names; activation falls on the bound stem rather than surrounding code.

patterns.name: bound in directions or travel
patterns.context: bound combines with directional or travel-related prefixes to describe the direction of departure/arrival or a north/south direction.
patterns.domain: Travel email, transportation encyclopedia entries, legal case narratives

patterns.name: bound in geographic or military compounds
patterns.context: bound describes going to or heading toward a place; the contexts involve a seafaring party and an approaching enemy aircraft, respectively.

patterns.name: spellbound
patterns.context: bound occurs in the fixed word spellbound, meaning enchanted or controlled by magic; this is unrelated to direction or code boundaries.

patterns.name: module boundaries
patterns.context: bound forms the stem of boundaries, referring to isolation or scope between software modules.

1_1884.description: 全部片段都命中 bound 词干，涵盖 bounding 标识符、出入／南北方向复合词、朝向目的地、spellbound及module boundaries；共同点主要是词形而非单一语义。

patterns.name: bound／bounding 词干
patterns.context: 词干本身被标记，出现在独立单词或复合词、派生词中；覆盖多种含义，如边界、方向、绑定和受约束状态。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；代码、百科、邮件、法律叙述及论坛讨论

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 bound
patterns.context: 出现在程序标识符内部，分别涉及矩形边界框、计算轮廓外接矩形及变量名；激活落在 bound 词干而非周围代码上。

patterns.name: 方向或行程中的 bound
patterns.context: bound 与表示方向或行程的前缀组成复合词，指向出发／到达流向或南北方向。
patterns.domain: 旅行邮件、交通百科、法律案件叙述

patterns.name: 地理或军事复合词中的 bound
patterns.context: bound 描述前往某处或朝向某处；上下文分别涉及航海队伍和敌机来袭。

patterns.name: spellbound
patterns.context: bound 出现在固定词 spellbound 中，表示被魔法迷住或控制；并非方向或代码边界含义。
patterns.domain: 奇幻游戏／角色背景文字

patterns.name: module boundaries
patterns.context: bound 构成 boundaries 的词干，指软件模块之间的隔离或作用范围。

en.description: Primarily responds to bound and its forms or compounds: it can refer to bookbinding, boundedness, traveling to a destination, directional movement, and also occurs in spellbound and boundless; the specific meaning depends on collocations and context.

patterns.name: bound meaning bookbound
patterns.context: Near books, booklets, or volumes, often paired with materials, colors, or binding methods, such as “bound in white and gold parchment”, “volumes bound in calf”, and “bound in cloth”.

patterns.name: bound meaning bounded or enclosed
patterns.context: Describes an opening delimited or enclosed by wire on one side or all around.

patterns.name: bound meaning traveling to a destination
patterns.context: After vehicles or people set out, bound is followed by a destination or direction, as in “Charleston bound for Hampton Roads” and “Red Sea-bound squad”.

patterns.name: bound in directional terms
patterns.context: Combines with directional words such as east, south, and north to form eastbound, southbound, and northbound, describing roads, platforms, or direction of travel.
patterns.domain: Legal text, transportation and geographic encyclopedias, news narratives

patterns.name: bound in spellbound
patterns.context: The latter part of spellbound, meaning captivated by magic or charm; nearby is “keeping him spellbound”.

patterns.name: bound in boundless
patterns.context: The stem portion of boundless, appearing in a username or signature, with the meaning “without bounds”.

1_1884.description: 主要响应 bound 及其词形或复合词：可指书籍装订、边界限定、驶往某地、方向行进，也出现在 spellbound、boundless 中；具体含义由搭配和上下文决定。

patterns.name: bound 表示装订
patterns.context: 书籍、书册或卷册附近，常与材料、颜色或装订方式搭配，如“bound in white and gold parchment”“volumes bound in calf”“bound in cloth”。

patterns.name: bound 表示界定或围住
patterns.context: 描述开口由线材在一侧或四周限定、围住。

patterns.name: bound 表示驶往某地
patterns.context: 交通工具或人员出发后，bound 后接目的地或方向，如“Charleston bound for Hampton Roads”“Red Sea-bound squad”。

patterns.name: 方位词中的 bound
patterns.context: 与 east、south、north 等方向词构成 eastbound、southbound、northbound，描述道路、站台或行进方向。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、交通与地理百科、新闻叙事

patterns.name: spellbound 中的 bound
patterns.context: 作为 spellbound 的后半部分，表示被魔法或魅力迷住；附近有“keeping him spellbound”。

patterns.name: boundless 中的 bound
patterns.context: 作为 boundless 的词干部分，出现在用户名或署名中，语义为无边界。

en.concept: Polysemous uses of the bound/bind word family
en.description: Activations mainly fall on the bound/bind word family: travel direction, tying or bookbinding, boundary constraints, adhesive materials, and spellbound. One instance of exposed is difficult to explain.

patterns.name: bound meaning “heading toward a place”
patterns.context: Combined with directional words to describe the direction of a lane, platform, or person's movement.
patterns.domain: Legal real estate records, transportation facility descriptions, witness testimony

patterns.name: bound meaning “tie, wrap, or bind”
patterns.context: Describes objects being tied up or books bound in a particular material; also includes the related noun forms bindle and binding.
patterns.domain: Legal testimony, book advertisements and binding history

patterns.name: bound indicating a boundary or enclosure
patterns.context: Describes the edges of an opening or area as defined or enclosed by structures.

patterns.name: binder/binders and the bind word family
patterns.context: Discusses adhesive materials used for granulation or shaping and the causes of their failure; the forms contain bind but do not refer to bookbinding.

patterns.name: bound meaning constrained or fascinated
patterns.context: Occurs in “keeping him spellbound,” meaning to fascinate or control someone.

patterns.name: Unclassified neighboring activation pattern
