patterns.name: Anchor bolts in construction
patterns.context: A legal document lists rebar, metal mesh, and anchor bolts used in house construction.

patterns.name: Substrate detached from a fixture
patterns.context: After manufacturing a strain gauge protective layer, the substrate is removed from the fixture; activation centers on “detached.”

1_1884.concept: 局部边界固定与脱离相关词形
1_1884.description: 激活分散于航海停泊、表面清洁抛光、粘结剂、开口边界、墙体及井下锚固、建筑锚栓和基片脱离；多为技术语境中的局部词形或动作，另有地名 Yorktown。

patterns.name: 海事航行与停泊
patterns.context: 航海操作清单中，描述船只转向、帆船航行与停泊；同段还出现“Jibing”“Luffing”“Reefing”。

patterns.name: 清洁与抛光接触表面
patterns.trigger: “« wiped» down”“« damp» MF« towel»”及“« buff»ed”“« contact» areas”
patterns.context: 汽车美容讨论中，擦拭橡胶密封条并抛光橡胶及接触区域。

patterns.name: 粘结剂及其失效
patterns.context: 讨论稻壳灰制粒在高温液态钢环境中的失败，并将其归因于粘结剂组成。

patterns.name: 边界、围定或约束开口
patterns.context: 描述轧制与非轧制金属丝如何围定开口边界。

patterns.name: 地点名称中的 Yorktown
patterns.context: 历史叙述列举张贴告示的地点；激活落在地名的一部分，语义上未必与其他模式相关。

patterns.name: 墙体锚固与支撑
patterns.context: 悬臂支撑需要加固墙体以承受载荷。

patterns.name: 井下生产衬管锚固
patterns.context: 描述井眼钻完、套管并射孔后，将生产衬管锚固在井眼中。

patterns.name: 锚栓用于建筑
patterns.context: 法律文书列举建房所用的钢筋、金属网和锚栓。

patterns.name: 基片从夹具脱离
patterns.context: 制造应变计保护层后，将基片从夹具上取下；激活集中在“detached”。

en.description: Activation is scattered across words and phrases concerning anchor, bound, vehicle and vessel components, metal plates, mesh, car care, and nautical actions; examples are common in patents and engineering descriptions but also include literary, forum, and legal texts.

patterns.name: The word anchor
patterns.context: Occurs in different senses and collocations: nautical “Coming to anchor,” “anchor a production liner” downhole, and “anchor bolts” in construction materials.

patterns.name: bound and boundary contexts
patterns.context: Describes an opening enclosed or delimited by wires on one or more sides.

patterns.name: Descriptions of vessel or vehicle components and structures
patterns.context: Concerns components of vehicles, hulls, or equipment, their installation locations, and entrances or exits.

patterns.name: plate and layered components
patterns.context: Repeatedly mentions metal plates and their support, attachment, or front-to-back layered structure.

patterns.name: Fabric or mesh materials
patterns.context: Describes openings formed by wires or wire mesh used in construction.

patterns.name: Vehicle surface cleaning and care
patterns.context: Describes wiping and polishing vehicle rubber seals and contact areas with a wet towel.

patterns.name: Red-letter posters and historical locations
patterns.context: Recounts a conspicuous red-letter notice being posted at a historical location after a viewpoint was challenged.

patterns.name: Material conveyance in rotating equipment
patterns.context: Describes a rotor flinging material radially outward and the roles of stator slots and teeth.

patterns.name: Nautical actions and onboard terminology
patterns.context: Lists operations such as tacking, sail handling, reefing, and coming alongside.

1_1884.description: 激活分散于anchor、bound、车辆船舶构件、金属板、网材、汽车护理及航海动作等词句；多见于专利和工程描述，但也涵盖文学、论坛与法律文本。

patterns.name: anchor 一词
patterns.context: 在不同语义和搭配中出现：航海的“Coming to anchor”、井下“anchor a production liner”、建筑材料“anchor bolts”。
patterns.domain: 航海文本、专利、法律文本

patterns.name: bound 及其边界语境
patterns.context: 描述开口被线材从一侧或多侧围住、界定。

patterns.name: 船舶或车辆部件与结构描述
patterns.context: 围绕车辆、船体或设备的构件、安装位置和出入口展开。

patterns.name: plate 及层状构件
patterns.context: 反复提及金属板及其支撑、附着或前后层结构。

patterns.name: 织物或网状材料
patterns.context: 描述线材形成的开口，或建筑中使用的钢丝网。

patterns.name: 车辆表面清洁护理
patterns.context: 描述用湿毛巾擦拭并抛光车辆橡胶密封条及接触部位。

patterns.name: 红字海报与历史地点
patterns.context: 叙述某种观点受反驳后，在历史地点张贴醒目红字告示。

patterns.name: 旋转设备中的物料输送
patterns.context: 描述转子将物料径向甩出，以及定子狭缝和齿的作用。

patterns.name: 航海动作与船上术语
patterns.context: 列举帆船转向、操帆、缩帆及靠岸等操作。

en.description: Activations occur on a variety of specific terms and intra-word fragments: anchor/anchors, tacking, hat in hatches, bind in binders, substrate, York in Yorktown, and several words in recipes and structural patents. Apart from recurring anchor, the patterns vary considerably in meaning and style and are difficult to group under a single theme.

patterns.name: anchor / anchors
patterns.context: The word itself triggers, referring to a ship's anchor, an anchor used for fixation within an organization, or a wall anchor, across different technical and semantic uses.

patterns.name: Other word-final fragment -ching
patterns.context: An intra-word fragment in a maritime operations term; it is not synonymous with anchor in the same passage.

patterns.name: hat in a compound word
patterns.context: Activation falls on the string hat in hatches; the context describes vehicle roof hatches, possibly reflecting a subword-fragment effect.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment in building materials and adhesives
patterns.context: Appears in a patent sentence about rice-husk-ash briquettes and their adhesive material; activation covers the initial fragment of binders.

patterns.name: package / substrate electronic packaging
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of flip-chip packaging, bump mounting, and signal paths.

patterns.name: Place-name fragment in a historical narrative
patterns.context: The York substring in a place name is activated in a list of locations in a historical narrative; it has no clear shared trigger with surrounding content such as doctrine or posters.

patterns.name: Baking and serving instructions
patterns.context: Recipe steps describe baking, covering the pie edge to prevent excessive browning, and letting it stand before serving.

patterns.name: Structural supports and panels
patterns.context: Describes metal support plates, plastic or composite striking plates, and interconnected convex panels.

patterns.name: Opening boundaries in metal wire mesh
patterns.context: Describes openings and their boundaries formed by rolled or non-rolled metal wires.

1_1884.description: 激活分布在多种具体词项和词内片段上：anchor/anchors、tacking、hatches中的hat、binders中的bind、substrate、Yorktown中的York，以及食谱和结构专利中的若干词。除anchor重复外，各模式语义与文体差异较大，难以归为单一主题。

patterns.name: anchor / anchors
patterns.context: 词本身触发；指船舶锚、组织内固定用锚，或墙体锚固件，含不同技术和语义用法。

patterns.name: 其他词尾片段 -ching
patterns.context: 航海操作术语中的词内片段；不与同段的 anchor 同义。

patterns.name: 帽子复合词中的 hat
patterns.context: 激活落在 hatches 中的 hat 字符串；上下文描述车辆车顶舱口，可能是子词片段效应。
patterns.domain: 车辆 / 军用装备百科说明

patterns.name: 建材与粘结剂词尾
patterns.context: 位于介绍稻壳灰压块及其粘结剂材料的专利句中；激活覆盖 binders 的词首片段。

patterns.name: package / substrate 电子封装
patterns.context: 出现在 flip-chip 封装、凸点安装及信号路径的描述中。

patterns.name: 历史叙述中的地名片段
patterns.context: 历史叙述列举地点时激活地名中的 York 子串；与周围的 doctrine、posters 等内容无明显共同触发。

patterns.name: 烘焙与上桌指令
patterns.context: 食谱步骤中，描述烘烤、覆盖饼边、防止过度上色以及食用前静置。

patterns.name: 结构支撑与板件
patterns.context: 描述金属支撑板、塑料或复合材料击球板及相互连接的凸面板件。

patterns.name: 金属丝网开口边界
patterns.context: 描述由轧制或非轧制金属丝围成的开口及其边界。
patterns.domain: 材料 / 金属丝结构专利

en.description: Activation is mainly associated with anchoring terms such as anchor/anchored, covering both vessel anchoring and engineering fastening; sporadic activation also occurs for dressing, nautical terms, clothing, vehicle hatches, plate structures, and the place name York.

patterns.name: anchor / anchoring
patterns.context: Anchors or anchoring structures and their fastening or mooring functions; not limited to literal ship anchors, but also includes anchoring in tissue, buildings, and wellbores.

patterns.name: dressing
patterns.context: The word appears both in a dressing operation for a polishing-cloth tool and in descriptions of a person’s clothing; both senses activate.

patterns.name: Clothing and nautical terminology
patterns.context: Nautical terms occur in a list of sailing operations; the same passage includes “Wearing ship” and “Coming to anchor.”

patterns.name: Head coverings and clothing
patterns.context: Sailors discuss someone’s attire, including a hat and changes of clothing.

patterns.name: Vehicle openings and hatches
patterns.context: Describes windows, doors, and roof hatches on vehicles or armored vehicles.

patterns.name: Metal-plate structures
patterns.context: Describes metal support plates, plastic or composite impact plates, and their connections.

patterns.name: York in a place name
patterns.context: The place name Yorkville occurs in road names and route descriptions.

1_1884.description: 主要激活于 anchor/anchored 等锚固词，涵盖船舶停泊及工程固定；另对 dressing、航海术语、服饰、车辆舱口、板材结构和地名 York 有零散激活。

patterns.name: anchor / anchoring
patterns.context: 锚或锚固结构及其固定、停泊用途；不局限于字面船锚，也包括组织、建筑和井筒中的锚固。
patterns.domain: 航海、专利、法律/建筑、油井技术

patterns.name: dressing
patterns.context: 该词出现在抛光布工具的修整操作，以及人物衣着的描述中；两种语义均有激活。

patterns.name: 衣着与航海词汇
patterns.context: 航海操作清单中出现的航行术语；同时段含“Wearing ship”和“Coming to anchor”。

patterns.name: 头部覆盖物与服饰
patterns.context: 水手谈论某人的穿着，涉及帽子和衣着变化。

patterns.name: 车辆开口与舱盖
patterns.context: 描述车辆/装甲车的车窗、车门及顶部舱口。

patterns.name: 金属板结构
patterns.context: 描述金属支撑板、塑料或复合材料撞击板及其连接关系。

patterns.name: 地名中的 York
patterns.context: 出现在道路名称和路线说明中的地名 Yorkville。

en.description: Strong activations often fall on anchor/anchored, referring to ships anchoring or components being fixed. There is also bound in patents meaning a boundary is defined, as well as isolated intra-word substrings in Yorkville, hatches, and associated, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Anchoring or fixing
patterns.context: Ships anchor at sea, in ports, or at berths, or components are fixed in place on walls, wellbores, and similar structures; related anchorage forms are also included.

patterns.name: Boundary definition
patterns.context: Describes what structures, materials, or components define the edge of an opening or slit; the same form occurs in both passages.

patterns.name: Yorkville in a road name
patterns.context: The place name Yorkville occurs in a road name and a description of an old route; activation centers on the intra-word York substring.

patterns.name: Hatches
patterns.context: The vehicle description mentions roof hatches; the marked feature is an intra-word substring of hatches.

patterns.name: Association or attachment
patterns.context: A patent describes the structural relationship between convex front and rear panels.

1_1884.description: 强激活多落在 anchor/anchored（船舶抛锚或构件固定）；另有专利中的 bound（边界限定），以及 Yorkville、hatches、associated 等孤立词内子串，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 锚定或固定
patterns.context: 船只在海上、港口或泊位抛锚，或把构件固定在墙体、井筒等位置；也包括相关的 anchorage 词形。

patterns.name: 边界限定
patterns.context: 描述开口或狭缝的边缘由何种结构、材料或部件限定；两段均出现同一词形。

patterns.name: 道路名称中的 Yorkville
patterns.context: 地名 Yorkville 出现在道路名称及旧路线说明中，激活集中于词内 York 子串。

patterns.name: 舱口
patterns.context: 车辆描述中出现 roof hatches；标记落在 hatches 的词内子串。

patterns.name: 关联或附属关系
patterns.context: 专利描述中凸面前板与后板之间的结构关系。

en.description: Strongly activated terms are scattered across nautical and patent texts: anchor, bound, and neutral, associated, attach, stacking, dressing, and others; most correspond to their own technical contexts, while several other cues are unmarked, making it difficult to assign them to one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: The term anchor
patterns.context: The word form anchor appears directly, referring respectively to dropping anchor in a nautical context and securing a production liner in a wellbore; the meanings differ
patterns.domain: Nautical explanatory text; patent technical background

patterns.name: The term bound and its inflected forms
patterns.context: Bound occurs to mean delimited by a boundary, tied, or joined; its specific meaning differs by passage

patterns.name: neutral gear in a gearbox
patterns.context: Describes the state or position of a gearbox mechanism

patterns.name: Convex metal-plate structure
patterns.context: Describes the structural relationship between a metal support plate and front and rear convex plates

patterns.name: Installation of a support ring for a tie rod
patterns.context: Following background about vibration and damage, a solution involving a support ring installed on a tie rod is introduced

patterns.name: Stacking folded signatures
patterns.context: A binding machine stacks bundles of trimmed and tied folded signatures for storage

patterns.name: Dressing a polishing cloth
patterns.context: Describes a rotating dressing tool pressing against the working surface of a polishing cloth, completing the dressing operation, and returning

patterns.name: Chemical precipitation and binding
patterns.context: Calcium ions and hydroxide ions near a cathode combine and precipitate as calcium hydroxide

patterns.name: Unmarked lexical cues
patterns.context: The nautical terminology passage contains tacking, while weft consists of a marked token followed by subsequent text; their relationship to the strongly marked anchor is unclear

patterns.name: Unmarked boundary and structural cues
patterns.context: Describes an opening formed by metal wires and its boundary structure; may relate to the spatial delimiting sense of bound

patterns.name: Unmarked gear-mechanism action cues
patterns.context: Describes engagement, disengagement, and relative positions between gears and a gearbox housing

patterns.name: Unmarked vibration cues
patterns.context: Discusses rotor vibration and reducing the free vibration length using a support ring

patterns.name: Unmarked material-transport cues
patterns.context: Describes radial transport of material by a rotor and stator slots, and their effects

patterns.name: Unmarked dressing-operation cues
patterns.context: Describes operation of the dressing tool and turntable

patterns.name: Unmarked ion and liquid cues
patterns.context: The process in which ions in liquid near a cathode combine and precipitate

1_1884.description: 强激活词项分散于航海与专利文本：anchor、bound及neutral、associated、attach、stacking、dressing等；多数对应各自技术语境，另有多组未标记线索，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: anchor 词项
patterns.context: 直接出现词形 anchor；分别用于航海的抛锚和井筒内固定生产衬管，语义不同
patterns.domain: 航海说明文；专利技术背景

patterns.name: bound 词项及其屈折形式
patterns.context: 出现 bound，表示由边界限定、捆扎或结合；各段具体含义不同

patterns.name: gearbox 中的 neutral 档位
patterns.context: 描述变速箱齿轮机构的状态或位置

patterns.name: 凸形金属板结构
patterns.context: 描述金属支撑板与前后凸形板之间的结构关系

patterns.name: tie rod 支撑环的安装
patterns.context: 振动与损伤背景之后，出现给 tie rod 安装支撑环的方案

patterns.name: 书帖堆叠
patterns.context: 装订设备存储已裁切、捆扎的书帖束时将其堆叠

patterns.name: 抛光布修整
patterns.context: 描述旋转修整工具压到抛光布工作面、完成修整后返回

patterns.name: 化学沉淀结合
patterns.context: 阴极附近的钙离子与氢氧根离子结合并沉淀为氢氧化钙

patterns.name: 未标记的词项线索
patterns.context: 航海术语段中出现 tacking，以及由标记 token 与后续文本组成的 weft；与强标记 anchor 的关系不明

patterns.name: 未标记的边界与结构词线索
patterns.context: 描述金属丝围成的开口及其边界构造；可能与 bound 的空间限定义相关

patterns.name: 未标记的齿轮机构动作线索
patterns.context: 描述齿轮与变速箱壳体间的啮合、脱开及相对位置

patterns.name: 未标记的振动线索
patterns.context: 讨论转子振动及通过支撑环缩短自由振动长度

patterns.name: 未标记的物料输运线索
patterns.context: 描述转子与定子狭缝对物料的径向输运及作用

patterns.name: 未标记的修整操作线索
patterns.context: 描述修整工具和转台的操作过程

patterns.name: 未标记的离子与液体线索
patterns.context: 阴极附近液体中的离子结合、沉淀过程

en.description: Primarily activates on descriptions of connections in the attach word family, especially components attached/attaching to a structure, connection locations, or mating relationships; also covers securing/securing of terminals and the separate use of programmed for flash memory.

patterns.name: Passive connection relationship
patterns.context: Describes how a component connects to another component, commonly in the form “attached/attaching to [target]”; the connection method may be explained in following text or left unspecified.
patterns.domain: Patent specifications; also bicycle repair Q&A

patterns.name: Connection points and mating structures
patterns.context: The activation occurs in contexts that clearly describe connection locations, connecting components, or mating relationships.
patterns.domain: Mechanical, vehicle, and equipment-structure patents; repair instructions

patterns.name: Fastening terminals or wires
patterns.context: Battery terminals or wires are fastened with bolts, nuts, etc.; not a form of attach, but part of the same fastening-connection descriptions.

patterns.name: Memory programming action
patterns.context: Describes bit-level programming of flash memory; distinct from the semantics of physical component connections.

1_1884.description: 主要对 attach 词族的连接描述激活，尤以部件 attached/attaching to 某结构、连接位置或配合关系为主；另对固定端子的 secured/securing，以及闪存 programmed 单独激活。

patterns.name: 被动连接关系
patterns.context: 描述部件如何连接到另一部件，常见结构为“attached/attaching to [目标]”，连接方式可以由后续文字说明或未说明。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书；另有自行车维修问答

patterns.name: 连接部位与配合结构
patterns.trigger: «attach»able to a «boat» «stern»；«deck» «attaching» «portions»；«bolts» «attaching» the caliper；«front» «cover» «attached» to the «front» «opening»
patterns.context: 激活词处于明确描述连接位置、连接部件或连接配合关系的语境中。
patterns.domain: 机械、车辆及设备结构专利；维修说明

patterns.name: 端子或导线的固定
patterns.context: 以螺栓、螺母等固定电池端子或导线；不是 attach 的词形，但同属紧固连接描述。

patterns.name: 记忆体编程动作
patterns.context: 描述闪存按位编程；与实体部件连接语义不同。

en.concept: Relationships and constraints among technical components
en.description: Most patent passages concern component relationships involving anchoring, support, restraint, delimitation, or force application; there is also nautical anchoring and an isolated mention of a clothes rack in everyday narrative.

patterns.name: Relational or component terms in patent claims
patterns.context: In mechanical, equipment, or chemical patent descriptions, denotes components and relationships involving fastening, support, restraint, delimitation, or force application; often occurs in noun phrases or technical process descriptions.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background and technical descriptions

patterns.name: Nautical term anchor
patterns.context: In a list of nautical actions, anchor refers to a ship’s anchor or dropping anchor; it shares a word form with the fastening/anchoring sense in patents but has a different meaning here.

patterns.name: Clothing and storage space in everyday narrative
patterns.context: Everyday narrative describes a dog hiding under a bed or in a low area of a closet; no clear shared trigger pattern with the other technical texts is apparent.

1_1884.description: 多数专利段落涉及部件的锚固、支承、约束、界定或施力关系；另有航海语境中的抛锚，以及日常叙事中衣物架的孤例。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求中的关系或构件术语
patterns.context: 机械、设备或化学专利描述中，表示固定、支承、约束、界定或施力的部件及其关系；常位于名词短语或技术过程描述中。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景与技术说明

patterns.name: 航海术语 anchor
patterns.context: 航海动作清单中，anchor 指船锚或抛锚；与专利中的固定/锚固用法词形相同，但此处语义不同。
patterns.domain: 航海类书籍或说明文字

patterns.name: 日常叙述中的衣物与储物空间
patterns.context: 描述狗躲在床下或衣橱低处的日常叙事；与其余技术文本没有明确共同触发模式。

en.concept: Connection and fastening of technical components
en.description: Primarily responds to patent-style technical descriptions of component connections, fastening, mounting, insertion, and end-position relationships; also covers component formation and mechanical-device terminology, and appears in biochemical surface immobilization and oil-circuit descriptions.

patterns.name: Attachment, fastening, or connection relationships
patterns.context: Describes a part, material, or assembly being connected, fastened, mounted, or plugged into another object; often appears in passive constructions or patent descriptions.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background; also NIH biomaterial descriptions

patterns.name: End, edge, or terminal position
patterns.context: Appears alongside component-position or connection relationships, identifying the end of a rod, wire, screw, or frame; segment [1] also describes an end support with «resting»4«on»1.
patterns.domain: Mechanical, automotive, electrical, and patent structural descriptions

patterns.name: Component inserted into or through a structure
patterns.context: A component enters a hole, adjacent structure, socket, or mounting position, usually as part of fastening or assembly steps.
patterns.domain: Mechanical assembly, electrical connections, and patent descriptions

patterns.name: Material or structure from which a component is made
patterns.context: Describes what structure a part consists of, how it is formed, or its relationship to a housing, surface, opening, etc.
patterns.domain: Mechanical, lighting, and material-structure descriptions in patents

patterns.name: Chemical immobilization and surface functionalization
patterns.context: Describes dextran covalently linked to a substrate through activated hydroxyl groups while retaining functional groups; a specific biochemical surface-treatment context.

patterns.name: Lubrication or fluid transport
patterns.context: Oil in a transmission housing is conveyed by splash or an oil pump to lubricate components; the activation point includes «attached»9, in a description of the oil pump's connection to a shaft.

patterns.name: Mechanical components and specific device terminology
patterns.context: Nouns for devices, fasteners, molds, frames, or transmission components in patent text; they may occur near assembly and fastening topics, but their semantics are individually sporadic.

1_1884.concept: 技术部件的连接与固定
1_1884.description: 主要响应专利式技术描述中部件的连接、固定、安装、插入及端部位置关系；也覆盖构件形成与机械装置术语，并在生化表面固定和油路描述中出现。

patterns.name: 附着、固定或连接关系
patterns.context: 描述零件、材料或组件被连接、固定、安装或插接到另一对象；多在被动结构或专利说明中出现。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景；另见 NIH 生物材料描述

patterns.name: 端部、边缘或末端位置
patterns.context: 与部件位置或连接关系并列，指出杆、线材、螺钉或框架的端部；段[1]另有«resting»4«on»1描述端部支承。
patterns.domain: 机械、汽车、电气及专利结构描述

patterns.name: 部件装入或穿过结构
patterns.context: 部件进入孔、相邻结构、插座或安装位置，通常伴随固定或装配步骤。
patterns.domain: 机械装配、电气连接及专利说明

patterns.name: 制成或构成部件的材料/结构
patterns.context: 描述零件由何种结构构成、如何形成，或部件与壳体、表面、开口等的关系。
patterns.domain: 专利中的机械、灯具及材料结构描述

patterns.name: 化学固定与表面功能化
patterns.context: 描述 dextran 经活化羟基后共价连接至基底，且仍有功能基团；属于特定生化表面处理语境。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物材料/表面化学

patterns.name: 润滑或流体输送
patterns.context: 传动箱内的油由飞溅或油泵输送以润滑部件；激活点包括«attached»9，落在油泵与轴的连接描述中。
patterns.domain: 汽车传动机构专利说明

patterns.name: 机械部件与具体装置术语
patterns.context: 专利文本中的装置、紧固件、模具、框架或传动部件名词；可能与装配固定主题相邻，但各自语义较分散。

en.description: Apart from “under” in everyday narratives, the neuron primarily responds to connection and mounting relationships between mechanical or device components, especially “attached/attaching.” These commonly appear in patent structural descriptions and also occur in repair contexts.

patterns.name: attached to / attaching
patterns.context: Occurs in passive or relational constructions describing a component connected or mounted to another component, especially attached to; this is the most stable shared trigger.
patterns.domain: Mechanical, vehicle, household, and device-structure descriptions in patent specifications; also repair Q&A

patterns.name: Object located underneath
patterns.context: Describes a dog hiding under a bed or clothing rack; appears only in this segment, with no clear link to connection structures.

patterns.name: Lighting fixtures and their components
patterns.context: Repeated in patent-claim-style sentences, referring to lighting fixtures, lamp bodies, lamp cavities, and shades; this segment also contains the highest-intensity instance of “attached.”

patterns.name: Support, mounting, and mechanical component relationships
patterns.context: Describes component support, mounting, construction, or connections in mechanical structures; often adjacent to or in the same passage as “attached” relationships, but does not independently explain all activation.
patterns.domain: Structures of furniture, loading equipment, vehicle switches, appliances, semiconductor equipment, shock absorbers, and golf clubs in patents

patterns.name: General component-connection wording
patterns.context: “Attaching” refers to connecting a caliper to the remaining components with bolts; similar to mounting relationships in patents, but from operational advice rather than patent text.

1_1884.description: 除日常叙事中的“under”外，神经元主要响应机械或器件部件间的连接、安装关系，尤其是“attached/attaching”，常见于专利结构描述，也见于维修语境。

patterns.name: attached to / attaching
patterns.context: 出现在描述部件被连接、安装到另一部件的被动或关系结构中，尤其是 attached to；这是最稳定的共同触发。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书中的机械、车辆、家居及器件结构描述；也出现于维修问答

patterns.name: 物体位于下方
patterns.context: 描述狗躲在床下或衣物架下；仅此段出现，未见与连接结构的明确关联。

patterns.name: 灯具及其组成部件
patterns.context: 在专利权利要求式句子中重复出现，指灯具、灯体、灯腔及灯罩等组件；该段也含最高强度的“attached”。

patterns.name: 支承、安装与机械部件关系
patterns.context: 在机械结构说明中描述部件支承、安装、构成或相互连接；多与“attached”关系相邻或同属一段，但不单独解释全部激活。
patterns.domain: 专利中的家具、装卸设备、车辆开关、家电、半导体设备、减振器及高尔夫球杆结构

patterns.name: 一般部件连接表述
patterns.trigger: “bolts attaching the caliper to the rest”
patterns.context: “attaching”表示通过螺栓连接卡钳与其余部件；与专利中的安装关系相似，但来自操作建议而非专利文本。

en.description: Activation is diffuse: bias/biasing and force application in patents, anchor/anchoring, and also mechanical connection actions, nautical vocabulary, domestic narratives, and floating-gate semiconductors and closet contexts; most patterns occur in only one or two passages.

patterns.name: bias as electrical bias or force application
patterns.context: In electronic, electrical, or mechanical patent contexts, denotes voltage bias or applying force to a component to hold it in a particular direction; in passage 3, «bi»3«asing»1«means»2 is a subword fragment of biasing.
patterns.domain: USPTO patents; mechanical structures and electronic circuits

patterns.name: anchor as a verb or nautical term
patterns.context: Passage 2 describes anchoring a production liner in a wellbore; passage 6 contains the phrase “Coming to anchor” in a list of nautical actions.
patterns.domain: Oil and gas extraction patent; nautical textbook

patterns.name: Sliding and connection actions
patterns.context: Describes a component that can slide on either side of a stop, and a function for binding a texture in OpenGL; the trigger forms and domains differ.

patterns.name: under in a location or load description
patterns.context: In passage 5, indicates a dog hiding under a bed or clothes rack; in passage 10, indicates a TFT sustaining a high bias voltage for a long time. The only commonality is the word form.

patterns.name: Structural descriptions using end and resting
patterns.context: Describes the other end of a component resting on a lip-shaped retainer, a spatial relationship in a mechanical patent.

patterns.name: Loading dock and closed state
patterns.context: A loading-dock door is partially open and closed by a movable door; the terms form one patent context, but no clear connection to other patterns is apparent.

patterns.name: Clothing and closet
patterns.context: Describes a miniature schnauzer hiding under a clothes rack near the master-bedroom closet; both trigger terms occur in a domestic narrative.

patterns.name: Nautical terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in a directory-style list of sailing actions and care topics; «earing» is the in-word marker in “Wearing ship” in the source text.

patterns.name: Semiconductor floating gates and programming
patterns.context: Describes charge, electron storage, conductivity, and programming in floating-gate transistors; the technical meaning is focused, but the unmarked terms include various related terminology.

1_1884.description: 激活分布较散：专利中的 bias/偏置与施力、anchor/锚固，另有机械连接动作、航海词汇、家庭叙事，以及浮栅半导体和衣柜语境；多数模式仅见一两段。

patterns.name: bias 作为偏置或施力
patterns.context: 电子、电气或机械专利语境中，表示电压偏置，或使部件受力、保持在特定方向；第3段的«bi»3«asing»1«means»2是 biasing 的分词片段。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利；机械结构与电子电路

patterns.name: anchor 作动词或航海术语
patterns.context: 第2段是将生产衬管锚固在井筒中；第6段出现在航海动作列表“Coming to anchor”中。
patterns.domain: 油气开采专利；航海教材

patterns.name: 滑动与连接动作
patterns.context: 分别描述止动器两侧可滑动的部件，以及 OpenGL 中绑定纹理的函数名；触发形式和领域不同。

patterns.name: under 出现在位置或负载描述中
patterns.context: 第5段表示狗躲在床下或衣架下；第10段表示 TFT 长时间承受较大偏置电压。共同点仅为同一个词形。

patterns.name: end 与 resting 的结构描述
patterns.context: 描述一个部件的另一端搁置在唇形保持件上，属于机械专利中的空间关系。

patterns.name: loading dock 与关闭状态
patterns.context: 货运码头的门部分打开，并由可移动门关闭；词语形成同一专利场景，但未见与其他模式的明显联系。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利，车辆约束装置

patterns.name: 服装与衣柜
patterns.context: 讲述迷你雪纳瑞躲在主卧衣柜附近的衣物架下；两个触发词处于家庭叙事语境。

patterns.name: 海上航行术语
patterns.context: 出现在帆船动作与照料主题的目录式列表中；«earing»是原文中“Wearing ship”的词内标记。

patterns.name: 半导体浮栅与编程
patterns.context: 描述浮栅晶体管中电荷、电子存储、导电性与编程，技术语义集中但未标记词包括多种相关术语。

en.concept: Component connections and arrangements in patents
en.description: Activation is concentrated in patent device descriptions, especially attached and relationships involving component mounting, support, connection, and arrangement; it also occurs alongside component names and functional-state words. All segments share a technical structural-description style.

patterns.name: Mechanical component connection or mounting
patterns.context: Describes how components in equipment are fastened, connected, supported, or arranged, often specifying the connection object, location, or mounting method; not limited to the word attached.
patterns.domain: Mechanical and equipment descriptions in USPTO patent background

patterns.name: Specific uses of attached
patterns.context: A component is connected to another component or structure; the connection method may be specified with pin, swing arm, etc., or only the connection object may be given. The word appears in every segment and is the most stable trigger.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background; high-density technical descriptions

patterns.name: Load-bearing, support, and component mating
patterns.context: Describes how support structures, springs, and platforms mate, or load-bearing relationships between components; attached need not appear.

patterns.name: Equipment operation and functional state
patterns.context: Patent text describes components' open/closed, retention, insertion-force, lubrication, or operational states; whether these are triggered by component connections is unclear.
patterns.domain: Industrial equipment and vehicle patent descriptions

patterns.name: Patent-style component names and structural descriptions
patterns.context: Lists equipment components and their structural relationships in succession; this format may co-occur with connection patterns but cannot independently explain all activation.

1_1884.concept: 专利中的部件连接与布置
1_1884.description: 激活集中于专利设备描述，尤其是 attached，及部件间的安装、支撑、连接和布置关系；同时伴随部件名与功能状态词。各段共享技术结构说明文体。

patterns.name: 机械部件连接或安装
patterns.context: 描述设备中部件如何固定、连接、支撑或布置，常带有连接对象、位置或安装方式；不局限于 attached 这一词。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景中的机械与设备说明

patterns.name: attached 的具体用法
patterns.context: 部件被连接到另一部件或结构上；连接方式可由 pin、swing arm 等说明，也可只说明连接对象。该词在各段均出现，是最稳定的触发。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景；高密度技术说明

patterns.name: 承载、支撑与部件配合
patterns.context: 描述支撑结构、弹簧与平台的配合，或构件之间的承载关系；不一定出现 attached。

patterns.name: 设备操作与功能性状态
patterns.context: 专利文字说明部件的开闭、保持、插入力、润滑或操作状态；是否由部件连接关系触发并不明确。
patterns.domain: 工业设备及车辆专利说明

patterns.name: 专利式部件名称与结构描述
patterns.trigger: «body»、«assembly»、«frame»、«deck»、«unit»等部件名及其相邻结构描述
patterns.context: 以具体部件名和结构关系连续罗列设备构成；该格式可能与连接模式共现，但不能单独解释全部激活。

en.description: Highly responsive to “attached/attaching,” which denotes components connected, mounted, or fastened to one another in patent-style mechanical structural descriptions; examples include doors, support plates, oil pumps, hoses, robotic arms, wafer devices, fans, seals, springs, and electrical connectors.

patterns.name: Component connection or fastening
patterns.context: Describes connections, mounting, or fastening between two or more mechanical components, devices, or structures; usually appears in structural descriptions in patent background sections.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent text, mechanical and equipment

1_1884.description: 在专利式机械结构说明中，对表示部件彼此连接、安装或固定的“attached/attaching”高度响应；实例涵盖门、支撑板、油泵、软管、机械臂、晶圆装置、风机、密封条、弹簧和电气连接器。

patterns.name: 部件连接或固定
patterns.context: 描述两个或多个机械部件、装置或结构之间的连接、安装或固定；通常出现在专利背景技术的结构说明中。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利文本，机械与设备

en.description: All segments come from patent background sections. Activation centers on descriptions of component connection, mounting, or fastening relationships: direct uses of attached, attaching, and mounted, or interact to describe a spring engaging a platform. Objects include doors, hoses, springs, plates, transmission components, fans, rails, seals, lamp shades, and switch assemblies.

patterns.name: Component connection or fastening
patterns.context: Describes one component connected, mounted, or fastened to another, commonly in forms such as “X attached/mounted to/between Y,” “attaching portions,” or “attach the springs to it.”
patterns.domain: Patent background, mechanical, vehicle, and appliance component structures

1_1884.description: 所有片段均来自专利背景，激活集中在部件连接、安装或固定关系的描述：直接出现 attached、attaching、mounted，或以 interact 描述弹簧与平台的接合。对象涵盖门、软管、弹簧、板、传动部件、风机、轨道、密封条、灯罩和开关组件。

patterns.name: 部件连接或固定
patterns.context: 描述一个部件被连接、安装、固定到另一部件，常见句式为“X attached/mounted to/between Y”或“attaching portions”“attach the springs to it”。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，机械、车辆及家电部件结构

en.concept: Assembly relationships among patent mechanical components
en.description: Primarily responds to patent-style descriptions of mechanical structures, especially component connections, installation, support, position, and motion; it also covers vehicle equipment, fluid lubrication, material construction, component counts, and functional descriptions. A few weak trigger terms have no independent consistent theme.

patterns.name: Components connected or fastened
patterns.context: Describes connections, installation, support, or pivotal connections between two or more mechanical components; trigger terms often occur in descriptions of component relationships
patterns.domain: Patent background and descriptions of mechanical, vehicle, and equipment structures

patterns.name: Support structures and load-bearing relationships
patterns.context: Structural components support decks, plates, or other components, often adjacent to terms such as frame, deck, and plate

patterns.name: Component positions and spatial relationships
patterns.context: Specifies whether components are above or below, in front of or above something, or positioned between two components

patterns.name: Vehicles and their subsystems
patterns.context: Patent texts concern subsystems such as vehicles, ships, transmissions, instrument switches, or vehicle lights; these often include descriptions of component installation

patterns.name: Mechanical motion or adjustment mechanisms
patterns.context: Mentions mechanisms that are movable, adjustable, rotating, oscillating, or arranged in sequence

patterns.name: Fluids, air, or lubricants
patterns.context: Describes air transported through ducts, or oil splashed or pumped through transmission components for lubrication

patterns.name: Materials and composite construction
patterns.context: Lists materials for structural components or assemblies made from different materials

patterns.name: Component counts and composition
patterns.context: Specifies that a structure consists of multiple modules, plates, or components

patterns.name: Component functions and uses
patterns.context: Explains the support, retention, forming, or lubrication functions of components

patterns.name: Assembly and installation processes
patterns.context: Describes components installed onto a body, wall, opening, or other component, or subsequent connectors assembled after installation

patterns.name: Local lexical or grammatical triggers
patterns.context: These words activate weakly across the passages and do not consistently correspond to the structural relationships above; the sporadic triggers may result from patent phrasing or adjacent technical descriptions

1_1884.concept: 专利机械部件装配关系
1_1884.description: 主要响应专利式机械结构叙述，尤其部件的连接、安装、支承、位置及运动关系；也覆盖车辆设备、流体润滑、材料构造、组件数量和功能说明。少数弱触发词缺乏独立一致主题。

patterns.name: 部件被连接/固定
patterns.context: 描述两个或多个机械部件之间的连接、安装、支承或可转动连接；触发词常出现在部件关系说明中
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术及机械/车辆/设备结构描述

patterns.name: 支承结构与承载关系
patterns.context: 结构件承托甲板、板件或其他部件，常与 frame、deck、plate 等词邻接

patterns.name: 部件位置与空间关系
patterns.trigger: «upper»1 ends；«lower»1；«front»2 opening；«above»3 the «support»3；«between» the support and bearing
patterns.context: 说明部件在上/下、前方、上方或两部件之间的位置关系

patterns.name: 车辆及其子系统
patterns.context: 专利文本中涉及车辆、船、传动机构、仪表开关或车灯等子系统；其中常伴随部件安装说明
patterns.domain: 汽车、船舶及交通工具专利

patterns.name: 机械运动或可调机构
patterns.context: 提及可移动、可调、旋转、摆动或按顺序布置的机构

patterns.name: 流体、空气或润滑介质
patterns.context: 说明空气经管道输送，或油在传动部件中飞溅/泵送以润滑
patterns.domain: 真空吸尘器与传动润滑专利

patterns.name: 材料与复合构造
patterns.context: 列举结构部件的材料或由不同材料构成的组件

patterns.name: 部件数量及构成
patterns.context: 说明结构由多个模块、板件或组件构成

patterns.name: 部件功能与用途
patterns.trigger: «to support» the «deck»；«for retaining» the switch；«providing» means；«lubric»«ated»
patterns.context: 解释部件的支承、保持、成形或润滑功能
patterns.domain: 专利背景及发明结构说明

patterns.name: 装配与安装过程
patterns.trigger: «installed» in the vehicle；«connectors» ... «attached» to the rear；«mounted»；«attached»
patterns.context: 描述部件安装到主体、墙面、开口或其他部件上，或装配后续连接件

patterns.name: 局部词形/语法触发
patterns.context: 这些词在各段中的激活较弱，且与上述结构关系并不稳定对应；可能是专利句式或邻近技术描述带来的零散触发

en.concept: Patent descriptions of mechanical component connections and structures
en.description: Primarily responds to connections, mounting, and fastening of mechanical components in patent style (attached, mounted, attaching), while also covering support and spatial layout; it additionally covers door states, fluid transport and lubrication, composite materials, manufacturing and sealing, and common component names.

patterns.name: Component connected or fastened
patterns.context: Mechanical or device descriptions explain a component's connection, mounting, or clamping relationship to another component, surface, bracket, or opening; often accompanied by component names and positional relationships.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background: mechanical, vehicle, appliance, wind-power equipment, furniture, semiconductor manufacturing, lighting, and shock-absorber devices

patterns.name: Support and load-bearing structures
patterns.context: Describes support surfaces, brackets, bearings, or load-bearing components, and their above/below, clamped, or supporting relationships to other structures.

patterns.name: Spatial relationships between components
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of the positions or layouts of adjacent structures, especially alongside mounting and support relationships.
patterns.domain: Patent device and component layout descriptions

patterns.name: Closed state of a door or opening
patterns.context: Describes loading openings, movable doors, and their open or closed state; one of the few triggers specific to a state word.

patterns.name: Fluid or material transport and lubrication
patterns.context: Describes air flowing through ducts, or oil splashing, being pumped, and lubricating components in a transmission housing.
patterns.domain: Vacuum cleaner and transmission-system patent descriptions

patterns.name: Laminated or composite construction
patterns.context: Introduces parts composed of multiple layers of board or different materials and their interconnections.
patterns.domain: Golf club head and material-structure patent descriptions

patterns.name: Formation, manufacturing, or sealing features
patterns.context: Describes machining grooves, injection molding, and the connection or overlap between seals and blade ends.
patterns.domain: Mechanical manufacturing and sealing-structure patent descriptions

patterns.name: Common component names in patent terminology
patterns.context: Occurs as part of device or component names, usually embedded in more specific descriptions of connections, positions, or structures; has low discriminative value on its own.

1_1884.concept: 专利机械部件连接与结构描述
1_1884.description: 主要响应专利文体中机械部件的连接、安装与固定（attached、mounted、attaching），并兼顾支承和空间布局；也覆盖门状态、流体输送润滑、复合材料、加工密封及常见部件命名。

patterns.name: 部件被连接或固定
patterns.context: 机械或装置描述中，说明部件与另一部件、表面、支架或开口的连接、安装、夹置关系；常伴随部件名称及位置关系。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，机械、车辆、家电、风力设备、家具、半导体制造、照明及减振装置

patterns.name: 支承与承载结构
patterns.context: 描述支撑面、支架、轴承或承载部件，以及其与其他结构的上下、夹置或承托关系。

patterns.name: 部件间空间位置关系
patterns.context: 在相邻结构的位置或布局描述中出现，尤其与安装、支承关系并列。
patterns.domain: 专利装置与组件布局描述

patterns.name: 门或开口的关闭状态
patterns.context: 描述装卸口、可动门及其开启或关闭状态；这是少数较具体的状态词触发。
patterns.domain: 车辆装卸设施专利描述

patterns.name: 流体或物质输送与润滑
patterns.context: 描述气流经过管道，或油在传动箱内飞溅、泵送和润滑部件。
patterns.domain: 吸尘器与传动机构专利描述

patterns.name: 层叠或复合材料构造
patterns.context: 介绍由多层板材或不同材料组成的零件及其相互连接。
patterns.domain: 高尔夫球杆头及材料结构专利描述

patterns.name: 形成、加工或密封特征
patterns.context: 描述加工形成槽、注塑制造，以及密封条与叶片端部的连接或重叠。
patterns.domain: 机械制造与密封结构专利描述

patterns.name: 专利术语中的常见部件名称
patterns.context: 作为装置或部件名称的一部分出现，通常嵌在更具体的连接、位置或结构说明中；单独看区分度较低。

en.concept: Equipment component relationships and assembly descriptions
en.description: Primarily responds to connections, fastening, support, and spatial assembly relationships between components in patents; also covers fluid transport, materials and forming, server insertion, and related equipment descriptions involving textile sewing and door states.

patterns.name: Part connection or fastening relationships
patterns.context: Describes two components in a mechanical device, piece of equipment, or structure being connected, fastened, mounted, or coupled; usually specifies component names and connection locations.
patterns.domain: Mechanical, vehicle, fan, bed-frame, server, and industrial equipment descriptions in patent background

patterns.name: Component support and bearing
patterns.context: A component provides support or bearing, or is explicitly described as resting on another component; adjacent to structural positions or force relationships.

patterns.name: Spatial positioning and assembly layout of mechanical components
patterns.context: Specifies a component's position relative to other components, arrangement, mounting orientation, or assembly position; a connection verb need not appear.

patterns.name: Component and fluid or material transport
patterns.context: Describes air, oil, or other media being transported, supplied, or splashed within equipment, and mentions ducts, pumps, or transmission mechanisms.
patterns.domain: Vacuum cleaner and automotive transmission patent descriptions

patterns.name: Forming processes and material composition
patterns.context: Describes what materials or structures a component consists of, or how it is formed through processes such as molding; a connection relationship is not required.

patterns.name: Server component insertion and system nodes
patterns.context: A board is inserted into a server system node, with cables, pads, and other related components listed in the context.

patterns.name: Sewn textiles, straps, and airflow regulation
patterns.context: A damper or tie that regulates airflow is sewn into a fabric edge; this is an everyday product description rather than a patent mechanical-assembly passage.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC product or clothing/ventilation product descriptions

patterns.name: Doors, vehicle restraint devices, and open/closed states
patterns.context: Describes the open or closed state of a loading dock door and a vehicle restraint assembly mounted on a wall; its specific connection-word pattern differs somewhat from those in the other passages.
patterns.domain: Loading dock equipment in patent background

1_1884.concept: 设备部件关系与装配描述
1_1884.description: 主要响应专利中部件间的连接、固定、支撑及空间装配关系；也覆盖流体输送、材料与成形、服务器插接，以及织物缝制和门体状态等相关设备描述。

patterns.name: 零件连接或固定关系
patterns.context: 描述机械、设备或结构中两个部件被连接、固定、安装或耦合；通常带有部件名称及连接位置。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的机械、车辆、风机、床架、服务器及工业设备说明

patterns.name: 部件支撑与承托
patterns.context: 部件承担支撑、承托功能，或明确描述部件搁置于另一部件上；与结构位置或受力关系相邻。

patterns.name: 机械部件的空间定位与装配布局
patterns.context: 说明部件相对于其他部件的位置、排列、安装方位或装配位置；不一定出现连接词。
patterns.domain: 专利中的机械结构说明

patterns.name: 部件与流体或物质输送
patterns.context: 描述空气、油等介质在设备内被输送、供给或飞溅，并提及管道、泵或传动机构。
patterns.domain: 吸尘器与汽车变速器专利说明

patterns.name: 成形加工与材料构成
patterns.context: 描述部件由何种材料或结构组成，或通过模塑等加工方式形成；不要求出现连接关系。
patterns.domain: 高尔夫球杆专利及制造工艺专利

patterns.name: 服务器部件插接及系统节点
patterns.context: 板卡插入服务器系统节点，且上下文列举线缆、垫片等相关部件。
patterns.domain: 专利中的服务器硬件说明

patterns.name: 缝制的织物、带件与气流调节
patterns.context: 织物边缘内缝有可调节风流的阻尼器或系带；这是日常产品描述而非专利机械装配段落。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 产品或服装/通风产品说明

patterns.name: 门、车辆约束装置及开闭状态
patterns.context: 描述装卸码头门的开闭状态，以及安装在墙上的车辆约束组件；与其他段落的具体连接词模式不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的装卸码头设备

en.concept: Mechanical connection and structural descriptions in patents
en.description: This neuron primarily responds to descriptions in patent text of mechanical component connection, fastening, and support relationships; it also covers component positions, fluid transport, lubrication, vibration suppression, and power transmission, as well as other mechanical structures and functions.

patterns.name: Mechanical component connection or fastening
patterns.context: Describes connections, mounting, fastening, or connection structures between components; most instances occur in mechanical-device patents.
patterns.domain: Patent specifications, mechanical and equipment structures

patterns.name: Support and load-bearing structures
patterns.context: Components provide support, carry loads, or stabilize, often co-occurring with structural components such as frame, deck, plate, ring, and bearing.

patterns.name: Mechanical components and their spatial relationships
patterns.context: Patent-style structural descriptions identify specific components, their locations, adjacency, or motion; this segment particularly highlights doors, hinges, and vehicle restraint devices.

patterns.name: Fluid or material transport
patterns.context: Describes air, oil, or circulating media being transported, lubricated, or circulated within equipment.
patterns.domain: Patent specifications, vacuum equipment, transmissions, and downhole equipment

patterns.name: Vibration and vibration suppression
patterns.context: Describes vibration and damage risk in rotating components, and reducing vibration with structures such as support rings; the same segment also concerns guide grooves and seals.
patterns.domain: Patent specifications, rotating machinery and sealing structures

patterns.name: Transmission and power transfer
patterns.context: Describes torque transfer through gears, transmission mechanisms, or between a shaft and wheel.

1_1884.concept: 专利中的机械连接与结构描述
1_1884.description: 该神经元主要响应专利文本中机械部件的连接、固定与支撑关系，也覆盖部件位置、流体输送、润滑、振动抑制及动力传递等机械结构和功能描述。

patterns.name: 机械部件连接或固定
patterns.context: 描述部件之间的连接、安装、固定或连接结构；多数出现在机械装置专利中。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书，机械与设备结构

patterns.name: 支撑与承载结构
patterns.context: 部件承担支撑、承载或稳定作用，常与 frame、deck、plate、ring、bearing 等结构部件同现。

patterns.name: 机械部件及其空间关系
patterns.context: 以专利式结构描述具体部件、所在位置、相邻关系或运动状态；本段尤突出门、铰链与车辆约束装置。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书，装卸平台设备

patterns.name: 流体或物质输送
patterns.context: 描述空气、油或循环介质在设备中的输送、润滑或循环。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书，真空设备、传动装置与井下设备

patterns.name: 振动与抑制振动
patterns.context: 描述旋转部件的振动、损伤风险及通过支撑环等结构降低振动；同段还涉及导槽和密封条结构。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书，旋转机械与密封结构

patterns.name: 传动与动力传递
patterns.context: 描述齿轮、传动机构或轴与轮之间的转矩传递。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书，传动装置与执行器

en.description: Activation is concentrated on component connection, installation, support, positioning, and assembly relationships in patent texts, especially passive «attached»; it also covers specific mechanical functions involving doors and vehicle restraints, spring supports, airflow transport, lubrication, sealing, chromatography, and spline drives.

patterns.name: Passive construction with attached
patterns.context: Usually follows linking or auxiliary verbs such as be/is/are/being and describes a component connected to another component; the object of connection is often indicated by to, between, or an implicit location.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of mechanical, vehicle, electrical, and equipment structures in patent background

patterns.name: Mechanical support and load-bearing structures
patterns.context: Describes a component supported, positioned, or assembled by a bracket, frame, deck, bearing, or support plate; some passages do not contain attached.
patterns.domain: Mechanical structures and equipment in patents

patterns.name: Component installation, positioning, or adjacency
patterns.context: Describes a component installed somewhere, located between two components, or resting on a support; related to connection but does not necessarily state a connection explicitly.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of device structures in patents

patterns.name: Doors, opening and closing, and vehicle restraint devices
patterns.context: Mentions a loading-dock door and a vehicle restraint assembly, describing a movable door that opens and closes and a restraint assembly installed on a wall.

patterns.name: Spring module connected to a deck
patterns.context: A spring module is positioned between a frame and a deck; the connection portion at its upper end interacts with the deck and connects the spring to it.

patterns.name: Contaminated airflow and hose connections
patterns.context: A vacuum-cleaner handle assembly’s duct transports dusty air and connects to the hose and body.

patterns.name: Low insertion force and rear connection of an electrical connector
patterns.context: A switch assembly is first installed in a dashboard opening, after which an electrical connector is attached to the rear of the assembly.

patterns.name: Gear transmission and lubrication
patterns.context: The position or gear of mating components in a transmission causes a countershaft to rotate; oil is splashed or delivered by an oil pump to lubricate components.

patterns.name: Guide grooves, injection molding, and seals
patterns.context: Describes molding guide grooves on the end face of a slide and on a seal, as well as a seal attached to or overlapping the end of the slide.

patterns.name: Thermal stability in liquid chromatography
patterns.context: The configuration of a chromatography column and inlet and outlet capillaries stabilizes the mobile phase in liquid chromatography; the capillaries connect to the column.

patterns.name: Torque transfer through splines and fastening of elastic material
patterns.context: A splined shaft transfers torque to a wheel through complementary shapes, while elastic material firmly connects inner and outer components.

1_1884.description: 激活集中于专利文本中部件连接、安装、支承、定位和装配关系，尤其是被动式«attached»；另覆盖门与车辆约束、弹簧支承、气流输送、润滑、密封、色谱及花键传动等具体机械功能。

patterns.name: attached 的被动结构
patterns.context: 通常位于 be/is/are/being 等系动词或助动词之后，描述部件与另一部件连接；连接对象常由 to、between 或隐含位置给出。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的机械、车辆、电气及设备结构描述

patterns.name: 机械支承与承载结构
patterns.context: 描述部件由支架、框架、甲板、轴承或支承板承托、定位或组合；部分段落并未出现 attached。
patterns.domain: 专利中的机械结构与设备

patterns.name: 部件安装、定位或相邻关系
patterns.context: 描述部件安装在某处、位于两部件之间，或搁置于支承件上；与连接关系相近但不一定明说连接。
patterns.domain: 专利中的装置结构描述

patterns.name: 门、开闭与车辆约束装置
patterns.context: 出现装卸平台的门及车辆约束组件，说明门可移动开闭且约束组件安装于墙面。

patterns.name: 弹簧模块连接甲板
patterns.context: 弹簧模块位于框架与甲板之间，上端的连接部分与甲板相互作用并将弹簧连接到甲板。
patterns.domain: 专利中的弹性支承结构

patterns.name: 污染气流与软管连接
patterns.context: 吸尘器手柄组件的导管输送含尘空气，并连接软管和机身。

patterns.name: 低插入力及电连接器后接
patterns.context: 开关组件先装入仪表板开口，随后电连接器连接到组件后部。

patterns.name: 齿轮传动与润滑
patterns.context: 变速箱中对偶件的位置或档位使副轴转动，油被飞溅或由油泵输送以润滑部件。

patterns.name: 导向槽、注塑及密封条
patterns.context: 描述滑片端面及密封条上的导向槽成型，以及密封条附接或与滑片端部重叠。

patterns.name: 液相色谱热稳定
patterns.context: 色谱柱及进、出毛细管的配置用于稳定液相色谱中的流动相，毛细管连接至色谱柱。

patterns.name: 花键传扭与弹性材料固定
patterns.context: 花键轴与轮之间通过互补形状传递扭矩，弹性材料牢固连接内外部件。

en.concept: Patent component connections and structural relationships
en.description: Primarily responds to patent-style descriptions of mechanical and equipment structures: components being connected, supported, mounted, or positioned, often involving attachment, assemblies, and constraints; it also covers materials, fluids, transmissions, and server hardware, with an overall emphasis on component relationships.

patterns.name: Components connected via “attached”
patterns.context: Describes one component connected, fastened, or mounted to another; examples include a hose to a body, a support plate to a golf club surface, a brake disc to a support and bearing, a lamp shade to a lamp body, and elastic material to an assembly.
patterns.domain: Patent background and descriptions of mechanical, vehicle, and electronic equipment

patterns.name: Support or load-bearing structures
patterns.context: Support components and their load-bearing, fastening, or relative-position relationships appear; emphasis is on how support structures mate with a platform, striking surface, or fan component.

patterns.name: Device and assembly composition or connection
patterns.context: Describes the composition and connection relationships among assemblies, modules, circuits, or equipment nodes in a device made up of multiple components.
patterns.domain: Patent background and equipment and electronic-system descriptions

patterns.name: Mechanical component functions and motion constraints
patterns.context: Describes vehicle restraints, bearings, or transmission components, as well as motion, torque transfer, or constrained-motion states.
patterns.domain: Patent background and mechanical and automotive engineering descriptions

patterns.name: Position and spatial relationships
patterns.context: Indicates relative position, orientation, or ends in component descriptions; occurs alongside mounting, assembly, and mechanical-structure contexts.

patterns.name: Specific materials and fluid media
patterns.context: Specifies component materials or the flow, transport, or lubrication role of media such as air and oil in a device.
patterns.domain: Patent background and mechanical and materials descriptions

patterns.name: Patent-style passive structural descriptions
patterns.context: Uses passive voice or nominalized constructions to specify component positions, composition, mounting, and mutual relationships.

patterns.name: Server equipment and nodes
patterns.context: Describes connections or insertion of circuit boards, pads, and wires into server system nodes.

patterns.name: Rollers and camber constraints, not fully explained
patterns.context: Describes roller support and restricted camber motion; although it includes mechanical constraint terminology, it corresponds less closely to the connection and assembly patterns of the other passages.

1_1884.concept: 专利部件连接与结构关系
1_1884.description: 主要响应专利式机械与设备结构说明：部件被连接、支撑、安装或定位，常见附着、组件及约束关系；也涉及材料、流体、传动和服务器硬件，整体偏部件关系描述。

patterns.name: 部件通过“attached”连接
patterns.context: 描述一个部件与另一个部件相连、固定或安装；对象包括软管与主体、支撑板与球杆表面、制动盘与支撑及轴承、灯罩与灯体、弹性材料与组件。
patterns.domain: 专利背景及机械、车辆、电子设备说明

patterns.name: 支撑或承载结构
patterns.context: 出现支撑部件及其承载、固定或相对位置关系；强调支撑结构与平台、击球面或风机部件的配合。
patterns.domain: 专利背景及机械结构说明

patterns.name: 装置及组件的构成或连接
patterns.context: 围绕由多个部件构成的装置，描述组件、模块、线路或设备节点之间的组成和连接关系。
patterns.domain: 专利背景及设备、电子系统说明

patterns.name: 机械部件的功能与运动约束
patterns.context: 描述车辆约束、轴承或传动部件，以及运动、扭矩传递或运动受限状态。
patterns.domain: 专利背景及机械、车辆工程说明

patterns.name: 位置和空间关系
patterns.context: 在部件描述中标示相对位置、方向或端部；与安装、装配及机械结构语境并存。

patterns.name: 具体材料与流体介质
patterns.context: 说明部件材料，或空气、油等介质在装置中的流动、输送或润滑作用。
patterns.domain: 专利背景及机械、材料说明

patterns.name: 专利式被动结构描述
patterns.context: 以被动语态或名词化结构交代部件的位置、构成、安装及相互关系。

patterns.name: 服务器设备与节点
patterns.context: 描述电路板、垫片、导线与服务器系统节点的连接或插接。
patterns.domain: 专利背景及计算机硬件

patterns.name: 未充分解释的滚轮与外倾约束
patterns.context: 描述滚轮支撑及外倾运动受限，虽有机械约束词汇，但与其余段落的连接、装配模式对应较弱。

en.concept: Descriptions of relationships among patent mechanical components
en.description: All passages are patent mechanical or product descriptions; the neuron favors descriptions of component connections, installation, position, and support, while also responding to adjacent technical discussion of assembly composition, materials, processes, and operation.

patterns.name: Connection or assembly relationships in patent mechanical structures
patterns.context: Describes a component’s position relative to another component, its fastening, connection, or assembly; connection terms are often followed by to, between, or a specific supporting component.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of mechanical, vehicle, and equipment structures in USPTO patent background

patterns.name: Spatial configurations of components and support structures
patterns.context: In addition to component connections, specifies end positions, surfaces, vertical relationships, or relative layouts between components.

patterns.name: Components and their composition or function
patterns.context: Describes an object as an assembly consisting of several components, or explains how an assembly carries or supports other components; not every occurrence directly indicates a connection.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of devices and components in patents

patterns.name: Specific patent objects and application areas
patterns.context: Activation contexts cover various specific mechanical products rather than one industry or component category.
patterns.domain: Vehicle, household-appliance, sports-equipment, lighting, transmission-system, fan, and ship patents

patterns.name: Materials, manufacturing, and transfer processes
patterns.context: Describes material composition, forming processes, or the transfer of force or oil between components; these accompany mechanical descriptions but are not equivalent to the connection terms themselves.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of materials, manufacturing, and mechanical operating principles in patents

patterns.name: Conventional style introducing patent background or field of invention
patterns.context: Uses conventional patent phrasing to introduce the invention’s subject or application; the passage does not show a subsequent connection structure.

1_1884.concept: 专利机械部件关系描述
1_1884.description: 所有片段均为专利机械或产品说明；神经元偏向描述部件的连接、安装、位置与支撑关系，同时响应组件构成、材料、工艺及工作过程等相邻技术叙述。

patterns.name: 专利机械结构中的连接或装配关系
patterns.context: 描述部件相对于另一部件的位置、固定、连接或装配；连接词常后接 to、between 或具体承载部件。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景中的机械、车辆及设备结构说明

patterns.name: 部件与承载结构的空间配置
patterns.context: 在说明零件连接之外，标出端部、表面、上下位置或部件之间的相对布局。

patterns.name: 组件及其构成或功能
patterns.context: 将对象描述为由若干部件构成的组件，或说明组件承载、支撑其他部件；并非所有出现都直接表示连接。
patterns.domain: 专利中的装置与部件说明

patterns.name: 具体专利对象与应用领域
patterns.context: 激活上下文覆盖多种具体机械产品，而非单一行业或零件类别。
patterns.domain: 车辆、家用电器、运动器材、灯具、传动系统、风机与船舶专利

patterns.name: 材料、制造与传递过程
patterns.context: 说明材料构成、成型工艺或力、油等在部件间的传递；这些内容伴随机械描述出现，但与连接词本身不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 专利中的材料、制造及机械工作原理说明

patterns.name: 专利背景或发明领域的固定文体
patterns.trigger: «Field of the Invention»；«The present invention relates»
patterns.context: 以专利惯用表述引出发明主题或应用对象；该片段未展示后续连接结构。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on the word forms causes and pauses; capitalization and within-word segmentation vary. Fragments of departure and pause also appear. The pattern spans multiple genres and corresponds to cause/causation and pause semantics, respectively.

patterns.name: Causal forms of causes
patterns.context: The word form is causes, with varied capitalization. It appears in statements about causes, causation, or disease outcomes, as well as in directory headings and truncated text.
patterns.domain: Dialogue transcripts, directories, encyclopedias, medical papers, forum discussions, technical texts, project abstracts

patterns.name: Pause-related forms of pauses
patterns.context: The word form is pauses; it refers to pauses in speech or games, a program pausing, or a pause before drawing a card.
patterns.domain: Dialogue transcripts, encyclopedias, code comments, Q&A

patterns.name: Same fragments in other words
patterns.context: Markers fall on a within-word fragment of departure and on different forms of pause; these differ from the full forms causes/pauses.

1_1981.description: 激活主要落在 causes 与 pauses 的词形上，大小写和词内分段多变；另有 departure 和 pause 的片段。横跨多种文体，分别对应原因/成因与暂停语义。

patterns.name: causes 的因果词形
patterns.context: 词形为 causes，大小写不一；多处出现在原因、成因或疾病后果的陈述中，也有目录标题与截断文本。
patterns.domain: 对话转写、目录、百科、医学论文、论坛讨论、技术文本、项目摘要

patterns.name: pauses 的暂停词形
patterns.context: 词形为 pauses；表示说话或游戏暂停、程序暂停，或抽牌前的停顿。
patterns.domain: 对话转写、百科、代码注释、问答

patterns.name: 其他词中的相同片段
patterns.context: 标记落在 departure 的词内片段及 pause 的不同词形上；与 causes/pauses 的完整词形不同。

en.description: Primarily responds to the word forms pauses/Pauses and causes/Causes, commonly triggered by ause within a word. The former means a pause; the latter means a reason or to cause. They vary in meaning and style.

patterns.name: Inflection and usage of pause/pauses
patterns.context: pauses/Pauses appears in a sentence to mean a stop, pause, or device suspension; includes verb and noun forms
patterns.domain: Spoken transcripts, catalogs, encyclopedias, code, forum discussions

patterns.name: Inflection and usage of causes
patterns.context: causes appears in a sentence as a noun (reasons) or verb (to cause); also includes causes following concatenated proper names
patterns.domain: Catalogs, medical papers, bibliographies, forum discussions, engineering discussions, research abstracts

1_1981.description: 主要响应 pauses/Pauses 与 causes/Causes 的词形，常见触发点是词内的 ause；前者表示暂停，后者表示原因或导致，语义和文体均多样。

patterns.name: pause/pause 的屈折与用法
patterns.context: 在句中出现 pauses/Pauses，表示停顿、暂停或设备暂停；包括动词及名词形式
patterns.domain: 口语转录、目录、百科、代码、论坛讨论

patterns.name: causes 的屈折与用法
patterns.context: causes 作为名词（原因）或动词（导致）出现在句中，也包括连写专名后的 causes
patterns.domain: 目录、医学论文、书目、论坛讨论、工程讨论、研究摘要

en.description: Activation primarily falls on the substring «auses» within causes, and also on a similar spelling substring in pauses/pause. The former occurs in pathology, bibliographic, economic, engineering, and PXE texts; the latter appears in contexts describing pausing actions or pause-key instructions.

patterns.name: Split forms of causes
patterns.context: The substring occurs in causes, possibly spanning the word onset or appearing as an embedded stem; lowercase, sentence-initial capitalization, and concatenated forms are all represented.

patterns.name: Split forms of pauses
patterns.context: The a(u)ses or ause substring in pauses/pause; used for the action of pausing, or as an item word in catalog-style text.
patterns.domain: Dialogue transcripts, narration, software documentation, forum posts, catalogs

1_1981.concept: 含 a(u)ses 的词内子串
1_1981.description: 激活主要落在 causes 的内部子串 «auses»，也落在 pauses/pause 的相近拼写子串上；前者见于病理、书目、经济、工程和 PXE 文本，后者见于暂停动作或暂停键说明。

patterns.name: causes 的拆分形式
patterns.context: 该子串出现在 causes 一词中，可能横跨词首或作为嵌入式词干；分别见小写、句首大写及黏连形式。
patterns.domain: 多领域正文、目录与摘要

patterns.name: pauses 的拆分形式
patterns.context: pauses/ pause 中的 a(u)ses 或 ause 子串；用作动词暂停，或目录式文本中的项目词。
patterns.domain: 对话转录、叙述、软件文档、论坛帖子、目录

en.description: All ten segments activate inside the word causes, with markers covering the suffix a(u)ses; some also mark the initial c. The word may appear at the beginning or in the middle of a sentence, or after a proper noun. Neither context nor domain imposes a stable constraint.

patterns.name: Within-word stem/letter sequence in causes
patterns.context: Matches the word causes or a contiguous within-word fragment; observed forms include C«auses», «c»«auses», PXEc«auses», with variable capitalization and annotation boundaries
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose, dialogue, directories, code, and medical abstracts

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: All fragments contain the contiguous letter sequence causes; surrounding context and genre vary widely, with no stable additional semantic or syntactic condition

1_1981.description: 十段均在 causes 一词内部激活，标记覆盖其后缀 a(u)ses；部分还标记词首 c。词可处于句首、句中或专名后，语境与领域均不构成稳定限制。

patterns.name: 词内 causes 的词干/字母串
patterns.trigger: «auses»10；第8、9、10段中触发部分前有«c»5，第10段为«c»后接«auses»10
patterns.context: 命中单词 causes 或其词内连续片段；可见形式包括 C«auses»、«c»«auses»、PXEc«auses»，大小写及标注边界不固定
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文、对话、目录、代码及医学摘要

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.trigger: 无法确认有区别于 causes 词内片段的第二触发模式
patterns.context: 所有片段都包含 causes 的连续字母串；其前后文与文体差异很大，未见稳定的额外语义或句法条件

en.description: Activation is concentrated on the in-word fragment “auses”: it occurs in causes (to cause) and pauses (to pause). It varies across domains, capitalization, and in-word segmentation, with different meanings and syntactic functions.

patterns.name: Causative verb “causes”
patterns.context: causes is used as a verb followed by the result or effect it produces; capitalization and in-word segmentation may vary
patterns.domain: Cross-domain explanatory text, including medicine, history, ecology, and engineering

patterns.name: “pauses” and pausing contexts
patterns.context: Describes a person or program temporarily stopping or pausing, or uses pauses as a transition cue
patterns.domain: Dialogue transcripts, narrative, game rules, Q&A advice, code comments

1_1981.description: 激活集中在词内片段“auses”：它出现在 causes（导致）及 pauses（暂停）中；跨领域、大小写与词内切分不一，词义和句法功能各异。

patterns.name: Causative verb“causes”
patterns.context: causes 作为动词，后接其造成的结果或影响；大小写及词内切分可变
patterns.domain: 跨领域说明性文本，包括医学、历史、生态、工程

patterns.name: “pauses”及暂停语境
patterns.context: 描述人或程序暂时停顿、暂停，或将 pauses 用作转场提示
patterns.domain: 对话转录、叙事、游戏规则、问答建议、代码注释

en.description: All passages strongly activate at the substring «auses» in causes; capitalization, syntactic position, topic, and genre vary. No reliable independent semantic or contextual pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Word-final causes
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the latter part of causes across sentence-internal text, headings, and directories; capitalization, preceding letters, and adjacent context are variable. The response may be local to the substring rather than to specific semantics or syntax.
patterns.domain: Multidomain texts, including oral transcripts, medical, Wikipedia, technical, historical, and legal texts

1_1981.description: 全部段落都在 causes 的子串 «auses» 处强激活，词形大小写、句法位置、主题和文体各异；未见可靠的独立语义或上下文模式。

patterns.name: 词尾 causes
patterns.context: 激活集中在 causes 的后半部分，横跨句中、标题和目录；大小写、前置字母及相邻语境不固定。可能是对该子串而非特定语义或句法的局部响应。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本，包括口语转录、医学、维基百科、技术、历史与法律文本

en.description: Strong activations are concentrated on local subword fragments produced by segmenting words such as causes, pauses, dummy, and member, especially auses in causes/pauses; weaker activations also occur on formatting tokens and common words.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of causes
patterns.context: After the full word causes is segmented, activation falls on the within-word substring auses; both sentence-initial uppercase Causes and sentence-internal lowercase causes occur.
patterns.domain: Academic discussion, technical explanations, and oral transcripts

patterns.name: Internal fragment of pauses
patterns.context: After the full word pauses is segmented, the within-word substring auses likewise activates; it appears in pause annotations or descriptions of someone pausing.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of dummy
patterns.context: After the full word dummy is segmented, the word-final substring ummy activates; one instance refers to an election test, and another occurs in an adult erotic context with the spelling yumm(y).

patterns.name: Internal fragment of member
patterns.context: The internal letters BER in uppercase MEMBERS / MEMBER are marked separately, surrounded by the recipients of a company notice.

patterns.name: Structural markers and formatting tokens
patterns.context: These activations are scattered across line breaks, HTML form tags, hyphens, and common function words; they have no stable local semantic condition and are markedly weaker than the main trigger in each segment.
patterns.domain: Forum questions, papers, notices, encyclopedias, web text

1_1981.description: 最强激活集中在 causes、pauses、dummy、member 等词被分词后的局部子串，尤以 auses 见于 causes/pauses 为主；另有低强度格式符及常见词激活。

patterns.name: causes 的内部片段
patterns.context: 完整词 causes 被切分后，激活落在词内子串 auses；既见句首大写 Causes，也见句中小写 causes。
patterns.domain: 学术论述、技术说明及口语转录

patterns.name: pauses 的内部片段
patterns.context: 完整词 pauses 被切分后，同样激活词内子串 auses；见于停顿标注或描述人物暂停。
patterns.domain: 口语转录、建议性文字、叙事

patterns.name: dummy 的内部片段
patterns.context: 完整词 dummy 被切分后，激活词尾子串 ummy；一处指选举测试，一处出现在成人色情语境中的 yumm(y) 拼写。

patterns.name: member 的内部片段
patterns.context: 大写排版中的 MEMBERS / MEMBER 内部字母 BER 被单独标出，周围是公司通知收件对象。

patterns.name: 结构性标记与格式 token
patterns.context: 这些激活分散在换行、HTML 表单标签、连字符和常见功能词上；没有稳定的局部语义条件，强度也明显低于各段的主触发。
patterns.domain: 论坛问题、论文、通知、百科、网页文本

en.description: Strong activations are concentrated on several within-word fragments: causes/cause, pauses, affirm/reaffirm, and the singleton Tray. They span diverse domains and meanings, with no unified grammatical or topical condition.

patterns.name: Segmented fragment of causes
patterns.context: Triggered inside causes, with the initial fragment c activating strongly; the word itself can mean a cause or function as a verb.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, technical explanations, historical documents, medical papers

patterns.name: Within-word fragment of pauses
patterns.context: Triggered in the middle of pauses, in contexts describing a brief pause or arranging a pause.
patterns.domain: Courtroom dialogue, life advice, card-game rules

patterns.name: Within-word fragment of affirm
patterns.context: Appears in affirm or reaffirm, involving confirmation, maintenance, or reconfirmation.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment of tray
patterns.context: In the technical phrase Java Tray Icon, Tray is segmented and triggers; the context is brief.

1_1981.description: 强激活集中于若干词内片段：causes/cause、pauses、affirm/reaffirm，以及单例 Tray。它们跨越多种领域和语义，未见统一的语法或主题条件。

patterns.name: causes 的分词片段
patterns.context: 在 causes 一词内部触发，词首片段 c 激活较强；词本身可指原因，也可作动词。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、技术说明、历史文献、医学论文

patterns.name: pauses 的词内片段
patterns.context: 在 pauses 一词中间触发，出现在叙述短暂停顿或安排暂停的语境。
patterns.domain: 法庭对话、生活建议、纸牌规则

patterns.name: affirm 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 affirm 或 reaffirm 中，涉及确认、维持或再次确认。

patterns.name: tray 的词内片段
patterns.context: Java Tray Icon 这一技术短语中，Tray 被拆分并触发；上下文很短。

en.concept: right angle bracket and right-shift symbol
en.description: Primarily responds to the right-shift operator in code, commonly used for byte splitting, bit-field extraction, hashing, and address conversion; it also responds to right-shift symbols in operator comparison tables and to double angle brackets surrounding an email attachment name.

patterns.name: Right-shift operator
patterns.context: Code shifts variables, integers, or bit fields to the right; often combined with & masks, |, assignment, or type conversion
patterns.domain: Programming code, especially bitwise operations and low-level data processing in C/C++, Go, VB, etc.

patterns.name: Operator comparison table
patterns.context: Comments or lists enumerate operators; no shift calculation is performed here

patterns.name: Email attachment filename delimiter
patterns.context: Attachment marker in an email body; angle brackets enclose the filename, with double angle brackets at the end

1_1981.description: 主要响应代码中的右移运算符，常见于字节拆分、位域提取、哈希和地址换算；也响应运算符对照表里的右移符号，以及邮件附件名两侧的双尖括号。

patterns.name: 右移位运算符
patterns.context: 代码中对变量、整数或位域做右移；常与 & 掩码、|、赋值或类型转换组合
patterns.domain: 编程代码，尤其 C/C++、Go、VB 等位运算与底层数据处理

patterns.name: 移位操作符对照表
patterns.context: 注释或列表枚举运算符，此处并非执行移位计算
patterns.domain: 编程语言语法/测试代码

patterns.name: 邮件附件文件名分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件正文中的附件标记；尖括号包围文件名，末尾出现双尖括号

en.description: Activations are distributed across diverse code contexts. More prominent local cues include flags, unsigned types, and C interface declarations; sporadic patterns also include ioctl, kernel system calls, cryptography, images, event flags, and PHP properties, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Variable name flags
patterns.context: The identifier contains flags, especially in underscore-separated variable or member names; no fixed semantics are required
patterns.domain: System code, thread libraries, and PHP documentation/code

patterns.name: unsigned type declaration
patterns.context: unsigned appears in C/C++ function parameters, pointers, or variable declarations, often adjacent to types such as int, char, and long
patterns.domain: Systems programming, cryptography, and image-processing code

patterns.name: Kernel/filesystem interface declaration
patterns.context: Declares kernel or filesystem functions, with parameters including structure pointers, integers, or buffers
patterns.domain: Linux kernel and Unix-like system code

patterns.name: ioctl command-parameter interface
patterns.context: A function or function pointer uses cmd and arg as command and parameter, involving device or file-operation interfaces
patterns.domain: Linux kernel and POSIX device interfaces

patterns.name: Versioned secp256k1 symbol
patterns.context: Version number v2.0.0 is embedded in a Rust/C FFI symbol name

patterns.name: Image buffer naming
patterns.context: Image output arrays are named by RGB channels and maximum dimensions

patterns.name: personality system call definition
patterns.context: Linux kernel system call macro and its parameter declaration

patterns.name: AES unwrap interface
patterns.context: AES key-unwrapping function declaration, with parameters including key, iv, and input/output buffers

patterns.name: Timer system call comment
patterns.context: Source comment lists setitimer/getitimer and is adjacent to syscall definitions

patterns.name: Event flag group
patterns.context: An event flag group used to create a thread, with a numbered object name

patterns.name: PHP property documentation and cache options
patterns.context: Documentation comment describes property overrides and provides an array of options to disable caching

1_1981.concept: 代码标识符与类型声明
1_1981.description: 激活分布于多种代码上下文，较明显的局部线索是 flags、unsigned 类型及 C 接口声明；另有 ioctl、内核系统调用、加密、图像、事件标志和 PHP 属性等零散模式，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 变量名 flags
patterns.context: 标识符中出现 flags，特别是下划线命名的变量或成员；不要求固定语义
patterns.domain: 系统代码、线程库及 PHP 文档/代码

patterns.name: unsigned 类型声明
patterns.context: C/C++ 函数参数、指针或变量声明中出现 unsigned，常与 int、char、long 等类型相邻
patterns.domain: 系统编程、加密与图像处理代码

patterns.name: 内核/文件系统接口声明
patterns.context: 声明内核或文件系统函数，参数包含结构体指针、整数或缓冲区
patterns.domain: Linux 内核及类 Unix 系统代码

patterns.name: ioctl 命令参数接口
patterns.context: 函数或函数指针以 cmd、arg 作为命令与参数，涉及设备或文件操作接口
patterns.domain: Linux 内核及 POSIX 设备接口

patterns.name: 带版本号的 secp256k1 符号
patterns.context: 版本号 v2.0.0 嵌入 Rust/C FFI 符号名

patterns.name: 图像缓冲区命名
patterns.context: 图像输出数组按 RGB 通道及最大尺寸命名

patterns.name: personality 系统调用定义
patterns.context: Linux 内核系统调用宏及其参数声明

patterns.name: AES unwrap 接口
patterns.context: AES 密钥解包函数声明，参数包含 key、iv、输入输出缓冲区

patterns.name: 定时器系统调用注释
patterns.context: 源码注释列举 setitimer/getitimer，并邻近 syscall 定义

patterns.name: 事件标志组
patterns.context: 创建线程使用的事件标志组，出现编号化对象名

patterns.name: PHP 属性文档与缓存选项
patterns.context: 文档注释描述属性覆盖，并给出禁用缓存选项数组

en.description: The most prominent recurring trigger across domains is the plus sign “+”; code punctuation, declarations, line-break boundaries, and a few comment headings and macro identifiers also activate. Co-occurrence cues are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Plus-sign token
patterns.context: The plus sign itself is strongly marked; it appears in regex questions, numeric and word-naming strategies, shopping-cart descriptions, array-length expressions, arithmetic problems, data descriptions in comments, and Laravel/React headings.

patterns.name: Punctuation and boundaries in code
patterns.context: Markers cover punctuation, type names, declarations, or line breaks in multiple code snippets; exact marker locations vary and are often interspersed with unmarked code.
patterns.domain: C/C++, hardware-description code, and programming Q&A code

patterns.name: Q&A line-break/format boundaries
patterns.context: Appears at the start of StackExchange questions or at structural boundaries in the body; especially visible in segments 1, 4, 7, and 10.

patterns.name: Separators and headings in code comments
patterns.context: Comment separators and section headings are marked, adjacent to graphics-rendering code.

patterns.name: Maximum/width identifiers
patterns.context: Markers appear in a hardware address-width macro and a UFS maximum-group-count macro; in both cases they are part of an identifier.

patterns.name: Type declarations and integer fields
patterns.context: Markers occur near type names or type/variable declarations; code also includes arrays, pointers, and structure fields.

patterns.name: Numeric-plus-word naming strategy
patterns.context: Discusses a strategy for names composed of a number plus a word, expressing annoyance.

1_1981.description: 最显著且跨领域反复出现的触发是加号「+」；此外，代码标点、声明、换行边界及少数注释标题和宏标识符也有激活。各处共现线索不完全一致。

patterns.name: 加号 token
patterns.context: 加号本身被强标记；出现在正则表达式问题、数字与单词命名策略、购物车描述、数组长度表达式、算术题、注释中的数据说明，以及 Laravel/React 标题中。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、代码、论坛文字

patterns.name: 代码中的标点与边界
patterns.trigger: «[»、«(»、«{»、«;» 等标记及相邻代码 token
patterns.context: 多处在代码片段中，标记覆盖标点、类型名、声明或换行；但具体标记位置并不一致，也常与未标记代码交错。
patterns.domain: C/C++、硬件描述代码及编程问答代码

patterns.name: 问答换行/格式边界
patterns.context: 出现在 StackExchange 问题开头或正文结构边界；在第1、4、7、10段尤其可见。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的分隔线与标题
patterns.context: 注释分隔线及章节标题被标记，邻近图形渲染代码。

patterns.name: 最大值/宽度标识符
patterns.context: 标记出现在硬件地址宽度宏和 UFS 最大组数宏中；两处均为标识符的一部分。
patterns.domain: Github 代码（硬件描述、文件系统）

patterns.name: 类型声明与整数字段

patterns.context: A Slovak sentence discusses the Lithuanian, Latvian, and Estonian peoples gaining resolve and strength from hardship.

patterns.name: The English adjective restrictive
patterns.context: Complains that the rules for asking questions on Stack Overflow are increasingly frustrating and restrictive.

patterns.name: Markers in C function declarations
patterns.context: External declarations, types, comments, and function-pointer parameters in C headers or interface code.

patterns.name: Hungarian word-internal fragments
patterns.context: The activation fragments are embedded in Hungarian word forms such as “lefolytassam” and “vitát”; the context is continuing a debate on someone else's behalf.

1_1981.description: 强激活分布在食谱的操作、状态变化及液体描述，也见于代码语法、英文词内片段、斯拉夫语和匈牙利语词形；除食谱外未见稳定共通语义。

patterns.name: 食谱中的烹调步骤

patterns.name: 含液体的容量描述
patterns.context: 描述杯子或容器能够容纳的液体容量

patterns.name: 英文词尾或词内的 -tribution/-tribution 类片段
patterns.context: 激活片段出现在“retribution”词内，句子涉及报复；未见其他明显烹饪或代码条件

patterns.name: 波罗的海民族与决心
patterns.context: 斯洛伐克语句子谈及立陶宛、拉脱维亚和爱沙尼亚民族从苦难中获得决心与力量

patterns.name: 英文形容词 restrictive

patterns.name: C 语言函数声明中的标记

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内片段
patterns.context: 这些激活片段嵌在匈牙利语词形中，如“lefolytassam”和“vitát”；语境是代为继续辩论

en.description: Activation is scattered across the Swedish word “minuter”, recipe cooking words, C/OpenGL code markers, and a few newline characters and Slovak word fragments; there is no single cross-domain semantic or stable syntactic function.

patterns.name: “minutes” in Swedish time expressions
patterns.context: Swedish parliamentary speeches discuss speaking time, time needed to complete something, and similar topics; the word is split into subword tokens, with activation concentrated on parts of “minuter”.

patterns.name: OpenGL function calls
patterns.context: C/OpenGL code contains gl function calls, parentheses, and graphics buffer constants; «Disable» and the left parenthesis have the strongest activation.

patterns.name: Recipe actions and cooking states
patterns.context: Imperative steps in English recipes describe heating, stirring, mixing ingredients, and cooking level or duration.

patterns.name: C declarations and type markers
patterns.context: Function prototypes and external function declarations in C code include pointers, structs, and types.

patterns.name: Newline characters and line breaks
patterns.context: Quoted dialogue in literary text is laid out across lines; activation falls on the newline marker, with no clear shared semantic cues nearby.

patterns.name: In-word Slavic fragments
patterns.context: Slovak parliamentary text discusses the peoples of Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia, and their suffering, determination, and strength; activation falls on an in-word fragment.

1_1981.description: 激活分散于瑞典语“minuter”、食谱烹饪词、C/OpenGL 代码标记，以及少量换行符和斯洛伐克语词片段；未见单一跨领域语义或稳定句法功能。

patterns.name: 瑞典语时间表达中的“分钟”
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会发言中谈论发言时长、完成所需时间等；词被分词标记拆开，激活集中在“minuter”的组成部分。

patterns.name: OpenGL 函数调用
patterns.context: C/OpenGL 代码中出现 gl 函数调用、括号和图形缓冲区常量；其中 «Disable» 与左括号激活最强。

patterns.name: 食谱操作与烹饪状态
