patterns.name: C 语言声明与类型标记
patterns.context: C 代码中的函数原型和外部函数声明，包含指针、结构体及类型。

patterns.name: 换行符及版面断行
patterns.context: 文学文本中带引号的对话按行排版；激活落在换行标记上，附近没有明显的共同语义线索。

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语词内片段
patterns.context: 斯洛伐克语议会文本中，涉及立陶宛、拉脱维亚、爱沙尼亚人民及其苦难、决心和力量；激活落在词内片段。

en.description: Activation fragments are scattered across different words and contexts: word-final fragments in two instances of retribution, actions and ingredient words in several recipes, and isolated word fragments in literary dialogue, reviews, Swedish parliamentary speech, and war recollections; there is no unified trigger apart from some local contexts.

patterns.name: Fragments within retribution
patterns.context: Word-final fragments occur in contexts discussing compensation, punishment, or revenge for wrongdoing or harm: once, destroying heraldic records as revenge; once, arguing for compensation of at least equivalent value.
patterns.domain: Fictional narration; moral argument in email

patterns.name: Action or state words in cooking steps
patterns.context: Recipes or cooking instructions describe ingredients, utensils, heat, timing, and actions such as adding, heating, stirring, or freezing; activations span multiple adjacent words.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment at the end of a paragraph
patterns.context: In a film-review context, describes laughing after being prompted; the trigger is a word-internal fragment whose local meaning differs from the other highly activated fragments in the paragraph.

patterns.name: Ingredient- or food-related word fragments
patterns.context: A recipe mentions frozen tilapia loins; adjacent to the cooking-step pattern, but activation falls on fragments of these specific words.

patterns.name: Action words in character dialogue
patterns.context: Novel dialogue discusses the behavior of objects or things and whether people can act on them; the strongest marker falls on Only.

patterns.name: Swedish word-internal fragments
patterns.context: A Swedish excerpt from a European Parliament speech; high activation occurs within formal forms of address and related terms under discussion.

patterns.name: Colloquial negation and time expressions
patterns.context: A spoken quotation about war memories; triggers fall on punctuation around a negative word and fragments such as there and only, with no clear semantic link to the other patterns.

1_1981.description: 激活片段分散于多种词与语境：两处 retribution 词尾、数段食谱中的操作和食材词，以及文学对白、评论、瑞典语议会发言和战争回忆中的零散词片段；除部分局部语境外无统一触发特征。

patterns.name: retribution 词内片段
patterns.context: 词尾片段出现在谈及因过错或伤害而应付出的报偿、惩罚或报复的语境里；一次是烧毁纹章记录作为报复，一次是主张应付至少等值的报偿
patterns.domain: 小说叙述；邮件中的道德论述

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤中的动作或状态词
patterns.trigger: « large»、« skins»、« that»、« easy»、« ignore»、«Heat»、« oil»、« the»、« onions»、« heat»、« softened»、« Increase»、« medium»、« add»、« blended»；以及 « Remove»、« warm»、« broth»、« vinegar»、« stirring»、« scrape»、« browned»、« bits»、« sugar»、« gently»、« minutes»、« liquid»、« reduced»；以及 « knife»、« freeze»、« solid»、« hours»、« frozen»、« completely»
patterns.context: 食谱或烹饪说明中，描述食材、器具、火候、时间，以及加入、加热、搅拌、冷冻等操作；触发分布在多个相邻词上

patterns.name: 段落末尾的词内片段
patterns.context: 影评语境里，描述被提示后发出笑声；触发是单词内部片段，局部语义与其余段落的高激活片段不同

patterns.name: 食材或食品相关词片段
patterns.trigger: « frozen»9、«ins»1，出现在 frozen 和 loins 中
patterns.context: 食谱文本中提及冷冻罗非鱼腰肉；与烹饪步骤模式相邻，但激活落在这些特定词的片段上

patterns.name: 人物对白中的动作词
patterns.context: 小说对白中谈论物件或事物的行为与人能否对其采取行动；最强标记落在 Only

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 欧洲议会发言的瑞典语片段；高激活出现在正式称呼及讨论相关词的内部

patterns.name: 口语否定与时间表达
patterns.context: 关于战争记忆的口语引述；触发落在否定词的标点、there 和 only 等片段，未见与其他模式明确的语义联系
patterns.domain: 口语访谈或回忆录引述

en.description: Activation is scattered across recipe actions and ingredients, code signature markers, in-word fragments in multiple languages, and fixed Swedish expressions. Only some passages share local strings or style; no unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Cooking steps in English recipes
patterns.context: A recipe context comprising ingredients, cookware, and steps describes heating, stirring, boiling, and reducing.

patterns.name: The chortle character sequence within an English word
patterns.context: The marker falls inside the English word chortle; the sentence says comedic content makes people laugh. The trigger appears to correspond to the in-word ort substring or its token boundary.

patterns.name: The insistir fragment in Spanish parliamentary text
patterns.context: In a Spanish parliamentary speech, the speaker says they want to emphasize something again; the highlight is within the verb insistir.

patterns.name: Objective-C method declarations and type markers
patterns.context: Parentheses, types, and pointer parameters occur together in Objective-C method signatures; activation is distributed across syntax markers and type declarations.

patterns.name: Specific food words in food lists
patterns.context: In food lists in English dietary or parenting text, highlights fall on in-word fragments of tortillas and bananas; other food names also occur in the same passage.

patterns.name: fall in Swedish
patterns.context: The phrase “i alla fall” or “i så fall” appears in a Swedish sentence; fall is highlighted in both contexts.

patterns.name: vilket in Swedish
patterns.context: In the parliamentary expression “i vilket fall som helst”, activation falls on an in-word fragment of vilket.

1_1981.description: 激活分散于食谱操作与食材、代码签名标记、多个语种的词内片段及瑞典语固定表达；仅部分语段共享局部词串或文体，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 英语食谱中的烹饪步骤
patterns.trigger: “« liquid»10”“« reduced»8”“«Heat»5”“« heat»5”“« add»5”“« broth»3”“« gently»4”
patterns.context: 食材、锅具及操作步骤构成的食谱语境，描述加热、搅拌、煮沸和收汁。

patterns.name: 英语词内的 chortle 字符片段
patterns.context: 标记落在英文单词 chortle 的内部；句子写喜剧内容引人发笑。触发似乎对应词内 ort 子串，或其分词边界。

patterns.name: 西班牙语议会文本中的 insistir 片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语议会发言中，主讲人表示要再次强调某事；高亮位于动词 insistir 的词内。

patterns.name: Objective-C 方法声明及类型标记
patterns.context: Objective-C 方法签名中，括号、类型和指针参数相邻出现；激活分布在语法标记及类型声明上。

patterns.name: 食物清单中的特定食品词
patterns.context: 英语饮食或育儿文本的食品枚举中，高亮落在 tortillas、bananas 的词内片段；同段还有其他食物名。

patterns.name: 瑞典语中的 fall
patterns.context: 瑞典语句子里出现短语“i alla fall”或“i så fall”；fall 在两种语境中均被高亮。

patterns.name: 瑞典语中的 vilket
patterns.context: 议会文本中“i vilket fall som helst”这一表达内，激活位于 vilket 的词内片段。

en.concept: Recipe contexts and scattered word fragments
en.description: Strong activations cluster in recipe texts, especially cooking actions, heat, and food states, and also involve ingredients and utensils. Other isolated phenomena include fragments within English, Hungarian, and Slovak words, C code punctuation, and line breaks in literary dialogue; no single pattern fully explains them.

patterns.name: Degree and state words in cooking steps
patterns.context: Occurs in recipe instructions and describes changes, degree, or target states of liquids, food, or heat.

patterns.name: Verbs in cooking instructions
patterns.context: Actions such as preparing ingredients, heating, mixing, or removing appear in recipe imperatives or sequences of steps.

patterns.name: Ingredient or utensil words in cooking texts
patterns.context: Names of ingredients, seasonings, or cooking utensils appear within cooking steps.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within English words
patterns.context: In English review prose, activation falls on words or their subword fragments; the passage has no obvious cooking context.

patterns.name: Hungarian word-internal fragments
patterns.context: In Hungarian parliamentary speech, activation falls within inflected or longer words.

patterns.name: Slovak word-internal fragments
patterns.context: In Slovak political text, activation occurs on letter fragments inside words rather than on clearly independent semantic words.

patterns.name: Punctuation and syntax fragments in C code
patterns.context: In network socket code, activations occur near assignments, function calls, pointers, and struct syntax.

patterns.name: Emphasis and line breaks in older English dialogue
patterns.context: Dialogue includes emphatic phrases, exclamations, and typographic line breaks; activations often occur on line breaks or short words.

patterns.name: Evaluative and ingredient words in recipe reviews
patterns.context: Users review recipes, describe making them repeatedly, or discuss ingredient use; these are not exclusively cooking steps.

1_1981.concept: 食谱操作语境及零散词片段
1_1981.description: 强激活集中于食谱文本，尤其烹饪动作、火候及食物状态，也涉及食材与器具；另有英文散文、匈牙利语和斯洛伐克语词内片段、C 代码标点及文学对白换行等离散现象，无法由单一模式充分解释。

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤中的程度与状态词
patterns.trigger: «liquid»10 is« reduced»7 by half；«golden»2« brown»2；«cool»6« slightly»4；«gentle»1« heat»5；«Increase»9« the»2« heat»3 to« medium»5
patterns.context: 处于食谱的操作说明中，描述液体、食物或火候的变化、程度或目标状态。

patterns.name: 烹饪指令中的动词
patterns.context: 食谱祈使句或连续操作步骤中，出现备料、加热、混合或移除等动作。

patterns.name: 烹饪文本中的食材或器具词
patterns.trigger: « broth»4；« vinegar»2；« skillet»1；« sea»1« salt»5；« oil»8；« onions»
patterns.context: 烹饪步骤内出现食材、调味品或烹饪器具名称。

patterns.name: 英语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 英文评论散文中，激活落在词语或其子词片段上；这段缺乏明显的烹饪语境。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内片段
patterns.context: 匈牙利语议会发言中，激活落在屈折词或较长词语的内部片段。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录，匈牙利语

patterns.name: 斯洛伐克语词内片段
patterns.context: 斯洛伐克语政治文本中，激活位于词语内部的字母片段，而非清晰的独立语义词。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录，斯洛伐克语

patterns.name: C 代码中的标点与语法片段
patterns.context: 网络套接字代码中，激活落在赋值、函数调用、指针和结构体语法附近。

patterns.name: 旧式英语对白中的强调与换行
patterns.context: 对话中有强调性短语、感叹和排版换行；激活常在换行或短词处。

patterns.name: 食谱评论中的评价与食材词
patterns.context: 用户评论食谱、介绍重复制作或食材用法；不完全是操作步骤。

en.description: The strongest and most grouped pattern is heat adjustment, heating, and cooking-result descriptions in recipe instructions (1, 2, 4). The remaining activations are scattered across novel subword fragments and line breaks, Hungarian fragments, product capacity descriptions, IRC nicknames, C code symbols, and email line breaks, making them difficult to group as a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Heat adjustment in cooking steps
patterns.context: Recipe instructions describing heating, adjusting the heat, and waiting for ingredients to reach a certain state; often near time, liquid, or ingredient references.

patterns.name: Other instructions involving duration or quantity
patterns.context: Operations in recipes described through duration, liquid changes, or mixture state; co-occurs with heat-related words but may also activate independently.

patterns.name: Colloquial emphatic words and inter-sentence line breaks
patterns.context: In novel dialogue, an emphatic word introduces a short sentence; activation also falls on line-break markers.

patterns.name: Substrings within Hungarian words
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments of Hungarian words in a sentence about members of parliament and an important debate; no clear link to the recipe pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Common fragments in English dialogue
patterns.context: In novel dialogue, activation falls on the abbreviation “ain't” and punctuation fragments in possessives/abbreviations; nearby text includes blame and a response.

patterns.name: Capacity and liquid-quantity contexts
patterns.context: Product descriptions comparing the capacity of cups and the risk of spilling when filled with liquid.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in chat
patterns.context: In IRC dialogue, activation falls on internal fragments of usernames or nicknames, with no clear semantic cues.

patterns.name: Syntax symbols and identifier fragments in C code
patterns.context: Appears near struct declarations, assignments, and function calls in network programming code.

patterns.name: Line-break markers in quoted text
patterns.context: In text with email quote levels increasing line by line, activation falls on newline characters; the sentence discusses when a party will start.

1_1981.description: 最强且成组的模式是食谱指令中的火力调节、加热及烹饪结果描述（1、2、4）。其余激活分散于小说词片段与换行、匈牙利语片段、商品容量描述、IRC昵称、C 代码符号及邮件换行，难以归为同一语义特征。

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤中的热量调节
patterns.context: 食谱指令中描述加热、调节火力并等待食材达到某状态；常邻近时间、液体或食材。

patterns.name: 其他含时长或数量的指令
patterns.context: 食谱中以时长、液体变化或混合物状态描述操作结果；与火力词共同出现，但也可能独立激活。

patterns.name: 口语强调词及句间换行
patterns.context: 小说对话中以强调词引出短句，激活也落在换行标记上。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内子串
patterns.context: 激活落在匈牙利语词的片段上，句意涉及议会成员和重要辩论；未见与食谱模式的明显联系。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本/匈牙利语

patterns.name: 英语对话中的常见片段
patterns.context: 小说对话里落在缩写“ain't”及所有格/缩写的标点片段上；附近有责备与回答。

patterns.name: 容量与液体量词语境
patterns.context: 产品描述比较杯子的容量及装液体时的溢出风险。

patterns.name: 聊天中的词内片段
patterns.context: IRC 对话中激活落在用户名或昵称的内部片段，缺乏清楚的语义线索。

patterns.name: C 代码中的语法符号与标识符片段
patterns.context: 网络编程代码中出现在结构体声明、赋值及函数调用附近。

patterns.name: 引文格式中的换行标记
patterns.context: 邮件引用层级逐行增加的文本中，激活落在换行符，句子谈及开始聚会的时间。

en.concept: Sentence-initial Only/only and heterogeneous local patterns
en.description: The most stable common cue is Only/only at the start of a sentence or clause, covering emphasis, restriction, responses, and narrative closure; other isolated activations occur in recipe words, code brackets, and configuration entries, with no shared semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “Only” at the start of a sentence or turn
patterns.context: “Only” appears at the start of a sentence or clause to emphasize, respond, contrast, or introduce what follows; it may be followed by punctuation, a noun, or a full clause.

patterns.name: Non-trigger co-occurrence of “only” in cooking instructions
patterns.context: Ingredients, cooking degree, or results are described in recipe steps; these passages do not support a unified “Only” trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Code punctuation and syntax
patterns.context: Activations occur near function calls, type casts, parentheses, or configuration entries in C/C++ code and build configurations; no obvious link to the “Only” pattern.

patterns.name: Narrative turn at the end of a sentence
patterns.context: A narrative paragraph closes with “Only time will tell”, expressing that the outcome remains unknown.

patterns.name: General meanings of only
patterns.context: “only” restricts time, quantity, or degree, or appears in fixed polite responses; the specific syntax and pragmatics vary considerably.
patterns.domain: Online comments, novels, chat, interview transcripts

1_1981.concept: 句首 Only/only 及异质局部模式
1_1981.description: 最稳定的共同线索是句首或分句开头的 Only/only，涵盖强调、限定、回应及叙事收束；另有食谱词、代码括号与配置项等孤立激活，无法归入同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 句首/话轮中的“Only”
patterns.context: “Only”位于句首或分句开头，用于强调、回应、转折或引出后续内容；后面可接标点、名词或完整分句。
patterns.domain: 小说、网页文本、聊天、对话

patterns.name: 烹饪指令中的“only”非触发共现
patterns.trigger: “only”未出现；显著激活集中在«mixture»9等词，另有«heat»4、«medium»6、«minutes»3、«warm»5、«liquid»9
patterns.context: 食谱步骤中的食材状态、烹饪程度或结果描述；这些段落并不支持统一的“Only”触发模式。

patterns.name: 代码标点与语法结构
patterns.context: C/C++代码与构建配置中，函数调用、类型转换、括号或配置项附近出现激活；与“Only”模式无明显联系。

patterns.name: 句末叙事转折语
patterns.context: 叙事段落末尾以“Only time will tell”收束，表达结果尚待揭晓。

patterns.name: 一般性的只、仅含义
patterns.trigger: «only»9 recently；«only»9 half；«only»9 a pleasure；«only»9 about 60 years ago
patterns.context: “only”用于时间、数量、程度限定，或固定礼貌回应；具体句法和语用差异较大。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、小说、聊天、访谈转写

en.concept: Multiple word forms and token fragments
en.description: Activations are most clearly concentrated on the CMake function name `cmake_minimum_required` and on `Only` at the beginning of sentences or phrases. Recipe instructions, apostrophes and adjacent word fragments also appear, along with several scattered code and prose tokens lacking a unified context.

patterns.name: CMake configuration identifier
patterns.context: A CMakeLists.txt configuration line, followed by `(VERSION ...)`; the same code context also contains symbols such as `«++»`, `« =»`, and `«}»`

patterns.name: Only at sentence or phrase start
patterns.context: Capitalized at the beginning of a quotation or narrative sentence (e.g., `Only—`, `Only Billy`, `Only time`, `Only the`); paragraph 2 is an emphatic expression in a quotation
patterns.domain: Novel narration and dialogue; also game narration

patterns.name: Recipe cooking steps
patterns.context: Sequential instructions for heating, frying, and adjusting the heat after preparing ingredients

patterns.name: Apostrophes and adjacent word fragments
patterns.context: An apostrophe appears as a standalone token in English contractions or within Italian words; ordinary narrative words also activate in the same passage
patterns.domain: English novel dialogue and Italian academic prose

patterns.name: Miscellaneous code or prose tokens
patterns.context: These tokens occur respectively in compile commands, C++ code, dialogue, compound-word suffixes, or ordinary narration; no common local trigger is apparent

1_1981.concept: 多个词形与 token 片段
1_1981.description: 激活最明确地集中在 CMake 函数名 `cmake_minimum_required`，以及句首或短语起始的 `Only`。另见食谱烹饪指令、撇号及邻接词片段，和若干分散的代码、散文 token，后者缺少统一上下文。

patterns.name: CMake 配置标识
patterns.context: CMakeLists.txt 配置行，后接 `(VERSION ...)`；同一代码上下文中也有 `«++»`、`« =»`、`«}»` 等 C/C++ 符号

patterns.name: Only 句首/短语起始
patterns.context: 大写时出现在引语或叙述句开头（如 `Only—`、`Only Billy`、`Only time`、`Only the`）；第2段为引语中的强调表达
patterns.domain: 小说叙事与对白；另有游戏叙述

patterns.name: 食谱烹饪步骤
patterns.context: 食材处理后按顺序说明加热、炒制和调节火力

patterns.name: 撇号及其邻接词片段
patterns.context: 撇号作为独立 token 出现在英语缩写拼写或意大利语词语内部；同段另有普通叙事词激活
patterns.domain: 英语小说对白与意大利语学术散文

patterns.name: 杂项代码或散文 token
patterns.trigger: 第1段的 `«++»`；第3段的 `« =»`、`«URE»`、`«}»`；第5段的 `«that»`、«It»；第9段的 `«effects»`；第10段的 `«that»`、`«few»`
patterns.context: 这些 token 分别处于编译命令、C++ 代码、对白、复合词后缀或普通叙述中；目前看不出共同的局部触发条件

en.concept: early time expressions and heterogeneous terms
en.description: Activations are scattered across different texts and parts of speech; the clearest repeated cue is early indicating an earlier time. Other local patterns include recipe operations and ingredients, CMake configuration terms, and novel dialogue. Some highlights fall on punctuation or subword fragments, making a unified explanation difficult.

patterns.name: Temporal use of early
patterns.context: Modifies an action or time point to indicate that it occurs earlier; in [7], “bananas early”; in [8], “as early as 3 P.M.”; in [10], “Sparrow spit early Thursday morning”.

patterns.name: Sentence-final or medial function words and punctuation
patterns.context: Activation falls near apostrophes, line breaks, quotation marks, or several common words, with no stable shared semantic context.

patterns.name: Ingredients and cooking-step words in recipes
patterns.context: Recipes describe ingredients, heating, adding liquid, and reducing; the two passages concern chicken mole and gravy preparation.

patterns.name: Code configuration terms
patterns.context: Appears in the CMake configuration statement “cmake_minimum_required”.

patterns.name: Colloquial words in dialogue
patterns.context: Novel dialogue contains apostrophe contractions and narrative words; no clear connection to highlights in other passages.

patterns.name: Emphasized words in phrases
patterns.context: Highlights occur in different phrases, and local context does not reveal a unified trigger.

patterns.name: Unexplained sporadic activations
patterns.context: These highlights fall respectively on fragments of Italian words, an IRC username, a novel word, a segmented fragment of banana, a code suffix, and punctuation; no stable shared condition is apparent.

1_1981.description: 激活分散在多种文本和词类中；较明显的重复线索是 early（表示较早时间），另有食谱操作词与食材、CMake 配置词及小说对白等局部模式。部分高亮落在标点或词片段，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: early 的时间用法
patterns.context: 修饰动作或时间点，表示较早发生；在[7]中为“bananas early”，[8]中为“as early as 3 P.M.”，[10]中为“Sparrow spit early Thursday morning”。
patterns.domain: 育儿博客、邮件、露营叙述

patterns.name: 句末或句中功能词与标点
patterns.context: 激活落在撇号、换行、引号附近或若干常见词上，未见稳定的共同语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 意大利语文本、IRC、小说、邮件

patterns.name: 食谱中的食材与烹饪步骤词
patterns.trigger: «chilli»10、«Heat»2、« Remove»3、« add»5、« broth»5、« vinegar»4、« liquid»10、« reduced»7
patterns.context: 食谱中描述食材、加热、加入液体及收汁等操作；两段分别涉及鸡肉摩尔酱和肉汁烹饪。

patterns.name: 代码配置术语
patterns.context: 出现在 CMake 配置语句“cmake_minimum_required”中。

patterns.name: 对话中的口语词
patterns.context: 小说对话中夹有撇号缩写及叙述性用词；与其他段的高亮缺乏明确关联。

patterns.name: 短语中被强调的词
patterns.context: 高亮分布在不同短语中，无法从局部上下文确定统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 未解释的零散激活
patterns.context: 这些高亮分别落在意大利语词的片段、IRC 用户名、小说词语、banana 的切分片段、代码后缀和标点上，未发现稳定共同条件。

en.description: Activations occur in recipe steps, ingredients, and food preparation, and also on digit strings, within-word fragments, line breaks, common words in novels, and C code syntax; aside from the recipe subset, no stable trigger condition spans the passages.

patterns.name: Heat or cooking state in recipe steps
patterns.context: Recipe instructions describe heating, adjusting the heat, or softening ingredients; the words occur within a sequence of steps.

patterns.name: Quantities, units, and ingredients in ingredient lists
patterns.context: A line-separated recipe ingredient list, where numbers, units of measurement, and ingredient names occur together.

patterns.name: Preparing and assembling cooked food
patterns.context: Describes frying, draining, shredding, and assembling food.

patterns.name: Numbers and alphanumeric strings
patterns.context: Activation falls on numbers, identifiers, or alphanumeric strings; their semantics and format vary by context.

patterns.name: Substrings within English words
patterns.context: Markers fall within words or their components rather than on complete, independent words; there is no stable shared context.

patterns.name: Line breaks or layout boundaries in novels
patterns.context: Activation markers appear near line breaks in novel text, including dialogue breaks, body-text breaks, or line breaks in table-of-contents entries.

patterns.name: Assignment and struct-member syntax in C code
patterns.context: Network programming code declares or initializes an address structure and calls accept; markers cover operators, keywords, and member-name fragments.

patterns.name: Other isolated English words
patterns.context: These words occur separately in historical narration, novel narration, or character dialogue, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition.

1_1981.description: 激活分布于食谱步骤、配料与食物处理，也落在数字串、词内片段、换行、小说常用词及C代码语法上；除食谱子集外，未见贯穿各段的稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤中的热度或烹饪状态
patterns.context: 食谱指令中描述加热、调节火力或食材软化；词语处在连续的操作步骤里。

patterns.name: 配料表中的数量、单位与食材
patterns.context: 换行分隔的食谱配料清单，数值、计量单位与食材名称相邻。

patterns.name: 烹饪食物的处理与组装
patterns.context: 叙述油炸、沥干、撕碎并组装食物的做法。

patterns.name: 数字与字母数字串
patterns.context: 激活落在数字、编号或字母数字串上；其语义与格式随上下文变化。

patterns.name: 英文分词内部的子串
patterns.context: 标记落在词内或词的组成部分上，而非完整、独立的词；没有稳定的共同语境。

patterns.name: 小说中的换行或版式边界
patterns.context: 激活标记出现在小说文本的换行附近，包括对话断行、正文断行或目录条目换行。

patterns.name: C 代码中的赋值与结构体成员语法
patterns.context: 网络编程代码中声明或初始化地址结构并调用 accept；标记覆盖运算符、关键字与成员名片段。

patterns.name: 其他孤立英文词语
patterns.context: 这些词分别出现在历史叙述、小说叙述或人物对话中，未见一致的语义或句法条件。

en.description: Activation patterns are mixed: several uses of Only in novels and static const declarations in C code are relatively consistent; other activations include sporadic word endings, dialogue words, code macros, and punctuation, which are difficult to group under a shared semantic interpretation.

patterns.name: Only followed by a quantity, person, or statement
patterns.context: Only functions as a sentence-initial or medial restrictive adverb, followed by a noun, proper name, or complete statement; at least three distinct uses, all with activation on Only.

patterns.name: static const declarations
patterns.context: static const declarations in C code, followed by declarations such as struct, arrays, or character types; const activates strongly, while static, struct, and others also activate more weakly.

patterns.name: Other sporadic words and punctuation
patterns.context: Word endings, words, and code punctuation scattered across different contexts, with no obvious shared semantics or stable contextual conditions.
patterns.domain: Religious text, literary dialogue, and code

patterns.name: Code macros and structural markers
patterns.context: Preprocessor directives, export-symbol macros, and struct or enum closing markers in code; these do not fully overlap with static const declarations.

1_1981.description: 激活模式混杂：小说中 Only 的多种用法、C 代码的 static const 声明较稳定；另有零散词尾、对白词语及代码宏和标点，难以归入共同语义。

patterns.name: Only 后接数量、人物或陈述
patterns.context: Only 作为句首或句中限制副词，后接名词、专名或完整陈述；至少三种不同用法，激活位置都在 Only。

patterns.name: static const 声明
patterns.context: C 代码中的 static const 声明，后接 struct、数组或字符类型等声明内容；const 激活强，static、struct 等也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 其他零散词语与标点
patterns.context: 分散在不同上下文中的词尾、词语及代码标点；没有显然共同的语义或稳定上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 宗教文本、文学对白与代码

patterns.name: 代码宏与结构性标记
patterns.context: 代码中的预处理指令、导出符号宏及结构体或枚举结束标记；不与 static const 声明完全重合。

en.concept: Mixed triggers from sentence-initial Only and recipe words
en.description: Activations are scattered: several passages are near sentence-initial Only; three recipe passages cover ingredients, seasonings, and cooking-step words; other activations are sporadic word fragments, apostrophes, punctuation, and Force in an aircraft name.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial emphatic Only
patterns.context: Only occurs at or near the beginning of a sentence, introducing a restriction, emphasis, or following noun phrase; [1] also has activation on punctuation and a line break
patterns.domain: Novel narration, news headlines, webpage excerpts, and general text

patterns.name: Cooking ingredients and step words
patterns.context: Local words around ingredients, seasonings, and cooking steps in recipes or cooking instructions

patterns.name: Punctuation or spelling fragments at sentence ends or within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on word fragments, word endings, or apostrophes in dialogue, news headlines, and quotations; no common, clear semantic condition

patterns.name: Force in an aircraft designation
patterns.context: Occurs in the military equipment name “Air Force F-35”

1_1981.concept: 句首 Only 与食谱词的混合触发
1_1981.description: 激活较分散：多段在句首 Only 附近；三段食谱中覆盖食材、调味料和烹饪步骤词；另有零散的词内片段、撇号、标点及军机名称中的 Force。

patterns.name: Only 句首强调词
patterns.context: Only 出现在句首或句首附近，引出限制、强调或后续名词短语；[1]还出现标点和换行处激活
patterns.domain: 小说叙述、新闻标题、网页片段及一般文本

patterns.name: 烹饪食材与步骤词
patterns.context: 食谱或烹饪说明中，食材、调味料及操作步骤周围的局部词语

patterns.name: 句末或词内的标点/拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内片段、词尾或撇号上，分别处于对白、新闻标题及引语中；缺乏共同的明显语义条件

patterns.name: 军机型号中的 Force
patterns.context: 位于“Air Force F-35”这一军事装备名称中

en.concept: Sentence-initial Only and sporadic word triggers
en.description: The most prominent repeated pattern is the emphatic or restrictive sentence-initial use of “Only”; the recipe command “​​Increase the heat” also triggers strongly. Other activations are scattered across recipes, code, technical Q&A, and novels, with no stable shared conditions; paragraph 2 also has no clear match.

patterns.name: Only at the start of a sentence or paragraph
patterns.context: Only is followed by a quantity, restricted object, or subject, as in “Only have a 5 percent chance”, “Only One of Six”, and “Only--”.
patterns.domain: News commentary, novels, prose; mostly emphatic or restrictive sentence-initial expressions

patterns.name: Word-form/semantic trigger for Increase
patterns.context: A cooking step commands increasing the heat, followed by “the heat to medium”.

patterns.name: Sporadic triggers from common words or phrases
patterns.context: These words occur respectively in recipes, C code, Objective-C declarations, database errors, and novel dialogue, with no shared local semantic or grammatical condition.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text: cooking, programming, technical Q&A, novels

1_1981.concept: 句首 Only 与零散词触发
1_1981.description: 激活最醒目的重复模式是句首强调或限制用法“Only”；另有食谱命令“​​Increase the heat”的强触发。其余若干激活散见于食谱、代码、技术问答和小说，未显示稳定共同条件；第2段也无明确对应。

patterns.name: 句首或段首的 Only
patterns.context: Only 后接数量、限定对象或主语，如“Only have a 5 percent chance”“Only One of Six”“Only--”。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、小说、散文；多为句首强调或限制表达

patterns.name: Increase 的词形/语义触发
patterns.context: 烹饪步骤中命令提高火力，后接“the heat to medium”。

patterns.name: 高频词或短语的零散触发
patterns.context: 这些词分别出现在食谱、C 代码、Objective-C 声明、数据库报错及小说对话中，缺少共同的局部语义或语法条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本：烹饪、编程、技术问答、小说

en.concept: Recipe cooking words and scattered word fragments
en.description: The clearest cluster is activations on ingredient, seasoning, and cooking-step words in recipes; the remaining activations are scattered across technical Q&A, chat, Danish, and fragments within English words, with no stable shared condition.

patterns.name: Action or measurement words in recipes
patterns.context: Words in cooking steps or ingredient lists involve food preparation, seasoning, heating, and timing; some activations fall on fragments within English words.

patterns.name: Fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activations occur on substrings within words rather than on complete words; the examples are not semantically or contextually consistent.

patterns.name: Restrictive expressions in programming Q&A
patterns.context: Technical Q&A describes constraints on a database identity column or the purpose of an interface port; activation concentrates on words expressing restriction, exclusion, or emphasis.

patterns.name: Update wording in IRC chat
patterns.context: A URL path contains update, followed by brief IRC chat.

patterns.name: Adverbs of emphasis or degree
patterns.context: A Danish sentence expresses increased urgency; the context concerns international cooperation and public health information.

patterns.name: Demonstrative pronouns
patterns.context: That appears in English narration or technical Q&A, referring to something or introducing a clause; no stable shared semantic role is evident.

patterns.name: Other scattered word fragments
patterns.context: Scattered across contexts such as recipes and novels, without a shared condition that would group them into the same semantic pattern.

1_1981.concept: 食谱烹饪词及零散词片段
1_1981.description: 最清晰的集中模式是食谱中对食材、调味与烹饪步骤词的激活；其余激活散布于技术问答、聊天、丹麦语及英文词内片段，缺少稳定共同条件。

patterns.name: 食谱中的动作或计量词
patterns.trigger: « diced»、« teaspoon»、« salt»、« ground»、« minutes»、« stirring»、« sprinkle»、« heat»
patterns.context: 烹饪步骤或配料表中，涉及食材处理、调味、加热和时间的词；部分激活落在英文词内部片段上。

patterns.name: 英语词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在词内子串而非完整词上；这些例子语义和上下文不统一。

patterns.name: 程序问答中的限定表达
patterns.context: 技术问答中，描述数据库标识列约束或接口端口用途，激活集中于限定、排除或强调的词。

patterns.name: IRC 聊天中的更新字样
patterns.context: 网址路径含 update，后接 IRC 简短聊天。

patterns.name: 强调程度的副词
patterns.context: 丹麦语句中表达紧迫程度增强；上下文谈国际合作与公共卫生信息。

patterns.name: 指示代词
patterns.context: 英语叙事或技术问答中出现 that，分别用于指代或引出从句；看不出稳定的共同语义作用。

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 分散在食谱、小说等语境，缺少能将它们归为同一语义模式的共同条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across languages and styles: prominent apostrophe-containing word fragments, recipe quantities and units, negative determiners, as well as code symbols, SQL errors, public health words, and words related to mobility; the words in novel dialogue are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: Contraction apostrophes and in-word fragments
patterns.context: Apostrophes occur within colloquial contractions or Italian word forms, rather than as standalone punctuation; in both examples, the highlights are adjacent to word boundaries.
patterns.domain: English colloquial dialogue; Italian academic discussion

patterns.name: Numbers, fractions, and recipe measurements
patterns.context: In ingredient lists or cooking steps, numbers, fractions, units of measurement, and ingredient descriptions occur near one another.

patterns.name: Negation and exclusion expressions
patterns.context: Occurs in English colloquial sentences emphasizing that something cannot be done or restricting scope; activation strength and trigger words are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Technical identifiers and parenthetical syntax
patterns.context: Function calls, assignments, type casts, and parentheses occur densely in C code.

patterns.name: Explicit-value error message
patterns.context: An SQL exception message describing an error when inserting an explicit value into an identity column.

patterns.name: Health risks and international cooperation vocabulary
patterns.context: A Danish sentence discusses avian influenza, pandemic risks, international cooperation, and public health; the highlighted word means “more”.
patterns.domain: European Parliament text, public health policy

patterns.name: Words related to physical mobility
patterns.context: A travel or camping narrative mentions a companion's mobility scooter and its battery.

patterns.name: Unclear sporadic triggers
patterns.context: Novel dialogue contains terms about an officer and an affair, as well as a passage anthropomorphically complaining about objects; the highlighted words show no common, stable local semantic or formal condition.

1_1981.description: 激活分散于多种语言和文体：突出撇号词内片段、配方数字单位、否定限定词，也涉及代码符号、SQL报错、公共卫生词和行动能力词；小说对白中的词项难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 缩写撇号与词内片段
patterns.context: 撇号出现在口语缩写或意大利语词形内部，而不是独立标点；两例中的高亮都紧邻词边界。
patterns.domain: 英语口语对话；意大利语学术论述

patterns.name: 数字、分数与计量配方
patterns.context: 食谱的配料清单或烹饪步骤中，数字、分数、计量单位及食材描述相邻出现。

patterns.name: 否定与排他表达
patterns.context: 在强调不能做某事或限定范围的英语口语句子中出现；高亮强度和触发词并不一致。

patterns.name: 技术标识符与括号语法
patterns.context: C 代码中函数调用、赋值、类型转换及括号等符号密集出现。

patterns.name: 显式值错误提示
patterns.context: SQL 异常消息中，描述向 identity 列插入显式值的错误。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、数据库错误信息

patterns.name: 健康风险与跨国合作词汇
patterns.context: 丹麦语句子讨论禽流感、大流行风险、国际合作和公共卫生；高亮词表示“更”。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、公共卫生政策

patterns.name: 身体行动能力词汇
patterns.context: 叙述旅行或露营经历时，提到队友的代步 scooter 及其电池。

patterns.name: 未明晰的零散触发
