1_2051.description: 所有片段均在学术或技术语境中出现“coefficient”，涵盖材料与测量、统计相关、物理、扩散、土壤矿化及分析方法等多种系数。

patterns.name: “coefficient”统计/物理量
patterns.context: 术语“coefficient”后接具体物理量或统计指标名称，如 restitution、absorption、correlation、Hall、diffusion、mineralization、linear、variation、variance；不限于该词前后的固定语法结构。
patterns.domain: 跨领域学术论文、专利背景及方法描述

en.description: All segments contain and activate “coefficient” in specialized technical contexts, covering coefficients of restitution, absorption, correlation, diffusion, Hall, mineralization, transformation, thermal expansion, friction, and variation; some segments also include measurement or parameter quantification.

patterns.name: Coefficient in technical terminology
patterns.context: “coefficient” occurs in a noun phrase for a measurement, calculation, or physical/statistical parameter; in many segments, the word itself is the strongest activation site
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, patent technical background; mechanics, materials, statistics, physics, soil science, medicine, and image coding

patterns.name: Coefficient-related numerical and measurement contexts
patterns.context: Statements about calculations, measurements, parameter changes, numerical results, or performance evaluations appear alongside or near a coefficient; activation is weaker and not shared by all segments
patterns.domain: Quantitative technical descriptions in abstracts and patent specifications

1_2051.description: 所有段均在专业技术语境中出现并激活“coefficient”，涵盖恢复、吸收、相关、扩散、霍尔、矿化、变换、热膨胀、摩擦及变异系数；部分段另伴随测量或参数定量描述。

patterns.name: 专业术语中的 coefficient
patterns.trigger: “coefficient”及其后续限定词，如 “coefficient of restitution”“absorption coefficient”“intraclass correlation coefficient”“Diffusion coefficient”“Hall coefficient”“transform coefficient”“coefficient of thermal expansion”“friction coefficient”“coefficient of variance”
patterns.context: “coefficient”处于测量、计算或物理/统计参数的名词短语中；多段里该词本身是最强激活位置
patterns.domain: 科学论文、专利技术背景；力学、材料、统计、物理、土壤、医学与图像编码

patterns.name: 系数相关的数值与测量语境
patterns.trigger: 如“modulus was calculated”“measurement repeatability”“values … of the parameters”“remains integer”“exceeded 14%”“can be improved”“validated … average”
patterns.context: 与系数并列或相邻的计算、测量、参数变化、数值结果或性能评价语句；激活较弱且并非各段共有
patterns.domain: 摘要与专利说明书中的定量技术描述

en.description: All snippets concern “coefficient” terminology in science or engineering and its quantitative parameters and measurement indicators; activation may cover the word and nearby function words, while the specific coefficient type varies across disciplines.

patterns.name: “coefficient” and the quantity it denotes
patterns.context: In descriptions of measurement, calculation, materials, or models, focus falls on the word coefficient and its adjacent technical collocation; it is sometimes preceded by a modifier and sometimes followed by an “of” phrase.
patterns.domain: Research papers and patent technical texts

patterns.name: Coefficients and quantitative measurement results
patterns.context: A coefficient occurs in a context of quantitative evaluation, statistical reliability, measurement validation, or experimental results; some contexts include values, units, or statistical indicators.

patterns.name: Engineering processes, coding, or material parameters
patterns.context: A coefficient serves as a parameter of a system, material, physical model, or engineering process, and is linked to absorption, diffusion, transformation, the Hall effect, or energy transfer.
patterns.domain: Patents, computer coding, physics, and materials research

patterns.name: Incidental activation of nearby non-coefficient words
patterns.context: These words occur near several high-activation sites, but their distribution is inconsistent and they cannot explain all instances on their own; they may be incidental signals from the syntax surrounding coefficient terminology.

1_2051.description: 所有片段均围绕科学或工程中的“coefficient”术语及其定量参数、测量指标展开；激活可能覆盖该词及邻近功能词，具体系数类型跨学科变化。

patterns.name: “coefficient”及其后续量名
patterns.trigger: “coefficient”后接或组成科学、工程术语，如“coefficient of restitution”“absorption coefficient”“reliability coefficient”“intraclass correlation coefficient”“Diffusion coefficient”“transform coefficient”“Hall coefficient”“mineralization coefficient”“coefficient of variance”“energy transfer coefficient”
patterns.context: 在测量、计算、材料或模型描述中，重点落在系数一词及紧邻的术语搭配；有时系数名词前有修饰语，有时后接“of”短语。
patterns.domain: 科研论文与专利技术文本

patterns.name: 系数与量化测量结果
patterns.trigger: “modulus was calculated”“areas under”“factor loading”“reliability coefficient was .95”“repeatability”“14%”“average coefficient of variance”
patterns.context: 系数处于定量评估、统计可靠性、测量验证或实验结果语境；部分上下文出现数值、单位或统计指标。

patterns.name: 工程处理、编码或材料参数
patterns.trigger: “absorption coefficient”“Diffusion coefficient”“transform coefficient”“Hall coefficient”“energy transfer coefficient”
patterns.context: 系数作为系统、材料、物理模型或工程处理的参数，与吸收、扩散、变换、霍尔效应或能量传递相连。
patterns.domain: 专利、计算机编码、物理与材料研究

patterns.name: 非系数的局部伴随词触发
patterns.trigger: “an”“the”“and”“from”“of”等常见功能词，以及“energy”“loading”“reliability”等邻近词
patterns.context: 这些词出现在若干高激活位置附近，但分布并不稳定，无法单独解释全部实例；可能是系数术语句法环境的伴随信号。

en.concept: TEM letter fragment and several lexical coincidences
en.description: The clearest activation is for the TEM letter fragment (legal CONTEMPT, microscope TEM, code TEMPLATE); also observed are commodity in commercial contexts and sporadic triggers such as Atomic, Reduce/Taken, and citation R3, across multiple domains.

patterns.name: TEM abbreviation and tokenization
patterns.context: In legal texts, “CONTEMPT TO” appears, with activation concentrated on the TEM letter fragment created by tokenization; electron microscopy abbreviation «TEM»10 also occurs.

patterns.name: commodity and commodity contexts
patterns.context: commodity refers to goods, energy, or the underlying asset of a futures contract; also appears in “lucrative commodity”, meaning information with commercial value.

patterns.name: Attribute template identifier
patterns.context: In the uppercase configuration key ATTR_BLOCKS_TEMPLATE, TEM is an internal fragment of TEMPLATE.

patterns.name: Energy-related proper name
patterns.context: Appears in the name of the statute 《Atomic Energy Act》.

patterns.name: Truncated word fragments in a disease/laboratory title
patterns.context: The title reads “Devices to Reduce the Volume of Blood Taken for Laboratory”; activation falls on fragments in Reduce and Taken.

patterns.name: Bibliographic citation marker
patterns.context: Appears in a bracketed citation marker in a passage about bacterial research; nearby are other activated words such as TEM and Atomic, but there is no apparent shared semantics here.

1_2051.concept: TEM字母片段及若干词汇偶合
1_2051.description: 激活最明显的是 TEM 字母片段（法律 CONTEMPT、显微镜 TEM、代码 TEMPLATE）；另见 commodity 商品语境，以及 Atomic、Reduce/Taken、引文 R3 等零散触发，整体跨领域。

patterns.name: TEM缩写与分词
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现“CONTEMPT TO”，激活集中在被切分的 TEM 字母片段；另有电子显微镜缩写 «TEM»10。

patterns.name: commodity及商品语境
patterns.context: commodity 指商品、能源或期货合约标的；另出现表示信息具有商业价值的 lucrative commodity。

patterns.name: 属性模板标识符
patterns.context: 大写配置键 ATTR_BLOCKS_TEMPLATE 中，TEM 是 TEMPLATE 的内部片段。

patterns.name: 能量相关专名
patterns.context: 出现在《Atomic Energy Act》这一法规名称中。
patterns.domain: 放射性管制与能源法规

patterns.name: 疾病/实验室标题中的截断词片段
patterns.context: 标题写作“Devices to Reduce the Volume of Blood Taken for Laboratory”，激活片段落在 Reduce 和 Taken。

patterns.name: 文献引文标记
patterns.context: 出现在细菌研究段落的方括号引文标记中；附近另有 TEM、Atomic 等激活词，但此处没有明显共同语义。

en.description: Activation is dispersed: clearer responses cover commodity in its goods/material sense, complex in complex relationships, and isolated words or expressions such as complete, a headline dash, constitute, and introduced; there are also subword fragments and function-word activations, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Use of commodity
patterns.context: In “a desired commodity” or “As a commodity”, refers to an item that can be obtained, produced, or traded; paragraph 4 also contains “commodity price effects”.

patterns.name: Complex structures or processes
patterns.context: Describes complexity in a life cycle, support mechanism, or the binding relationship between a drug and carrier molecule.

patterns.name: Complete/entire
patterns.context: “They are complete with the prior comments” describes attachments or exchanged files that include previous comments.

patterns.name: Dash after a newspaper name
patterns.context: A news item begins with an uppercase newspaper name and publisher information in parentheses, followed by a dash and the article text.

patterns.name: Nominalized causative/constitutive expression
patterns.context: constitute is used to describe parasites as a major disease burden.

patterns.name: Sample introduction expression
patterns.context: A blood sample is introduced into a sealed, evacuated test container.

patterns.name: Word forms and morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activation covers tokenized fragments within words; the bottled water fragment recurs, while another example comes from an uppercase proper name/headline.

patterns.name: Other local activations of common function words or technical terms
patterns.context: Scattered within sentences, with no stable shared semantic or syntactic condition.

1_2051.concept: 词汇与技术文本局部特征
1_2051.description: 激活分散：较明显地覆盖 commodity 的商品/物质用法、complex 的复杂关系，以及 complete、报头破折号、constitute、introduced 等孤立词或表达；另有词片段和功能词激活，未形成统一语义模式。

patterns.name: commodity 用法
patterns.context: “a desired commodity”或“As a commodity”语境，指可供获取、生产或交易的物品；第4段另有 commodity price effects。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、投资/经济文本

patterns.name: 复杂结构或过程
patterns.context: 形容生命周期、支持机制或药物与载体分子的结合关系复杂。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、专利技术文本

patterns.name: 完整/齐全
patterns.context: “They are complete with the prior comments”，描述附件或交换文件包含此前评论。

patterns.name: 报纸名称后的破折号
patterns.context: 新闻条目以全大写报纸名称及括号内出版方信息开头，破折号后接报道正文。

patterns.name: 名词化使动/构成表达
patterns.context: 以 constitute 描述寄生虫构成重大疾病负担。

patterns.name: 样本导入表达
patterns.context: 血液样本被引入密封抽真空的测试容器。

patterns.name: 词形与构词碎片
patterns.context: 激活覆盖词内部的分词片段；bottled water 片段重复出现，另一例来自大写专名/报头。

patterns.name: 其他常见功能词或技术词局部激活
patterns.context: 零散落在句中，未见稳定的共同语义或句法条件。

en.description: The most stable trigger is the word form complex: it refers both to complex situations, objects, or processes and, as a noun, to molecular complexes; it occurs across genres, with local meaning varying by domain.

patterns.name: complex and its forms
patterns.context: The word form complex functions as an adjective or noun, modifying systems, medical conditions, processes, relationships, or residential facilities; it appears in different sentence positions, with no fixed surrounding context
patterns.domain: Cross-disciplinary English, including medical abstracts, patent background, Wikipedia, and lifestyle guides

patterns.name: Noun complex meaning molecular complex
patterns.context: complex is a noun referring to a complex associated with molecules, receptors, or immune substances, often in contexts of extraction, testing, or analysis

patterns.name: No clear shared trigger pattern
patterns.context: Only the word’s occurrence is shared; there are no other identifiable common semantic or contextual features

1_2051.description: 最稳定的触发是词形 complex：既指复杂的情形、对象或过程，也作名词指分子复合物；跨文体出现，局部语义随领域变化。

patterns.name: complex 及其形态
patterns.context: 词形 complex 作形容词或名词，修饰系统、病情、过程、关系或居住设施；出现在句中不同位置，前后文并不固定
patterns.domain: 跨学科英语，包括医学摘要、专利背景、维基百科及生活指南

patterns.name: 名词 complex 表示分子复合物
patterns.context: complex 作名词，指与分子、受体或免疫物质相关的复合物，常出现在提取、检测或分析的语境中

patterns.name: 未见明显共同触发模式
patterns.trigger: 标记词均为 «complex»10，但词义及局部搭配与其他段不一致
patterns.context: 仅有该词的出现，缺少可确认的其他共享语义或上下文特征

en.concept: The word complex and its multiple senses
en.description: All fragments activate on complex: most are nouns in domain-specific terms meaning a compound, complex, or assembly, including a fluoride salt and a housing complex; one instance is the adjective meaning complicated.

patterns.name: “complex” with preceding modifiers
patterns.context: The noun complex occurs in various grammatical positions, often modified by a specialized name or constituent; in some contexts it refers to a molecular or protein complex, and may also refer to salts, a housing complex, or complex considerations.
patterns.domain: Patents, encyclopedic texts, medical and biological papers; mainly technical noun phrases

patterns.name: complex at the end of a term
patterns.context: A compound term or proper name ends in complex; the preceding words specify the components, type, or object of the complex.
patterns.domain: Mainly life-sciences terminology, also chemistry, materials/patents, and architecture-related terminology

patterns.name: Adjective complex meaning complicated
patterns.context: complex is an adjective modifying considerations, describing the considerations involved in handling methanol required for induction during scale-up fermentation.

1_2051.concept: complex 一词及其多义用法
1_2051.description: 全部片段均在 complex 处激活：多数是各领域术语中表示复合物、复合体或组合体的名词，也包括氟化物盐、住宅群；另有一次形容词“复杂的”。

patterns.name: “complex”及其前置修饰语
patterns.trigger: «complex»10；前置词包括“complex fluoride salts”“residential complex”“(NADH-PMS-NBT) complex”“complex and potentially expensive considerations”“NDH-1M complex”“horseradish peroxidase complex”“nuclear pore complex”“GP IIb/IIIa complex”“avidin biotin complex”“PanZ·RCoA complex”
patterns.context: 多种语法位置中的名词 complex，常由专业名称或组成成分修饰；在部分语境中指分子/蛋白复合物，也可指盐类、住宅群或复杂考量。
patterns.domain: 专利、百科、医学与生物学论文；以技术性名词短语为主

patterns.name: 术语边界处的 complex
patterns.context: 复合术语或专名末尾以 complex 收束；前面的词限定复合物的成分、类型或对象。
patterns.domain: 主要为生命科学术语，也包括化学、材料/专利和建筑相关术语

patterns.name: 形容词 complex 表示复杂的
patterns.context: complex 作形容词，修饰 considerations，描述规模化发酵时诱导所需甲醇带来的处理考量。
patterns.domain: 生物工艺专利背景文字

en.description: Primarily responds to the spelling sequence supers, covering supersede, superseding, and supersedeas in legal texts, and supersomes in biomedicine; also activates on “ઇન્ટરનેટ” and “શેર” in a Gujarati passage, which does not fit the main pattern.

patterns.name: The word fragment supers
patterns.context: Activation centers on the beginning or interior of words starting with supers; these include both uninterrupted spellings and forms split by corpus tokenization markers.

patterns.name: Gujarati social vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears in Gujarati text following the Github string stream_notification_disable_button, with no clear connection to the legal root supers.

1_2051.description: 主要对 supers 拼写序列有反应，覆盖法律中的 supersede、superseding、supersedeas，以及生物医学中的 supersomes；另在一段 Gujarati 文本中激活于“ઇન્ટરનેટ”“શેર”，与主模式不符。

patterns.name: 单词片段 supers
patterns.context: 激活集中在以 supers 开头的词内部或词首；既包括普通连续拼写，也包括语料分词标记切开的形式。
patterns.domain: 法律文本与生物医学摘要

patterns.name: Gujarati 社交词汇
patterns.context: 出现在 Github 字符串 stream_notification_disable_button 后的 Gujarati 文本中，与法律词根 supers 无明显联系。
patterns.domain: 代码字符串及 Gujarati 文本

en.concept: Recognition of the раз subword fragment
en.description: The most stable common feature across the segments is the fragment «раз», often at the beginning of Russian or Bulgarian words as a prefix; the triggered words vary in meaning and style. Segments 9 and 10 also mark other internal word fragments, whose specific connection is uncertain.

patterns.name: Russian root раз-
patterns.context: The activation marker falls within a Russian or Bulgarian word beginning with раз, usually immediately after the prefix; meanings and grammatical functions vary considerably.
patterns.domain: Russian StackExchange, Russian Wikipedia, Bulgarian EuroParl

patterns.name: Localized activation in other раз-containing forms
patterns.context: In segments 9 and 10, markers also fall within Russian words but do not mark a complete initial раз-; this may relate to participles, tokenization, or context, and it is unclear whether it belongs to the main pattern.

1_2051.description: 各段最稳定的共同点是片段 «раз»，常位于俄语或保加利亚语词首并构成前缀；触发词语义与文体多样。第9、10段还标出其他词内片段，具体关联不确定。

patterns.name: 俄语词根 раз-
patterns.trigger: « раз»10ных», « раз»10местить», « раз»10витие», « раз»10виване», « раз»10война», « раз»10делитель», « раз»10поредби»
patterns.context: 激活标记落在俄语或保加利亚语中以 раз 开头的词内，通常紧接该词前缀；词义与语法功能差异很大。
patterns.domain: 俄语 StackExchange、俄语 Wikipedia、保加利亚语 EuroParl

patterns.name: 其他带-раз词形中的局部激活
patterns.context: 第9、10段的标记也落在俄语词内部，但未标出完整的 раз- 词首；可能与分词、切分或上下文有关，不能确定是否属于主模式。

en.description: The most stable pattern is strong activation on the “раз” fragment in various Slavic words, including forms meaning development, difference, regulation, and separator. There are also weaker isolated activations for Polish “świętego” and English “essential”.

patterns.name: The “раз” stem in Slavic words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the “раз” stem fragment in Cyrillic or Latin transliteration; subsequent forms and meanings vary, with no required syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Bulgarian parliamentary text, Russian Q&A/encyclopedia, and programming text

patterns.name: Fragment in Polish religious text
patterns.context: Activation appears in Polish biblical/liturgical text, in religious titles such as “Listu świętego Pawła”; it has no clear morphological correspondence with the other highly activated fragments.
patterns.domain: Polish religious text (content hosted on Github)

patterns.name: Fragment in English Jainism vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears in the explanation of Jainism’s “six essential duties”; the word recurs, but activation is moderate, with other low-intensity markers nearby.

1_2051.description: 最稳定的模式是多种斯拉夫语词中“раз”片段的强激活，涵盖发展、不同、规定、分隔符等词形。另有波兰语“świętego”和英文“essential”的较弱孤立激活。

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语词中的“раз”词干
patterns.context: 激活落在西里尔或拉丁转写的“раз”词干片段上；后续词形和词义各异，不要求特定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 保加利亚语议会文本、俄语问答/百科及编程文本

patterns.name: 波兰语宗教文本中的片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在波兰语圣经/礼仪文字中，处于“Listu świętego Pawła”等宗教称谓里；与其余高激活片段无明显词形对应。
patterns.domain: 波兰语宗教文本（Github 收录内容）

patterns.name: 英语 Jainism 词汇中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Jainism 的“six essential duties”说明中；该词重复出现，但激活仅为中等，附近有其他低强度标记。

en.description: Responds mainly to the Cyrillic initial fragment «раз», covering a range of meanings in Russian and Bulgarian; also responds clearly to the Polish initial fragment «ś». The remaining marked activations show no stable common pattern.

patterns.name: Cyrillic initial «раз»
patterns.context: A Russian or Bulgarian word begins with «раз»; the examples cover different meanings and word forms, not just one fixed collocation.
patterns.domain: Russian/Bulgarian; technical Q&A, encyclopedic texts, European Parliament texts

patterns.name: Polish initial «ś»
patterns.context: A Polish word begins with «ś» with an acute accent; examples occur in religious and parliamentary texts.
patterns.domain: Polish; Github texts, European Parliament texts

1_2051.concept: 不同语言的特定词首片段
1_2051.description: 主要响应西里尔语词首「раз」，在俄语、保加利亚语中涵盖多种词义；另对波兰语词首「ś」有明显响应。其余标记激活未呈现稳定共同模式。

patterns.name: 西里尔语「раз」词首
patterns.context: 俄语或保加利亚语词语以「раз」开头；涵盖不同词义和词形，并非只限于某个固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 俄语/保加利亚语；技术问答、百科、欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 波兰语「ś」词首
patterns.context: 波兰语词以带尖音符的「ś」开头；分别出现在宗教文本和议会文本中。
patterns.domain: 波兰语；Github 文本、欧洲议会文本

en.description: Primarily responds to the in-word substring「раз」in Cyrillic text across varied word forms and styles; also responds to different words beginning with「ś」in two Polish passages, which cannot be explained by the main pattern.

patterns.name: Bulgarian root -раз-
patterns.context: 「раз」appears as a contiguous in-word substring in passages; following suffixes and sentence meanings vary, with no fixed syntactic position required
patterns.domain: Bulgarian political texts, technical Q&A, and other texts; also found in Russian word forms

patterns.name: Polish święt- word form
patterns.context: In Polish religious text, the activation marker falls on the initial letter ś of świętymi

patterns.name: Polish środk- word form
patterns.context: In a Polish sentence, the activation marker falls on the initial letter ś of środkami
patterns.domain: Polish EuroParl text discussing funds needed for biodiversity

1_2051.concept: 多语种特定字母串检测
1_2051.description: 主要响应西里尔文字中的词内子串「раз」，跨多种词形和文体；另在两段波兰语中响应以「ś」开头的不同词，二者不能由主模式解释。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词根-раз-
patterns.context: 片段中「раз」作为词内连续子串出现；后续词尾和句子含义多样，不要求固定句法位置
patterns.domain: 保加利亚语政治文本、技术问答及其他文本；也见俄语词形

patterns.name: 波兰语 święt- 词形
patterns.context: 波兰语宗教语句中，激活标记落在 świętymi 的首字母 ś
patterns.domain: Github 中的波兰语宗教文本

patterns.name: 波兰语 środk- 词形
patterns.context: 波兰语句子中，激活标记落在 środkami 的首字母 ś
patterns.domain: EuroParl 波兰语文本，讨论生物多样性所需资金

en.description: Mostly activates in several different Bulgarian words beginning with “раз”; also occurs on the shared stem of English flattening, and once in a Russian template description, on the initial parts of шаблона and разделитель.

patterns.name: Bulgarian forms related to the stem “раз”
patterns.context: Activation falls within Bulgarian words beginning with “раз”; meanings and full word forms vary.
patterns.domain: EuroParl policy texts, also Wikipedia and StackExchange

patterns.name: English flattening stem
patterns.context: Activation falls in English “flattening,” referring either to flattening of the lumbar curve or flattening of a band structure.
patterns.domain: Legal medical records, condensed-matter physics papers

patterns.name: Russian template and delimiter description
patterns.context: The word “шаблона” and a description of a delimiter after a template; activation also falls on the initial “раз” in “разделитель.”

1_2051.description: 主要激活在保加利亚语多个以“раз”开头的不同词中；另有英语 flattening 的共同词干，且一次俄语模板说明中也激活于 шаблона 及 разделитель 的词首。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词干“раз”相关
patterns.context: 激活落在保加利亚语中以“раз”开头的词内部；词义和完整词形各异。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 政策文本，也出现于维基百科、StackExchange

patterns.name: 英语 flattening 词干
patterns.context: 激活落在英语“flattening”中，涉及腰椎曲线变平或能带变平两种语义。
patterns.domain: 法律医学记录、凝聚态物理论文

patterns.name: 俄语模板与分隔符说明
patterns.context: 词语“шаблона”及关于模板后分隔符的说明；激活另落在“разделитель”中的“раз”词首。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the legal title “Defender” for attorneys, especially Public Defender and variants such as Federal, County, and Appellate; also activates on the personal title “the Defender of Gibraltar” in a book catalog.

patterns.name: Public Defender title
patterns.context: Appears in attorney lists or counsel descriptions in legal rulings, usually preceded by an institutional or rank modifier and followed by appointed, a possessive, a name, or a comma
patterns.domain: U.S. court rulings, appellate opinions, and attorney lists

patterns.name: Defender in book catalogs
patterns.context: A personal title in a book catalog entry, referring to the Defender of Gibraltar; not a legal professional title

1_2051.description: 主要对法律文本中律师职衔“Defender”强烈响应，尤其 Public Defender 及其 Federal、County、Appellate 等变体；另对书目中人物称号“the Defender of Gibraltar”激活。

patterns.name: Public Defender 职衔
patterns.context: 出现在法律判决的律师名单或代理人介绍中，通常前接机构或职级修饰语，后接 appointed、所有格、姓名或逗号
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、上诉意见及律师名单

patterns.name: 书名目录中的 Defender
patterns.context: 作为书籍目录条目中的人物称号，指直布罗陀的 Defender；不是法律职业职衔

en.concept: Internal word fragments and Cys markers
en.description: Activation falls mainly on internal fragments after the Bulgarian “раз” stem and after Cys residue markers in biomedical texts; other examples include NEGLIGENCE in a legal disclaimer, adjoined in a real-estate document, and coffins in an architectural description, with no shared meaning or stylistic pattern established.

patterns.name: Subword activation within Slavic stems
patterns.context: In Bulgarian texts, the marker falls after the stem “раз” and before the word ending; all three segments occur within longer words, not on an independent word at sentence start.

patterns.name: Cys residues and disulfide-bond contexts
patterns.context: The activation marker falls after Cys and concerns cysteine residues, Cys-Cys chemistry, or protein motifs; in some examples, a number or hyphen immediately follows Cys.

patterns.name: Uppercase OR in a legal disclaimer
patterns.context: An all-caps limitation-of-liability phrase in a legal clause; the marker falls on NEGLIGENCE, not OR.

patterns.name: adjoined in a legal property description
patterns.context: In a property valuation judgment describing adjoining parcels, activation occurs within the English word adjoined.

patterns.name: coffins in a funeral context
patterns.context: In a description of Roman architecture and the use of a funerary entrance, activation occurs within the English word coffins.

1_2051.description: 激活主要落在保加利亚语“раз”词干后的词内片段，以及生物医学文本中 Cys 残基标记后；另见法律免责声明的 NEGLIGENCE、地产文书的 adjoined、建筑说明的 coffins，未能归为共同词义或文体模式。

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语词干中段的分词激活
patterns.context: 保加利亚语文本中，标记落在词干“раз”之后、词尾之前；三段都出现在较长词内，并非句首独立词。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，保加利亚语政治/政策文本

patterns.name: Cys 残基及二硫键语境
patterns.context: 激活标记落在 Cys 后，涉及半胱氨酸残基、Cys-Cys 化学或蛋白质基序；部分例子中 Cys 后紧接数字或连字符。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与蛋白质科学论文

patterns.name: 法律免责声明中的大写 OR
patterns.context: 法律条款中的全大写责任限制用语；标记落在 NEGLIGENCE，而非 OR。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 电子书法律免责声明

patterns.name: 法律地产描述中的 adjoined
patterns.context: 地产估值判决描述相邻地块时，激活位于英文单词 adjoined 的词内。

patterns.name: 葬礼相关的 coffins
patterns.context: 描述罗马建筑及葬礼入口用途时，激活位于英文单词 coffins 的词内。

en.description: Primarily responds to the split-written tambourine/tambourica stem and uppercase or nearly uppercase NEGLIGENCE in legal disclaimers; a few highlights fall on place names, personal names, or entry terms, which cannot be explained by these two patterns.

patterns.name: tambourine-related words
patterns.context: The word is split into a part beginning with tamb, followed by ourine/ourica; appears in contexts such as musical instruments, band members, and song descriptions.
patterns.domain: Music reviews and band profiles, ethnomusic introductions

patterns.name: negligence in legal disclaimers
patterns.context: Appears in disclaimers, damages, and liability clauses, often alongside words such as damages, liability, contract, and tort; the second passage also contains «REMEDIES FOR» before negligence.
patterns.domain: Legal disclaimers, software licenses, and liability clauses

patterns.name: Unexplained local collocations
patterns.context: These highlighted passages occur in personal names, place names, or entry text; the available context is insufficient to establish a connection to the main trigger patterns.

1_2051.description: 主要响应拆分书写的 tambourine/tambourica 词干，以及法律免责条款中大写或近似大写的 NEGLIGENCE；少数高亮落在地名、人名或条目词上，无法由这两类模式解释。

patterns.name: tambourine相关词
patterns.context: 词被拆分为以 tamb 开头、后接 ourine/ourica；出现在乐器、乐队人员、歌曲描述等语境。
patterns.domain: 音乐评论与乐队资料、民族音乐介绍

patterns.name: 法律免责声明中的 negligence
patterns.context: 出现在免责、损害赔偿及责任条款中，常与 damages、liability、contract、tort 等词同现；第2段还出现 negligence 前的 «REMEDIES FOR»。
patterns.domain: 法律免责声明、软件许可及责任条款

patterns.name: 未解释的局部搭配
patterns.context: 这些高亮片段分别处于人名、地名或条目文本中；现有上下文不足以确认它们与主要触发模式相关。

en.description: Activation often falls on letter fragments or short words after tokenization: the abbreviation GN, place and personal names, institutional name fragments, and several English initial fragments; the contexts are diverse and resist a unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: GN character sequence
patterns.context: GN as an abbreviation or part of a name, with subsequent characters tokenized separately; occurs in proper names, technical terminology, and method names
patterns.domain: Sports, medicine, forum discussions, numerical methods

patterns.name: English initial letter fragments
patterns.context: In Latvian institutional names, words are tokenized into an initial segment and a remainder; activation falls on several initial fragments
patterns.domain: Latvian text containing EU institutional names

patterns.name: Internal fragments in place names
patterns.context: Partial tokens in place or street names; occur in addresses in legal texts, and in place names in category entries and architectural restoration descriptions
patterns.domain: Legal judgments, encyclopedic categories, architecture and heritage descriptions

patterns.name: Internal letter fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on initial fragments of common English words, occurring in a category term, a verb in a legal text, and a noun in a construction description; there is no shared semantic context

patterns.name: Token fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Token fragments from the name Katy Bryce, split in an author biography

patterns.name: Fragments adjacent to numbers
patterns.context: Numbers as part of a street address or parcel area; activation occurs only in legal real-estate descriptions

patterns.name: Academic word-initial fragment
patterns.context: An initial fragment of the long technical word “electrophysiological” in a medical abstract

1_2051.description: 激活多落在分词后的字母片段或短词上：GN 缩写、地名/人名、机构名片段及若干英语词首片段；不同语境分散，难以由统一语义解释。

patterns.name: GN 字母串
patterns.trigger: « GN»10 后接数字/字母，如“GN»10FL”“GN»1011”“GN»10OME”；另有“GN»9 method”
patterns.context: GN 作为缩写或名称的一部分，后续字符被分词为独立 token；出现在专名、技术术语及方法名称中
patterns.domain: 体育、医学、论坛讨论、数值方法

patterns.name: 英语词首字母片段
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语机构名称中，词语被分词为首段与后续部分；激活落在若干词首片段上
patterns.domain: 欧盟机构名称的拉脱维亚语文本

patterns.name: 地名词内片段
patterns.context: 地名或街道名的部分 token；分别出现在法律文本中的地址，以及分类条目、建筑修复介绍中的地名
patterns.domain: 法律判决、百科分类、建筑与遗产介绍

patterns.name: 词内字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在常见英语词的词首片段，分别位于分类词、法律文本中的动词和建筑施工描述中的名词；没有共同语义上下文

patterns.name: 人名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 人名 Katy Bryce 被拆分的 token 片段，处于作者简介中

patterns.name: 数值邻接片段
patterns.context: 数字作为街道地址或地块面积的一部分；激活只出现在法律地产描述中

patterns.name: 学术词尾片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要中长技术词“electrophysiological”的词首片段

en.concept: Difficult to unify; favors specific word forms
en.description: Activations mainly fall on legal prohibition terms enjoined/enjoining; there are also strong activations on the coff stem in coffins and on screw (including screw it up), the latter two appearing respectively in burial accounts and technical or colloquial contexts.

patterns.name: Injunction and judicial prohibition terms
patterns.context: Appears in court rulings or legal discussions describing a court prohibiting a party or government from continuing an action, enforcing a law, or carrying out a project; often co-occurs with “court,” “restrained,” “from,” and “enforcement.”

patterns.name: coffins stem
patterns.context: Appears in accounts related to funerals, burial, or body transport; the stem is split in the annotation, and the complete word is「coffins」.

patterns.name: screw and screw it up
patterns.context: One occurrence is the noun「screw」in an orthopedic screw patent text; another is the verb in the colloquial phrase「screw it up」. They share only spelling, not meaning or context.
patterns.domain: Patent technical text; colloquial HackerNews comments

1_2051.concept: 难以统一；偏向特定词形
1_2051.description: 激活主要落在法律禁令词 enjoined/enjoining；另对 coffins 中的 coff 词干及 screw（含 screw it up）有强激活，后两类分别见于埋葬叙述和技术、口语语境。

patterns.name: injunction及司法禁令用语
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决或法律论述中，描述法院禁止当事人或政府继续行动、执行法律或开展项目；常与「court」「restrained」「from」「enforcement」等同现。

patterns.name: coffins 词干
patterns.context: 出现在葬礼、埋葬或尸体运输相关叙述中；词干被拆分标注，完整词为「coffins」。

patterns.name: screw 及 screw it up
patterns.context: 一处是骨科螺钉专利文本中的名词「screw」，另一处是口语短语「screw it up」中的动词；仅有共同字形，语义和语境不同。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本；HackerNews 口语评论

en.description: The strongest and repeated trigger is the place name Cornwall, which occurs across varied contexts; weaker or isolated highlights include York, Butterfield, Canal, and Chart, appearing to be triggers of different word forms or subwords that cannot reliably be grouped into one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Place name Cornwall
patterns.context: The place name Cornwall occurs in people categories, literary narrative, church locations, architectural restoration accounts, hospital names, and structured addresses; sometimes it appears with York but also occurs alone.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic entries, novels, local reporting, news, structured webpages, etc.

patterns.name: York-related place names
patterns.context: Cornwall and York appear together, or York occurs in place-name contexts such as location categories and addresses; activation is weaker and differs from the strong Cornwall trigger.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic entries, historical narrative, category texts

patterns.name: Butterfield string
patterns.context: Occurs in a park name in an event announcement; strong activation falls on a token fragment of Butterfield.

patterns.name: Canal in a nautical context
patterns.context: Mentions sailing, towing, and passage through the Panama Canal; strong activation falls on Canal.

patterns.name: Chart category word
patterns.context: Appears at the end of a chart name in an account of music sales and singles rankings.

patterns.name: Isolated activations not identifiable from highlighted words
patterns.context: Each occurs in only one segment, and the highlighted portion provides insufficient evidence of a stable trigger pattern shared with other segments.

1_2051.description: 最强且重复的触发是地名 Cornwall，跨多种语境均出现；另有较弱或孤立的 York、Butterfield、Canal、Chart 等高亮，像是不同词形或子词触发，不能可靠归并为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: Cornwall地名
patterns.context: 地名 Cornwall 出现在人物分类、文学叙述、教堂所在地、建筑修复经历、医院名称及结构化地址等不同上下文中；有时与 York 连用，但也单独出现。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、小说、地方报道、新闻、结构化网页等

patterns.name: York相关地名
patterns.context: Cornwall 与 York 并列，或出现在地点分类、地址等地名语境中；激活较弱且与强烈的 Cornwall 触发不同。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、历史叙述、分类文本

patterns.name: Butterfield字符串
patterns.context: 出现在演出公告的公园名称中；强激活落在 Butterfield 的分词片段上。

patterns.name: 航海运河语境
patterns.context: 提及航行、拖带及穿越巴拿马运河；强激活落在 Canal。

patterns.name: 排行榜类别词
patterns.context: 音乐发行量与单曲排名叙述中，出现在榜单名称末尾。
patterns.domain: 音乐传记或唱片成绩叙述

patterns.name: 无法由高亮词判定的离散激活
patterns.context: 各自仅在单段中出现，且高亮部分没有足够证据构成与其他段共享的稳定触发模式。
patterns.domain: 结构化网页字段（7）；演出公告缩写（8）

en.description: Across all passages, the strongest activation occurs on Canal, usually referring to a canal or canal district; there are also proper-name uses in anatomical duct names, the horse name Canaletto, and Canal Rest House.

patterns.name: Canal (waterway)
patterns.context: The token Canal itself is a strong trigger across all passages; it is usually part of a proper name referring to a canal, waterway, canal district, or related facility.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic or explanatory texts about geography, transport, history, law, sports lists, and other topics

patterns.name: Bridges and waterway geography around canals
patterns.context: The canal is part of a bridge crossing, nearby water system, or geographic route; in some passages, Canal is part of a compound proper name.

patterns.name: Canals as historical transport and trade infrastructure
patterns.context: Canals appear alongside construction, freight, migration history, or shipping routes.
patterns.domain: Local history, transport history, and geographic encyclopedias

patterns.name: Panama Canal and Canal Zone
patterns.context: Contexts concerning the Panama Canal, the Canal Zone, vessel passage, treaties, or territorial jurisdiction.

patterns.name: Anatomical duct names
patterns.context: Canal appears in the proper name of a body structure, not a waterway; the other nearby entries are also anatomical terms.

patterns.name: Canaletto in a racehorse name
patterns.context: The activation falls on the substring Canal in the horse name Canaletto, not on the waterway meaning.

patterns.name: Canal Rest House facility name
patterns.context: Canal and Rest House form a facility name; surrounding text gives information about people’s positions and village locations.

1_2051.description: 所有片段都在 Canal 上出现最强激活，通常指运河或运河区；另有解剖学管道名、马名 Canaletto 和 Canal Rest House 等专名用法。

patterns.name: Canal（交通水道）
patterns.context: token Canal 本身是所有片段的强触发点；多为专名的一部分，指运河、航道、运河区或相关设施。
patterns.domain: 地理、交通、历史、法律、体育名单等百科或说明性文本

patterns.name: 运河周边的桥梁与水道地理
patterns.context: 运河作为桥梁跨越对象、邻近水系或地理路线的一部分；有些段落的 Canal 是复合专名。
patterns.domain: 交通基础设施与地理描述

patterns.name: 运河作为历史交通与贸易设施
patterns.context: 运河与修建、货运、移民史或航运路线共同出现。
patterns.domain: 地方史、交通史与地理百科

patterns.name: 巴拿马运河及运河区
patterns.context: 巴拿马运河、运河区及船只通行、条约或领土管辖语境。

patterns.name: 解剖学中的管道名称
patterns.context: Canal 出现在人体结构专名中，而非水道；其余附近条目也是解剖学术语。

patterns.name: 赛马专名中的 Canaletto
patterns.context: 激活落在马名 Canaletto 的子串 Canal 上，并非运河含义。

patterns.name: Canal Rest House 地名设施
patterns.context: Canal 与 Rest House 构成设施名称，周边是人物任职和村镇地点信息。
patterns.domain: 人物传记、地方地名介绍

en.concept: Canal and transportation terms in proper names
en.description: The strongest activations cluster around Canal and named waterways. Other triggers include maritime terms tow/tug, the abbreviation OM, and scattered list, horse-racing, and transportation-history names; these do not form a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: The word Canal and proper names containing it
patterns.context: In proper names, place names, or historical-geography accounts, especially when Canal is followed by a proper name or appears in a waterway name; also found in Guyon's Canal.

patterns.name: Terms related to tugboat towing
patterns.context: In accounts of ships in distress, towing rescues, or tugboat fees, tow/towage and tug occur together or in related contexts.
patterns.domain: Maritime narratives, customs and legal texts

patterns.name: The string OM
patterns.context: OM appears in an uppercase abbreviation or company name; it appears once in a code symbol and once in a corporate name.

patterns.name: Proper names and entry-list formatting
patterns.context: Proper names, surgery names, or organization names are listed consecutively in titles or entries; no consistent lexical trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Horse-racing proper names
patterns.context: In horse-racing coverage, activation falls on fragments of the names of competing horses.

patterns.name: Railway history accounts
patterns.context: In accounts of the history of British railway closures, Beeching cuts are mentioned.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in place or route names
patterns.context: A segmented place-name or road-term fragment appears near road numbers or route names.

1_2051.concept: 专名中的 Canal 及交通词
1_2051.description: 最显著触发集中于 Canal 及专名航道；另有 tow/tug 海事词、OM 缩写，以及若干分散的列表、赛马和交通史名称触发，无法归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: Canal 一词及其专名
patterns.context: 在专名、地名或历史地理叙述中，尤其是 Canal 后接专名或处于航道名称中；也见于 Guyon's Canal。

patterns.name: 拖船牵引相关词
patterns.context: 船舶遇险、拖带救援或拖船费用的叙述中，tow/towage 与 tug 相邻或相关。
patterns.domain: 海事叙事、海关法律文本

patterns.name: OM 字母串
patterns.context: 大写缩写或公司名称内部出现 OM；在代码符号和企业名称中各出现一次。

patterns.name: 专名及词条列表格式
patterns.context: 标题或条目式列表中连续列出专名、手术名称或组织名称；未见统一的词义触发条件。

patterns.name: 赛马专名
patterns.context: 赛马赛事报道中，激活落在参赛马匹名称的片段上。

patterns.name: 铁路历史叙述
patterns.context: 英国铁路关闭史叙述中，提及 Beeching cuts。

patterns.name: 地名或路线名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 道路编号或路线名称附近出现被切分的地名／道路词片段。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on names or terms containing Huss (Hussain, Husserl, Hussars, etc.), and also respond clearly to the complete word overtime; the latter spans legal, poetic, and explanatory contexts, with no clear semantic connection between the two.

patterns.name: Huss- stem and proper names
patterns.context: Names, a philosopher’s surname, or a military unit name beginning with Huss; subsequent spellings vary and may span tokens
patterns.domain: Biographies, philosophical bibliographies, historical/military accounts, and web text

patterns.name: overtime word form
patterns.context: The complete word appears in wage/damages items or in general accounts such as poetry or superstition
patterns.domain: Legal documents, poetry, popular explanatory prose

1_2051.description: 激活主要集中于含 Huss 的人名或词项（Hussain、Husserl、Hussars 等），也明显响应完整词 overtime；后者跨法律、诗歌和说明文语境，二者未见明确语义联系。

patterns.name: Huss-词干与专名
patterns.context: 出现以 Huss 开头的姓名、哲学家姓氏或军团名称；后续拼写各异，可能跨 token
patterns.domain: 人物传记、哲学书目、历史/军事叙述及网页文本

patterns.name: overtime 词形
patterns.context: 完整词出现在工资/损害项目中，或诗歌、迷信等一般叙述中
patterns.domain: 法律文书、诗歌、通俗说明文

en.concept: Proper names and structured names in formal documents
en.description: The strongest recurring pattern is “Regiment” in formal military-unit names, often accompanied by a unit number, branch, or historical context. Another pattern is a legal case heading formatted with a court, case number, and date.

patterns.name: Regiment in military-unit names
patterns.context: Formal regiment names appear in accounts of military organizations or biographies of historical figures, usually adjacent to a unit number, branch, or information about the parent force.
patterns.domain: Military history, biographies, encyclopedia entries, and historical documents

patterns.name: Court case headings and citation formats
patterns.context: A case heading or citation in a legal document; no clear Regiment trigger is present.

1_2051.concept: 正式文书中的专名与结构化名称
1_2051.description: 最强且反复出现的模式是军事单位正式名称中的“Regiment”，常伴番号、兵种或历史语境；另有一段法律案件抬头，呈现法院、案号和日期格式。

patterns.name: 军团名称中的 Regiment
patterns.trigger: «Regiment»9/10，前接编号、序数或部队名称，如“2nd Wisconsin Volunteer Infantry Regiment”“London Regiment”“10th Chasseurs à cheval Regiment”
patterns.context: 军事组织或历史人物传记中，出现正式军团名称；通常前后紧邻单位番号、兵种或所属部队信息。
patterns.domain: 军事史、人物传记、百科条目及历史文献

patterns.name: 法院案件标题与引文格式
patterns.trigger: “United States Bankruptcy Court”“No. 78-31799”“December 5, 1979”等法院名称、案号和日期
patterns.context: 法律文书的案件抬头或引用信息；未出现明显的 Regiment 触发词。

en.description: Activations cluster around several recurring word forms: Regiment, enlisted, rocking, and overtime. Other activations are scattered within words or on individual words across military history, literature, law, and patents, with no unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: enlisted
patterns.context: In accounts of people joining the military or a regiment; usually immediately followed by Army or the name of a military force.

patterns.name: Regiment
patterns.context: Regiment occurs in a military-unit name; it is often preceded by an ordinal, place name, or unit number, and may be followed by information about military organization.
patterns.domain: Military history, organizational or ceremonial records

patterns.name: rocking
patterns.context: Describes an object or person swaying or shaking continuously, or figuratively “having a great time”; contexts include branches moving and life on social media.

patterns.name: overtime
patterns.context: The word overtime occurs in a legal claim about wages or in a rhyming poem; the same word form recurs across genres.

patterns.name: Other locally high-activation words
patterns.context: Each occurs within a different word or proper name: Territorial, Staffordshire, edible, suspire, indeed; there is no shared clear context.
patterns.domain: Military history, ceremonial catalogs, patent texts, poetry

1_2051.description: 激活集中在若干重复词形：Regiment、enlisted、rocking、overtime；另有分散的词内片段或单词高激活，跨军事史、文学、法律、专利等语境，未见统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: enlisted
patterns.context: 人物加入军队或军团的叙述中；通常紧接 Army 或军队名称。

patterns.name: Regiment
patterns.context: 军事单位名称中出现 Regiment；前面常有序数、地名或番号，后面可接军队编制信息。
patterns.domain: 军事史、编制或典礼记录

patterns.name: rocking
patterns.context: 描述物体或人物持续摆动、摇晃，或比喻性地“过得精彩”；上下文分别是树枝摇动和社交媒体上的生活。

patterns.name: overtime
patterns.context: 词语 overtime 出现在劳动工资法律主张或押韵诗句中；相同词形跨文体重复。

patterns.name: 其他局部高激活词
patterns.context: 各自处于不同词语或专名内部：Territorial、Staffordshire、edible、suspire、indeed；没有共同的清晰语境。
patterns.domain: 军事史、典礼目录、专利文本、诗歌

en.description: High activations fall respectively on a fragment of vulnerable, the beginning of the proper name Quad, the place name Cornwall, and a Portuguese corre- fragment; these word forms belong to different contexts, with no common semantics or stable syntactic condition.

patterns.name: vulneráveis
patterns.context: In Portuguese, describes people or infrastructure that are susceptible to harm or in a vulnerable state; the word is split in the annotation.
patterns.domain: European Parliament political texts, philosophical discussions

patterns.name: Quad names
patterns.context: Part of proper names: Quad-channel, Quad City, QuadSport; names span word boundaries or include hyphens.
patterns.domain: Hardware specifications, U.S. law, motorcycle advertising

patterns.name: Cornwall place name
patterns.context: The proper name Cornwall; one passage is a place name, and another is a historical account about the place.
patterns.domain: Historical figures and local history, encyclopedias

patterns.name: False-positive word endings
patterns.context: Portuguese words beginning with corre- are split; the high activation falls on an identically spelled fragment, but the continuations form correta and correio respectively.

1_2051.description: 高激活分别落在 vulnerable 的词片、Quad 专名开头、Cornwall 地名，以及葡语 corre- 词片；这些词形分属不同语境，未见共同语义或稳定句法条件。

patterns.name: vulneráveis
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中形容人群或基础设施容易受损、处于脆弱状态；词被拆分标记。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会政治文本、哲学论述

patterns.name: Quad 名称
patterns.context: 作为专名的一部分：Quad-channel、Quad City、QuadSport；跨越单词边界或连字符组成名称。
patterns.domain: 硬件规格、美国法律、摩托车广告

patterns.name: Cornwall 地名
patterns.context: 专名 Cornwall；一段是地名，一段是关于该地的历史叙述。
patterns.domain: 古籍人物与地方史、百科全书

patterns.name: 错误响应词尾
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中 corre- 开头的词被切分；高激活落在拼写相同的片段，但后续分别构成 correta 和 correio。
patterns.domain: 软件问答、欧洲议会发言

en.concept: Recognition of specific words and proper-name fragments
en.description: Activations cluster around four string fragments: Italian individ, English centrifug, medical carcin, and the proper-name fragment Yug. The first three are mostly word-initial fragments across word forms, while Yug appears in different proper names.

patterns.name: The substring “individ” and its word forms
patterns.context: In Italian sentences, a complete word is segmented, and activation falls on the root fragment “individ”; it occurs in contexts describing the determination of a region or the identification of an object
patterns.domain: EU Parliament texts, Italian academic writing

patterns.name: The substring “centrifug” and its word forms
patterns.context: In English technical texts describing centrifugal force or centrifugal microfluidic systems; activation falls on the word-initial fragment of centrifugal

patterns.name: The substring “carcin”
patterns.context: A word-initial fragment of carcinogen-related words in medical research texts; contexts involve carcinogens, DNA damage, or exposure

patterns.name: The proper-name fragment “Yug”
patterns.context: Occurs in proper names: the username Yugabyte in a code copyright notice and the Yu-Gi-Oh!-related name Yugi; in both cases, the activated fragment is “Yug”
patterns.domain: Code copyright notices, fan plot summaries

1_2051.concept: 特定词语与专名片段识别
1_2051.description: 激活集中于四类字符串片段：意大利语 individ、英语 centrifug、医学 carcin、专名 Yug；前三类多为跨词形的词首片段，Yug则出现在不同专名中。

patterns.name: 子串「individ」及其词形
patterns.context: 意大利语句中，完整词被拆分，激活落在词根片段「individ」；分别出现在描述确定区域或识别对象的语境中
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会文本、意大利语学术论述

patterns.name: 子串「centrifug」及其词形
patterns.context: 英语技术文本中，描述离心力或离心微流控系统；激活落在 centrifugal 的词首片段

patterns.name: 子串「carcin」
patterns.context: 医学研究文本中，作为 carcinogen（致癌物）相关词语的词首片段；涉及致癌物、DNA损伤或暴露

patterns.name: 专名片段「Yug」
patterns.context: 出现在专名中：代码版权声明里的用户名 Yugabyte，以及《游戏王》相关人名 Yugi；激活片段都在「Yug」
patterns.domain: 代码版权声明、粉丝剧情摘要

en.concept: Specific word forms and place-name fragments
en.description: Activations cluster around two types of word forms: Italian individ- (especially individuare/individuabile) and fragments related to the English place names Estonia/Tallinn. There is also one intraword fragment in Lust. The triggers span languages, corpora, and genres, and do not appear to form a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Italian word forms with individ-
patterns.context: Words containing the individ- stem are segmented; in Italian, individuare/individuabile is especially common, meaning to identify or determine.
patterns.domain: Italian parliamentary and philosophical texts; also English individualization terminology, covering [1][2][3][6][10]

patterns.name: Estonian place names and their stems
patterns.context: The geographic entities Estonia/Estonia or Tallinn, Estonia appear; the stem may be split across tokens.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedias, hotel promotions, sports coverage, public health research, covering [4][7][8][9]

patterns.name: An intraword fragment in lust
patterns.context: The English word Lust is segmented in a question heading about avoiding desire or sin.

1_2051.description: 激活集中于两类词形：意大利语 individ-（尤指 individuare/individuabile）及英语 Estonia/Tallinn 地名相关片段；另有一次 Lust 的词内片段。触发跨语言、语料与文体，不像单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 意大利语词形 individ-
patterns.context: 包含 individ- 词干的词被分词切开；意大利语中尤见 individuare/individuabile，意为识别、确定。
patterns.domain: 意大利语议会文本与哲学文本；另有英语个体化术语，覆盖 [1][2][3][6][10]

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚地名及其词干
patterns.context: 出现 Estonia/Estonia 或 Tallinn, Estonia 等地理实体；词干可能跨 token 切分。
patterns.domain: 英语百科、酒店促销、体育报道、公共卫生研究，覆盖 [4][7][8][9]

patterns.name: lust 的词内片段
patterns.context: 英语词 Lust 被切分，出现在关于避免欲望或罪的提问标题中。

en.description: Activations are scattered across languages and genres: descriptions of vulnerability, collapse, or being struck; place names such as Estonia; product straps; the periphery of a welded joint in a patent; legal entities and airport names; and code copyright holders. Apart from a few local word forms, there is no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Vulnerable, poor, or under-pressure states
patterns.context: Explicitly includes vulneráveis or describes vulnerability or a state of being under pressure through collapse or being struck; trigger words include Portuguese, Dutch, and other forms.

patterns.name: Estonia in place names
patterns.context: Estonia or a place name listed alongside it appears in a place-name or historical-geography account.

patterns.name: Straps
patterns.context: In product descriptions, strap refers to the strap of a bag or the head strap of a headset.

patterns.name: The periphery of a welded joint
patterns.context: A patent text describes the area, perimeter, or structure of a welded joint.

patterns.name: Legal case number and airline name
patterns.context: Describes the effects of a U.S. act taking effect on a specific company and airport.

patterns.name: Code copyright holder name
patterns.context: An organization name appears in the copyright notice at the beginning of a code file.

1_2051.description: 激活分散于多种语言和文体：脆弱、崩塌或受打击的描述；Estonia 等地名；商品肩带；专利焊接外周；法律实体与机场名称；代码版权主体。除少数局部词形外，缺乏统一语义触发点。

patterns.name: 脆弱、贫困或承压状态
patterns.trigger: « vulner»10áveis« da»1« soc»1iedade；« vulner»9áveis；« col»2apso；« kl»4appen
patterns.context: 明确出现 vulneráveis，或以崩塌、受打击描述脆弱对象或状态；触发词有葡语、荷语等形式。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、哲学文本

patterns.name: 地名中的 Estonia
patterns.context: 地名或历史地名叙述中出现 Estonia，或与之并列的地名。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科地理、人物传记

patterns.name: 肩带
patterns.context: 在商品描述中 strap 指包或头戴设备的肩带／头带。

patterns.name: 焊接部位的外周
patterns.trigger: « outer»2« periphery»9 of« each»1« wel»2ded portion
patterns.context: 专利文本描述焊接部位的面积、周边或结构。

patterns.name: 法律案号及航空公司名
patterns.context: 美国法案生效后，叙述其对特定公司及机场的影响。

patterns.name: 代码版权主体名称
patterns.context: 代码文件开头的版权声明中出现组织名称。

en.description: Strong activations span multiple languages and domains, mainly falling on several word-form fragments: Portuguese vulner, English cris, overtime, and the applic stem; enlisted also occurs. There is no single stable semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Portuguese vulneráveis stem
patterns.context: In Portuguese, describes people or things that are vulnerable or susceptible to harm; in [1] it refers to impoverished groups, and in [2] to house foundations. High activation falls on the stem vulner.

patterns.name: English crispy stem
patterns.context: In English food descriptions, describes a crisp texture; [3] is part of the name of a refrigerator crisper drawer, and [4] describes the texture of caramel popcorn.

patterns.name: overtime stem
patterns.context: In English accounts, appears in the fixed expression minds will work overtime, or in poetry where the author writes overtime; both involve exceeding the usual degree or continuing creative work, but the contexts differ.

patterns.name: English enlisted
patterns.context: A biographical account of joining or serving in the military, specifically participating in the Mexican–American War.

patterns.name: Italian applicare stem
patterns.context: In Italian or French contexts involving policies, rules, or instruments, means to implement, apply, or be applicable; the two occurrences concern applying rules and the applicability of regulations for measuring devices.
patterns.domain: EU Parliament policy texts, regulatory texts

patterns.name: English applicator
patterns.context: In a medical experimental method, refers to an instrument used to deliver sound; it is orthographically similar to the preceding applicare/applicables stems, but differs in meaning and language.

1_2051.description: 强激活覆盖多种语言和领域，主要落在若干词形片段：葡语 vulner、英语 cris、overtime，以及 applic 词干；另有 enlisted。没有单一稳定语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 葡语 vulneráveis 词干
patterns.context: 葡语中描述人群或事物容易受伤害、处于脆弱状态；在[1]指贫困群体，在[2]指房屋地基。高激活落在词干 vulner。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会文本；哲学/论述散文

patterns.name: 英语 crispy 词干
patterns.context: 英语食品介绍中描述食物的酥脆口感；[3]为冰箱保鲜抽屉名称的一部分，[4]为焦糖爆米花的口感描述。
patterns.domain: 产品说明、食品宣传文案

patterns.name: overtime 词干
patterns.context: 英语叙述中出现固定表达 minds will work overtime，或诗歌中作者写作 overtime；语义均涉及超出通常程度或持续创作，但语境不同。

patterns.name: 英语 enlisted
patterns.context: 人物传记叙述加入军队或服役，具体为参加美墨战争。

patterns.name: 意大利语 applicare 词干
patterns.context: 意大利语或法语中的政策、规则、器具等语境，表示实施、适用或可适用；两处分别是应用规则与适用测量装置法规。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会政策文本、法规文本

patterns.name: 英语 applicator
patterns.context: 医学实验方法中指用于传递声音的器具；与前述 applicare/applicables 词干在拼写上相似，但语义和语言不同。

en.concept: Multilingual subword fragments and string matching
en.description: Strong activations fall on a word-initial substring of Portuguese vulneráveis, the string Quad across proper names and compounds, and indul- in religious Q&A. The first two span multiple contexts, with no clear semantic connection between them.

patterns.name: Subword activation in Portuguese vulneráveis
patterns.context: Appears as a word-initial substring of the Portuguese word vulneráveis (“vulnerable”); once it refers to poorer, vulnerable people in society, and once to a weak house foundation.
patterns.domain: Portuguese political texts and philosophical writing

patterns.name: Quad string activation
patterns.context: Occurs in Quad strings with varying capitalization or in compounds: the proper name Yugabyte, Quad City, QuadSport, Quadri, as well as quadrant, Quad-channel, and Quad Core; following characters and meanings vary widely.
patterns.domain: Code comments, law, product marketing, Italian bibliographies, hardware specifications, chat

patterns.name: Religious sin and indulgence topics
patterns.context: Occurs in Q&A about Hinduism and desire, referring to discussions of sin, especially sins related to indulgence.

1_2051.concept: 多语种词片段与字符串匹配
1_2051.description: 强激活分别落在葡语 vulneráveis 的词首子串、跨专名与复合词的 Quad 字符串，以及宗教问答中的 indul-；前两者各跨多种上下文，彼此语义联系不明。

patterns.name: 葡语 vulneráveis 的分词激活
patterns.context: 作为葡萄牙语单词 vulneráveis（“脆弱的”）的词首子串出现；一次指社会中较贫困、脆弱的人群，一次指房屋地基脆弱。
patterns.domain: 葡语政治文本与哲学论述

patterns.name: Quad 字符串激活
patterns.context: 出现在不同大小写或复合形式的 Quad 字符串中：专名 Yugabyte、Quad City、QuadSport、Quadri，以及 quadrant、Quad-channel、Quad Core；后续字符和语义差异很大。
patterns.domain: 代码注释、法律、产品宣传、意大利语书目、硬件规格、聊天

patterns.name: 宗教罪与纵欲话题
patterns.context: 出现在有关印度教与欲望的问答中，指向对罪、尤其与纵欲相关之罪的讨论。

en.concept: Specific word forms and license-marker detection
en.description: The main responses are to vulneráveis, BSD license contexts, and the word form Beauties; weaker activations also occur on copyright-notice wording and several isolated words. The patterns span Portuguese, code and legal texts, and English encyclopedias, with no single semantic theme.

patterns.name: The word form vulneráveis
patterns.context: In Portuguese, describes poor or vulnerable groups, or a weak house foundation; the trigger is the word form vulneráveis

patterns.name: BSD license marker
patterns.context: BSD appears in software copyright headers, license notices, or legal clauses; not all words surrounding BSD activate equally

patterns.name: The word form Beauties
patterns.context: Beauties appears in English texts, used in a book title/list of people and in a description of a historical figure

patterns.name: Qualifiers in copyright notices
patterns.context: Fixed wording about the copyright holder or rights notice in a copyright header; it often co-occurs with the BSD marker but is a separate visible activation

patterns.name: Other scattered lexical items
patterns.context: Local words in individual passages, with no consistent trigger context across passages; they should not be grouped with the main patterns
patterns.domain: Source code, Portuguese prose, legal emails, encyclopedias

1_2051.concept: 特定词形与许可证标记检测
1_2051.description: 主要响应 vulneráveis、BSD 许可证语境和 Beauties 词形；还对版权声明用语及若干孤立词有较弱激活。模式跨葡语、代码法律文本与英语百科，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: vulneráveis 词形
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中描述贫困或易受伤害群体，或描述房屋地基脆弱；触发点是 vulneráveis 这一词形
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、哲学文本

patterns.name: BSD 许可证标记
patterns.context: 软件版权头、许可证声明或法律条款中出现 BSD；并非所有 BSD 周边词都同样激活

patterns.name: Beauties 词形
patterns.context: 英语文本中出现 Beauties，分别用于书名/人物名单和历史人物描述
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 文学名单、历史百科

patterns.name: 版权声明中的限定词
patterns.context: 版权头中公司或权利声明的固定措辞；与 BSD 标记常共现，但本身是另一处可见激活

patterns.name: 其它零散词项
patterns.context: 各段中的局部词项，缺少跨段一致的触发上下文；不宜并入主要模式
patterns.domain: 源码、葡萄牙语散文、法律邮件、百科

en.description: Activations are scattered across strap-related product descriptions and idiomatic expressions, BSD license markers, and several proper-name or numeric subword fragments. The latter lack a clear shared meaning and may reflect local token-level features.

patterns.name: strap and product descriptions
patterns.context: Refers to a head strap or bag strap in product descriptions; used idiomatically in podcast copy to mean “get ready to listen to a long discussion”

patterns.name: BSD license marker
patterns.context: A BSD license name appears in code comments or transaction documents, often adjacent to license or licensing terms

patterns.name: Proper-name or numeric subword fragments

en.description: Activations are scattered across code licenses and copyright notices, product strap descriptions, the historical place name Nashville, the patent term malfunctions, and the religious term indulgence; no single semantic pattern unifies them.

en.description: All passages activate on the MAT letter sequence: primarily MAT in the all-caps “Materials and Methods” heading, but also the MAT abbreviation and split English word forms.

patterns.name: MAT abbreviation and letter sequence

1_2105.concept: MAT字母序列

patterns.name: 材料与方法章节标题

en.concept: MAT character fragment and methods section titles
en.description: Strong activations concentrate on “MAT”-initial methods section titles at the ends of academic texts; the same character fragment also activates in the tax abbreviation MAT and in INFLAMMATORY. “FORMAT” in segment 8 contains the same fragment but does not activate, which is difficult to explain.

patterns.name: Research paper methods section title
patterns.context: An all-caps research paper section title following a line break at the end of a paragraph; title variants may be followed by a section anchor or separator line.

patterns.name: MAT abbreviation
patterns.context: The uppercase abbreviation MAT appears in a minimum alternate tax context in a policy discussion; it shares a character fragment with MATERIALS in methods titles but has a different meaning.

patterns.name: MAT fragment in an inflammation-related word
patterns.context: The fragment occurs in the token-split uppercase word INFLAMMATORY, describing aspirin’s anti-inflammatory effect.

1_2105.concept: MAT 字符片段及方法标题

patterns.name: MATERIAL in the “MATERIALS AND METHODS” heading

patterns.name: INFLAMMATORY in an inflammation-related heading

patterns.name: MAT abbreviation
patterns.context: MAT is an abbreviation for minimum alternate tax, appearing in a parenthetical definition.

patterns.name: MAT at the end of FORMAT
