en.description: Primarily sensitive to distance and its compound long-distance, spanning spatial separation, travel distance, and abstract distance; there are also anomalous activations in two biomedical passages, one on a paper-heading fragment and the other on a kinase term.

patterns.name: Hyphenated distance word
patterns.context: Distance combines with the preceding long to form a hyphenated compound; passage 4 also describes a long-distance driving scenario.

patterns.name: Standalone distance
patterns.context: Distance is a noun denoting spatial separation, travel distance, or abstract distance from truth; it may occur with a preposition or in a measurement description.
patterns.domain: Philosophy, network technology, running, and nanomaterials

patterns.name: Other weakly related or anomalous activations
patterns.context: Activation falls on a split paper-heading fragment or biochemical term, with no apparent relation to the word form distance.

1_2105.concept: distance 词形及距离概念
1_2105.description: 主要对 distance 及其复合词 long-distance 敏感，涵盖空间间隔、行进距离和抽象距离；另有两段生物医学文本的异常激活，分别落在论文标题片段和激酶术语上。

patterns.name: 连字符距离词
patterns.context: distance 与前置 long 组成连字符复合词；第 4 段中还出现长距离驾驶情境。

patterns.name: 独立的 distance
patterns.context: distance 作为名词，表示空间间隔、行进距离或抽象的真理距离；可带介词或出现在测量描述中。
patterns.domain: 哲学、网络技术、跑步、纳米材料

patterns.name: 其他弱关联或异常激活
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的论文标题词片段或生化术语上，与 distance 词形无明显关系。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on stimul- medical vocabulary and formerly in former-name explanations; other cases include hyphenated compounds, competitions and after in event announcements, and site. The Swedish passage [1] has no clear corresponding trigger word.

patterns.name: “stimul” stem
patterns.context: The word occurs in physiological, medical, or pharmacological contexts, referring to a stimulant, stimulus, or substance with a stimulating effect; activation spans word forms

patterns.name: “formerly”
patterns.context: Used to introduce an object's former name or historical identity
patterns.domain: Legal cases, historical notes, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Hyphenated compounds
patterns.context: A hyphen occurs within a compound or numerical modifier; when present, it also marks nearby word fragments

patterns.name: “after” at the end of a passage
patterns.context: Appears in the event-scheduling phrase “right after”

patterns.name: Event and competition vocabulary
patterns.context: Descriptions of pet costume events, awards, and winners

patterns.name: “site”
patterns.context: Used as the name of a location or specific venue

1_2105.concept: 词形与局部搭配特征
1_2105.description: 激活主要落在 stimul- 医学词汇和 formerly 旧称说明；另有连字符复合形式、活动公告中的比赛及 after，以及 site。瑞典语段[1]未见明确对应触发词。

patterns.name: “stimul”词干
patterns.context: 该词出现在生理、医学或药理语境中，指刺激物、刺激因素或具有刺激作用的物质；跨词形激活

patterns.name: “formerly”
patterns.context: 用于引出对象的旧名称或历史身份
patterns.domain: 法律判例、历史说明、百科条目

patterns.name: 包含“-”的复合形式
patterns.context: 连字符位于复合词或数字修饰语内部；出现时同时标记邻近词片段

patterns.name: 段落结束处的“after”
patterns.context: 出现在活动安排的短语“right after”中

patterns.name: 活动与比赛词汇
patterns.context: 宠物装扮活动及奖项、获奖者的说明

patterns.name: “site”
patterns.context: 作为地点或特定场地的名称使用
patterns.domain: 活动公告、历史地理说明

en.concept: Common noun fragments such as number / devices
en.description: Activation mainly occurs on “number” and quantity expressions such as “a number of,” and is also common on “devices” in patents; other activations include medical services, cell expression, alcohol treatment, prime-number questions, and several intra-word subword fragments, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: number and its collocations
patterns.context: In noun phrases, denotes a quantity, several objects, or a number; activation concentrates on number, commonly in “a number of” or “a prime number?”
patterns.domain: Patent, medical, public health, encyclopedic, literary, and mathematical texts

patterns.name: devices
patterns.context: The plural noun devices occurs in descriptions of technical or wireless communication devices

patterns.name: cells and mRNAs
patterns.context: Describes cells expressing mRNA, or cells in tissue or ligaments

patterns.name: Health service descriptors
patterns.context: Describes the principles, features, provision, and staffing of mental health services

patterns.name: Behavioral treatment context
patterns.context: Discusses alcohol dependence treatment and adjunctive treatment plans

patterns.name: Inflectional endings and intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within or at the end of split words, including semiconductor, aseptic, rattlesnake, canyons, incompressible, portability, and communication; there is no consistent local semantic condition
patterns.domain: Patents, encyclopedic texts, and literary texts

patterns.name: Prime-number judgment format
patterns.context: Poses a truth-value judgment with “Is … a prime number?” followed by True/False

1_2105.concept: number / devices 等常见名词片段
1_2105.description: 主要激活于“number”及“a number of”等数量表达，也常见于专利中的“devices”；另有医学服务、细胞表达、酒精治疗、质数问句，以及若干词内子词片段激活，彼此语义并不统一。

patterns.name: number 及其搭配
patterns.context: 名词短语中表示数量、若干对象或一个数；激活位置集中在 number，常见于“a number of”或“a prime number?”
patterns.domain: 专利、医学、公共卫生、百科、文学及数学文本

patterns.name: devices
patterns.context: 复数名词 devices，出现在技术装置或无线通信装置的描述中

patterns.name: cells 与 mRNAs
patterns.context: 描述细胞表达 mRNA、组织或韧带中的细胞情况

patterns.name: 健康服务描述词
patterns.context: 描述心理健康服务的原则、特征、供给与人员配置

patterns.name: 行为治疗语境
patterns.context: 谈酒精依赖治疗及辅助治疗方案

patterns.name: 分词词尾与词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的词内部或词尾，涉及 semiconductor、aseptic、rattlesnake、canyons、incompressible、portability、communication 等不同词；没有一致的局部语义条件

patterns.name: 质数判断格式
patterns.context: 以“Is … a prime number?”提出真值判断，并跟随 True/False

en.description: Strongly responds primarily to circuits referring to U.S. judicial circuits in legal texts, sections preceding statutory citations, and scope of in contexts concerning legal applicability; it also responds to patent language using “is directed to” to introduce the technical subject matter.

patterns.name: “scope of” phrase in legal texts
patterns.context: Appears in sentences discussing the scope of applicability, authority, or liability, followed by statutory provisions, procedures, employment relationships, etc.; in multiple examples, the activation falls directly on scope.

patterns.name: circuits in legal texts
patterns.context: Mentions multiple federal courts of appeals and their rulings, views, or arguments.

patterns.name: sections in statutory citations
patterns.context: Used before a statutory or regulatory number to introduce a specific provision.

patterns.name: Technical subject matter of patent applications
patterns.context: Patent descriptions use “is directed to” to introduce the technical solution or purpose addressed by the application.

1_2105.concept: 法律范围与司法辖区用语
1_2105.description: 主要对美国法律文本中表示法院巡回区的circuits、条文编号前的sections及法律适用范围语境中的scope of强烈响应；另对专利文本中“is directed to”引出技术主题的表述响应。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的“scope of”短语
patterns.context: 出现在讨论适用范围、权限或责任边界的句子中，后接法律条款、程序、雇佣关系等；多个例子中直接激活的是 scope。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 circuits
patterns.context: 提及多个联邦巡回上诉法院及其裁判、观点或论证。

patterns.name: 法律条文引用中的 sections
patterns.context: 在法条或法规编号之前，用于引出具体条文编号。

patterns.name: 专利申请的技术主题
patterns.context: 专利说明中以“is directed to”引出申请所针对的技术方案或目的。

en.description: Primarily responds to set in legal texts (set aside, set forth, set-asides) and to court-procedure terms; also covers statutory citations, case consolidation, and railway history, the latter not fully matching the main pattern.

patterns.name: set in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs in fixed expressions in legal proceedings or statutory payments, such as “set aside,” “set forth,” and the debt-reserve term “set-asides”; activation centers on set.
patterns.domain: Legal opinions, litigation documents, and statutes

patterns.name: Litigation procedure and court terminology
patterns.context: Procedural descriptions of court rulings, motions, case consolidation, or court orders; several also contain fixed legal-document expressions.

patterns.name: Legal citations and statutory structure
patterns.context: Statutes or legal citations consisting of numbered provisions, levels of codes, and statutory references.

patterns.name: Railway, company, and bankruptcy narrative
patterns.context: Describes railway branches, railway company bankruptcy, and subsequent ownership; although from legal-source material, this is not a typical expression of litigation procedure.

patterns.name: Plural claims in a particular legal case
patterns.context: A trustee is ordered by a court to bring certain claims; context is insufficient to determine whether the term belongs to a broader shared pattern.

1_2105.concept: 法律文书与程序表达
1_2105.description: 主要响应法律文本中的 set（set aside、set forth、set-asides）及法院程序词；也覆盖法条引注、案件合并和铁路历史叙述，后者与主模式不完全吻合。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 set
patterns.context: 出现在法律程序或法定款项的固定搭配中：如 “set aside”“set forth”，以及债务储备金术语 “set-asides”；触发集中在 set。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、诉讼文书及法规

patterns.name: 诉讼程序与法院术语
patterns.context: 法院裁判、动议、案件合并或法院命令等程序性叙述；多处同时出现法律文书固定表达。

patterns.name: 法律引注与法条结构
patterns.context: 以编号、法典层级和法条引用构成的法规或法律引注。

patterns.name: 铁路、公司及破产叙述
patterns.context: 叙述铁路支线、铁路公司破产及其后续归属；虽含法律语料来源，但不是典型诉讼程序表达。
patterns.domain: 百科全书式历史/交通叙述

patterns.name: 特定法律案件中的复数诉讼请求
patterns.context: 信托受托人被法院命令提起某些诉讼；上下文不足以判断该词是否属于更广泛的共同模式。

en.concept: Set phrases and statutory terminology in legal documents
en.description: Activation mainly concentrates on two types of word strings in legal documents: “set forth,” used to cite facts, reasons, or grounds, and “subdivision” in statutory or planning contexts; several other legal-term activations are scattered and lack a common trigger condition.

patterns.name: set forth in legal opinions
patterns.context: The phrase introduces, states, or refers to reasons, facts, claimed amounts, legal provisions, or agreements listed later or earlier; common in formal judicial writing.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions, legal opinions, and litigation documents

patterns.name: subdivision in statutes
patterns.context: Appears in statutory provisions, citations, or land-planning contexts; activation concentrates on a subword fragment of subdivision.
patterns.domain: Statutory citations and land-planning legal texts

patterns.name: Legal-text activations not attributable to the above phrases
patterns.context: Also occurs in court opinions or regulatory texts, but high-activation words are scattered, and the provided context does not establish a common local trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Court opinions, regulations, and administrative legal documents

1_2105.concept: 法律文书固定表达与条文术语
1_2105.description: 激活主要集中在法律文书中两类词串：引述事实、理由或依据的“set forth”，以及法条或规划语境中的“subdivision”；另有若干分散的法律术语激活，缺乏共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的 set forth
patterns.context: 该短语用于引出、陈述或指向后文/前文所列的理由、事实、请求金额、法律规定或协议；常见于裁判文书的正式句式。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、法律意见及诉讼文书

patterns.name: 法律条文中的 subdivision
patterns.context: 出现在法律条文、法条编号或土地规划语境中；激活集中于 subdivision 一词的分词片段。
patterns.domain: 法律条文引用、土地规划法律文本

patterns.name: 无法归入上述短语的法律文本激活
patterns.trigger: 未见稳定重复的单一触发子串；如 «institution»1、«Board»5«Commission»4ers、«directions»7
patterns.context: 同为法律判决或法规文本，但高激活词分散，无法从所给上下文确认共同的局部触发条件。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、法规及行政法律文书

en.concept: Rulings and provisions in legal proceedings
en.description: Primarily responds to ordered commands or ruling sentences in legal documents, especially those directing subsequent proceedings or actions; it also responds to set forth in judicial reasoning and litigation expressions such as set aside and sets forth. Overall, the contexts are judicial and statutory.

patterns.name: Court issues an order or ruling
patterns.context: The court is the subject, or the ruling uses imperative language; nearby terms often include ordered, that, motion, and judgment.

patterns.name: Procedural command sentences in legal documents
patterns.context: An order directs parties, trustees, or others to take subsequent action, or specifies how the case should proceed.

patterns.name: Fixed judicial-reasoning phrasing in opinions or motions
patterns.context: Used in a court opinion when explaining how a motion, request, or dispute will be handled; activation falls on set.

patterns.name: General litigation collocations with set
patterns.context: set occurs in collocations relating to litigation motions or statements of procedural rules, but does not necessarily involve a court order; it may be related to fixed judicial-reasoning phrasing or merely a lexical overlap.

patterns.name: Local co-occurrence of verbs for orders and judgments
patterns.context: Legal texts contain vocabulary related to rulings, judgments, or litigation motions; in some examples, the highly activated word is not directly ordered.

1_2105.concept: 法律程序中的裁定与规定
1_2105.description: 主要响应法律文书中的 ordered 命令或裁定句，尤其指示后续程序或行动；也响应判决理由中的 set forth，以及 set aside、sets forth 等诉讼搭配。整体限于司法与法规语境。

patterns.name: 法院发布命令或裁定
patterns.trigger: “court ordered”“trial judge ordered”“ordered, adjudged”“hereby is denied”
patterns.context: 法院作为主语，或裁定文书使用命令式措辞；附近常出现 ordered、that、motion、judgment 等词。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的程序性命令句
patterns.trigger: “were ordered to proceed”“ordered the trustees to”“court ordered a pre-sentence investigation”
patterns.context: 命令规定当事人、受托人或相关人员采取后续行动，或指示案件程序如何继续。

patterns.name: 判决或动议中的固定裁判理由措辞
patterns.context: 法院意见书在说明将如何处理动议、请求或争议时使用；激活落在 set。

patterns.name: 法律语境中 set 的一般诉讼搭配
patterns.trigger: “motion to set aside”“sets forth the following procedures”
patterns.context: set 出现在诉讼动议或陈述程序规则的搭配中，但未必涉及法院命令；与固定裁判理由措辞可能有关，也可能只是词项重合。

patterns.name: 命令与判决动词的局部共现
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现裁定、判决或诉讼动议词汇；个别例子中高激活词并不直接是 ordered。

en.description: The neuron primarily responds to the verb set in U.S. legal documents, especially set forth; it also responds to legal collocations such as set out, set off, and set aside, often used to state facts or reasons, offset amounts, or request vacatur or exemption.

patterns.name: “set forth” introducing reasons or facts
patterns.context: Introduces reasons below, earlier statements, or facts to be stated in legal opinions and court orders
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and judicial documents

patterns.name: “set out” introducing facts
patterns.context: Signals in a judgment that the facts have been set out in the court's opinion

patterns.name: “set off” as an offset
patterns.context: A counterclaim seeks to offset debt using a credit memorandum

patterns.name: “set aside” for vacatur or exemption
patterns.context: In legal contexts, requests vacatur of a default judgment, reversal or correction of a sentence, or treatment of property as exempt; the specific meaning depends on the object
patterns.domain: Civil litigation, bankruptcy law, and criminal procedure case law

1_2105.concept: 法律文书中的 set 搭配
1_2105.description: 神经元主要响应美国法律文书中的动词 set，尤其是 set forth；也响应 set out、set off、set aside 等法律固定搭配，常用于陈述事实、理由、抵销或请求撤销／豁免。

patterns.name: “set forth”引出理由或事实
patterns.trigger: «set»10 «forth»，如“reasons set forth below”“facts as set forth previously”“set forth the undisputed facts”
patterns.context: 法律意见书、法院命令中引出下文理由、先前陈述或待述事实

patterns.name: “set out”引出事实
patterns.context: 判决书中提示事实已在法院意见中列出

patterns.name: “set off”抵销
patterns.trigger: “to «set»10«off» credit memos against any amounts owed”
patterns.context: 反诉请求以贷项备忘录抵销欠款

patterns.name: “set aside”撤销或豁免
patterns.context: 法律语境中请求撤销缺席判决、撤销或更正刑罚，或将财产列为豁免；具体含义取决于宾语
patterns.domain: 民事诉讼、破产法与刑事程序判例

en.description: All segments occur in legal-procedure narratives where a court or adjudicator issues an order, «ordered»; the text that follows describes the recipient, content, or subsequent proceedings. The form also includes «ordered»9.

patterns.name: Court-order verb
patterns.context: A court, judge, or administrative hearing officer issues a ruling, followed by the order’s content, parties, or disposition; commonly occurs in narratives of legal opinions.

1_2105.concept: 司法命令
1_2105.description: 所有片段都在法律程序叙述中出现法院或审判者作出命令的 «ordered»；其后说明命令对象、内容或后续程序，词形也包括«ordered»9。

patterns.name: 法院命令动词
patterns.context: 法院、法官或行政听证人员作出裁定，后接命令内容、当事人或处置措施；多出现在法律判决叙述中。
patterns.domain: 美国判例、诉讼程序叙述

en.concept: Setups and rulings in legal documents
en.description: Primarily responds to “set” and its collocations in legal contexts, covering vacating, offsetting, stating, allocating, listing, and scheduling; also responds to court orders, motions, statutory citations, and judgment-document formats.

patterns.name: Set and its phrasal verbs
patterns.context: Describes matters raised, scheduled, or handled by a court or party in legal texts; different collocations indicate vacating or setting aside, offsetting, stating, retaining funds, allocating property, listing considerations, and scheduling trial dates.

patterns.name: Court orders and judicial actions
patterns.context: Describes court orders, rulings, motions, or related judicial proceedings; paragraph 3 specifically concerns removing a trustee and ordering the trustee to file suit.
patterns.domain: Legal judgments and descriptions of judicial proceedings

patterns.name: Legal citations and statutory numbering
patterns.context: Activated by citations to statutes, regulations, or cases, often co-occurring with motions, court proceedings, or government debt provisions.

patterns.name: Paragraph and formatting markers in judgments
patterns.context: Appears near paragraph breaks, case narratives, and quotation formats in legal opinions; some instances may reflect document layout rather than an independent semantic trigger.

1_2105.concept: 法律文书中的设定与裁定
1_2105.description: 主要响应法律语境中的“set”及其搭配，涵盖撤销、抵销、陈述、分配、列举和排期；也响应法院命令、动议、法条引用及判决文书格式。

patterns.name: set 及其短语动词
patterns.trigger: «set»，包括“set» aside”“set»off”“set» forth”“set»-asides”“set» apart”“set» out”“set» a trial date”
patterns.context: 法律文本中描述法院或当事人提出、安排或处理事项；不同搭配分别表示撤销/搁置、抵销、陈述、留置资金、分配财产、列举考量因素及安排审判日期。

patterns.name: 法院命令与司法行动
patterns.context: 叙述法院的命令、裁定、动议或相关司法程序；第3段尤其涉及撤换受托人并命令受托人提起诉讼。
patterns.domain: 法律判决与司法程序叙述

patterns.name: 法律引用与法规编号
patterns.context: 出现法条、法规或判例引用时激活，常与动议、法院程序或政府债务规定共现。

patterns.name: 判决文书的段落与格式标记
patterns.context: 法律意见书的换段、案件叙述和引文格式附近出现；部分可能反映文书排版而非独立语义触发。

en.concept: Legal claims and judicial panel terminology
en.description: Primarily activates on proposition(s) (litigation claims, grounds for appeal, and ballot Proposition measures) and panel (court panels, related judges, and procedural narratives) in U.S. legal texts; it also activates on line in railway history.

patterns.name: proposition(s): arguments/claims
patterns.context: Refers to legal claims or grounds for appeal in opinions or litigation documents, or to numbered ballot measures named Proposition; the former often collocate with relied upon, for reversal, and of error.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and legal documents; also California ballot-measure legislative context

patterns.name: Appellate panels and judicial proceedings
patterns.context: Descriptions of court proceedings, panel composition, or procedural history, involving the issuance of opinions, case consolidation, rehearing, or judicial participation.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal and state court opinions, judicial-procedure narratives

patterns.name: Railway-line narrative
patterns.context: In a historical account of a railway line being leased or absorbed, line refers to the railway route; no clear legal or panel context is present.

1_2105.concept: 法律主张与司法合议庭词汇
1_2105.description: 主要对美国法律文本中的 proposition(s)（诉讼主张、上诉理由，也包括公投 Proposition）及 panel（法院合议庭、相关法官与程序叙述）激活；另在铁路史中对 line 激活。

patterns.name: proposition(s) 论点/主张
patterns.context: 法律意见或诉讼文书中谈及法律主张、上诉理由，或以 Proposition 加编号称呼公投提案；前者常与 relied upon、for reversal、of error 等搭配。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决及法律文书；也包括加州公投立法背景

patterns.name: 上诉合议庭与司法程序
patterns.context: 法院审理、合议庭组成或程序经过的描述，涉及意见发布、案件合并、重审或法官参与。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦及州法院判决、司法程序叙述

patterns.name: 铁路线路叙述
patterns.context: 铁路线路被租赁或吸收的历史叙述中，line 指铁路线路；未见明确法律或合议庭语境。

en.description: Primarily responds to procedures, litigation participants, disputed issues, and statutory numbering in legal judgments and regulatory citations; also appears with sentencing terms and descriptions of corporate or railroad organizations. Several general-purpose words activate only in legal narratives.

patterns.name: Legal propositions and reasoning in court opinions
patterns.context: Appears when a court states an issue, lists grounds for appeal, or cites legal arguments; sometimes capitalized.

patterns.name: Statutory provisions and subdivisions
patterns.context: Near statute names, section numbers, subdivisions, or regulatory citations, commonly in criminal, bankruptcy, and tax-law texts.

patterns.name: Case and litigation terminology in judgments
patterns.context: In formal references to parties, creditors, estates, claims, procedures, or courts.

patterns.name: Legal procedure verbs and requests for relief
patterns.context: When describing procedural actions such as filing a motion, requesting court action, offsetting, or vacating or correcting a judgment.

patterns.name: Sentencing context
patterns.context: When discussing terms of imprisonment, consecutive sentences, or vacating or correcting a sentence.

patterns.name: Corporate and railroad organizational relationships
patterns.context: When describing railroad ownership, the place of organization of a foreign corporation, or tax exemptions.

patterns.name: Legal collocations outside litigation
patterns.context: Describes a bill’s passage through a proposal and its alternate name; the activated word itself is general-purpose and depends on legal enactment narratives.

patterns.name: Quotative connective in testimonial narrative
patterns.context: When witness testimony recounts violent conduct; viewed in isolation, it is general-purpose, with no clear specialized legal trigger.

1_2105.concept: 法律文本与诉讼术语
1_2105.description: 主要响应法律判决与法规引文中的程序、诉讼参与者、争点和法条编号；另见刑罚术语及公司/铁路组织描述。若干泛用词只在法律叙述中激活。

patterns.name: 法院意见中的法律命题/理由
patterns.context: 在法院陈述争点、列举上诉理由或引述法律论证时出现；有时首字母大写

patterns.name: 法律条文及细分编号
patterns.context: 法条名称、条号、款项编号或法规引文附近，常见于刑事、破产、税法等法律文本

patterns.name: 判决文书中的案件与诉讼术语
patterns.context: 当事人、债权人、遗产、诉讼请求、程序或法院的正式称谓与叙述中

patterns.name: 法律程序动词与救济请求
patterns.context: 描述提出动议、请求法院采取行动、抵销或撤销/更正判决等程序行为时

patterns.name: 刑罚与量刑语境
patterns.context: 讨论刑期、连续执行或撤销/更正刑罚时

patterns.name: 公司与铁路组织关系
patterns.context: 描述铁路所有权或外国公司组织地及税收豁免时

patterns.name: 非诉讼语境中的法律搭配
patterns.context: 描述法案经某提案通过及其别称；激活词本身较泛，依附于法律制定叙述

patterns.name: 叙事性证言中的引述连接词
patterns.context: 证人证言转述暴力行为时；孤立看属于泛用语，缺少明显的专门法律触发条件
patterns.domain: 刑事判决中的证据叙述

en.concept: Legal procedure and statutory terminology in U.S. opinions
en.description: The neuron primarily responds to legal argument and procedural vocabulary in U.S. opinions: propositions/claims, bankruptcy statutes and petitions, and motions for relief; it also responds in legal contexts involving sentences, estate appointments, government bonds, homestead mortgages, and setoffs.

patterns.name: Propositions and legal claims
patterns.context: Refers to a legal claim or specific proposal in an opinion, legal argument, or election-measure context; segment 3 includes capitalization and plural variants.
patterns.domain: Legal opinions, criminal justice, and election law

patterns.name: Bankruptcy proceedings and statutes
patterns.context: Appears in bankruptcy case narratives or statutory citations concerning petitions, creditors, debtors, and statutory procedures.

patterns.name: Judicial motions and requests for relief
patterns.context: When parties file a motion, petition, or request for relief with a court; some examples relate to criminal judgments or bankruptcy disputes.

patterns.name: Sentencing and execution of judgment
patterns.context: Describes a sentence, consecutive service, or a request to vacate or correct a judgment in a criminal case.

patterns.name: Appointment of estate administrator
patterns.context: At the beginning of an estate case, identifies the estate administrator and the plaintiff’s standing.

patterns.name: Statutory bonds and debt repayment
patterns.context: Cites government code provisions listing bond-related repayments, reserves, and other payments.

patterns.name: Homestead exemption and mortgage
patterns.context: Cites case law explaining a legal proposition concerning homestead-related deeds or mortgages.

patterns.name: Setoff dispute
patterns.context: In a bankruptcy adversary proceeding, the defendant asserts a counterclaim to set off a credit memorandum against an amount owed.

patterns.name: Ownership of bankruptcy estate and petition date
patterns.context: Discusses ownership of property or the debtor’s rights as of the bankruptcy petition date, citing cases and statutes.

1_2105.concept: 美国判决中的法律程序与法条术语
1_2105.description: 神经元主要响应美国判决文本中的法律论证与程序词汇：命题/主张、破产法条及申请、动议救济；另响应刑期、遗产任命、政府债券、宅地抵押和抵销等法律语境。

patterns.name: 命题及法律主张
patterns.context: 判决、法律论证或选举措施语境中，指称一项法律主张或特定提案；第3段出现大小写与复数变体
patterns.domain: 法律判决、刑事司法与选举法

patterns.name: 破产程序与法条
patterns.context: 破产案件叙述或法条引用中，围绕申请、债权人、债务人及法定程序出现
patterns.domain: 破产法判决及法条文本

patterns.name: 司法动议与救济请求
patterns.trigger: «motion»、«filed»、«requests»，以及 «to vacate, set aside, or correct»
patterns.context: 当事人向法院提出动议、申请或请求救济时；部分与刑事判决或破产争议相连

patterns.name: 判决刑期与执行
patterns.context: 刑事案件中描述刑期、连续执行或请求撤销、更正判决

patterns.name: 遗产管理任命
patterns.context: 遗产诉讼开头交代遗产管理人身份及原告资格

patterns.name: 法定债券及债务偿付
patterns.context: 引用政府法典条款，列举债券相关偿付、储备及其他付款

patterns.name: 房屋豁免与抵押
patterns.context: 援引判例说明宅地相关契据或抵押的法律命题

patterns.name: 抵销争议
patterns.context: 破产对抗诉讼中，被告以反诉主张抵销信用备忘录与欠款

patterns.name: 破产财产归属与申请日
patterns.context: 讨论财产在破产申请日的归属或债务人权利，并援引判例和法条

en.description: Activations come from varied legal judgment excerpts: prominent are the varied legal collocations of set, as well as proposition, litigation procedure, judgment remedies, and contract disputes. Oil and gas, real-estate terminology, and sporadic formatting terms also occur; the activations do not form a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Set and its phrases in legal litigation
patterns.context: Describes matters raised, scheduled, vacated, offset, or stated by a court or party in legal texts; activations span different collocations and need not share a single legal meaning.
patterns.domain: Judgments, litigation procedures, and legal reasoning

patterns.name: Issues, claims, or propositions in law
patterns.context: States or discusses a proposition, claim, or disputed issue in a legal opinion; forms include both the common noun and the name Proposition 47.

patterns.name: Designation, applications, and judgment dispositions in legal documents
patterns.context: Describes criminal convictions, sentences, and procedures for seeking relief from a court; no single stable trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Parties and court-procedure markers in legal cases
patterns.context: Legal contexts such as case captions, creditor objections, court rulings, and trial proceedings; triggers may be related to formatted captions or procedural terms.
patterns.domain: Legal case captions and procedural narratives

patterns.name: Contracts, agreements, and arbitration
patterns.context: Concerns agreement terms, arbitration, counterclaims, and disputes between parties; some words also occur in other legal patterns.

patterns.name: Transaction or asset terms in specific legal fields
patterns.context: Discusses oil and gas production interests, or real estate, homesteads, and mortgages; apart from belonging to legal corpora, these have no clear shared trigger.
patterns.domain: Oil and gas interests and real-estate law

patterns.name: Sporadic highlighted words or formatting markers
patterns.context: Appears in citations, proper names, punctuation, or formatting fragments; it is unclear whether activation is semantic or caused by tokenization or formatting.
patterns.domain: Citations and formatting in legal texts

1_2105.concept: 法律诉讼文本词汇
1_2105.description: 激活来自多类法律判决片段：突出 set 的多种法律搭配，以及命题、诉讼程序、判决救济和合同争议词。另有油气、不动产术语及零散格式词；难以归纳为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 法律诉讼中的 set 及其短语
patterns.trigger: «set»（如 «set»« aside»、«set»« off»、«set» a «trial» date、«set»« forth»、«set» out）
patterns.context: 法律文本中描述法院或当事人提出、安排、撤销、抵销或陈述事项；激活分布在多种不同搭配，未必共享单一法律含义。
patterns.domain: 判决、诉讼程序及法律论证

patterns.name: 法律中的议题、主张或命题
patterns.context: 法律意见书中陈述或讨论一项命题、主张或争议事项；词形既包括普通名词，也包括 Proposition 47 的名称。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的指定、申请与判决处置
patterns.context: 描述刑事定罪、刑罚及申请法院救济的程序；未见单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 法律案件当事人及法院程序标记
patterns.context: 案件标题、债权人异议、法院裁定和审判程序等法律语境；触发可能与格式化标题或程序词有关。
patterns.domain: 法律案件标题与程序叙述

patterns.name: 合同、协议与仲裁
patterns.context: 围绕协议条款、仲裁、反诉及当事人争议展开；部分词也出现在其他法律模式中。

patterns.name: 特定法律领域中的交易或资产术语
patterns.context: 讨论油气生产权益或不动产、宅地及抵押；除均属法律语料外，彼此没有明显共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 零散高亮词或格式标记
patterns.context: 出现在引文、专名、标点或排版片段中，无法确认是语义触发还是分词、格式造成的激活。
patterns.domain: 法律文本中的引文与格式

en.description: Primarily responds to procedural expressions in legal documents concerning claims, applications for relief, appeals, and review, as well as statutory and case-citation markers; it also appears in bankruptcy roles, sentencing terminology, and legal section headings.

patterns.name: Claims, relief, and procedural actions in litigation
patterns.context: Sentences in which litigants assert claims or seek relief, or courts review or dismiss cases; often adjacent to case types, statutes, and procedural stages.
patterns.domain: Opinions, appellate briefs, and other legal documents

patterns.name: Citation and statutory markers
patterns.context: Statute numbers, parenthetical years or subdivisions, case citations, and surrounding punctuation; activation falls on the markers themselves and on a few related citation terms.

patterns.name: Legal status and litigation roles
patterns.context: Identifies a creditor’s status and litigation role in a bankruptcy case caption.

patterns.name: Incarceration and supervised release after sentencing
patterns.context: Describes a sentence, supervised release, and violation of federal law; activation falls on intra-word fragments of offense- or sentence-related terms.

patterns.name: Jurisdiction and review of immigration removal
patterns.context: The government opposes a petition, and the court explains its jurisdiction and statutory basis for reviewing a final immigration removal order.

patterns.name: Rule exceptions and legal principles
patterns.context: Discusses a legal rule and its exception after a case citation.

patterns.name: Case names and heading text
patterns.context: Roman numerals used as section headings in an opinion.

1_2105.concept: 法律诉讼程序与引证
1_2105.description: 主要响应法律诉讼文书中提出主张、申请救济、上诉与审查等程序表达，也响应法条和判例引证标记；另见破产角色、刑罚用语及法律章节标题。

patterns.name: 法律诉讼中的主张、救济与程序动作
patterns.context: 诉讼当事人提出主张、申请救济，或法院审查、驳回案件的句子；常与案件类型、法条和程序阶段相邻。
patterns.domain: 判决书、上诉意见及其他法律文书

patterns.name: 引证与法条标记
patterns.context: 法条编号、括号内年份或分项、判例引证及其周边标点；激活落在标记本身，也落在少量引证关联词上。

patterns.name: 法律身份与诉讼角色
patterns.context: 破产案件标题中标示债权人身份及其诉讼角色。

patterns.name: 监禁及刑罚后的监督释放
patterns.context: 描述刑罚、监督释放及违反联邦法律；激活落在罪名或刑罚相关词的词内片段。

patterns.name: 管辖权与移民遣返审查
patterns.context: 政府反对请愿，法院说明审查移民遣返最终命令的管辖权和法源。

patterns.name: 规则例外及法律原则
patterns.context: 判例引证后讨论某项法律规则及其例外。

patterns.name: 案件专名及标题文本
patterns.context: 罗马数字作为判决章节标题。

en.description: Activations are concentrated in procedural and statutory expressions in U.S. case law: court motions and decisions, criminal convictions and imprisonment, and citations to legal authority. They also cover specific contexts such as bankruptcy, trusts, tax summonses, and prison administration.

patterns.name: Procedural actions and rulings in legal litigation
patterns.context: Describes court proceedings, motions filed by parties or handled by a court, scheduling trials, and vacating or correcting judgments; often occurs alongside statutes and litigation documents.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Criminal convictions, sentences, and incarcerated persons
patterns.context: Involves prisoner status, convictions, sentences or imprisonment, and lawsuits brought by prisoners.
patterns.domain: Criminal case law and prisoner litigation

patterns.name: Statutory and regulatory citations
patterns.context: Specific code, chapter, or section numbers appear, often to identify the basis for litigation, an offense, or a legal rule.

patterns.name: Legal relationships, claims, and related actions
patterns.context: Describes legal relationships and actions such as party status in bankruptcy cases, trustees recovering property, summons investigations, or claims.
patterns.domain: Civil, bankruptcy, and tax case law

patterns.name: Criminal offenses, drugs, and related violations
patterns.context: States facts of an offense, charges, controlled substances, or violations of criminal laws; sometimes linked to a conviction or statutory citation.

patterns.name: County jail facilities and county prisoner administration
patterns.context: Distinguishes local detention facilities from sentenced prisoners and discusses county board authority over county prisoners.

patterns.name: Tax authority summons
patterns.context: Requires an attorney to testify before a special agent of the tax authority; the summons is issued under a provision of the Internal Revenue Code.

patterns.name: Bankruptcy case caption and objecting creditor
patterns.context: Lists the debtor under “In the Matter of” and identifies the creditor filing an objection.

patterns.name: Trustee recovery of trust property
patterns.context: The court orders a trustee to take necessary legal action to recover title to and possession of trust property.

patterns.name: Government motion to dismiss
patterns.context: The state seeks dismissal of a lawsuit; the court denies the motion and schedules a trial date.

1_2105.concept: 美国判例法律程序与法条
1_2105.description: 激活集中于美国判例中的法律程序与法条表达：法院动议和裁判、刑事定罪及服刑、法律依据引用，并涵盖破产、信托、税务传票、监狱管理等具体法律情境。

patterns.name: 法律诉讼中的程序动作与裁判
patterns.context: 描述法院审理、当事人提出或法院处理动议、安排审判及撤销或更正判决等程序；常与法条和诉讼文件并现。

patterns.name: 刑事定罪、刑罚与羁押人员
patterns.context: 涉及囚犯身份、定罪、刑罚或服刑，以及囚犯提起的诉讼。

patterns.name: 法条与法规引用
patterns.context: 出现具体法典、章节或条款编号，常用于说明诉讼依据、犯罪依据或法律规则。

patterns.name: 法律关系、请求及相关法律行为
patterns.context: 描述破产案件当事人身份、受托人追索财产、传票调查或诉讼请求等法律关系与行为。

patterns.name: 刑事犯罪、毒品与相关违法行为
patterns.context: 陈述犯罪事实、罪名、受管制物质或违反刑事法规；有时与定罪或法条引用相连。

patterns.name: 县级监狱设施与县囚管理
patterns.context: 区分地方羁押设施与服刑囚犯，并讨论县委员会对县囚的管理权限。

patterns.name: 税务机关传票
patterns.context: 要求律师到税务机关特别代理人面前作证，传票依据《国内税收法典》条文发出。

patterns.name: 破产案件标题与异议债权人
patterns.context: 以“In the Matter of”列出债务人，并标明提出异议的债权人。

patterns.name: 受托人追回信托财产
patterns.context: 法院命令受托人采取必要诉讼，以追回信托财产的产权和占有。

patterns.name: 政府一方的撤诉动议
patterns.context: 州政府申请驳回诉讼，法院拒绝并安排审判日期。

en.description: Activations cluster in U.S. court documents: heading formats, legal argument and statutory citations, procedural applications and rulings, parties and facts, evidentiary judgments, and language concerning transfer of property and land rights.

patterns.name: Formatting boundaries and headings in legal documents
patterns.context: Headings, case names, party designations, and uppercase headings in court opinions, pleadings, or judgments; activation often falls on heading words, token-split words, or formatting separators.

patterns.name: Legal argument and judicial phrasing
patterns.context: Common legal abstract nouns and argumentative collocations used to describe disputes, legal grounds, questions on review, or reasoning behind a ruling.

patterns.name: Legal procedure, relief, and rulings
patterns.context: Mentions the filing of an application, a procedural motion, a writ, or a procedural disposition by the court.

patterns.name: Rights, property, and conveyance documents in law
patterns.context: Describes ownership of land or property, or formal deed language granting or transferring rights.
patterns.domain: Property law and land conveyance documents

patterns.name: Statutes, numbering, and citation structure
patterns.context: Cites codes, statute numbers, or statutory subdivisions, especially around numbers and legal terms.

patterns.name: Case facts and participants
patterns.context: States party identities, the sequence of arrest and prosecution, or facts about property and locations involved in a case.

patterns.name: Legal judgments, records, and evidence
patterns.context: Describes prior judgments, factual records, or evidentiary materials and discusses their role in proceedings.

patterns.name: Land-tax dispositions and government title
patterns.context: Describes a sheriff issuing a land deed to the state and its grant or transfer terms.

1_2105.concept: 美国法律文书语言
1_2105.description: 激活集中于美国法院文书：标题格式、法律论证与法条引证、程序申请和裁判、当事人及事实、证据判决，以及财产与土地权利转让措辞。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的格式边界与标题
patterns.trigger: «Matter»、«Object»ing、«MEM»«ORANDUM»« OPINION»、«THE EXCEPT«ION» OF« NO» CA«USE» OF« ACTION»
patterns.context: 法院意见、诉状或判决文书中的标题、案名、当事人身份及大写标题；激活常落在标题词、被拆分的词或格式分隔符上

patterns.name: 法律论证与裁判措辞
patterns.context: 叙述争议、法律依据、审查问题或裁判理由时，常见法律抽象名词及其论证搭配

patterns.name: 法律程序、救济及裁判结果
patterns.context: 提及提出申请、程序性动议、司法令状或法院采取的程序处置时

patterns.name: 法律中的权利、财产与文书转让
patterns.context: 叙述土地、财产所有权，或契据中授予、转让权利的正式措辞
patterns.domain: 财产法及土地法律文书

patterns.name: 法条、编号及引文结构
patterns.context: 引用法典、法规条号或法条分项时，尤其在编号及其周围的法律名词上

patterns.name: 案件事实与诉讼参与人
patterns.context: 交代当事人身份、逮捕起诉经过或涉案财产与地点等事实

patterns.name: 法律判决、记录与证据
patterns.context: 说明既有判决、事实记录或证据材料，并讨论其在程序中的作用

patterns.name: 土地税务处置与政府产权
patterns.context: 叙述警长向州政府签发土地契据及其授予、转让内容

en.concept: Statutes and judicial procedure in U.S. legal texts
en.description: Primarily responds to statutory citations, subsection numbering, and litigation-procedure language in U.S. legal texts; also covers criminal convictions and imprisonment, evidentiary standards, government agencies, bankruptcy captions, and employment during reentry into society.

patterns.name: Statutory numbering and subsection format
patterns.context: Statutes or subsections are cited in legal texts; activations cluster around section symbols, parentheses, and subsection structures. Numbers or letters themselves may also be marked.

patterns.name: Procedure and rulings in litigation documents
patterns.context: Procedural language in which a court discusses jurisdiction, review, applications, or a ruling; does not require a particular statutory format.

patterns.name: Criminal convictions, sentences, and imprisonment
patterns.context: Discusses offenses, convictions, incarceration, or sentence execution; some examples also include statutory citations.
patterns.domain: Criminal justice and related statutes and judgments

patterns.name: Subsection structure and legislative terminology
patterns.context: Cites a statute’s section, subdivision, and content, often with numbering, parentheses, and normative statements.
patterns.domain: Statutory interpretation and statutory analysis in judgments

patterns.name: Evidence and legal standards in case law
patterns.context: A court states a standard of review and lists evidentiary conditions; trigger words involve subjective statements and objective evidence.

patterns.name: Jurisdictions and government agency names
patterns.context: Mentions local government agencies or facilities and discusses their statutory classification, authority, or the people they oversee.
patterns.domain: Local government laws and judicial judgments

patterns.name: Bankruptcy parties and litigation captions
patterns.context: Case captions list debtors, objecting creditors, and opposing parties; markers cluster around caption terms or party labels.
patterns.domain: Bankruptcy judgment case names and captions

patterns.name: Reentry and employment arrangements
patterns.context: Describes arrangements for work at a reentry facility after imprisonment, possibly followed by a narrative of misconduct.

1_2105.concept: 美国法律文本中的法条与司法程序
1_2105.description: 主要响应美国法律文本中的法条引用、分款编号及诉讼程序措辞；也覆盖刑事定罪服刑、证据标准、政府机构、破产案名和再入社会就业等法律语境。

patterns.name: 法条编号与分款格式
patterns.trigger: «§»、«(»、«)»及相邻的数字、字母分款，如“§ 1252(a)(1)”“§ 137, subdivision (3b)”
patterns.context: 法律文本中引述法条或细分条款，激活集中在法条符号、括号和分款结构；数字或字母本身也可能被标记。

patterns.name: 诉讼文书中的程序与裁判用语
patterns.trigger: “petition”“jurisdiction”“review”“final order”“summary judgment shall be entered”“denial of his application”
patterns.context: 法院论述管辖权、审查、申请或裁判结果的程序性语句；不要求特定法条格式。

patterns.name: 刑事定罪、刑罚与服刑
patterns.context: 讨论犯罪、定罪、监禁或刑罚执行；部分例子也带有法条引用。
patterns.domain: 刑事司法及相关法规、判决

patterns.name: 法规的分款结构与立法术语
patterns.context: 引用法规的 section、subdivision 及其内容，常伴随编号、括号和规范性陈述。
patterns.domain: 法规解释与判决中的法条分析

patterns.name: 判例中的证据与法律标准
patterns.trigger: “subjective testimony of pain”“pain standard requires”“objective medical evidence”
patterns.context: 法院陈述判断标准，并列出证据条件；触发词涉及主观陈述和客观证据。

patterns.name: 司法辖区和政府机构名称
patterns.trigger: “Indiana Department of Natural Resources”“county boards”“municipal detention facilities”
patterns.context: 提及地方政府机构或设施，并讨论其法定分类、权限或管理对象。
patterns.domain: 地方政府法规与司法判决

patterns.name: 破产案件当事人与诉讼标题
patterns.context: 案件标题列举债务人、异议债权人及对立当事人；标记集中在标题词或当事人标签。
patterns.domain: 破产判决的案名与标题

patterns.name: 再入社会与就业安排
patterns.context: 描述服刑后在再入社会机构及工作岗位的安排，随后可能叙述违规行为。
patterns.domain: 刑罚执行与再入社会叙述

en.concept: Legal text structure and adjudicative terminology
en.description: Primarily responds to statutory provisions, subsection numbering, and citation structures in U.S. legal texts. Also responds to terms for issues, adjudication, evidentiary review, jurisdictional procedure, bankruptcy case captions, and normative payment obligations in judicial opinions.

patterns.name: Statutes and subsection numbering
patterns.context: Citations to statutes, subclauses, or parenthesized subsection numbering in legal texts; the marker often falls on the number and surrounding clause structure.

patterns.name: Judicial rulings and legal reasoning
patterns.context: Appears when a court opinion states issues, interprets law, or explains its holding; does not depend on a specific statutory citation.

patterns.name: Elements of criminal offenses in statutes
patterns.context: When discussing offenses, crimes defined by statute, and their elements.

patterns.name: Evidence and standards of legal review
patterns.context: When discussing evidentiary standards of proof, summary judgment, or litigation materials.
patterns.domain: Judicial opinions; civil procedure and injury/disability evidence

patterns.name: Review of jurisdiction and removal orders
patterns.context: Describes a court’s authority and procedure for reviewing a removal order or final administrative order.

patterns.name: Court and bankruptcy proceeding identification
patterns.context: Bankruptcy cases, trustees, appellate bodies, or court levels listed in case captions or heading information.

patterns.name: Obligations and payment clauses in formal rules
patterns.context: Normative provisions specify fund allocation, payment methods, or obligations; appear alongside clause numbering.

1_2105.concept: 法律文本结构与裁判术语
1_2105.description: 主要响应美国法律文本中法条、分项编号及其引用结构，也响应判决的争点、裁判、证据审查、管辖程序、破产案头信息和规范性付款义务用语。

patterns.name: 法条与分项编号
patterns.context: 法律文本中引用法条、细分条款或带括号的分项编号；标记常落在编号及其周围的条款结构上。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、法规引用

patterns.name: 司法裁判与论证用语
patterns.context: 法院判决陈述争点、解释法律或说明裁判结论时出现；不依赖特定法条编号。

patterns.name: 刑事法条构成要件
patterns.context: 讨论罪名、法条所定义的犯罪及其构成要件时。

patterns.name: 证据与法律审查标准
patterns.context: 讨论证据证明标准或简易判决及诉讼材料时。
patterns.domain: 司法意见；民事程序与伤痛/伤残证据

patterns.name: 裁判管辖与移除令审查
patterns.context: 说明法院审查移除令或最终行政命令的权限与程序。

patterns.name: 法院及破产程序身份信息
patterns.context: 案件标题或案头信息列出破产案件、受托人、上诉机构或法院层级。

patterns.name: 正式规范中的义务与付款条款
patterns.context: 规范性条款规定资金分配、付款方式或义务；与条款编号并列出现。
patterns.domain: 法规或合同式法律文本

en.concept: Provisions and procedural terminology in legal texts
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in statutory subdivisions or section citations and nearby litigation, criminal conviction, and bankruptcy terminology in legal documents; also includes legal fact terms for real-estate subdivision and estate administration.

patterns.name: Statutory subdivisions
patterns.context: A statutory subdivision is cited in legal reasoning, often near a section number, a parenthetical subdivision, and an explanation of its application or content.

patterns.name: Section in statutory citations
patterns.context: A legal number follows section, often alongside subdivision, title numbers, violations, or statutory elements.

patterns.name: Case captions and litigation roles
patterns.context: In case names, party identities, appellants, or judicial institutions, with activations on legal roles or institutional terms.
patterns.domain: Bankruptcy case captions and procedural information

patterns.name: Litigation procedure and ruling language
patterns.context: Appears when describing an appeal, request, ruling, or claim; the same passage may also contain statutory citations.

patterns.name: Legal status and conviction records
patterns.context: Discusses felonies, convictions, offense elements, or treatment of conviction records; may co-occur with subdivision citations.

patterns.name: Bankruptcy procedure, property, and claims
patterns.context: In bankruptcy cases, involves the debtor, petition date, property, liens, trustee, or creditor.

patterns.name: Controlled substances and criminal statutes
patterns.context: Lists controlled substances and cites relevant provisions of the United States Code.

patterns.name: Lots and zoning terminology
patterns.context: Describes the planning, lot numbers, and streets of a residential subdivision; subdivision here means land division, not a statutory subdivision.

patterns.name: Estate administration status
patterns.context: Introduces an estate administrator and their relationship to the plaintiff.

patterns.name: Standalone section-heading marker
patterns.context: Cites a Bankruptcy Act provision and its subsection in a bankruptcy-law passage discussing rights acquired by a trustee.

1_2105.concept: 法律文本中的条款与程序术语
1_2105.description: 激活主要集中于法律文书中的法条分项/section 引用及其邻近的诉讼、刑事定罪和破产术语；另见地产分区、遗产管理等法律事实用语。

patterns.name: 法条细分项
patterns.context: 法律论证中引用法条的 subdivision，常与 section 编号、括号内分项及其适用或内容说明相邻。

patterns.name: 法条引用中的 section
patterns.context: section 后接法律编号，常伴随 subdivision、标题编号、违规行为或法条要件。

patterns.name: 案件标题与诉讼角色
patterns.trigger: «Object»10ing« Cred»2itor；« Chapter»6 13« Trustee；« Bankruptcy»2« Appellate»1« Panel»9
patterns.context: 案件名称、当事人身份、上诉方或司法机构等标题信息中，激活落在法律角色或机构称谓上。
patterns.domain: 破产案件标题与程序信息

patterns.name: 诉讼程序与裁判措辞
patterns.context: 描述上诉、请求、裁判或主张时出现；同段还可能含法条引用。

patterns.name: 法律身份及定罪记录
patterns.context: 讨论重罪、定罪、罪名要件或定罪记录如何处理；有时与 subdivision 引用并现。

patterns.name: 破产程序与财产/债权
patterns.context: 破产案件中涉及债务人、申请日、财产、留置权、受托人或债权人。
patterns.domain: 破产法判决与案件标题

patterns.name: 刑事管制物质及刑法条文
patterns.context: 列举受管制物质并引用美国法典相关刑事条款。

patterns.name: 地块与分区用语
patterns.context: 描述住宅区增建地块的规划、地块编号及街道；“subdivision”在此为土地分区而非条文分项。
patterns.domain: 地产、土地规划法律事实

patterns.name: 遗产管理身份
patterns.context: 介绍遗产管理人及其与原告的关系。

patterns.name: 单独出现的章节标题标记
patterns.context: 破产法段落中引用 Bankruptcy Act 条款及其子款，周围讨论受托人取得的权利。

en.concept: Legal text structure and clause citations
en.description: Primarily responds to hierarchical statutory numbering and parenthetical/subsection structure in U.S. legal texts. Also covers case captions, litigation roles and procedural language, criminal-law vocabulary, formal clause language, and one narrative about notice of evidence.

patterns.name: Hierarchical statutory numbering
patterns.context: When regulations or opinions cite clauses, hierarchical numbers appear adjacent to parentheses, letters, and digits; also occurs in quotations of statutory text.

patterns.name: Legal document titles and litigation roles
patterns.context: Identifies parties, litigation roles, document types, and court jurisdiction in case captions, court headings, or opinion text.

patterns.name: Legal procedure and adjudicative language
patterns.context: Procedural and adjudicative terms used to describe appeals, claims, disputed allegations, or holdings.

patterns.name: Offense names and criminal procedure in statutory citations
patterns.context: Discusses convictions, penalties, criminal liability, criminal statutes, or charges, often alongside statutory numbering.

patterns.name: Formal normative language in legal texts
patterns.context: Uses formal, prescriptive language when regulations or contract clauses set out rules, tax rates, payment obligations, or clause content.
patterns.domain: Regulations, contracts, and quoted clauses in opinions

patterns.name: Evidence and notice in ordinary legal narratives
patterns.context: Describes delivery of materials, service of notice, and related dates; does not clearly follow a clause-numbering pattern.

patterns.name: Clause-structure words and local activation around compound numbering
patterns.context: The marker may fall on token boundaries, numbering symbols, or adjacent clause structures in statutory citations; it also occurs in numbered contract sections, beyond statutory content.

1_2105.concept: 法律文本结构与条款引用
1_2105.description: 主要响应美国法律文本中的层级法条编号及其括号、子项结构；也覆盖案件抬头、诉讼角色与程序措辞、刑事法律词汇、正式条款用语，以及一处证据通知叙事。

patterns.name: 法条分层编号
patterns.context: 法规或判决引用条款时，编号层级及括号、字母、数字紧邻出现；也可见于法条内容的引述。

patterns.name: 法律文书标题与诉讼角色
patterns.context: 案件标题、法院抬头或判决正文中标示当事人、诉讼身份、文书类型及法院管辖信息。
patterns.domain: 法院判决、破产案件文书

patterns.name: 法律程序与裁判措辞
patterns.context: 叙述上诉、诉讼请求、争议主张或裁判结论时出现的程序及裁判词汇。

patterns.name: 法规引用中的罪名与刑事诉讼用语
patterns.context: 讨论定罪、刑罚、刑事责任、刑法条文或指控，常伴随法条编号。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的正式规范措辞
patterns.context: 法规或合同条款说明规则、税率、付款义务或条款内容时，使用正式的规范和规定性措辞。
patterns.domain: 法规、合同及判决中的条款引述

patterns.name: 普通法律叙事中的证据与通知
patterns.context: 叙述材料交付、通知送达及相关时间事实；不明显属于条款编号模式。

patterns.name: 条款结构词与复合编号的局部激活
patterns.context: 标记可能落在法条引文的分词边界、编号符号或紧邻的条款结构上；除法条内容外，亦出现在合同分段编号。

en.concept: Structure and procedural terminology in legal documents
en.description: Primarily responds to legal texts, especially subsection numbering and court procedure and adjudicative language. Also covers tax clauses, case captions, litigation stages, appeals of fines and fees, and summary judgment, with one isolated patent-application citation.

patterns.name: Subsection structure in statutory numbering
patterns.context: In legal texts, citations to regulations often contain sub/subdivision/subsection/subd. and parenthetical hierarchical numbering; activation concentrates on tokenized citation fragments and numbering tokens.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw legal opinions, judgments, and statutory citations

patterns.name: Court procedure and adjudicative language
patterns.context: In criminal or civil legal narratives, activation falls on procedural or adjudicative terms such as appeal, ruling, pleading, trial, and conviction; these often co-occur with statutory citations but are not limited to clause numbering.

patterns.name: Titles and proper-name formatting in legal texts
patterns.context: Capitalized title words, proper names, and their formatting fragments in case captions or party identification lines.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw case captions / bankruptcy case names

patterns.name: Statutory tax provisions and tax rates
patterns.context: Statutes or litigation contexts describing the source of tax payments, tax collection, or the subjects to which tax rates apply.

patterns.name: Patent and technical background citations
patterns.context: The background art lists issued patents or co-pending applications; activation falls on terms denoting patent-document categories.

patterns.name: Damages phase and case progression
patterns.context: Describes subsequent case proceedings using stage names for liability determination and damages proceedings.

patterns.name: Appeals involving fines and fees
patterns.context: States that an appeal concerns only an erroneous calculation or collection of a fine, surcharge, or litigation costs.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw appeals and criminal procedure rules

patterns.name: Procedural summary judgment language
patterns.context: Cites civil procedure rules to describe entry of a default judgment or summary judgment against the nonmoving party based on pleadings, depositions, written responses, and other materials.

1_2105.concept: 法律文书中的结构与程序术语
1_2105.description: 主要响应法律文本，尤其法规分项编号及法院程序、裁判用语；也覆盖税条款、案件标题、诉讼阶段、罚费上诉和总结判决，并有专利申请引文这一孤例。

patterns.name: 法条编号中的分项结构
patterns.context: 法律文本中引用法规时，编号前后常出现 sub/subdivision/subsection/subd. 及括号层级编号；激活集中于这些引用片段中的分词和编号 token。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律意见、判决及法规引文

patterns.name: 法院程序与裁判用语
patterns.context: 刑事或民事司法叙述中，激活落在上诉、裁判、诉状、审判及定罪等程序或裁判词语；常与法条引用同现，但并非只限于法条编号。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的标题与专名格式
patterns.context: 案件标题或当事人身份行中出现大写标题词、专名及其排版片段。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 案件标题／破产案名

patterns.name: 法定税收及税率条款
patterns.context: 描述税款来源、税收征收或税率适用对象的法条或诉讼背景。

patterns.name: 专利与技术背景引文
patterns.context: 背景技术部分列举已授权专利或共同待审申请，激活落在专利文献类别词上。

patterns.name: 损害赔偿阶段及案件推进
patterns.context: 概述案件后续安排时，以阶段名称描述责任认定和损害赔偿程序。

patterns.name: 罚金与费用上诉事项
patterns.context: 说明上诉仅涉及罚金、附加费或诉讼费用的错误计算或征收。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 上诉及刑事程序规则

patterns.name: 程序性总结判决措辞
patterns.context: 引用民事诉讼规则，说明根据诉状、证言、书面答复等材料作出缺席／不利于非动议方的总结判决。

en.concept: Statutory subdivisions and appellate phrasing in U.S. judgments
en.description: Activations are concentrated in U.S. legal texts, with “subdivision/subd” and parenthetical numbering in statutory citations as the most stable pattern; other contexts include “point/error” formats for appellate grounds, and criminal, procedural, tax, engineering, and family-law terminology.

patterns.name: Subdivision in statutory numbering
patterns.context: A specific statute or subdivision is cited in a legal text; activations mainly involve fragments of subdivision and parenthetical numbers, especially hierarchical statutory numbering.

patterns.name: Claims of error in appellate judgments
patterns.context: An appellate opinion or judgment summary describes a party’s grounds for appeal; common formats include point of error/point followed by alleged trial-court error.

patterns.name: Criminal conviction and sentencing terminology
patterns.context: Criminal cases discuss convictions, offenses, sentences, prior records, or the admissibility of evidence; some terms occur incidentally in statutory text.

patterns.name: Judgment and litigation-procedure language
patterns.context: Describes litigation history, court rulings, or appeals; words are broadly distributed and are not necessarily the most direct activation triggers.

patterns.name: Partition legal terminology and service of materials
patterns.context: Discusses contractors, owners, material supply, and deadlines for service of notice; “material” is marked as split in the source, and it is uncertain whether the word itself is the trigger.

patterns.name: Tax rates and tax provisions
patterns.context: Involves statutory interpretation of taxes, tax rates, or tax revenues; activations still mainly fall on adjacent fragments of statutory numbering terms.

patterns.name: Death or personal injury damages context
patterns.context: Describes the division of marital property or retirement benefits; co-occurs with appellate-court claims of error phrasing in other passages.

1_2105.concept: 美国判决中的法条分项与上诉表述
1_2105.description: 激活集中于美国法律文本，尤以法条引用中“subdivision/subd”及括号编号最稳定；另见上诉理由的“point/error”格式，以及刑事、程序、税务、工程和家庭法术语。

patterns.name: 法律条文编号中的 subdivision
patterns.trigger: “subdivision”/“subd”以及紧随其后的“(”和字母、数字编号，如“Sub»4«division»10« (»1i)” “subd»5.« (»2a)”“«sub»4«division»9« (»1a...)”
patterns.context: 法律文本中引用具体法条或分项；激活主要落在 subdivision 的词片及括号编号，尤其是条文层级编号。

patterns.name: 上诉判决中的错误主张
patterns.trigger: “point”及邻近的“error”或“the trial court erred”，如“first point of error” “first point ... the trial court erred”
patterns.context: 上诉意见或判决摘要叙述一方提出的上诉理由；常见格式为 point of error/point followed by alleged trial-court error。

patterns.name: 刑事定罪及刑罚相关词语
patterns.context: 刑事案件中讨论定罪、罪名、刑罚、前科或证据是否可采；部分词语仅偶然出现在法条内容中。

patterns.name: 判决与诉讼程序措辞
patterns.context: 叙述诉讼经过、法院裁决或上诉；词语分布较广，且未必是最直接的激活触发点。

patterns.name: 分割的法律术语及材料送达
patterns.context: 讨论承包商、业主、材料供应与通知送达期限；“material”在原文中被切分标记，触发是否与该词本身有关不确定。
patterns.domain: 建筑工程款或留置权判决

patterns.name: 税率与税收条款
patterns.context: 涉及税款、税率或税收收入的法规解释；激活点仍主要落在相邻的条文编号词片上。

patterns.name: 死亡或人身伤害赔偿语境
patterns.trigger: “wife be paid $10,000”“retirement plan’s payments”“interest in the benefits”
patterns.context: 叙述夫妻财产或退休福利分配；与其他段落中上诉法院错误主张的措辞并存。

en.concept: Clauses and litigation language in U.S. legal texts
en.description: Activations are concentrated in U.S. legal texts, especially subdivision/subsection and statutory numbering. They also occur in appellate and adjudicative procedure language in opinions and extend to legal contexts involving remedies, construction payments, tax law, and criminal procedure.

patterns.name: Markers of statutory sublevels
patterns.context: Subdivision/subsection and similar hierarchical terms, along with their numbers and letter markers, appear in statutory text or citations in opinions; markers are often split across multiple tokens, with related activations concentrated on word endings or numbering markers

patterns.name: Procedural and adjudicative language in court opinions
patterns.context: Opinions or litigation materials describe party roles, grounds for appeal, court rulings, and trial proceedings; activation may occur on specific legal terms or fixed phrases
patterns.domain: Opinions, appellate opinions, and procedural narratives

patterns.name: Judicial remedy terms in case citations
patterns.context: Legal discussion cites legal encyclopedias or case materials and refers to remedies and their categories

patterns.name: Construction payments and notice facts
patterns.context: Factual accounts concerning owners, contractors, material suppliers, and payment notices, including whether notice was timely
patterns.domain: Construction, payment, or lien dispute opinions

patterns.name: Tax rate provisions in tax law
patterns.context: A bill or tax provision specifies the taxpayer, tax type, and applicable rate

patterns.name: Conviction and sentencing stages in criminal cases
patterns.context: Narratives about a defendant’s competency, conviction, and proceedings after the guilty phase but before sentencing

1_2105.concept: 美国法律文本中的条款与诉讼表述
1_2105.description: 激活集中于美国法律文本：尤其是 subdivision/subsection 及条文编号；也见于判决中的上诉、裁判程序表述，并延伸到救济、工程款、税法和刑事程序等法律语境。

patterns.name: 法律条文的细分层级标记
patterns.trigger: « subdiv»«isions»、« Sub»«division»、« Sub»«section»，以及紧随其后的“(f)”“(2i)”“(2b)”“(2a)”“B”等
patterns.context: 法律条文或判决引用中，出现 subdivision/subsection 等条文层级词及其编号、字母标记；标记常被拆成多个 token，相关激活集中在词尾或编号标记

patterns.name: 法院裁判文书中的程序与裁判表述
patterns.trigger: “Objecting Creditor”“Appellant's first point”“point of error”“trial court erred”“appeal followed”“found Defendant competent”
patterns.context: 法院判决或诉讼材料叙述当事人身份、上诉理由、法院裁定及审判过程；可能在特定诉讼术语或固定句式处激活
patterns.domain: 判决书、上诉意见及诉讼程序叙述

patterns.name: 判例引用中的司法救济术语
patterns.context: 法律论述引用法律百科或判例资料，出现救济方式及其分类条目
patterns.domain: 法律论证、法律百科引用

patterns.name: 建筑工程款与通知事实叙述
patterns.context: 围绕业主、承包商、材料供应商及付款通知的事实叙述，讨论通知是否及时
patterns.domain: 建筑工程、工程款或留置权争议判决

patterns.name: 税法中的税率规定
patterns.trigger: “graduated tax imposed upon individuals, estates and trusts”及“rate”
patterns.context: 法案或税收条款说明纳税主体、税种及税率的适用规定

patterns.name: 刑事定罪与量刑阶段叙述
patterns.context: 刑事案件叙述被告能力、定罪及有罪阶段后、量刑前的程序

en.concept: Legal clause citations and legal texts
en.description: Primarily responds to clause numbering and subdivision/subsection/section citations in legal texts, and also to criminal procedure, evidence, and tax-opinion language. One passage on chromatography materials and procedures differs from the legal pattern.

patterns.name: Subdivision in statutory numbering
patterns.context: Appears in statutory, opinion, or regulatory citations, usually with a number or introducing an explanation of a specific clause.

patterns.name: Section citations
patterns.context: Section combined with a number forms a statutory or tax provision citation; subdivision/subsection may occur nearby.
patterns.domain: Legal opinions, tax, and regulatory texts

patterns.name: Statutory procedure or legal-status vocabulary
patterns.context: Legal discussion describes conviction, punishment, offense elements, liability, or admissibility of evidence; no single fixed trigger word.
patterns.domain: Criminal law, evidence law, and judicial opinions

patterns.name: Disputes and adjudicative language in court opinions
patterns.context: States issues, party positions, or questions reviewed by the court in a judicial opinion.

patterns.name: Tax-law terminology
patterns.context: Tax statutes, tax opinions, or tax-authority proceedings.

patterns.name: Chromatography procedures and materials
patterns.context: Describes sample components and solvents, stationary phases, or materials used in thin-layer chromatography.

1_2105.concept: 法律条款引文及法律文本
1_2105.description: 主要响应法律文本中的条款编号与 subdivision/subsection/section 引文，也涉及刑事程序、证据和税务判决用语；另有一段色谱实验材料与步骤，和法律模式不同。

patterns.name: 法律条文编号中的 subdivision
patterns.context: 出现在法条、判决或法规引文中，通常带编号，或引出对具体条款的说明。

patterns.name: section 法条引文
patterns.context: section 与数字组成法条或税法条款引文；有时邻近 subdivision/subsection。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、税务与法规文本

patterns.name: 法定程序或法律状态词汇
patterns.context: 法律论述中描述定罪、刑罚、犯罪构成、责任或证据可采性；并非单一固定词触发。
patterns.domain: 刑法、证据法及司法意见

patterns.name: 法院意见的争议与裁判表述
patterns.context: 在司法意见中陈述争点、当事方立场或法院审查的问题。

patterns.name: 税务法律术语
patterns.context: 税法、税务判决或税务机关程序语境。

patterns.name: 色谱实验步骤与材料
patterns.context: 描述样品组分及薄层色谱的溶剂、固定相或材料。
patterns.domain: 生物医学/化学方法文本（PubMed Central）

en.concept: Statutory citations in U.S. legal texts
en.description: Primarily activates on references to statutory subsections and their numbering in case law, and on expressions introducing statutory text. Also covers criminal, tax, civil-remedy, litigation-procedure, service, and bankruptcy-caption contexts.

patterns.name: Subdivision/subsection in statutes
patterns.context: Statutory numbering, subsection markers, or references to specific statutory content; often introduces a clause’s application, provisions, or contents at the beginning or within a sentence.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and statutory texts (FreeLaw)

patterns.name: Quoting specific statutory provisions
patterns.context: Explains a statute or subsection’s provisions, application, or amounts; often followed by quoted statutory text.

patterns.name: Legal procedure and judicial reasoning
patterns.context: Describes a party’s appeal, a court’s ruling, and claims of error, often using appellate-opinion reasoning patterns.

patterns.name: Offenses and penalties
patterns.context: Mentions offenses, convictions, penalties, or criminal liability; sometimes embedded in statutory interpretation.

patterns.name: Legal damages and remedies
patterns.context: Discusses damages calculations or injunctive relief; this example concerns a legal reference and argument about uncertainty in the amount of damages.
patterns.domain: Civil legal argument and legal encyclopedia citations

patterns.name: Tax rates and taxation in statutes
patterns.context: Involves taxes, tax rates, or tax revenue, alongside statutory provisions or related litigation.

patterns.name: Legal notice and service
patterns.context: Describes when the owner was notified after delivery of materials and the circumstances of service, followed by the appellant’s legal argument.
patterns.domain: Construction or materials payment dispute case law

patterns.name: Bankruptcy case captions and party designations
patterns.context: Appears in case-caption-style headings listing the debtor, objecting creditor, and opposing party.

1_2105.concept: 美国法律文本中的条款引用
1_2105.description: 主要对判例中引用法规子款及其编号、引出条文内容的表达激活；也覆盖刑事、税务、民事救济、诉讼程序、送达和破产标题等多类法律语境。

patterns.name: 法条中的 subdivision/subsection
patterns.context: 法条编号、子款标记或对具体条款内容的引用；常在句首或句中引出条款的适用、规定或内容。

patterns.name: 引述法规具体规定
patterns.trigger: « provides»、« states»、« applies»、« fixes»，以及 «"[» 或 «"(» 后的引文起始
patterns.context: 围绕法条或子款说明其规定、适用或数额；常接引号内的法规原文。

patterns.name: 法律程序与判决论证
patterns.context: 叙述当事人上诉、法院裁判及对裁判错误的主张，常出现 appellate opinion 的论证句式。

patterns.name: 犯罪与刑罚相关表述
patterns.context: 提及罪名、定罪、刑罚或刑事责任；有时嵌在法规条文解释中。

patterns.name: 法律上的损害与救济
patterns.context: 讨论损害赔偿的计算或禁令救济；本例为法律资料引证及对损害数额不确定性的论述。
patterns.domain: 民事法律论述与法律百科引证

patterns.name: 法条中的税率及税收
patterns.context: 涉及税款、税率或税收收入，并与法案条款或相关诉讼相邻。

patterns.name: 法律通知与送达
patterns.context: 描述材料交付后通知业主的时间及送达情况，随后提出上诉方的法律主张。
patterns.domain: 建筑工程款或材料款纠纷判例

patterns.name: 破产案件标题与当事人称谓
patterns.context: 出现在判例首页式标题中，列出债务人、异议债权人及对方当事人。

en.description: Primarily responds to statutory names, subdivision numbers, and their interpretation in legal texts, commonly in case-law and regulatory citations; also responds to one case caption, a passage of litigation language, and the suffix in Auctions in an email, with the latter patterns of unclear relation to the main pattern.

patterns.name: Statutory subdivisions and parenthetical numbering
patterns.context: In statutory citations or legal texts, a statute name is adjacent to numeric or lettered subdivision numbers; especially token fragments Sub/division or Sub/section followed by a number.
patterns.domain: Case law, statutes, and legal opinions

patterns.name: Explanation of subdivisions in statutory language
patterns.context: Legal texts explain the scope, content, or elements of a statutory subdivision; co-occurs with the statutory numbering pattern.

patterns.name: Court litigation and appellate language
patterns.context: Describes a party’s appeal, a court ruling, or a claim that a lower court erred; some passages also cite statutes.

patterns.name: Case citations and party captions
patterns.context: Citations, case captions, and party identity information at the beginning of judgments or bankruptcy cases.

patterns.name: Auction-related word form
patterns.context: The name of the Yahoo! Auctions website in a commercial email; unrelated to statutory or litigation contexts.

1_2105.concept: 法律条款及分项编号
1_2105.description: 主要响应法律文本中法条名称、分项编号及其释义，常见于判例和法规引用；也响应一处案件标题、一段诉讼措辞及邮件里的 Auctions 词尾，后几类与主模式关系不明。

patterns.name: 法条分项与括号编号
patterns.trigger: «section»、«subdivision»、«subdivisions»、«Sub»«division»、«Sub»«section»，以及紧随其后的如« (»1b)、« (»1i)、« (»1a) 等编号
patterns.context: 法条引用或法律文本中，法条名称与数字、字母分项编号相邻；尤其分词片段 Sub/division 或 Sub/section 后接编号。

patterns.name: 法条措辞中的细分说明
patterns.context: 法律文本解释某个分项适用范围、条款内容或构成要件；与法条编号模式同现。

patterns.name: 法院诉讼与上诉措辞
patterns.context: 叙述当事人上诉、法院裁判或主张下级法院错误；部分段落同时引用法条。

patterns.name: 判例引注与案件当事人标题
patterns.context: 判决或破产案件开头的引注、案件标题与当事人身份信息。

patterns.name: 拍卖相关词形
patterns.context: 商业邮件中的 Yahoo! Auctions 网站名称；与法条、诉讼语境无关。

en.concept: Structure of legal opinions and statutory subsections
en.description: Primarily responds to “subdivision/subsection” and numbering that identify statutory subsections in legal texts. It also responds more weakly to opinion terminology, party roles, and signatures and opening phrases in appellate opinions.

patterns.name: Statutory subsection terminology
patterns.context: Subdivision/subsection labels appear in quotations or interpretations of legal provisions, often with parenthetical numbering and statute numbers.

patterns.name: Propositions and adjudicative language in legal reasoning
patterns.context: The court considers a party’s legal argument, admissibility of evidence, or whether a judgment was proper.

patterns.name: Litigation roles in case captions
patterns.context: A bankruptcy caption lists the objecting creditor and parties to the case.

patterns.name: Judicial signatures and appellate-opinion phrasing
patterns.context: The opening of an opinion lists the panel of judges and uses a standard phrase to state that the defendant appealed the judgment.

1_2105.concept: 法律判决结构与法条分项
1_2105.description: 主要对法律文本中标示法条分项的“subdivision/subsection”及编号敏感；另对判决论证术语、案件当事人身份和上诉判决的署名与开头句式有较弱响应。

patterns.name: 法条分项术语
patterns.context: 法律条文引述或解释中，出现 subdivision/subsection 等分项标签，常伴随括号编号和法条号。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的命题与裁判用语
patterns.context: 法院讨论当事人的法律主张、证据可采性或判决是否适当。

patterns.name: 案件标题中的诉讼身份
patterns.context: 破产案件标题列出提出异议的债权人及案件当事人。

patterns.name: 法院署名与上诉裁判句式
patterns.context: 判决开头列出合议法官，并以标准句式说明被告对判决提起上诉。

en.concept: Procedural and subsection terminology in legal texts
en.description: Primarily responds to statutory subdivisions and court-procedure language in legal texts. Also covers case captions, tax summonses, injunction citations, and activation on the ending of “auctions” in advertising and resale contexts.

patterns.name: Statutory subdivision terminology
patterns.context: In regulatory or opinion citations, refers to a statutory subdivision, numbered clause, or its application; tokenization indicates activation on multiple subword fragments of subdivision.

patterns.name: Appellate language in legal opinions
patterns.context: Appears in opinions describing a defendant’s or party’s appeal, trial, conviction, and court ruling.

patterns.name: Legal document titles and litigation roles
patterns.context: Appears in case captions or party descriptions; the third passage is a bankruptcy case caption.
patterns.domain: U.S. court case captions, bankruptcy documents

patterns.name: Tax authorities and summonses
patterns.context: Describes a lawyer being required to testify under a tax summons.

patterns.name: Injunction terminology in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in legal discussion and secondary citations concerning damages and remedies.

patterns.name: Auction-related form “Auctions”
patterns.context: Refers to Yahoo! Auctions in an advertisement and to physical auctions in a product-resale description; the triggering fragment is the ending of auctions.
patterns.domain: Commercial advertising, consumer and resale descriptions

1_2105.concept: 法律文本中的程序与分款术语
1_2105.description: 主要响应法律文本中 subdivision 法条分款及法院程序用语；也覆盖案件标题、税务传票、禁令引证，并对 auctions 的词尾在广告与转售语境中激活。

patterns.name: 法条 subdivision 术语
patterns.context: 在法规或判决引述中，指向法条的分款、款项编号或其适用内容；分词标记显示激活落在 subdivision 的多个子词片段上。
patterns.domain: 美国法律文本，法条引述

patterns.name: 法律判决中的司法上诉表述
patterns.context: 出现在判决叙述被告或当事人上诉、审判、定罪及法院裁判的语境中。

patterns.name: 法律文书标题与诉讼角色
patterns.context: 出现在案件标题或当事人身份描述中；第3段是破产案件标题。
patterns.domain: 美国法院案件标题、破产法文书

patterns.name: 税务机关及传票
patterns.context: 描述律师依税法传票被要求出庭作证。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的禁令术语
patterns.context: 出现在关于损害赔偿及救济的法律论述和二手法律引证中。
patterns.domain: 法律参考文献、救济与禁令

patterns.name: 拍卖相关词形 Auctions
patterns.context: 在广告中指 Yahoo! Auctions，在商品转卖说明中指实体拍卖；触发片段是 auctions 的词尾部分。
patterns.domain: 商业宣传、消费与转售说明

en.concept: Statutes and litigation terminology in legal texts
en.description: Primarily responds to statutory subdivisions and numbering in legal texts, and also covers opinions, appeals, criminal convictions, tax disputes, and procedural roles. One instance is the auction-promotion term “Auctions” in an email, which does not naturally fit the legal pattern.

patterns.name: Subdivision in statutory text
patterns.context: Appears in regulations or in opinions quoting or interpreting statutes, often followed by numbers and parenthetical subsection numbers such as “(1b)” or “(1a)”; also includes the related term “Subsection”.

patterns.name: Litigation and appellate language in opinions
patterns.context: Appears in court opinions or case narratives concerning parties, grounds for appeal, convictions, or requests for relief.

patterns.name: Disputes and adjudicative language in legal documents
patterns.context: Used to state issues pending decision, arguments, or determinations of validity in tax or regulatory disputes.

patterns.name: Convictions and penalties in criminal cases
patterns.context: Concerns a felony conviction, a post-incarceration petition to change the conviction classification, or statutes concerning child sex offenses.

patterns.name: Statutory numbering and citation structure
patterns.context: Cites specific statutes, regulations, or code provisions in legal texts; often co-occurs with subdivision/subsection.

patterns.name: Internal tax rates and tax terminology
patterns.context: Discusses tax rates, tax years, or taxpayer eligibility; occurs alongside statutory citations.

patterns.name: Administrative and legal procedure roles
patterns.context: Describes parties in an estate proceeding or procedures for summoning a witness for investigation by a government agency.
patterns.domain: Civil litigation and administrative enforcement legal texts (FreeLaw)

patterns.name: Shopping promotion term in email
patterns.context: Appears in the context of the Yahoo! Auctions website and an email promotion to win a car, unlike the legal-text pattern.

1_2105.concept: 法律文本中的法条与诉讼术语
1_2105.description: 主要响应法律文本中的法规分款与法条编号，也覆盖判决、上诉、刑事定罪、税务争议及程序角色等法律语境；另有一例邮件中的“Auctions”拍卖促销词，无法与法律模式自然统一。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的 subdivision
patterns.context: 出现在法规、判决对法条的引述或解释中，常接编号及括号中的子款编号，如“(1b)”“(1a)”；也包括相近的“Subsection”。

patterns.name: 判决中的诉讼与上诉用语
patterns.trigger: « propositions»、« reversal»、« action»、« appeals»、« conviction»、« petition»、« error»、« contends»
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见书或案件叙述中，涉及当事人、上诉理由、定罪或请求救济。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的争议与裁判表述
patterns.context: 在税务或法规争议的论述中，用于陈述待决问题、主张或效力判断。

patterns.name: 刑事案件中的定罪与刑罚
patterns.context: 与重罪定罪、服刑后申请变更定罪分类，或涉及儿童性犯罪的法条有关。

patterns.name: 法条编号与引用结构
patterns.context: 法律文本中引用具体法条、法规或法典条款；常与 subdivision/subsection 同现。

patterns.name: 内部税率与税务术语
patterns.trigger: « tax»、« imposed»、« individuals»、« estates»、« trusts»、« taxable»
patterns.context: 讨论税率、纳税年度或纳税人资格；与法条引用并存。

patterns.name: 行政与法律程序角色
patterns.trigger: « administr»atrix、« defendant»、« plaintiff»、« agent»、« Service»、« summons»
patterns.context: 描述遗产诉讼中的当事人或传唤证人接受政府机构调查的程序。
patterns.domain: 民事诉讼及行政执法法律文本（FreeLaw）

patterns.name: 电邮中的购物促销词
patterns.context: 出现在雅虎拍卖网站和赢取汽车的促销邮件语境中，与法律文本模式不同。

en.concept: Statutes and litigation language in U.S. case law
en.description: Primarily responds to statutory subdivision citations and language about criminal convictions and appellate grounds in U.S. case law; also appears in tax provisions, estate litigation, court procedure, and sex-offense statutes.

patterns.name: Statutory subdivision and subdivision/section terminology
patterns.context: When statutes or judgments cite provisions, especially when explaining the content, scope, or legal effect of a subdivision or subsection.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and statutory law

patterns.name: Criminal convictions and appeals
patterns.context: Litigation narratives describing a defendant’s conviction, criminal charges, post-conviction relief, or appeal from a conviction.

patterns.name: Listing appellate grounds
patterns.context: An appellate opinion or judgment summary introduces multiple legal claims or alleged errors raised by a party.

patterns.name: Estate administrator in estate litigation
patterns.context: Introduces a party to estate litigation and their status as an estate administrator.

patterns.name: Statutory provisions for taxes and interest penalties
patterns.context: Statutes specify tax rates or taxable parties, or prescribe how interest and penalties are to be retained.

patterns.name: Court, trial, and judgment citations
patterns.context: Marks the trial process, court rulings, or judge information in a judgment; often adjacent to a case’s appellate narrative.

patterns.name: Sex-offense statutes
patterns.context: Cites statutes addressing child sex offenses and describes the categories of offenses listed in them.

1_2105.concept: 美国判例中的法律条文与诉讼措辞
1_2105.description: 主要响应美国判例中法条分项引用及刑事定罪、上诉理由等措辞；也出现在税法规定、遗产诉讼、法院程序和性犯罪法规语境。

patterns.name: 法条分项与 subdivision/section 术语
patterns.context: 法条或判决引用法规条文时，尤其是说明 subdivision、subsection 的内容、适用范围或法律效果。

patterns.name: 刑事定罪与上诉
patterns.context: 描述被告定罪、犯罪指控、定罪后救济或对定罪提出上诉的诉讼叙述。

patterns.name: 上诉理由的列举
patterns.context: 上诉意见或判决概述中，介绍当事人提出的多个法律主张或错误理由。

patterns.name: 遗产诉讼中的遗产管理人
patterns.context: 介绍遗产诉讼当事人及其作为遗产管理人的身份。

patterns.name: 税款与利息罚金的法定规定
patterns.context: 法规规定税率、征税对象，或规定利息与罚金如何保留。

patterns.name: 法院、审判及判决引用
patterns.context: 判决书中标示审判过程、法院裁判或法官信息；常与案件上诉叙述相邻。

patterns.name: 性犯罪案件法规
patterns.context: 引用针对儿童性犯罪案件的法规，并说明法规列举的犯罪类别。

en.concept: Structure and terminology in legal case law
en.description: Primarily responds to statutory subsection citations in case law (especially subdivision/subsection), litigation claims, grounds for appeal, and criminal-conviction terminology. Also involves localized legal contexts such as estate parties, tax rates, opinion title formatting, and notices of payment for building materials.

patterns.name: Subdivision/subsection in statutes
patterns.context: Cites subdivisions or subsections in legal opinions or regulatory citations and explains their application, content, or effect
patterns.domain: Regulations, legal reasoning in case law

patterns.name: Litigation claims and judgment terminology
patterns.context: A court opinion lists parties’ claims, grounds for appeal, or requests to vacate a judgment

patterns.name: Convictions and criminal-case terminology
patterns.context: Discusses criminal convictions, offense elements, penalties, or criminal appeals

patterns.name: Party roles in estate litigation
patterns.context: Identifies the estate administrator and parties to a civil lawsuit
patterns.domain: Factual section of a civil opinion

patterns.name: Tax rates and taxable subjects
patterns.context: A bill provision sets progressive tax rates on individuals, estates, and trusts
