patterns.name: Fortune-telling claims about coffee, love, and domestic happiness
patterns.context: In dream or symbolic interpretations, connects the properties of coffee to love, friendship, and domestic happiness.

1_2341.description: 激活主要集中于 independence（含殖民独立、地方自治及南北战争语境）；另涉及销量 copies、出版者、音乐人员名单、absent，以及占卜文案中的 domestic happiness。

patterns.name: “independence”及其政治语境
patterns.context: 出现 independence，尤其指国家独立、脱离殖民统治或地方自治；也出现在美国南北战争相关历史叙述中。
patterns.domain: 历史、政治、民族独立及地方自治；Wikipedia、Gutenberg、Pile-CC

patterns.name: 销量与复制品数量
patterns.context: 描述游戏或音乐作品发行后售出的数量，常与作品、专辑、游戏及时间节点相邻。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 的游戏、音乐及销量条目

patterns.name: 出版与出版从业者
patterns.context: 触发词位于出版者、出版公司或出版相关职业描述中。
patterns.domain: 音乐版权信息、浪漫小说作者简介

patterns.name: 乐器与音乐制作人员
patterns.trigger: « string»7 instruments；« backing»2 vocals；« acoustic»3 guitar
patterns.context: 出现在歌曲或专辑的人员、乐器与演奏/演唱分工名单中。

patterns.name: 非政治语境中的“absent”
patterns.context: 讨论公司中是否存在政治现象时，以 absent 描述某些地方缺少这种现象。

patterns.name: 咖啡、爱情与家庭幸福的占卜式说法
patterns.context: 在梦境或象征解释中，将咖啡的性质联系到爱情、友谊及家庭幸福。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 的通俗占卜/梦境解释文案

en.concept: Vocabulary of work releases and sales
en.description: Primarily responds to vocabulary related to work releases, sales statistics, and associated publishing, gaming, and music terms, especially copies denoting items after a number; sporadic triggers include game-genre terms, within in a poem, and contained in a project context.

patterns.name: copies after a quantity sold
patterns.context: Immediately follows a sales figure to indicate the number of physical or digital copies sold; sometimes followed by sold at the end of the sentence.
patterns.domain: Sales statistics for records, games, bestsellers, etc.; encyclopedia and email text

patterns.name: Work releases and reissues
patterns.context: Describes the release or re-release of a work, game, or film, or a release date; not every occurrence is adjacent to sales.

patterns.name: Work and media categories or release-channel vocabulary
patterns.context: In contexts involving publishing, games, or work releases, triggers include terms related to media categories, publishers, or work titles.
patterns.domain: Romance author biographies, game and film encyclopedias

patterns.name: Music charts and sales performance
patterns.context: Descriptions of album or single chart positions, weekly chart performance, and sales figures.

patterns.name: Fantasy/action genre labels in game titles
patterns.context: A genre description after a game title, categorizing it as a dark fantasy action-adventure game.

patterns.name: within in a phrase
patterns.context: within indicating place or an internal position in a poem; no clear connection to work sales or publishing contexts.

patterns.name: contained in project setup
patterns.context: Discusses a project, domain names, and online services being brought together in one place; activation falls on contained, not a sales term.

1_2341.description: 主要响应作品发行、销量统计及其相关出版、游戏和音乐语汇，尤其是数字后表示副本的 copies；另有游戏类型词、诗句中的 within 和项目语境中的 contained 等零散触发。

patterns.name: 售出数量后的 copies
patterns.context: 紧接销量数字，用于表示售出的实体或数字副本；有时句尾再接 sold。
patterns.domain: 唱片、游戏、畅销书等销量统计；百科和邮件文本

patterns.name: 作品发布及再版
patterns.context: 描述作品、游戏或电影的发行、再发行或发行节点；并非所有出现都紧邻销量。

patterns.name: 作品与媒体类别或发行渠道词汇
patterns.context: 围绕出版、游戏或作品发行的语境，触发点是媒体类别、出版方或作品命名相关词。
patterns.domain: 爱情小说作者简介、游戏与电影百科

patterns.name: 音乐榜单与销售表现
patterns.context: 专辑或单曲的榜单名次、周榜表现及销售数量描述。

patterns.name: 游戏名称中的 fantasy/action 题材标签
patterns.context: 游戏标题之后的类型描述，组合成暗黑奇幻动作冒险游戏的类别介绍。

patterns.name: 短语中的 within
patterns.trigger: “« within»5 thine own deep sunken eyes”
patterns.context: 诗句中表示处所或内在位置的 within；与作品销量或出版语境无明显联系。

patterns.name: 项目搭建中的 contained
patterns.context: 谈论项目、域名与在线服务被集中在同一处；激活落在 contained，而非销量词。

en.concept: Word forms and common subword fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered: prominent ones occur on -able (laughable), -less (winless), and deleted, alongside sporadic adverbs, numbers, and common function words; there is no unified semantic or domain pattern.

patterns.name: Suffix -able
patterns.context: Forms an adjective after a root, especially laughable; activation falls on able.

patterns.name: Suffix -less
patterns.context: Combines with win to form a word meaning without wins, appearing in winless drought/streak.

patterns.name: -itled suffix / debut-related participle
patterns.context: In album descriptions, self-titled modifies debut album.

patterns.name: deleted for removed content
patterns.context: Describes deleted scenes in films or television programs/series removed from an archive.
patterns.domain: Film and television encyclopedia, TV archives

patterns.name: Quantity or ordinal numbers
patterns.context: Numbers appear in sports scores, statistics, or split text fragments; the context of the latter is unclear.

patterns.name: Adverbs of range or degree
patterns.context: Adverbs or degree/range modifiers occur in evaluative narrative; the triggers are not consistent with one another.

patterns.name: Anaphoric or temporal adverbs
patterns.context: Various instances indicate duration, past time, or joint participation, with no shared local syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Grammatical function words and common word fragments
patterns.context: Distributed across different syntactic positions; may reflect weak activations or fragment boundaries, with no stable shared condition.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, online discussions, music reviews

1_2341.description: 激活模式分散：显著落在 -able（laughable）、-less（winless）及 deleted 等词片段，也覆盖零散副词、数字和常见小词；没有统一语义或领域。

patterns.name: 后缀 -able
patterns.context: 在词根后形成形容词，尤其是 laughable；激活落在 able 部分。

patterns.name: 后缀 -less
patterns.context: 在 win 后构成表示缺乏胜利的词，出现在 winless drought/streak 中。

patterns.name: 后缀 -itled / debut 相关分词
patterns.context: 专辑介绍中，self-titled 修饰 debut album。

patterns.name: 删除内容的 deleted
patterns.context: 说明影视作品中的删减场景，或节目/系列从档案中被删除。

patterns.name: 数量或序数数字
patterns.context: 数字出现在体育比赛比分、统计或被拆分的文本片段中；后者上下文不明确。
patterns.domain: 体育报道；HackerNews 文本片段

patterns.name: 范围或程度副词
patterns.context: 副词或程度/范围修饰语出现在评价性叙述中；触发词彼此并不一致。

patterns.name: 回指或时间副词
patterns.context: 分别表示时间延续、过去时间或共同参与，缺乏共同局部句法模式。
patterns.domain: 百科、体育报道、音乐介绍

patterns.name: 语法性小词与常见词片段
patterns.context: 分布于不同句法位置，可能是弱激活或片段边界影响，未见稳定共同条件。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、网络讨论、音乐评论

en.description: Activations are distributed across specific words or subword fragments: able in laughable, contained, deleted scenes, and sensibility, absent, and independently; contexts span film, sports, reviews, military, and music, with no unified theme apparent.

patterns.name: Suffix in laughable
patterns.context: Evaluates a person or viewpoint as absurd or ridiculous; modifies comparisons involving a player and descriptions of a company.

patterns.name: contained
patterns.context: Describes something as confined, controlled, or kept in a closed state; examples include a ghost being imprisoned, gambling being difficult to control, and rations being self-contained.
patterns.domain: Film plots, social commentary, military ration descriptions

patterns.name: deleted scenes
patterns.context: Mentions deleted footage in film releases or production materials.
patterns.domain: Film reviews, descriptions of film extras

patterns.name: sensibility
patterns.context: Discusses an author's judgment or perception in writing articles.

patterns.name: absent
patterns.context: Discusses whether political factors are lacking in certain companies.

patterns.name: independently
patterns.context: Describes a musician independently releasing an album.

1_2341.description: 激活分散在若干具体词项或子词上：laughable 中的 able、contained、deleted scenes，以及 sensibility、absent、independently；语境跨影视、体育、评论、军事与音乐，未见统一主题。

patterns.name: laughable 的后缀
patterns.context: 评价某人或某观点荒唐、可笑；分别修饰对球员的比较和对公司的描述。
patterns.domain: 体育评论、科技/商业评论

patterns.name: contained
patterns.context: 描述某物被限制、控制或维持在封闭状态；包括幽灵被关押、赌博难以管控，以及口粮自成一体。
patterns.domain: 影视剧情、社会评论、军事口粮介绍

patterns.name: deleted scenes
patterns.context: 提及电影发行或制作资料中的删减片段。
patterns.domain: 电影评论、电影附加内容介绍

patterns.name: sensibility
patterns.context: 谈论作者具备写作文章的判断力或感知力。

patterns.name: absent
patterns.context: 讨论某些公司是否缺少政治因素。

patterns.name: independently
patterns.context: 描述音乐人独立发行专辑。

en.description: Primarily responds to contexts about music releases, unreleased tracks, and record sales and charts; other instances include the contrastive word Nevertheless, an abstract-noun suffix fragment, and Swedish internal subword activations, with no clear connection to the music pattern.

patterns.name: Record releases and chart/sales contexts
patterns.context: Describes album or single releases, chart positions, and sales figures, especially expressions such as “sold … copies” and “album chart”

patterns.name: Unreleased or re-released music material
patterns.context: The stem released occurs in un«released» or re-«released», referring to album tracks, audio, or film re-releases

patterns.name: Contrastive or concessive conjunction nevertheless
patterns.context: In a personal blog, after introducing a cosmetics collection and the surprise it caused, nevertheless introduces what follows

patterns.name: Internal fragments in Swedish words
patterns.context: In continuous Swedish text, activation falls on segmented morphemes or subwords; no clear semantic or syntactic commonality is evident

patterns.name: Abstract noun suffix -ibility
patterns.context: In an Apple-related comment, activation falls on the ending fragment of sensibility; this is a single instance, so no independent semantic pattern can be established

1_2341.description: 主要对音乐发行、未发行曲目及唱片销量榜单语境反应；另有单例转折词 Nevertheless、抽象名词词尾片段，以及瑞典语词内子词激活，未显示与音乐模式的明确联系。

patterns.name: 唱片发行及榜单销量语境
patterns.trigger: «copies»9、«chart»/«charts»、«peaked»、«#»；常与专辑、发行、销量数字相邻
patterns.context: 描述专辑或单曲的发行、榜单名次、销售数量，尤其是“sold … copies”“album chart”等表达

patterns.name: 未发行或重新发行的音乐材料
patterns.context: 词根 released 出现在 un«released» 或 re-«released» 中，谈论唱片曲目、音源或电影再发行

patterns.name: 转折或让步连接词 nevertheless
patterns.context: 个人博客中在介绍化妆品收藏及其带来的震惊后，以 nevertheless 转入后续内容

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语连续文本中，激活落在被拆分的词素或子词上；未见清晰的语义或句法共性

patterns.name: 抽象名词后缀 -ibility
patterns.context: Apple 相关评论中，激活落在 sensibility 的词尾片段；单例，不能确定独立语义模式

en.description: Strong activations often fall on the English or French adjective endings -able/-ible, especially in laughable and lovable in English; there are also released, titled, and multiple within-word fragment activations in French sentences.

patterns.name: Judgments of ridiculousness, implausibility, or absurdity
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of negatively evaluative adjectives; the target may be a comparison, claim, opinion, or market idea.

patterns.name: Describing people or things as lovable
patterns.context: Describes appealing qualities of a person, group, or character.
patterns.domain: Literary narratives, film reviews, children's book descriptions

patterns.name: The English adjective endings -able/-ible
patterns.context: Activation falls on adjective or noun ending fragments; different roots have different meanings, and the endings themselves do not always convey the same semantics.

patterns.name: The French adjective ending -able
patterns.context: Activation falls on French adjective endings, in contexts evaluating the effects of a crisis and describing product quality, respectively.

patterns.name: released in English participles/derivatives
patterns.context: Activation falls on the string released in contexts related to release or re-release; one occurrence has a negative prefix, and another has the re- prefix.

patterns.name: Local activation on the English ending -itled
patterns.context: Activation covers titled in a phrase describing the naming of a work; its relation to the strongly activated endings in other passages is unclear.

patterns.name: Within-word character-fragment activation in French
patterns.context: Multiple internal subword fragments in words are marked in a long French sentence, including “par conséquent,” “les effets,” and “pleinement évaluables”; they do not map exactly to a single morpheme.

patterns.name: Within-word character-fragment activation in French (legal text)
patterns.context: Multiple internal word fragments are activated in a sentence about EU legislation and the quality of animal-origin products; there is also the explicit ending in “irréproch«able».”

1_2341.description: 强激活多落在英语或法语的形容词词尾 -able/-ible，英语中尤见 laughable、lovable；另有 released、titled及法语句中多处词内片段激活。

patterns.name: 可笑、不可信或荒谬的判断
patterns.context: 出现在带有负面评价的形容词结尾；对象可以是比较、论断、观点或市场设想。

patterns.name: 形容人物或事物可爱
patterns.context: 描述人物、群体或角色的讨喜特质。
patterns.domain: 文学叙述、电影评论、儿童读物介绍

patterns.name: 英语形容词的 -able/-ible 词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在形容词或名词的词尾片段；不同词根对应不同含义，词尾本身并不总带有相同语义。

patterns.name: 法语形容词词尾 -able
patterns.context: 激活落在法语形容词的词尾，分别处于评价危机影响、描述产品质量的语境。

patterns.name: 英语过去分词/派生词中的 released
patterns.context: 激活落在与发行、重发有关的 released 字符串中；一处是否定前缀，一处是 re- 前缀。
patterns.domain: 百科音乐条目、电影资料

patterns.name: 英语词尾 -itled 的局部激活
patterns.context: 在描述作品命名的短语中，激活覆盖 titled；与其他段的高激活词尾是否相关不明。

patterns.name: 法语词内字符片段激活
patterns.context: 长法语句中多个词的内部子词片段被标记，包含“par conséquent”“les effets”“pleinement évaluables”；不完全对应单一词素。

patterns.name: 法语词内字符片段激活（法律文本）
patterns.context: 关于欧盟立法、动物源产品质量的句子里，多个词内部片段有激活，另有明确的“irréproch«able»”词尾。

en.description: Activations mainly occur on the French dest- word family and English contained; other sporadic word-form fragments include sensibility, sauna, dominance, and malheureusement. The fragments belong to varied semantics and registers, with no unified theme.

patterns.name: «destiné» word-form activation
patterns.context: French forms beginning with dest-, especially destiné / destinataires; activation falls on a stem fragment, while meanings and syntactic environments vary.
patterns.domain: European Parliament text, French email disclaimers

patterns.name: «contenu/contained» word-form activation
patterns.context: In English, describes a state of being controlled, restricted, or kept within a range; the two instances concern a ghost and sports betting, respectively.

patterns.name: «-ility»-related word forms
patterns.context: A suffix fragment within the English word “sensibility”, referring to an author's judgment; no repeated occurrence of the same word is evident.

patterns.name: «sau-»-related fragment
patterns.context: An internal fragment of “sauna” in a hotel amenities description, in a list of facilities; single instance.

patterns.name: «dominance» word-form fragment
patterns.context: An English noun describing overwhelming superiority in a golf tournament; single instance.

patterns.name: «malheureusement» word-form activation
patterns.context: A segmented form of the French adverb malheureusement, expressing regret or misfortune; single instance.

1_2341.description: 激活主要落在法语 dest- 词族及英语 contained；另有 sensibility、sauna、dominance 和 malheureusement 等零散词形片段。不同片段分属多种语义与文体，未见统一主题。

patterns.name: «destiné»词形激活
patterns.context: 法语中以 dest- 开头的词形，尤其是 destiné / destinataires；激活落在词干片段，词义和句法环境不同。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会文本、法语邮件免责声明

patterns.name: «contenu/contained»词形激活
patterns.context: 英语中形容被控制、限制或维持在某种范围内的状态；两处分别谈幽灵与体育博彩。

patterns.name: «-ility»相关词形
patterns.context: 英语词 “sensibility” 内部的词尾片段，谈作者的判断力；未见同词重复。

patterns.name: «sau-»相关片段
patterns.context: 酒店设施介绍中的 “sauna” 词内片段，处于列举配套设施的语境；单例。

patterns.name: «dominance»词形片段
patterns.context: 英语名词，描述高尔夫赛事中的压倒性优势；单例。

patterns.name: «malheureusement»词形激活
patterns.context: 法语副词 malheureusement 的分段词形，表达遗憾或不幸；单例。

en.description: Activations often fall on the ending of the Swedish word “grundläggande,” the English word “borderline,” and fragments of the French word “heureusement”; others occur across different words and languages, with no unified contextual condition and no clear overall pattern.

patterns.name: Core fragment of the Swedish word “grundläggande”
patterns.context: The word occurs in expressions such as “basic freedoms and democracy,” “basic issues,” “basic debate,” and “of fundamental importance”; the target activation falls on a word-ending fragment, not a consistent syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Formal political texts in Swedish from the European Parliament

patterns.name: English borderline
patterns.context: The word form itself is highlighted; in one instance it modifies RB (running back), and in another describes a woman, with clearly different meanings and contexts.
patterns.domain: English sports discussions and online commentary

patterns.name: French heureusement
patterns.context: The adverb occurs in a sentence to mean “fortunately”; the surrounding meaning differs between the two examples.

patterns.name: Other highlighted within-word fragments
patterns.context: Highlights fall on within-word fragments or endings in different languages, with no pattern explained by shared semantics or syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: Swedish, English, and other European Parliament languages; parliamentary and encyclopedia texts

1_2341.description: 激活多落在瑞典语“grundläggande”词尾、英语“borderline”和法语“heureusement”片段；其余散见不同词语与语种，缺少统一上下文条件，整体规律不清。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词形“grundläggande”的核心片段
patterns.context: 该词出现在“基本自由与民主”“基本问题”“基本辩论”“基本重要性”等表达中；目标激活落在词尾片段，而非一致的句法位置。
patterns.domain: 瑞典语欧洲议会正式政治文本

patterns.name: 英语 borderline
patterns.context: 词形本身被突出；一处修饰 RB（跑卫），另一处形容 woman，语义与语境差异明显。
patterns.domain: 英语体育讨论与网络评论

patterns.name: 法语 heureusement
patterns.context: 副词出现在句中，表达“幸运地／令人庆幸地”；两例周围句意不同。

patterns.name: 其他词内高亮片段
patterns.context: 高亮落在不同语言的词内片段或词尾，未见可由共同语义或句法条件解释的模式。
patterns.domain: 瑞典语、英语及其他欧洲议会语种；议会与百科文本

en.description: All snippets are production credits for Project Gutenberg e-books, especially those containing “Online Distributed Proofreading Team”; they are often followed by the http:// and www URL prefixes.

patterns.name: Distributed in Gutenberg production credits
patterns.context: Appears in the credit format “Produced by … and the Online Distributed Proofreading Team”; this word is marked as strongly activated, while Online is also weakly activated.
patterns.domain: Project Gutenberg e-book production credits / text digitization metadata

patterns.name: Online in credits
patterns.context: Immediately precedes “Distributed Proofreading Team,” after the production credits.
patterns.domain: Project Gutenberg e-book production credits / text digitization metadata

patterns.name: URL prefix after credits
patterns.context: Immediately follows the Proofreading Team credit as the beginning of the project URL; activation is weak, and www is not marked in every snippet.
patterns.domain: Web addresses / e-book copyright and production notes

1_2341.description: 所有片段均为Project Gutenberg电子书的制作署名，尤其出现“Online Distributed Proofreading Team”；常伴随署名后的http://及www网址前缀。

patterns.name: Gutenberg制作署名中的 Distributed
patterns.context: 出现在“Produced by … and the Online Distributed Proofreading Team”署名格式中；该词被标记为强激活，Online也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: Project Gutenberg电子书制作署名／文本数字化元数据

patterns.name: 署名中的 Online
patterns.context: 紧邻“Distributed Proofreading Team”之前，在制作人员署名之后。
patterns.domain: Project Gutenberg电子书制作署名／文本数字化元数据

patterns.name: 署名后的网址前缀
patterns.context: 紧随Proofreading Team署名之后，作为项目网址开头；激活较弱，且并非每段都标记www。
patterns.domain: 网页地址／电子书版权与制作说明

en.description: All excerpts are Project Gutenberg production credits; the strongest trigger is concentrated on “Distributed,” commonly in “Online Distributed Proofreading Team.” URLs and other wording in production notes also occasionally show weaker activation.

patterns.name: Project Gutenberg proofreading team credits
patterns.context: Production credits at the beginning of an e-book list contributors, followed by the proofreading team name; “Distributed” is the most consistent and strongest trigger, often alongside “Online” and “Proofreading Team.”

patterns.name: URL in production credits
patterns.context: A URL pointing to the Project Gutenberg website appears at the end of the credit line; URL token activation is weak and is unmarked in some excerpts.

patterns.name: Alternative production-note wording
patterns.context: Introduces production staff with “E-text prepared by” instead of “Produced by,” then still mentions the proofreading team.

1_2341.concept: Project Gutenberg 校对团队署名
1_2341.description: 所有片段均为 Project Gutenberg 制作署名；最强触发集中在“Distributed”，常见于“Online Distributed Proofreading Team”，网址及制作说明的其他措辞也偶有较弱激活。

patterns.name: Project Gutenberg 校对团队署名
patterns.trigger: « Distributed»10/« Distributed»9；常与« Online»相邻，出现在“the Online Distributed Proofreading Team”中
patterns.context: 电子书开头的制作人员说明中，列出贡献者后接校对团队名称；“Distributed”是最稳定、最强的触发词，周围常有“Online”“Proofreading Team”。
patterns.domain: Project Gutenberg 电子书前置说明

patterns.name: 制作人员说明中的网址
patterns.context: 署名行末尾出现指向 Project Gutenberg 网站的 URL；网址 token 的激活较弱，个别片段中未标记。
patterns.domain: 电子书制作说明中的网址

patterns.name: 替代制作说明措辞
patterns.context: 以“E-text prepared by”而非“Produced by”引出制作人员，随后仍提到校对团队。
patterns.domain: Project Gutenberg 电子书前置说明

en.description: Primarily responds to “Online Distributed Proofreading Team” in Gutenberg production credits and “edition” following an ordinal indicating an edition number; activation also occurs in a volleyball title and inside a long Swedish word, which may not share the same semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Gutenberg copyright-page credit formula
patterns.context: An e-book production staff list is followed by Online Distributed Proofreading Team, often with a URL afterward

patterns.name: edition after an ordinal
patterns.context: In an event or activity description, an ordinal indicates the edition number, often in the structure “Nth edition”

patterns.name: Internal fragment of the word edition
patterns.context: Activation falls on a word boundary or internal subword in a volleyball league title; distinct from the “edition” pattern

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a Swedish word
patterns.context: A subword fragment inside a long Swedish word, concerning shipbreaking and environmental hazards

1_2341.description: 主要响应Gutenberg制作人员署名中的“Online Distributed Proofreading Team”，以及序数词表示届次的“edition”；另有排球标题和瑞典语长词内部片段的激活，未必共享同一语义模式。

patterns.name: Gutenberg版权页署名公式
patterns.trigger: the «Online»«Distributed» Proofreading Team；Produced by / E-text prepared by
patterns.context: 电子书制作人员名单后接 Online Distributed Proofreading Team，常继续出现网址

patterns.name: 序数词后的 edition
patterns.context: 赛事或活动介绍中，序数词说明届次，常见结构为“第N届”
patterns.domain: 网页活动介绍、体育赛事百科

patterns.name: edition单词的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词边界或词内子词上，语境为排球联赛标题；与“edition”模式不同

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语长词内部的子词片段，涉及拆船及环境危害

en.description: Responds to the production-credit template at the beginning of Gutenberg e-books, especially “Online Distributed Proofreading Team”; it also responds weakly to the following http://www URL fragment.

patterns.name: PG e-text production credits
patterns.context: Appears in production credits at the beginning of a book text, often connected to “Produced by [name] and the”; “Distributed” activates most strongly, and “Online” also activates.

patterns.name: Web address in the credit line
patterns.context: The production credit is followed by “at http://www”; the URL portion also activates weakly.
patterns.domain: Project Gutenberg e-book front matter and URL

1_2341.description: 响应 Gutenberg 电子书开头的制作署名模板，尤其是“Online Distributed Proofreading Team”；也对紧随其后的 http://www 网址片段有较弱响应。

patterns.name: PG 电子文本制作署名
patterns.context: 出现在书籍文本开头的制作人员署名中，常与“Produced by [姓名] and the”相连；“Distributed”激活最强，“Online”也激活。
patterns.domain: Project Gutenberg 电子书前置信息

patterns.name: 署名行中的网页地址
patterns.context: 制作署名后接“at http://www”，网址部分也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: Project Gutenberg 电子书前置信息及网址

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: several Swedish parliamentary texts contain far+ande forms, alongside other Swedish fragments; the remaining cases involve attraction in an academic title, the ending of Horace, released in a song entry, and a Teradata technical title.

patterns.name: Swedish ending “farande”
patterns.context: This word form and nearby word fragments activate in Swedish; no sentence-initial position or specific syntactic position is required.

patterns.name: “Sexual Attraction” in a title
patterns.context: A phrase in an English paper title describing men's same-sex sexual attraction and hiding that attraction in offline settings.

patterns.name: Dean within a proper name
patterns.context: A final fragment of the English name Horace; the name is repeated immediately afterward in the same entry.

patterns.name: released in a song entry
patterns.context: Describes a song's release; often co-occurs with words such as song, single, band, or release year.
patterns.domain: English song entries and music descriptions

patterns.name: Time interval macro parameter
patterns.context: A StackExchange question title concerns Teradata macro parameters and time intervals.

patterns.name: Other Swedish word fragments
patterns.context: Falls within words or near word boundaries in Swedish sentences; the fragments differ, and the available contexts are insufficient to identify a shared trigger condition.

1_2341.description: 激活模式分散：瑞典语议会文本中多次出现 far+ande 词形，也有其他瑞典语片段；其余分别涉及论文标题中的吸引、Horace 词尾、歌曲条目的 released，以及 Teradata 技术标题。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词尾「farande」
patterns.context: 瑞典语中该词形及其附近词片段激活；不要求句首或特定句法位置

patterns.name: 标题中的“Sexual Attraction”
patterns.context: 英文论文标题中描述男性对同性的性吸引、且在离线环境隐藏该吸引的短语

patterns.name: 专名内部的 Dean
patterns.context: 英文人名 Horace 的词尾片段；同一条目紧接着重复该人名
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科人物条目标题

patterns.name: 歌曲条目中的 released
patterns.context: 歌曲介绍中说明歌曲发行；常与 song、single、乐队或发行年份等词共现
patterns.domain: 英文歌曲条目及音乐介绍

patterns.name: 时间间隔宏参数
patterns.context: StackExchange 问题标题以 Teradata macro 参数和 time interval 为主题

patterns.name: 瑞典语其他词片段
patterns.context: 在瑞典语句子中落在词内或词边界附近；这些片段彼此不同，现有上下文不足以确定共同触发条件

en.description: Activation is scattered across word-form fragments in Scandinavian negation contexts involving någon/några, the ending of the English proper noun Charlton, and fragments in several English terms, names, and credits. The examples have no shared clear semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: Scandinavian negation words triggered by missing words
patterns.context: Appears in negation or restriction expressions, often with words meaning “none/any,” such as “ikke … nogen,” “må ikke … nogen,” and “några ledamöter”; strong activation falls on word-form fragments

patterns.name: Charlton in an English word ending
patterns.context: Appears as the final subword fragment of the proper noun Charlton; contexts mention speaker Charlton Heston and Charlton Athletic

patterns.name: Ending of a term for same-sex attraction
patterns.context: Appears in the phrase “Same-Sex Sexual Attraction,” as an ending fragment of the term Attraction

patterns.name: Ending in a term for dancers
patterns.context: Appears near the beginning of “soloists” in an entry explaining categories of ballet company members, alongside terms such as dancer, ballet, and group

patterns.name: Online proofreading project name
patterns.context: Appears in production credits in Gutenberg text, immediately adjacent to “Online … Proofreading Team”

patterns.name: Name fragment in a legal record
patterns.context: Appears as an internal fragment of the name Ronnie, followed by a middle initial and surname

1_2341.description: 激活分散于多类词形片段：斯堪的纳维亚语否定环境中的 någon/några、英语专名 Charlton 的词尾，以及若干英语术语、人名和署名中的片段。各例没有共同清晰的语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: 缺词触发的斯堪的纳维亚语否定词
patterns.context: 出现在否定或限制表达中，常与表示“没有/任何”的词搭配，如“ikke … nogen”“må ikke … nogen”“några ledamöter”；强激活落在词形片段上
patterns.domain: 丹麦语、瑞典语议会文本

patterns.name: 英语词尾中的 Charlton
patterns.context: 作为专名 Charlton 的末尾子词片段出现；上下文分别提到演讲者 Charlton Heston 和 Charlton Athletic

patterns.name: 隐匿性吸引对象术语的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在短语“Same-Sex Sexual Attraction”中，是术语 Attraction 的词尾片段

patterns.name: 舞蹈演员术语中的词尾
patterns.context: 在解释芭蕾舞团成员类别的条目中，出现在“soloists”一词前部，且与 dancer、ballet、group 等术语同现

patterns.name: 在线校对项目名称
patterns.context: 出现在 Gutenberg 文本的制作署名中，紧邻“Online … Proofreading Team”

patterns.name: 法律记录中的人名片段
patterns.context: 作为人名 Ronnie 的词内片段，后接缩写中间名及姓氏
patterns.domain: 美国法律文书／人员名单

en.description: Activation is scattered across Swedish word endings, English contained, and subwords in several isolated English words and proper nouns. Aside from repeated word forms in the Swedish parliamentary passages, no stable semantic or formal pattern covers all snippets.

patterns.name: Swedish internal fragments of “förfarande/fortfarande”
patterns.context: In continuous Swedish text, the trigger falls on an ending that crosses a subword boundary; snippets 1 and 6 contain “fortfarande,” while snippets 7 and 8 contain “förfarande.”

patterns.name: contained
patterns.context: Describes something being restricted, controlled, or confined in English sentences; one example concerns sports betting being difficult to control, another a monster being confined.

patterns.name: Sexual-attraction ending
patterns.context: “attraction” in an English title, specifically referring to concealed same-sex sexual attraction in offline settings.

patterns.name: edition
patterns.context: Refers to the tenth edition of a series of events in an English event description.

patterns.name: Dancer-category ending
patterns.context: In the ballet term “soloists,” activation falls on the stem “solo,” followed by an unmarked ending.

patterns.name: ton in a proper noun
patterns.context: The subword “ton” inside the proper noun “Huntington Beach,” with no apparent semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Project file link in an Enron email

1_2341.description: 激活分散在瑞典语词尾、英文 contained 及若干孤立英文词或专名子词上；除瑞典语议会段存在重复词形外，未见能覆盖所有片段的稳定语义或形式规律。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内“förfarande/fortfarande”的分词
patterns.context: 瑞典语连续文本中，触发落在跨子词边界的词尾；第1、6段是“fortfarande”，第7、8段是“förfarande”。

patterns.name: contained
patterns.context: 英文句中描述事物被限制、控制或关押；一处指体育博彩难以被控制，一处指怪物被关押。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 网络文本；Wikipedia 叙事

patterns.name: 性吸引词尾
patterns.context: 英文标题中的“attraction”，具体指线下环境中隐藏的同性性吸引。

patterns.name: edition
patterns.context: 英文活动介绍中指某系列活动的第十届。

patterns.name: 舞者类别词尾
patterns.context: 芭蕾舞术语“soloists”中，激活落在词干“solo”上，后接未标记词尾。

patterns.name: 专名中的ton
patterns.context: 专名“Huntington Beach”内部的子词“ton”，没有明显语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的项目文件链接

en.description: Activation is distributed across music works and charts, performers, technical endings, French fragments, sports reporting, and event editions; evidence is insufficient to show a single semantic trigger across snippets.

patterns.name: Word-final or internal morpheme “ton”
patterns.context: Appears in proper nouns or compound technical terms, such as Moulton; may also activate alongside other ending fragments.

patterns.name: stepp(er)-related words
patterns.context: Appears in algorithm implementation names or medical device names; the same word appears twice in snippet 3 and appears in stepper-stabilizer in snippet 6.

patterns.name: Song or music-work entries
patterns.context: In song titles or descriptions of musicians’ work, covering composition, release, and chart information; activation is not fixed to a particular music-related word.

patterns.name: Charts, sales, and release-format information
patterns.context: Describes rankings, sales, number of copies, or release media formats for albums or records.

patterns.name: Performer groups or band performances
patterns.context: Describes ballet dancer categories, dance company composition, or bands and their stage lineups.

patterns.name: Internal French fragments and function words
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments and short function words in continuous French text; no stable semantic theme shared with other snippets is apparent.

patterns.name: Common words in sports reporting
patterns.context: Appears in a recap of a Boston–Montreal game, describing head-to-head records and team performance.

patterns.name: Dates and event editions
patterns.context: A page-style event description states the event edition after the date.

1_2341.description: 激活分布于音乐作品与榜单、表演者、技术词尾、法语片段、体育报道及活动届次；跨段没有足够证据证明由单一语义触发。

patterns.name: 词尾或词中 morpheme “ton”
patterns.context: 出现在专名或复合技术词中，如 Moulton；同时可与其他词尾片段共同激活。

patterns.name: stepp(er) 相关词
patterns.context: 出现在算法实现名称或医疗设备名称中；第3段同一词出现两次，第6段出现在 stepper-stabilizer 中。
patterns.domain: 软件代码、医疗设备描述

patterns.name: 歌曲或音乐作品条目
patterns.context: 歌曲名称或音乐人作品介绍中，描述创作、发行及榜单信息；激活并不固定于某一音乐词。

patterns.name: 榜单、销量与发行格式信息
patterns.context: 介绍专辑或唱片的排名、销量、复制数量或发行载体格式。

patterns.name: 表演者群体或乐队演出
patterns.context: 描述芭蕾舞者类别、舞团组成，或乐队及其舞台演出阵容。

patterns.name: 法语词内片段及句法词
patterns.context: 激活落在法语连续文本中的词内片段及短功能词；未见与其他段稳定共享的语义主题。

patterns.name: 体育报道常见词
patterns.context: 出现在波士顿对蒙特利尔的比赛回顾中，描述交锋记录和球队表现。

patterns.name: 日期与活动届次
patterns.context: 页面式活动介绍中，日期之后说明活动的第几届。

en.concept: Weakly related words and tokenization fragments
en.description: Strong activations are distributed across multilingual token fragments, copies in record sales, players being released by teams, and local terms related to music albums, dance, academic titles, parliamentary speeches, and event editions; no reliable correspondence is evident in the Swedish passages.

patterns.name: Multilingual fragments within tokenized words
patterns.context: When a word is split into multiple tokens, activation falls on part of the word; the word meanings and full parts of speech are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Mixed English, Swedish, French, and other-language corpus

patterns.name: copies in release and sales data
patterns.context: Album sales are expressed as a number followed by copies, often preceded by sold, million, or a specific sales figure; this is the strongest trigger in all three passages.
patterns.domain: Music encyclopedias and record sales descriptions

patterns.name: released in professional sports
patterns.context: A player is released by a team or no longer retained, usually after season or appearance records.

patterns.name: Music album-related words
patterns.context: Descriptions of album releases, charts, and editions; apart from copies, activations are weaker and the words are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Highlighted fragments in fixed titles
patterns.context: Occurs in a research title describing men's same-sex sexual attraction and online dating; activation is distributed across title words.

patterns.name: Areas of action in parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: A French political speech mentions several areas of action during the president's term.

patterns.name: Groups/soloists in dance terminology
patterns.context: Explains ballet dancer categories and groups made up of non-soloists.

patterns.name: Dates and editions
patterns.context: An event page lists dates and mentions the tenth edition of an event; strong activation is concentrated on edition.

1_2341.concept: 弱相关的词项与分词片段
1_2341.description: 强激活分散于多语言分词片段、唱片销量中的 copies、球员被球队 released，以及音乐专辑、舞蹈、学术标题、议会讲话和活动版次等局部词项；瑞典语段未见可靠对应。

patterns.name: 分词内部的多语言片段
patterns.context: 词被拆成多个 token 时，激活落在词的一部分；词义和完整词类并不一致。
patterns.domain: 英语、瑞典语、法语等混合语料

patterns.name: 发行与销售数据中的 copies
patterns.context: 专辑销量以数字加 copies 表达，前文常有 sold、million 或具体销量；在三个段落中均为最强触发。
patterns.domain: 音乐百科及唱片销量描述

patterns.name: 职业体育中的 released
patterns.context: 球员被球队释放或不再留用，通常出现在赛季、出场记录之后。

patterns.name: 音乐专辑相关词
patterns.context: 专辑发行、排行榜、版次等描述；除 copies 外，触发较弱且词项不完全一致。

patterns.name: 固定标题中的高亮片段
patterns.context: 出现在研究标题中，描述男性同性性吸引及线上约会；激活分散在标题词中。

patterns.name: 议会讲话中的行动领域
patterns.context: 法语政治讲话中提及主席任期的若干行动领域。

patterns.name: 舞蹈术语中的团体/独舞者
patterns.context: 解释芭蕾舞者类别及非独舞者组成的群体。

patterns.name: 日期与版次
patterns.context: 活动页面列出日期，并提到某活动的第十届；强激活集中在 edition。

en.description: Activation is distributed across internal fragments and short words in multiple languages, and also appears in ballet terminology, hostnames, event editions, tennis courts, and hockey commentary; no stable unified semantic trigger spans the snippets.

patterns.name: Dance roles and soloists
patterns.context: Explains categories of ballet dancers and the distinction between corps dancers and soloists

patterns.name: Game consoles and platform names
patterns.context: Introduces announcements and game consoles from Microsoft, Sony, and Nintendo

patterns.name: Ordinals and version/edition expressions
patterns.context: Ordinals indicate an event or performance edition; month names appear in date contexts
patterns.domain: Event and sports entries, web dates

patterns.name: Internal fragments and affixes
patterns.context: Activation falls on stems, internal fragments, or endings of ordinary English words across different parts of speech, with no unified semantics

patterns.name: Internal French fragments and morphology
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments in continuous French text, involving word forms and characters inside word boundaries

patterns.name: Project names and URL fragments
patterns.context: An energy project description includes a project name, URL marker, and part of a place name

patterns.name: Description of an outdoor clay court
patterns.context: A tennis event entry describes court conditions

patterns.name: Hockey season and game evaluation
patterns.context: Reviews recent head-to-head games and assesses the matchup and team performance

patterns.name: French pronouns and common internal fragments
patterns.context: In parliamentary text, activation is distributed across internal or short fragments in pronouns, verbs, prepositions, and nouns

1_2341.description: 激活分布于多语种词内片段及短词，也出现在芭蕾术语、主机名、赛事届次、球场和冰球评论中；跨段缺少稳定统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 舞蹈角色与独舞者
patterns.context: 解释芭蕾舞者类别及群舞与独舞的区别

patterns.name: 游戏主机与平台名称
patterns.context: 介绍微软、索尼、任天堂的发布会及游戏主机

patterns.name: 序数与版本／届次表达
patterns.context: 赛事或演出介绍中用序数说明届次；日期语境中出现月份名称
patterns.domain: 活动、赛事条目及网页日期

patterns.name: 词内片段与词缀
patterns.context: 激活落在普通英语单词的词干、内部片段或词尾，片段跨越不同词类，缺少统一语义

patterns.name: 法语词内片段与形态变化
patterns.context: 激活落在连续法语文本中的词内片段，涉及词形及词边界内部字符
patterns.domain: 法语议会演讲／政治文本

patterns.name: 项目名称及网址片段

en.description: Activation often falls on internal fragments or word endings, spanning French word forms, dance terminology, literary endings, and descriptions of dates, events, games, devices, and people. Languages, topics, and corpora differ substantially, with no unified semantic trigger evident.

en.description: Activations are scattered across word-initial, medial, and final fragments, as well as complete words, in English and French; they cover inflection, domain terminology, and function words across corpora and styles, with no stable semantic condition apparent.

patterns.name: French within-word fragments

en.concept: Evan strings and adjacent name text
en.description: Primarily responds to Evan at a word boundary, covering personal names and the place name Evanston; activation usually falls on Evan, with a few cases extending to adjacent name fragments. The Danny Welbeck/transfer headline in segment 9 cannot be explained by this pattern.

patterns.name: Evan string
patterns.context: “Evan” appears at a word boundary in text such as names and institutional addresses; it is followed by different strings, including Sharp, Herod, Hughes, Rodriguez, Blass, Vucci, and ston.

patterns.name: Evan concatenated in a name entry

patterns.name: Name order in Enron lists
patterns.context: In semicolon-separated name lists, Evan is followed by Herod; activation also falls on adjacent name fragments.

patterns.name: Place name Evanston
patterns.context: The substring Evan in the place name Evanston is marked; it occurs in a railway route description and a university address.

patterns.name: Author/cartoonist names

patterns.name: Player name Evan Rodriguez

patterns.name: Journalist byline Evan Blass

patterns.name: Photographer credit Evan Vucci

patterns.name: Evan Hughes in an email address

patterns.name: Welbeck in a football report
