en.description: Strongly responds mainly to the letter string Evan: it appears both in personal names and at the beginning of the place name Evanston. Other sporadic markers occur across names, words, and formatting, with no unifying explanation. The marker in segment 9 cannot be confirmed as related to this pattern.

patterns.name: Evan name fragment
patterns.context: In names, Evan is followed by a surname or part of a surname; this name component is marked across segments and has the strongest activation.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including people lists, news bylines, email directories, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Evanston place-name fragment
patterns.context: Evan begins the place name Evanston, while the following letters are unmarked; appears in public transit descriptions and university addresses.

patterns.name: Weak activation on Evan in the name Welbeck
patterns.context: May involve footballer Danny Welbeck, but the marker falls within the name and does not form a clear Evan string; its relation to the main pattern is uncertain.

patterns.name: Other unmarked patterns
patterns.context: These activations are scattered across names, common words, numbers, or formatting markers; there is insufficient evidence to infer a stable, independent pattern.

1_2469.description: 主要对字母串 Evan 强烈响应：既见于人名，也见于 Evanston 地名开头；其他零散标记分布在姓名、词语和格式中，缺少统一解释。第9段的标记无法确证与此模式相关。

patterns.name: Evan 人名片段
patterns.context: 在姓名中 Evan 后接姓氏或姓氏的一部分；各段中此姓名成分被标记，且激活最强。
patterns.domain: 人物名单、新闻署名、邮件目录、百科条目等多种文体

patterns.name: Evanston 地名片段
patterns.context: Evan 是地名 Evanston 的开头，后续字母未标记；出现在公共交通介绍和大学地址中。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、学术论文地址

patterns.name: Welbeck 名字中的 Evan 弱激活
patterns.context: 可能涉及足球运动员 Danny Welbeck，但标记落在姓名内部且不构成明显的 Evan 字符串；无法确定是否与主模式有关。

patterns.name: 未标记的其余模式
patterns.trigger: 段内其他标记，如« Sharp»4、« Her»2、« year»2、« Poss»2
patterns.context: 这些激活分散在姓名、普通词语、数字或格式标记上；没有足够证据归纳成稳定的独立模式。

en.description: Activates mainly on the string “Evan” and its occurrences within words (e.g., Evanston), across various contexts; one other activation falls on the substring “arks” in the news headline “sparks”.

patterns.name: Evan name or string fragment
patterns.context: Appears in personal names, bylines, email addresses, or place names; in several examples it is followed by a surname or place-name suffix.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including news, email, Wikipedia, comics, sports, technology articles, and academic papers

patterns.name: Word fragment in a Welbeck headline
patterns.context: Appears in the headline Danny Welbeck transfer sparks frenzy of misquoting, with activation concentrated on a substring of sparks.

1_2469.description: 主要对字符串 “Evan” 及其词内出现形式（如 Evanston）激活，跨多种语境；另有一次激活落在新闻标题 “sparks” 的子串 “arks” 上。

patterns.name: Evan 名字或字符串片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名、署名、邮件地址，或地名中；在多个例子里后接姓氏或地名后缀。
patterns.domain: 新闻、邮件、维基百科、漫画、体育、科技文章、学术论文等多种文体

patterns.name: Wellbeck 标题中的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在标题 Danny Welbeck transfer sparks frenzy of misquoting 中，激活集中于 sparks 的子串。

en.description: Many activations focus on the name Evan (with different surnames and Evanston) and Sharp, appearing in lists, news bylines, and email addresses; sporadic triggers also occur in formatting separators, comics, transport, sports news, and mathematical fragments, with no unified context.

patterns.name: Evan name fragment
patterns.context: Evan is followed by different surnames or subsequent parts of a name; it may also occur near line breaks, punctuation, or list boundaries.

patterns.name: Sharp in name lists
patterns.context: Occurs in personal names or parallel lists; segment [1] has Evan Sharp, and segment [2] has Steve Sharp.
patterns.domain: Entrepreneur profiles and email contact lists

patterns.name: Numbering and line breaks in formatted text
patterns.context: Formatting tokens such as line breaks, numbering, and separators in web excerpts or lists; may co-occur with name triggers, but not always.
patterns.domain: Web pages, sports rosters, and other structured text

patterns.name: Discussion and comic-production terms
patterns.context: In comic entries, descriptions of works, authors, and illustrators.

patterns.name: Transport routes and direction terms
patterns.context: Descriptions of a railway branch and its service direction, including the proper noun Evanston.

patterns.name: Names and positions in player rosters
patterns.context: Numbered lists of players, position abbreviations, and schools.

patterns.name: Reporting terms in technology product articles
patterns.context: Technology news sentences describing Moto X/Z products and the source of leaked images.

patterns.name: News photo credits
patterns.context: In political news, photo captions credit a photojournalist by name and include a wire-service marker.

patterns.name: Football news word fragments
patterns.context: A headline-style phrase describing Danny Welbeck's transfer sparking a frenzy; activation is distributed across word fragments.

patterns.name: Enron email addresses and recipients
patterns.context: Names embedded in email directories or address strings made up of departments, locations, and email formats.

patterns.name: Mathematical expression fragments
patterns.context: An algebraic expression containing ind, i, numbers, multiplication signs, and plus signs; lacks name or list context.

1_2469.concept: Evan/Sharp 字符串及杂项片段
1_2469.description: 多段激活集中于人名 Evan（不同姓氏、Evanston）及 Sharp，并见于名单、新闻署名、邮箱等；另有格式分隔、漫画、交通、体育新闻和数学片段等零散触发，未形成统一语境。

patterns.name: Evan 姓名片段
patterns.context: Evan 后接不同姓氏或姓名后续部分；也可能处于换行、标点或名单边界附近。

patterns.name: 名字列表中的 Sharp
patterns.context: 出现在人物姓名或并列名单中；第[1]段 Evan Sharp，第[2]段 Steve Sharp。
patterns.domain: 创业者介绍、邮件联系人名单

patterns.name: 格式化文本中的编号与换行
patterns.context: 网页摘录或名单的换行、编号、分隔符等格式 token；与姓名触发可能共同出现，但不总是如此。
patterns.domain: 网页、体育名单及其他结构化文本

patterns.name: 讨论与漫画制作词
patterns.context: 漫画条目介绍中，描述作品及作者、画师。

patterns.name: 交通线路与方向词
patterns.context: 关于铁路支线及其服务方向的叙述，包含专名 Evanston。

patterns.name: 球员名单中的姓名及位置
patterns.context: 编号列表中列出球员、位置缩写与学校。

patterns.name: 科技产品文章中的报道词
patterns.context: 描述 Moto X/Z 产品及泄露图片来源的科技新闻语句。

patterns.name: 新闻图片署名
patterns.context: 政治新闻中，照片说明以摄影记者姓名和通讯社标记署名。

patterns.name: 足球新闻词语片段
patterns.context: 标题式短句，描述 Danny Welbeck 转会引发轰动；激活分布在词内片段。

patterns.name: Enron 邮件地址与收件人
patterns.context: 姓名嵌在部门、地点及邮箱格式构成的邮件目录或地址串中。

patterns.name: 数学公式片段
patterns.context: 代数表达式中出现 ind、i、数字、乘号与加号；缺乏姓名或名单语境。

en.description: Most fragments occur in names or proper nouns containing Evan, including people lists, bylines, news, and place names; there are also sporadic activations on Sharp, art, exclamatory dialogue, split headlines, and mathematical symbols, with no common explanation.

patterns.name: Evan in personal names
patterns.context: Names in people lists, bylines, news captions, or body text; activation falls on Evan and, in some samples, extends to the surname or adjacent token.
patterns.domain: Directories, news, comic bylines, sports rosters, corporate email

patterns.name: Evan followed by a name or part of a proper noun
patterns.context: Evan is part of a name or proper noun, followed by a surname or combined with a subsequent proper noun to form a place name, byline, etc.; specific contexts vary considerably.

patterns.name: Other local token patterns
patterns.context: These activations occur separately in personal names or comic bylines, exclamatory dialogue, split headlines, mathematical expressions, and numbered lists; there is insufficient evidence to group them under the same trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Mixed: lists, comics, news headlines, mathematical text

1_2469.description: 多数片段在姓名或专名中出现 Evan，涵盖人物名单、署名、新闻和地名；另有 Sharp、art、感叹号台词、拆分标题及数学符号等零散激活，尚无共同解释。

patterns.name: 人名中的 Evan
patterns.context: 人名列表、署名、新闻图片说明或正文中的姓名；激活落在 Evan 上，部分样本也延续到姓氏或相邻 token。
patterns.domain: 人物名录、新闻、漫画署名、体育名单、企业邮件

patterns.name: Evan 后接姓名或专名组成部分
patterns.trigger: «Evan»10ston« Express»3；« Evan»10 Blass；« Evan»10 Vucci；« Evan»10 Rodriguez
patterns.context: Evan 是名字或专名的一部分，后接姓氏，或与后续专名共同构成地名、署名等；具体上下文差异较大。

patterns.name: 其他局部 token 模式
patterns.trigger: « Sharp»4；« art»4；« jump»1 on in«!»1；«Danny»3 Wel«beck transfer»5 sp«arks»10；«ind»2« i»9；«2»3 («45»1«)»2
patterns.context: 这些激活分别出现在人名或漫画署名、带感叹号的台词、被拆分的标题、数学表达式及编号列表中；没有足够证据归并为同一触发条件。
patterns.domain: 混合：名单、漫画、新闻标题、数学文本

en.description: Activations focus on two types of strings: Evan (including Evanston) and auditory in biomedical contexts; a mathematical expression also has sporadic activations and may represent an independent pattern.

patterns.name: Evan string
patterns.context: The name or word form Evan occurs; it may be followed by a surname or serve as the beginning of a compound word.
patterns.domain: Name lists, research text, Wikipedia, news, and comic descriptions

patterns.name: Auditory-related terms
patterns.context: auditory occurs in contexts involving the auditory system, stimuli, or pathology.

patterns.name: Numbers or formatting markers
patterns.context: Numbers, letters, and punctuation interleave in a mathematical expression; activations in this segment are sporadic.

1_2469.description: 激活集中在两类字符串：Evan（含 Evanston）以及生物医学语境中的 auditory；另有一段数学表达式出现零散激活，可能是独立模式。

patterns.name: Evan 字符串
patterns.context: 人名或词形 Evan 出现；可接姓氏，也可作为复合词开头
patterns.domain: 人名列表、科研文本、维基百科、新闻及漫画介绍

patterns.name: 听觉相关词
patterns.context: 听觉系统、刺激或病理等语境中出现 auditory

patterns.name: 数字或格式化标记
patterns.context: 数学表达式中数字、字母与标点交错；该段触发分布零散

en.concept: Polysemous features of Evan and auditory terms
en.description: Strongly activates on the string “Evan” (a personal name or Evanston) and “auditory” in medical neuroscience; sporadic activations also occur on formulas, years, some name fragments, and terms from several domains, with no stable single trigger condition.

patterns.name: “Evan” as a name or place
patterns.context: Occurs in names (e.g., Evan Sharp, Evan Blass, Evan Vuc…) or in the place name Evanston; there is no fixed sentence pattern.
patterns.domain: Technology personnel lists, comic credits, geographic entries, news photo credits, and email contact lists

patterns.name: “auditory” and hearing-related terms
patterns.context: Occurs in neuroscience or medical contexts, modifying neocortical dysfunction, nerve fibers, or stimulation.
patterns.domain: NIH research project descriptions and PubMed abstracts

patterns.name: Mathematical notation and numbers
patterns.context: Isolated mathematical expression fragments; there is insufficient context to identify a specific trigger condition.

patterns.name: Date and year numbers
patterns.context: Years embedded in descriptions of engineering construction or historical service development.

patterns.name: Surname fragments in name lists
patterns.context: Names are listed separated by commas or semicolons; this partially overlaps with the “Evan” name pattern, but not every name list contains it.
patterns.domain: Technology company staff lists, comic credits, and email contact lists

patterns.name: Sporadic activations in ordinary words and titles
patterns.context: Occurs separately in slogans, work descriptions, section headings, and research project descriptions, with no stable shared condition.
patterns.domain: Web text, encyclopedia entries, and research descriptions

patterns.name: Terms in firearm and public safety reporting
patterns.context: Occurs in news excerpts related to the president, gun violence, and campus safety.

patterns.name: Clinical outcomes and temporal-lobe terms
patterns.context: Describes clinical changes in epilepsy patients and temporal-lobe discharges; occurs in the same medical context as auditory stimuli in this segment.

1_2469.description: 主要对“Evan”字样（人名或 Evanston）及医学神经科学中的“auditory”强烈激活；另对公式、年份、部分姓名片段及若干领域词语有零散激活，无法归为稳定单一触发条件。

patterns.name: “Evan”人名或地名
patterns.context: 出现在人名中（如 Evan Sharp、Evan Blass、Evan Vuc…）或地名 Evanston 中；并非固定句式。
patterns.domain: 科技人物名单、漫画署名、地理条目、新闻图片署名及邮件通讯录

patterns.name: “auditory”听觉相关词
patterns.context: 出现在神经科学或医学语境，修饰 neocortical dysfunction、nerve fibers，或 stimulation。

patterns.name: 数学记号及数字
patterns.context: 孤立的数学表达式片段；缺乏足够上下文判断具体触发条件。

patterns.name: 日期与年份数字
patterns.context: 年份嵌在工程建设或历史服务沿革的叙述中。

patterns.name: 人名列表中的姓氏片段
patterns.context: 姓名以逗号、分号分隔列出；与“Evan”人名模式有一定重叠，但并非每个姓名列表都出现。
patterns.domain: 科技公司人员名单、漫画署名、邮件通讯录

patterns.name: 普通词语及标题中的零散激活
patterns.context: 分别出现在宣传语、作品介绍、章节标题和科研项目描述中，未见稳定共同条件。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、百科条目、科研简介

patterns.name: 枪支与公共安全报道词语
patterns.context: 出现在总统与枪支暴力、校园安全相关报道片段中。

patterns.name: 临床结果与时间叶相关词语
patterns.context: 描述癫痫患者的临床变化及颞叶放电；与本段的 auditory 刺激同处医学语境。

en.description: Activations focus on Evan (including Evanston) and auditory in research contexts; a mathematical expression also activates on variables, numbers, and symbols. The contexts of these patterns differ markedly.

patterns.name: Evan in names or place names
patterns.context: The proper noun Evan occurs as a personal name or as part of a place name; the surrounding context is not fixed.
patterns.domain: News, technology personnel lists, comic credits, photo credits, railway entries, and email contact lists

patterns.name: Hearing-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of auditory nerves, auditory stimulation, or the auditory cortex.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and variables
patterns.context: Variables, numbers, and operators occur in a mathematical expression; activation is distributed near the beginning of the expression and around numbers.

1_2469.description: 激活集中于 Evan（含 Evanston）和科研语境中的 auditory；另有一段数学表达式中的变量、数字及符号激活。各模式语境差异明显。

patterns.name: 名字或地名中的 Evan
patterns.context: 出现专名 Evan，作为人名或地名的一部分；周围语境并不固定。
patterns.domain: 新闻、科技人物名单、漫画署名、照片署名、铁路条目及邮件联系人名单

patterns.name: 听觉相关词汇
patterns.context: 出现在听觉神经、听觉刺激或听觉皮层等研究描述中。
patterns.domain: 神经科学、医学及科研摘要

patterns.name: 数学符号与变量
patterns.context: 数学表达式中出现变量、数字及运算符；激活分布在表达式开头及数字周围。

en.concept: Blues strings and occasional word fragments
en.description: Most activations fall on Blues-related strings, including music genre terms, song and album titles, and the Russian Blue cat breed; there are also isolated substring activations on astics in microplastics and lay in the name Findlay.

patterns.name: Word-final Blues
patterns.context: Blues occurs in a music genre, song title, album title, or cat breed name; it also appears in names joined to preceding modifiers, such as «Russian»«Blues».
patterns.domain: Music entries, biographies, song/album catalogs, and animal breed entries

patterns.name: Microplastics term
patterns.context: Occurs in the word “microplastics” at the start of a scientific abstract; activation focuses on an internal subword fragment.

patterns.name: Final substring in the name Findlay
patterns.context: The final substring of the name “Polly Findlay” activates; the preceding text concerns a theater work and director information.

1_2469.concept: Blues 字符串及偶发词片段
1_2469.description: 多数激活落在 Blues 相关字符串中，涵盖乐种术语、歌曲与专辑名，以及俄罗斯蓝猫品种；另有微塑料词中 astics 和人名 Findlay 的 lay 两个孤立子串激活。

patterns.name: 词尾 Blues
patterns.context: 在乐种、曲名、专辑名或猫品种名称中出现 Blues；也包括被前置修饰语连在一起的名称，如«Russian»«Blues»。
patterns.domain: 音乐条目、人物传记、歌曲/专辑目录，也有动物品种条目

patterns.name: 微塑料词项
patterns.context: 出现在科学摘要开头的“microplastics”词中；激活集中于词的内部子词片段。

patterns.name: 人名末尾 Findlay
patterns.context: 人名“Polly Findlay”末尾子串激活，前文为剧院作品及导演信息。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the capitalized form Blues, commonly in descriptions of music genres and proper names for songs, albums, and bands; it also responds to the cat name Russian Blues. The activation on wizards in segment 10 has no visible connection.

patterns.name: Blues in music genre names
patterns.context: Occurs in music styles, genre names, or explanations of genres; often listed alongside other genres or included in the full name of R&B.
patterns.domain: Music terminology, music history, or music descriptions

patterns.name: Blues in proper names
patterns.context: Blues is part of a proper name, including a work title, music group, or genre name; the text need not be explaining the meaning of blues.
patterns.domain: Music and artist entries, record catalogs, and encyclopedia categories

patterns.name: Blues in cat breed names
patterns.context: Blues refers to Russian Blue cats and occurs in descriptions of breed traits and behavior, rather than in a musical context.
patterns.domain: Animal encyclopedias and cat breed descriptions

patterns.name: Blues string matching
patterns.context: The word form Blues, with this capitalization, may trigger activation; the cat-breed usage shows that the pattern is not limited to musical meaning.

patterns.name: Other word forms without an apparent Blues trigger
patterns.context: Occurs in a sentence about a data-processing and marketing company; the local context contains no Blues or clear musical meaning.
patterns.domain: Digital marketing and business data descriptions

1_2469.description: 主要强烈响应大小写形式 Blues，常见于音乐流派说明及歌曲、专辑、乐队等专名；也响应 Russian Blues 猫名。第10段的 wizards 激活缺乏可见关联。

patterns.name: 音乐流派名称中的 Blues
patterns.context: 出现在音乐风格、流派名称或流派解释中，常与其他音乐类型并列，或作为 R&B 全称的一部分。
patterns.domain: 音乐术语、音乐史或音乐介绍

patterns.name: 专名中的 Blues
patterns.trigger: «Blues»10／«Blues»9，嵌在专辑、歌曲、乐队或其他专名中，如 «2»«Frets» from «the» «Blues»、«Island» «Blues»、«Sligo River» «Blues»、«A Shot of Rhythm and Blues»、«St.» «Louis» «Blues»、«Telemark» «Blues»lag
patterns.context: Blues 是专名的组成部分；涉及作品标题、音乐团体或流派名称，不要求正文正在解释 blues 的含义。
patterns.domain: 音乐作品与音乐人条目、唱片目录、百科分类

patterns.name: 猫品种名称中的 Blues
patterns.context: Blues 指 Russian Blue 猫，出现在品种特征及其行为描述中，而非音乐语境。

patterns.name: Blues 字符串匹配
patterns.context: 只要出现大小写为 Blues 的词形就可能激活；猫品种用法表明该模式不局限于音乐语义。

patterns.name: 无明显 Blues 触发的其他词形
patterns.context: 出现在描述数据处理与营销公司的句子中，局部上下文未见 Blues 或明显音乐含义。
patterns.domain: 数字营销、商业数据说明

en.description: Primarily activates on the spelling fragment ighter in English words, especially lighter; it also covers freighter, highlighter, straighter, and brighter. Some contexts happen to discuss reduced weight, but the trigger spans meanings and does not necessarily require that semantic connection.

patterns.name: -ighter spelling fragment
patterns.context: The activated fragment is usually inside a word, often in words ending in -ighter or containing ighter; the words need not share a meaning.
patterns.domain: English text across domains, including forums, emails, encyclopedias, patents, and literary descriptions

patterns.name: lighter and descriptions of reduced weight
patterns.context: Describes a lighter door, lens, or engine component; the activated fragment still corresponds to the spelling in lighter.
patterns.domain: Consumer products, photography equipment, and engineering patents

patterns.name: ighter in other words
patterns.context: The trigger is embedded in different words such as freighter, highlighter, straighter, and brighter, with meanings related to ships, reading tools, direction, or brightness, respectively.

patterns.name: lighter in engineering and equipment contexts
patterns.context: Explicitly compares weight or describes the engineering effect of reducing a component's weight.
patterns.domain: Product descriptions, photography forums, and engineering patents

1_2469.concept: 英语中的 ighter 字符串片段
1_2469.description: 主要激活英语单词中的 ighter 拼写片段，尤其是 lighter；也涵盖 freighter、highlighter、straighter、brighter 等。部分上下文恰好谈轻量化，但触发跨词义，未必要求该语义。

patterns.name: -ighter 拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活片段多位于单词内部，常见于以 -ighter 结尾或包含 ighter 的拼写；并不要求这些词具有相同词义。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的英语文本，包括论坛、邮件、百科、专利及文学介绍

patterns.name: lighter 及轻量化表述
patterns.context: 描述重量较轻的门、镜头或发动机部件；其中激活片段仍对应 lighter 的拼写部分。
patterns.domain: 生活用品、摄影器材、工程专利

patterns.name: ighter 出现在其他词中
patterns.context: 触发部分嵌在 freighter、highlighter、straighter、brighter 等不同词中，意义分别涉及船、阅读工具、方向或亮度。

patterns.name: 工程与设备语境中的 lighter
patterns.context: 显式比较重量，或说明减轻部件重量的工程效果。
patterns.domain: 产品说明、摄影论坛、工程专利

en.description: All fragments activate at the end of the surnames Parker/Barker, including personal names in body text, email addresses, and names or filenames in headlines, URLs, and paths; the names appear across diverse fields and genres.

patterns.name: Parker surname or suffix
patterns.context: Activation falls on the end of a surname in a personal name, email address, URL, or file path; sometimes the word beginning is unmarked, and sometimes only part is marked.
patterns.domain: News, email, forum links, encyclopedia, and patent text

1_2469.description: 所有片段都在 Parker/Barker 姓氏末尾出现激活，包括正文中的人名、邮件地址，以及标题、网址和路径中的姓名或文件名；姓名所处领域和文体多样。

patterns.name: Parker 姓氏或其后缀
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名、邮箱地址、网址或文件路径中的姓氏末尾；有的词首未标记，有的仅部分标记。
patterns.domain: 新闻、邮件、论坛链接、百科及专利文本

en.description: Most segments activate in bird(s) or compounds containing it, often on word-final birds/bird; there are also activations on the arner substring in learner and on birdsong in a citation marker, indicating responses to several orthographic fragments rather than a unified meaning.

patterns.name: Word-final birds
patterns.context: Activation falls on the birds part of bird(s); it occurs in contexts involving hummingbirds, cardinals, birds in flight, and also URLs or quoted titles.
patterns.domain: Nature, sports, news, and web text

patterns.name: bird-related identifiers
patterns.context: bird is part of a compound or a URL/project-path identifier, rather than the ordinary standalone word birds.

patterns.name: Embedded substring learner
patterns.context: Activation falls on the internal substring arner in learner; the word is unrelated to birds and occurs in the educational expressions learner-centered and learner.

patterns.name: Reference author-name fragment
patterns.context: birds followed by ong forms part of a reference author's name/citation marker; the context discusses cervical screening automation and is unrelated to birds.

1_2469.concept: 含 bird(s) 的字形片段
1_2469.description: 多数段落在 bird(s) 或其复合词中激活，常落在词尾 birds/bird；另在 learner 的 arner 子串及引文标识 birdsong 中激活，显示对若干字形片段的响应，而非统一语义。

patterns.name: 词尾 birds
patterns.context: 激活落在 bird(s) 词形的 birds 部分；出现在蜂鸟、红雀、飞行中的鸟等语境，也出现在网址或被引用标题中。
patterns.domain: 自然、体育、新闻及网页文本

patterns.name: bird 相关标识符
patterns.context: bird 是复合词或 URL/项目路径标识符的一部分，并非普通独立的 birds。

patterns.name: 嵌入式子串 learner
patterns.context: 激活落在 learner 的内部子串 arner；词义与鸟类无关，出现在 learner-centered 与 learner 两种教育表达中。

patterns.name: 参考文献作者名片段
patterns.context: birds 与后续 ong 构成参考文献作者名/引文标识的一部分；上下文讨论宫颈筛查自动化，与鸟类无关。

en.description: Strongly activates on the literal substring “bird,” whether it occurs in common compounds (earlybird, warbird), bird-related words, proper nouns (Blackbird, Bluebird, Nightbird), product names (Thunderbird), or URLs. Surrounding words and domains vary considerably.

patterns.name: bird morpheme/word ending
patterns.context: Bird occurs within complete words or proper nouns, including compounds, brand names, and URL identifiers; activation is concentrated on the bird string itself.

1_2469.description: 对字面子串“bird”强烈激活，不论它出现在普通复合词（earlybird、warbird）、鸟类相关词、专名（Blackbird、Bluebird、Nightbird）还是产品名（Thunderbird）及网址中。其他周边词语和领域差异较大。

patterns.name: bird 词素/词尾
patterns.context: 在完整单词或专名中出现 bird，包括复合词、品牌名及网址标识；激活集中在 bird 字符串本身。

en.concept: Final subword token in bird-final words
en.description: All segments activate on the final part of words or proper names ending in bird, including earlybird, Firebird, warbird, Nightbird, Blackbird, Thunderbird, Bluebird, and Greybird; the pattern spans domains and does not depend on a particular writing style.

patterns.name: Final part of the earlybird compound
patterns.context: The trigger word ends in bird, especially earlybird; it occurs in a ticketing sentence.

patterns.name: Final part of the Firebird compound
patterns.context: Part of the song title “Firebird Suite”.

patterns.name: Final part of the warbird compound
patterns.context: Describes vintage aircraft or aircraft models, following war.

patterns.name: Final part of the Nightbird compound
patterns.context: The proper name Nightbird refers to a San Francisco food-service provider.

patterns.name: Final part of the proper name Blackbird
patterns.context: Suggests naming an educational project Blackbird Pi.

patterns.name: Final part of the Thunderbird software name
patterns.context: The final part of the name of the Thunderbird email client.

patterns.name: Final part of the Thunderbird street name
patterns.context: The proper name Thunderbird Rd. in an address.

patterns.name: Final part of the Bluebird model name
patterns.context: The final part of the model name Bluebird Sylphy.

patterns.name: Final part of the Greybird theme name
patterns.context: The final part of the desktop theme name Greybird.

1_2469.concept: bird 结尾词的末尾子词元
1_2469.description: 所有段均在 bird 结尾的词或专名的末尾部分激活，包括 earlybird、Firebird、warbird、Nightbird、Blackbird、Thunderbird、Bluebird、Greybird；跨领域且不依赖特定文体。

patterns.name: earlybird 复合词末尾
patterns.context: 触发词以 bird 结尾，尤其是 earlybird；出现于票务句中

patterns.name: Firebird 复合词末尾
patterns.context: 作为曲名 “Firebird Suite” 的一部分

patterns.name: warbird 复合词末尾
patterns.context: 描述老式飞机或飞机模型，位于 war 之后
patterns.domain: 电脑硬件论坛/航空爱好

patterns.name: Nightbird 复合词末尾
patterns.context: 专名 Nightbird，指旧金山餐饮服务方

patterns.name: Blackbird 专名末尾
patterns.context: 建议将教育项目命名为 Blackbird Pi
patterns.domain: 教育/编程与音乐课程讨论

patterns.name: Thunderbird 软件名末尾
patterns.context: Thunderbird 邮件客户端名称的末尾部分

patterns.name: Thunderbird 地址名末尾
patterns.context: 地址中的专名 Thunderbird Rd.

patterns.name: Bluebird 车型名末尾
patterns.context: 车型专名 Bluebird Sylphy 中的末尾部分

patterns.name: Greybird 主题名末尾
patterns.context: 桌面主题专名 Greybird 中的末尾部分

en.concept: Sensitive to specific letter strings and word fragments
en.description: Responds mainly to the letter string bird, commonly in compounds or proper nouns containing bird; it also responds to the technical compound Box and sporadically activates on several proper nouns or internal word fragments, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: bird suffix or word-final fragment
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the contiguous letter fragment bird, in both standalone words and compounds or proper nouns; no fixed syntactic position is required.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including event promotion, music and album titles, automobiles, aviation, and education

patterns.name: Box word ending
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the Box part of a compound; the examples are an interface component name and a control name.

patterns.name: Internal proper-noun fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in the place name Pensacola, not in ordinary semantic usage.
patterns.domain: Performance venue in an encyclopedia entry

patterns.name: Internal proper-noun fragment
patterns.context: Occurs within a car model name.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the character name Nasedo.

patterns.name: Name-final fragment
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the personal name Debriano.

patterns.name: Other sporadic fragments
patterns.context: Occur separately in an album title, an event name, and within a common word; there are too few examples to establish a shared condition.

1_2469.concept: 对特定字母串及词片段敏感
1_2469.description: 主要响应 bird 字母串，常见于含 bird 的复合词或专名；也响应技术复合词 Box，并零星激活于若干专名或词内片段，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: bird 后缀或词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在 bird 这个连续字母片段，既包括独立词，也包括复合词和专名；不要求固定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 活动宣传、音乐与专辑名称、汽车、航空、教育等多种文体

patterns.name: Box 词尾
patterns.context: 激活出现在复合词 Box 部分；样例中分别是界面组件名和控件名。

patterns.name: 专名内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在地名 Pensacola 中，不见于普通语义用法。
patterns.domain: 百科条目中的演出地点

patterns.name: 专名内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在汽车型号专名内部。

patterns.name: 词尾片段
patterns.context: 出现在角色姓名 Nasedo 的词尾部分。

patterns.name: 姓名词尾片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名 Debriano 的词尾部分。

patterns.name: 其他偶发片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在专辑标题、事件名称、普通词内部；样例不足以确定共同条件。
patterns.domain: 混合文体，无法归为一致领域

en.concept: Letter fragments in the middle and at the ends of words
en.description: Activations often fall on contiguous letter fragments in the middle or at the ends of words: leman (including gentleman, Alleman, audleman), bird, fish, boxes, and son. Some fragments may relate to meaning or domain, but their behavior varies across contexts.

patterns.name: gentleman / -leman spelling fragment
patterns.context: Activations fall on the leman letter fragment in gentleman or similarly spelled names/words; may occur in possessives, quotations, book titles, or literary prose.

patterns.name: -man surname or name fragment
patterns.context: Activations fall on the final letter fragment of the name Alleman, possibly sharing character features with the gentleman pattern.

patterns.name: -bird ending
patterns.context: Activations fall on the bird ending in the compounds earlybird and warbird; the contexts differ in their specific meanings.

patterns.name: -fish ending
patterns.context: Activations fall on the final fish fragment of the surname Lowenfish.
patterns.domain: Book titles and author names in baseball articles

patterns.name: -box / boxes fragment
patterns.context: Activations fall on the final boxes in the compound mailboxes.

patterns.name: -son surname fragment
patterns.context: Activations fall on the final fragment of the name Claeson in a bibliographic citation.

1_2469.description: 激活多落在词中或词尾的连续字母片段：leman（含 gentleman、Alleman、audleman）、bird、fish、boxes、son。部分片段可与词义或领域关联，但跨语境表现不一。

patterns.name: gentleman / -leman 拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 gentleman 或拼写相近的人名/词的 leman 字母片段；可出现在所有格、引语、书名或文学正文中。

patterns.name: -man 姓氏或姓名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在人名 Alleman 的末尾字母片段，与 gentleman 模式可能共享字符特征。
patterns.domain: 百科全书、拼字比赛报道

patterns.name: -bird 词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 bird 这一词尾片段，分别出现在复合词 earlybird 和 warbird 中；语境与其具体含义不同。
patterns.domain: 活动公告、航空爱好者论坛

patterns.name: -fish 词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在姓氏 Lowenfish 的末尾 fish 片段。
patterns.domain: 棒球文章中的书名及作者姓名

patterns.name: -box / boxes 片段
patterns.context: 激活落在复合词 mailboxes 的词尾 boxes。

patterns.name: -son 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 激活落在人名 Claeson 的末尾片段，出现在文献引用中。

en.description: The neuron mainly responds to local substrings within several words: room (especially restroom), keeper, steeper, and single instances of castle and ants; triggers span multiple domains and often occur at word endings.

patterns.name: restroom and its morphological variants
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on room(s) at the end of restroom(s), in contexts involving facilities, using the restroom, or looking for a toilet; the prefix rest is unmarked.
patterns.domain: Public information, legal narratives, parenting text

patterns.name: keeper ending
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-final substring of keeper, in web page titles related to football goalkeepers and in work titles.

patterns.name: steeper comparative ending
patterns.context: Activation falls at the end of steeper, describing a curve or slope as steeper; the preceding st is unmarked.
patterns.domain: Quantitative comparisons in medical paper abstracts

patterns.name: castle ending
patterns.context: Activation falls on the castle substring in the proper name Newcastle, in a list of war memorials.

patterns.name: consultants in legal documents
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-final ants in Consultants, repeated in narratives of arbitration and motions.

1_2469.concept: 词内子串 room/词尾模式
1_2469.description: 神经元主要响应若干词内的局部子串：room（尤其 restroom）、keeper、steeper，以及单例 castle、ants；触发不依赖单一领域，常落在词尾。

patterns.name: restroom 词及其构词变体
patterns.context: 激活集中在 restroom(s) 末尾的 room(s)，出现在设施、如厕或寻找厕所的语境中；前缀 rest 未标记。
patterns.domain: 公共信息、法律叙述、育儿文本

patterns.name: keeper 词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 keeper 的词尾子串，分别出现在足球守门员相关网页标题和作品名中。

patterns.name: steeper 比较级词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 steeper 的词尾，描述曲线或斜率更陡；前面的 st 未标记。
patterns.domain: 医学论文摘要中的定量比较

patterns.name: castle 词尾
patterns.context: 激活位于专名 Newcastle 的 castle 子串，出现在战争纪念碑列表中。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 consultants
patterns.context: 激活落在 Consultants 的词尾 ants，在仲裁与动议的诉讼叙述中重复出现。

en.concept: thumbnail subword fragment, with occasional proper-name activations
en.description: The strongest recurring pattern is the nail fragment when thumbnail is split; other activations include castle in Newcastle/Rockcastle, Theatre/borough in theater listings, and sporadic triggers for Board, steeper, waters, riot, and several weak fragments.

patterns.name: thumbnail ending/segmentation
patterns.context: Activates on the nail subword fragment when thumbnail is split as thumb«nail»; adjacent suffixes may also activate, such as «er»2, «Image»2.
patterns.domain: Web markup, forum discussions, programming Q&A, place-name entries

patterns.name: Proper names and the stem castle
patterns.context: Occurs at the ends of place names, especially Newcastle upon Tyne and Rockcastle County.

patterns.name: theatre term
patterns.context: In performance listings, Theatre follows a theater or region name; borough also activates strongly when Finborough and Theatre are adjacent.

patterns.name: steep in medical curves
patterns.context: Describes equivalent curves becoming steeper as the number of doses increases; activation falls on the initial fragment of steeper.

patterns.name: Patent Board
patterns.context: Occurs in the institution name Patent Trial & Appeal Board.

patterns.name: riot
patterns.context: In the phrase riot grrrls, as part of a subculture name; activation is weak.

patterns.name: waters
patterns.context: Occurs in the geographic description headwaters of the Green River.

patterns.name: Past-participle suffix indicating completion
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across multiple words or phrase fragments split into subwords, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition; these weak activations may be incidental co-occurrences.

1_2469.concept: thumbnail 词片段，兼有专名偶发激活
1_2469.description: 最强且反复的模式是 thumbnail 被拆分时的 nail 片段；另有 Newcastle/Rockcastle 的 castle、戏剧条目中的 Theatre/borough，以及零散触发 Board、steeper、waters、riot 和若干弱片段激活。

patterns.name: thumbnail 词尾/分词
patterns.context: 在 thumbnail 被拆分为 thumb«nail» 的词片段中激活；有时相邻后缀也激活，如 «er»2、«Image»2。
patterns.domain: 网页标记、论坛讨论、编程问答、地名条目

patterns.name: 专名与词干 castle
patterns.context: 出现在地名末尾，尤其是 Newcastle upon Tyne 和 Rockcastle County。

patterns.name: theatre 词项
patterns.context: 剧目演出记录中，Theatre 前接剧院或地区名称；Finborough 与 Theatre 相邻时 borough 也强烈激活。

patterns.name: 医学曲线中的 steep
patterns.context: 描述等效曲线随分次数增加而变陡；激活落在 steeper 的词首片段。

patterns.name: Patent Board
patterns.context: 出现在 Patent Trial & Appeal Board 这一机构名称中。

patterns.name: riot
patterns.context: 短语 riot grrrls 中，作为亚文化名称的一部分；激活较弱。

patterns.name: waters
patterns.context: 出现在地理描述 headwaters of the Green River 中。

patterns.name: 表示完成的过去分词后缀
patterns.context: 激活分散在多个被分词切开的词或短语片段中，未见一致的语义或句法条件；这些弱激活可能是偶然共现。

en.description: The most prominent repeated pattern is the within-word fragment “nail,” especially in thumbnail, and also in nailer and the proper noun Tournaile. Other activations are scattered across legal terminology, recipe wording, and the ending of NBA referees, with no shared context.

patterns.name: “nail” subword fragment
patterns.context: Within words such as thumbnail and nailer, or embedded in a proper-noun spelling; commonly appears in web pages, code, forums, and biographical text.
patterns.domain: Web content, programming discussions, forums, and encyclopedias

patterns.name: Legal terminology and markup
patterns.context: Formal names of patent trial and appeal bodies and descriptions of legal proceedings; seen only in this segment, and HTML attribute fragments also occur.

patterns.name: Food-related word fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in the phrase “heavy whipping cream” when describing dessert preparation.

patterns.name: NBA referee ending
patterns.context: Occurs in the word “referees,” in the context of NBA referee lists and hiring information.

1_2469.description: 最醒目的重复模式是词内片段“nail”，尤其出现在 thumbnail，也见于 nailer 和专名 Tournaile。其余激活分散在法律术语、食谱用词及 NBA referees 的词尾，缺少共同上下文。

patterns.name: “nail”子词片段
patterns.context: 在 thumbnail、nailer 等词内部，或嵌在专名拼写中；常见于网页、代码、论坛和人物传记文本。
patterns.domain: 网页内容、编程讨论、论坛及百科

patterns.name: 法律词汇及标记
patterns.context: 专利审判与上诉机构的正式名称及法律程序介绍；仅见于此段，且同时出现 HTML 属性片段。

patterns.name: 餐饮词汇片段
patterns.context: 描述甜点制作时，出现在“heavy whipping cream”短语中。

patterns.name: NBA裁判词尾
patterns.context: 出现在“referees”一词中，语境是 NBA 裁判名单与聘用信息。

en.description: Strong activations cluster on several specific within-word fragments: inates in discriminate, ateur in Amateur, and a few endings such as rees, yard, and inaries. These fragments occur across different semantics and styles and cannot be explained by a single theme.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in discriminate
patterns.context: The trigger occurs on the final fragment “inates” in discriminate/discriminates; in [1] it means distinguishing light levels, in [2] government discrimination, in [3][4] discrimination against groups or users, and in [7] distinguishing disease categories; the meanings differ
patterns.domain: Patents, political commentary, online discussions, medical abstracts

patterns.name: Endings such as -ateur/-yard
patterns.context: Activations fall on specific endings within complete words; [5] is Amateur in a golf event name, [9] is Amateur as a programmer category, and [8] is Halfyard in a personal name

patterns.name: Occupational ending -rees
patterns.context: Activates on the plural ending of referee in descriptions of NBA referees and their hiring

patterns.name: Mathematical term ending -aries
patterns.context: Activates at the end of preliminaries, referring to preparatory material containing definitions in a paper

1_2469.description: 高激活集中在若干特定词内片段：discriminate 的 inates、Amateur 的 ateur，以及少数词尾 rees、yard、inaries；这些片段跨不同语义与文体出现，不能统一解释为某个主题。

patterns.name: discriminate 的词内片段
patterns.context: 触发位置位于 discriminate/discriminates 的词尾片段“inates”；在 [1] 表示辨别光照水平，在 [2] 表示政府歧视，在 [3][4] 表示对群体或用户的歧视，在 [7] 表示区分疾病类别，语义不同
patterns.domain: 专利、政治评论、网络讨论、医学摘要

patterns.name: -ateur/-yard 等词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词内部的特定词尾片段；[5] 为高尔夫赛事名称中的 Amateur，[9] 为程序员类别 Amateur，[8] 为人名 Halfyard
patterns.domain: 邮件、网络讨论、体育传记

patterns.name: 职业词尾 -rees
patterns.context: 激活在 referee 的复数词尾，处于 NBA 裁判及聘用叙述中

patterns.name: 数学术语词尾 -aries
patterns.context: 激活在 preliminaries 一词的末尾，指论文中给出定义的预备内容

en.description: Primarily responds to Discography headings, discography subheadings, and music-related narrative in Wikipedia musician or band entries; it also covers lineup lists. Other contexts include sports events and referees, as well as punctuation and indentation in C++ code. Word-final fragments may reflect token-form features.

patterns.name: Discography section heading
patterns.context: A standalone section heading appearing after the article body, often followed by subheadings such as “Albums,” “Studio albums,” or “Singles,” or by album entries; formatting boundaries are also commonly activated.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia musician and band entries, and discographies

patterns.name: Music-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of musicians, bands, performances, or record releases; not necessarily adjacent to a Discography heading.

patterns.name: Specific word-final and word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on word endings or subword fragments in complete words or markup tokens; some words occur in non-music contexts, suggesting a morphological or token-related pattern rather than a single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Sports events and referees
patterns.context: Motorsports event coverage or NBA referee biographies; no music discography formatting is present.

patterns.name: Band member and lineup lists
patterns.context: Lists band lineups by instrument, performance role, or member grouping.

patterns.name: Code indentation and control flow
patterns.context: In C++ code snippets, activation occurs on statement punctuation and indentation whitespace; there is no evident semantic link to the surrounding music entries.

1_2469.concept: 音乐条目的唱片目录格式
1_2469.description: 主要响应 Wikipedia 音乐人或乐队条目中的 Discography 标题、唱片子标题及音乐相关叙述，也覆盖阵容列表；另有体育赛事和裁判语境，以及 C++ 代码中的标点与缩进。词尾片段可能反映 token 形态特征。

patterns.name: Discography 小节标题
patterns.context: 条目正文后出现独立的小节标题，常紧接“Albums”“Studio albums”“Singles”等子标题或专辑条目；格式化边界也常被激活。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 音乐人、乐队条目及唱片目录

patterns.name: 音乐相关词汇
patterns.context: 出现在音乐人、乐队、演出或唱片发行的叙述中；不一定与 Discography 标题相邻。
patterns.domain: 音乐传记与唱片发行叙述

patterns.name: 特定词尾及词形片段
patterns.trigger: “Speedway”中的“way”、“Development League”中的“League”、“referees”中的“rees”、“Biography/Discography”式标题中的“ography”、“DegreesToRadians”中的“Degrees”
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词或标记 token 的词尾、子词片段上；部分词处于非音乐语境，可能是词形或 token 相关模式，而非单一语义触发。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本及代码标识符

patterns.name: 体育赛事与裁判
patterns.context: 赛车赛事报道或 NBA 裁判履历；没有音乐目录格式。

patterns.name: 乐队成员与阵容列表
patterns.context: 以乐器、演奏角色或成员组合列出乐队阵容。
patterns.domain: 乐队简介与音乐人条目

patterns.name: 代码缩进与控制流
patterns.context: C++ 代码片段中，激活出现在语句标点和缩进空白处；与周围音乐条目不构成明显语义联系。

en.description: Strong activations often fall on English word endings or subword fragments: away, toileting, referees, remained, room, and less; fragments in Dutch and proper names also occur. Semantics and styles are scattered, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: away ending component
patterns.context: In English compounds, away occurs at the end; contexts concern dietary advice or steal statistics in sports games

patterns.name: Place or region ending
patterns.context: Plural region or country name components in geographical or political contexts
patterns.domain: Dutch European Parliament texts; English conspiracy texts

patterns.name: Internal fragment in the proper name FreeType
patterns.context: Occurs in the FreeType project name and its license description

patterns.name: toileting in activities of daily living
patterns.context: Lists activities of daily living requiring assistance or attention, alongside eating, drinking, and showering

patterns.name: NBA referee ending
patterns.context: In descriptions of basketball league referees’ hiring and career histories, activations fall on the ending of referees

patterns.name: Ending of remained
patterns.context: Indicates that something continued to be in a given state, referring respectively to unopened books and unpaid fines

patterns.name: room ending in restroom
patterns.context: Describes being escorted to the restroom in a legal account

patterns.name: less ending in needless
patterns.context: The fixed expression “Needless to say” introduces commentary

patterns.name: Unexplained isolated triggers
patterns.context: No stable, shared trigger condition is apparent in the available contexts
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias; Dutch parliamentary texts; several other texts with low-intensity activations

1_2469.description: 强激活多落在英文词尾或子词片段：away、toileting、referees、remained、room、less；另见荷兰语与专名中的片段。语义和文体分散，触发条件并不统一。

patterns.name: away 词尾成分
patterns.context: 英文复合词中 away 是词尾，语境与饮食建议或体育比赛的抢断统计有关

patterns.name: 地名或地区词尾
patterns.context: 地理或政治语境中的复数区域、国家名称成分
patterns.domain: 荷兰语欧洲议会文本；英文阴谋论文本

patterns.name: FreeType 专名的内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在 FreeType 项目名称及其许可说明中

patterns.name: 日常生活活动中的 toileting
patterns.context: 列举需要协助或注意的日常生活活动，周围包含 eating、drinking、showering

patterns.name: NBA 裁判词尾
patterns.context: 篮球联盟裁判的聘用、履历描述中，激活落在 referees 的词尾

patterns.name: remained 的词尾
patterns.context: 表示某物仍处于某状态，分别用于未开启的书籍和未缴罚款

patterns.name: restroom 的 room 词尾
patterns.context: 法律叙述中描述被护送去洗手间

patterns.name: needless 的 less 词尾
patterns.context: 固定表达“Needless to say”引出评论

patterns.name: 未解释的孤立触发
patterns.context: 现有上下文中看不出稳定、共同的触发条件
patterns.domain: 体育百科；荷兰语议会文本；其余文本中多处低强度激活

en.concept: Word-final referees and sporadic word fragments
en.description: The most stable pattern is word-final activation on refe«rees» across sports, academic, and legal contexts. Other sporadic activations occur in different long words or endings (such as kil«ometer», handsom«ely», Take«away», and croche«ting»); their domains and semantics do not align, so they cannot reliably be grouped into a single pattern.

patterns.name: “referees” ending
patterns.context: Refers to sports officials, paper reviewers, or referees in legal proceedings; activation is concentrated on the ending “rees,” usually after the stem “refe” has already appeared.

patterns.name: “特”-like syllables within complex words
patterns.context: May respond to smaller word units or specific subword fragments within longer words; trigger positions span different word forms, with no stable shared semantics.
patterns.domain: Patents, Dutch parliamentary text, programming discussions

patterns.name: “takeaway” ending
patterns.context: Appears in a summary label in a fitness and diet article, with activation on the second part of the compound.

patterns.name: “workout” ending
patterns.context: Appears in diet and exercise advice; the word is split by a hyphen, and activation covers the work/out fragments.

patterns.name: “crocheting” ending
patterns.context: In a personal email describing watching the recipient's videos and crocheting; activation falls at the end of the gerund.

patterns.name: “handsomely” ending
patterns.context: Used as an adverb meaning generously or in a substantial amount in a forum conversation; appears only here.

patterns.name: Ending in “simple”
patterns.context: In a forum discussion of Lisp compilation, activation falls at the beginning of a sentence after an abbreviation and on the word “simple”; the trigger relationship is unclear.

patterns.name: “kilometer” ending
patterns.context: A Dutch sentence discusses the length of the European coastline; activation is concentrated at the end of the unit of measurement.

1_2469.description: 最稳定模式是跨体育、学术和法律语境中 refe«rees» 的词尾激活。其余零散激活分布在不同长词或词尾（如 kil«ometer»、handsom«ely»、Take«away»、croche«ting»），领域和语义不统一，不能可靠归为单一模式。

patterns.name: “referees”词尾
patterns.context: 指涉赛事裁判、论文审稿人或法律程序中的 ref（referees）；激活集中在词尾“rees”，前文通常已经出现词干“refe”。

patterns.name: 复杂词内部的“特”类音节
patterns.context: 可能响应较长词内部的细分词块或特定子词片段；触发位置跨越不同词形，未见稳定共同语义。
patterns.domain: 专利、荷兰语议会文本、编程讨论

patterns.name: “takeaway”词尾
patterns.context: 出现在健身饮食文章的小结标签中，激活落在复合词后半部分。

patterns.name: “workout”词尾
patterns.context: 出现在饮食与运动建议中，词被连字符拆分，激活覆盖 work/out 片段。

patterns.name: “crocheting”词尾
patterns.context: 个人邮件中描述观看对方视频及钩针编织；激活位于动名词词尾。

patterns.name: “handsomely”词尾
patterns.context: 论坛对话中作副词，表示丰厚地或慷慨地；只有此处出现。

patterns.name: “simple”中的词尾
patterns.context: Lisp 编译的论坛讨论中，激活落在缩写后的句子开头及“simple”一词；触发关联不明确。

patterns.name: “kilometer”词尾
patterns.context: 荷兰语句子谈欧洲海岸线长度，激活集中在计量单位词尾。

en.description: The main activation is on the ending its in limits, across disciplines and contexts; strong activations also occur on the ending of the Dutch verscheidenheid and the ending of the title Takeaway. The latter two have no clear semantic connection to the main pattern.

patterns.name: Ending of limits
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the noun limits in titles, body text, book titles, and technical texts; no specific semantic domain is required.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain texts: philosophy, mathematics, news, energy trading, etc.

patterns.name: Ending of variety
patterns.context: Occurs in a sentence describing the diversity of specific characteristics of a coastal region; differs from the English limits pattern.

patterns.name: Title ending
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the article subheading Takeaway, followed by a colon and a summary; has no clear semantic connection to limits.
patterns.domain: Online fitness and dietary advice articles

1_2469.concept: 词尾片段识别（以 limits 的 -its 为主）
1_2469.description: 主要对 limits 的词尾 its 激活，跨学科与语境出现；另对荷兰语 verscheidenheid 的词尾及标题 Takeaway 的词尾强烈激活，后二者与主模式无明显语义联系。

patterns.name: limits 的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在名词 limits 的词尾，涵盖标题、正文、书名及技术文本；不要求特定语义领域。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本：哲学、数学、新闻、能源交易等

patterns.name: variety 的词尾
patterns.trigger: “versche«iden»10«heid»6”，即荷兰语 verscheidenheid 的词尾部分
patterns.context: 出现在描述沿海地区具体特征多样性的句子中；与英文 limits 模式不同。

patterns.name: 标题词尾
patterns.context: 出现在文章小标题 Takeaway 的词尾，后接冒号并引出总结；与 limits 无明显语义联系。
patterns.domain: 健身、饮食建议类网络文章

en.description: Activations concentrate on several final fragments within English words: rees in referees, its in limits, and Type in FreeType and one in Chaperone. The semantics and style vary; the main commonality is that these are word-final substrings.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in referees
patterns.context: The word-final “rees” in the English word referees is marked; it refers to sports officials or academic paper reviewers, with the preceding context determining the specific meaning.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, academic acknowledgments and publishing processes, legal documents

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in limits
patterns.context: The word-final “its” in the word Limits is marked, appearing in body text or a title about boundaries or restrictions.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in Type
patterns.context: Type in the proper name FreeType is marked, appearing in software project copyright notices.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in one
patterns.context: “one” occurs at the end of a word in the subheading “Chaperone Therapy”; the heading’s specific meaning is connected to the preceding discussion of gene therapy.

1_2469.description: 激活集中于若干英文词内部的末尾片段：referees 的 rees、limits 的 its，以及 FreeType 的 Type 和 Chaperone 的 one。语义与文体不统一，主要共同点是词尾子串。

patterns.name: referees 词尾
patterns.context: 英文单词 referees 的词尾 “rees” 被标记；指向裁判或论文审稿人，前文语境决定具体含义。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、学术致谢与出版流程、法律文书

patterns.name: limits 词尾
patterns.context: 单词 Limits 的词尾 “its” 被标记，出现在关于界限、限制的正文或标题中。

patterns.name: Type 词尾
patterns.context: 专名 FreeType 中的 Type 被标记，位于软件项目版权说明中。
patterns.domain: 代码注释、软件版权文本

patterns.name: one 词尾
patterns.context: “one”作为单词末尾，出现在小标题“Chaperone Therapy”中；标题具体含义与前文基因治疗讨论相连。

en.description: The most stable strong trigger is the ending fragment its in limits, appearing across titles and body text in multiple domains. Other activations include disagrees in legal contexts and a local activation in the proper name Landmark; the remaining activations are weaker and lack a shared explanation.

patterns.name: Limits word form and title use
patterns.context: Strongly responds to the ending fragment its in the word form limits; appears in body text, paper titles, book titles, or title-like phrases, with no fixed preceding semantics.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain texts; philosophy, mathematics, science, and general writing

patterns.name: Expression of disagreement in legal rulings
patterns.context: Occurs in court opinions where the subject is the court or a party, describing disagreement with a claim, fact, or issue.

patterns.name: Fragment in the proper name Landmark
patterns.context: Activations fall within the proper name Landmark; occurs in company names and legal case-related contexts.

1_2469.concept: 词形片段 its（尤其 limits）
1_2469.description: 最稳定的强触发是 limits 的词尾片段 its，跨标题与正文、多个领域出现。另有法律语境中的 disagrees，以及专名 Landmark 的局部激活；其余激活较弱且缺少共同解释。

patterns.name: Limits 词形及标题用法
patterns.context: 对 limits 词形中的词尾片段 its 有强反应；出现在正文、论文标题、书名或标题式短语中，前置语义不固定。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本；哲学、数学、科学及一般文字

patterns.name: 法律判决中的分歧表达
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见中，主语为 court 或当事方，描述对主张、事实或问题持不同意见。

patterns.name: Landmark 专名中的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 Landmark 这个专名内部；分别出现在公司名称及法律案件相关语境。

en.concept: Word forms containing the letter sequence its
en.description: Strongly responds mainly to the English substring “limits” across academic, news, email, entertainment, and general texts; strong activations also occur in “lands” in Netherlands and the word-final “its” in recruits, in different contexts.

patterns.name: The word limits
patterns.context: The English word limits appears in a title, body text, or proper name; no specific semantic domain is required, and it may also occur in a plural possessive form or in a title.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English texts, including academic papers, news headlines, emails, music program titles, and general web content

patterns.name: Place name Netherlands
patterns.context: The latter part of the full word Netherlands, in a parenthetical explanation of an institution and country related to the LOFAR consortium.

patterns.name: Recruitment verb recruits
patterns.context: The word-final fragment in the verb recruits, appearing in a film synopsis describing the recruitment of hackers to assist with an operation.

1_2469.concept: 含字母子串 its 的词形
1_2469.description: 主要对英语子串“limits”强烈响应，跨学术、新闻、邮件、娱乐及普通文本；另在Netherlands的“lands”和recruits的“its”词尾出现强激活，二者语境各异。

patterns.name: 单词 limits
patterns.trigger: «Lim»its«»10（包括大小写变化及标点邻接形式）
patterns.context: 在标题、正文或专名中出现英语单词 limits；不要求特定语义领域，也可处于复数所有格或标题位置。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语文本，包括学术论文、新闻标题、邮件、音乐节目名称及普通网页内容

patterns.name: 地区名称 Netherlands
patterns.context: 完整词 Netherlands 的后半部分，处于 LOFAR 联盟相关机构与国家名称的括号说明中。

patterns.name: 招聘动词 recruits
patterns.context: 动词 recruits 的词尾，出现在电影剧情简介中，描述招募黑客协助行动。

en.description: The most prominent cue is referees/referee, covering sports officials, anonymous reviewers, and court-appointed personnel. There are also sporadic activations involving legal rulings and disagreements, SQL subwords, and biomedical materials, with no unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: The word referees
patterns.context: The full word referees is segmented and marked; it refers to NBA officials, anonymous paper reviewers, court-appointed adjudicators, or soccer referees.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, philosophy papers, legal texts

patterns.name: Referee-related forms
patterns.context: The word referee/ref appears directly, in a context involving the role or training of a referee.

patterns.name: Adjudication or disagreement
patterns.context: A court or party expresses a differing opinion in a legal argument; this shares the spelling fragment referees with the reviewer pattern but not the same word sense.

patterns.name: partition and court ruling
patterns.context: A legal dispute over the division of land, handled by court-appointed personnel.

patterns.name: rate in an immigration-related word
patterns.context: The SQL query text contains the segmented word migrate; it has no obvious semantic connection to the other main trigger words.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in Greenlandic
patterns.context: A word-final fragment in the SQL collation name Danish_Greenlandic; this may be a spelling-based trigger.

patterns.name: Materials and immobilization
patterns.context: Describes platelet materials immobilized on a solid support and used for plasma processing.

patterns.name: Opportunity and time in a legal context
patterns.context: Describes a defendant’s opportunity to obtain a remedy and its duration; it is adjacent to the context of disagreement over a judgment, but the trigger word itself does not form a clear common pattern.

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: Some activations may be due to document domain, common function words, or subword fragments, but no stable shared trigger condition can be inferred from the material.

1_2469.description: 最显著线索是 referees/referee：涵盖体育裁判、匿名审稿人及法院指定人员。另有法律裁决与分歧词、SQL子词及生物医学材料等零散激活，未见统一语义解释。

patterns.name: referees 一词
patterns.context: 完整单词 referees 被拆分标注；用于指 NBA 裁判、论文匿名审稿人、法院指定的裁决人员或足球裁判。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、哲学论文、法律文本

patterns.name: 裁判相关词形
patterns.context: 直接出现 referee/ref 一词，语境涉及裁判身份或培训。

patterns.name: 裁决或意见分歧
patterns.context: 法律论证中法院或当事方表达不同意见；与审稿人模式共享 referees 的字形片段，但并非同一词义。

patterns.name: partition 及法院裁定
patterns.context: 围绕土地分割的法律争议，由法院任命人员处理。

patterns.name: 移民词中的 rate
patterns.context: SQL 查询文本中的 migrate 被拆分标注；与其他主要触发词缺少明显语义联系。

patterns.name: Greenlandic 词尾
patterns.context: SQL 排序规则名称 Danish_Greenlandic 中的词尾片段；可能是字形触发。

patterns.name: 材料与 immobilization
patterns.context: 描述血小板材料固定于固体支持物并用于血浆处理。

patterns.name: 法律语境中的机会与时间
patterns.context: 描述被告获得补救问题的机会及其持续时间；与判决分歧语境相邻，但触发词本身不构成明确共同模式。

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: 部分激活可能由文档领域、常见功能词或子词片段造成，但无法从材料中归纳出稳定共同触发条件。

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across several endings and proper-name fragments: Delegates and highways are most prominent, with additional examples including -ones, -erton, -bound, -lands, -ways, -ists, and -ends. Other fragments lack shared semantics or context.

patterns.name: Delegates
patterns.context: Occurs in contexts involving people’s names, state legislatures, or conference members; the word is often split and marked as Deleg + ates
patterns.domain: Law, state government, historical conferences, and biographies

patterns.name: Plural highways
patterns.context: Plural forms highways/highways appear in road names, transport infrastructure, or highway systems described by law
patterns.domain: Law, traffic news, place names, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Plural ending -ones
patterns.context: Occurs in the plural ending of co-chaperones in a biology context; may be sensitive to the segmented ones fragment or plural suffix

patterns.name: -erton in a proper name
patterns.context: Occurs in the place-name ending of Cal State Fullerton

patterns.name: -bound ending
patterns.context: Occurs in directional compounds such as eastbound, describing road traffic

patterns.name: -lands ending
patterns.context: Occurs as part of the place name Highlands

patterns.name: -ways / ways ending
patterns.context: Occurs in the book title Byways, adjacent to place names or road-related words such as highways and highlands

patterns.name: -ists ending
patterns.context: Occurs in motorists, referring to road users; nearby words include detoured, bridge, and ramps

patterns.name: -ends ending
patterns.context: Occurs in ancient legends, referring to historical or legendary figures

patterns.name: Unclear spelling fragments
patterns.context: Appear respectively in shutout, State, the number 5, interred, Havana, Skye, and Wattis; no contextual conditions unify these fragments
patterns.domain: Sports news, financial reporting, biographies, encyclopedia entries

1_2469.concept: 复数词尾与专名/词尾片段
1_2469.description: 强激活分散在若干词尾和专名片段：Delegates、highways 最显著，另见 -ones、-erton、-bound、-lands、-ways、-ists、-ends；其余片段缺少共同语义或语境。

patterns.name: 委托代表（Delegates）
patterns.context: 出现在人名、州议会或会议成员等语境中，词通常被拆分标记为 Deleg + ates
patterns.domain: 法律、州政、历史会议与人物传记

patterns.name: 复数 highways
patterns.context: 道路名称、交通设施或法律所述公路体系中出现 highways/highways 的复数形式
patterns.domain: 法律、交通新闻、地名与百科条目

patterns.name: 复数词尾 -ones
patterns.context: 出现在 co-chaperones 一词的复数词尾，生物学语境；可能对拆分后的 ones 片段或复数后缀敏感

patterns.name: 专名中的 -erton
patterns.context: 出现在 Cal State Fullerton 的地名后缀中

patterns.name: 词尾 -bound
patterns.context: 出现在 eastbound 这类方向复合词中，描述道路交通

patterns.name: 词尾 -lands
patterns.context: 出现在 Highlands 这一地名组成部分中

patterns.name: 词尾 -ways / ways
patterns.context: 出现在书名 Byways 中，与 highways、highlands 等地名或道路相关词相邻

en.description: Activations are scattered across the interior or endings of various words: biological enzyme names, chaperone proteins, operon, tutoring-related forms, and terms from school names, entertainment listings, and dentistry; no unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Biomedical suffix -ase
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of an enzyme name, especially Q-beta replicase; the sentence discusses protein biosynthesis, enzyme structure, or mechanism of action.

patterns.name: Therapy-related ending -one
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of “chaperone,” in a context involving gene therapy or chaperone therapy for Gaucher disease.

patterns.name: School-name fragment in an event name
patterns.context: Activation occurs in the school name Cal State Fullerton; the same sentence mentions the team’s winning streak.

patterns.name: Plural ending -ones
patterns.context: Activation falls on the plural ending of the biological term chaperones, in a discussion of chaperone proteins and their co-chaperones.

patterns.name: Entertainment program table heading

patterns.domain: Television program data, entertainment encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Inflections of tutoring words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the past participle or -ing form of tutor, used respectively in a code variable name and a description of personal teaching experience.

patterns.name: Tutoring-system terminology in patent text
patterns.context: Activation falls on tutoring in the phrase “Intelligent tutoring systems,” in a comparison with computerized training methods.

patterns.name: -on in a gene name
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of operon; the sentence describes a gene cluster, reading frames, and regulatory elements.

patterns.name: Dental ending -ored
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of restored; the context describes unrestored natural teeth and their measurement.

patterns.name: 娱乐节目表格标题

en.description: Strong activations often fall on English suffixes or word-final fragments, such as -ones, -ase, -ored, -ends, -its, -ases, and -ation; they span scientific, legal, casual, and program-related texts, alongside sporadic weak markers, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: English plural possessive ending -ones
patterns.context: Often occurs in plural forms or nearby possessive forms of words such as chaperone/co-chaperone; activation falls on the word-final fragment, often in biomedical prose.

patterns.name: English ending -ase
patterns.context: Activation is located at the end of the enzyme name replicase; the context discusses Q-beta replicase and its function.

patterns.name: English ending -ored
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-final fragment in restored, in an experimental description of natural teeth and staining.

patterns.name: English ending -legends
patterns.context: Activation is located on the word-final fragment in legends, referring to performers from earlier times; the context is casual discussion about finding old movie clips.

patterns.name: English ending -solicits
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of solicits; it appears in statements about company business activities and in legal provisions.

patterns.name: English ending -recruits
patterns.context: Activation is located on the ending of recruits, describing a character recruiting hackers in a plot synopsis.

patterns.name: English ending -releases
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of releases, near a television program schedule or results heading.

patterns.name: English ending -ation
patterns.context: Activation is located on the infix in elimination; the context is a program elimination table heading.

patterns.name: English ending -on
patterns.context: There is no other clear trigger here independent of the legal context; unmarked words should not be mistaken for an activation pattern.

patterns.name: Unclustered weak markers or sporadic activations
patterns.context: These markers occur in different syntactic positions and contexts, with low intensity; the examples do not establish an independent, stable semantic or syntactic trigger condition.

1_2469.description: 强激活多落在英文词内后缀或词尾片段，如 -ones、-ase、-ored、-ends、-its、-ases、-ation；覆盖科研、法律、闲聊与节目资料，另有零散弱标记，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.context: 激活位于 legends 的词尾片段，指古代表演者；上下文是寻找旧电影片段的闲聊。

patterns.name: 英文词尾 -releases
patterns.context: 激活落在 releases 的词尾，处于电视节目赛程或结果标题附近。

patterns.name: 英文词尾 -ation
patterns.context: 激活位于 elimination 的词内后缀；上下文为节目淘汰表标题。

patterns.trigger: “inter«course»”未触发；相反，本段显著激活在完整词“solic«its»”的后缀。
patterns.context: 此处无独立于法律语境的其他清晰触发；不应把未标记词误认为激活模式。

patterns.name: 未归并的弱标记或零散激活
patterns.context: 这些标记分布于不同句法位置与语境，强度低，难以从例子中确认独立、稳定的语义或句法触发条件。

en.description: Activations often fall on subword fragments, especially word forms or endings such as solicits, -is/-ases, -ase, and -ists; there are also sporadic fragments from medical terms, compounds, legal citations, and bill names, with no consistent semantics or style.

patterns.name: solicits word form
patterns.context: The stem and word forms of the verb solicit, involving soliciting, inviting, or seeking; the object is not always the same across contexts.

patterns.name: Medical terms with -is/-ases
patterns.context: The endings of the medical terms plasmapheresis and apheresis; the endings themselves are activation sites.

patterns.name: Biological terms with -ase
patterns.context: The ending and plural forms of the protein/enzyme name replicase.

patterns.name: People or identity terms with -ists
patterns.context: The noun suffix -ists, referring to road users; nearby context concerns traffic diversions.

patterns.name: Other intraword suffix fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on intraword fragments involving compounds/endings, -oring, medical adjectives, and -ored; no shared semantic condition is evident.

patterns.name: Legal citations and bill word forms
patterns.context: Numeric fragments in legal citations and internal fragments of compound insurance bill names.

1_2469.description: 激活多落在词内片段，尤其是 solicits、-is/-ases、-ase、-ists 等词形或词尾；另有零散的医学词、复合词、法律编号和法案名称片段，语义与文体并不统一。

patterns.name: solicits 词形

en.description: Activations are distributed across within-word fragments in words from many domains and sporadic whole words; the more recognizable local clusters are solicits and disagrees in legal contexts and terms related to plasmapheresis in medical contexts, but overall there is no unified semantic or grammatical pattern.

patterns.name: Within-word suffix fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal fragments or endings of longer words, including biomedical terminology, general vocabulary, and legal language, with no unified meaning.

patterns.name: solicits word form
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences describing soliciting, requesting, or attracting attention; often in legal contexts, but also in philosophical discussion.

patterns.name: disagrees word form
patterns.context: Used to express that a court or party holds a different opinion.

patterns.name: Terms related to plasmapheresis
patterns.context: Concerns plasma exchange and its clinical applications or experimental evaluation; activations span within-word fragments after segmentation.

patterns.name: Function words in phrase structures
patterns.context: These markers are scattered across different syntactic environments, with no stable, consistent local structure or semantic condition.

patterns.name: Other terms in medical research contexts
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of platelet immunoadsorption, dental measurements, or clinical research; no unified trigger condition is evident among other activated words in the same passage.

patterns.name: Judicial terms in legal arguments
patterns.context: Occurs in argumentation where a court states its position.

1_2469.description: 激活分布于多领域词语的词内片段及零散完整词；较可辨认的局部簇是法律语境的solicits、disagrees，以及医学语境的plasmapheresis相关词，但整体缺乏统一语义或语法模式。

patterns.name: 词内后缀片段

patterns.name: solicits词形

en.concept: Intraword fragment «its» and several plural/ending fragments
en.description: The strongest and most consistent trigger across domains is the word-form fragment «its» in solic«its»; weaker fragments include tutor«ed», ali«ases», Rele«ases», and disag«rees». Other activations are sporadic and lack stable semantic conditions.

patterns.name: solicits word form and meaning
patterns.context: Third-person singular verb form; the object may be business or unlawful sexual intercourse, among other things, meaning to solicit, invite, or engage in solicitation.

patterns.name: tutor-related word forms
patterns.context: A stem suffix in a compound identifier, describing a user or audience category.

patterns.name: alias/aliases-related word forms
patterns.context: Refers to aliases or format aliases; appears in variables, methods, and XML tags.

patterns.name: release word form
patterns.context: Plural noun appearing near a program elimination/schedule table; may also be a common trigger for releases.

patterns.name: disagrees word form
patterns.context: Third-person singular verb expressing the court's disagreement with the preceding argument.

patterns.name: Weak word-form fragments across boundaries
patterns.context: There are no evident shared local semantic conditions in the respective sentences or code; most are low-intensity fragments and include common function words, intraword suffixes, punctuation, and spaces.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, philosophical discussion, medical papers, code, encyclopedia entries, and legal documents

1_2469.concept: 词内片段«its»及若干复数/词尾片段
1_2469.description: 最强且跨领域重复的触发是词形片段«its»，位于 solic«its»；另有较弱的 tutor«ed»、ali«ases»、Rele«ases»、disag«rees»等词尾或词内片段。其余激活零散，缺乏稳定语义条件。

en.description: High activations mainly fall on intraword suffixes or endings: solicits, releases, and medical -sis; there are also the enzyme-name plural -ases, elimination, determines, and unveiling. Triggers are scattered across legal, medical, biological, entertainment, software, and technology texts.

patterns.name: solicits word form
patterns.context: In legal texts, describes a party soliciting business or a statute describing solicitation of unlawful sexual conduct; in philosophical texts, solicits means attracting attention.

patterns.name: Plural releases
patterns.context: Appears in a list or version-release process as a heading or process item.

patterns.name: Medical terms ending in -sis
patterns.context: In medical contexts, appears in the names of treatments or experimental methods; the highlight falls on the term-final -sis.

patterns.name: Plural enzyme names in -ase
patterns.context: Refers to the plural form of Q-beta replicase in protein synthesis research.

patterns.name: -ination ending
patterns.context: In a column heading in a television competition program ranking table.

patterns.name: -ines verb ending
patterns.context: In a court decision sentence describing the court reaching a determination.

patterns.name: -iling ending
patterns.context: Describes a product reveal at a product launch event.

1_2469.description: 高激活主要落在词内后缀或词尾：solicits、releases，以及医学 -sis；另有酶名复数 -ases、elimination、determines、unveiling。触发分散于法律、医学、生物学、娱乐、软件和科技文本。

en.description: Activations often fall on short intraword fragments such as -ase, -is, -uria, -rees, -ored, and solicits; there are also “up” and code indentation. Domains, contexts, and meanings vary, making a unified pattern difficult to establish.

patterns.name: Intraword or word-final fragments -is / -ise / -asis
patterns.context: Activations often fall on short intraword substrings or word endings rather than complete words; these substrings span multiple parts of speech and word forms, with no fixed surrounding context.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: biomedical, legal, philosophical, and general texts

patterns.name: solicits in legal contexts
patterns.context: Appears in legal texts describing solicitation of business or unlawful sexual conduct; the same word form also appears in non-legal texts.

patterns.name: Past-participle forms with -ored
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the “ored” fragment in past participles or compounds, with no evident shared theme in the surrounding context.

patterns.name: Short-fragment activations in common words
patterns.context: Isolated subword fragments or whitespace are marked; there is insufficient evidence that they share clear semantic conditions with other triggers.

1_2469.description: 激活多落在词内短片段：如 -ase、-is、-uria、-rees、-ored，以及 solicits；另有“up”和代码缩进。跨领域、上下文与语义不一，难以确认统一规律。

patterns.name: 词内或词尾的 -is / -ise / -asis 片段
patterns.trigger: “biosynthesis”中的“synthesis”尾部、“replicase”中的“ase”、“proteinuria”中的“uria”、“plasmapheresis”中的“is”及“disagrees”中的“rees”
patterns.context: 激活常落在词内的短子串或词尾，而非完整词；这些子串跨越多种词类和词形，周边语境不固定。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：生物医学、法律、哲学与一般文本

patterns.name: 法律语境中的 solicits
patterns.context: 出现在法律文本中，描述招揽业务或非法性行为；相同词形也出现在非法律文本中。

patterns.name: 过去分词 -ored 词形

patterns.name: 常见词中的短片段激活
patterns.context: 孤立的子词片段或空白被标记；未见足够证据说明其与其他触发共享明确语义条件。

en.description: Activations mainly occur on English word endings or derivational suffix fragments, commonly -ases, -its, -leases, -ation, and -iling; TeX command fragments, short words, and whitespace also appear, so a single semantic explanation is not possible.

patterns.name: Verb endings such as -ases/-ates
patterns.context: Markers cluster on word suffixes or endings, especially at the junction between a stem and ending; they cover different meanings and contexts and cannot be attributed to a single semantic category
patterns.domain: Biomedical, legal, encyclopedia, news, and technical texts

patterns.name: Longer within-word suffixes or derived forms
patterns.context: Activations fall on derivational suffixes or final portions within words, occurring in nouns or gerunds

patterns.name: Common short words and root endings
patterns.context: A few high-frequency words or root endings also activate; contextual conditions are unclear, making them difficult to unify with the main word-form pattern

patterns.name: Internal fragments in TeX commands
patterns.context: Activations occur on word fragments in LaTeX macro commands and their arguments, in formatting code contexts

patterns.name: determines word form
patterns.context: A legal sentence structure in which a court finds or determines a matter.

patterns.name: replicase-related word forms
patterns.context: Protein synthesis and Q-beta replicase research contexts; both instances highlight the enzyme-name ending.

en.concept: Specific subword fragments and word forms

patterns.domain: Personal profiles, teaching, and technical discussions
