patterns.context: The context concerns an uncertain future, speculation, or unrealized outcome; however, not all specific expressions in these snippets are marked as positive activations. The primary activation remains on might.
patterns.domain: Personal correspondence, news commentary, sports narratives, and general explanations

patterns.name: First- and second-person and communication contexts
patterns.context: Possibilities or requests concern the speaker, recipient, or a shared relationship; person marking itself is not consistently activated across segments and cannot be treated as a stable trigger on its own.
patterns.domain: Emails, interpersonal narratives, and religious/reflective writing

patterns.name: Diverse content following might
patterns.context: The content following might varies widely, involving knowledge, communication, emotions, relationships, competition, sports goals, and difficulties; there is no shared lexical theme.
patterns.domain: Science headlines, business emails, religious essays, personal emails, news commentary, game/town discussions, sports reporting, and legal advice

patterns.name: Possibility judgments in contrast or transition
patterns.context: A possibility judgment appears in a sentence with a transition, contrast, or revised expectation; these are local pragmatic contexts for might, not shared by all segments.
patterns.domain: Psychological advice, personal emails, and news commentary

1_2918.description: 全部十段都突出激活 might，后接从简单动词到 have 结构及否定结构，表达可能、推测、假设或委婉建议。话题和文体跨度很大，其他词句差异明显。

patterns.name: 情态结构中的 might
patterns.trigger: “might”及其后的动词或动词短语，如 “might not know”“might have”“might find”“might seem”“might be”“might not be able”
patterns.context: 主要激活落在 might；它常引出可能、假设、建议或不确定结果，后面可接动词原形，也可接 have + 分词或 not。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的说明、叙事、邮件、评论与劝告等文体

patterns.name: 不确定性与推测表达
patterns.trigger: “Who knows what the future brings”“It appears”“could have entirely envisioned”“not look bright”等与可能性相关的表达
patterns.context: 语境围绕尚未确定的未来、推测或未实现的结果；但这些片段中的具体表达并非都标记为正激活，主要激活仍在 might。
patterns.domain: 个人通信、新闻评论、体育叙事及一般说明

patterns.name: 第一、二人称及交流语境
patterns.trigger: “you might”“we might”“I was hoping that you might”“relates to us”
patterns.context: 可能性或请求涉及说话者、收信者或共同关系；不同段落中人称本身的激活并不一致，不能单独视为稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: 邮件、人际叙述与宗教/反思性文字

patterns.name: 话题各异的后续内容
patterns.trigger: “about fish”“a hole in communications”“incredible joy”“someone better than me”“better shops”“high goals”“a way out”等
patterns.context: might 后接内容差异很大，分别涉及知识、沟通、情绪、关系、竞争、体育目标和困境；未见共同的词汇主题。
patterns.domain: 科普标题、商务邮件、宗教随笔、私人邮件、新闻评论、游戏/城镇讨论、体育报道及法律建议

patterns.name: 对比或转折中的可能判断
patterns.trigger: “These two ideas might seem contradictory but…”；“Even so … you might find…”；“might have been moved a little bit”
patterns.context: 可能性判断嵌在转折、对照或修正预期的语句中；这些是 might 的局部语用环境，并非所有段落共有。
patterns.domain: 心理建议、个人邮件与新闻评论

en.description: Activation is mainly on might, followed by various possible outcomes; there is also activation on the compensate word family and a few words such as gear, relationship, searching, and potential. Contexts span multiple domains, with no unifying semantic theme.

patterns.name: Tokens following might
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the modal verb might, especially when followed immediately by an unmarked verb or phrase; in [1], might may also function as a prediction at the sentence level.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain web, email, religious/philosophical, legal, and game text

patterns.name: Compensation word family
patterns.context: Contexts include compensating someone for their time, mitigating famine risk, or compensating a litigant; the trigger itself is unmarked, while compensate is marked.
patterns.domain: Business emails, health information, legal texts

patterns.name: Other sporadic triggers
patterns.context: These highlighted words each occur in different contexts, with no stable shared local pattern.
patterns.domain: Science communication, personal emails, religious philosophy

1_2918.description: 主要激活于 might，后接各种可能性内容；另对 compensate 词族及少数 gear、relationship、searching、potential 等词有激活。语境跨领域，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: might 后的词元
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在情态动词 might，尤其是它后面紧跟未标记的动词或短语时；[1]中 might 也可能表示整句位置上的预测。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的网页、邮件、宗教哲学、法律及游戏文本

patterns.name: 补偿词族
patterns.context: 在补偿某人时间、弥补饥荒风险或赔偿诉讼对方等语境中；触发词本身未标出，标记在 compensate。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、健康科普、法律文本

patterns.name: 其他零散触发
patterns.context: 这些高亮词各自出现在不同语境，未见稳定的共同局部模式。
patterns.domain: 科普、私人邮件、宗教哲学

en.concept: «lems» letter fragment and similar word segments
en.description: Most activations fall on «lems» in Danish and Swedish forms of “member states”; activation also occurs on similar letter fragments in golems and underscore/underscored, as well as on y after Beck in an email, possibly mixing word-form and local token features.

patterns.name: Member-state stem in Danish compounds
patterns.context: Activation falls on the cross-token fragment «lems», followed by Danish staters; the surrounding text discusses EU member states, solidarity, and policy.

patterns.name: Danish “member state” word forms
patterns.context: Activation appears on the stem fragment of the word for member state; surrounding text concerns member-state measures, funding, or implementation.

patterns.name: Swedish “member state” word forms
patterns.context: Activation falls within med«lems»staterna; the context discusses member-state responsibilities, legal implementation, or policy.

patterns.name: Local fragment in Swedish member-state policy contexts
patterns.context: The same word form appears in policy discussions involving transfers, response deadlines, and similar topics; activation remains localized within the word.

patterns.name: Same letter fragment in the English plural golems
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs in go«lems», not in “member states”; adjacent text discusses golems.

patterns.name: Underscore word in PHP post data
patterns.context: Activation falls on the undersc...core word segment; the original text is underscore. The title asks how to iterate over formatted PHP post data.

patterns.name: Underscore word in a medical abstract
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-initial fragment of underscored; the sentence says accountability pressures underscore the need for standardized measurement.

patterns.name: y after a name and an upward-trend phrase
patterns.context: The name Beck is followed by y, then “going up in Jan”; activation falls mainly on y, with uncertain semantic connection.

1_2918.description: 多数激活落在丹麦语、瑞典语“成员国”词形的 «lems»；另在 golems、underscore/underscored 的相似字母片段激活，另有邮件中 Beck 后的 y，可能混合词形与局部 token 特征。

patterns.name: 丹麦语复合词中的成员国词干
patterns.context: 激活落在跨词片段 «lems»，后接丹麦语 staters；周围是欧盟成员国、团结与政策表述。

patterns.name: 丹麦语“成员国”相关词形
patterns.context: 激活出现在成员国一词的词干片段，周围涉及成员国措施、资金或实施。

patterns.name: 瑞典语“成员国”相关词形
patterns.context: 激活落在 med«lems»staterna 内，语境讨论成员国的责任、法律实施或政策。

patterns.name: 瑞典语成员国政策语境中的局部片段
patterns.context: 同一词形出现在转移、答复期限等政策讨论中；激活仍定位于词内片段。

patterns.name: 英语复数 golems 中的相同字母片段
patterns.context: 触发片段位于 go«lems» 中，不是“成员国”；相邻文本谈及 golems。

patterns.name: PHP 帖子数据中的下划线词
patterns.context: 激活落在 undersc...core 词段，原文为 underscore；标题询问如何遍历格式化的 PHP 帖子数据。

patterns.name: 医学摘要中的下划线词
patterns.context: 激活落在 underscored 的词首片段；句中表示问责压力凸显标准化测量的需要。

patterns.name: 姓名后的 y 与上涨短语
patterns.context: 姓名 Beck 后接 y，随后出现“going up in Jan”；激活主要落在 y，语义联系不确定。

en.description: Activation is mainly on the spect spelling fragment and its various word forms, and also on the clim- climate-word stem; there is additionally a hyd- fragment seen only in Rhyd-uchaf. The trigger locations and meanings are not consistent across these patterns.

patterns.name: spect- stem
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the spect spelling fragment within words, covering different forms such as spectator, spectacles, spectre, spectrofluorimetry, and specter, with varying meanings and syntactic positions.
patterns.domain: Cross-disciplinary: materials science, ophthalmology, literature, research methods, and law

patterns.name: clim- stem
patterns.context: Occurs in vocabulary related to climate or climatic conditions, including climatic and climates.
patterns.domain: Agriculture, meteorology, environmental health, patent background

patterns.name: hyd- fragment
patterns.context: The short string “Rhyd-uchaf” in a Wikipedia snippet; there is insufficient context to determine whether it is an independent lexical pattern.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia proper name or article text

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: The snippet concerns wartime deprivation and a lack of food in the South, but the markers fall only on a fragment within “privations” and words such as “became”; this cannot be explained by the main stem pattern.

1_2918.description: 主要对 spect 拼写片段及其多种词形激活，也对 clim- 气候词词干激活；另有仅见于 Rhyd-uchaf 的 hyd- 片段。各模式触发位置与词义并不统一。

patterns.name: spect-词干
patterns.context: 激活集中于单词内部的 spect 拼写片段；覆盖 spectator、spectacles、spectre、spectrofluorimetry、specter 等不同词形，词义和句法位置不一。
patterns.domain: 跨学科：材料科学、眼科、文学、科研方法、法律

patterns.name: clim-词干
patterns.context: 出现在气候或气候条件相关词汇中，包括 climatic 和 climates。
patterns.domain: 农业、气象、环境健康、专利背景

patterns.name: hyd-片段
patterns.context: 维基百科片段中的短字符串“Rhyd-uchaf”；缺少足够上下文判断它是否是独立词汇模式。
patterns.domain: 维基百科专名或条目文本

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.trigger: 未见与上述片段相符的明确触发词
patterns.context: 片段内容涉及战争时期匮乏及南方缺少食物，但标记只落在“privations”内部的片段和“became”等词上；无法由主要词干模式解释。

en.concept: bi subword fragments and scientific text
en.description: Most segments activate on bi subword fragments, covering biological vocabulary, bi-compounds, Bihar, and biodiesel; other high-activation words occur in contexts involving protein function and material-energy calculations.

patterns.name: bi-initial subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on the fragment bi; the word completed by the fragment varies and may be part of biomedical, biology, or an ordinary word.

patterns.name: bi in biologist
patterns.context: biologist is split into bi and ologist, with strong activation on the initial bi; the context introduces a molecular biologist.

patterns.name: bi- compound prefix
patterns.context: bi- is followed by a hyphen, forming a compound that denotes two directions or two circuits.

patterns.name: bi in biology-related words
patterns.context: bi begins words such as biology, biochemistry, and biometrical, whose meanings concern biology, biochemistry, or biostatistical analysis.

patterns.name: bi in the place name Bihar
patterns.context: bi is the initial fragment of the Indian place name Bihar, in a context describing a village, temple, and surrounding information.

patterns.name: bi in biodiesel
patterns.context: bi is the initial fragment of biodiesel; the text discusses its production and the transesterification reaction.

patterns.name: Biomolecules and protein function
patterns.context: In a context involving chaperone proteins and their role in the protein lifecycle, activation falls on functions, not the bi fragment.

patterns.name: Materials chemistry structures and calculations
patterns.context: Activation falls on calculations; the context concerns CoO6 octahedra, ion positions, supercells, and energy calculations.

1_2918.description: 多数段在 bi 子词片段上激活，涵盖生物学词汇、bi-复合词、Bihar 与 biodiesel；另有蛋白质功能和材料能量计算语境中的高激活词。

patterns.name: bi 开头子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 bi 片段；该片段后续拼成的词并不固定，可能是 biomedical、biology 或普通词的一部分。
patterns.domain: 跨领域，主要见于生物医学文本

patterns.name: biologist 中的 bi
patterns.context: biologist 被拆成 bi 与 ologist，强激活在词首 bi；上下文介绍一位分子生物学家。

patterns.name: bi- 复合词前缀
patterns.context: bi- 后接连字符，构成表示双向或双回路的复合词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究、专利技术背景

patterns.name: 生物学相关词中的 bi
patterns.context: bi 作为 biology、biochemistry、biometrical 等词的开头，后续词义涉及生物学、生化或生物统计分析。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要、项目说明

patterns.name: 地名 Bihar 中的 bi
patterns.context: bi 是印度地名 Bihar 的词首片段，处在介绍村庄、寺庙与周边信息的语境中。

patterns.name: 生物柴油中的 bi
patterns.context: bi 位于 biodiesel 词首；文本讨论其生产及酯交换反应。

patterns.name: 生物分子与蛋白质功能
patterns.context: 在分子伴侣蛋白及其作用于蛋白质生命周期的语境中，激活落在 functions，而非 bi 片段。
patterns.domain: 生物医学综述或研究文本

patterns.name: 材料化学结构与计算
patterns.context: 激活落在 calculations；上下文涉及 CoO6 八面体、离子位置、超晶胞及能量计算。

en.concept: function word family and local vocabulary
en.description: The most stable trigger is the function/functions/functional word family, covering functions, uses, and the mathematical sense of “a function of a variable”; several sporadic lexical activations remain unexplained by the main pattern.

patterns.name: functions word forms
patterns.context: functions/function(s) appears in terminology or descriptions, especially when explaining the function or use of an object; it is sometimes preceded by modifiers such as its/their/basic/physiological and followed by of/by/as.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, patent technology, materials and device descriptions

patterns.name: functions as a noun
patterns.context: functions refers to the basic or physiological functions of proteins, in biological discussion of HSP, NF-kappaB, and regulation of nuclear signaling.

patterns.name: function in variable-related terminology
patterns.context: function appears in the mathematical/experimental measurement expression “as a function of pressure,” rather than its usual sense of function or use.

patterns.name: Other local lexical activations
patterns.context: These activations occur respectively in micro/nanotechnology, electronic devices, the title of an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and the resistivity notation varrho(T); there is no shared local trigger condition.

1_2918.description: 最稳定的触发是 function/functions/functional 词族，涵盖功能、用途和数学上的“关于某变量的函数”用法；另有若干零散词汇激活，无法由主模式解释。

patterns.name: functions 词形
patterns.context: 术语或描述中出现 functions/function(s)，尤其在说明某对象所承担的功能或用途时；有时前接 its/their/basic/physiological 等限定词，后接 of/by/as。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、专利技术、材料与器件描述

patterns.name: functions 作名词
patterns.trigger: «functions»10 in «the» life cycle of «proteins»（第 1 段）；«functions»9 of these «proteins»（第 2 段）
patterns.context: functions 指蛋白质的基本或生理功能；置于有关 HSP、NF-kappaB 与核信号调节的生物学论述中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要及项目描述

patterns.name: function 作变量相关术语
patterns.context: function 出现在“as a function of pressure”这一数学／实验测量表达中，并非通常的功能用途义。

patterns.name: 其他局部词汇激活
patterns.trigger: «Micro»（第 4 段）；«electronic»（第 5 段）；«academ»（第 9 段）；«var»与«T»（第 10 段）
patterns.context: 这些激活分别落在微/纳米技术、电子器件、中国科学院院士称谓，以及电阻率记号 varrho(T) 中；未见共同的局部触发条件。
patterns.domain: 专利、人物简介、物理摘要

en.concept: Functions and example structures in technical descriptions
en.description: Primarily responds to words describing the functions and uses of objects in technical texts, as well as example-giving structures. It also responds to research-discourse terms such as specifically, analytic, and function; several cross-domain one-off words have no consistent collocations.

patterns.name: function and collocations
patterns.context: Describes the role or function of an object or material in technical explanations; common collocations include “have ... functions,” “reinforcing function,” and “guiding function.”
patterns.domain: Biomedical, materials, and engineering technology texts

patterns.name: such as example structure
patterns.context: such as is followed by specific examples or occurs in a listing structure; activation may fall on such or as.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, patent background, biographical introductions

patterns.name: specifically as a qualifier
patterns.context: specifically introduces a defined research target or concrete operation, such as specifically evaluated/capture.

patterns.name: Objects of analysis or examination
patterns.context: In theoretical or experimental discussion, refers to the analysis, measurement, or examination of a variable or model property; function here may also have its general mathematical sense.
patterns.domain: Theoretical physics and experimental materials science

patterns.name: Specific properties of materials or objects
patterns.context: Marks a specific property, capability, device component, or characterization method in its respective context; these examples have no obvious shared collocations.
patterns.domain: Nanobiotechnology, biographies, electronic device patents, materials characterization

patterns.name: Numerical and symbolic scientific notation
patterns.context: In theoretical science texts, numbers, hyphens, and dimensional abbreviations combine to form technical notation; activation is high on D.

patterns.name: Patent composition and use descriptions
patterns.context: Lists product ingredients and explains that a material is used to impart frictional properties; related to other function patterns, but the trigger words themselves are weak.

patterns.name: Occasional activation on discourse connectors
patterns.context: Appears when connecting supplementary information, but activation is weak and this is not a primary trigger pattern.

1_2918.concept: 科技说明中的功能与举例
1_2918.description: 主要对科技文本中描述对象功能、用途及举例结构的词语响应，也会响应 specifically、analytic、function 等研究论述用语；另有若干跨领域单例词，缺乏统一搭配。

patterns.name: function及其搭配
patterns.context: 在科技说明中描述某物或材料所承担的作用、功能；常见于“have ... functions”“reinforcing function”“guiding function”等搭配。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、材料与工程技术文本

patterns.name: such as举例结构
patterns.context: such as 后接具体例子，或处于列举例子的结构中；激活可落在 such 或 as 上。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、专利背景、人物介绍

patterns.name: specifically强调限定
patterns.context: specifically 用来引出明确的研究评估对象或具体操作，如 specifically evaluated/capture。

patterns.name: 分析或考察对象
patterns.context: 在理论或实验论述中，指向对某变量或模型性质的分析、测量或考察；此处的 function 也可能是一般数学用法。
patterns.domain: 理论物理与实验材料科学

patterns.name: 材料或对象的具体属性
patterns.context: 在各自语境中标记具体属性、能力、设备部件或表征方法；这些例子之间没有明显共同搭配。
patterns.domain: 纳米生物技术、人物传记、电子设备专利、材料表征

patterns.name: 数值与符号化科学记号
patterns.context: 理论科学文本中，数字、连字符与维度缩写共同构成技术记号；高激活落在 D。

patterns.name: 专利构成与用途描述
patterns.context: 列举制品原料，并说明材料用于赋予摩擦性质；与其他功能类模式有联系，但触发词本身不强。

patterns.name: 篇章衔接词也有零星激活
patterns.context: 连接补充信息时出现，但强度低且并非主要触发模式。

en.description: All snippets activate on the same word form, analytic, across contexts including physics, biomedicine, psychology, cybersecurity, computer science, and philosophy. Following words and meanings vary, with no unified domain or semantic condition.

patterns.name: Word form analytic
patterns.context: The word analytic appears directly, followed by different nouns or phrases; it does not depend on a specific domain.

patterns.name: analytic continuation
patterns.context: analytic modifies continuation; discusses analytic continuation in dimension D in the Luttinger model.

patterns.name: analytic strategies
patterns.context: analytic modifies strategies, referring to analytical strategies used in research.

patterns.name: analytic expressions
patterns.context: analytic modifies expressions, describing expressions for dark matter signals limited by thermal noise.

patterns.name: analytic processing
patterns.context: analytic is coordinated with synthetic and refers to a type of sound processing.

patterns.name: analytic resources
patterns.context: analytic is coordinated with personal and financial, referring to resources that a cyberattack may obtain.

patterns.name: analytic procedures
patterns.context: analytic modifies procedures, referring to methods designed for a specific problem.

patterns.name: analytic query processing
patterns.context: analytic query processing is contrasted with neural query processing; the phrase crosses a line break.
patterns.domain: Technical discussion, databases, and computer hardware

patterns.name: analytic models
patterns.context: analytic modifies models, used to simplify modeling, predict observed results, or assist instrument design.

patterns.name: analytic philosophy
patterns.context: analytic is part of the name of a philosophical school, alongside pragmatism, phenomenology, and others.

1_2918.description: 全部片段都激活在同一词形 analytic 上，覆盖物理、生物医学、心理学、网络安全、计算机、哲学等语境；后接词及含义多样，未见统一的领域或语义条件。

patterns.name: analytic 的词形
patterns.context: 直接出现单词 analytic，后接不同名词或短语；不依赖某一特定领域。

patterns.name: analytic continuation
patterns.context: analytic 作定语，修饰 continuation；讨论 Luttinger 模型中对维数 D 的解析延拓。

patterns.name: analytic strategies
patterns.context: analytic 修饰 strategies，指研究中采用的分析策略。

patterns.name: analytic expressions
patterns.context: analytic 修饰 expressions，描述热噪声受限暗物质信号的表达式。

patterns.name: analytic processing
patterns.context: analytic 与 synthetic 并列，指声音加工的一种类型。

patterns.name: analytic resources
patterns.context: analytic 与 personal、financial 并列，指网络攻击可能获取的资源。

patterns.name: analytic procedures
patterns.context: analytic 修饰 procedures，指针对特定问题制定的方法。

patterns.name: analytic query processing
patterns.context: analytic query processing 与 neural query processing 对照；词组跨换行。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、数据库与计算机硬件

patterns.name: analytic models
patterns.context: analytic 修饰 models；用于简化建模、预测观测结果或辅助仪器设计。

patterns.name: analytic philosophy
patterns.context: analytic 作为哲学流派名称的一部分，与 pragmatism、phenomenology 等并列。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on two forms, trainers (6 segments) and mapping (3 segments), with one additional segment on analytic (analytic continuation). The forms occur across different contexts and domains, with no obvious shared semantics.

patterns.name: trainers form
patterns.context: The direct trigger is trainers, appearing in noun phrases about trainers, coaches, or staff involved in research training programs; modifiers and following content vary.
patterns.domain: NIH project descriptions, fitness advice, general explanations

patterns.name: mapping form
patterns.context: The direct trigger is mapping; it refers variously to diagramming/element mapping, protein conformation mapping, and mapping regions of physical dynamics, with no consistent context.
patterns.domain: Materials science, biomedicine, condensed matter physics

patterns.name: analytic continuation phrase
patterns.context: The trigger analytic appears in a discussion of analytic continuation in dimension D; the surrounding context concerns the Luttinger model.

1_2918.description: 激活集中在 trainers（6段）与 mapping（3段）两个词形，另有 analytic（解析延拓）1段。各词形跨越不同上下文和领域，没有明显共同语义。

patterns.name: trainers 词形
patterns.context: 直接触发词 trainers，出现在介绍训练人员、教练或研究培训项目人员的名词短语中；前置修饰语和后续内容各异。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目描述、健身建议、一般说明

patterns.name: mapping 词形
patterns.context: 直接触发 mapping；分别指图示/元素映射、蛋白构象映射和物理动力学区域映射，所处上下文不统一。
patterns.domain: 材料科学、生物医学、凝聚态物理

patterns.name: analytic continuation 短语
patterns.context: 触发词 analytic 出现在讨论维数 D 的解析延拓时；相邻上下文涉及 Luttinger 模型。

en.description: Strong activations occur across different word forms or phrases, including function(s), conduc-, trainers, and analytic, referring respectively to function, conductive/conducive, trainers, and mathematical physics terminology; no clear, unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: function(s) word forms
patterns.context: Nouns describing the function of devices, mitochondria, or biological components; strong activation falls on function/functions
patterns.domain: Patent background, medical abstracts, NIH project descriptions

patterns.name: conductive/conducive word forms
patterns.context: The stem conduc- appears in the adjectives conductive or conducive; strong activation falls on the stem

patterns.name: SME trainers
patterns.context: Describes trained and certified SME trainers; strong activation is on trainers

patterns.name: analytic continuation
patterns.context: Developing the analytic continuation in a physics paper; strong activation is on analytic

1_2918.description: 强激活分布在 function(s)、conduc-、trainers 和 analytic 等不同词形或短语上，分别涉及功能、导热/有利于、培训人员及数学物理术语；未见统一的明显语义触发条件。

patterns.name: function(s) 词形
patterns.context: 名词，描述器件、线粒体或生物元件的功能；强激活落在 function/functions
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学摘要、NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: conductive/conducive 词形
patterns.context: 词干 conduc- 出现在形容词 conductive（导热/导电）或 conducive（有利于）中；强激活落在词干上
patterns.domain: 专利技术描述、法律判决

patterns.name: SME trainers
patterns.context: 描述受训且经认证的 SME trainers，强激活在 trainers
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 项目行政文本

patterns.name: analytic continuation
patterns.context: 物理学论文中 developing the analytic continuation；强激活在 analytic

en.concept: Polysemy of function and sporadic word fragments
en.description: Most segments activate on the word function, covering general function, operation, and biological functional processes; there is also a mathematical use in pressure-dependent relationships. Other high activations are scattered across word fragments with no obvious shared pattern.

patterns.name: Functional sense of function
patterns.context: Occurs in expressions such as “function and proper operation,” “mitochondrial function inhibition,” and “impair the function of the rotor,” meaning a function, operation, or functional process; it can trigger in different syntactic positions.
patterns.domain: Patent background, medical and biological abstracts, engineering technology; [1][3][4][5][9]

patterns.name: Mathematical relationship in function of pressure
patterns.context: In “as a function of pressure,” function refers to a mathematical relationship that varies with pressure, not a general function.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations outside function
patterns.context: Activation falls on different words or word fragments, with no obvious shared semantics or syntactic conditions in their sentences.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, patent background, NIH training programs, journal copyright lines

1_2918.concept: function 多义词及零散词片段
1_2918.description: 多数段在 function 一词上激活，涵盖一般功能、运作及生物功能过程；另有压力依赖关系的数学用法。其余高激活分散在无明显共同模式的词片段上。

patterns.name: function 的功能义
patterns.context: 出现在“function and proper operation”“mitochondrial function inhibition”“impair the function of the rotor”等表达中，表示功能、运作或某项功能过程；不同句法位置均可触发。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学与生物学摘要、工程技术；[1][3][4][5][9]

patterns.name: function of pressure 的数学关系
patterns.context: “as a function of pressure”中，function 指随压力变化的数学关系，而非一般功能。

patterns.name: 非 function 的零散激活
patterns.context: 激活落在不同词或词片段上，所在句子中没有明显共同语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利背景、NIH 培训项目、期刊版权行

en.description: Primarily activates on the word function and its phrase structures, covering physiological roles, material functions, and variable-function relationships; there are also sporadic activations on replacement, parenthesized numbering, and isotope mass numbers.

patterns.name: function-related phrases
patterns.context: Occurs in technical statements describing material uses, biological roles, or a variable as a function of another variable; activations often concentrate on function
patterns.domain: Patents, life sciences abstracts and proposals, physics papers

patterns.name: Biological terms preceding function
patterns.context: Biomedical contexts discussing the physiological roles of cellular components, proteins, or channels; activation falls on function

patterns.name: Material or cellular terms preceding function
patterns.context: Refers respectively to the electronic function of materials and mitochondrial function; the trigger remains function, but its referent differs

patterns.name: as a function of construction
patterns.context: Describes the dependence of resistivity on pressure in physics

patterns.name: Replacement/substitution noun
patterns.context: In studies of enzyme properties, replacement introduces a substitution operation; it is not clearly related to the main function pattern

patterns.name: Parenthesized numbering
patterns.context: Parenthesized numbers in a list of research objectives; may be triggered by local punctuation or formatting

patterns.name: Isotope mass numbers
patterns.context: Superscript mass numbers of radioactive nickel and cobalt isotopes in astrophysics text

1_2918.description: 主要对 function 一词及其短语结构激活，涵盖生理作用、材料功能和变量函数关系；另有 replacement、括号编号及同位素质量数等零散激活。

patterns.name: function 相关词组
patterns.trigger: “function”及其前后的限定词，如“electronic function materials”“mitochondrial function”“physiological function”“as a function of pressure”
patterns.context: 出现于技术性陈述中，描述材料用途、生物学作用，或某变量作为另一变量的函数；多处激活集中在 function
patterns.domain: 专利、生命科学摘要与申请书、物理学论文

patterns.name: function 前置的生物学术语
patterns.trigger: “physiological function”“physiological function of TRPC channels”“physiological function of the FMR protein”
patterns.context: 生物医学语境中讨论细胞成分、蛋白质或通道的生理作用；激活落在 function
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: function 前置的材料或细胞术语
patterns.context: 分别指材料的电子功能、线粒体功能；触发词仍为 function，但所指不同

patterns.name: as a function of 结构
patterns.context: 物理学中描述电阻率随压力变化的依赖关系

patterns.name: 替换/取代名词
patterns.context: 酶性质研究中，以 replacement 引出替换操作；与 function 主模式不明显相关

patterns.name: 编号括号
patterns.context: 研究目标列表中的括号编号；可能是局部标点/格式触发

patterns.name: 同位素质量数
patterns.context: 天体物理文本中放射性镍、钴同位素的上标质量数

en.concept: whey form and sporadic word features
en.description: The most consistent signal is whey formed across tokens, found in dairy, nutrition, and biomedical contexts; function also activates in materials or biological contexts. The rest consists of scattered word fragments and terms with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: whey subword fragment
patterns.context: Tokens combine across segmentation boundaries to form whey; occurs in references to whey protein, dairy products, or whey acidic protein
patterns.domain: Dairy, nutrition, medical and biological research

patterns.name: The word function
patterns.context: function occurs in a materials or biological context, modifying a material or describing physiological/mitochondrial function
patterns.domain: Patent materials, cell biology, and medical research

patterns.name: Other sporadic word fragments or terms
patterns.context: No stable shared context is evident; activations occur on technical terms or internal word fragments
patterns.domain: Patents, microbiology, genetics, signal transduction, animal nutrition, and mitochondrial research

patterns.name: Hydroxychloroquine title fragment
patterns.context: A subword fragment in the middle of a drug name; a one-off, with the surrounding title mentioning retinal pigment

patterns.name: Fragments in a production and feedstock context
patterns.context: Describes producing a copolymer using inexpensive substrates and lists whey among the carbon sources; shares the form whey with other hits but differs in context

patterns.name: Polysemous distribution of highlighted words
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across titles, patent background, experimental descriptions, and research abstracts; apart from whey and function, it is difficult to explain with a unified semantic condition
patterns.domain: Medical, patent, and biological science texts

1_2918.description: 最稳定的线索是跨 token 拼出的 whey（乳清），见于乳制品、营养及生物医学语境；另有 function 在材料或生物学语境中激活。其余为分散的词片段与术语，缺少统一语义条件。

patterns.name: whey 子词片段
patterns.context: token 跨分词边界拼成 whey；出现在乳清蛋白、乳制品或乳清酸性蛋白等表述中
patterns.domain: 乳品、营养、医学与生物研究

patterns.name: 功能一词
patterns.context: 在材料或生物学语境中出现 function，修饰材料或描述生理/线粒体功能
patterns.domain: 专利材料、细胞生物学与医学研究

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段或术语
patterns.context: 未见稳定共同上下文；分别是技术术语或词语内部片段中的激活
patterns.domain: 专利、微生物学、遗传学、信号传导、畜牧营养及线粒体研究

patterns.name: 羟氯喹标题片段
patterns.context: 药物名称中间的子词片段，单例，周围标题提到视网膜色素

patterns.name: 生产性与原料语境中的片段
patterns.context: 描述利用廉价底物生产共聚物，并列举乳清等碳源；与其他 whey 命中共享词形但语境不同
patterns.domain: 微生物生物技术论文摘要

patterns.name: 高亮词语的多义分布
patterns.context: 激活散布于标题、专利背景、实验描述及研究摘要；除 whey 与 function 外，难以由统一语义条件解释
patterns.domain: 跨医学、专利与生物科学文本

en.description: Primarily responds to nuclides, neutrons, and nuclear spin terminology in nuclear physics text, and also to wheezing in clinical respiratory text; it additionally activates in descriptions of material electronic function and mitochondrial function.

patterns.name: Nuclear reactions and nuclide notation
patterns.context: Nuclide symbols, isotopes, and neutron-related terms, including nuclear reaction, nucleosynthesis, and nuclear physics experimental contexts.

patterns.name: wheezing in medical text
patterns.context: Wheezing in descriptions of respiratory disease or clinical examinations; often listed alongside asthma, dyspnea, chest symptoms, or lung auscultation.

patterns.name: Material and electronic function
patterns.context: Describes organic compounds used in optical or electronic materials; activation is concentrated on the word function.

patterns.name: DNA repair and mitochondrial function
patterns.context: Medical research statements about the effects of inhibiting mitochondrial function on DNA repair in human cells.

1_2918.concept: 科学文本中的专门术语
1_2918.description: 主要响应核物理文本中的核素、中子及核自旋术语，也响应临床呼吸文本中的 wheezing；另在材料电子功能和线粒体功能表述中激活。

patterns.name: 核反应与核素记号
patterns.context: 核素符号、同位素及中子相关术语；包括核反应、天体核合成与核物理实验语境。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的 wheezing
patterns.context: 呼吸道疾病或临床检查描述中出现喘鸣；常与哮喘、dyspnea、胸部症状或肺部听诊并列。
patterns.domain: PubMed 医学摘要／临床法律记录

patterns.name: 材料功能与电子功能
patterns.context: 描述有机化合物用于光学或电子材料；激活集中在 function 一词。
patterns.domain: 专利背景／有机电子材料

patterns.name: DNA 修复与线粒体功能
patterns.context: 关于抑制线粒体功能对人类细胞 DNA 修复影响的医学研究表述。

en.description: Activations are scattered across chemical formulas, medical abbreviations, patent numbers, web separators, and subword fragments in proper names or ordinary words, often alongside special characters and segmentation boundaries; no stable semantic theme covers all examples.

patterns.name: Numbers and symbols in chemical formulas
patterns.context: Chemical formulas, concentrations, and other numbers and symbols are interspersed in chemical substances or experimental procedures; activation often falls on split chemical-formula characters.

patterns.name: Unusual spelling fragments in proper names
patterns.context: When personal names, place names, or animal names are split into multiple subwords, activation falls on spelling fragments; there is no obvious unified semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, novel summaries, research abstracts

patterns.name: Patent numbers and punctuation-number strings
patterns.context: Patent numbers are cited in patent background, forming dense sequences of digits and punctuation.

patterns.name: Web decoration symbols and quotation markers
patterns.context: Forum posts use separator lines, tildes, or quotation marks to organize content.

patterns.name: Medical abbreviations and terms with symbols
patterns.context: Medical or biological terms appear as abbreviations, hyphens, and ion symbols, possibly alongside subword segmentation.
patterns.domain: Clinical research, medical abstracts, research project texts

patterns.name: Sporadic word fragments in ordinary technical passages
patterns.context: In general technical or narrative text, activation falls on subword fragments of ordinary words; trigger conditions do not obviously align with those in the other segments.
patterns.domain: Patents, research project texts, novel summaries

1_2918.description: 激活散见于化学式、医学缩写、专利编号、网页分隔符及专名或普通词的子词片段，常伴随特殊字符和分词边界；未见能覆盖全部例子的稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 化学式中的数字及符号
patterns.context: 化学物质或实验步骤中，化学式、浓度等数字与符号穿插出现；激活常落在拆分的化学式字符上。
patterns.domain: 化学、生物医学实验方法

patterns.name: 专名中的特殊拼写片段
patterns.context: 人名、地名或动物名称被切分成多个子词时，激活落在拼写片段；没有明显的统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、小说简介、科研摘要

patterns.name: 专利编号与标点数字串
patterns.context: 专利背景中引用专利号，数字和标点构成密集序列。

patterns.name: 网页装饰符号与引用标记
patterns.context: 论坛帖子以分隔线、波浪线或引用符号组织内容。

patterns.name: 医学缩写与带符号术语
patterns.context: 医学或生物学术语以缩写、连字符和离子符号呈现，可能伴随子词切分。
patterns.domain: 临床研究、医学摘要、科研项目文本

patterns.name: 常规专业文段中的零散词片段
patterns.context: 一般专业或叙述性文字中，激活落在普通词的子词片段；与其余段落触发条件不明显一致。
patterns.domain: 专利、科研项目文本、小说简介

en.concept: Mixed response to the intraword fragments «e» and «in»
en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on the intraword «e» fragment, found in dynein, wheezing, peephole, and dye; there is also activation on «o f» in legal citations. Medical passages center on motor proteins or wheezing.

patterns.name: Biomedical text related to dynein
patterns.context: Appears in sentences about cellular motility, cytoskeletal motors, dynein subtypes, or their inhibitors; triggers center on the intraword fragments «ne»«in».

patterns.name: wheezing spelling fragment
patterns.context: Activation on the «e» within wheezing; the context concerns wheezing, asthma symptoms, lung examinations, or bronchoconstriction.
patterns.domain: Medical records, asthma research, clinical abstracts, and medical encyclopedias

patterns.name: Peephole-related word fragment
patterns.context: Appears in peephole in a narrative; this is a single instance, and the activated fragment is the same «e» as in wheezing.

patterns.name: o f in statutory citations
patterns.context: Separated letter fragments form of and appear near statutory provisions and legal citations.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in dye
patterns.context: Appears in compounds such as water-soluble-dye-containing ink; an isolated instance with no matching immediate medical context.
patterns.domain: Patent background technology involving aqueous inks and dyes

1_2918.concept: 词内片段«e»及«in»的混合响应
1_2918.description: 强激活主要落在词内的 «e» 片段：见于 dynein、wheezing、peephole、dye；另在法律引文的 «o f» 上激活。医学段落集中于运动蛋白或喘鸣。

patterns.name: dynein 相关生物医学文本
patterns.context: 出现在关于细胞运动、细胞骨架马达、dynein 亚型或其抑制剂的句子中；触发集中于词内片段 «ne»«in»。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究提案

patterns.name: wheezing 拼写片段
patterns.context: 词语 wheezing 中间的 «e» 激活；上下文涉及喘鸣、哮喘症状、肺部检查或支气管收缩。
patterns.domain: 医学记录、哮喘研究、临床摘要及医学百科

patterns.name: 窥视孔相关词片段
patterns.context: 出现在叙事中的 peephole（门上的窥视孔）；仅此一例，激活片段与 wheezing 中的 «e» 相同。

patterns.name: 法条引文中的 o f
patterns.context: 分开的字母片段构成 of，出现在法条条文和法律引文附近。

patterns.name: 染料词内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在 water-soluble-dye-containing ink 一类复合词中；孤立例子，未见相同的眼前医学语境。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，涉及水性墨水和染料

en.description: Strong activations often fall on in-containing or related spelling fragments within words such as dynein, tyrosinase, Rhein, and Sonnenschein. They also occur in maximal, hyphens, and several unrelated ordinary words; triggers span domains and are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: dynein-related subword fragments
patterns.context: Research texts on motor proteins, processivity, and ATPase activity; activation falls on segmented fragments of dynein and also on the final fragment of maximal.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in gene and disease research
patterns.context: Activation occurs inside biomedical terms containing the letter sequence in; the terms and contexts vary.

patterns.name: In fragment within German words
patterns.context: Activation falls within German compounds or proper names, especially spelling fragments such as Rhein/Hinblick.

patterns.name: Syllabic fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across spelling fragments in a law firm's name, recurring within the same segment.

patterns.name: In fragments in ordinary English words
patterns.context: Activation occurs inside ordinary English words, with no obvious semantic connection to dynein or German words.

patterns.name: English word-final fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs at a hyphen, but may be associated with a proper name, abbreviation, or formatting; evidence is limited.

patterns.name: Other local in-word fragments
patterns.context: These activations do not clearly correspond to the spelling patterns above and may be triggered by local vocabulary or incidental segmentation.

1_2918.description: 强激活多落在 dynein、tyrosinase、Rhein、Sonnenschein 等词内含 in/相关拼写片段处，也见于 maximal、连字符和若干无明显关联的普通词；触发跨领域且不完全一致。

patterns.name: dynein 相关子词片段
patterns.context: 细胞运动蛋白、过程性及 ATPase 活性的科研文本；激活落在 dynein 的分词片段，也出现在 maximal 的词尾片段。

patterns.name: 基因与疾病研究中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在包含字母串 in 的生物医学术语内部；不同术语和上下文。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 德语词内 in 片段
patterns.context: 激活落在德语复合词或专名中，尤其包含 Rhein/Hinblick 一类拼写片段。
patterns.domain: 德语议会文本、百科全书

patterns.name: 专名中的音节片段
patterns.context: 激活分布于律师事务所名称的拼写片段，重复出现于同一段。

patterns.name: 英文普通词中的 in 片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在英语普通词内部，缺少与 dynein 或德语词的明显语义联系。

patterns.name: 英文词尾片段
patterns.context: 连字符处有激活，但可能依附于专名、缩写或行文格式，证据有限。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、生物医学文本

patterns.name: 其他局部词内片段
patterns.context: 这些激活未与上述稳定拼写模式明显对应，可能是局部词汇或分词偶然触发。

en.description: The strongest activations are concentrated on the ne/in fragments in dynein; the remaining hits are scattered across intraword fragments such as e and ne, punctuation, and forum formatting, and cannot be explained by a consistent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Intraword tokenization of dynein
patterns.context: In biomedical text, dynein is split into marked fragments, especially when describing cytoplasmic dynein, motility, and ATPase.

patterns.name: ne substring
patterns.context: The trigger appears on the letter fragment ne across word boundaries or within words; it also occurs in other fragments ending or beginning with ne.

patterns.name: Word fragments containing e
patterns.context: The marker falls on the character e or a fragment containing it in split words, across varied meanings and contexts.

patterns.name: Punctuation and hyphens
patterns.context: Appears near abbreviations, compounds, or sentence boundaries in technical text; intensity is lower, with no stable semantic condition.

patterns.name: Notable phrase fragments
patterns.context: Appears in separators in HackerNews posts and in word fragments at sentence beginnings, with no shared context.

patterns.name: ne-related word fragments
patterns.context: Hits the character fragment ne in obstetric terms.

patterns.name: e-related word fragments
patterns.context: Hits intraword e fragments in peephole, Dogetipping, pigeons, and other words, with inconsistent meanings.

patterns.name: Unmerged word fragments
patterns.context: Scattered hits on proper nouns and short fragments in word endings or ordinary words, with no confirmed unifying condition.

1_2918.description: 主要高激活集中在 dynein 的 ne/in 词片；其余分散命中 e、ne 等词内碎片、标点及论坛格式，无法由一致语义模式解释。

patterns.name: dynein 词内分词
patterns.context: 在生物医学文本中，dynein 被拆分为带标记的词片，尤见于描述细胞质 dynein、运动和 ATPase。

patterns.name: ne 子串
patterns.context: 触发形式出现在跨词边界或词内的 ne 字母片段；也见于其他以 ne 为结尾或起始的词片。

patterns.name: 含 e 的词片
patterns.trigger: «e»10（Pa«ik»2 实为分词碎片处的 e、dy«e»10、pig«e»9«ons»6、Dog«e»9）
patterns.context: 标记落在被拆分词语中的 e 字符或词片上，语义和上下文各异。
patterns.domain: 专利、论坛及 NIH 文本

patterns.name: 标点与连字符
patterns.context: 在技术文本的缩写、复合词或句子边界附近出现；强度较低，未显示稳定的语义条件。

patterns.name: 显著短语片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在 HackerNews 帖子的分隔符和句首单词片段，缺乏共同语境。

patterns.name: ne 相关词片
patterns.context: 在妇产科名词中命中 ne 字符片段。

patterns.name: e 相关词片
patterns.context: 命中 peephole、Dogetipping、pigeons 等词内 e 字符片段，语义不一致。

patterns.name: 未能归并的词片段
patterns.context: 零散命中专名、词尾或普通词中的短片段，缺少可确认的统一条件。

en.concept: dynein character fragments and miscellaneous substrings
en.description: The most prominent pattern is the ne/in character fragments in biomedical text where dynein is split; other activations are scattered across dye/Doge, gynecological words, names and proper nouns, peep-hole, forum formatting, and common function words, making them difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: ne/in character fragments inside dynein
patterns.context: The fragments occur within dynein, the name of a molecular motor, often in sentences discussing its subtypes, activity, or cellular processes.
patterns.domain: Biomedical science, cell biology, and NIH research abstracts

patterns.name: e inside dye-related words
patterns.context: Includes dye-containing compounds in patents and the word Doge; the only commonality is the character fragment, not the context.

patterns.name: The ne syllable in gynecological terms
patterns.context: One occurrence is in a list involving obstetrics and gynecology in an ultrasound diagnosis; another is the abbreviation/spelling née in the name of a party to a legal case.

patterns.name: Letters or substrings inside proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations fall within personal names, company names, or name abbreviations, without consistent semantic or syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic/biographical introductions, news excerpts, legal and biographical texts

patterns.name: e/pe character fragments in narrative words
patterns.context: Occurs within a word describing looking out through a peephole in a suspense narrative; its connection to other fragments is unclear.

patterns.name: Symbols and initial-letter fragments
patterns.context: HackerNews posts contain code fences/tildes, lists after line breaks, or short labels; these activations may arise from formatting or tokenization boundaries.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations in function words and general affixes
patterns.context: Sporadic common words, hyphens, and line-break markers in long texts across different domains, with no stable shared semantic condition.

1_2918.concept: dynein 字符片段及杂散子串
1_2918.description: 最显著的模式是生物医学文本中 dynein 被拆分时的 ne/in 字符片段；其余激活散见于 dye/Doge、妇科词、姓名与专名、peep-hole、论坛格式及常见功能词，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: dynein 单词内部的 ne/in 字符片段
patterns.trigger: «ne»、«in»，出现在 dy«ne»in、dy«ne»7«in»10 等拆分形式中

patterns.name: dye 相关词内部的 e

patterns.domain: 专利文本、HackerNews 加密货币讨论

patterns.name: ne 音节出现在妇科相关词中
patterns.context: 一处在 ultrasound 诊断涉及妇产科的列表中；另一处是法律案件当事人姓名中的 née 缩写/拼写。
patterns.domain: 专利医学描述、法律判例

patterns.name: 专名内部的字母或子串
patterns.context: 激活落在个人姓名、公司名或姓名缩写的内部，缺少一致的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 百科/人物介绍、新闻片段、法律及传记文本

patterns.name: e/pe 字符片段出现在叙事词中
patterns.context: 出现在惊悚叙事中描述从猫眼向外看的词语内部；与其他片段的联系不明显。

patterns.name: 标记符号与首字母片段
patterns.context: HackerNews 帖子中包含代码围栏/波浪线、换行后的列表或短标签；这些激活可能来自格式或分词边界。
patterns.domain: 论坛帖子、加密货币讨论

patterns.name: 句法功能词及一般词缀零星激活
patterns.context: 在不同领域长文本中的零星常见词、连字符和换行标记，没有稳定的同一语义条件。

en.description: Strong responses often fall on intraword fragments: dynein, interspersed, gynecology, as well as peephole, pee, and tycoon; they also occur on periods in species abbreviations. Triggers are scattered, and some may be subword or character patterns.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in dynein
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs within dynein; the context discusses cellular transport, molecular motors, drugs, or ATPase.

patterns.name: ers in interspersed
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs within interspersed, describing DNA sequence distribution in the genome or interspersed text and images.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment related to gynecology
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs within gynecology, near obstetrics, as a field of application for ultrasound diagnostics.

patterns.name: e in peephole
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs within peephole; the passage narrates a character at home hearing someone kick the door.

patterns.name: e in pee
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs within pee; the context discusses filtering water from wastewater and drying the solids for fertilizer.
patterns.domain: Online forum discussion, sustainable resource use

patterns.name: on in a word related to Maximov
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs at the end of tycoon; the context introduces an entrepreneur, wealth, and company shares.

patterns.name: Period in the name S. mansoni
patterns.context: Activation is marked on the period in the abbreviation S., next to the species name mansoni and genome research content.

1_2918.description: 强响应多落在词内片段：dynein、interspersed、gynecology，以及 peephole、pee、tycoon 等；也出现于物种缩写句点。触发分散，部分可能是子词或字符模式。

patterns.name: dynein 词内片段
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在 dynein 这个词内部；上下文讨论细胞运输、分子马达、药物或 ATPase。

patterns.name: 穿插词中的 ers
patterns.context: 触发片段位于 interspersed 一词内部，描述 DNA 序列在基因组中的分布，或图文穿插排列。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、百科说明

patterns.name: 妇科相关词内片段
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在 gynecology 一词内部，邻近 obstetrics，属于超声诊断的适用领域。

patterns.name: peephole 中的 e
patterns.context: 触发片段位于 peephole 一词内部；此段是人物在家中听到有人踹门的叙事。

patterns.name: pee 中的 e
patterns.context: 触发片段位于 pee 一词内部；上下文谈从废水中过滤水并将固体物干燥作肥料。
patterns.domain: 网络论坛讨论、可持续利用

patterns.name: Maximov 相关词中的 on
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在 tycoon 一词末尾；上下文介绍企业家、财富与公司股权。

patterns.name: S. mansoni 名称中的点
patterns.context: 激活标在缩写 S. 的句点上，邻近物种名 mansoni 和基因组研究内容。

en.description: Activations cluster in local character fragments within several English words: dynein, gynecology, interspersed, and aldehyde. Interspersed occurs multiple times across contexts involving genomes, text, and data layout, without a shared semantic condition.

patterns.name: Fragment in dynein
patterns.context: A substring within the spelling of dynein; occurs in discussions of dynein motors, inhibitors, or subtypes.

patterns.name: Fragment in a gynecological term
patterns.context: Occurs within gynecology, near names of medical specialties such as obstetrics.

patterns.name: Fragment in interspersed
patterns.context: Occurs within interspersed, describing the interleaved distribution of DNA sequences, text illustrations, or disk data regions.
patterns.domain: Genomics, book descriptions, computer storage patents, and web articles

patterns.name: Fragment in aldehyde
patterns.context: Occurs within aldehyde in a reference title, alongside terminology related to collagen cross-linking.

1_2918.description: 激活集中在若干英文词内部的局部字母片段：dynein、gynecology、interspersed 和 aldehyde；其中 interspersed 多次出现，语境横跨基因组、文本与数据布局，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: dynein 词中片段
patterns.context: 作为 dynein 拼写内部的子串；出现在对 dynein 马达、抑制剂或亚型的讨论中。
patterns.domain: 细胞生物学、NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 妇产科词中片段
patterns.context: 出现在 gynecology 一词内部，邻近 obstetrics 等医学科室名称。

patterns.name: interspersed 词中片段
patterns.context: 出现在 interspersed 一词内部，描述 DNA 序列、文本插图或磁盘数据区域之间的交错分布。
patterns.domain: 基因组学、图书描述、计算机存储专利及网络文章

patterns.name: aldehyde 词中片段
patterns.context: 出现在参考文献标题中的 aldehyde 一词内部，周围是胶原交联相关术语。

en.description: Activations span multiple domains without a unified semantic theme. Visible patterns include gynecology, clinical relationships and events, dynein, a terrorist-attack quotation, aldehyde, web questions, and dye inks. Several strong activations fall on subword fragments of split words.

patterns.name: Gynecology in obstetric terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in a list of ultrasound diagnostic applications, adjacent to obstetric«s»4 and; activation concentrates within the split-token word gynecology, especially ne.

patterns.name: Clinical events and research relationships in medical studies
patterns.context: Studies the relationship between RV strain and adverse events in patients with DCM; activations fall on words such as relationship, and, and events.

patterns.name: Dynein in molecular motor research
patterns.context: Describes the cytoskeleton/molecular motors, organelle transport, or motility mechanisms; dynein is split into subword fragments, with ne and in prominent. Myosin, kinesin, or intracellular transport are also mentioned.
patterns.domain: Cell biology research abstracts and grant applications

patterns.name: Terrorist-attack quotation in breaking news
patterns.context: A news narrative describes masked men entering a hair salon and shouting about a terrorist attack; activation is at the opening quotation mark and terrorist.

patterns.name: Aldehyde in literature citations
patterns.context: In references or materials chemistry discussions, aldehyde is split into subword fragments; one passage concerns collagen cross-linking, another collagen materials and films.
patterns.domain: Biomaterials, chemical literature, or patent text

patterns.name: Questions about revenue and scale in web discussions
patterns.context: Informal questions about potential acquirers, compensation, or amounts for a company/asset, followed by web comments.

patterns.name: Water-soluble dye ink
patterns.context: Patent background describes water-soluble dye ink and the quality of recorded images; activations fall on dy«e»9 and fragments such as hyphens.

1_2918.description: 激活覆盖多个领域且没有统一语义主题；可见模式包括 gynecology、临床关系与事件、dynein、恐袭引语、aldehyde、网络问句及染料墨水。多处强激活落在被切分词的子词片段上。

patterns.name: 妇产科术语中的 gynecology
patterns.context: 出现在超声诊断用途列表中，紧邻 obstetric«s»4 and；激活集中在被拆分标记的 gynecology 一词内部，尤其是 ne。
patterns.domain: 超声诊断、医学专利背景

patterns.name: 医学研究中的临床事件与研究关系

patterns.name: 分子马达研究中的 dynein
patterns.context: 描述细胞骨架/分子马达、细胞器运输或运动机制；dynein 被子词片段拆开标记，ne 与 in 激活突出。也提到 myosin、kinesin 或细胞内运输。
patterns.domain: 细胞生物学研究摘要与基金申请

patterns.name: 突发新闻中的恐袭引语
patterns.context: 新闻叙述蒙面男子闯入美发沙龙并高喊恐怖袭击；激活位于引语起始符号及 terrorist。

patterns.name: 文献引文中的 aldehyde
patterns.context: 在参考文献或材料化学讨论中，aldehyde 被子词片段拆分；一个段落谈胶原交联，另一个谈胶原材料与薄膜。
patterns.domain: 生物材料、化学文献或专利文本

patterns.name: 网页讨论中的收入与规模提问
patterns.trigger: « this»1 year? Who« is»1 likely ... how« much»1?
patterns.context: 围绕公司/资产可能的收购方、薪酬或金额提出口语化问题，随后接网页评论内容。

patterns.name: 水溶性染料墨水
patterns.context: 专利背景中描述水溶性染料墨水及其记录图像质量；激活落在 dy«e»9 以及连字符等词片段上。

en.concept: Intraword e and specific subword fragments
en.description: Primarily activates on e inside various words, especially split words; it also activates on intraword fragments in dynein and Nippon, and on wavy-line separators in forums. Examples span different domains and cannot all be grouped into the same semantic theme.

patterns.name: Intraword e
patterns.context: Activation falls on e within words, especially when a word is split into tokens and e is followed by an ending or hyphen; however, the words and contexts vary widely.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: news, literature, patents, medicine, research, and online discussion

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in dynein
patterns.context: Occurs in research text about cellular transport or molecular motors, in cytoplasmic dynein or dynein isoforms.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in Nippon
patterns.context: Appears after Nippon in the names of Japanese organizations or brands; one instance concerns an airline and another a feed manufacturer.

patterns.name: Word ending in gynecology
patterns.context: Appears in a list of fields of application for ultrasound diagnostics, as the latter part of obstetrics and gynecology.

patterns.name: Specific formatting marker
patterns.context: Appears in the separator position in a HackerNews post, surrounded by comments and cryptocurrency tipping discussion.

1_2918.concept: 词内 e 与特定子词片段
1_2918.description: 主要激活于多种词内部的 e，尤其是被切分的词；另对 dynein、Nippon 等词内片段及论坛波浪线分隔符有激活。各例领域分散，不能都归为同一语义主题。

patterns.name: 词内的 e
patterns.trigger: «e»（包括 «e» 后接被拆开的词尾，如 «e»10«hy»1«de»1、«e»9«-»2）
patterns.context: 激活位置落在词内部的 e 上，尤其是词被分词切分、该 e 后还有词尾或连字符时；但覆盖词类和上下文多样。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；新闻、文献、专利、医学、科研和网络对话

patterns.name: dynein 词内片段
patterns.context: 在细胞运输或分子马达相关科研文本中，出现在 cytoplasmic dynein 或 dynein isoforms 中。
patterns.domain: 细胞生物学、科研资助摘要

patterns.name: Nippon 词内片段

patterns.domain: 航空新闻、动物实验方法

patterns.name: gynecology 词尾
patterns.context: 出现在超声诊断适用领域的并列列表中，作为 obstetrics and gynecology 的后半词。

patterns.name: 特定格式标记
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 帖子的分隔符位置，周围是留言和加密货币小费讨论。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on internal character fragments in English words, commonly dynein (nein). Other examples are scattered across personal names, proper nouns, enzyme names, and common words, spanning research, patents, news, catalogs, and legal texts. There is insufficient evidence for a unified semantic or domain-specific trigger pattern.

patterns.name: The “in” fragment inside English words
patterns.context: Activations fall on the consecutive internal character fragment “nein,” especially in dynein, the name of a molecular motor; the same fragment may also occur in other words.

patterns.name: The “e” fragment inside English words
patterns.context: Activations fall on the letter e at the end or within a word; the examples are the compound dye-containing and the name Harte.

patterns.name: The “ens” fragment inside English words
patterns.context: Activations fall within names containing ens; the examples are Dickens and Sonnenschein.
patterns.domain: Bibliographic catalogs, names and citations in legal documents

patterns.name: The “ipp/on” fragment inside English words
patterns.context: Activations fall within the proper noun Nippon, with separated high-activation character fragments together forming part of the word.
patterns.domain: News reporting, institutional/product names in scientific papers

patterns.name: The “ress” fragment inside English words
patterns.context: Occurs in hairdressing, with activation across its character fragment; the context mentions a hair salon.

patterns.name: The “ase” fragment inside English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the suffix fragment of the enzyme name ATPase.

patterns.name: The “e/spers” fragment inside English words
patterns.context: Activations fall in the middle-to-late portion of interspersed; the sentence discusses DNA sequences in a genome.

1_2918.description: 激活主要落在英文词的内部字母片段，常见于 dynein（nein）；其他例子分散在人名、专名、酶名及普通词中，跨越科研、专利、新闻、目录和法律文本。没有足够证据确认统一的语义或领域触发模式。

patterns.name: 英文词内的「in」片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文单词内部连续的字母片段「nein」，尤其出现在 dynein 这个分子马达名称中；同一片段也可能出现在其他词中。
patterns.domain: 细胞生物学、NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 英文词内的「e」片段
patterns.context: 激活落在单词末尾或内部的字母 e；所给例子分别属于复合词 dye-containing 与人名 Harte。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、书目/目录文本

patterns.name: 英文词内的「ens」片段
patterns.context: 激活落在包含 ens 的人名拼写中；一个是 Dickens，另一个是 Sonnenschein。
patterns.domain: 书目目录、法律文书中的姓名与引文

patterns.name: 英文词内的「ipp/on」片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名 Nippon 中，分隔的高激活字母片段合起来构成词的一部分。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、科学论文中的机构/商品名称

patterns.name: 英文词内的「ress」片段
patterns.context: 出现在 hairdressing 一词中，激活覆盖其字母片段；语境提及美发沙龙。

patterns.name: 英文词内的「ase」片段
patterns.context: 激活落在酶名称 ATPase 的词尾片段。

patterns.name: 英文词内的「e/spers」片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 interspersed 一词的中后段；句子讨论基因组中的 DNA 序列。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on internal subword fragments in proper nouns, technical terms, and common words, and also occur on formatting boundary tokens (spaces, colons, hyphens). Contexts span biology, medicine, news, catalogs, patents, and legal texts.

patterns.name: Tokenization fragments of the motor protein dynein
patterns.context: Occurs in biological contexts involving dynein, intracellular transport, or molecular motors; high activation concentrates on split-token fragments of dynein
patterns.domain: Cell biology, NIH research plans and papers

patterns.name: Temperature and time markers
patterns.context: Experimental methods express environmental conditions using numbers, units, or times; activations fall on narrow spaces or formatting tokens such as colons

patterns.name: Tokenization fragments in Japanese proper nouns
patterns.context: Japanese institutions or airline names are split into multiple subwords; this is not a general Japanese-topic word

patterns.name: Numeric and hyphen formatting
patterns.context: Hyphens in compound words or legal titles are marked separately; the two occurrences are from different semantic domains

patterns.name: Name tokenization in bibliographies
patterns.context: In catalog-style bibliographies, author names are split into subwords; underscores, page numbers, and line-break layout also appear

patterns.name: Tokenization fragments in political vocabulary
patterns.context: Words such as tantalising, Obamacons, and neocons appear in political commentary, with activations concentrated on internal subword fragments

patterns.name: Subword fragments in printing color terminology
patterns.context: In four-color printing descriptions listing channels as Y, M, C, K, a subword fragment of cyan activates

patterns.name: Tokenization fragments in names and place names
patterns.context: Lawyers’ names, law firms, or place names in legal documents are split into subwords; highlights concentrate on internal spelling fragments

patterns.name: Tokenization fragments in medical vocabulary
patterns.context: A hospital proper noun in a clinical research abstract has a highlighted subword; other medical terms in the same passage do not show the same strong activation

1_2918.description: 激活主要落在专名、术语及普通词的内部子词片段，也出现在格式性边界 token（空格、冒号、连字符）；语境横跨生物学、医学、新闻、目录、专利和法律文本。

patterns.name: 动力蛋白 dynein 的分词片段
patterns.context: 出现 dynein、细胞内运输或分子马达的生物学语境；高激活集中在被拆分标记的 dynein 子词片段
patterns.domain: 细胞生物学、NIH 研究计划与论文

patterns.name: 温度与时间标记
patterns.context: 实验方法中以数字、单位或时刻表示环境条件；激活落在窄空格或冒号等格式 token 上

patterns.name: 日本专名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 日本机构或航空公司名称中，专名被切分为多个子词；并非一般日本主题词
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、饲料供应商名称

patterns.name: 数字与连字符格式
patterns.context: 复合词或法律称谓中的连字符被独立标记；两处语义领域不同

patterns.name: 书目中的姓名分词
patterns.context: 目录式书目中，作者姓名被拆成子词；同时有下划线、页码和换行排版

patterns.name: 政治词汇的分词片段
patterns.context: 政治评论中出现 tantalising、Obamacons、neocons 等词，激活集中在词内子词片段

patterns.name: 印刷色彩术语的子词片段
patterns.context: 四色印刷说明以 Y、M、C、K 列举颜色通道时，cyan 的子词片段激活

patterns.name: 姓名与地名的分词片段
patterns.context: 法律文书中的律师姓名、律所或地名被拆分为子词；高亮集中在拼写内部片段

patterns.name: 医学词汇的分词片段
patterns.context: 临床研究摘要中的医院专名出现高亮子词；同段其他医学术语未呈现相同强激活

en.concept: Specific character fragments within English words
en.description: Activations mainly occur on ers (sometimes along with ed) in interspersed; they also occur on on in Nippon, ens in Dickens, t in trot, and e in sneeze. These are all local fragments within words, while the latter examples lack shared semantics or style.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in interspersed
patterns.context: The middle character sequence ers in interspersed is strongly marked; the following ed sometimes activates as well.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose and academic text

patterns.name: The on syllable in a proper noun
patterns.context: The on syllable within Nippon, a Japanese company or airline name; distinct from the interspersed pattern.

patterns.name: The ens sequence within a proper noun/surname
patterns.context: The ens character sequence in the surname Dickens, in a list of bibliography-style titles.

patterns.name: Word-final t in English
patterns.context: Within the word trot in an erotic personal narrative; occurs in isolation and is difficult to connect to other patterns.

patterns.name: e in sneeze
patterns.context: In the idiom “nothing to sneeze at,” activation falls on the e in sneeze.

1_2918.concept: 英语词内特定字符片段
1_2918.description: 主要激活出现在 interspersed 的 ers（有时连同 ed）；另在 Nippon 的 on、Dickens 的 ens、trot 的 t、sneeze 的 e 中出现，均为词内局部片段，后几类缺乏共同语义或文体。

patterns.name: interspersed 的词内片段
patterns.context: 单词 interspersed 中间的 ers 字符段被强烈标记；后续 ed 有时也激活。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文散文与学术文本

patterns.name: 专名中的 on 音节
patterns.context: 日本公司或航空公司名称 Nippon 内的 on 音节；与 interspersed 模式不同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法、新闻报道

patterns.name: 专名/姓氏内部的 ens
patterns.context: 姓氏 Dickens 内的 ens 字符段，位于书目式标题列表中。

patterns.name: 英语词尾 t
patterns.context: 性描写叙述中的单词 trot 内部；孤立出现，难以与其他模式联系。

patterns.name: 单词 sneeze 中的 e
patterns.context: 在惯用表达 “nothing to sneeze at” 中，激活落在 sneeze 的 e 上。

en.concept: Mixed intraword fragments and formatting features
en.description: Activations mainly cover intraword character fragments in various words, especially on; there are also scattered responses to the neocons word form, webpage layout symbols, time colons, and abbreviation fragments, with weak semantic consistency across passages.

patterns.name: Intraword suffix “on”
patterns.context: Activation often falls on character fragments inside or at the end of English words, rather than on complete words; it spans proper nouns, ordinary words, and scientific terms, with no consistent neighboring meaning
patterns.domain: Mixed corpus: news, scientific literature, catalogs, and tables

patterns.name: Neoconservative word forms
patterns.context: Appears in contexts discussing a political faction or its political influence; activation is concentrated on intraword fragments in “neocon(s)/neoconservative” forms

patterns.name: Formatting symbols and markers
patterns.context: Appears near code fences, wiki tables, or heading/formatting markers; these activations have no clear semantic connection to intraword “on” or political word forms

patterns.name: Punctuation in quantitative conditions
patterns.context: A colon is highlighted in an expression of a time range in experimental animal husbandry conditions

patterns.name: English spelling fragment
patterns.context: A suffix fragment inside the negative contraction “Don't”; this example has no confirmed shared semantics

1_2918.concept: 混杂的词内片段与格式特征
1_2918.description: 激活主要覆盖多种词内字符片段，尤其是on；另对neocons词形及网页排版符号、时间冒号和缩写片段有零散反应，跨段语义一致性弱。

patterns.name: 词内后缀“on”
patterns.trigger: «on»，尤其在“Nipp«on»”“Neut«ron»”“Bret Hart«e»”附近；也包括“Bret Hart«e»”中触发的末尾字符
patterns.context: 激活常落在英文词内部或词尾的字符片段，而非完整词；跨越专名、普通词和科学术语，邻近词义并不统一
patterns.domain: 混合语料：新闻、科学文献、目录与表格

patterns.name: 新保守主义词形
patterns.context: 出现在谈论政治派别或其政治影响的语境中；激活集中在“neocon(s)/neoconservative”词形的内部片段

patterns.name: 格式符号与标记
patterns.context: 出现在代码围栏、维基表格或标题/排版标记中；这些激活与词内“on”及政治词形缺乏明确语义联系

patterns.name: 量化条件中的标点
patterns.context: 在实验动物饲养条件的时间范围表达中，冒号被突出

patterns.name: 英语拼写片段
patterns.context: 否定缩写“Don't”内部的后缀片段；该例中没有可确认的共同语义

en.description: Activations are scattered across internal tokens in book titles, names, political vocabulary, institutional names, and biomedical terms. Some examples involve on, neocon, dynein, or cyclin; there are also isolated examples in sneeze and Dutch tokenization, with no stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: The character sequence “on” in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on subword fragments within several proper nouns or words; multiple hits involve the sequence on, but tokenization boundaries and annotation positions vary.
patterns.domain: Bibliographies, news, political commentary, aviation, and research texts

patterns.name: neocon/neoconservative-related word fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in English political commentary about neoconservatives, their political influence, or their era; similar fragments also occur in different contexts.

patterns.name: Fragment within dynein
patterns.context: In research proposals describing cytoskeletal motor proteins and intracellular transport, activation concentrates on tokenized fragments of dynein.

patterns.name: Fragment within Cyclin C
patterns.context: In an abstract describing a mouse cyclin C promoter fragment and its expression, activation falls on an internal fragment of cyclin.

patterns.name: Product/institution names containing on
patterns.context: Occurs in the feed manufacturer name Nippon and airline name All Nippon Airways; the surrounding contexts are experimental methods and an accident report, respectively.

patterns.name: Possible local trigger on the final e
patterns.context: Occurs in sneeze in HackerNews and in a tokenized word in a Dutch parliamentary speech; the two contexts have no obvious commonality.

1_2918.description: 激活分散在书名、人名、政治词汇、机构名和生物医学术语的词内分词上；部分例子涉及 on、neocon、dynein 或 cyclin，另有孤立的 sneeze 与荷兰语分词，未见稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 专名中的字母序列「on」
patterns.trigger: «on»，包括人名/书名中的「Bret Hart«e»」「Dufferin」附近的分词片段，以及「Nipp«on»」「ne«oc»ons」等上下文中的分词
patterns.context: 激活集中在若干专名或词内的子词片段；可见多处命中涉及字母序列 on，但分词边界和标注位置并不一致。
patterns.domain: 书目、新闻、政治评论、航空与科研文本

patterns.name: neocon/neoconservative 相关词片段
patterns.context: 出现在谈论新保守主义者、其政治影响或时代的英文政治评论中；相似片段也出现在不同语境。

patterns.name: dynein 词内片段
patterns.context: 在介绍细胞骨架马达蛋白、细胞内运输的科研提案中，激活集中于 dynein 的分词片段。

patterns.name: Cyclin C 词内片段
patterns.context: 在描述小鼠 cyclin C 启动子片段及其表达的摘要中，激活落在 cyclin 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 带 on 的产品名/机构名
patterns.context: 出现在饲料制造商名称 Nippon，以及航空公司名称 All Nippon Airways 中；周围分别是实验方法和事故报道。

patterns.name: 疑似词尾 e 的局部触发
patterns.context: 分别见于 HackerNews 中的 sneeze，以及荷兰语议会发言中的词内分词；两处语境没有明显共同点。

en.description: A few passages repeatedly activate on tokenized fragments of “neoconservative(s)”; other activations are scattered across internal word fragments, proper nouns, and punctuation formatting, with no unified context or semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Word forms related to neoconservatives
patterns.context: The triggering fragment occurs in “neocon / neoconservative(s),” whose word forms may be split into multiple tokens; surrounding text discusses political ideologies, politicians, or public policy.
patterns.domain: Political commentary, historical discussions, web articles

patterns.name: n't in English contractions
patterns.context: Occurs in the negative contraction “Don't”; only one example, in an article subheading.

patterns.name: on in a proper noun or word ending
patterns.context: Occurs within the proper noun “Nippon,” not as a standalone word; appears in feed manufacturer and airline names.

patterns.name: Letters or initial fragments in proper nouns or words
patterns.context: Distributed near tokenization boundaries in names, author names in book titles, protein names, and common words; no clear consistent semantic or syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic entries, bibliographic catalogs, biomedical texts, news, and commentary

patterns.name: Punctuation and formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Occurs in decimals, hyphenated compounds, times, URLs, Markdown/catalog formatting, and parentheses in figure captions; there is no shared theme across contexts.
patterns.domain: Experimental methods, URLs and web pages, bibliographies, papers, and figure captions

patterns.name: Possible word fragment “in”
patterns.context: Occurs at the ends of the biomedical terms cyclin and dynein; the fragment may reflect within-word tokenization and does not establish a stable semantic trigger.

1_2918.description: 少数段落反复激活于“neoconservative(s)”的分词片段；其余激活散见词内片段、专名及标点格式，缺少统一上下文或语义规律。

patterns.name: 新保守派词形片段
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在“neocon / neoconservative(s)”词中，词形可能被分成多个 token；周围讨论政治思潮、政治人物或公共政策。
patterns.domain: 政治评论、历史讨论、网络文章

patterns.name: 英文缩合形式中的 n't
patterns.context: 出现在否定缩合词“Don't”中；仅一例，且上下文是文章小标题。

patterns.name: 专名或词尾中的 on
patterns.context: 出现在专名“Nippon”内部，而非独立词；见于饲料制造商名称和航空公司名称。
patterns.domain: 生物医学实验方法、新闻报道

patterns.name: 专名中的字母或词首片段
patterns.context: 分布在姓名、书名作者名、蛋白质名称及普通词的分词边界附近；没有明显一致的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、书目目录、生物医学文本、新闻与评论

patterns.name: 标点与格式边界
patterns.context: 出现在小数、连字符复合词、时间、网址、Markdown/目录格式及图注括号等结构中；不同上下文间没有共同主题。
patterns.domain: 实验方法、网址与网页、书目、论文及图注

patterns.name: 疑似词形片段“in”
patterns.context: 出现在生物医学术语 cyclin 和 dynein 的词尾；该片段可能反映词内分词，不能据此确定稳定的语义触发。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与细胞生物学

en.description: Activations are scattered across dynein molecular motor contexts, neocon political terms, and character fragments in numbers, hyphens, proper nouns, and web formatting. The latter categories span domains and vary in conditions, with no unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: Dynein-related words
patterns.context: Mentions intracellular transport, molecular motors, organelle movement, or experiments inhibiting dynein/kinesin activity

patterns.name: neocon/conservative political terms
patterns.context: Political labels such as neocons and neoconservatives occur in political analysis or public policy discussions

patterns.name: Character fragments within specific words
patterns.context: Triggers are distributed within or at the boundaries of different words; the provided material shows no consistent semantic condition
patterns.domain: Experimental methods, news reporting, and political commentary

patterns.name: Fragments in names and institutional names
patterns.context: Marked character fragments occur in proper nouns such as personal names, law firms, or place names
patterns.domain: Legal documents, bibliographies, or literary texts

patterns.name: Web links and formatting markers
patterns.context: Link text, underlining, or Markdown-like symbols; no apparent semantic connection

1_2918.concept: 混合的词形与字符片段
1_2918.description: 激活散见于 dynein 分子马达语境、neocon 政治词语，以及数字、连字符、专名和网页格式等字符片段。后几类跨域且条件不一，整体没有统一语义解释。

patterns.name: dynein 相关词语
patterns.context: 提到细胞内运输、分子马达、细胞器运动，或抑制 dynein/kinesin 活性的实验

patterns.name: neocon／保守派政治词语
patterns.context: neocons、neoconservatives 等政治标签出现在政治分析或公共政策讨论中

patterns.name: 特定词内的字母片段
patterns.context: 触发分布在不同词的内部或边界；所给材料中没有一致的语义条件
patterns.domain: 实验方法、新闻报道及政治评论

patterns.name: 姓名与机构名中的片段
patterns.context: 人名、律师事务所或地名等专名中出现被标记的字符片段
patterns.domain: 法律文书、书目或文学文本

patterns.name: 网页链接及格式标记
patterns.context: 链接文本、下划线格式或类似 Markdown 的符号；无明显语义关联

en.concept: Local intraword letter fragments (biased toward in)
en.description: Activations mainly fall on intraword in fragments, as in dynein, cyclin, and Nippon, and also occur in neocon forms; there are additionally scattered punctuation, formatting, and ordinary word fragments that are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: Word-final/intraword “in” fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on letter fragments across token boundaries or within words, commonly in words containing in; surrounding word meanings and syntax vary greatly.
patterns.domain: Cross-disciplinary prose, proper nouns, and bibliographic text

patterns.name: neocon conservative forms
patterns.context: neocons or neoconservatives occur in political commentary, with activation concentrated on internal word fragments.

patterns.name: Numbers, punctuation, and formatting fragments
patterns.context: Local fragments near numbers, times, units, URLs, or formatting markers; different passages show no stable shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Experimental methods, news, webpage markup, bibliographic formatting

patterns.name: Short words and common word fragments
patterns.context: Scattered occurrences in ordinary sentences, with no consistent syntactic position or semantic role; may be secondary activations or unrelated to the main trigger.
patterns.domain: News, commentary, narrative, and academic text

patterns.name: Letter fragments in names
patterns.context: Local characters in proper nouns or titles/bibliographic entries are marked, with no stable name category or semantic condition apparent.
patterns.domain: Historical figure entries, bibliographies, and catalogs

1_2918.concept: 词内局部字母片段（偏 in）
1_2918.description: 激活主要落在词内的 in 片段（如 dynein、cyclin、Nippon），也见于 neocon 词形；另有零散标点、格式及普通词片段，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 词尾/词内「in」片段
patterns.context: 激活落在跨分词边界或词内部的字母片段上，常见于含 in 的词；周边词义和句法差异很大。
patterns.domain: 跨学科正文、专名与书目文本

patterns.name: neocon 保守派词形
patterns.context: 政治评论中出现 neocons 或 neoconservatives，激活集中在词的内部片段。
patterns.domain: 政治评论、博客/网页文本

patterns.name: 数字、标点与格式片段
patterns.context: 数字、时间、单位、URL或排版标记附近的局部片段；不同段落中没有稳定的共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 实验方法、新闻、网页标记、书目排版

patterns.name: 短词及常见词片段
patterns.context: 零散出现在普通句子中，未见一致的句法位置或语义角色；可能是次要激活或与主触发无关。
patterns.domain: 新闻、评论、叙事及学术文本

patterns.name: 姓名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 专名或标题/书目条目中的局部字符被标记，未显示稳定的姓名类别或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 历史人物条目、书目和目录

en.description: Activations mainly fall on word-final fragments within several complete words: ons in political terms neocons/neoconservatives, in in dynein; also on in Nippon, an in cyan, and in in Cyclin. Triggers depend on specific word forms and contexts, spanning multiple domains.

patterns.name: neo-cons suffix
patterns.context: Activation falls on the spelling fragment «ons», shared by neocons or neoconservatives; the surrounding text typically discusses political factions, history, or public policy.

patterns.name: dynein suffix
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-final fragment «in» in dynein, in contexts involving cellular transport, the cytoskeleton, or molecular motors.

patterns.name: Nippon proper-noun fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-final «on» in Nippon; occurs in the name of a feed manufacturer and in an airline name.
patterns.domain: Research methods, proper nouns in news reporting

patterns.name: cyan color-word ending
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-final «an» in cyan, in a list of the Y, M, C, K four-color printing channels.

patterns.name: Fragment within cyclin
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-final fragment «in» in Cyclin, adjacent to D1; no other example occurs in the same molecular biology context.

1_2918.description: 激活主要落在若干完整词的内部词尾片段：政治词 neocons/neoconservatives 的 ons、dynein 的 in；另见 Nippon 的 on、cyan 的 an 和 Cyclin 的 in。触发取决于具体词形及语境，跨越多个领域。

patterns.name: neo-cons 后缀
patterns.context: 激活落在拼写片段 «ons»，共同组成 neocons 或 neoconservatives；前文通常在谈政治派别、历史或公共政策。
patterns.domain: 政治评论、新闻、论坛文本

patterns.name: dynein 后缀
patterns.context: 激活落在 dynein 的词尾片段 «in»，处于细胞运输、细胞骨架或分子马达等语境。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、NIH 研究摘要

patterns.name: Nippon 专名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 Nippon 的词尾 «on»；分别出现在饲料制造商名称与航空公司名称中。
patterns.domain: 科研方法、新闻报道中的专名

patterns.name: cyan 颜色词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 cyan 的词尾 «an»，出现在印刷四色 Y、M、C、K 的列举中。

patterns.name: cyclin 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 Cyclin 一词的词尾片段 «in»，紧邻 D1；除此之外未见相同分子生物学语境。

en.concept: Word-form fragments and the string on
en.description: The strongest pattern is fragments within neocons/neoconservative forms; however, the neuron also responds to various unrelated words containing on (Nippon, neutron, dynein, tycoons). There are also weak activations on of, punctuation/formatting, and several isolated word fragments, which are difficult to group into a unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: neo-cons/neoconservative word forms
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on intraword fragments in neocons or neoconservative(s); sometimes these span token splits or are followed by word endings.
patterns.domain: Political commentary, history, and public policy; passages 1–3

patterns.name: English word ending -on
patterns.context: Activation falls on words ending in on or containing corresponding split fragments; these occur in different words, including Japan, Japan Airlines, neutron, midbody protein names, and tycoons, without requiring a connection to political topics.
patterns.domain: Scientific text, aviation news, business/literary profiles; passages 4–10

patterns.name: Token “of” in ordinary words
patterns.context: Weak activation occurs when the preposition of appears in noun phrases; not limited to passages related to neocons.

patterns.name: Punctuation and formatting tokens
patterns.context: Scattered activations occur near numbers, hyphens, URLs, Markdown code fences, or heading markers; trigger conditions are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Paper methods, news, forums, and webpage formatting; passages 2, 4–6, 9

patterns.name: Scattered ordinary word fragments
patterns.context: These fragments each have only weak activation, with no common, stable word meaning or contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Commentary, news, research abstracts, and astronomy papers; passages 1, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9

1_2918.concept: 词形片段及 on 字符串
1_2918.description: 最强模式是 neocons/neoconservative 词形中的片段；但神经元也响应多种含 on 的无关词（Nippon、neutron、dynein、tycoons）。另有 of、标点格式及若干孤立词片段的弱激活，难以归入统一语义主题。

patterns.name: neo-cons／neoconservative 词形
patterns.context: 激活集中在 neocons 或 neoconservative(s) 的词内片段；有时跨 token 拆分或后接词尾。
patterns.domain: 政治评论、历史与公共政策；段 1–3

patterns.name: 英语词尾 -on
patterns.context: 激活落在以 on 结尾或含相应拆分片段的词中；出现于 Japan、日本航空、neutron、中间蛋白名称及 tycoons 等不同词里，并不要求与政治主题相关。
patterns.domain: 科学文本、航空新闻、商业／文学简介；段 4–10

patterns.name: 普通词中的 token「of」
patterns.context: 在名词短语中出现介词 of 时有弱激活；不只见于 neocon 相关段落。

patterns.name: 标点与格式 token
patterns.context: 数字、连字符、网址、Markdown 代码围栏或标题标记附近出现零散激活；触发条件不一致。
patterns.domain: 论文实验方法、新闻、论坛及网页格式；段 2、4–6、9

patterns.name: 零散普通词片段
patterns.context: 这些片段各自仅有弱激活，未见共同而稳定的词义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 评论、新闻、科研摘要与天文学论文；段 1、3、5、6、8、9

en.description: High activations often fall on the strings opin/Chopin, the plural ending itors, the proper-name fragment talbahn, and shine. These examples span multiple genres; local word-form overlap is more apparent than a unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Chopin in titles or words
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the name Chopin or the fragment opin across a word boundary. The same letters occur in the full name, truncated words, or ordinary words, and do not always refer to Chopin.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, academic papers, legal and financial texts

patterns.name: Editor ending
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the word editors, sometimes preceded by a hyphenated word form; the local trigger resembles a subword fragment rather than sentence meaning.

patterns.name: Synthetic capacitor ending
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of supercapacitors, embedded in a materials-synthesis paper title; it may share the same ending pattern as editors.

patterns.name: MEK inhibitor ending
patterns.context: Occurs in Inhibitors in a medical title, preceded by MEK and describing therapeutic use.
