patterns.name: Bahn in a railway name
patterns.context: Occurs near the end of the German proper name Wern talbahn; the context also describes a railway.

patterns.name: Cosmetics product review
patterns.context: Describes the natural sheen of a lip product after application, with evaluations of its texture, effect, and degree of disappointment.

1_3010.description: 高激活多落在字符串 opin/Chopin、复数词尾 itors、专名 talbahn 片段及 shine；这些例子分属多种文体，局部词形重合比统一语义主题更明显。

patterns.name: 标题或词中的 Chopin
patterns.context: 激活集中在 Chopin 这个姓名或跨词边界的片段 opin 上；出现于完整姓名、残缺词或普通词中的相同字母串，并不总是指肖邦。
patterns.domain: 百科、学术论文、法律与金融文本

patterns.name: 编辑者词尾
patterns.context: 出现在单词 editors 的词尾，前文可有连字符构成的词形；局部触发更像子词片段而非句义。
patterns.domain: 医学论文及临床科学讨论

patterns.name: 合成电容器词尾
patterns.context: 出现在 supercapacitors 的词尾，嵌于材料合成论文标题；可能与 editors 的同一词尾模式相同。

patterns.name: MEK 抑制剂词尾
patterns.context: 出现在医学标题中的 Inhibitors，前接 MEK，描述治疗用途。

patterns.name: 铁路名称中的 Bahn
patterns.context: 出现在德语专名 Wern talbahn 的末尾附近；同时上下文介绍一条铁路。

patterns.name: 化妆品产品评价
patterns.context: 描述唇部产品上唇后的自然光泽，伴随对质地、效果和失望程度的评价。

en.description: Activation falls mainly on the continuous character fragment “opin” and the word ending “itors”; the former spans opinions, Chopin, and surnames, while the latter occurs in two different types of nouns. There are also sporadic triggers for editors, a German place name, and product shine, with no unified semantics apparent.

patterns.name: Word fragment “opin”
patterns.context: A continuous character fragment within English words; spans different word forms and capitalization boundaries, with no consistent semantic condition observed.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text: legal prose, cited literature, financial disclaimers, mathematics papers, and music-related encyclopedias

patterns.name: Surname Chopin
patterns.context: Appears as a person’s name: once referring to the pianist or someone associated with him, and once as an author’s surname in a citation.

patterns.name: Plural suffix -itors
patterns.context: Appears at the ends of nouns, in “supercapacitors” and “inhibitors”; the meanings and contexts differ.

patterns.name: Editor suffix fragment
patterns.context: Appears within “editors,” in discussions of conflicts of interest and clinical science publishing.

patterns.name: Wern compound fragment
patterns.context: Appears within the German railway proper name “Wern­talbahn.”

patterns.name: Shine description
patterns.context: Describes the natural shine after applying a lip product.

patterns.name: Artificial neural network word fragment
patterns.context: Not semantically related to opinions; merely a letter fragment in the surname “Duminil-Copin,” with the same trigger form as pattern 1.

1_3010.description: 激活主要落在连续字符片段“opin”和词尾“itors”；前者跨越意见、Chopin及作者姓氏，后者见于两类不同名词。另有编辑者、德语地名和产品光泽等零散触发，未显示统一语义。

patterns.name: 单词片段 “opin”
patterns.context: 英文单词内部的连续字符片段；覆盖不同词形与大小写边界，未见统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本：法律散文、引用文献、金融免责声明、数学论文及音乐相关百科

patterns.name: 姓氏 Chopin
patterns.context: 作为人名出现：一处指钢琴家或其相关人物，一处是文献引用中的作者姓氏。

patterns.name: 复数后缀 -itors
patterns.context: 出现在名词末尾，分别为“supercapacitors”和“inhibitors”；词义与语境不同。
patterns.domain: 材料科学摘要、医学摘要

patterns.name: 编辑者后缀片段
patterns.context: 出现在“editors”内部，处于利益冲突及临床科学出版讨论中。

patterns.name: Wern 复合词片段
patterns.context: 出现在德语铁路专名“Wern­talbahn”内部。

patterns.name: 光泽描述
patterns.context: 用于描述唇部产品涂抹后的自然光泽。

patterns.name: 人工神经网络词片段
patterns.context: 并非语义上的意见；只是“Duminil-Copin”姓氏中的字母片段，与模式1的触发形式相同。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on several specific word-form fragments: Chopin/Copin, opin in opinions, and the -itors ending; there are also fragments from the German railway name tal and shine in a beauty context. The trigger words differ considerably in semantics and domain.

patterns.name: Chopin-related names
patterns.context: Appears in names; sometimes as the complete surname Chopin, sometimes as the final Chopin fragment split by token boundaries.

patterns.name: The opin ending in opinions
patterns.context: opinions is split into an activation token beginning with opin and the following ions; these occur in a plural noun in historical discussion and a plural noun in a financial disclaimer, respectively.

patterns.name: ions ending and ion-device words
patterns.context: Activation falls on words ending in -itors: capacitors, inhibitors, editors; their meanings and domains differ.
patterns.domain: Materials science, medical reviews, academic publishing discussions

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a German railway name
patterns.context: Appears within the German compound proper name Wern-tal-bahn, referring to part of a railway name.

patterns.name: shine in a cosmetics description
patterns.context: Appears in a consumer review of a lip makeup effect, describing a natural shine.

1_3010.description: 激活集中在若干特定词形片段：Chopin/Copin、opinions 的 opin、以及 -itors 词尾；另有德语铁路名片段 tal 和美妆语境中的 shine。各触发词的语义与领域差异较大。

patterns.name: Chopin 相关姓名
patterns.context: 出现在人名中；有时是完整姓氏 Chopin，有时是被 token 边界切开的 Chopin 末尾片段。
patterns.domain: 百科、学术引文、数学论文

patterns.name: 意见 opinions 的词尾
patterns.context: opinions 被拆成以 opin 开头的激活 token 和后续 ions；分别处于历史论述中的复数名词，以及金融免责声明中的复数名词。

patterns.name: ions 词尾与离子设备词
patterns.context: 激活落在以 -itors 结尾的词上：capacitors、inhibitors、editors；词义和领域不同。
patterns.domain: 材料科学、医学综述、学术出版讨论

patterns.name: 德语铁路名称内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在德语复合专名 Wern-tal-bahn 内，指铁路名称的一部分。

patterns.name: 化妆品描述中的 shine
patterns.context: 出现在唇部化妆效果的消费者评论中，描述自然光泽。

en.description: Activations often fall on string fragments in different words: -itors, Chopin/segmented opin, and part of Wern(tal)bahn. They occur in heterogeneous contexts such as titles, proper names, ordinary words, drug names, and German compounds.

patterns.name: English word ending -itors
patterns.context: The trigger is the suffix fragment “itors” within full words, appearing in “supercapacitors” and “Inhibitors”; both examples occur in titles.
patterns.domain: PubMed paper titles on materials and medicine, respectively

patterns.name: Chopin in a proper name
patterns.context: Triggers the string Chopin, both as the pianist’s name and in a cited author’s name.

patterns.name: Segmented opin
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the in-word fragment “opin” in opinion(s), while the following “ions” activates weakly; it occurs in contexts about authority and opinions, and disclaimers.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg legal discussion, Enron financial disclaimer

patterns.name: opin in a mathematician’s surname
patterns.context: The fragment “opin” occurs near the end of the mathematician’s surname Duminil-Copin.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics paper body and citations

patterns.name: opin in a drug name
patterns.context: The fragment “opin” occurs in the drug name lopinavir.
patterns.domain: PubMed medical abstracts, drug data in liver cells

patterns.name: talbahn in a German railway word
patterns.context: Activation falls on the “talb” portion of the German compound Wern(tal)bahn; the context is a railway name and its description.

patterns.name: Editor ending -editors
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the ending fragment “itors” in the word editors following stakeholders.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central discussion of conflicts of interest in clinical science

1_3010.description: 激活多落在不同词中的字符串片段：-itors、Chopin/切分出的 opin，以及 Wern(tal)bahn 的局部；对应标题、专名、普通词、药名和德语复合词等异质语境。

patterns.name: 英文词尾 -itors
patterns.context: 触发点是完整单词中的后缀片段 “itors”，分别出现在 “supercapacitors” 和 “Inhibitors”；两例都位于标题中。
patterns.domain: PubMed 论文标题，分别涉及材料与医学

patterns.name: 专名中的 Chopin
patterns.context: 触发字符串 Chopin，既作为钢琴家姓名，也出现在参考文献作者姓名中。

patterns.name: 切分出的 opin
patterns.context: 激活集中在 opinion(s) 的词内片段 “opin”，而后续 “ions” 激活弱；出现在关于权威与意见、以及免责声明的语境中。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 法律论述、Enron 金融免责声明

patterns.name: 数学作者姓氏中的 opin
patterns.context: 片段 “opin” 位于数学家姓氏 Duminil-Copin 的词尾附近。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文正文与引文

patterns.name: 药名中的 opin
patterns.context: 片段 “opin” 出现在药物名称 lopinavir 内。
patterns.domain: PubMed 医学摘要，肝细胞中的药物数据

patterns.name: 德语铁路词中的 talbahn
patterns.context: 激活落在德语复合词 Wern(tal)bahn 的 “talb” 部分；上下文是铁路名称及其介绍。

patterns.name: 编辑者词尾 -editors
patterns.context: 激活集中在 stakeholders 后的 editors 一词词尾片段 “itors”。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 关于临床科学利益冲突的论述

en.description: Strong activation is concentrated on several local letter strings: -itors, Chopin, and opin; there are also sporadic activations for controlled, ating, and citation marker B. These appear across domains, with no unified semantic or syntactic condition observed.

patterns.name: English suffix -itors
patterns.context: Activation falls on the letter string “itors” at the ends of words, forming “capacitors,” “Inhibitors,” “Monitors,” and “Editors”; no specific syntactic position is required.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including materials science, medicine, computing, and publishing

patterns.name: Chopin string
patterns.context: Activation occurs in the name or work title Chopin; [4] is in the context of the pianist and piano competitions, while [8] is a citation entry.

patterns.name: opin string
patterns.context: Activation corresponds to the continuous letters “opin” within English words; in [9] it occurs in “lopinavir,” and in [10] in “opinions.”
patterns.domain: Medical drug names and literary prose

patterns.name: Other local strings
patterns.context: Appear respectively in “controlled synthesis,” “Calibrating,” and the literature marker “[@B]”; no clear shared context with the other patterns.
patterns.domain: Abstracts, technical articles, academic literature markers

1_3010.description: 强激活集中于若干局部字母串：-itors、Chopin、opin；另有 controlled、ating 和引用标记 B 的零散激活。它们跨领域出现，未见统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 英文后缀 -itors
patterns.context: 激活落在单词末尾的字母串“itors”，分别组成“capacitors”“Inhibitors”“Monitors”“Editors”；不要求特定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 材料科学、医学、计算机、出版等多种文体

patterns.name: Chopin 字符串
patterns.context: 激活出现在人名或作品名 Chopin 中；[4] 是钢琴家及钢琴比赛语境，[8] 是引用条目。

patterns.name: opin 字符串
patterns.context: 激活对应英文单词内部连续字母“opin”；[9] 中位于“lopinavir”，[10] 中位于“opinions”。
patterns.domain: 医学药物名称与文学散文

patterns.name: 其他局部字符串
patterns.context: 分别出现在“controlled synthesis”“Calibrating”和文献标记“[@B]”中；与其他模式没有明显共同上下文。
patterns.domain: 摘要、技术文章、学术文献标记

en.description: All segments contain the marked substring itors, commonly in endings such as inhibitors, itors, editors, monitors, and visitors. A few segments also mark nearby fragments or punctuation, but these variations have no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Ending itors
patterns.context: Activations fall on the ending substring itors in a word; prefixes and semantics vary with context.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including medical papers, web code, and technical articles

patterns.name: Other endings or in-word fragments
patterns.context: A few activations occur on short word fragments other than itors; there is no consistent lexical meaning or local syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Special markers and code structure
patterns.context: Activations fall on citation markers, HTML/script punctuation, or adjacent code fragments, alongside itors activations in the same segment.

1_3010.description: 所有段都含有被标记的 itors 子串，常见于 inhibitors、itors、editors、monitors、visitors 等词尾；少数段还标记了邻近片段或标点，但这些变化缺乏统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 词尾 itors
patterns.context: 激活落在单词的词尾子串 itors 上；前缀和语义随上下文变化。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、网页代码、技术文章等多种文体

patterns.name: 其他词尾或词内片段
patterns.trigger: «ac»（[1]、[7] 的 supercap«ac»itors）、«Mon»（[5] 的 Monitors）、«S»（[7] 的 S2）、«p»（[9] 的 piano）
patterns.context: 少数激活出现在 itors 以外的短词片段；没有一致的词义或局部句法条件。
patterns.domain: 材料科学、技术文档、传记

patterns.name: 特殊标记与代码结构
patterns.context: 激活落在引文标记、HTML/脚本标点或相邻代码片段，伴随同段的 itors 激活。

en.description: The main response is to the segmented plural ending “itors,” covering words such as capacitors, inhibitors, editors, and visitors. There are also isolated activations on Valley, Chopin, and shine, with no shared contextual pattern.

patterns.name: Plural suffix -itors
patterns.context: The ending is segmented separately and activates strongly; preceding text includes supercap«ac»itors, MEK Inhib«itors», ed«itors», Vis«itors», Medical Ed«itors», and Inhib«itors».
patterns.domain: Materials science, biomedicine, web HTML, general English

patterns.name: Valley in a place name
patterns.context: Occurs in the proper name Wern Valley Railway, forming part of the place name.

patterns.name: Pianist’s surname in a person’s name
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of a pianist and people associated with piano competitions.

patterns.name: shine in a code example
patterns.context: Occurs in StackExchange text explaining the advantages of Python list comprehensions, preceded by list-comprehensions.

1_3010.description: 主要响应被切分出的复数词尾“itors”，涵盖电容器、抑制剂、编辑和访客等词；另对 Valley、Chopin、shine 有孤立激活，缺少共同上下文模式。

patterns.name: 复数后缀 -itors
patterns.context: 词尾被单独切分并强激活；前文包括 supercap«ac»itors、MEK Inhib«itors»、ed«itors»、Vis«itors»、Medical Ed«itors»，以及 Inhib«itors»。
patterns.domain: 材料科学、生物医学、网页 HTML、通用英文

patterns.name: 地名中的 Valley
patterns.context: 出现在专名 Wern Valley Railway 中，构成地名的一部分。
patterns.domain: 维基百科地理／铁路条目

patterns.name: 人名中的钢琴家姓氏
patterns.context: 出现在钢琴家及钢琴比赛相关的人名叙述中。
patterns.domain: 维基百科音乐人物传记

patterns.name: 代码示例中的 shine
patterns.context: 出现在解释 Python 列表推导式优势的 StackExchange 文字中，前有 list-comprehensions。

en.description: Every segment contains the contiguous letter fragment “opin,” whether in opinion words such as opinions/opinione, proper names such as Chopin/Duminil-Copin, or the drug name lopinavir; the domains and meanings vary widely.

patterns.name: opin stem
patterns.context: The trigger fragment contains opin; it is often followed by endings forming opinions, opinione, opinion, or lopinavir
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text; contexts include people’s names, academic citations, legal discussion, disclaimers, forum opinions, and drug names

patterns.name: opin followed by opinion-related endings
patterns.context: opin is followed by the English plural ending -ions or the Italian ending -ione; semantically, these occur in expressions about opinions, views, or commentary
patterns.domain: Parliamentary speeches, legal prose, financial disclaimers, forum discussions

patterns.name: opin as a spelling fragment in a proper name
patterns.context: opin is embedded in the proper names Chopin or Duminil-Copin, not in opinion-related words
patterns.domain: Pianist and competition descriptions; mathematics papers and references

patterns.name: opin embedded in the drug name lopinavir
patterns.context: opin occurs within the drug name lopinavir, near content about antiviral drugs, COVID-19, drug interactions, or liver-cell studies

1_3010.description: 所有段均含有连续字母片段“opin”，无论它属于 opinions/opinione 等意见词、Chopin/Duminil-Copin 等专名，还是药物名 lopinavir；领域和语义差异很大。

patterns.name: opin 词干
patterns.context: 触发片段含有 opin；后续常接词尾构成 opinions、opinione、opinion 或 lopinavir
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本；不同语境包括人物姓名、学术引文、法律论述、免责声明、论坛观点及药物名称

patterns.name: opin 后接意见类词尾
patterns.context: opin 后接英语复数词尾 -ions 或意大利语词尾 -ione；语义上分别出现在意见、观点或评论相关表述中
patterns.domain: 议会发言、法律散文、金融免责声明、论坛讨论

patterns.name: opin 作为人名拼写片段
patterns.context: opin 嵌在专名 Chopin 或 Duminil-Copin 中，并非意见类词语
patterns.domain: 钢琴家与比赛介绍；数学论文及参考文献

patterns.name: opin 嵌入药物名 lopinavir
patterns.context: opin 位于药物名称 lopinavir 内，邻近抗病毒药物、COVID-19、药物相互作用或肝细胞研究内容

en.description: Activations concentrate on the contiguous letters opin: they occur in opinions/opinion words, Chopin, and various unrelated proper names and URLs. This looks more like recognition of a character fragment than a unified semantic feature.

patterns.name: opinions stem
patterns.context: opin is followed by an ending to form a word meaning a view or opinion; preceding text may discuss people, committees, or arguments
patterns.domain: General discussion, parliamentary speeches, forum discussions, legal disclaimers

patterns.name: Chopin name
patterns.context: Occurs in names related to the pianist or his works

patterns.name: opin as an in-word fragment
patterns.context: Matches only the in-word letter fragment, unrelated to the meanings of opinions or Chopin

patterns.name: opin in a web path
patterns.context: Occurs in the URL path of a legal opinion webpage

1_3010.description: 激活集中于连续字母 opin：它出现在 opinions/意见词形、Chopin，以及多个无关专名和 URL 中；更像识别字符片段，而非统一语义。

patterns.name: opinions 词干
patterns.context: opin 后接词尾，组成表示观点或看法的词；前文可谈人物、委员会或论证
patterns.domain: 一般论述、议会发言、论坛讨论、法律免责声明

patterns.name: Chopin 姓名
patterns.context: 出现在钢琴家或作品相关的人名中

patterns.name: opin 作为词内片段
patterns.context: 只匹配词内字母片段，与 opinions 或 Chopin 的词义无关
patterns.domain: 生物医学名称、数学家姓名

patterns.name: opin 网页路径片段
patterns.context: 出现在法律意见网页的 URL 路径中

en.description: All segments match the substring opin inside a full word. Strong activations span opinion forms and various unrelated proper names; the local pattern appears to respond to a letter fragment rather than a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: “opin” stem fragment
patterns.context: The trigger occurs inside different full words: opinione, opinions, opinlindex, Chopin, Duminil-Copin, nyctalopin, Scopinaro; it does not correspond to a single meaning.

patterns.name: Opinion/view word forms
patterns.context: Occurs in words for opinions or views, in discussions of authority and evidence, financial disclaimers, programming comments, and European Parliament speeches.
patterns.domain: Legal discussion, financial disclaimers, technical discussion, parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: Incidental substring in proper names
patterns.context: The substring is only part of a name or label and is unrelated to “opinion”: Chopin (including the surname and its referent), Duminil-Copin, nyctalopin, Scopinaro, and the URL fragment opinlindex.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries on people and music, mathematics literature, neuroscience research, medical papers, legal URLs

1_3010.description: 所有片段都在完整词内部命中 opin 子串，强激活跨越 opinion 词形与多种无关专名；局部模式更像对字母片段的响应，而非单一语义。

patterns.name: “opin”词干片段
patterns.context: 触发点出现在不同完整词的内部：opinione、opinions、opinlindex、Chopin、Duminil-Copin、nyctalopin、Scopinaro；并非只对应单一词义。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的词语子串模式

patterns.name: 意见／观点词形
patterns.context: 位于意见、看法等词中；分别出现在权威与证据的讨论、金融免责声明、编程评论，以及欧洲议会发言。
patterns.domain: 法律论述、金融免责声明、技术讨论、议会发言

patterns.name: 专名中的偶然子串
patterns.context: 该子串只是姓名或名称的一部分，与“意见”无关：Chopin（包括姓氏及其所指对象）、Duminil-Copin、nyctalopin、Scopinaro，以及网址片段opinlindex。
patterns.domain: 百科人物与音乐、数学文献、神经科学研究、医学论文、法律网址

en.description: Activations mainly fall on fragments inside multilingual words, especially subword fragments such as nature and Ne that can continue into different words. Other activations include atta in the French s’attaquer and 313 in a number table.

patterns.name: Suffixes or stem suffixes in nature words
patterns.context: Activations fall on initial subword fragments of nature-related words, with following characters or tokens completing different words; they span word contexts and capitalization forms.
patterns.domain: French, English, Romanian, and legal texts

patterns.name: Segmentation boundary in French attaquer
patterns.context: The reflexive structure s'attaquer follows a pronoun; strong activations concentrate on the stem fragment atta in attaquer. The surrounding text concerns attacking or targeting something.

patterns.name: 313 in a number sequence
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the number 313 in a comma-separated, line-by-line ascending comparison table; other numbers in the same table also activate more weakly.
patterns.domain: Number tables in code or data files

patterns.name: Typography and structural markers in written text
patterns.context: Different texts contain sentence-initial words, title-style capitalized words, or numbered labels; these may also be incidental cues accompanying the word-fragment triggers, and evidence is insufficient to confirm an independent pattern.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary texts, news headlines, patents and legal documents, data tables

1_3010.concept: 多语种词内片段与边界
1_3010.description: 主要激活落在多语种词语内部的片段，尤其是 nature、Ne 等可续接成不同单词的子串；另有法语 s’attaquer 的 atta，以及数字表中的 313。

patterns.name: 自然词中的词尾或词干后缀
patterns.context: 激活落在自然词的前部子词片段上，后续字符或 token 接续完成不同单词；跨越词语境与大小写形式。
patterns.domain: 法语、英语、罗马尼亚语及法律文本

patterns.name: 法语 attaquer 的分词边界
patterns.context: 代词后的反身结构 s'attaquer，强激活集中在 attaquer 的词干片段 atta；周围谈及攻击或针对某对象。

patterns.name: 数字序列中的 313
patterns.context: 逗号分隔、逐行递增的数字对照表中，激活出现在编号 313；同一表内其他编号也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 代码或数据文件中的数字表

patterns.name: 书面文本的排版与结构标记
patterns.context: 不同文本中出现句首词、标题式大写词或数字编号；这些现象也可能只是上述词片段触发的伴随线索，证据不足以确认独立模式。
patterns.domain: 议会文本、新闻标题、专利与法律文书、数据表

en.concept: Template type parameters and multilingual word fragments
en.description: Activation is most concentrated at type-parameter positions in C++ template declarations; there are also scattered activations on in-word fragments in French and Romanian, as well as sporadic code identifiers and document markers, which are difficult to explain with a unified account.

patterns.name: Type parameters in C++ template code
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated in template declarations, especially on type parameters following typename and at the closing position of template parameter lists; nearby code includes functions, structs, namespaces, and type aliases.

patterns.name: Romanian in-word string “area”
patterns.context: Appears within or at the beginning of Romanian word forms, such as the sea name “Marea” and “formarea”; the sentences discuss maritime regions or government issues.

patterns.name: French in-word string “pré”
patterns.context: Appears within French words such as “précédents” and “prévoir,” in definition explanations or provisions in parliamentary text.
patterns.domain: ArXiv French academic text, EuroParl French parliamentary text

patterns.name: Romanian word ending “or”
patterns.context: Appears at the end of “țărilor”; the sentence concerns affected countries and the international community.

patterns.name: Tokenized word fragments in code
patterns.context: Appear in C++ test code and comments; triggers are distributed across expected-warning comments, template declarations, and namespace declarations, rather than being explained by a single keyword.

patterns.name: Token fragments in code identifiers
patterns.context: Appear in VelocyPack type aliases and compound identifiers.

patterns.name: Unclustered sporadic code activations
patterns.context: Activation falls on module names and identifiers in Python import statements, with no clear local structure shared with other code segments.

patterns.name: Unclustered French in-word fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on a French adverb expressing necessity; nearby text discusses the purpose and necessity of medical devices.

patterns.name: Unclustered Romanian in-word fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on a word in parliamentary text about the fate of the Palestinian people in Gaza.

patterns.name: Unclustered French definition-formatting fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a definition label in ArXiv text; other notable activations are scattered through French sentences and mathematical descriptions.

1_3010.concept: 模板类型参数与多语种词片段
1_3010.description: 激活最集中于 C++ 模板声明中的类型参数位置；另有分散的法语、罗马尼亚语词内片段激活，以及零散代码标识符和文档标记，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: C++ 模板代码中的类型参数
patterns.context: 激活集中在 template 声明中，尤其是 typename 后的类型参数及模板参数列表的闭合位置；相邻代码包含函数、结构体、命名空间和类型别名。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 C++ 源码

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内字串“area”
patterns.context: 出现在罗马尼亚语词形内部或词首，如海名“Marea”及“formarea”；所在句子讨论海域或政府议题。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 法语词内字串“pré”
patterns.context: 出现在法语词内部，如“précédents”“prévoir”，涉及定义说明或议会文本中的规定。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 法语学术文本、EuroParl 法语议会文本

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词尾“or”
patterns.context: 出现在“țărilor”一词的末尾；该句谈及受灾国家与国际社会。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 代码中的词语 token 化片段
patterns.context: 出现在 C++ 测试代码及注释中；触发分布于预期警告注释、模板声明和命名空间声明，并非仅由单一关键词解释。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 C++ 测试代码

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在 VelocyPack 类型别名及复合标识符中。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 C++ 源码

patterns.name: 无法归并的零散代码激活
patterns.context: 激活落在 Python 导入语句中的模块名和标识符，未见与其他代码段共享的明确局部结构。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 Python 源码

patterns.name: 无法归并的法语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在强调必要性的法语副词中，附近谈及医疗器械的用途与必要性。

patterns.name: 无法归并的罗马尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在有关加沙巴勒斯坦人民命运的议会文本词语中。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 无法归并的法语定义排版片段
patterns.context: 出现在 ArXiv 文本的定义标签中；其他显著激活分散在法语句子和数学描述里。

en.concept: C++ template syntax and French fragments
en.description: Most code segments activate around C++ template declarations and adjacent types, structs, implementations, or aliases. Two French parliamentary text segments also activate on in-word fragments and sentence-internal words, which the code pattern cannot explain.

patterns.name: C++ template declarations
patterns.context: Activations concentrate around template declarations and their parameter lists, especially after typename, type parameters, or parameter packs; they are usually near the beginning of a declaration.
patterns.domain: C++ code from Github and StackExchange

patterns.name: Template implementations and type utility code
patterns.context: Around template declarations are implementations, structs, type aliases, or generic helper functions; these may reinforce the first pattern, but these terms are not shared by all template segments.
patterns.domain: C++ generic libraries and project source code

patterns.name: French in-word fragments and sentence-internal connectives
patterns.context: Activations occur in continuous French prose concerning Europe, Asia, Russia, recent developments, or hope; there is no apparent template or code context.

patterns.name: French negation and pronouns
patterns.context: These fragments occur in French discussion of Europe, its history, wars, and the common market, constituting prose activations independent of the code pattern.

1_3010.description: 多数代码段在 C++ 模板声明及相邻的类型、结构体、实现或别名处激活；两段法语议会文本也在法语词内片段和句中词语上激活，无法由代码模式解释。

patterns.name: C++ 模板声明
patterns.context: 激活集中在模板声明及其模板参数列表附近，尤其是 typename、类型参数或参数包之后；通常处于声明开头。
patterns.domain: Github 和 StackExchange 的 C++ 代码

patterns.name: 模板实现与类型工具代码
patterns.context: 模板声明周围是实现、结构体、类型别名或泛型辅助函数；可能加强第一种模式，但这些词并非所有模板段共有。
patterns.domain: C++ 泛型库与项目源码

patterns.name: 法语词内片段与句中连接词
patterns.context: 激活出现在连续的法语正文中，涉及欧洲、亚洲、俄罗斯、近况或希望；没有明显的模板或代码语境。

patterns.name: 法语否定与代词
patterns.context: 这些片段出现在关于欧洲及其历史、战争和共同市场的法语论述中，构成独立于代码模式的正文激活。

en.description: Activation is distributed across typename/type parameters and punctuation and whitespace in C++ template code, as well as in-word fragments in several European parliamentary texts: French and Romanian word forms, and disaster-crisis contexts. No unified word meaning or stable cross-domain trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: English template parameter placeholder
patterns.context: A type parameter follows typename in C++ template declarations; appears repeatedly before template definitions

patterns.name: French in-word fragment «ait»
patterns.context: In the French conditional verb aurait, the triggered portion is split into tokens; occurs mid-sentence, not sentence-initially

patterns.name: French in-word fragment «Mad»
patterns.context: The initial fragment of the title Madame, followed by a person’s name

patterns.name: Romanian in-word fragment «it»
patterns.context: An internal part of the Romanian plural noun autoritățile, discussing affected authorities

patterns.name: French in-word fragment «s»
patterns.context: An internal fragment of the French word santé (health), in a context about protecting human health

patterns.name: French in-word fragment «elle»
patterns.context: elle in the French expression celle-ci, referring to a previously mentioned situation

patterns.name: Code punctuation and whitespace fragments
patterns.context: Near angle brackets, semicolons, and line breaks in C++ template code; no stable single-word trigger

patterns.name: Disaster and crisis vocabulary fragments
patterns.context: Describes disasters, war, or their effects, with in-word fragments marked as segmented

1_3010.concept: 混合的词形与代码结构片段
1_3010.description: 激活分布于C++模板代码的typename/类型参数及标点空白，也出现在多种欧洲议会文本的词内片段：法语、罗马尼亚语词形，以及灾难危机语境；未见统一词义或稳定跨领域触发。

patterns.name: 英语模板参数占位符
patterns.context: C++ 模板声明中，typename 后接类型参数；多次出现于模板定义前

patterns.name: 法语词内片段 «ait»
patterns.context: 法语条件式动词 aurait 中，触发部分被拆分标记；处于句中而非句首

patterns.name: 法语词内片段 «Mad»
patterns.context: 称谓 Madame 的词首片段，后接人名

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内片段 «it»
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语复数名词 autoritățile 的词内部分，谈及受影响当局

patterns.name: 法语词内片段 «s»
patterns.context: 法语 santé（健康）词内片段，处于保护人类健康的语境

patterns.name: 法语词内片段 «elle»
patterns.context: 法语 celle-ci 中的 elle，指代前文所述情况

patterns.name: 代码标点与空白片段
patterns.context: C++ 模板代码中的尖括号、分号及换行附近；没有稳定单一词汇触发

patterns.name: 灾难及危机词汇片段
patterns.context: 描述灾难、战争或其影响，词内片段被分段标记

en.concept: Tokenization boundaries and local word-form fragments
en.description: Activations mainly concentrate on local fragments in segmented French and Romanian word forms (especially forms meaning “also” and future-tense verbs), as well as C++ template angle brackets and type syntax. Other parliamentary words are sporadic and lack a unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: Word-form fragments meaning “also/continue”
patterns.context: Romanian “de asemenea” (“also”) and in-word fragments in French future-tense verb forms; activations fall on spelling fragments spanning tokens.

patterns.name: C++ template and type syntax
patterns.context: Template parameter lists, angle brackets, type names, and template-instantiation syntax in C++ code; angle brackets and type-related tokens are especially prominent.

patterns.name: Other French conjunctions and function words
patterns.context: Occurs in ordinary syntax in parliamentary texts; these words are scattered across different topics and do not individually form a stable, specific semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Social and policy topics
patterns.context: Concerns health, the environment, agriculture, the EU, or religious politics; there is no consistent evidence of high activation on these topic words themselves.

patterns.name: Romanian emotional-expression fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences condemning events and mentioning victims; the fragments are Romanian in-word or cross-word tokenizations, with no clear connection to the other patterns.

patterns.name: Prefatory terms in French legal/procedural text
patterns.context: Concerns a proposed directive and its future safeguards; it occurs in a single segment, and it is difficult to determine whether the trigger is semantic or a tokenization coincidence.

patterns.name: C++ string-parsing call
patterns.context: A templated tag parameter is near angle brackets in a string-parsing function call; it is adjacent to the template syntax pattern, but may simply co-occur with code here.

patterns.name: Fragments near names or proper nouns
patterns.context: Token fragments near names or proper nouns in parliamentary speeches; there is insufficient context to determine their semantic role.

1_3010.concept: 分词边界与局部词形片段
1_3010.description: 激活主要集中于法语、罗马尼亚语词形被拆分后的局部片段（尤其同样、将来时动词），以及 C++ 模板尖括号和类型语法。其余议会词项分散，缺乏统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 表示“同样／继续”的词形片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语“de asemenea”（同样），以及法语将来时动词词形中的词内片段；激活落在跨 token 拼写片段上。
patterns.domain: 罗马尼亚语、法语议会发言

patterns.name: C++ 模板与类型语法
patterns.context: C++ 代码中模板参数列表、尖括号、类型名和模板实例化语法；尖括号及类型相关 token 尤其显著。

patterns.name: 其他法语连词与功能词
patterns.context: 出现在议会文本的普通句法中；这些词分散于不同主题，单独看不构成稳定的特定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 社会与政策议题词
patterns.context: 涉及健康、环境、农业、欧盟或宗教政治；未见这些主题词本身有一致的高激活证据。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语情感表达片段
patterns.context: 出现在谴责事件、提及受害者的句子中；片段是罗马尼亚语词内或词间分词，未显示与其他模式的明确联系。

patterns.name: 法语法律／程序文本中的序言词
patterns.context: 指令提案及其将来保障作用；单段出现，且难以确认是语义触发还是分词偶合。

patterns.name: C++ 字符串解析调用
patterns.context: 字符串解析函数调用中，模板化 tag 参数靠近尖括号；与模板语法模式相邻，但此处也可能只是代码共现。

patterns.name: 姓名或专名附近的碎片
patterns.context: 议会发言姓名或专名周边的分词片段，没有足够上下文判断其自身语义作用。

en.concept: Template-list closing symbols and sporadic language forms
en.description: Primarily responds to the closing angle bracket of parameter lists in C++ template declarations; in French parliamentary text, it also responds to conditional polite verbs, verb endings, and in-word subword fragments, spanning policy statements and proper names.

patterns.name: Right angle bracket in C++ template declarations
patterns.context: At the closing point of template parameter lists in C++ source code, especially at the end of declarations, class templates, or function templates; activation is concentrated on the closing angle bracket, and occasionally involves adjacent template syntax

patterns.name: French conditional polite expression
patterns.context: First-person conditional polite expressions in parliamentary speeches, often used to make a request or suggestion; the context is French

patterns.name: French verb-ending fragment
patterns.context: A word is subword-tokenized in continuous French text; it occurs in an expression for “raising a serious question” and is not clearly a polite conditional

patterns.name: Fragments within French safeguard and policy words
patterns.context: Formal policy contexts concerning EU directives and their protection of human health and the environment; activation falls within segmented words

patterns.name: French in-word subword fragment
patterns.context: Part of an isolated name or proper noun; the fragment lacks sufficient context to show a connection to other patterns

1_3010.concept: 模板列表闭合符及零散语言形式
1_3010.description: 主要响应 C++ 模板声明参数列表的闭合尖括号；法语议会文本中另有对条件式礼貌动词、动词词尾及词内子词片段的响应，覆盖政策语句和专名。

patterns.name: C++ 模板声明中的右尖括号
patterns.trigger: 模板参数列表末尾的 «>»10、«>»9 或相邻的 «>»6；如 «typename TSpec, typename TMatrix>»、«template<bool>»、«template<typename T>»
patterns.context: C++ 源码中模板形参列表闭合处，尤其是声明、类或函数模板的末尾；激活集中在闭合尖括号，偶尔也涉及邻近模板语法

patterns.name: 法语条件式礼貌表达
patterns.context: 议会发言中使用第一人称条件式礼貌表达，常用于请求或提出建议；上下文为法语

patterns.name: 法语动词词尾片段
patterns.trigger: «pos»、«er» 等被切分标记的法语动词片段，见 «se poser»
patterns.context: 法语连续文本中，词语被子词切分；该处处于“提出严肃问题”的表达里，并非明显的礼貌条件式

patterns.name: 法语保障与政策词语内部片段
patterns.context: 欧盟指令及其对人类健康、环境的保护等正式政策语境；激活落在被切分词内部

patterns.name: 法语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 孤立姓名或专名的一部分；片段缺乏足够上下文显示与其他模式的联系

en.description: Responds primarily to C++ template declarations and parameter-list closing symbols, also covering code identifiers and fragments inside macros. It also responds to in-word subwords, common short words, and a few sentence-initial speech markers in French parliamentary text; no unified semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: C++ template parameter-list closing symbol
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the closing angle bracket of a template parameter list, often followed by a function, struct, or alias definition; the closing symbol alone stands out more than the overall semantics.

patterns.name: C++ template declarations and type parameters
patterns.context: Keywords and type parameters near template declarations also activate, typically alongside template parameter lists and their closing symbols.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within French words
patterns.context: Long or common French words are split into multiple tokens, with activation on internal word fragments and their local combinations; no consistent word meaning or syntactic position is apparent.

patterns.name: Common French short words and word-form fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in French sentences, including conjunctions, negation structures, and apostrophe tokenization; some fragments recur, but not all tokens of the same type are marked.

patterns.name: Fragments inside C++ macro names
patterns.context: Occurs inside all-caps, underscore-separated preprocessor macro identifiers; activation is distributed across identifier fragments and is not limited to template syntax.

patterns.name: Identifier fragments in code
patterns.context: Occurs in C++ identifiers or type names, some of which are split stems; no stable, specific semantic category is evident.
patterns.domain: C++ source code and technical Q&A code

patterns.name: French sentence-initial or speech contexts
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of sentences, in forms of address, or in questions in parliamentary speeches or minutes.

1_3010.concept: 局部 token 形态与边界
1_3010.description: 主要响应 C++ 模板声明及参数列表闭合符号，也覆盖代码标识符和宏内部片段；另在法语议会文本中响应词内子词、常见短词及少量句首发言标记，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: C++ 模板参数列表结束符
patterns.context: 激活集中在模板参数列表的闭合尖括号，常在后面接函数、结构体或别名定义；单独的闭合符号而非整体语义最突出。

patterns.name: C++ 模板声明及类型形参
patterns.context: 模板声明附近的关键字和类型形参也有激活；通常与模板参数列表及其结束符同现。

patterns.name: 法语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 法语长词或常用词被分成多个 token，激活落在词内部片段及其局部组合；未见一致的词义或句法位置。

patterns.name: 法语常见短词与词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在法语句子中，涉及连词、否定结构和撇号分词；有些片段多次出现，但并非所有同类 token 都被标记。

patterns.name: C++ 宏名内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在全大写下划线分隔的预处理宏标识符内部；激活分布于标识符片段，并非只限于模板语法。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符片段
patterns.context: 出现在 C++ 标识符或类型名中，部分是被切分的词干；未显示稳定的具体语义类别。
patterns.domain: C++ 源码及技术问答代码

patterns.name: 法语句首或发言语境
patterns.context: 出现在议会发言或议事记录中的句首、称呼或提问位置。

en.description: Activation is distributed across in-word inflectional fragments and common word fragments in French and Romanian, and also appears on C++ template parameters, angle brackets, declarations, and punctuation. There is no single semantic theme; across corpora, activation may favor word fragments and structural tokens.

patterns.name: French future-tense verb ending
patterns.context: The future ending -era or conditional ending -erais follows a French verb stem; the surrounding context is a predicate in a sentence.
patterns.domain: EuroParl French political speeches and parliamentary text

patterns.name: French verb stems and inflectional fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on stem or affix fragments within French words; these are mostly inflected forms, word-form variations, or words split into subwords.

patterns.name: French word-initial and function-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across short function words, pronouns, articles/prepositions, and word-initial fragments; there is no consistent semantic category.

patterns.name: Romanian word endings and in-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within or at the end of Romanian words, including word-form fragments; this passage is in a different language from the French passages, with no clear shared semantics observed.

patterns.name: C++ template parameters and angle brackets
patterns.context: Activation appears around parameter lists, angle brackets, type names, and separators in C++ template declarations; several strong responses fall on closing angle brackets or template syntax.

patterns.name: C++ punctuation, type declarations, and code fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs on C++ declarations, preprocessor branches, type qualifiers, and punctuation; it is not limited to template syntax.

1_3010.description: 激活分布在法语、罗马尼亚语的词内屈折片段及常见词片段，也出现在C++模板参数、尖括号、声明与标点上。没有单一语义主题；跨语料可能偏向词片段和结构性 token。

patterns.name: 法语动词将来时词尾
patterns.context: 法语动词词干后出现将来时词尾 -era，或条件式词尾 -erais；周围是句子中的谓语动词。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 法语政治演讲与议会文本

patterns.name: 法语动词词干与屈折片段
patterns.trigger: «lev»2é、« c»1raint«es»2、« ag»1«i»2、« sel»4«on»2、« term»4«e»1、« sout»2«ien»4、« cit»3«oy»4ens、« fond»1ées、« cons»5équ«ences»5
patterns.context: 激活落在法语词内部的词干或词缀片段；多为屈折形式、词形变化或被分词切开的词。

patterns.name: 法语词首及功能词片段
patterns.context: 激活散布在短功能词、代词、冠词/介词以及词语开头片段上；没有一致的语义类别。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词尾与词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在罗马尼亚语词内部或词尾，包含词形片段；该段与法语段落不同语种，未见明确共享语义。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语政治文本

patterns.name: C++ 模板参数与尖括号
patterns.context: C++ 模板声明中，参数列表及尖括号、类型名、分隔符附近出现激活；若干强响应落在闭合尖括号或模板语法处。

patterns.name: C++ 标点、类型声明与代码词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在 C++ 声明、预处理分支、类型限定符及标点上；不只限于模板语法。

en.concept: C++ template closers and type declarations
en.description: High activation often occurs at closing C++ template angle brackets, especially in nested type aliases. There are also sporadic triggers such as category, Callback, Scanner, and parameter packs, along with several local symbol/identifier activations that cannot be covered by a single pattern.

patterns.name: Template angle brackets and template-parameter endings
patterns.context: In C++ template declarations, instantiations, or function templates, angle brackets close the template parameter list; a type name or parameter pack sometimes immediately precedes them.

patterns.name: Nested closing brackets at the end of type lists
patterns.context: In nested template type aliases, the inner template argument list closes before the outer closing bracket.

patterns.name: category substring in an identifier
patterns.context: Occurs in the member field name “_side_category;”, near other type declarations such as typedef, Line, and Segment.

patterns.name: Callback substring in a callback class name
patterns.context: Template forward declarations and their concrete typedef instantiations; the identifier is Callback.

patterns.name: Type-name substring in scanner declarations
patterns.context: The Scanner type recurs in forward declarations, function-pointer parameters, and struct definitions.

patterns.name: Parameter-pack ellipsis
patterns.context: A typename parameter-pack declaration in a C++ variadic template, followed by Args and a closing angle bracket.

patterns.name: Other local identifier or symbol activations
patterns.context: Occur respectively in template static-member initialization, rectangle callback types, lookup-function comments/return values, TODO comments, and parse tag dispatch; there is no shared, obvious local trigger.
patterns.domain: C++ source code, comments, and test markers

1_3010.concept: C++ 模板闭合符及类型声明
1_3010.description: 高激活多见于 C++ 模板尖括号闭合，尤其嵌套类型别名；另有 category、Callback、Scanner、参数包等零散触发，及若干局部符号/标识符激活，无法用单一模式覆盖。

patterns.name: 模板尖括号及模板参数收尾
patterns.trigger: «>»、«>»10、«>»8，常出现在模板参数列表或模板实参列表的闭合处
patterns.context: C++ 模板声明、实例化或函数模板中，尖括号闭合模板参数列表；有时前面紧邻类型名或参数包

patterns.name: 类型列表中的末尾嵌套闭合
patterns.context: 嵌套模板类型别名中，内层模板实参列表闭合后接外层闭合符

patterns.name: 标识符中的 category 子串
patterns.context: 出现在成员字段名“_side_category;”中，附近还有 typedef、Line、Segment 等类型声明

patterns.name: 回调类名中的 Callback 子串
patterns.context: 模板前向声明及其具体 typedef 实例化，标识符为 Callback

patterns.name: 扫描器声明中的类型名子串
patterns.context: 前向声明、函数指针参数和结构体定义反复出现 Scanner 类型

patterns.name: 参数包省略号
patterns.context: C++ 可变参数模板的 typename 参数包声明，后接 Args 和尖括号闭合

patterns.name: 其他局部标识符或符号激活
patterns.context: 分别出现在模板静态成员初始化、矩形回调类型、查找函数注释/返回值、TODO 注释及 parse 的 tag 分派中；没有共同的明显局部触发条件
patterns.domain: C++ 源码、注释与测试标记

en.description: Appears mainly in code, especially C++ type declarations, templates, and standard-library types; it also covers general C++ structural tokens, Java class-member declarations, and a polite expression in a French parliamentary address.

patterns.name: C++ templates and type declarations
patterns.context: Defines aliases, template parameters, or nested types in C++ code; highlights often fall on type names, template angle brackets, and nearby tokens.

patterns.name: C++ standard-library containers and complex types
patterns.context: Combines standard-library containers, strings, and multi-value return types in type declarations or function signatures, especially at the ends of nested templates.

patterns.name: C++ declarations, punctuation, and code structure
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across punctuation, types, and identifiers in C++ declarations, loops, function bodies, or struct definitions; no single-word trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: French formal address and speech
patterns.context: At the beginning of a formal parliamentary speech, greeting and congratulating the chair and members of parliament.

patterns.name: Java class members and inheritance declarations
patterns.context: Declares inheritance relationships and fields in Java class definitions.

1_3010.description: 主要出现在代码中，尤其是 C++ 类型声明、模板与标准库类型；也覆盖一般 C++ 结构 token、Java 类成员声明，以及一段法语议会致辞中的礼貌表达。

patterns.name: C++ 模板与类型声明
patterns.context: 在 C++ 代码中定义别名、模板参数或嵌套类型；高亮常落在类型名、模板尖括号及其邻近 token。

patterns.name: C++ 标准库容器及复杂类型
patterns.context: 类型声明或函数签名中组合标准库容器、字符串和多返回值类型，尤其是嵌套模板结束处。

patterns.name: C++ 声明、标点与代码结构
patterns.context: C++ 声明、循环、函数体或结构体定义中，激活分散在标点、类型和标识符；没有明显单一词汇触发条件。

patterns.name: 法语礼貌称呼与致辞
patterns.context: 议会正式发言开头，对主席及议员致意、祝贺。

patterns.name: Java 类成员与继承声明
patterns.context: Java 类定义中声明继承关系及字段。

en.concept: C++ type and template declaration patterns
en.description: Responds primarily to typedef, typename, template/scope separators, and compound identifiers in C++ type declarations and template code, also covering Boost.MPL metaprogramming. It also activates on an English code comment and fragments within French words.

patterns.name: C++ type aliases and typedef declarations
patterns.context: Declares nested types, container types, function pointers, or local types in C++ templates or class/function definitions; commonly occurs in declaration statements.

patterns.name: Boost.MPL template metaprogramming
patterns.context: Boost.MPL represents compile-time operations using template specializations, type tags, and nested type/apply.

patterns.name: Token boundaries and naming fragments within identifiers
patterns.context: Long underscore-connected type names, member names, or compound identifiers, often adjacent to typedef declarations.

patterns.name: Parameter-wrapper description in an English code comment
patterns.context: An English documentation comment before a function template describes the behavior of a parameter wrapper.

patterns.name: Fragments within French words
patterns.context: Subword fragments occur within words in continuous French text; no obvious C++ syntax context is present.

1_3010.concept: C++ 类型与模板声明模式
1_3010.description: 主要响应 C++ 类型声明和模板代码中的 typedef、typename、模板/作用域分隔符及复合标识符，也覆盖 Boost.MPL 元编程；另对一段英文代码注释和法语词内片段有激活。

patterns.name: C++ 类型别名与 typedef 声明
patterns.context: 在 C++ 模板或类/函数定义中声明嵌套类型、容器类型、函数指针或局部类型；常见于声明语句

patterns.name: Boost.MPL 模板元编程
patterns.context: Boost.MPL 中以模板特化、类型标签及嵌套 type/apply 表示编译期操作

patterns.name: 标识符内的分词边界与命名片段
patterns.context: 下划线连接的长类型名、成员名或复合标识符，常与 typedef 类型声明相邻

patterns.name: 英文代码注释中的参数包装说明
patterns.trigger: “wraps the argument into a file_name named argument”
patterns.context: 函数模板前的英文文档注释，说明包装参数的行为

patterns.name: 法语词语内部片段
patterns.context: 连续法语正文中出现词内子词片段；没有明显 C++ 语法上下文

en.description: Primarily responds to structural words and closing symbols in C++ template, type-alias, and type-trait declarations; it also responds to congratulations and audience pronouns in French parliamentary addresses, and activates on “prim” in a Romanian speech passage.

patterns.name: C++ templates and type declarations
patterns.context: Triggers occur in C++ template parameters, type aliases, or type-trait declarations, often at angle-bracket closures; [1] and [4] are especially concentrated at the ends of template type expressions.

patterns.name: French congratulations and address
patterns.context: In parliamentary speeches, greeting or congratulating elected officials or the chair; activation falls near first-person expressions, congratulatory verbs, and forms of address.

patterns.name: French pronoun vous
patterns.context: The pronoun appears in French sentences, including both audience address in parliamentary speeches and general policy text expressions such as “for you/to you”; it is not limited to congratulatory contexts.

patterns.name: Romanian political speech word form
patterns.context: Appears in “ați primit” in a Romanian parliamentary speech passage.

1_3010.concept: 上下文依赖的结构与词形
1_3010.description: 主要响应 C++ 模板、类型别名和类型特征声明中的结构词及闭合符；另对法语议会致辞中的祝贺、受众代词有反应，并在一段罗马尼亚语发言中激活于“prim”。

patterns.name: C++ 模板与类型声明
patterns.context: 触发点位于 C++ 模板参数、类型别名或类型特征声明中，常见于尖括号闭合处；[1]、[4] 尤其集中在模板类型表达式末尾。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 C++ 源码

patterns.name: 法语祝贺与致辞
patterns.context: 在议会发言中，向当选者或主席致意、祝贺；激活落在第一人称表达、祝贺动词及称呼附近。

patterns.name: 法语代词 vous
patterns.context: 代词出现在法语句子中，既包括议会致辞里的受众称呼，也包括一般政策文本中的“为你们/向你们提供”等表达；并非只限祝贺语境。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语政治发言词形
patterns.context: 出现在罗马尼亚语议会发言片段的“ați primit”中。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语政治演讲

en.description: Activation falls mainly into two groups: fragments within words and a few function words in French parliamentary text; and templates, type declarations, and related punctuation in C++ source code. The code group is primarily Boost/MPL, with some ordinary C++ declarations.

patterns.name: Fragments within or at the ends of French words
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within or at the ends of segmented French words, including common words and inflected forms; the words occur mostly in continuous French prose.
patterns.domain: French parliamentary debates and formal political text

patterns.name: C++ template and type syntax
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on template parameters, type names, qualified names, and punctuation in C++ declarations; mostly Boost/MPL code, but also other C++ code.

patterns.name: Fragments of common French function words
patterns.context: Common pronouns, prepositions, or articles occur in French sentences; some words are near punctuation or syntactic boundaries.

patterns.name: Angle brackets and declaration structures in code
patterns.context: Delimiters and declaration-ending symbols in C++ template declarations, structs, or function signatures; they occur alongside type/template syntax.

1_3010.description: 激活主要分两组：法语议会文本中的词内片段及少量功能词；C++ 源码中的模板、类型声明和相关标点。代码组以 Boost/MPL 为主，另有普通 C++ 声明。

patterns.name: 法语词内/词尾片段
patterns.trigger: « plus»1«ieurs»4、« Ét»1«ats»1、« res»4sources、« mis»5ère、« Mes»2dames、« voud»2«rais»2、« félic»iter»9
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的法语词内部或词尾，涉及常见词及屈折形式；词片段所在句子多为连续法语正文。
patterns.domain: 法语议会辩论与正式政治文本

patterns.name: C++模板及类型语法
patterns.context: 激活集中在 C++ 声明中的模板参数、类型名、限定名及标点；多为 Boost/MPL 代码，也包括其他 C++ 代码。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 C++ 源码

patterns.name: 普通法语功能词片段
patterns.context: 法语句子中出现常见代词、介词或冠词；部分词位于标点或句法边界附近。

patterns.name: 代码中的尖括号与声明结构
patterns.context: C++ 模板声明、结构体或函数签名中的界定符与声明结束符；与类型/模板语法共同出现。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 C++ 源码

en.description: Activation is concentrated in two distinct types of text: words and in-word fragments in French parliamentary sentences, and templates, type declarations, and related punctuation in C++ source code. The trigger forms differ markedly, making them difficult to explain through a single specific word meaning.

patterns.name: French segmented in-word fragments
patterns.context: Words or in-word fragments in continuous French text, including EU institutions, parliamentary speeches, and political affairs. Activation often falls on common words, morphemes, or parts of words, rather than corresponding to only one specific word meaning.

patterns.name: C++ template and type syntax
patterns.context: Template parameters, type names, qualified names, and declaration syntax in C++ code; high activation can occur on template symbols, identifier fragments, and common type keywords.

1_3010.concept: 语言特定的局部语法片段
1_3010.description: 激活集中在两类不同文本：法语议会语句中的词与词内片段，以及 C++ 源码中模板、类型声明和相关标点。两类触发形式差异明显，难以由单一具体词义解释。

patterns.name: 法语词内切分片段
patterns.context: 法语连续文本中的词或词内片段；包括欧盟机构、议会发言及政治事务语境。激活常落在常见词、词素或词的一部分，并非只对应某一特定词义。

patterns.name: C++模板及类型语法
patterns.context: C++代码中模板参数、类型名、限定名及声明语法；高激活可出现在模板符号、标识符片段和常见类型关键字上。

en.concept: C++ template syntax and French subword fragments
en.description: Activation is seen mainly on keywords and punctuation in C++ templates/type declarations. In French text, some subwords also activate, especially in “féliciter” in parliamentary addresses; there are also sporadic fragments in medical text, so no single semantic feature accounts for them.

patterns.name: C++ type aliases and template-metaprogramming punctuation
patterns.context: C++ code containing template parameter packs, type qualifiers, type aliases, or complex template types; activation is distributed across keywords, punctuation, and nearby type names.

patterns.name: Congratulations in formal French addresses
patterns.context: Parliamentary speeches address or congratulate members, often using «je voudrais féliciter»; the word is split into subwords.

patterns.name: Subword/word-form fragments within French words
patterns.context: In continuous French text, internal subword fragments and parts of word forms are marked in several words; aside from explicit parliamentary addresses, the triggering semantics are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Fragments within French medical terms
patterns.context: In French medical papers, marked activations fall on internal subword fragments in medical terms such as adrenalectomy, as well as in ordinary words.

1_3010.concept: C++模板语法及法语子词片段
1_3010.description: 激活主要见于 C++ 模板/类型声明中的关键字与标点；法语文本中也激活部分词内子词，尤见议会致辞的“féliciter”，另有医学文本零散片段，无法归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: C++ 类型别名与模板元编程标点
patterns.context: C++ 代码中出现模板参数包、类型限定、类型别名或复杂模板类型；激活分散于关键字、标点及类型名附近。

patterns.name: 法语正式致辞中的祝贺
patterns.context: 议会发言中向议员致意或祝贺，常见搭配 «je voudrais féliciter»；词被切分为子词。

patterns.name: 法语词内子词/词形片段
patterns.context: 法语连续文本中，若干词的内部子词片段及词形部分被标记；除明确的议会致辞外，触发语义不一致。

patterns.name: 法语医学术语的词内片段
patterns.context: 法语医学论文中，标记落在肾上腺切除等医学术语及普通词的内部子词片段上。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 法语医学论文

en.description: Covers type and identifier fragments in C++ template parameter packs, type aliases, and declarations, as well as French polite congratulations in parliamentary corpora, social policy, and Romanian expressions of EU-related risks; there is no clear shared trigger across code and multilingual parliamentary text.

patterns.name: C++ template parameter packs and forwarding references
patterns.context: A parameter pack appears in a template declaration, often adjacent to a type name, reference, or function declaration; activation often falls on the ellipsis and fragments of the spelling Args.

patterns.name: C++ type definitions and template metaprogramming
patterns.context: Type aliases, nested types, template type expressions, and long underscore-connected type names; activation falls on subwords within identifiers and some punctuation.
patterns.domain: Github, C++ template and library code

patterns.name: Type and symbol fragments in C++ declarations
patterns.context: In class member declarations, function-pointer typedefs, structs, and operator overload declarations, type qualifiers, reference symbols, and identifier fragments may activate; their trigger positions vary.

patterns.name: Polite expressions in French parliamentary addresses
patterns.context: At the opening of parliamentary remarks or in an address, the speaker expresses congratulations in the first person and politely addresses members; activation centers on fragments of je and féliciter.

patterns.name: EU social policy and poverty issues
patterns.context: Discussion of EU institutions, resources provided by member states, social programs, and combating poverty; local subwords in multiple words are marked.

patterns.name: Romanian expressions of EU-related risks
patterns.context: Romanian sentences discuss EU-related issues and expressions about deepening or creating risks; activation is distributed across tokenized word fragments.

1_3010.description: 覆盖C++模板参数包、类型别名及声明中的类型和标识符片段，也覆盖议会语料中法语礼貌祝贺、社会政策与罗马尼亚语欧盟风险表述；没有贯穿代码与多语议会文本的明确共同触发条件。

patterns.name: C++模板参数包与转发引用
patterns.context: 模板声明中出现参数包，常邻接类型名、引用或函数声明；激活常落在省略号及 Args 拼写片段上。

patterns.name: C++类型定义与模板元编程
patterns.context: 类型别名、嵌套类型、模板类型表达式及由下划线连接的长类型名；激活落在标识符内部的子词和部分标点。

patterns.name: C++声明中的类型与符号片段
patterns.trigger: « const»3« &»6；«Buffer»2«&»5« operator»4；« char»3 uchar«;»2；« int»2；« Report»3«ErrorProc»
patterns.context: 类成员声明、函数指针 typedef、结构体及运算符重载声明中，类型限定符、引用符、标识符片段均可能激活；各段触发位置不完全相同。

patterns.name: 法语议会致辞中的礼貌表达
patterns.trigger: « je»6 voudrais félic«iter»9；« Mes»3dames et Messieurs les Députés,« je»6 voudrais
patterns.context: 议会发言开头或致辞中，以第一人称表达祝贺、礼貌称呼议员；激活集中于 je 和 féliciter 的片段。

patterns.name: 欧盟社会政策与贫困议题
patterns.trigger: « sources»；« disposition»；« res»4«sources»；« lut»5«te»2 contre la« mis»4«ère
patterns.context: 谈及欧盟机构、成员国提供资源，社会项目及反贫困；多个词的局部子词被标记。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语欧盟风险表述
patterns.trigger: « Uni»3une«a»6 Europeană；« ad»5«ân»1ci« rep»4«rez»3intă；« a»5 de«ven»8«it»3 evident
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句子谈欧盟相关问题及加深、产生风险等表述；激活分布在被切分的词片段中。

en.description: Responds primarily to typed declarations and syntax structures in code, especially C++ templates, dependent types, and declarators; it also covers function/pointer declarations, Java classes and interfaces, and Boost code. There is also an unrelated French parliamentary address.

patterns.name: C++ template types and metaprogramming declarations
patterns.context: Occurs in C++ template or type-alias declarations, often combined with dependent types, template specializations, nested scopes, and punctuation; most evident in excerpts 1, 2, 3, 6, and 7.

patterns.name: C++ pointers, references, and declarator symbols
patterns.context: References, function pointers, variadic parameters, and declaration-ending punctuation occur in type declarations or function parameters; these fragments are not always part of template metaprogramming.

patterns.name: C++ return types and function implementations
patterns.context: Function definitions, wrapper functions, or simple return implementations; names occur next to their implementation bodies.

patterns.name: Java class and member declarations
patterns.context: Java inheritance declarations and field declarations, including generic wildcards; unlike C++ template declarations, these are also typed code declarations.

patterns.name: Type-conversion/state-type interface
patterns.context: Documentation comments describe retrieving state by requested type and returning null on failure, followed by a Java method declaration.
patterns.domain: Java API documentation and interface code

patterns.name: C++ namespaces and container/sequence operations
patterns.context: Template declarations in a Boost namespace; the excerpt also contains version comments.

patterns.name: Forms of address and polite expressions in French
patterns.context: At the beginning of a European Parliament speech, addressing members and expressing congratulations; unrelated to the code patterns.

patterns.name: C interface and function-pointer declarations
patterns.context: C-style struct and callback function-pointer type declarations, including a forward struct declaration and variadic parameters.

1_3010.concept: 类型化声明与代码语法
1_3010.description: 主要响应代码中的类型化声明与语法结构，尤其是 C++ 模板、依赖类型和声明符；也覆盖函数/指针声明、Java 类与接口、Boost 代码。另有一段无关的法语议会致辞。

patterns.name: C++ 模板类型与元编程声明
patterns.context: 出现在 C++ 模板或类型别名声明中，常与依赖类型、模板特化、嵌套作用域及标点组合；第 1、2、3、6、7 段最明显。
patterns.domain: C++/Boost 泛型与模板元编程代码

patterns.name: C++ 指针、引用与声明符号
patterns.context: 类型声明或函数参数中出现引用、函数指针、可变参数和声明结束标点；这些片段不总是模板元编程的一部分。

patterns.name: C++ 返回类型与函数实现
patterns.context: 函数定义、包装函数或简单返回实现；名称与实现体相邻。

patterns.name: Java 类及成员声明
patterns.context: Java 类继承声明和字段声明，含泛型通配符；与 C++ 模板声明不同，但同样是类型化代码声明。

patterns.name: 类型转换/状态类型接口
patterns.context: 文档注释描述按请求类型获取状态及失败时返回 null，随后是 Java 方法声明。
patterns.domain: Java API 文档与接口代码

patterns.name: C++ 命名空间与容器/序列操作
patterns.context: Boost 命名空间中的模板声明；片段还包含版本注释。

patterns.name: 法语议会称呼与礼貌表达
patterns.trigger: « Mes»dames et Messieurs les Députés,« je» voud«rais» ... «félic»«iter»
patterns.context: 欧洲议会发言开头，向议员致意并表达祝贺；与代码模式无关。

patterns.name: C 接口与函数指针声明
patterns.context: C 风格结构体及回调函数指针类型声明，包含前置结构体声明与可变参数。

en.concept: Mixed feature of intra-word substrings and code structures
en.description: Activation is scattered across pes in the Hungarian word képesek, C++ template types and parameter-list symbols, and iter in French féliciter; C++ Args ellipses and the Java identifier Editor also appear.

patterns.name: Hungarian word forms containing pes
patterns.context: The substring pes occurs in Hungarian words; the examples are képesek and képesek, with nearby context discussing whether something can be done or the possession of an ability.

patterns.name: type in C++ type definitions
patterns.context: Near type aliases and nested type names in C++ template metaprogramming code; the second segment also contains «error»2«_»2«storage»1«_»1«type»3«;»2.

patterns.name: C++ variadic template marker
patterns.context: In a template parameter list, the ellipsis is adjacent to the template parameter name Args; seen only here.

patterns.name: Template macro parameter-list terminator
patterns.context: The closing symbol > of a template parameter list in a macro-expanded template declaration activates.

patterns.name: it within an English congratulatory word
patterns.context: In a French parliamentary address, the final-letter substring iter in féliciter is marked; it is not an independent English word.

patterns.name: iter within a congratulatory word
patterns.context: Also occurs within féliciter in a French parliamentary address, surrounded by congratulations to an elected official.

patterns.name: Visible editor identifier
patterns.context: Editor editor appears in a Java method parameter list, with an annotation and generic parameter on the same line.

1_3010.concept: 词内子串与代码结构的混合特征
1_3010.description: 激活分散于匈牙利语 képesek 的 pes、C++ 模板类型与参数列表符号，以及法语 féliciter 的 iter；另见 C++ Args 省略号和 Java Editor 标识符。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语中含 pes 的词形
patterns.context: 匈牙利语词中出现子串 pes；例中分别为 képesek、képesek，附近语境谈及能否做到或具备能力。

patterns.name: C++ 类型定义中的 type
patterns.trigger: «type»4、«wrapped»4、«_»4；反复出现于 typedef、模板类型及 ::type 等结构中
patterns.context: C++ 模板元编程代码中，类型别名及嵌套类型名附近；第2段另有 «error»2«_»2«storage»1«_»1«type»3«;»2。

patterns.name: C++ 可变参数模板标记
patterns.context: template 参数列表中，省略号紧邻模板参数名 Args；只见于此处。

patterns.name: 模板宏中的参数列表结尾
patterns.context: 宏展开形式的模板声明中，模板参数列表闭合符号 > 激活。

patterns.name: 英语祝贺词内的 it
patterns.context: 法语议会致辞中，法语 féliciter 的末尾字母子串 iter 被标记；并非英语独立词。

patterns.name: 英语祝贺词内的 iter
patterns.context: 法语议会致辞中，同样出现在 féliciter 内，周围是对当选者表示祝贺。

patterns.name: 可见编辑器标识符
patterns.context: Java 方法参数列表中出现 Editor editor，且同一行还有注解和泛型参数。

en.description: Activation centers on closing generic/template angle brackets in code, especially C++ parameter packs; there are also sporadic fragments within C++, Java, French, and Hungarian words. There is no uniform cross-domain trigger.

patterns.name: C++ variadic templates
patterns.context: In a C++ template declaration, an ellipsis is adjacent to the type parameter pack Ar(gs), followed by a closing angle bracket; both segments occur in code declarations

patterns.name: Generic type-parameter closure
patterns.context: Angle brackets used to close nested generic or template types, including parameter-pack declarations, wildcard generics, and type parameters

patterns.name: Partial-word segmentation in French
patterns.context: Verbal forms in spoken French or parliamentary transcripts are segmented; ons follows a stem to form the first-person plural present tense, as in faisons

patterns.name: Hungarian ability word forms
patterns.context: Intra-word segmentation in Hungarian; pes follows ké to form képes/ képesek (able, capable)

patterns.name: C++ integer type marker
patterns.context: Within the underscore-separated type name integral_c_tag, the marker occurs inside the name

patterns.name: C++ rvalue-reference symbol
patterns.context: In the parameter type of an overloaded assignment operator, the double ampersand denotes an rvalue reference

patterns.name: French morpheme segmentation
patterns.context: In continuous French text, activation falls on multiple fragments within words or at word boundaries; no consistent syntactic trigger is apparent

patterns.name: Hungarian morpheme segmentation
patterns.context: Fragments within words or at word boundaries in continuous Hungarian text; aside from képes, there is insufficient repeated evidence to identify a common condition

patterns.name: Java type names and modifiers
patterns.context: A Java class member declaration contains an access modifier, a final field, and a generic type with a wildcard

patterns.name: Java generic parameters and type names
patterns.context: A List generic in a Java test method parameter contains an extends wildcard and a nested type closure

patterns.name: Java class-literal generic
patterns.context: A Java method parameter for returning a state uses Class<? extends State>

patterns.name: C++ template member declaration
patterns.context: A template specialization declaration in standard-library-style C++ code, followed by an impl struct and template members

patterns.name: Java serialization type parameter
patterns.context: A Java JSON deserialization method returns an Option generic type and contains a type deserializer

1_3010.concept: 尖括号闭合及词内片段
1_3010.description: 激活集中于代码里的尖括号泛型/模板闭合，尤其 C++ 参数包；另有零散的 C++、Java 类型声明及法语、匈牙利语词内片段。跨领域触发条件并不统一。

patterns.name: C++ 可变参数模板
patterns.context: C++ 模板声明中，省略号紧邻类型参数包 Ar(gs)，后接尖括号闭合；两段都位于代码声明中

patterns.name: 泛型类型参数闭合
patterns.context: 尖括号作为嵌套泛型或模板类型的闭合符号；包括参数包声明、通配符泛型及类型参数

patterns.name: 法语词内部分词
patterns.context: 法语口语或议会记录中的动词形式被切分，ons 接在词干后形成第一人称复数现在时，如 faisons

patterns.name: 匈牙利语能力词形
patterns.context: 匈牙利语词内分词，pes 接在 ké 后组成 képes/ képesek（能够、有能力）

patterns.name: C++ 整数类型标记
patterns.context: 模板特化名称 integral_c_tag 中，标记位于下划线分隔的类型名内部

patterns.name: C++ 右值引用符号
patterns.context: 赋值运算符重载的参数类型中，双与号表示右值引用

patterns.name: 法语词素切分
patterns.context: 法语连续正文中，激活落在词内或词边界处的多个片段，未见统一的句法触发条件

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词素切分
patterns.context: 匈牙利语连续正文中的词内或词边界片段；除 képes 外，没有足够重复证据确定共同条件

patterns.name: Java 类型名及修饰符
patterns.context: Java 类成员声明中，访问修饰符、final 字段和带通配符的泛型类型同时出现

patterns.name: Java 泛型参数与类型名
patterns.context: Java 测试方法参数中的 List 泛型，包含 extends 通配符和嵌套类型闭合

patterns.name: Java 类字面量泛型
patterns.context: 返回状态的 Java 方法参数使用 Class<? extends State>

patterns.name: C++ 模板成员声明
patterns.context: C++ 标准库风格的模板特化声明，后接 impl 结构体及模板成员

patterns.name: Java 序列化类型参数
patterns.context: Java JSON 反序列化方法中返回 Option 泛型类型，并出现类型反序列化器

en.concept: Code generic syntax and incidental word fragments
en.description: Responds primarily to angle brackets, parameter packs, type aliases, and generic declarations in C++ template code; there are also sporadic activations on class-member declarations. In EuroParl text, activations are scattered across French, Hungarian, and Romanian word fragments and function structures, with no unified word meaning or cross-language rule apparent.

patterns.name: C++ template parameter packs and their declarations
patterns.context: In template declarations, an ellipsis is adjacent to the parameter-pack name Args, followed by a right angle bracket; type parameters in template parameter lists also occur.

patterns.name: C++ type aliases and template metaprogramming
patterns.context: In type aliases, typedefs, nested types, iterators, or Boost/MPL template expressions, activation is concentrated on angle brackets, type names, and nearby symbols.

patterns.name: C++ operator overload declarations
patterns.context: An assignment operator and move-assignment operator are declared in the VertexBuffer class interface.

patterns.name: Java class and generic member declarations
patterns.context: In a Java class definition, the field type is an abstract class with generic parameters.

patterns.name: French first person and complement structures
patterns.context: In parliamentary speeches, first-person expressions convey wishes or reminders, followed by a que clause; activation falls on function words and word fragments.

patterns.name: Fragments within Hungarian words and expressions of ability
patterns.context: In continuous Hungarian text, activation falls within words or at affix boundaries; forms meaning “be able to” are included.

patterns.name: Romanian parliamentary forms of address and fragments within words
patterns.context: Formal forms of address in parliamentary speeches and internal fragments of Romanian word forms; preposition/article and noun combinations also occur.

1_3010.concept: 代码泛型语法与偶发词片段
1_3010.description: 主要响应 C++ 模板代码中的尖括号、参数包、类型别名及泛型声明；另对类成员声明有零星响应。EuroParl 中则分散落在法语、匈牙利语、罗马尼亚语词片段与功能结构上，未见统一词义或跨语言规则。

patterns.name: C++ 模板参数包及其声明
patterns.context: 模板声明中省略号紧邻参数包名 Args，后接右尖括号；也见于模板参数列表中的类型参数。

patterns.name: C++ 类型别名与模板元编程
patterns.context: 类型别名、typedef、嵌套类型、迭代器或 Boost/MPL 模板表达式中，激活集中在尖括号、类型名及其邻近符号。
patterns.domain: Github C++ 模板/泛型代码

patterns.name: C++ 运算符重载声明
patterns.context: VertexBuffer 类接口中声明赋值运算符及移动赋值运算符。

patterns.name: Java 类及泛型成员声明
patterns.context: Java 类定义中，字段类型为带泛型参数的抽象类。

patterns.name: 法语第一人称及其补语结构
patterns.trigger: « je»7 voudrais rapp«eler»；« chose»10 que nous« demand»
patterns.context: 议会发言中第一人称表达愿望或提醒，后接 que 从句；激活落在功能词和词语片段上。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内片段及能力表达
patterns.context: 匈牙利语连续正文中，激活落在词内部或词缀边界；包含“能够”一类形式。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 匈牙利语议会发言

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语议会称呼与词内片段
patterns.context: 议会发言的正式称呼及罗马尼亚语词形内部片段，另有介词/冠词与名词连写。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语议会发言

en.description: Activation occurs in formal first-person expressions in French parliamentary addresses, and extensively in C++ template and type declaration syntax; one example also highlights a function pattern with a const-reference parameter and return statement.

patterns.name: Fixed expressions in French parliamentary speech
patterns.context: In French parliamentary addresses or debates, the first-person speaker uses formal, polite language to express remarks, congratulations, requests, or customary appeals; activation is distributed across multiple parts of the phrases, not necessarily adjacent.

patterns.name: C++ template and type declaration syntax
patterns.context: In C++ source code, template parameter lists, template specializations, type aliases, and nested type declarations; activation falls near syntax keywords, angle brackets, and type names, often in Boost-style generic code.

patterns.name: C++ const-reference parameters and return statements
patterns.context: A function signature takes a string by const reference and returns that parameter in the function body; the current example is a short string-conversion helper.

1_3010.description: 激活见于法语议会致辞中的正式第一人称表达，也大量见于 C++ 模板、类型声明等语法结构；另有一例突出 const 引用形参与返回参数的函数写法。

patterns.name: 法语议会发言中的固定搭配
patterns.trigger: « je»7、« Mes»2dames et Messieurs les Députés、« féliciter»9、« demander»4«ons»6«const»3«am»3«ment»4
patterns.context: 法语议会致辞或辩论中，第一人称发言者用正式礼貌语气表达发言、祝贺、请求或惯常诉求；激活分布在短语多个组成部分，未必都紧邻。

patterns.name: C++ 模板与类型声明语法
patterns.context: C++ 源码中模板参数列表、模板特化、类型别名及嵌套类型声明；激活落在语法关键字、尖括号和类型名附近，常见于 Boost 风格泛型代码。

patterns.name: C++ 引用形参与返回语句
patterns.context: 函数签名以 const 引用接收字符串，并在函数体内返回该参数；当前例子是简短的字符串转换辅助代码。

en.description: Activation spans parliamentary text in multiple languages and C++ code: French polite addresses and policy-related intra-word fragments, Hungarian and Romanian fragments, as well as C++ template, type, and operator syntax. No common pattern is sufficiently clear.

patterns.name: Polite expressions in French parliamentary addresses
patterns.context: In French parliamentary speech, addressing members or congratulating elected officials; activation is scattered across different parts of phrases rather than corresponding to a single continuous word.

patterns.name: C++ template and type syntax
patterns.context: C++ source code contains syntax structures such as template parameter packs, type declarations, references, and operator overloads.

patterns.name: Hungarian intra-word fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Hungarian text, activation falls within words or near word boundaries; examples include “képesek” and “megtenni”.

patterns.name: Romanian forms of address to members and intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Romanian parliamentary forms of address; activation covers fragments of polite address, plurals, or case endings.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in French policy vocabulary
patterns.context: In a French policy discussion, activation is distributed within long words; the sentence concerns the committee, budget control, and a specific proposal.

1_3010.description: 激活横跨多种语言的议会文本和C++代码：法语礼貌致辞及政策词内片段、匈牙利语和罗马尼亚语片段，以及C++模板、类型和运算符语法。共同规律不够确定。

patterns.name: 法语议会致辞中的礼貌表达
patterns.context: 法语议会发言中，称呼议员或祝贺当选；激活散布在短语各处，并非只对应一个连续词。

patterns.name: C++ 模板与类型语法
patterns.context: C++ 源码中出现模板参数包、类型声明、引用及运算符重载等语法结构。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内片段
patterns.context: 匈牙利语连续文本中，激活落在词内部或词边界附近；例中包括“képesek”“megtenni”等。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语议员称呼及词内片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语议会称呼语，激活覆盖礼貌称呼、复数或格词尾等片段。

patterns.name: 法语政策词汇中的内部片段
patterns.context: 法语政策讨论句中，激活分布于长词内部；句子谈及委员会、预算控制及具体提案。

en.concept: Mixed pattern of code and parliamentary text
en.description: Activation centers on two contexts: C++ templates, types, and iterator declarations; and intra-word fragments in French or Romanian parliamentary text from EuroParl. The latter span languages and diverse fragments, with no stable shared meaning or word form apparent.

patterns.name: C++ templates and type declarations
patterns.context: Occurs in C++ code declarations, often alongside template parameters, type names, operator overloads, or typedefs

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in French parliamentary speech
patterns.context: Embedded within French words, occurring in continuous speeches about forms of address to members, parliamentary procedure, or policy

patterns.name: Fragments in Romanian parliamentary speech
patterns.context: Embedded in Romanian parliamentary forms of address and references to committees

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Romanian narration
patterns.context: Embedded in Romanian narratives about occupation and its historical effects

1_3010.concept: 代码与议会文本的混合模式
1_3010.description: 激活集中于两类语境：C++ 模板、类型与迭代器等声明；以及 EuroParl 中法语或罗马尼亚语议会文本的词内片段。后者跨语言且片段多样，未见稳定共享的词义或词形。

patterns.name: C++ 模板与类型声明
patterns.context: 出现在 C++ 代码声明中，常伴随模板参数、类型名、运算符重载或 typedef

patterns.name: 法语议会发言的词内片段
patterns.context: 嵌在法语单词内部，出现在议员称呼、议会程序或政策讨论的连续发言中

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语议会发言片段
patterns.context: 嵌在罗马尼亚语议会称呼和委员会相关表述中
patterns.domain: EuroParl / 罗马尼亚语议会演讲

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语叙述词内片段
patterns.context: 嵌在关于占领及其历史影响的罗马尼亚语叙述中
patterns.domain: EuroParl / 罗马尼亚语政治叙述

en.concept: Local patterns in formal discourse and code structures
en.description: Activation occurs in C++ template and declaration syntax, as well as in formal French and Romanian parliamentary discourse and a French Q&A about expression. Cross-language fragments within words and function words cannot be reduced to a single clear trigger.

patterns.name: C++ templates and type declarations
patterns.context: C++ code contains template parameter packs, type names, member functions, or operator declarations; activation is distributed across punctuation, identifier fragments, and nearby template syntax.

patterns.name: Formulaic expressions in French parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: French parliamentary speeches or formal debate text, including addresses, congratulations, and statements of committee requests; triggers fall on internal word fragments and common function words.

patterns.name: Explanatory questions and quotations in French
patterns.context: Explanatory text discussing French expressions or accents, with suggested phrasing and example questions.

patterns.name: Romanian parliamentary speeches and government statements
patterns.context: Romanian parliamentary speeches or formal statements, including addressing the President and members, thanking them for the opportunity to speak, expressing support, or introducing policy issues. Activation often falls on segmented fragments within words.

patterns.name: Specific triggers that could not be grouped
patterns.context: These activations may come respectively from code declaration details or fragments within French words; the available context is insufficient to determine stable conditions distinct from the patterns above.

1_3010.concept: 正式语篇与代码结构中的局部模式
1_3010.description: 激活见于C++模板与声明语法，也见于法语、罗马尼亚语正式议会语篇及一段法语表达问答；跨语言的词内片段和功能词无法归结为单一明确触发。

patterns.name: C++模板与类型声明
patterns.context: C++代码中出现模板参数包、类型名、成员函数或运算符声明；激活分布在标点、标识符片段和模板语法附近。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 C++ 代码

patterns.name: 法语议会发言套语
patterns.trigger: «Mes»dames et Messieurs les Députés、«je» voudrais、«féliciter»，以及 «il» y «a»
patterns.context: 法语议会演讲或正式辩论文本；包括致辞、祝贺、陈述委员会请求等表达，触发落在词语内部片段及常见功能词上。

patterns.name: 法语说明性问句与引用
patterns.context: 讨论法语表达方式或重音的说明文字，以建议措辞并举例问句为语境。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语议会发言与政务陈述
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语议会发言或正式陈述，包括称呼主席与议员、感谢发言机会、表达支持或介绍政策议题。激活常落在词内切分片段。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语议会记录

patterns.name: 未能归并的具体触发
patterns.trigger: C++ 中的 «const» «&» «from»，以及法语议会段落中 «long»«tem»ps、«bud»gétaire 等局部片段
patterns.context: 这些激活可能分别来自代码声明细节或法语词内片段；现有上下文不足以确定独立于上述模式的稳定条件。
patterns.domain: Github C++ 与 EuroParl 法语

en.description: Activation spans two clearly distinct sets of material: C++ template/type declarations and French text. The French examples often contain formal parliamentary first-person expressions, and also include language Q&A; activation falls on words, subwords, and code syntax symbols, with no single stable trigger rule apparent.

patterns.name: C++ template parameter packs and declaration symbols
patterns.context: Near parameter packs, references, and operator declarations in C++ declarations or template code; activation often falls on syntax tokens or subwords of identifiers.

patterns.name: C++ typedefs and type metaprogramming
patterns.context: In nested type aliases, iterator traits, template specializations, or Boost type computation code.

patterns.name: First-person expressions in French parliamentary speech
patterns.context: In formal parliamentary speech, the speaker uses the first person to express a wish, request, or position; activation is distributed across French words and their subwords.

patterns.name: Subword activations within French words
patterns.context: In French text, activation may fall on subwords within a word; besides parliamentary speech, it also appears in language Q&A discussing French accent usage.
patterns.domain: French parliamentary records and StackExchange language Q&A

patterns.name: French expression fragments with no obvious shared theme
patterns.context: A language Q&A discussing how to express an issue related to accent; distinct in topic from parliamentary speech and C++ code.

1_3010.description: 激活跨 C++ 模板/类型声明与法语文本两组明显不同的材料。法语中常见正式议会第一人称表达，也见语言问答；激活落在词、子词及代码语法符号上，未见单一稳定触发规则。

patterns.name: C++ 模板参数包与声明符号
patterns.context: C++ 声明或模板代码中，尤其是模板参数包、引用和运算符声明附近；激活常落在语法 token 或标识符的子词上。

patterns.name: C++ typedef 与类型元编程
patterns.context: 嵌套类型别名、迭代器 traits、模板特化或 Boost 类型计算代码中。

patterns.name: 法语议会发言中的第一人称表达
patterns.context: 正式议会发言中，发言者以第一人称表达意愿、请求或立场；激活分布在法语词语及其子词上。

patterns.name: 法语词语内部的子词激活
patterns.context: 法语文本中，激活可落在词的内部子词；除议会发言外，也见于讨论法语重音用法的语言问答。
patterns.domain: 法语议会记录与 StackExchange 语言问答

patterns.name: 无明显共享主题的法语表达片段
patterns.context: 讨论如何表达口音问题的语言问答；与议会发言及 C++ 代码主题不同。

en.description: Activation is distributed across two clearly heterogeneous contexts: template, type, and punctuation syntax in code, and fragments within French words or at their endings; Java stack-trace ellipses also activate. No unified semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Template and type syntax in code
patterns.context: Around type parameters, references, member function declarations, and punctuation in C++ declarations or template code; generic brackets also appear in JavaScript/React.

patterns.name: Fragments and endings within French words
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within French words or at their endings, often involving inflectional forms and intra-word segmentation; there is no unified meaning or syntactic position.
patterns.domain: French Q&A and European Parliament speeches

patterns.name: Ellipsis marker in a Java stack trace
patterns.context: At the end of an exception stack trace, an ellipsis summarizes omitted call frames, followed by “9 more”.

1_3010.concept: 文本片段与代码语法触发
1_3010.description: 激活分布于两类明显异质的上下文：代码中的模板、类型及标点语法，以及法语词的内部片段或词尾；另对 Java 堆栈省略号激活。未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 代码中的模板与类型语法
patterns.context: C++ 声明或模板代码中，围绕类型参数、引用、成员函数声明和标点符号；另见 JavaScript/React 中的泛型括号。

patterns.name: 法语词内片段与词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在法语词的内部片段或词尾，常见于词形变化、词内切分；不是统一的词义或句法位置。
patterns.domain: 法语问答与欧洲议会发言
