patterns.name: Java 堆栈中的省略标记
patterns.context: 异常堆栈末尾以省略号概括未展示的调用帧，后接“9 more”。

en.description: Activation occurs in two types of corpus: in C++, it favors template angle brackets and parameter packs, with a few left square brackets; in French text, it falls on various words or intra-word fragments, including parliamentary politeness and language Q&A. There is no clear shared trigger form across corpora.

patterns.name: C++ template parameter packs and angle brackets
patterns.context: In C++ template declarations or instantiations, activation centers on parameter-pack ellipses, identifier fragments, and closing angle brackets; not all template syntax activates equally.

patterns.name: Word fragments in French polite expressions
patterns.context: In French parliamentary speech, activation mainly falls on polite forms of address, congratulatory expressions, or word-internal segmented fragments; the specific vocabulary differs between examples.

patterns.name: French inflectional and grammatical fragments
patterns.context: In French language discussions, activation falls on articles, verb forms, and substrings within words; the segment discusses interrogative intonation and accent.

patterns.name: C++ square brackets
patterns.context: In the array member declaration `float min[]; float max[];`, the left square bracket activates; no other brackets with the same marker appear in this example.

1_3010.description: 激活分布在两类语料：C++ 中偏向模板尖括号、参数包及少量数组左方括号；法语文本中落在若干词语或词内片段，涵盖议会礼貌表达和语言问答。跨语料没有明显共享的具体触发形式。

patterns.name: C++ 模板参数包与尖括号
patterns.context: C++ 模板声明或实例化中，激活集中在参数包省略号、标识符片段及闭合尖括号附近；并非每处模板语法都同样激活。

patterns.name: 法语礼貌表达中的词语片段
patterns.trigger: « je»、« félic»iter»、« Mes»dames、« élus»，以及 « naturel» 的词内片段
patterns.context: 法语议会发言中，主要落在礼貌称呼、祝贺用语或词语内部的分词片段；不同段具体词汇并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 法语词形与语法片段
patterns.trigger: « un»« ton»、« interrog»atif、« ser»ait、« nature»l、« te»« pose»；另见 « ne»、« faisons»
patterns.context: 法语语言讨论中，激活落在冠词、动词词形及词内子串；该段讨论疑问语调和重音。

patterns.name: C++ 方括号
patterns.context: 数组成员声明 `float min[]; float max[];` 中，激活的是左方括号；本例未见相同标记的其他括号。

en.concept: Code template structures and multilingual word fragments
en.description: Most samples are C++ template code, where activation often falls on template parameters, type metaprogramming, underscore-compound identifiers, and declaration punctuation. There are also activations on fragments within words in French and Romanian parliamentary text, which are difficult to explain together with the code patterns.

patterns.name: C++ template parameter declarations
patterns.context: Template declarations contain type parameters, parameter packs, or template closing symbols; often adjacent to class, struct, function, or type aliases.

patterns.name: C++ references and assignment operators
patterns.context: Class member-function or special-member-function declarations, especially copy/move assignment operators and reference return types.

patterns.name: C++ template specialization and type metaprogramming
patterns.context: Template specialization, nested type deduction, or Boost-style compile-time type computation.

patterns.name: Underscores and compound identifiers in C++ type names
patterns.context: Templates or type aliases with underscored identifiers, commonly implementation-detail names.

patterns.name: C++ declaration and punctuation boundaries
patterns.context: End or separator positions in declarations, function bodies, or template lists; activation falls near punctuation and is not necessarily specific to a semantic structure.

patterns.name: Fragments within French word forms
patterns.context: In continuous French parliamentary speech, activation is distributed across fragments within words and common short words; no obvious local syntactic condition shared with C++ patterns is apparent.

patterns.name: Fragments within Romanian word forms
patterns.context: In Romanian parliamentary speeches, activation occurs in forms of address, affixes, or fragments within words.

1_3010.concept: 代码模板结构与多语词片段
1_3010.description: 多数样本是 C++ 模板代码，激活常落在模板参数、类型元编程、下划线复合标识符及声明标点；另有法语、罗马尼亚语议会文本中的词内片段激活，难与代码模式统一解释。

patterns.name: C++ 模板参数声明
patterns.context: 模板声明中出现类型参数、参数包或模板闭合符；常与 class、struct、函数或类型别名相邻。

patterns.name: C++ 引用与赋值运算符
patterns.context: 类成员函数或特殊成员函数声明，尤其是复制/移动赋值运算符及引用返回类型。

patterns.name: C++ 模板特化及类型元编程
patterns.context: 模板特化、嵌套类型推导或 Boost 风格的编译期类型计算。

patterns.name: C++ 类型名中的下划线与复合标识符
patterns.context: 标识符含下划线的模板或类型别名，常见于实现细节名称。

patterns.name: C++ 声明及标点边界
patterns.context: 声明、函数体或模板列表的结束/分隔位置；激活落在标点附近，未必专属于某一语义结构。

patterns.name: 法语词形内部片段
patterns.context: 法语议会发言的连续文本中，激活分布在词内片段及常用短词；没有明显与 C++ 模式相同的局部语法条件。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词形内部片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语议会发言中，激活出现在称呼、词缀或词内片段。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语议会记录

en.description: Primarily responds to C++ template declarations, parameter packs, and type metaprogramming syntax; there are also sporadic responses to forms of address, statements, and political or religious arguments in French parliamentary speech.

patterns.name: C++ template parameter packs
patterns.context: The trigger is a parameter pack in a template declaration, especially an ellipsis adjacent to a type parameter or Args; class names or function declarations often appear nearby.

patterns.name: C++ template declarations and type names
patterns.context: Occurs in templates, type aliases, nested types, or class declarations; activation spans multiple C++ syntax positions, not only parameter packs.

patterns.name: Template metaprogramming and type transformations
patterns.context: Type aliases depend on nested types or Boost.MPL metaprogramming structures.

patterns.name: Operator overload declarations
patterns.context: Copy or move assignment operators are declared in a class interface.

patterns.name: Type aliases and callback types
patterns.context: A typedef names an instantiated template type as a callback type.

patterns.name: Static member template instantiation
patterns.context: Definitions of static members of a template class and instantiations of their specific types.

patterns.name: French parliamentary statements and polite expressions
patterns.context: In parliamentary speech, addressing members, explaining an issue, or making a statement; activation falls within and around French words.

patterns.name: Discussion of religious and political power
patterns.context: In the context of an amendment, religious power is explicitly distinguished from political power.

1_3010.description: 主要响应 C++ 模板声明、参数包及类型元编程语法；另对法语议会发言中的称谓、陈述和政治宗教论述有零散响应。

patterns.name: C++ 模板参数包
patterns.context: 触发点是模板声明中的参数包，尤其是省略号与类型参数、Args 相邻；周围常有类名或函数声明。

patterns.name: C++ 模板声明与类型名
patterns.context: 出现在模板、类型别名、嵌套类型或类声明中；激活分布于多个 C++ 语法位置，不限于参数包。

patterns.name: 模板元编程与类型变换
patterns.context: 类型别名依赖嵌套类型或 Boost.MPL 元编程结构。
patterns.domain: Github C++ 模板元编程代码

patterns.name: 运算符重载声明
patterns.context: 类接口中声明拷贝或移动赋值运算符。

patterns.name: 类型别名与回调类型
patterns.context: 用 typedef 将模板实例化类型命名为回调类型。

patterns.name: 静态成员模板实例化
patterns.context: 模板类的静态成员定义及其具体类型实例化。

patterns.name: 法语议会陈述与礼貌表达
patterns.trigger: au Parlement、C'est ce que nous faisons aujourd'hui、Monsieur le Président、Mesdames et Messieurs les Députés、je voudrais
patterns.context: 议会发言中向议员致意、说明议题或提出陈述；激活落在法语词语内部及其周边。

patterns.name: 宗教与政治权力的论述
patterns.trigger: l'Église protestante、pouvoir religieux、pouvoir politique、Il doit être dit clairement
patterns.context: 修正案语境下明确区分宗教权力与政治权力。

en.description: Activation covers type markers in C++ template and type declarations, as well as various word fragments and function words in French and Romanian parliamentary texts and French-language discussions; it spans languages and domains, with no single clear triggering semantics.

patterns.name: C++ templates and type declarations
patterns.context: Occurs in C++ template parameters, type aliases, or class declarations; activation often falls on type names and adjacent symbols.

patterns.name: Function words and fragments within words in French parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: Embedded in French sentences, especially parliamentary statements or debates; activation is scattered across pronouns, negation structures, verb fragments, and internal parts of ordinary words, and does not always fall on complete words.

patterns.name: Romanian parliamentary forms of address and word-form fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in formal forms of address to the Speaker and members; activation covers multiple subword fragments within terms of address.

patterns.name: Discussions of French pronunciation and spelling
patterns.context: Examples discuss question intonation, accents, and natural phrasing; activation falls on the words used in the discussion and their fragments.

1_3010.description: 激活涵盖 C++ 模板与类型声明中的类型标记，以及法语、罗马尼亚语议会文本和法语语言讨论中的多种词片段与功能词；跨语言、跨领域，未见单一明确触发语义。

patterns.name: C++ 模板与类型声明
patterns.context: 出现在 C++ 代码的模板参数、类型别名或类声明中；激活常落在类型名及其相邻符号上。

patterns.name: 法语议会发言中的功能词和词内片段
patterns.trigger: «je»、«Il»、«ne»、«ont»、«faire» 的片段 «fa»、以及 «jour»、«merc» 等词内片段
patterns.context: 嵌在法语句子中，尤其是议会陈述或辩论；激活散布于代词、否定结构、动词片段及普通词内部，并不总落在完整词上。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语议会称谓及词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在对议长和议员的正式称呼中；激活覆盖称谓词内部的多个子词片段。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语议会记录

patterns.name: 法语发音与拼写讨论
patterns.context: 围绕疑问语调、口音及措辞自然度举例，激活落在讨论用的词语及其片段上。

en.description: Most segments activate the substring «eper» within English words, including deeper, steeper, sweeper, sleeper, and beeper; two other segments activate Devanagari characters or adjacent boundaries, appearing respectively in an honorific in Hindi and a sequence of month names.

patterns.name: -eper fragments within words or at morphological boundaries
patterns.context: Primarily in English words, activation is concentrated on the substring eper; it can occur in comparative endings such as deeper and steeper, as well as in different word forms such as sweeper, sleeper, and beeper.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English text, including encyclopedias, blogs, philosophy, law, and academic papers; [2] is non-English script date text that cannot be explained by this English substring pattern

patterns.name: Sanskrit letters and word-segmentation boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on Devanagari characters or their surrounding space markers; in [1], it occurs in a Hindi honorific at the end of a temple entry, and in [2], in an underscore-separated sequence of Hindi month names.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia text interspersed with Hindi; Hindi date/month strings on GitHub

1_3058.description: 多数段在英文单词内激活子串«eper»，涵盖 deeper、steeper、sweeper、sleeper、beeper 等；另两段激活天城文字符或相邻边界，分别出现在印地语敬称和月份序列中。

patterns.name: 词内或形态边界上的 -eper 片段
patterns.context: 主要在英文单词中，激活集中于 eper 子串；可出现在比较级词尾 deeper、steeper，也出现在 sweeper、sleeper、beeper 等不同词形中。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文文本，包括百科、博客、哲学、法律和学术论文；[2]为非英语脚本日期文本，无法由该英文子串模式解释

patterns.name: 梵文字母及分词边界
patterns.context: 激活落在天城文字符或其周围的空标记上；[1]中位于寺庙条目末尾的印地语敬称，[2]中组成按下划线分隔的印地语月份序列。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 印地语夹杂文本、GitHub 上的印地语日期/月份字符串

en.description: Primarily activates on within-word substrings containing eper, including sweeper, sleeper, deeper, beeper, and steeper; also responds to Devanagari characters and gullies-related fragments.

patterns.name: eper substring
patterns.context: Tokens containing the continuous letter substring eper are segmented, with activation concentrated on that substring; word meaning and syntactic position are not fixed.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including encyclopedias, personal blogs, philosophy, law, and astronomy

patterns.name: Devanagari markers
patterns.context: Activates in text containing Devanagari writing or characters; [1] mixes English and Devanagari, while [2] is a Devanagari date sequence.

patterns.name: Gullies-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears in passages describing gully clearance or glacial landforms, but is not the only activation pattern within those passages.

1_3058.description: 主要激活于含 eper 的词内子串，涵盖 sweeper、sleeper、deeper、beeper、steeper；另对天城文字符及 gullies 相关片段有响应。

patterns.name: eper 子串
patterns.context: 含有连续字母子串 eper 的 token 被拆分标记，激活集中在该子串；词义和句法位置不固定
patterns.domain: 百科、个人博客、哲学、法律、天文学等多种文体

patterns.name: 天城文标记
patterns.context: 在夹有天城文文字或字符的文本处激活；[1]为英文与天城文混排，[2]为天城文日期序列

patterns.name: gullies 相关词汇
patterns.context: 在描述清理沟槽或冰川地貌的段落中出现，但并非段内唯一激活模式

en.description: Strongly responds primarily to the eper substring within English words (steeper, deeper, sweeper, sleeper, beeper), across fields and with varied meanings; the mix of Indian place names and Devanagari in paragraph 1, and the Devanagari date in paragraph 2, show no clear corresponding pattern.

patterns.name: Comparative suffix in words ending in *-eper
patterns.context: Activation falls on the string eper; the preceding text forms steeper, deeper, sweeper, sleeper, and beeper, respectively. The sentences, meanings, and capitalization vary widely, and the activation position is not tied to a specific field.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English text: encyclopedias, blogs, philosophy, law, astronomy, etc.

1_3058.concept: 英语中的 eper 子串
1_3058.description: 主要对英语词中 eper 子串（steeper、deeper、sweeper、sleeper、beeper）强烈响应，跨领域且语义各异；第1段印度地名与天城文混排、第2段天城文日期未见清楚对应模式。

patterns.name: 以 *-eper 结尾的比较级词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在字符串 eper 上；前文分别构成 steeper、deeper、sweeper、sleeper、beeper。词语所在句子、语义和大小写差异很大，触发位置不依赖某个固定领域。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语文本：百科、博客、哲学、法律、天文学等

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the -eper substring in English spelling, commonly in sweeper, sleeper, deeper, and steeper; it also responds to Devanagari characters and their segmented fragments.

patterns.name: English word-final -eper
patterns.context: The triggering substring occurs in the -eper spelling fragment at the end of or within English words; it sometimes crosses subword boundaries.
patterns.domain: Across encyclopedia, blog, legal, philosophy, and scientific texts

patterns.name: Sanskrit/Hindi Devanagari fragments
patterns.context: Devanagari characters and letter/diacritic combinations split by the tokenizer; [1] immediately follows the end of an English sentence, and [2] is continuous date text.
patterns.domain: Multilingual Wikipedia text and code repository content

1_3058.description: 主要对英语拼写中的 -eper 子串强烈响应，常见于 sweeper、sleeper、deeper、steeper；另对天城文字符及其拆分片段有响应。

patterns.name: 英语词尾 -eper
patterns.context: 触发子串出现在英语单词词尾或词内的 -eper 拼写片段；有时跨子词边界。
patterns.domain: 跨百科、博客、法律、哲学与科学文本

patterns.name: 梵文/印地语天城文片段
patterns.context: 天城文字符及其被分词器拆开的字母、附标组合；[1]紧接英文句子末尾，[2]是连续的日期文本。
patterns.domain: 多语种维基文本与代码仓库内容

en.description: The most stable pattern is the English-internal fragment «eper», occurring in different words such as sweeper, sleeper, deeper, beeper, and steeper; there are also activations on two passages of Devanagari characters and secondary activations on some sentence-initial periods.

patterns.name: per/eper subword fragment
patterns.context: The trigger is usually the eper/eper character fragment inside an English word; it can occur at the end of a word, in compounds, or in participles, with wide variation in prefixes and meanings.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English text, including encyclopedias, blogs, law, philosophy, and papers; also one Devanagari passage, whose relation to this pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Devanagari character activation
patterns.context: Occurs near a temple name in Devanagari transliteration, and in date text arranged by month; character-level annotations are fragmented, so the precise trigger cannot be confirmed from the samples.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia place-name/religion entries and GitHub date or calendar text.

patterns.name: Preceding delimiter punctuation
patterns.context: Periods at the beginning of sentences or paragraphs also show moderate activation, but not every period is marked, and they are not the strongest shared trigger.

1_3058.description: 最稳定模式是英语内部片段 «eper»，落在 sweeper、sleeper、deeper、beeper、steeper 等不同词中；另有两段天城文字符激活及若干句首句点的次级激活。

patterns.name: per/eper 子词片段
patterns.context: 触发位置多为英语单词内部的 eper/eper 字符片段；可出现在词尾、复合词或分词中，前缀与词义差异很大。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语文本，包括百科、博客、法律、哲学和论文；另有一段天城文文本，无法确定与此模式的关系。

patterns.name: 天城文字符激活
patterns.context: 出现于寺庙名称附近的天城文转写，以及按月份排列的日期文本；字符级标注较碎，无法从样本确认精确触发片段。
patterns.domain: 百科地名/宗教条目及 GitHub 日期或日历文本。

patterns.name: 前置分隔标点
patterns.context: 句首或段落起始位置的句点也有中等激活，但并非每处句点都标记，且不是最强共同触发。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on the string fragment “eper” and its surrounding letters, commonly in sleeper, sweeper, deeper, and beeper; it also occurs in non-English character fragments containing similar substrings. The segments' contexts vary widely in topic.

patterns.name: Words containing sleeper
patterns.context: The triggering token occurs at the end of or within English words, especially words containing sleeper/sweeper/deeper/beeper; in [4] it also occurs in non-English character fragments
patterns.domain: English encyclopedia, reviews, legal texts, and web text; also Hindi character sequences on Github

1_3058.description: 激活集中在字符串片段“eper”及其周边字母，常见于 sleeper、sweeper、deeper、beeper；也会出现在含类似子串的非英语字符碎片。各段上下文主题差异很大。

patterns.name: 含 sleeper 的词
patterns.context: 触发 token 出现在英文单词末尾或内部，尤其是带有 sleeper/sweeper/deeper/beeper 字样的词；在 [4] 中还出现于非英语字符碎片
patterns.domain: 英文百科、评论、法律文本及网页文本；另有 Github 上的印地语字符序列

en.description: Primarily responds to the -eper string across morpheme boundaries, including steeper, deeper, sleeper, and beeper; it also activates on the word form gullies and temple-related segmented fragments, with one Devanagari fragment activation.

patterns.name: Word-final -eper (comparative/derived forms)
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-final substring -eper split across morpheme boundaries, involving greater depth/steepness, sleep products, or occupational nouns; the preceding stems and meanings vary.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, religious texts, product reviews, social policy, philosophy, astronomy, law, etc.

patterns.name: Word forms related to gullies
patterns.context: Occurs in entries or geomorphology studies introducing gullies and ditch clearing; activation is distributed across multiple in-word subword fragments.

patterns.name: Transliterated fragments in Indian temple names
patterns.context: Indian religious site names and temple descriptions; markers fall on segmented fragments of Temple and deity names.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, Indian religion and local descriptions

patterns.name: Opaque Hindi/Sanskrit text fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in a mixed Latin-script and Devanagari string at the end of a paragraph; the specific meaning and triggering boundary are unclear.

1_3058.description: 主要响应跨词素切分后的 -eper 字符串，涵盖 steeper、deeper、sleeper、beeper；另对 gullies 词形及寺庙相关拆分片段有激活，且有一处天城文碎片激活。

patterns.name: 词尾 -eper（比较级/派生形式）
patterns.context: 激活落在跨词素边界拆分出的词尾子串 -eper 上，涉及更深/更陡、睡眠用品或职业名词；前面的词干和含义各异。
patterns.domain: 百科、宗教文字、商品评论、社会政策、哲学、天文学、法律等

patterns.name: gullies 相关词形
patterns.context: 出现在介绍 gullies（沟壑、排水沟）及清理沟渠的词条或地貌研究中；激活分布在词内多个子词片段。

patterns.name: 印度寺庙名称中的音译碎片
patterns.context: 印度宗教场所名称与寺庙介绍；标记落在 Temple 的拆分片段及神祇名称片段。
patterns.domain: 百科条目，印度宗教与地方介绍

patterns.name: 不透明的印地语/梵文文字碎片
patterns.context: 出现在段落末尾一处混合拉丁字母与天城文的字符串中，具体词义及触发边界不明。
patterns.domain: 百科文本，含印地语/天城文内容

en.description: The most stable pattern is several (sometimes unmarked) introducing multiple countable objects; there is also local word-final activation in the proper name Sleeper and the occupation term sweeper. Segments 2 and 5 have no clear corresponding trigger and cannot be reliably classified.

patterns.name: Plural objects following several
patterns.context: When describing multiple countable people, things, problems, or time units, several introduces a following plural noun or noun phrase; the target activation falls on several.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain narratives, paper abstracts, patent backgrounds, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Sleeper in proper names or compounds
patterns.context: The band name Oh, Sleeper appears in sentences about tours/performances; activation is concentrated on the final word of the proper name.

patterns.name: Suffix -er in occupational/tool names
patterns.context: When listing people or machines that clean ditches or streets, word-final -sweeper refers to a tool or occupation performing the sweeping action; activation falls on the final part.

1_3058.description: 最稳定模式是 several（有时未标记）引出多个可数对象；另有 Sleeper 专名和 sweeper 职业名中的词尾局部激活。第2、5段无明确对应触发，不能可靠归类。

patterns.name: several 后接复数对象
patterns.trigger: «several»10，后接« friends»4、« known»8 links、« yeast»…« screens»1、« problems»1、« decades»2、« smaller»…（以及第2段“several”未标记）
patterns.context: 在描述多个可数人、事物、问题或时间单位时，several 引出后续复数名词或名词短语；目标激活落在 several 上。
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、论文摘要、专利背景和百科条目

patterns.name: 专名或复合词中的 Sleeper
patterns.context: 乐队名称 Oh, Sleeper 出现在巡演/演出相关句子中；激活集中在专名的末词。

patterns.name: 职业/工具名称的后缀 er
patterns.context: 在列举清洁沟渠或街道的人或机器时，词尾 -sweeper 指执行清扫动作的工具或职业；激活落在词尾部分。

en.concept: Specific word forms in academic texts
en.description: Primarily responds to “several” and the “alkaloid(s)” stem in natural-products literature; there are also a few sporadic word-fragment activations. The former means “a number of” across academic fields, while the latter is concentrated in biomedical and chemical contexts.

patterns.name: The word “several”
patterns.context: Often used to mean “a number of/several types” in academic sentences summarizing research, species, diseases, prevention studies, or experiments; no narrower fixed collocation is apparent.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, research proposals, and social psychology papers

patterns.name: The “alkaloid(s)” stem
patterns.context: When discussing secretions, pharmacologically active compounds, or plant-based medicinal compounds; the trigger position falls on the beginning of the stem across plural and singular forms.

patterns.name: Sporadic word activations
patterns.context: Appear sporadically, with no shared context or stable semantic relation; some may be split word fragments.

1_3058.concept: 学术文本中的特定词形
1_3058.description: 主要响应“several”，以及天然产物文献中的“alkaloid(s)”词干；另有少量分散词片段激活。前者跨多个学术领域表示“若干”，后者集中于生物医学和化学语境。

patterns.name: “several”一词
patterns.context: 在概述研究、物种、疾病、预防研究或实验的学术句子中，常用于表示“若干/多种”；无明显更窄的固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、研究计划及社会心理学论文

patterns.name: “alkaloid(s)”词干
patterns.context: 涉及分泌物、药理活性成分或植物药成分时；触发位置落在词干开头，跨越复数和单数形式。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与天然产物化学文献

patterns.name: 零散词语激活
patterns.context: 分散出现，未见共同上下文或稳定语义关系；部分可能是被拆分的词片段。

en.description: Activation commonly occurs on “under” followed by conditions, models, or clauses; it also appears across statistical research phrasing, name fragments, medical diagnoses, license headers, imaging, condensed-matter physics, and materials chemistry terminology, spanning a wide range of fields.

patterns.name: “under” and its following context
patterns.context: “under” appears as a preposition, a compound prefix, or license wording; it is followed by content such as models, conditions, illumination, mathematical mappings, or license clauses.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain, especially academic papers and technical documents

patterns.name: Statistical research phrasing
patterns.context: Researchers describe conducting experiments, inferential problems in research, or mathematical objects.

patterns.name: Names and name fragments
patterns.context: A person's full name appears or forms part of a compound proper name; activation falls on several subword fragments of the name.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries and condensed-matter physics papers

patterns.name: Medical terminology and diagnostic methods
patterns.context: Describes urine cytology as a method for diagnosing acute problems with kidney transplants.

patterns.name: License header format
patterns.context: Software license statements and contributor clauses in newline-separated comments.

patterns.name: Microscopic imaging and transparent samples
patterns.context: Introduces optical microscopy and the transparency of biological samples under visible light.

patterns.name: Spin-orbit and materials phase-transition terminology
patterns.context: Discusses the effects of material parameters, symmetry, and spin-orbit interactions on transitions.

patterns.name: Mitochondrial granules and experimental conditions
patterns.context: Mentions studies of mitochondrial granules and molecular probes under equilibrium and time-resolved conditions; the initial “rial” is a truncated word fragment.

patterns.name: Material properties and crystal polymorphs
patterns.context: Describes the thermal properties and phase transition of a cubic polymorph of a magnesium borohydride.

1_3058.description: 激活常见于“under”及其后接条件、模型或条款，也散见统计研究措辞、姓名片段、医学诊断、许可标头、成像、凝聚态物理和材料化学术语，领域跨度很大。

patterns.name: “under”及其后续语境
patterns.trigger: «under»；[1]“under the model”，[3]“under misspecification”，[4]“underused”，[5]“under”$h$，[6]“under one or more”，[7]“under visible light”，[9]“under equilibrium”
patterns.context: “under”作为介词、复合词前缀或许可证措辞出现；后接模型、条件、光照、数学映射或许可条款等内容。
patterns.domain: 跨领域，尤见学术论文与技术文档

patterns.name: 统计研究措辞
patterns.context: 研究者描述开展实验、研究推断问题或考虑数学对象时。

patterns.name: 姓名与姓名片段
patterns.context: 人名完整出现或作为复合专名的一部分；激活落在姓名的若干子词片段上。
patterns.domain: 百科条目与凝聚态物理论文

patterns.name: 医学术语与诊断方法
patterns.context: 描述尿液细胞学作为诊断肾移植物急性问题的方法。

patterns.name: 许可证标头格式
patterns.context: 换行注释中的软件许可证声明及贡献者条款。

patterns.name: 显微成像与透明样本
patterns.trigger: «Opt»«ical» «microscopy»、“«a» commonly used method”、“quite transparent under visible light”
patterns.context: 介绍光学显微镜及生物样本在可见光下的透明性。

patterns.name: 自旋轨道与材料相变术语
patterns.context: 讨论材料参数、对称性及自旋轨道相互作用对转变的影响。

patterns.name: 线粒体颗粒与实验条件
patterns.context: 提及线粒体颗粒及分子探针在平衡和时间分辨条件下的研究；开头的“rial”是截断词片段。

patterns.name: 材料性质与晶体多形
patterns.context: 描述一种镁硼氢化物立方多形的热学性质和相变。

en.description: Activation primarily falls on under in paper contexts, where it often introduces a condition, environment, or scope; it also appears after an abstract opening, in hydrostatic-pressure conditions, and in the fixed term area under the curve. Segment 7 has no clear under trigger.

patterns.name: under after an abstract marker
patterns.context: At the start of an abstract, the immediately following under is marked with strong activation; different segments have under followed by misspecification, local laser intensity, shared-memory architecture, or a magnetic field.

patterns.name: under conditions or scope
patterns.context: under introduces a condition, intervention, or scope, followed by a specific context; examples include under very general conditions, under arbitrary interventions, and under the action of transformations such as de Sitter.
patterns.domain: Scientific paper bodies or abstracts, covering statistics, physics, and causal inference

patterns.name: under the curve
patterns.context: In the fixed term area under the curve, under and curve form the name of an evaluation metric.

patterns.name: under hydrostatic pressure
patterns.context: Describes the stability or phase behavior of materials under hydrostatic pressure.

patterns.name: under + conditional noun phrase
patterns.context: under introduces an external-field condition in a physical experiment or model.

patterns.name: Continuation after under in paper statements
patterns.context: Activation occurs on under in academic statements; the following content is not necessarily a common fixed collocation; all examples express a condition, environment, or scope.

1_3058.description: 激活主要落在论文语境中的 under：它常引出条件、环境或适用范围；也见于摘要开头后的 under、静水压力条件和固定术语 area under the curve。第7段未见明确 under 触发。

patterns.name: 摘要标记后的 under
patterns.context: 摘要起始处，紧接其后的 under 被标记为强激活；不同片段中 under 后接 misspecification、局部激光强度、共享内存架构或磁场等内容。

patterns.name: under 条件或作用域
patterns.context: under 引出某个条件、干预或作用域，后接具体情境；包括在非常一般的条件下、任意干预下，以及在 de Sitter 等变换作用下。
patterns.domain: 科学论文正文或摘要，涵盖统计、物理与因果推断

patterns.name: under the curve
patterns.context: 固定术语 area under the curve 中，under 与 curve 组成评价指标名称。
patterns.domain: 生物医学/分类器性能评估

patterns.name: under hydrostatic pressure
patterns.context: 描述材料在静水压力条件下的稳定性或相行为。

patterns.name: under + 条件性名词短语
patterns.context: under 引出物理实验或模型的外场条件。

patterns.name: 论文陈述中的 under 后延续
patterns.context: 激活发生在学术陈述中的 under，后续内容不一定是紧邻的常见固定搭配；各例均表达条件、环境或适用范围。

en.concept: Local formatting and phrasing in academic papers
en.description: Activations are scattered across academic papers: several instances of the abstract-style “We study” and the conditional introducer “under,” along with frequent citation text “et al.” Other passages concern agriculture, quantum dynamics, stellar observations, polarization, high-energy spectra, and black-hole gravitational entropy; no unified specialized terminology theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Statements of research topics and methods
patterns.context: Abstracts introduce research topics with “We study”; in the samples, this is followed by different topics such as Bayesian inference, spin correlations, or instability.

patterns.name: Use of under to state research conditions
patterns.context: “under misspecification,” “under a magnetic field,” and “under a local applied laser intensity”; introduces model assumptions or experimental conditions.
patterns.domain: Statistics, condensed matter physics, soft matter physics

patterns.name: Combination adjacent to gravity regime
patterns.context: The fragment begins with “gravity regime.”; preceding text is missing, making it difficult to determine a more specific trigger condition.

patterns.name: et al. in reference author names
patterns.context: Appears in parenthetical or square-bracket citations, often adjacent to a year or punctuation; also appears as the formatted “*et al.*”.

patterns.name: Sweet potato scientific name and crop description
patterns.context: The scientific name of a plant is followed by descriptions of crop importance, cultivation range, and yield; the beginning of the passage appears to truncate the scientific name.

patterns.name: Mechanics/quantum chemistry terminology combinations
patterns.context: Discusses fictitious derivative forces and that the order of projection and adiabatic transformation cannot safely be interchanged.

patterns.name: Stellar names and astronomer groups
patterns.context: Discusses stellar designations and aliases, describing how spectroscopists from different eras have studied them.

patterns.name: Polarization degree and literature citations
patterns.context: Reports polarization measurements and cites results using author names and journal references.

patterns.name: Descriptions of high-energy spectra of black-hole candidates
patterns.context: Caption- or introduction-like text describes broadband high-energy emission spectra of multiple Galactic black-hole candidates.

patterns.name: Definition of black-hole gravitational entropy
patterns.context: Discusses the definition of gravitational entropy in accelerating black-hole solutions, mentioning phenomenological methods and prior work.

1_3058.concept: 学术论文局部格式与措辞
1_3058.description: 激活分散于学术论文：多处出现摘要式“We study”与条件引导词“under”，并常见文献引注“et al.”；其余分别涉及农业、量子动力学、恒星观测、偏振、高能谱及黑洞引力熵，未见统一的专门术语主题。

patterns.name: 研究对象与方法陈述
patterns.context: 摘要中以“We study”引出研究主题；在样本中后接 Bayesian inference、spin correlations 或 instability 等不同主题。

patterns.name: under 的研究条件用法
patterns.context: “under misspecification”“under a magnetic field”“under a local applied laser intensity”；引出模型假设或实验条件。
patterns.domain: 统计、凝聚态物理、软物质物理

patterns.name: gravity regime 邻接组合
patterns.context: 片段开头为“gravity regime.”，前文缺失，难以确定更具体触发条件。
patterns.domain: 天体物理或引力研究文本

patterns.name: 参考文献作者名中的 et al.
patterns.context: 出现在括号或方括号引用中，常邻接年份或标点；也见作带格式标记的“*et al.*”。

patterns.name: 甘薯学名与作物描述
patterns.context: 植物学名后接作物重要性、种植范围及产量描述；该段开头疑似学名被截断。

patterns.name: 力学／量子化学术语搭配
patterns.context: 讨论导数力是假象，以及投影与绝热变换次序不可安全交换。

patterns.name: 恒星名称与天文学家群体
patterns.trigger: “star HD190073”及“classical as well as modern spectroscopists”
patterns.context: 以恒星编号和别名为对象，叙述其受到不同时代光谱学家的关注。

patterns.name: 偏振度与文献引用
patterns.context: 报告偏振度测量值，并以作者名和期刊文献标识引用结果。

patterns.name: 黑洞候选体的高能谱图描述
patterns.context: 图注或引言式文字说明多个银河系黑洞候选体的宽带高能辐射谱。

patterns.name: 黑洞引力熵定义
patterns.context: 讨论加速黑洞解中的引力熵定义，并提及现象学方法及前人工作。

en.description: Primarily responds to citation cues in academic papers: author names followed by “et al.”, often accompanied by a year, parentheses, or reference labels; it also responds to “see:” formats listing related literature. There is also an isolated high activation on “under misspecification” in a statistical abstract.

patterns.name: Author-year academic citations
patterns.context: Cites research in the body of an academic paper, especially author names followed by et al. and a year, reference number, or citation parentheses.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers from ArXiv and PubMed Central, involving astronomy, agriculture, medicine, protein research, etc.

patterns.name: Bibliography lists and directive-style citations
patterns.context: Lists multiple references around a topic such as related research or structures; formatting often includes italicized authors, years, and reference labels.
patterns.domain: Literature references or related-work descriptions in papers, covering fields such as chemistry.

patterns.name: under in a statistics context
patterns.context: Appears in an abstract describing the model-misspecification condition under which generalized Bayesian inference is considered; the high activation here is isolated, with no citation format shared with the other segments.

1_3058.description: 主要响应学术论文中的引文线索：作者名后接“et al.”，常伴随年份、括号或文献标签；也响应列举相关文献的“see:”格式。另有统计摘要中“under misspecification”的孤立高激活。

patterns.name: 作者-年份式学术引文
patterns.trigger: “et al”及其后的“10”标记，常与作者名、年份和括号或方括号引文相邻；如“Grove et al. 1998”“Bloom et al.”
patterns.context: 学术论文正文中引用研究，尤其是作者名后接 et al. 和年份、文献编号或引用括号。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 与 PubMed Central 的科学论文，涉及天文学、农业、医学、蛋白质研究等。

patterns.name: 文献列表与指引式引用
patterns.trigger: “see:”以及多次出现的“*et al.*”“[@…]”和年份，如“see: Balalaie *et al.* (2003[@bb21])”
patterns.context: 以相关研究或结构为主题，列出多条参考文献；格式常含斜体作者、年份和文献标签。
patterns.domain: 论文中的参考文献指引或相关工作说明，涵盖化学等领域。

patterns.name: 统计学语境中的 under
patterns.context: 出现在摘要中，描述广义贝叶斯推断所处的模型误设条件；此处高激活是孤立现象，未见与其他段相同的引文格式。

en.description: Many activation fragments are academic English, often including the author citation format “et al.” and general paper vocabulary; topics are varied, spanning astrophysics, neuroscience, ophthalmology, biology, sensor engineering, and statistics, with no single field-specific theme explaining all of them.

patterns.name: Abbreviated author names in academic citations
patterns.context: et al. follows an author’s name, often accompanied by a year, parentheses, or a reference; this phrase appears in multiple passages.

patterns.name: English articles and common academic collocations
patterns.context: These high-frequency words are embedded in ordinary English sentences, often in academic prose; specific trigger positions are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Astronomical and high-energy physics terminology
patterns.context: Scientific contexts involving black holes, astronomical spectra, stars, or nuclear reactions.

patterns.name: Neuroscience and synaptic plasticity terminology
patterns.context: Discusses STDP, synaptic efficacy, and its long-term changes in the brain.

patterns.name: Acuity and near vision
patterns.context: Compares visual acuity with near-vision function and mentions reading books or newspapers.

patterns.name: Genetic epistasis and influenza proteins
patterns.context: Describes epistatic interactions in coupled sites and protein measurements.

patterns.name: Sensor data collection
patterns.context: Describes reducing energy consumption during sensor data collection and includes several sensor literature citations.

patterns.name: Bayesian inference abstract phrasing
patterns.context: An abstract opens by stating the research topic and model setup.

1_3058.description: 激活片段多为学术英语，常见作者引用格式“et al.”及一般论文用词；题材分散，涵盖天体物理、神经科学、眼科、生物学、传感器工程和统计学，未见单一领域主题能解释全部。

patterns.name: 学术引用中的作者名缩写
patterns.context: 作者姓名后接 et al.，常伴随年份、括号或文献引用；该短语在多段中出现

patterns.name: 英语冠词与常见学术搭配
patterns.context: 这些高频词嵌在正常英文句子中，常见于学术叙述；具体触发位置并不一致

patterns.name: 天体与高能物理术语
patterns.context: 涉及黑洞、天体光谱、恒星或核反应的科学上下文
patterns.domain: 天体物理与核物理论文

patterns.name: 神经科学与突触可塑性术语
patterns.context: 讨论 STDP、突触效能及其在脑中的长期改变

patterns.name: 视力与近距离阅读
patterns.context: 比较视觉 acuity 与近距离视觉功能，提及阅读书籍或报纸

patterns.name: 遗传上位性与流感蛋白
patterns.context: 说明耦合位点及蛋白测量中的上位性相互作用

patterns.name: 传感器数据采集
patterns.context: 描述降低传感器数据采集过程能耗，并附多条传感器文献引用

patterns.name: 贝叶斯推断摘要措辞
patterns.context: 论文摘要开头陈述研究主题及模型设定

en.concept: Academic paper text markers and citations
en.description: Activation is distributed across academic paper contexts, commonly including abstract/introduction/figure structure markers and author/reference citation formats; the body topics vary widely, including astrophysics, biology, mathematical statistics, and computer vision, making a single-topic explanation difficult.

patterns.name: Academic paper structure markers
patterns.context: At the beginning of a paper abstract or introduction, and near figure citations in the body; the structure markers themselves activate, while body content varies

patterns.name: Black holes and accretion in astrophysics
patterns.context: When discussing high-energy radiation, Galactic black hole candidates, accretion disks, or observations of outbursts; some instances contain only black-hole-related words

patterns.name: Author formatting in literature citations
patterns.context: When citing researchers in the body, usually following author names and possibly accompanied by a year or bracketed citation marker

patterns.name: Reference markers and bibliography keys
patterns.context: LaTeX/BibTeX-style bibliography keys appear in the body or immediately adjacent to a citation; the same segment may also contain ordinary literature descriptions

patterns.name: Biological species and research subjects
patterns.context: Introduces plant species, crops, or protein interactions in an introduction or research background

patterns.name: Methods and theoretical terminology
patterns.context: Introduces statistical inference conditions or mathematical operators in abstracts; no specific content-word pattern shared with other segments is apparent

patterns.name: Motion information and video frames
patterns.context: Reviews recent work and explains approximating motion information using differences between adjacent frames

1_3058.concept: 学术论文文本标记与引用
1_3058.description: 激活分布于学术论文语境，常见摘要/引言/图表结构标记、作者与文献引用格式；正文主题跨度很大，包括天体物理、生物学、数学统计及计算机视觉，难以由单一主题解释。

patterns.name: 学术论文结构标记
patterns.context: 论文摘要或引言开头，以及正文中的图表引用附近；结构标记本身有激活，正文内容多样

patterns.name: 天体物理中的黑洞与吸积
patterns.context: 讨论高能辐射、银河系黑洞候选体、吸积盘或爆发源观测时；有些实例仅出现黑洞相关词语

patterns.name: 文献引用中的作者格式
patterns.context: 正文引用研究者时，通常跟随作者姓名，并可能带年份或方括号引用标记

patterns.name: 参考文献标记与文献键
patterns.context: 正文引用或紧邻引用处出现 LaTeX/BibTeX 风格的文献键；同一段也可能包含普通文献叙述

patterns.name: 生物学物种与研究对象
patterns.context: 引言或研究背景中介绍植物物种、作物或蛋白质相互作用
patterns.domain: 植物学、农业、生物学论文

patterns.name: 方法与理论术语
patterns.context: 摘要中介绍统计推断条件或数学算子；未见与其他段落共享的特定内容词模式
patterns.domain: 统计学与数学论文摘要

patterns.name: 运动信息与视频帧
patterns.context: 回顾近期工作，说明以相邻帧差异近似运动信息

en.description: The most stable shared cue is the author—et al.—year citation and surrounding citation formatting in academic papers; there are also astrophysics topics, cross-disciplinary research terminology, and numerical enumerations. broad also appears in astronomical spectral-line and material-bandgap contexts, but with different meanings.

patterns.name: Authors and years in paper references
patterns.context: In academic paper text or citations, an author surname is followed by “et al.” and a year; activation often falls near al or the period.
patterns.domain: ArXiv and PubMed Central academic literature

patterns.name: Broadband/spectral-line emission in high-energy astrophysics
patterns.context: When discussing black-hole candidates or X-ray spectra, broad describes a spectrum or emission line.

patterns.name: Special markers and numbering in academic citations
patterns.context: Near citations, reference indices, or figure and table citations; these markers co-occur with author–year citations.

patterns.name: Enumerated entities and values in scientific text
patterns.context: Academic prose lists astronomical objects, years, energy ranges, or measurement conditions; no stable shared trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Biomedical and biological research terminology
patterns.context: Research reports describe experimental subjects, phenomena, or prior studies, often accompanied by author–year citations.

patterns.name: Supernovae and stellar names
patterns.context: Astronomical catalogs or observational papers list supernovae, stars, and their designations.

patterns.name: Galaxy structure and redshift surveys
patterns.context: Compares spatial structure, velocity dispersion, and other observational properties across survey fields.

patterns.name: Non-astronomical uses of broadband/band
patterns.context: Quantum-well and quantum-dot materials research discusses tuning the bandgap; this differs from the astronomical broad band context.

1_3058.concept: 学术论文引用邻近模式
1_3058.description: 最稳定的共同线索是学术论文中的作者—et al.—年份引用及周边引文格式；另有天体物理主题、跨学科研究术语与数值列举。broad 在天体谱线和材料带隙语境中也出现，但含义不同。

patterns.name: 论文参考文献中的作者与年份
patterns.context: 学术论文正文或引用中，作者姓氏后接“et al.”及年份；激活常落在 al 或句点附近。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 与 PubMed Central 学术文献

patterns.name: 高能天体物理中的宽带/谱线辐射
patterns.trigger: “broad band high energy emission spectra”“broad emission lines”
patterns.context: 讨论黑洞候选体或 X 射线光谱时，出现 broad 描述能谱或发射线。

patterns.name: 学术引用中的特殊标记与编号
patterns.context: 引文、文献索引或图表引用附近；这些标记与作者—年份引用并存。

patterns.name: 科学文本中的列举式实体及数值
patterns.context: 学术叙述中列出天体、年份、能量范围或测量条件；未见稳定的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 生物医学与生物学研究术语
patterns.context: 研究报告描述实验对象、现象或已有研究，并常伴随作者—年份引用。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、材料与生物学

patterns.name: 超新星与恒星名称
patterns.context: 天体目录或观测论文中列举超新星、恒星及其编号。

patterns.name: 星系结构与红移巡天
patterns.context: 比较不同巡天视场中的空间结构、速度弥散等观测特征。

patterns.name: 非天文学的宽带/能带用法
patterns.context: 量子阱与量子点材料研究中，讨论调节带隙；与天文学中的 broad band 语境不同。

en.concept: Proper names and citations in academic papers
en.description: Activates in formatted academic papers, especially astronomical texts involving celestial terminology, object identifiers, observational or theoretical accounts, and citations; also responds to titles, acronym definitions, and citations, methods, and crop introductions in interdisciplinary papers.

patterns.name: Astrophysical and observational object names
patterns.context: Occurs in astronomical paper narratives, often alongside object names, physical processes, observational results, or model descriptions; it is not triggered by a single word in these terms.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, observational astronomy, and cosmology papers

patterns.name: Literature citations in astronomy papers
patterns.context: Cites prior studies, authors, and years, often after descriptions of objects or research results; this pattern also appears in agronomy and crystallography papers.

patterns.name: Author names and reference formats
patterns.context: Activation spans multiple parts of author surnames, et al., and numeric years or reference markers; it is not necessarily limited to one discipline.

patterns.name: Numbers and alphanumeric identifiers in proper names
patterns.context: Numbers and alphanumeric strings are embedded in celestial names, source identifiers, or years; nearby context identifies objects or describes event dates.
patterns.domain: Astronomical object naming and academic narratives

patterns.name: Paper section headings
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of papers or around titles and section boundaries; activation falls on headings and some adjacent formatting markers.

patterns.name: Definitions or abbreviations following proper names
patterns.context: An object name or abbreviation is introduced first, followed by hereafter to establish a shorter name used later.

patterns.name: Interdisciplinary scientific methods and experimental/computational descriptions
patterns.context: Describes computations or methods performed according to established protocols, with citations; unrelated to astrophysical subject matter.

patterns.name: Crop introductions and yield descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces a crop’s importance, cultivation range, or yield, accompanied by author–year citations; activation is concentrated near the crop name.

1_3058.concept: 学术论文中的专名与引文
1_3058.description: 激活见于格式化学术论文，尤其天文学文本中的天体术语、对象编号、观测或理论叙述及引文；也响应标题、简称定义和跨学科论文中的引文、方法、作物介绍。

patterns.name: 天体物理与观测对象名称
patterns.trigger: “black hole”“galactic”“star”“SNe”“Hubble Deep Field”“gravitational entropy”“AM E”“accretion disk”等天体、天文现象或观测对象术语
patterns.context: 处于天文学论文叙述中，常与对象名称、物理过程、观测结果或模型描述相邻；并非这些术语中的某个单词单独触发。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、观测天文学与宇宙学论文

patterns.name: 天文论文中的文献引证
patterns.trigger: “et al.”、“1998”、“1997a”、“[@B16]”及作者名与年份构成的引文
patterns.context: 引用既有研究、作者和年份，常出现在天体或研究结果描述之后；此模式也见于非天文的农学及晶体学论文。

patterns.name: 作者名与参考文献格式
patterns.trigger: “Grove et al. 1998”、“Fox et al. 1998”、“Bond et al. 2003”、“Merrill 1933”、“Gao et al.”、“Tan et al.”等作者—引文片段
patterns.context: 激活覆盖作者姓氏、et al. 和数字年份或文献标记的多个部分；未必局限于某个学科。
patterns.domain: 跨学科的学术引文文本

patterns.name: 专名中的数字与字母数字编号
patterns.context: 数字和字母数字串嵌在天体名称、来源编号或年份中；相邻上下文为对象识别或事件年代说明。
patterns.domain: 天文学对象命名与学术叙述

patterns.name: 论文结构标题
patterns.context: 出现在论文开头或标题、章节边界处；激活落在标题及部分紧邻格式标记。

patterns.name: 专名之后的定义或简称说明
patterns.context: 先给出对象名称或缩写，再用 hereafter 引入下文简称。
patterns.domain: 学术论文中的术语定义

patterns.name: 跨学科科学方法与实验/计算描述
patterns.context: 描述计算或方法依照既有协议执行，并附引文；与天体物理主题无关。

patterns.name: 农作物介绍与产量描述
patterns.trigger: “a … is an important food crop cultivated in over 100 countries”“Its high yielding”
patterns.context: 介绍作物的重要性、种植范围或产量，伴随作者—年份引文；主要激活集中在作物名称附近。

en.concept: Astrophysics terminology and formatting in scientific papers
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in scientific paper contexts, especially astrophysics topics such as galaxies, stars, black-hole accretion, supernovae, and observational analysis; they also cover paper titles, figure and table markers, and author–year citations. There is also one passage on computational chemistry methods.

patterns.name: Galaxy and stellar research in astrophysics
patterns.context: Discusses stellar populations, star formation, galaxy structure, or observational properties; commonly found in paper introductions, abstracts, and results sections.

patterns.name: Accretion and black holes in astrophysics
patterns.context: Discusses accretion of matter, accretion disks, black-hole candidates, and related high-energy observations.

patterns.name: Supernovae and astronomical names in astrophysics
patterns.context: Lists supernovae or unusual stars alongside literature years and authors; trigger words often occur in astronomical names and citations.

patterns.name: Academic paper section headings and formatting
patterns.context: Near paper section headings, chapter markers, figure numbers, or methods-section headings.

patterns.name: Scientific paper citation formatting
patterns.context: Near author–year citations and reference parentheses; co-occurs with astrophysics literature content.

patterns.name: Computational method markers in chemistry papers
patterns.context: Supplementary-material-style sections on chemical structures or schemes mention Hirshfeld surface calculations and protocols.

patterns.name: Galaxy kinematics and mass estimation
patterns.context: Reports galaxy velocity dispersion, radial variation, and tracer-based mass estimates.

1_3058.concept: 科学论文中的天体物理术语与格式
1_3058.description: 激活主要集中于科学论文语境，尤其是天体物理中星系、恒星、黑洞吸积、超新星及观测分析；也覆盖论文标题、图表标记、作者年份引文。另有一段化学计算方法文本。

patterns.name: 天体物理中的星系与恒星研究
patterns.context: 讨论星系的恒星族、恒星形成、星系结构或观测性质；常见于论文引言、摘要及结果段。

patterns.name: 天体物理中的吸积与黑洞
patterns.context: 讨论物质吸积、吸积盘、黑洞候选体及相关高能观测。

patterns.name: 天体物理中的超新星与天体名称
patterns.context: 列举超新星或特殊恒星及文献年份、作者；触发词多处于天体名称和引文中。

patterns.name: 学术论文结构标题与格式
patterns.context: 论文段落标题、章节标记、图号或方法部分标题附近。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，主要为天体物理

patterns.name: 科学论文引文格式
patterns.context: 作者—年份式引用及参考文献括号附近；与天体物理文献内容并存。

patterns.name: 化学论文中的计算方法标记
patterns.context: 化学结构或方案的补充材料式章节中，提及 Hirshfeld 表面计算与协议。

patterns.name: 星系运动学与质量估算
patterns.context: 报告星系的速度弥散、径向变化及示踪质量估算。

en.description: Activates mainly in astrophysics papers, covering galaxies, stars, black holes, gas accretion, supernovae, and observational projects; one passage from an animal behavior introduction has a different topic.

patterns.name: Galaxy stellar populations and near-infrared spectra
patterns.context: Discusses the use of the near-infrared to probe galaxy stellar populations and predictions of stellar models for their contributions to spectra.

patterns.name: Black hole accretion and high-energy radiation

1_3058.description: 激活跨天体物理与神经科学文本：前者涉及恒星、星系、宇宙学及黑洞吸积辐射；后者集中于皮质脊髓束等运动神经通路。各组以领域术语为触发线索。

en.description: Responds mainly to galaxy, star formation, feedback, black hole, and observational vocabulary in astrophysics papers, and also to paper abstract formats; there are also passages on gravitational entropy theory and an evolutionary biology example, which do not fit a single narrow topic.

patterns.name: Astrophysics and cosmology research contexts
patterns.context: Occurs in research paper abstracts or body text discussing galaxies, star formation, galaxy clusters, black holes, cosmological models, and observational evidence; no particular fixed term or syntactic position is required.

patterns.name: Stellar populations and star formation
patterns.context: Discusses stellar composition in galaxies, star formation activity, or stellar evolution and its impact on observed spectra.

patterns.name: Feedback mechanisms in galaxy formation
patterns.context: Treats feedback or hot gas as a component of galaxy formation models and connects it to observations or model interpretation.

patterns.name: Astronomical facilities and radio properties
patterns.context: Mentions a specific observing satellite or lists the radio properties of celestial objects with literature citations; the pattern need not relate to the same observing band.

patterns.name: Black hole entropy and gravitational theory
patterns.context: The title and abstract discuss the definition or validity of gravitational entropy for black holes, rather than galaxy observations.

patterns.name: Evolutionary convergence and molecular-level biological examples
patterns.context: Uses morphological or molecular-level examples to illustrate similar evolutionary problems and convergent outcomes.
patterns.domain: Biology, evolutionary biology PubMed Central papers

patterns.name: Astronomical observation case: black hole accretion disk and emission lines
patterns.context: Describes observations of emission lines or line profiles in a specific galaxy, suggesting an accretion disk around a supermassive black hole.

patterns.name: Abstract and research-statement formats
patterns.context: Occurs near paper abstracts, titles, or statements of research aims; it may co-occur with astrophysical content but cannot by itself explain all activations.

en.description: Activations are scattered across segmented proper nouns/abbreviations, fluid mechanics terminology, stellar spectra and star-formation terminology, abstract-style research phrasing, and biological species names; no shared semantic pattern explains all fragments.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation falls inside segmented proper nouns or abbreviations, often adjacent to citations, author names, or institutional names; the fragments vary across word forms, with no unified semantic condition apparent.
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic body text and author/reference text

patterns.name: Fluid mechanics terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of RANS flow solutions, velocity fields, and pressure fields.

patterns.name: Astrophysics and stellar terminology

en.description: Activations fall on subword fragments within terms from different fields: Majorana, Stokes, Dhyana, X-ray, Stieltjes, stress, and erg; there are also the number 10 and broad. Apart from a shared “ana” fragment, there is no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Fragment within the term Majorana

patterns.domain: Theoretical physics, particle physics, and condensed matter physics

patterns.name: Ending of the acronym RANS
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the Navier–Stokes equation name, near mentions of RANS flow solutions, velocity, and pressure fields.
patterns.domain: Fluid mechanics, machine learning application papers

patterns.name: Name fragment in Dhyana
patterns.context: Occurs within the actor’s name Dhyana in a cast list; there is no evident physics or technical context.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in X-ray
patterns.context: Occurs in X-ray, near discussion of redshift, galaxy clusters, and scaling relations.

patterns.name: Ending fragment in Stieltjes
patterns.context: Occurs within the mathematical term Stieltjes-type, in a discussion of quark vacuum polarization.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in stress

patterns.name: Fragment in the unit of excitation energy
patterns.context: A word-internal part of the physical unit erg, occurring near luminosity expressions for high-redshift objects.

patterns.name: Anomalous activation in an SFR numeric expression

patterns.name: Dipole interaction context

1_3058.description: 激活多落在不同领域术语的词内片段：Majorana、Stokes、Dhyana、X-ray、Stieltjes、stress、erg；另有数字10与broad。除相似的“ana”片段外，缺少统一语义模式。

patterns.name: RANS 缩写末尾

patterns.domain: 流体力学、机器学习应用论文

patterns.name: Dhyana 人名片段

patterns.name: X-ray 词内片段

patterns.name: 偶极相互作用语境

en.description: The strongest activations often fall on internal fragments of cross-domain technical terms or proper nouns, such as rickets, Stokes, Majorana, Stieltjes, Dhyana, and reappraisal, as well as the numerical symbol ±; weaker activations are often sporadic common words. A unified semantic trigger cannot be confirmed.

patterns.name: rickets fragment within an English word
patterns.context: The full word is “rickets,” occurring in medical discussion of rickets, its causes, phosphorus metabolism, or vitamin D; activation covers only the latter part of the word.

patterns.name: RANS fragment within an English word
patterns.context: Occurs in the fluid mechanics term “Reynolds Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) flow solutions”; activation covers a word fragment at the end of a compound proper name.

patterns.name: Name fragment within an English word
patterns.context: Forms the name “Dhyana Madan,” appearing in a cast list.

patterns.name: Technical term fragment within an English word
patterns.context: Occurs in an abstract on topological superconductors and Majorana Kramers pairs.

patterns.name: Proper noun fragment within an English word
patterns.context: Occurs in the mathematical term “Stieltjes type.”

patterns.name: Numerical unit fragment within an English word
patterns.context: Located in the error expression for a redshift measurement, representing the plus/minus sign.

patterns.name: Psychology word fragment within an English word
patterns.context: Occurs in psychology or neuroscience discussion of prefrontal cortex and amygdala regulation.

patterns.name: Weak generalization to common function words
patterns.context: In a few passages, common prepositions or auxiliary verbs are weakly activated; no stable shared context emerges.

patterns.name: Ordinary words and phrases with weak activation
patterns.context: Appear sporadically in texts from different fields, with low intensity and no inferable shared trigger condition.

1_3058.description: 最强激活多落在跨领域专业词或专名的内部片段，如 rickets、Stokes、Majorana、Stieltjes、Dhyana、reappraisal，另有数值符号±；弱激活多为零散常见词。无法确认统一语义触发。

en.concept: The subword fragment forming, with sporadic word-form and proper-name triggers
en.description: Activations mainly fall on the subword fragment forming in different words: star-forming, Fourier-transforming, and transforming growth factor; there are also the ending of the word for rickets and internal fragments of the proper names Stieltjes and Majorana.

patterns.name: Stieltjes proper-name segmentation
patterns.context: A physics abstract discusses a function type describing quark vacuum polarization as a function of external momentum; strong activation falls on an internal subword fragment of the proper name Stieltjes.

patterns.name: Rickets-related word ending
patterns.context: The final subword of the word rickets; occurs in descriptions of a disease caused by loss of PHEX function and in accounts related to phosphate metabolism and vitamin D deficiency.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of the proper name Majorana
patterns.context: A topological superconducting qubit abstract mentions Majorana zero modes / Kramers pairs; activation falls on an internal fragment of the proper name.

patterns.name: Word ending related to galaxy formation
patterns.context: An astronomy abstract describes a galaxy or galaxy sample forming stars; activation falls on the compound word forming.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in Fourier transform
patterns.context: Discusses PDEs in inhomogeneous systems and states that eigenmodes cannot be obtained via Fourier transform; the forming fragment is activated, but the context does not concern star formation.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in TGF-beta
patterns.context: The word forming is part of transforming in the name transforming growth factor beta; it does not describe star formation.

1_3058.concept: 词片段 forming，兼有零散词形/专名触发
1_3058.description: 激活主要落在不同词中的 forming 子词片段：恒星形成、Fourier-transforming 和 transforming growth factor；另有佝偻病词尾，以及 Stieltjes、Majorana 专名内部片段。

patterns.name: Stieltjes 专名切分
patterns.context: 物理学摘要中讨论夸克真空极化随外部动量变化的函数类型；强激活落在专名 Stieltjes 的内部子词片段。

patterns.name: 佝偻病相关词尾
patterns.context: 佝偻病一词的末尾子词；分别出现在 PHEX 功能缺失导致的疾病描述，以及磷代谢、维生素 D 缺乏相关叙述中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与医学文献

patterns.name: Majorana 专名中段
patterns.context: 拓扑超导量子比特摘要中出现 Majorana 零模／Kramers 对；激活落在专名内部片段。

patterns.name: 星系形成相关词尾

patterns.name: Fourier 变换词内片段

patterns.context: 转化生长因子 beta 的名称中，forming 作为 transforming 的组成部分；不是描述恒星形成。

en.concept: forming subword fragments and sporadic terms
en.description: The most stable cue is the within-word fragment forming, commonly found in transforming and also in star-forming; other sporadic activations include Stieltjes, the author-name fragment al, fragments of astronomical project names, and flow-field prediction terminology. No unified semantic explanation is apparent.

patterns.name: transforming word forms
patterns.context: Activations cluster on the within-word fragments in transforming / forming; they occur in proper names, technical terms, or compounds, and are not limited to a single domain.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, astronomy, and general academic texts

patterns.name: Stieltjes name fragment
patterns.context: In the mathematical term “Stieltjes type”, activation falls on different subword fragments within the proper name.

patterns.name: Fourier transforming word fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in discussions of Fourier transforms of partial differential equations; activation is on the within-word fragment in transforming.

patterns.name: Suffix of a model-name abbreviation
patterns.context: In an author-name citation for a materials simulation method, activation falls on the fragment “al”; it has no obvious semantic connection to transforming word forms.

patterns.name: KMOS instrument-name fragment
patterns.context: A substring within the proper name of an astronomical survey project is activated in a sentence discussing observations of galaxy clusters.

patterns.name: CNN flow-field prediction terminology
patterns.context: Describes a CNN predicting velocity and pressure fields for unseen flow conditions and geometries; multiple content words are activated, which the transforming pattern cannot explain.

1_3058.concept: forming 词内片段及零散词项
1_3058.description: 最稳定的线索是词内片段 forming，常见于 transforming，也见于 star-forming；另有 Stieltjes、作者名 al、天文项目名片段及流场预测术语等零散激活，缺乏统一语义解释。

patterns.name: transforming 词形
patterns.context: 激活集中在 transforming / forming 的词内片段；用于专名、术语或复合词中，并非只限于某一领域。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、天文学及一般学术文本

patterns.name: Stieltjes 名称片段
patterns.context: 数学术语 “Stieltjes type” 中，激活落在专名内部不同子词片段。

patterns.name: Fourier transforming 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在对偏微分方程作 Fourier 变换的论述中；激活在 transforming 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 模型名称缩写尾部
patterns.context: 材料模拟方法的作者名引用中，激活落在 “al” 片段；与 transforming 词形无明显语义联系。

patterns.name: KMOS 仪器名片段
patterns.context: 天文巡天项目专名内部的子串被激活，所在句讨论星系团观测。

patterns.name: CNN 流场预测术语
patterns.context: 描述 CNN 对未见流动条件和几何形状预测速度、压力场；多个内容词激活，无法由 transforming 模式解释。

en.concept: Subword fragments of rare technical terms
en.description: Activations often fall within or at the end of subwords in technical terms, proper names, or compounds across fluid mechanics, physics, astronomy, medicine, and materials science; triggers are not limited to a single discipline and often occur in fragments of rare words split into subwords.

patterns.name: Navier–Stokes token fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in a technical context describing RANS flow solutions; strong activation falls on the split ending token «okes».

patterns.name: Stieltjes word-ending fragment
patterns.context: The vacuum polarization function is described as a Stieltjes-type function of external momentum q²; activation is concentrated on the split token of the proper name.

patterns.name: “tail” fragments in astronomical terms
patterns.context: Subword fragments in astronomical proper names or terms, including instrument names, survey names, lensing, reddening, line of sight, and gamma rays; not all fragments activate equally strongly.

patterns.name: Medical term endings
patterns.context: Activation falls on endings or subwords of medical vocabulary in disease names, hair types, and biopsy descriptions.

patterns.name: PDE operation ending
patterns.context: In a discussion of obtaining eigenmodes from partial differential equations in inhomogeneous systems, activation occurs on the suffix token of a compound verb.

patterns.name: Author surname fragment in a material name
patterns.context: Author surnames and citation abbreviations activate strongly in citations for an effective force field used in molecular dynamics simulations.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a personal name
patterns.context: A researcher’s name in a list of immunology projects; activation is concentrated on the final token of the split name.

1_3058.concept: 罕见专业词的子词片段
1_3058.description: 激活多落在专业术语、专名或复合词的内部/词尾子词：流体、物理、天文、医学、材料领域及人名中均有；触发条件并不局限于单一学科，常见于被拆分的罕见词片段。

patterns.name: Navier–Stokes 分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在描述 RANS 流动解的技术语境中；强激活落在被拆分的词尾 token «okes»。

patterns.name: Stieltjes 词尾片段
patterns.context: 真空极化函数被描述为外部动量 q² 的 Stieltjes 类型函数；激活集中在拼写被拆分的专名 token。

patterns.name: 天体术语中的「尾」片段
patterns.context: 天文学专名或术语的子词片段，包括仪器名、巡天名、透镜、颜色变红及视线、伽马射线等；并非每个片段强度相同。

patterns.name: 医学术语词尾
patterns.context: 在疾病名称、毛发类型及活检描述中，激活落于医学词汇的词尾或子词。

patterns.name: PDE 操作词尾
patterns.context: 讨论非均匀系统中由偏微分方程求本征模态时，激活出现在复合动词的后缀 token。

patterns.name: 材料名称中的作者姓氏片段
patterns.context: 分子动力学模拟所用有效力场的引文中，作者姓氏及引用缩写出现较强激活。

patterns.name: 人名内部片段
patterns.context: 免疫研究项目列表中的研究者姓名；激活集中在人名拆分后的末段 token。

en.description: The clearest repeated pattern is “line(s) of sight” in astronomy texts; the remaining activations are scattered across different substrings of scientific terms, proper names, common words, and citation markers. No consistent trigger condition is apparent, and a single semantic pattern cannot explain them.

patterns.name: Line-of-sight / spectral-line terminology
patterns.context: In astrophysics texts, the phrase “line(s) of sight” describes an observation path; the final word sight in this phrase is marked as strongly activated.

patterns.name: Specific substrings in proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on substrings within proper names, technical terms, or across-word fragments; they involve different word forms and spelling positions, with no shared meaning or positional condition.
patterns.domain: Physics, mathematics, biomedicine, and academic citations

patterns.name: Other sporadic word fragments in scientific texts
patterns.context: Activations fall separately on a fluid-mechanics abbreviation, descriptive words, document titles, and astrophysics terminology. No shared local collocation or stable contextual condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Interdisciplinary scientific papers, medical abstracts, and document structure

patterns.name: Other weak and scattered activations
patterns.context: The same passage contains several additional lower-intensity activations, distributed across common words, stem fragments, and citation markers; it is unclear whether they belong to the main trigger pattern.

1_3058.description: 最清楚的重复模式是天文学文本中的“line(s) of sight”；其余激活分散在科学术语、专名、普通词及引用标记的不同子串上，尚无一致的触发条件，不能用单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 视线/谱线术语
patterns.context: 天体物理文本中，短语“line(s) of sight”用于描述观测路径；该短语末尾的 sight 被标记为强激活。
patterns.domain: 天文学、天体物理研究论文

patterns.name: 专有名词中的特定子串
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、术语或跨词片段内部的子串上；涉及不同词形和拼写位置，未见统一的词义或位置条件。
patterns.domain: 物理、数学、生物医学及学术引用

patterns.name: 科学文本中其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 激活分别落在流体力学缩写、描述性词语、文档标题和天体物理术语上，未发现共同的局部搭配或稳定上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 跨学科科学论文、医学摘要和文档结构

patterns.name: 其余弱而分散的激活
patterns.context: 同一段中另有多个强度较低的激活，分布在普通词、词干片段和引用标记上；无法确定其是否属于主要触发模式。

en.concept: ana strings in names and words, with sporadic subwords
en.description: The most stable cue is the ana/Rana letter fragment in names or within words, found in personal names, company names, place names, and disease names. Other activations are scattered across paper terminology, common words, and list formatting, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Rana surname fragment
patterns.context: The Rana/Rana- string embedded in personal or institutional names; surrounding letters and capitalization vary, but the fragment recurs.
patterns.domain: Entries, paper author lists, company or institution names

patterns.name: Ana syllable in place names and proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on letter fragments within proper names, possibly part of a place name, disease name, or other name; superficially similar to the Rana surname pattern, but the terms differ.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries and public health reports

patterns.name: Within-word ana fragment and spelling boundaries
patterns.context: Activation occurs within longer words or names, with some words split by tokenization boundaries; beyond ana, the other marked fragments have no shared lexical or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, author lists, legal texts

patterns.name: Sporadic technical-term subwords
patterns.context: Parts of several terms in technical texts are marked, with no consistent semantic category or fixed collocation.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, condensed matter physics, astronomy, and fluid mechanics

patterns.name: Sporadic common words or syntactic fragments
patterns.context: These markers are scattered across different sentence positions and semantic categories and cannot be explained by a shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Paper abstracts and public health articles

patterns.name: Reference/list formatting
patterns.context: Activations occur in formats dense with proper names, such as author lists or company names; only some highlighted spans correspond to the recurring ana/Rana fragment.
patterns.domain: Paper author lists, legal and company-name lists

1_3058.concept: 名称及词内 ana 字符串，伴随零散子词
1_3058.description: 最稳定线索是名称或词内的 ana/Rana 字母片段，见于人名、公司名、地名及疾病名；其余激活散落于论文术语、普通词和名单格式，缺少统一触发条件。

patterns.name: Rana 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 嵌在个人姓名或机构名称中的 Rana/Rana- 字符串；前后字母和大小写不同，但该片段反复出现。
patterns.domain: 条目、论文作者名单、公司或机构名称

patterns.name: 地名/专名中的 ana 音节
patterns.context: 激活落在专名内部的字母片段，可能是地名、疾病名或名称的一部分；与 Rana 姓氏模式有表面相似，但词项并不相同。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、公共卫生报道

patterns.name: 词内ana片段及拼写边界
patterns.trigger: «ana»（Major«ana» K«ram»ers）；«ana»（Verinder S. R«ana»）；以及«der»、«redd»、«led»等词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在较长词或姓名的内部，部分词被分词边界拆开；除 ana 外，其他被标记片段缺乏共同词汇或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、作者名单、法律文本

patterns.name: 零散技术术语子词
patterns.context: 技术文本中若干术语的内部或组成部分被标记，未显示一致的语义类别或固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、凝聚态物理、天文学、流体力学

patterns.name: 零散一般词或句法片段
patterns.context: 这些标记分散在不同句子位置和语义类别中，无法由共同触发条件解释。
patterns.domain: 论文摘要、公共卫生文章

patterns.name: 参考文献/名单格式
patterns.context: 激活出现在作者名单或公司名等专名密集的列举格式中；其中只有部分高亮可与反复出现的 ana/Rana 片段对应。
patterns.domain: 论文作者名单、法律及公司名称列表

en.description: Activations concentrate on several word-form fragments: sight in the astronomy phrase “line of sight,” the suffix ickets in the medical word rickets, and ana in the proper names Lana and Haryana; these patterns span different fields, with one additional unexplained passage.

patterns.name: sight in the phrase “line of sight”
patterns.context: In astronomy or radio astronomy contexts, describes properties of an object along the line of sight; in both passages, the final word “sight” in the phrase activates strongly.

patterns.name: Subword in the disease word rickets
patterns.context: The name of rickets appears in medical texts; the trigger is the word suffix “ickets”.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, clinical medicine, and medical reviews

patterns.name: Lana in a name
patterns.context: The substring Lana in a proper name or organization name; contexts include a list of names and an airline name.

patterns.name: Suffix in the place name Haryana
patterns.context: The Indian place name Haryana; occurs in contexts describing an industrial development agency or gotra distribution, with strong activation on “ana”.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, Indian geography and society

1_3058.description: 激活集中于若干词形片段：天文学短语“line of sight”的 sight、医学词 rickets 的后缀 ickets，以及专名中的 Lana、Haryana 的 ana；这些模式领域各异，另有一段无法解释。

patterns.name: 短语 “line of sight” 中的 sight
patterns.context: 天文学或射电天文学语境中，描述观测对象沿视线方向的性质；在两个片段里均是短语末尾的 “sight” 强激活。

patterns.name: 疾病词 rickets 的子词
patterns.context: 医学文本中出现佝偻病名称；触发部分是单词后缀 “ickets”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、临床与医学综述

patterns.name: 名称中的 Lana
patterns.context: 专名或机构名称中的 Lana 子串；上下文分别是名称列表和航空公司名称。

patterns.name: 地名 Haryana 的后缀
patterns.context: 印度地名 Haryana；在描述工业开发机构或 gotra 分布的语境中出现，强激活落在 “ana”。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、印度地理与社会

en.concept: biased toward the medical suffix “ickets”; others uncertain
en.description: The clearest repeated pattern is the suffix “ickets” in the disease word “rickets”. Other activations are scattered across astronomical terminology, physics/fluid-mechanics vocabulary, and fragments of proper names; they are sporadic and difficult to group. Encyclopedia-list passages also lack a confirmable shared trigger.

patterns.name: rickets spelling fragment
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the disease name “rickets”; the preceding stem is not activated or marked, with activation concentrated on the suffix substring.

patterns.name: Local fragments in astronomical terms or proper names
patterns.context: In astronomy texts, activation falls on local fragments of astrophysical terminology, observational descriptions, and compound proper names; there is also within-word segmentation, as in “Spectrograph”.

patterns.name: Striped-phase word form
patterns.context: Describes “striped phases” in one-dimensional space; activation is concentrated on “striped”, alongside physics terms such as algebraically localized impurities in the same sentence.

patterns.name: Other scientific terms and paper vocabulary
patterns.context: Occurs separately in equations, descriptions of compressible convection, and flow-field prediction in fluid mechanics; the current sample is insufficient to determine whether these terms share a narrower trigger rule.
patterns.domain: Fluid mechanics and computational science papers

patterns.name: Fragment within a proper name
patterns.context: Occurs within the proper name “Lanaes Aereas Trans Costa Rica” in a list; the activation is a local substring, with no clear connection to other passages.

patterns.name: Unrelated sporadic terms
patterns.context: These activations are scattered across different syntactic positions and may involve within-word fragments, common paper vocabulary, or citation markers; the current examples do not support a unified condition.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, medical texts, and citations

1_3058.concept: 偏向医学词尾“ickets”，其余不确定
1_3058.description: 最明确的重复模式是疾病词“rickets”的词尾“ickets”。其余激活散见于天文术语、物理/流体力学词汇和专名片段；零散且难以归并，百科列表段也缺少可确认的共同触发。

patterns.name: rickets 拼写片段
patterns.context: 出现在疾病名称“rickets”末尾；前面的词干未激活或未标记，触发集中在词尾子串。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、内分泌与营养学

patterns.name: 天文术语或专名中的局部片段
patterns.context: 天文学文本中，激活落在天体物理术语、观测描述及复合专名的局部片段；另有词内切分，如“Spectrograph”。
patterns.domain: 天文学与天体物理学论文

patterns.name: 带状相与条纹词形
patterns.context: 描述一维空间中的“striped phases”；激活集中于“striped”一词，且同句有代数局域杂质等物理术语。

patterns.name: 其他科学词项及论文用语
patterns.context: 分别出现在流体力学中的方程、可压缩对流及流场预测描述；当前样本不足以确认这些词项是否共享更窄的触发规则。
patterns.domain: 流体力学与计算科学论文

patterns.name: 专名内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在列表中的“Lanaes Aereas Trans Costa Rica”专名内，激活是局部子串；与其他段的联系不明。

patterns.name: 无法归并的零散词项
patterns.context: 这些激活分散在不同句法位置，可能涉及词内片段、常见论文词汇或引文标记；现有例子无法支持统一条件。
patterns.domain: 跨科学论文、医学文本及引文

en.description: Activations are scattered across within-word fragments in proper names or technical terms, as well as a few complete domain terms. Visible patterns include Sertoli, rickets, sight, Stokes, star formation, and name fragments, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Within-word segmented token «ana»
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs within a proper name; the fragment itself is not a complete word.

patterns.name: Within-word segmented token «str»
patterns.context: In “striped phases”, the marker covers the word-final «ped», occurring in a physics-paper abstract describing phases.

patterns.name: Disease name “rickets”
patterns.context: Occurs in medical descriptions of causes or clinical consequences; examples concern X-linked hypophosphatemia and vitamin D deficiency.

patterns.name: Support-cell name “Sertoli”
patterns.context: Occurs in research contexts involving testicular germ cells and cell junctions, with a within-word fragment marked.
patterns.domain: Reproductive biology and NIH research abstracts

patterns.name: “sight” in astrophysics
patterns.context: Occurs in an explanation of AGN reddening by dust along the line of sight.

patterns.name: Fluid-mechanics term “Stokes”
patterns.context: Occurs in technical terminology for RANS flow solutions; the trigger is a fragment within a compound proper name.

patterns.name: “ana” fragment in a personal name
patterns.context: Occurs within a researcher’s name in an immunology research-project list.

patterns.name: “formation” in galaxy-formation terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in an astronomical description of star formation in cluster member stars.

1_3058.description: 激活分散在专名或术语的词内片段，以及少数完整领域词上；可见模式包括Sertoli、rickets、视线、Stokes、星形成和姓名片段，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 词内分段 token「ana」
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在专名内部；片段本身不是完整词。

patterns.name: 词内分段 token「str」
patterns.context: 在 “striped phases” 中，标记覆盖词尾 «ped»，出现在物理学论文摘要对相的描述中。

patterns.name: 疾病名「rickets」
patterns.context: 出现在对病因或临床后果的医学描述中；分别涉及 X 连锁低磷血症和维生素 D 缺乏。

patterns.name: 支持细胞名「Sertoli」
patterns.context: 出现在睾丸生殖细胞及细胞连接相关的研究语境中，标记词内片段。
patterns.domain: 生殖生物学、NIH 研究摘要

patterns.name: 天体物理中的「sight」
patterns.context: 出现在 AGN 被尘埃沿视线方向红化的解释中。

patterns.name: 流体力学术语「Stokes」
patterns.context: 出现在 RANS 流动解的技术术语中，触发的是复合专名内部片段。

patterns.name: 人名内片段「ana」
patterns.context: 出现在免疫研究项目列表中的研究者姓名内。

patterns.name: 星系形成术语中的「formation」
patterns.context: 出现在星团成员星形成过程的天文学描述中。

en.concept: local orthographic fragments in heterogeneous scientific texts
en.description: Activations are scattered across letter fragments spanning words, involving astrophysics, rickets and phosphate metabolism, striped phases, cancer risk, fluid mechanics, and encyclopedia proper names. There is no stable single theme; some may be orthographic triggers.

patterns.name: Specific word-final or within-word letter fragments
patterns.context: Activation markers often cover letter fragments within words or across word boundaries rather than complete semantic units; they occur in diverse technical texts.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; paper abstracts, medical texts, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Astrophysics and galaxy observations
patterns.context: Research contexts involving celestial objects, galaxies, accretion disks, dust extinction, interstellar regions, and radio observations; some triggers may also be generic word fragments.

patterns.name: Hypophosphatemic rickets in medicine
patterns.context: Occurs in discussions of PHEX loss of function, FGF23, phosphate metabolism, or related pathophysiological mechanisms; rickets is explicitly mentioned in both passages.

patterns.name: Striped phases in physics research
patterns.context: Effects of algebraically localized impurities on striped phases in one-dimensional space; the pattern occurs only once and may be unrelated to the main trigger.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in name and abbreviation entries
patterns.context: Occurs in the proper name “Lanaes Aereas Trans Costa Rica” in an encyclopedia disambiguation-style list, without a confirmable semantic connection.

patterns.name: Radiation exposure and breast cancer risk models
patterns.context: Lists radiation exposure sites and mentions the Gail model for predicting absolute breast cancer risk.

patterns.name: Flow-field machine learning and fluid mechanics
patterns.context: A CNN predicts velocity and pressure fields under unseen conditions based on object shape, involving RANS flow solutions.

patterns.name: Temperature profiles and self-similar evolution
patterns.context: Discusses temperature-profile measurements, mass estimates, and whether preliminary results agree with self-similar evolution; activation fragments are sporadic.

1_3058.concept: 异质科学文本中的局部字形片段
1_3058.description: 激活分散于跨词字母片段，涉及天体物理、佝偻病与磷代谢、条纹相、癌症风险、流体力学及百科专名；没有稳定的单一主题，部分可能是字形触发。

patterns.name: 词尾或词内的特定字母片段
patterns.context: 激活标记常覆盖跨词边界或词内部的字母片段，而非完整语义单位；分布在多种专业文本中。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；论文摘要、医学文本、百科条目

patterns.name: 天体物理与星系观测
patterns.context: 天体、星系、吸积盘、尘埃消光、星际区域及射电观测等研究语境；若干触发也可能是通用词片段。
patterns.domain: 天文学与天体物理 ArXiv 论文
